PortraitGiverText.text: 从海盗舰队司令托尼·双牙那里夺取生锈的牢笼钥匙。
PortraitGiverText.english: Get the rusted cage key from the pirate admiral, Tony Two-Tusk.

identity.title: Two-Tusk Takedown
identity.objectives: Obtain the Rusted Cage Key.
identity.description: This treasure's all fake, but it's not like those den whompers are going to know the difference. Stupid ogres!$B$BHere's the plan... you head into the Admiral's Den and spread all of this "treasure" around to any ogres that get in your way. Then all you have to do is confront Tony Two-Tusk.$B$BYou'll have the key to the cage in no-time!

PortraitGiverText.text: 从海盗舰队司令托尼·双牙那里夺取生锈的牢笼钥匙。
PortraitGiverText.english: Get the rusted cage key from the pirate admiral, Tony Two-Tusk.

identity.title: Dark Heart
identity.objectives: Slay Edana Hatetalon and obtain Edana's Dark Heart.
identity.description: Edana Hatetalon is the queen of the Northspring harpies that reside in the ruins to the west. It is her malicious will that leads the harpies to defend their nests among the ruins of our people.$B$BThe harpies can call to her with a horn they carry - blowing it by the Hatetalon stones, in the northern part of the ruins, will summon Edana.$B$BShow no mercy for these foul creatures. Slay her, and bring her dark heart to me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 找到邪爪之石，然后吹响号角，她自会出现。
PortraitGiverText.english: Search for the Hatetalon stones, then blast the horn. She will come.

identity.title: Dah, Nunt... Dah, Nunt...
identity.objectives: Budd wants you to use the Booby-Trapped Bait at the Rusty Harpoon Gun in the Skeletal Reef.
identity.description: So, seein' as ya been so kind to me, I'm inclined to let you in on a special secret.$b$bI've found the biggest shiney of all, no more than 50 steps from where we're standin'!$b$bOnly one thing stands between you, me, and great fortune - and his name is Gnaws.$b$bDon't fret now - I've got a plan.$b$bGnaws loves his grubs, so I've loaded one up with that gunpowder so as to make like a trap of sorts, ya see?$b$bJust set it floatin' up in the reef. Once the shark is dead, we're rich!

PortraitGiverText.text: 这片水域不安全！
PortraitGiverText.english: These waters are far from safe!

identity.title: Not Soon Forgotten
identity.objectives: Kill Varkul the Unrelenting.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
identity.description: The Kvaldir leader has shown his rotting, ugly face but a short swim from here, down this hall to our west. We kill him now and the Kvaldir occupation of our once beloved city shall be ended.$B$BBeware Battlemaiden, for he is no weakling. He has many Kvaldir at his command. Some Sira'kess Sea Witches have been dispatched to weaken him during your attack, but they will be interrupted if you let any of his Kvaldir attack them.$B$BShow no mercy, Battlemaiden.

PortraitGiverText.text: 瓦丝琪尔的克瓦迪尔军队首领，瓦尔库是出了名的高傲和悍勇。
PortraitGiverText.english: Leader of the Kvaldir forces in Vashj'ir, Varkul is known for being prideful and fearless.

identity.title: A Prayer and a Wing
identity.objectives: Use the Enormous Bird Call at one of Blaithe's Nests perched atop the Rim of the World. Kill Blaithe and gather one of his Ancient Feathers.
identity.description: A winged visage? Could it be...?$B$B$n, there's no time to waste. You may have been speaking to Aviana herself, trying to return to us.$B$BI'll need something from Aviana's past to reach out to her. High atop the ridge overlooking this shrine, you'll find a series of huge nests belonging to Blaithe, an ancient bird of prey that was once her consort. For ten thousand years he's been mad with grief.$B$BGo to one of his roosts, and use this call to summon him. Kill Blaithe and bring me one of his feathers.

PortraitGiverText.text: 使用巨鸟召唤哨以召唤布雷瑟。
PortraitGiverText.english: Use the Enormous Bird Call to summon Blaithe.

identity.title: DUN-dun-DUN-dun-DUN-dun
identity.objectives: Use Budd's Chain on the Rusty Harpoon Gun in The Skeletal Reef. Fire the Harpoon when Gnaws is in position over the gun.
identity.description: If ol' Gnaws had heels he'd be on 'em right now.$b$bFortunately for you, I think like a shark.$b$bGnaws is mad as all get out and we're gunna use that to our advantage.$b$bHere, I found this chain while out treasure-huntin'. Use it to tie off to that harpoon gun.$b$bWhen Gnaws sees ya he'll be consumed with rage - that's when we strike!$b$bYou try to finish him off and I'll sneak in there and grab the shiney.$b$bHurry, $c, before he grows them teeth back!

PortraitGiverText.text: 这片水域略微安全一些了，不过也不是太安全……
PortraitGiverText.english: It's a little bit safer to go back in these waters, but not much...

identity.title: Some People Just Need Killing
identity.objectives: Slay Chief Prospector Hondo.  Use the Inconspicuous Box to disguise yourself along the way.
identity.description: The tunnel ahead, headin' west, will take you straight to Chief Prospector Hondo's office.  He's the big cheese around here, and Tak'arili's heard tell that he's a darn fine miner.  That's why he's gotta die.$b$bThere's just one problem: the pathway is completely FILLED with those pesky Nethergarde flunkies.  That's why you gotta disguise yourself.  Hop inside this box here, and sneak down the pathway.  Hopefully you won't draw too much suspicion on your way to da killin'.

PortraitGiverText.text: 一个胖男孩，宏多打小就这模样。
PortraitGiverText.english: A chunky boy, Hondo was always picked on as a child.

identity.title: Not Just Any Body
identity.objectives: Find Loramus' Head, Loramus' Torso, and Loramus' Legs.
identity.description: Loramus Thalipedes is dead.  Well, let me step back... that's an assumption on my part, but I do know that his body lies in three pieces.$b$b<Lynnore ponders for a moment.>$b$bIf you bring me the pieces, we still have a recourse.  All three pieces are nearby... the Dreadmaul ogres hide them in their caves.  In fact, one of them is in that chest, down the ledge behind me...

PortraitGiverText.text: 恶魔猎手还活着时的模样。
PortraitGiverText.english: The demon hunter in life.

identity.title: Loramus Thalipedes Awaits
identity.objectives: Speak with Bloodmage Lynnore and participate in her ritual.
identity.description: The enchantment on these amulets was not complex.  Together, their power will grant you access to Razelikh, the amulets' creator.$b$bI am prepared to perform the ritual on you and Loramus.  Speak with me when you are both ready.

identity.title: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
identity.objectives: Speak with the Deathly Usher north of the Rise of the Defiler.  Once atop the Rise, destroy Razelikh's body, then use the Stone Knife of Sealing to imprison his soul.
identity.description: Hero, listen well.$b$bFirst, we must travel to the Deathly Usher, who waits at the northern foot of the Rise of the Defiler, to our northeast.  The usher will take us to the top of the rise.  Once there, I need you to help me defeat Razelikh, for I fear that I am not strong enough to defeat him alone.$b$bMost importantly, I need you to hold the stone knife, and do not use it until I tell you to.  The knife will trap Razelikh's soul within its new, eternal prison.$b$bIf we succeed, speak with Wazzik.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你了解他的真名，这将给他带来灭顶之灾。
PortraitGiverText.english: Your knowledge of his true name shall prove to be his undoing.

identity.title: The Mad Magus
identity.objectives: Extract the soul of Mad Magus Tirth.
identity.description: There's only one ting left dat we can do. Ya gotta slay someone with the big mojo in Tony's presence.$B$BNo, not me!$B$BOl' Magus Tirth went crazy when he tried ta stop the waters rushin' in at the Cataclysm. Now he be hauntin' the area just south of the Holdfast.$B$BTake dis soul stick an' use it on his corpse, mon. Then bring Tony back an' we be gettin' him back in his body.$B$BYa can use me spirit portal ta get down there an' back.

PortraitGiverText.text: 抽取他的魔精。
PortraitGiverText.english: Extract his soul.

identity.title: A Closer Look
identity.objectives: Scout out the crashed ships on the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.
identity.description: We've seen countless ships sail past the shore to the southeast, but most pass by inconspicuously.  Several days ago, however, a powerful storm carried several of the ships to shore and left them wrecked.$b$bI'd bet a pint of Nethergarde Bitter that they were Horde ships if I didn't love Nethergarde Bitter so much.  I can pay you gold, though, if you'll go check out those ships and report back.

AreaDescription.text: 侦查破碎海岸上的船只
AreaDescription.english: Scout the ships on the Shattershore

identity.title: The Downfall of Marl Wormthorn
identity.objectives: Kill Marl Wormthorn at Maldraz in the Blasted Lands.  You can use the Demoniac Vessel to pull him out of his trance.
identity.description: Wormthorn's unnatural forest threatens our excursion's progress.  His trees' roots break our picks, his moss grows over our excavation sites, and his animals attack my men.  When it comes to digging, I'll take a demon-infested wasteland over a forest any day.$b$bTake the demoniac vessel and use it on Marl Wormthorn to pull him from his trance.  Return to me when he is no more.

PortraitGiverText.text: 当恶魔夺走了他的理智，一切希望都破灭了。
PortraitGiverText.english: When the demons took his mind, all hope was lost.

identity.title: Drungeld Glowerglare
identity.objectives: Kill Drungeld Glowerglare and take his beard.
identity.description: The Dark Iron clan is up to no good out here. And if that surprises you, you're thicker than the addled blotters over in that tent. Muradin may pay lip service to those sooty cretins back in Ironforge, but out here all bets are off.$B$BWe had a raid against the camp last night, and one raid is too many. Their leader's a stout fellow by the name of Glowerglare, and he's hiding in the cave on the south bank of the river.$B$BBring me Glowerglare's beard as proof he's no longer a threat to us and Ironforge.

PortraitGiverText.text: 拿到他的胡子。没错，他的胡子。
PortraitGiverText.english: Get his beard.  That's right, his beard.

identity.title: Gerenzo the Traitor
identity.objectives: Kill Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle.
identity.description: <The Gnomecorder comes to life with a loud buzz.>$B$BCome in, $n! Are you zhere? I have noted on ze map that you are near ze Cragpool Lake vater vheel, is that correct?$B$BIt vould appear that ze Venture Co. has holed up at ze vheel. Have a look around vhile you are up zhere. If you happen to zee a traitorous gnome by ze name of Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, put your boot firmly up his keester for me and for Gnomeregan! I vill pay handsomely!

PortraitGiverText.text: 你会收拾那个侏儒的，对吧？
PortraitGiverText.english: You vill be taking care of ze gnome, yes?

PortraitTurnInText.english: You kill vith a passion!  Zuperb!

identity.title: A Bird in Hand
identity.objectives: Extinguish a Harpy Signal Fire to get the attention of Marion Wormwing. Fight her until Thisalee subdues her, then question the harpy matron.
identity.description: It's time to get to the bottom of this. We need to interrogate the matron of these beasts, Marion Wormwing. We'll capture her alive. Here's the plan:$B$BThe harpies communicate across the ridge using a series of signal fires. If we extinguish one, Marion is sure to come investigate.$B$BYou fight her as a distraction while I sneak up behind and grab her. I'll leave the questioning to you. Let's get her, $n!

PortraitGiverText.text: 只需要引她出来，然后开打。我会伺机在后解决剩下的问题。
PortraitGiverText.english: Just lure her out and start fighting. I'll sneak up behind her and take care of the rest.

identity.title: A Bone to Pick
identity.objectives: Budd wants you to collect the Pewter Pounder from King Gurboggle at Gurboggle's Ledge.
identity.description: We did it!$b$bGnaws is down, and I have our shiney!$b$bThat's good news.$b$bDarn shiney is cursed treasure - makes everyone who touches it a skeleton.$b$bThat's bad news.$b$bThese cursed pirates say the Gilblin King has the secret to remove the hex.$b$bThat's good news.$b$bI can't step foot outside the reef or I'll be cursed forever.$b$bThat's bad news.

PortraitGiverText.text: 来试试看啊！
PortraitGiverText.english: Come and get it!

identity.title: Get Zherin!
identity.objectives: Obtain the Horde's Proposal.
identity.description: If we're going to get those oil drilling rights, we need to know what the Horde is offering. How can we win if we can't do them one better?!$B$BTheir negotiator, Trackmaster Zherin, is up there talking with one of their khans right now. Why don't you head up and persuade him to hand over the Horde's proposal?$B$BYou don't have to kill him... we're not savages! Just rough him up a bit.

PortraitGiverText.text: 从他身上拿到部落投标书！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get the Horde's Proposal from him!

identity.title: Get Koalbeard!
identity.objectives: Obtain the Alliance's Proposal.
identity.description: If we're going to get those oil drilling rights, we need to know what the Alliance is offering. How can we win if we can't do them one better?!$B$BTheir negotiator, Kravel Koalbeard, is up there talking with one of their khans right now. Why don't you head up and persuade him to hand over the Alliance's proposal?$B$BYou don't have to kill him... we're not savages! Just rough him up a bit.

PortraitGiverText.text: 从他身上拿到联盟投标书！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get the Alliance's Proposal from him!

identity.title: The Ancient Brazier
identity.objectives: Reignite the Ancient Brazier and obtain the Sacred Flame.
identity.description: What do we have here? A $r? Come to steal our land with your honeyed tongue and promises?$B$BYou do not fool me. I have lived a long time, and I know what dealing with your kind means. But the khans do not listen to their elders like they used to.$B$BSince you are here, I will put you to use. When the waters rushed in, the great water spirit, Aquarian, doused the Ancient Brazier deep inside of Splithoof Hold.$B$BUse this brand to reignite the brazier. Aquarian is sure to come. Bring me the Sacred Flame.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他熄灭了远古火盆！他带着神圣烈焰。
PortraitGiverText.english: He snuffed out the Ancient Brazier! He has the Sacred Flame!

identity.title: Sethria's Demise
identity.objectives: Slay the dragon Sethria. Once she reveals her true form, you will need to use the signal rocket to call in reinforcements!
identity.description: While you've been raiding Sethria's nest, messages have been flying back and forth between here and the shrine. Skylord Omnuron was at first reluctant, but I've persuaded my fellow druids to risk a direct assault on Sethria herself.$B$BEveryone agreed to my plan... provided YOU spearhead the attack.$B$BTake this signal rocket and engage Sethria on the far ridge. When she reveals her true colors and shifts to her dragon form, fire the rocket and backup will arrive to help you!

PortraitGiverText.text: 当她显露出巨龙形态时，立即给我们打出信号！
PortraitGiverText.english: As soon as she reveals her dragon form, signal us for help!

identity.title: Assault on Menethil Keep
identity.objectives: Kill Horghast Flarecrazed.
identity.description: We'd barely pulled ourselves together after the flood when the Dark Iron hit the town. My men and I all rushed to defend the townsfolk, but the crazed fools retreated right into the keep itself.$B$BThey're holed up good, and we can't destroy the keep. Not with half the town in ruins already.$B$BTake my place, $n. I'd take the leader on myself if he hadn't dealt me this blow. Enter the keep, slay Horghast, and bring this to an end!

PortraitGiverText.text: 去击败他！
PortraitGiverText.english: I want him dead!

identity.title: Defend the Drill
identity.objectives: Defend the Oil Drilling Rig.
identity.description: I'm not leaving here empty-handed! Are you?$B$BI bet you were wondering what's in the giant crate. Well, wait no longer. I want you to take one of our drilling rigs to the oil pools and pump us up some crude.$B$BOf course, you should expect the centaurs to attack. Just defend the drill long enough for us to get a barrel or two out of the ground.

identity.title: Defend the Drill
identity.objectives: Defend the Oil Drilling Rig.
identity.description: I'm not leaving here empty-handed! Are you?$B$BI bet you were wondering what's in the giant crate. Well, wait no longer. I want you to take one of our drilling rigs to the oil pools and pump us up some crude.$B$BOf course, you should expect the centaurs to attack. Just defend the drill long enough for us to get a barrel or two out of the ground.

identity.title: Claws from the Deep
identity.objectives: Collect Gobbler's Head from Gobbler and slay 12 Bluegill Murlocs of any kind.
identity.description: Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline.  They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.$B$BOne of these murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other bluegill murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby murloc hovels.  Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.$B$BGobbler prowls the river inlet north of here.  Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他再也不能给我们找麻烦了。
PortraitGiverText.english: He'll trouble us no more.

identity.title: Is This Thing On?
identity.objectives: Kill Master Assassin Kel'istra.
identity.description: <The Gnomecorder crackles with energy. You can hear Lieutenant Paulson on the other end.>$B$BStupid gnome junk... Is ANYBODY there? $n, are you there?$B$BMaybe $g he's:she's; dead.$B$BListen, if you can still hear me, we just got word that a Horde master assassin is in the mines, directing the other assassins. Find her, kill her, report back to me.$B$BPaulson, out.

PortraitGiverText.text: 倒霉的侏儒装置！有人吗？！
PortraitGiverText.english: Damned gnomish contraption!  HELLO?!

identity.title: Go Blow that Horn
identity.objectives: Slay Whrrrl.
identity.description: That old, bitter centaur, Skycaller Vrakthris, mentioned a great air spirit that the centaur worship. To secure the Heights, the last step is for us to deal with this thing.$B$BI've seen them blow the giant horn at the top of the hill up there and an air elemental came down. It gave them orders and then dissipated.$B$BGo blow that horn, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 吹响号角并且击败他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Blow the horn and then slay him!

identity.title: Go Blow that Horn
identity.objectives: Slay Whrrrl.
identity.description: That old, bitter centaur, Skycaller Vrakthris, mentioned a great air spirit that the centaur worship. To secure the Heights, the last step is for us to deal with this thing.$B$BI've seen them blow the giant horn at the top of the hill up there and an air elemental came down. It gave them orders and then dissipated.$B$BGo blow that horn, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 吹响号角并且击败他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Blow the horn and then slay him!

Title.text: 追蹤任務─戈德林串完畢

identity.title: The Ultrasafe Personnel Launcher
identity.objectives: Use the Ultrasafe Personnel Launcher to deploy to Frostmane Retreat.
identity.description: The cataclysm has brought our enemies closer to home, so the chief of Gnomeregan covert operations asked me to build a device to dispatch personnel quickly and quietly to any corner of Dun Morogh.$B$BBehold, the ultrasafe personnel launcher!$B$BWith a jolt of electricity and the benefit of a VLD parachute system, uh, that's 'very late deployment' for you laymen, this baby'll get you to the front in no time. Just hop aboard and prepare for flight! Slamp Wobblecog will be waiting for you in the drop zone.

AreaDescription.text: 使用超安全单兵发射器前往霜鬃营地。
AreaDescription.english: Use Ultrasafe Personnel Launcher to deploy to Frostmane Retreat

identity.title: Yorla Darksnare
identity.objectives: Slay Yorla Darksnare.
identity.description: I've found out who's pulling the strings on this operation here. Yorla Darksnare is directing the Dark Iron dwarves from a camp to the east, and it might've been orders to have the gnolls steal Ironforge's gold in the first place.$B$BWhat's more, she's a wanted criminal... she's been inciting rebellion and attacks against Ironforge since Magni was still alive.$B$BShe can't slip through our fingers this time, $n. Go and get her!

PortraitGiverText.text: 去干掉她！
PortraitGiverText.english: Go an' get her!

identity.title: Save the Sentinel
identity.objectives: Rescue the Feralas Sentinel.
identity.description: <Brienna waves a note around with Taur-ahe markings on it.>$B$BThose monsters have captured one of our sentinels! They're threatening to kill her if we don't pull back!$B$BWe don't negotiate with cowardly beasts! Please, if you can, rescue her before it's too late, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 赶紧把她放出来。
PortraitGiverText.english: Free her before it's too late.

identity.title: The Brave and the Bold
identity.objectives: Rescue the Freewind Brave.
identity.description: <Rau dismissively waves a note around with Taur-ahe markings on it.>$B$BThose mongrels have captured one of our braves! They're threatening to kill him if we don't pull back!$B$BWe'll never allow those Grimtotem cowards to keep Freewind Post! Please, rescue him before it's too late, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 赶紧把他放出来。
PortraitGiverText.english: Free him before it's too late.

identity.title: Horn of the Traitor
identity.objectives: Collect Longhorn's Horn.
identity.description: Here lies the broken body of the Freewind Post lorekeeper, Montarr. The aged tauren's body is broken, lying in a pool of his own blood.$B$BA trail of droplets leads back to the inn....

PortraitGiverText.text: 叛徒。把他剩下来那只角砍了！
PortraitGiverText.english: The Traitor. Get his remaining horn!

identity.title: Horn of the Traitor
identity.objectives: Collect Longhorn's Horn.
identity.description: Here lies the broken body of the Freewind Post lorekeeper, Montarr. The aged tauren's body is broken, lying in a pool of his own blood.$B$BA trail of droplets leads back to the inn....

PortraitGiverText.text: 叛徒。把他剩下来那只角砍了！
PortraitGiverText.english: The Traitor. Get his remaining horn!

identity.title: Nespirah
identity.objectives: Enter Nespirah's northwestern entrance, then find a way to communicate with it.
identity.description: It is clear to me at this point what must be done, $n.$b$bThe naga can only be obtaining these pearls from one place: Nespirah, the ancient, shelled creature that rests outside of this cave.  Why Nespirah would submit to the naga, however, is beyond my understanding.$b$bWe can enter Nespirah's body cavity through a small tube near the exit to this cave.  I must first fetch my master, then we can meet you on the inside.  We will convene in Nespirah's northwestern entrance.

AreaDescription.text: 找到与奈瑟匹拉联系的办法
AreaDescription.english: Find a way to communicate with Nespirah

identity.title: Last Ditch Effort
identity.objectives: Assist Master Thal'darah in search of any druids left behind at Thal'darah Grove.
identity.description: The Horde have signaled a retreat. Look now, they fall back from the field of battle - portends of disaster.$B$BWe must make one final descent into Thal'darah Grove. I could not live with myself if any of our young druids were left behind.$B$BAssist me, hero. I will take the reins. You search for any druids that might be left behind.$B$BWe will go when you are ready.

identity.title: Making Contact
identity.objectives: Observe as Earthmender Duarn attempts to communicate with Nespirah.
identity.description: I can't believe that Nespirah would willingly allow these naga to take residence inside her shell.  As I see it, one of two things has happened: they have convinced her to willingly join their cause, or they have weakened her to a point where she cannot fight back.  Either one is bad.$b$bHere in this chamber, I should be able to communicate directly with Nespirah.  Let us find out for ourselves.  Speak to me when you are prepared, $c.

AreaDescription.text: 同大地治愈者达鲁交谈

identity.title: Breaking Through
identity.objectives: Observe as Earthmender Duarn attempts to speak with Nespirah.
identity.description: A trained shaman has the ability to communicate with the four elements of earth, fire, air and water.  This is known.$b$bWhat is not as widely known, however, is the presence of a fifth element.  This element is not as clearly described as the other four, but it has to do with the shared... commonality between all living creatures.$b$bMy theory is that the crab, as a creature of the sea, is close enough to Nespirah that, with the elements' coaxing, we can convince it to act as Nespirah's mouthpiece.

AreaDescription.text: 与大地治愈者达鲁交谈

identity.title: Overseer Idra'kess
identity.objectives: Head to the top of Nespirah and slay Overseer Idra'kess.
identity.description: My men are flagging, $n.  We won't last much longer against these naga, I'm afraid.  With the Idra'kess' weapons, and Nespirah's pearls, we should be ready to bust out of here.$b$bFollow the wall to the southeast, and look for a ramp to the upper chamber.  I assume their leader is in there, or perhaps the key to Nespirah's awakening.  Hopefully both.$b$bIf you feel strong enough, head up to the top of the shell and look for some answers.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奈瑟匹拉的亵渎者
PortraitGiverText.english: Desecrator of Nespirah.

identity.title: Finish Nemesis
identity.objectives: Use the Totem of Tortolla and the help of a Child of Tortolla to defeat Nemesis. See Garunda Mountainpeak if you lose your turtle companion.
identity.description: Your turtle companion can use this newfound power to render the two of you invulnerable for a short period of time. You can "turtle up" to avoid the worst of Nemesis and his fury. To do so, simply invoke this totem.$B$BThis is all I can do for you. Together, you and a Child of Tortolla must defeat Nemesis, once and for all. Finish the Usurper!$B$BReturn to me if you lose your turtle friend.

PortraitGiverText.text: 使用你的图腾和乌龟伙伴来抵挡他的喷吐攻击。这个伪神必须被消灭！
PortraitGiverText.english: Use your totem and turtle companion to withstand his eruption attack. The false God must be destroyed!

PortraitGiverName.text: 篡位的复仇之神，涅墨西斯

identity.title: Call of Duty
identity.objectives: Ride the mercenary ship to battle.
identity.description: Listen up, $r!$b$bA new landmass has emerged off the coast of Eastern Kingdoms and we are engaged in a critical battle for control of the island!$b$bVictory there will leave Stormwind completely defenseless!$b$bNow is the time to strike!$b$bReport to the docks at once for transport to the battle.$b$bEvery warship is engaged, so you'll be boarding a mercenary vessel commissioned by the Warchief himself.

AreaDescription.text: 乘坐雇佣船只前往瓦丝琪尔
AreaDescription.english: Ride the mercenary ship to Vashj'ir

identity.title: Ascending the Vale
identity.objectives: Use Salsbury's Rocket Pack to ascend the Charred Vale's volcano.
identity.description: I am told that before the great upheaval the Charred Vale was a valley, closed off to the sea. One has merely to look to the south to see that the Charred Vale is no longer a valley and in fact has become an area of great volcanic activity.$B$BSalsbury here has configured a device that will allow us to ascend the volcano. Use it to get to the top and assess the goings on.$B$BI will keep in touch with this Gnomecorder device, which Salsbury has so kindly gifted upon me.

identity.title: Brood of Seldarria
identity.objectives: Destroy 5 of Seldarria's Eggs.
identity.description: <The Gnomecorder buzzes.>$B$BBe very careful, $n. You do not want to rouse that black dragon.$B$BNow, look around you. If this is a nest then there must be black dragon eggs nearby. Search the premises for eggs and destroy any that you see.$B$BReturn to me should you find and destroy Seldarria's eggs.$B$BGoldrinn watch over you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 登山时务必小心。一旦失足跌落，后果不堪设想。
PortraitGiverText.english: Maintain caution.  A misstep here could be disastrous.

identity.title: We're Here to Do One Thing, Maybe Two...
identity.objectives: Take the Krom'gar Wagon to the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains.
identity.description: You're in Hellscream's army now, $n, and in Hellscream's army we kick butt and take names. Gone are the days of our people starving in the streets of Orgrimmar as we sign treaties with elves. We take what we need now. Kalimdor belongs to the Horde!$B$BThe Alliance attempts to stop our expansion every chance they get. Unsatisfied with owning most of the Eastern Kingdoms, those pig-lickers want it all!$B$BOverlord Krom'gar has called for more troops in Stonetalon. Get on the caravan west of here and go!

AreaDescription.text: 乘克罗姆加马车前往皱石岗
AreaDescription.english: Krom'gar Wagon taken to the Fold

identity.title: A Standard Day for Azrajar
identity.objectives: Plant the Alliance Standard in Fathom-Caller Azrajar's corpse.
identity.description: $n, the snakes are after our daft and barmy. Go back northwest to Deepfin Ridge and plant some do me good in that pot and pan pitch and toss of theirs.$B$BThey'll kick and prance away with their alderman's nails tucked between their nutmegs when they see that. Not that they've got any nutmegs mind you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 把旗帜插到他身边！
PortraitGiverText.english: Plant a banner in his corpse!

identity.title: A Standard Day for Azrajar
identity.objectives: Plant the Horde Standard in Fathom-Caller Azrajar's corpse.
identity.description: $n, the naga are after our forces. I need you to go back northwest to Deepfin Ridge and stick our standard in their general, Fathom-Caller Azrajar.$B$BThey'll swim away with their tails tucked between their... er. Well, I guess they don't have any legs, now do they?

PortraitGiverText.text: 把旗帜插到他身边！
PortraitGiverText.english: Plant a banner in his corpse!

identity.title: Put It On
identity.objectives: Witness what occurs when you place the Merciless One on your head.
identity.description: Hey, $n, I've got an idea for a disguise! Take one of these merciless whatchamacallits and put it on your head.$B$BWhat could possibly go wrong?$B$BReady to put it on?

identity.title: Put It On
identity.objectives: Witness what occurs when you place the Merciless One on your head.
identity.description: I've got an idea for a sweet disguise, but I'm going to need your help, $n! Take one of these merciless corpses and put it on your head.$B$BI know, I know, but it's dead, so what could possibly go wrong other than you smelling bad for a day or two?$B$BReady to put it on?

identity.title: Breaking Through
identity.objectives: Observe as Earthmender Duarn attempts to speak with Nespirah.
identity.description: A trained shaman has the ability to communicate with the four elements of earth, fire, air and water.  This is known.$b$bWhat is not as widely known, however, is the presence of a fifth element.  This element is not as clearly described as the other four, but it has to do with the shared... commonality between all living creatures.$b$bMy theory is that the crab, as a creature of the sea, is close enough to Nespirah that, with the elements' coaxing, we can convince it to act as Nespirah's mouthpiece.

AreaDescription.text: 与大地治愈者达鲁交谈

identity.title: Overseer Idra'kess
identity.objectives: Head to the top of Nespirah and slay Overseer Idra'kess.
identity.description: My men are flagging, $n.  We won't last much longer against these naga, I'm afraid.  With the Idra'kess' weapons, and Nespirah's pearls, we should be ready to bust out of here.$b$bFollow the wall northeast, and look for a ramp to the upper chamber.  I assume their leader is in there, or perhaps the key to Nespirah's awakening.  Hopefully both.$b$bIf you feel strong enough, head up to the top of the shell and look for some answers.  Hellscream's eyes are upon you!

PortraitGiverText.text: 奈瑟匹拉的亵渎者
PortraitGiverText.english: Desecrator of Nespirah.

identity.title: The Brothers Digsong 2: Eel-Egg-Trick Boogaloo
identity.objectives: Use the Eel-splosive Device near a Devious Great-Eel in Underlight Canyon, then defeat the Weakened Great-Eel.
identity.description: Those eels ate my brother.  My brother, $n!  It's time someone showed 'em who's boss.$b$b<Humphrey removes several sticks of dynamite from his vest and shoves them through the egg's outer membrane.>$b$bThe great-eels to the south are too tough to fight one-on-one, but with this egg, we should be able to even the odds.  Place it near one of those creatures, then... kablooie!$b$bIf the bomb doesn't kill the eel outright, it should be near enough to death for you to finish it off.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我可怜的兄弟奥斯卡。他葬身于鳗鱼之腹。
PortraitGiverText.english: My poor brother, Oskar.  Eaten by an eel, he was.

identity.title: Wanted!  Marez Cowl
identity.objectives: Bring Marez's head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
identity.description: A bounty has been placed on the head of Marez Cowl, a high-level advisor and operative of the Syndicate.  She was last seen within the Syndicate controlled territory of Stromgarde.$B$BBounty may be collected from Captain Nials.$B$BBe warned: Marez is a skilled and cunning warlock, known for her trafficking with demons.  Extreme caution is advised when hunting her.

PortraitGiverText.text: 把她的徽记给我带来！
PortraitGiverText.english: Bring me her head!

identity.title: The Traitor Orc
identity.objectives: Retrieve Marez Cowl's Befouled Bloodstone Orb.
identity.description: There is no doubt in my mind that a powerful warlock resides within the walls of Stromgarde. From time to time, using an arcane magical relic, this warlock has summoned forth terrible demons in large numbers. We must remove the source of her energy.$b$bFind the warlock and kill her. Bring me whatever magical object you find on her person, and I will take steps to destroy it and see that its power is not used to taint this land any longer.

PortraitGiverText.text: 拿到她的邪恶的血石宝珠！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get her Befouled Bloodstone Orb!

identity.title: The Real Threat
identity.objectives: Slay Or'Kalar and take his head.
identity.description: Or'Kalar leads the ogres here. He has evaded slaughter for years. His very presence is an affront to the Dark Lady; Mug'thol, traitor to the Forsaken, commands him from afar!$B$BWe do not suffer ogres or traitors on Forsaken land. Bring me this ogre's head and I will make sure it's burned properly this time.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奥卡拉尔比他的任何同族都要高出一个头。我希望你去纠正这一点。
PortraitGiverText.english: Or'Kalar stands a head taller than any of his kin.  I'd like you to remedy that.

identity.title: Sigil of Arathor
identity.objectives: Collect the Sigil of Arathor from Lieutenant Valorcall.
identity.description: I entrusted the sigil of Arathor to Lieutenant Valorcall, leader of my cavalry. He barely escaped with his life when it was taken.$B$BIt is unlikely he will do so again. Valorcall patrols the road between Stromgarde Keep and Refuge Point. Find him, and take the sigil from him once more.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他曾经是我最优秀，最忠诚的中尉。哦，得了吧！
PortraitGiverText.english: He was one of my best, most loyal lieutenants.  Oh well!

identity.title: Wand over Fist
identity.objectives: Find Trelane's Wand of Invocation and return it to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
identity.description: Hey, $n. Sorry to be so short with ye earlier... and no, that ain't a pun.$B$BI figured out where Trelane's first item ended up: Kor'gresh has it in Boulderfist Hall. An' by the way he was throwing down blasts of ice at his kin to keep them in line, he must be close to figurin' out how to use all of its powers.$B$BBoulderfist Hall's south of here an' then east of Thandol Span. Find the ogre an' get back that wand.$B$BWhile you're gone, I'll figure out what we're gonna do about Stromgarde.

PortraitGiverText.text: 拿到这根魔杖，我们就能继续推进计划了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Once we have the wand, we can move forward with our plan.

identity.title: Breaking the Keystone
identity.objectives: Obtain the Rod of Order from Fozruk.
identity.description: Opening the Stones of Binding loosened much of my confinement, but a lock still holds me chained.  It is the Keystone you see among this circle of stones.  And the key is held by one of my captors, the stone watcher Fozruk.$B$BYou must obtain that key, which the stone watchers call the Rod of Order, from Fozruk and use it to open the Keystone.$B$B$n, you have done so much to aid me.  Just a little more...and my gratitude will shake the very foundations of the earth!

PortraitGiverText.text: 取得秩序魔棒！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get the Rod of Order!

identity.title: The Princess Unleashed
identity.objectives: Summon and defeat Myzrael at the Shards of Myzrael.
identity.description: Myzrael's no innocent princess. She's a terribly dangerous force, and the giants had every reason to chain her down there. I'm afraid you've been had.$B$BAccording to Gerrig, you have to summon her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her.  Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards.$B$BHere's the scroll you'll need. Be careful with it; I risked a few teeth to get it. Good luck, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 释放她……然后毁掉她。
PortraitGiverText.english: Set her free... then destroy her.

identity.title: Goggle Boggle
identity.objectives: Escort Professor Phizzlethorpe to the cave and back.
identity.description: Now that we are full-fledged Blackwater Raiders it is our job to help Mr. O'Breen locate the lost elven treasure.$b$bIt is next to impossible to find the gems in the dark sea without aid. The doctor has constructed some goggles that will help. He needs the goggles charged with the energy derived from the enchanted stone in the cave just up the hill.$b$bBut the cave is cursed! When we get close, we get ambushed. Defend me and I can harness the energy from the stone into the goggles.

identity.title: Free Wil'hai
identity.objectives: Slay all of the Tentacle Horrors to free Wil'hai.
identity.description: Those tentacle horrors rising from the depths have trapped that poor beast. Please, $n, can you save it by destroying those things?$B$BWill you free Wil'hai?$B$BHere, take my totem and plant it near the tentacles. The cold it emanates will cause major shrinkage on those monsters and then you'll be able to destroy them.

PortraitGiverText.text: 释放维尔哈伊
PortraitGiverText.english: Free Wil'hai

identity.title: Kobold Fury!
identity.objectives: Use the Kobold War Horn near the Horde Banner at the Unearthed Grounds to unleash the Kobold Army!
identity.description: We now command the kobold armies of Stonetalon! It almost sounds impressive. Almost.$B$B<Devo sighs.>$B$BThe Alliance base camp north of here is tightly guarded. It is nigh impregnable, save for the entry point by the Unearthed Grounds, northeast of here. Take this kobold war horn and head towards the Unearthed Grounds. Enter from the east, $n! Once there, head west until you arrive at the location I have marked upon your map. Use the horn there to unleash kobold fury upon the Alliance!

identity.title: Wanted!  Otto and Falconcrest
identity.objectives: Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
identity.description: The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto.  Falconcrest heads the Syndicate's efforts in the Arathi Highlands, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.$B$BHis bodyguard Otto, although not a strategic target, is a fierce opponent and has killed dozens of our defenders.$B$BTheir bounties may be collected from Captain Nials.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他的护卫想必十分严密。谨慎行事。
PortraitGiverText.english: He will be well-protected.  Go with caution.

identity.title: Here Fishie Fishie 2: Eel-Egg-Trick Boogaloo
identity.objectives: Use the Eel-splosive Device near a Devious Great-eel in Underlight Canyon, then defeat the Weakened Great-Eel.
identity.description: <Orako removes an explosive trap from his sack and shoves it through the egg's outer membrane.>$b$bThis will make the egg explode.  Place the egg down next to one of those giant eels, and wait for them to come close.  When the egg explodes, the big fish will be almost dead, and you can finish killing it.$b$bSave my wolf!  With this egg, you can do it.

PortraitGiverText.text: 帮我找到我的狼！
PortraitGiverText.english: Help me find my wolf!

identity.title: Is This Justice?
identity.objectives: Defend yourself.
identity.description: He was a good boy, $n. Young, loving. He would have never killed any of the young druids. They were his friends! No... Not Orthus.$B$BThe General must be called to answer for this crime. I will have justice!

identity.title: Fuel-ology 101
identity.objectives: Use the Fuel Sampling Station in Darkbreak Cove to create the perfect bio-fuel.
identity.description: How much do you know about fuel, $n?  Constructing the perfect fuel is a tricky job, as there's plenty of factors to balance: chrono-pyroxidation parameters, tempero-incendiary variables, conflagrational siltification criteria... and that's only naming a few.$b$bHopefully the samples you brought me can be combined in the right proportions to create... the perfect bio-fuel.  Use that table over there and try combining some samples!  Bring the result to me when you're done.

identity.title: Just Like Old Times
identity.objectives: Collect the Sealed Folder from the Forsaken Courier.
identity.description: It's funny. Kin and I have been through so much together, and here we find ourselves back in Arathi, like so many years ago.$B$BWe broke up a plot to create a new plague right here, her and I. It doesn't look like the Horde learned their lesson, because they're all over this farm yet again.$B$BTheir undead courier is shuffling around as obvious as daylight. If you want to help, find the courier and bring back whatever they're carrying.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在路上找到她。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find her on the road.

identity.title: ... It Will Come
identity.objectives: Obtain the Brain of the Unfathomable.
identity.description: I now imbue you with the energies of the corrupting faceless.$B$BSwim down to my luring totem in the trench to the northeast. Release the energies through it. Bring back the brain of their leader.$B$BCall forth to Ick'thys the Unfathomable... it will come!

PortraitGiverText.text: 你需要它的触须！
PortraitGiverText.english: You need its brain!

identity.title: Kinelory Strikes
identity.objectives: Protect Kinelory until she returns to Quae.
identity.description: All right, $n. I'm ready if you are.$B$BShall we?

identity.title: Seize the Ambassador
identity.objectives: Go to the Dark Iron Embassy and use the Sturdy Manacles to arrest Ambassador Slaghammer.
identity.description: The ambassador's betrayal will long haunt me. You must arrest him before he can do further harm, or worse, before he can escape and start planning the next attack. Ironforge is not safe with Ambassador Slaghammer free inside the city.$B$BTake these manacles and go to the Dark Iron embassy. It's just to the north of the High Seat, around the rim of the Great Forge. Arrest Ambassador Slaghammer and return with him.

AreaDescription.text: 逮捕熔锤大使并将他带至王座厅
AreaDescription.english: Arrest Ambassador Slaghammer and bring him to the High Seat

identity.title: The Perfect Fuel
identity.objectives: Use the Fuel Sampling Station in Tenebrous Cavern to create the perfect bio-fuel.
identity.description: How much do you know about fuel, $n?  Constructing the perfect fuel is a tricky job, as there's plenty of factors to balance: chrono-pyroxidation parameters, tempero-incendiary variables, conflagrational siltification criteria... and that's only naming a few.$b$bHopefully the samples you brought me can be combined in the right proportions to create... the perfect bio-fuel.  Use that table over there and try combining some samples!  Bring the result to me when you're done.

identity.title: All that Rises
identity.objectives: Slay Hallazeal the Ascended.
identity.description: <The voice of the ancient presses against your mind.>$B$BNOW THAT... YOU HAVE STOLEN... THE ENERGIES OF... THE FAITHFUL, ENTER... THE TEMPLE AND... DESTROY... HALLAZEAL THE ASCENDED!

PortraitGiverText.text: 使用被占据的奔流杀死升腾者海纳泽尔。
PortraitGiverText.english: Use the possessed torrent to slay this thing and put an end to the Ascended in Vashj'ir!

identity.title: A Decisive Strike
identity.objectives: Kill Grawmug.
identity.description: It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug. He's the biggest of all the troggs here, lurking deep within the darkness of the caves to the north.$b$bIf you feel yourself worthy, $n, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug.

PortraitGiverText.text: 击败他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill him!

identity.title: Kasim Sharim
identity.objectives: Report to Kasim Sharim in the back of the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.
identity.description: I need you to pass on a message for me.$b$bKasim Sharim is an old blood mage that knows a great deal about the demons of the Blasted Lands.  Though you wouldn't know from looking at him, he's quite old, and very powerful... if a little eccentric.  As of late, he spends his days in the back of the Serpent's Coil, a cave not far from where you killed those cultists.$b$bPlease, deliver this message to him.  He will know what it means.

PortraitGiverText.text: 血巫师，古怪的隐士
PortraitGiverText.english: Blood wizard and eccentric recluse

identity.title: Blood Ritual
identity.objectives: Speak with Kasim Sharim to begin the blood ritual.
identity.description: I suppose you want to know what we're doing.  Here's the short version - a version at which I happen to be an expert:$b$bThe Shadowsworn cultists wish to summon the demon, Razelikh, back to the Blasted Lands.  We cannot allow this to happen.  So we're going to summon him ourselves, and then kill him.  A task not as simple as it sounds...$b$bLet me know when you are ready to begin the blood ritual, and then stand back.

AreaDescription.text: 与卡西姆·夏利姆交谈，开始鲜血仪祭
AreaDescription.english: Speak with Kasim Sharim to begin the blood ritual

identity.title: Not Just Any Body
identity.objectives: Find Loramus' Head, Loramus' Torso, and Loramus' Legs.
identity.description: We need Loramus Thalipedes, the demon hunter.  He knows Razelikh's true name, and as you know: if you know the name of the demon, you have power over it.  The problem is that Loramus has been killed, and his body torn apart.$b$bIf you bring me the pieces, we still have a recourse.  All three pieces are in the west... the Dreadmaul ogres hide them in their caves.  Move quickly, for much like Grimeo, Loramus also owes me a debt...

PortraitGiverText.text: 恶魔猎手还活着时的模样。
PortraitGiverText.english: The demon hunter in life.

identity.title: The Final Ritual
identity.objectives: Speak with Kasim Sharim and participate in his ritual.
identity.description: The knife is ready.  Loramus is present, and he knows what he must do.  I must now take the three amulets and use their enchantment to grant you access to Razelikh, the amulets' creator.$b$bI am prepared to perform the ritual on you and Loramus.  Speak with me when you are both ready.

AreaDescription.text: 参与卡西姆·夏利姆的仪式

identity.title: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
identity.objectives: Speak with the Deathly Usher north of the Rise of the Defiler.  Once atop the Rise, destroy Razelikh's body, then use the Stone Knife of Sealing to imprison his soul.
identity.description: Hero, listen well.$b$bFirst, we must travel to the Deathly Usher, who waits at the northern foot of the Rise of the Defiler, to our northwest.  The usher will take us to the top of the rise.  Once there, you will help me defeat Razelikh, for I fear I am not strong enough to defeat him alone.$b$bMost importantly, I need you to hold the stone knife, and do not use it until I tell you to.  The knife will trap Razelikh's soul within its new, eternal prison.$b$bIf we succeed, speak with Grimeo, the draenei.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你了解他的真名，这将给他带来灭顶之灾。
PortraitGiverText.english: Your knowledge of his true name shall prove to be his undoing.

identity.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket
identity.objectives: Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and collect Fizsprocket's Clipboard.
identity.description: According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.$b$bThe depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is Supervisor Fizsprocket, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.

PortraitGiverText.text: 拿到他的笔记板。
PortraitGiverText.english: Get his clipboard.

identity.title: The Downfall of Marl Wormthorn
identity.objectives: Kill Marl Wormthorn at Maldraz in the Blasted Lands.  You can use the Demoniac Vessel to pull him out of his trance.
identity.description: When word gets out about what we've done... there's no saying what the citizens of Surwich will do.  They cling so closely to Wormthorn's dream...$b$b...but still, it must be done.  Take the demoniac vessel and use it on Marl Wormthorn to pull him from his trance.  Return to me when he is no more.

PortraitGiverText.text: 当恶魔夺走了他的理智，一切希望都破灭了。
PortraitGiverText.english: When the demons took his mind, all hope was lost.

identity.title: The Angerfang Menace
identity.objectives: Slay Gorfax Angerfang and 16 Dragonmaw Orcs in the Angerfang Encampment.
identity.description: When we hauled up here to get away from the raptors, we put ourselves right next to a whole slew of Dragonmaw orcs!$B$BI've heard the stories in Menethil, how the Dragonmaw are even cruder barbarians than other orcs, how they strangle black dragons with their bare hands... I don't know how much of it's true, but I know we can't just let 'em sit up here in the hills.$B$BYou've got the chops for it, $n. Head east to the Angerfang Encampment, take care of those orcs, and make sure you get their leader!

PortraitGiverText.text: 怒牙龙喉氏族的酋长
PortraitGiverText.english: Chief of the Angerfang Dragonmaw

identity.title: Gammerita, Mon!
identity.objectives: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.$B$BKatoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.
identity.description: Yo! There be a turtle out there not like the others. She be the Gammerita, leader of the saltwater snapjaws - a downright dirty thievin' reptile.$B$BMon, she stole my best lure. Snapped it right off my line! Since then, the fish just aren't biting the same.$B$BFind Gammerita and get my lure out of her stomach.

PortraitGiverText.text: 海滩龟壳巨无霸。
PortraitGiverText.english: The shelled behemoth of the shores.

identity.title: Livin' the Life
identity.objectives: Use Two-Shoed Lou's Old House at the back of the Jangolode Mine in Westfall.
identity.description: Listen, I really shouldn't be talkin' to you, but I owe Horatio a favor or two. I don't really know nothin' about what happened to the Furlbrows, but I might be able to point you in the right direction.$B$B<Lou hands you a large crate.>$B$BThat crate used to be my home before I struck it rich. Now I'm livin' the life every hobo dreams of!$B$BRight, so you take that there livin' crate and head to the Jangolode Mine, southwest of here. Head to the back of the mine and once there, hide in the crate.

identity.title: On Second Thought, Take One Prisoner
identity.objectives: Subdue Mor'norokk the Hateful at the Alliance Gunship in Deepholm.
identity.description: It's not too late, $n.  The cultists are probably still here.$B$BGo below decks, find out who's in charge and subdue them.$B$BWe will obtain answers to our questions, one way or another.

PortraitGiverText.text: 尽量不要杀了他。我们要留一个活口。
PortraitGiverText.english: Try not to kill him. We're going to need this one alive.

identity.title: Bleed the Bloodshaper
identity.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Orders from one of the Twilight Bloodshapers at Deathwing's Fall.
identity.description: The Twilight's Hammer are wielding foul magic here, $n.  They animate and energize the remains of Deathwing's blood, so that instead of drying out and disappearing it thrives and becomes more abundant.$B$BTake out one of the bloodshapers, see if they have any clues as to where we can find this "forgemaster."

PortraitGiverText.text: 他们中的一个或许可能把我们领到铸炉之主那儿去。
PortraitGiverText.english: One of them might lead us to the Forgemaster.

PortraitTurnInText.english: They're keeping slaves here?

identity.title: Deathwing's Fall
identity.objectives: Go to Deathwing's Fall in Deepholm.
identity.description: The Twilight's Hammer involvement in the disappearance of the World Pillar fragment makes complete sense.  Let us hope that we can act swiftly enough to recover it.$B$B<Maruut places his hand on your shoulder.>$B$BI've established a spiritual bond with you.  We should be able to communicate while you remain in Deepholm.$B$BGo to Deathwing's Fall to the southeast and investigate the Twilight's Hammer operation there.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们的灵魂现在连接在了一起，这样即便你不在，我们也能联系。
PortraitGiverText.english: Our spirits are now linked so that we may communicate while you're away.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 他们一定把碎片带到这里来过！
PortraitTurnInText.english: They must've brought the fragment here!

AreaDescription.text: 已到达死亡之翼陨落地

identity.title: Thornar Thunderclash
identity.objectives: Kill Thornar Thunderclash.
identity.description: We've been trying to take out the commander of the Wildhammer encroaching on our lands, but we've had no luck.$B$BThornar Thunderclash sits in the safety of his command post, his voice booming across the battlefield to rally the dwarves. We're thinking he needs to be quieted.$B$BCut Thornar down and we can clean up the rest of this skirmish with no problem.

PortraitGiverText.text: 如果除掉了这个笨蛋，我方的胜算就大大增加了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Our troops stand a much better chance once this oaf is dead on the ground.

identity.title: Prime Slime
identity.objectives: Collect a Direglob Sample from The Direglob.
identity.description: I've become very interested in the slimes inhabiting Skulk Rock. No matter how many times they're cleared out, they seem to return, yet it doesn't seem they're capable of reproducing from a single slime.$B$BI think something's growing in there. There's a source where all the slimes come from, and I want to study it. Find this source, and bring me back a sample.

PortraitGiverText.text: 尽量别靠得太近了…谁知道这玩意儿到底有什么能耐呢？
PortraitGiverText.english: Try not to get too close... Who knows what this thing is capable of?

identity.title: Secrets of the Tower
identity.objectives: Enter Mortwake's Tower and find Helix Gearbreaker.
identity.description: Helix has got himself holed up inside Klaven Mortwake's old tower. I won't lie to you, $n, it's heavily guarded. I count six armed mercenaries just on the outside. There's no way you're getting inside that tower by yourself. Lucky for you, Claire and I are here.$B$B<Kearnen pats her sniper rifle.>$B$BI'll cover your entry.$B$BTake this shrouding potion, you'll need it once you get inside. Use it as soon as you enter the tower and head upstairs. Find out what Helix is hiding up there!

identity.title: Nezzliok Will Know
identity.objectives: Obtain Nezzliok's Head from Nezzliok the Dire in Zul'Kunda.
identity.description: Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it.  But we are no closer to finding him.$B$BWe must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp witchdoctor will know it.  He is an enemy of the Darkspear tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from his dead lips!$B$BBring me the head of Nezzliok the Dire and place it within this cauldron.$B$BHe is deep within Zul'Kunda.  Bring his head...we will then make it talk.

PortraitGiverText.text: 血顶的首席巫医就在祖昆达深处。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Bloodscalps' chief witch doctor will be deep within Zul'Kunda.

identity.title: Saving Yenniku
identity.objectives: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.
identity.description: I have reshaped the Mind's Eye into a Soul Gem.  Its purpose is twofold: you must use it to stun Yenniku, and once stunned place it upon his head to entrap his soul.$B$BMy suspicions that I spoke of earlier were correct: the spirits tell me that Yenniku dwells not with Zanzil the Outcast, but within the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe, to the southwest.  Once you have freed Yenniku's spirit, return to Nimboya at Grom'gol.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他经历了那么多……是时候让他的灵魂解放了。
PortraitGiverText.english: He's gone through so much... it's time to set his soul free.

identity.title: Imposing Confrontation
identity.objectives: Read the Earthen Ring Proclamation to Boden the Imposing.
identity.description: Have ya seen the looming giant in the distance to the northeast? Dat is Boden the Imposing, one of Therazane the Stonemother's Stone Lords.$B$BWe be knowin' little of da Stone Lords, but Boden is not known ta be very level-headed. Sadly, he seems to be da one leadin' dis assault, so he's the one we must be confrontin'.$B$BTake dis proclamation to him and read it aloud on behalf of da Earthen Ring. I know it be a bit of a stretch to think words will settle dis, but we have to try. Be cautious.

PortraitGiverText.text: 有时想不被人看低真是很难。
PortraitGiverText.english: Sometimes it's hard not to be looked down upon.

identity.title: A Vision of the Past
identity.objectives: Enter the Defias Hideout and follow the trail of homeless to the Deadmines dungeon. Enter the Deadmines dungeon and use the Incense Burner to see into the past.
identity.description: This incense will put your body and mind in a deep meditative state. Once the trance begins you will be pulled into the spirit world. Do not fight the trance once it has begun, $n. Allow the spirits to show you what they know.$B$BYou must leave now. Go to the Deadmines, a place which I am told holds great significance in the history of Westfall. Once inside, use the incense.$B$BYou may enter the Deadmines through the old farmhouse south of here. Follow the homeless. $B$BReturn to Gryan with your discovery.

identity.title: Rise of the Brotherhood
identity.objectives: Bear witness to the rise of the Brotherhood.
identity.description: I had no idea that VanCleef had a daughter, $n. If there was one thing that man was exceptionally skilled at, it was keeping secrets.$B$BHow tragic. Poor thing witnessed a horrible act. Had I only known.$B$BWhat was that? Did you hear something? It seems as if the gnolls are pulling back... where are my guards?$B$BON GUARD, $n!

identity.title: Who's a Big Troll?
identity.objectives: Obtain Gan'zulah's Body from Zul'Kunda.
identity.description: <The skull speaks once more.>$b$bMy soul is ready, but my body is not.  The Bloodscalps desecrated my old body long ago.  The horrors that they inflicted upon me... my spirit watched on while they tore my body apart and, and... I can't go on.$b$bTheir chief, Gan'zulah, presided over the gruesome acts.  In fact, if memory serves, he was a strong, powerful troll... about the same size as I was.  What a fine coincidence.$b$bYou know what to do, $r.  Make it quick.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他是一个大巨魔。
PortraitGiverText.english: HE'S a big troll.

identity.title: Cozzle's Plan
identity.objectives: Obtain Cozzle's Key from Foreman Cozzle, then obtain the Fuel Regulator Blueprints.
identity.description: I may be of Darkspear birth, but I spent my childhood here, in Stranglethorn Vale.  I've seen everything there is to see here in Stranglethorn, but the most offensive is the devastation that the Venture Company has done to the riverbed.$b$bTo make things worse, Foreman Cozzle and his crew have been increasing their activity, and I suspect they have some new plan.  Succeed where I failed, $n: Kill Cozzle, obtain his key, and steal the blueprints from his apartment.

PortraitGiverText.text: 工头考兹尔会藏在钻油机的顶部。他手里有你要的钥匙。
PortraitGiverText.english: Foreman Cozzle will be hiding atop his oil rig.  He'll have the key you need.

identity.title: Smoot's Samophlange
identity.objectives: Find Smoot somewhere in Bilgewater Harbor. Tackle him and get the Induction Samophlange.
identity.description: It was the Captain who insisted his new engines use an induction samophlange.$B$BThose things hadn't even been invented yet!$B$BI tasked Smoot with creating one based on some stolen Venture Company schematics, and he's finally built a working model.$B$BNow that he's got his samophlange, he's drunk with power. He's running all over town with it like a goblin possessed.$B$BSmack Smoot and snag my samophlange, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在锈水港的某处找到斯姆特。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Smoot somewhere in Bilgewater Harbor!

identity.title: Be Raptor
identity.objectives: Speak with Priestess Hu'rala, then help the Captured Lashtail Hatchling escape from Zul'Gurub.
identity.description: Mind Control, very powerful, yes.$b$bWith luck, you can help Ohgan'aka escape from Zul'Gurub.$b$bThen, Ohgan'aka becomes $n'aka again!$b$bSpeak to Priestess, yes, and help $n'aka escape.

PortraitGiverText.text: 被困在祖尔格拉布！
PortraitGiverText.english: Trapped in Zul'Gurub!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Returned from the dead?

identity.title: Heads Up
identity.objectives: Defeat Umboda Three-Heads and collect his head.
identity.description: Umboda of the Vilebranch is one of their strongest warriors, and a sick butcher.$B$BHe takes the heads of all he slays as trinkets, rewards...even weapons!  It's his turn to be taken.$B$BFind Umboda "Three-Heads", slay him, and bring me HIS head! We'll see how the Vilebranch fight when we throw it back over their walls!

PortraitGiverText.text: 拿到他的脑袋，中间的那个。
PortraitGiverText.english: Bring back his head.  The middle one.

identity.title: Ongo'longo's Revenge
identity.objectives: Fight Ongo'longo until he breaks free.
identity.description: Ongo'longo was one of us. What outsiders called a Dire Troll, but he was a Revantusk, and a proud warrior like all of us!$B$BThen the Vilebranch took him. They keep him chained up in a pit at the top of Jintha'Alor, made to dance for their sick amusement.$B$BNo chains can hold Ongo'longo. All you need to do is raise his temper, $n. Fight him until he's enraged enough to remember his true spirit and break free... and then get out of the way!

PortraitGiverText.text: 惹他发火，然后别挡他的道！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get him angry, then get out of his way!

identity.title: Hunt the Keeper
identity.objectives: Kill Morta'gya the Keeper and obtain the Tablet of Shadra.
identity.description: Kotonga has told me of Shadra. She is the venom queen, the loa of spiders, worshipped in darkness. If the Vilebranch are performing rituals, I'm not going to let them finish.$B$BCheck the cave behind the altar at the top of Jintha'Alor. Deep within it, one of Shadra's keepers might still be lurking. Kill her and take whatever she carries back here so we can know what's going on.

PortraitGiverText.text: 毫无疑问，她肯定缩在洞穴的最深处。
PortraitGiverText.english: She'll be cowering in the back of the cave, no doubt.

identity.title: Hatred Runs Deep
identity.objectives: Kill Dragul Giantbutcher and 12 Twilight Cultists at Lorthuna's Gate.
identity.description: I would apologize for Boden, but stone is stubborn.$B$BIt does not sway from its ways without the wear of time.$B$BThe Stone Lords, Boden and I among them, are charged with retrieving the World Pillar.$B$BIn that, we are at odds.$B$BI would extend my patience upon you, $r.$B$BProve that you are no ally of the Twilight Cult or Deathwing...$B$BCarry our hatred upon them.$B$BStrike swiftly where we cannot.$B$BSucceed and I will listen.

PortraitGiverText.text: 洛苏娜之门的部队领袖。
PortraitGiverText.english: Leader of the forces at Lorthuna's Gate.

identity.title: Ending the Invasion!
identity.objectives: Kill Kurtok the Slayer.
identity.description: The rampaging orc horde is lead by a savage beast known as Kurtok the Slayer! Kurtok is responsible for the recent invasion and must be killed if we are to have peace in the valley.$B$BVenture back east, across the river and through the vineyard, and look for the passage leading into the mountains. Kurtok will be there, preparing for another assault. Kill him and return to me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 库尔托克藏在烟与火中，就在东边。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kurtok hides amidst the smoke and flames, to the east.

identity.title: The Shell of Shadra
identity.objectives: Kill Qiaga the Keeper and collect the Shell of Shadra.
identity.description: We've one last part to collect, and then we'll have everything we need.$B$BThe Shell of Shadra is held by the spider god's last living high priestess, Qiaga the Keeper. She stands atop the Altar of Zul, guarded by other fanatical zealots.$B$BSimple enough, no? Get up the steps of the altar and send her head rolling back down them. Bring the shell to me and we will have Shadra at last.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奇尔加是沙德拉的狂热信徒。她不会轻易放弃沙德拉之壳的。
PortraitGiverText.english: Qiaga is a devoted disciple of Shadra.  She will not part with the shell easily.

identity.title: To Steal From Thieves
identity.objectives: Take the heads of Kenata Dabyrie, Fardel Dabyrie, and Marcel Dabyrie.
identity.description: The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!$B$BMy family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, she and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.$B$BI don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!$B$BKill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.

PortraitGiverText.text: 她必须付出惨痛的代价！
PortraitGiverText.english: She will pay with her head!

identity.title: Ruuzel
identity.objectives: Obtain the Ring of Zoram.
identity.description: I fear the ancient statuette's secrets will remain forever hidden unless you find the key to their ancient locks.$B$BThat key is a ring, the Ring of Zoram. It belonged to the rulers of this city before the waves of the Sundering drowned it.$B$BFor years the ring was lost, but the naga have recently found it.$B$BTheir leader, Ruuzel, dwells on her isle on the northern edge of the Zoram Strand. Please, $n, retrieve the ring for me!

PortraitGiverText.text: 她带着佐拉姆之戒！
PortraitGiverText.english: She has the Ring of Zoram!

identity.title: The Branch of Cenarius
identity.objectives: Obtain the Branch of Cenarius.
identity.description: Anilia puts her hands on your shoulders and draws you close. Gasping, she points towards the arch to the north, before her eyes close and her last wheezing breath leaves her body. "He has taken it... Geltharis..." You know in your heart that Anilia's dying wish is to see the Branch of Cenarius back in dryad hands.

PortraitGiverText.text: 从他身上拿到塞纳留斯的树枝！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get the Branch of Cenarius from him!

identity.title: A New Adornment
identity.objectives: Obtain Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod.
identity.description: I'm certain that the long-dead wizard, Dartol, intended to use his rod to subjugate and destroy us just as the night elves and orcs have, but I think now we'll put that thing to an unintended use.$B$BRan Bloodtooth is the king of all of the Ashenvale furbolg. His tribe, the Bloodtooth, are the most powerful and keep themselves secluded in a camp just to the east.$B$BKill them all and bring back his skull. Let us see if we can put it to good use.

PortraitGiverText.text: 获得兰恩·血牙的徽记。
PortraitGiverText.english: Get Ran's skull.

identity.title: True Power of the Rod
identity.objectives: Use Dartol's Rod and speak with Ota Wen. Convince him to rise up against his Horde oppressors. Then, deliver Dartol's Rod to Raene Wolfrunner.
identity.description: Now, take the rod and while using its power, speak with my brother, Ota Wen.$B$BOta is amongst the other furbolg that the orcs have captured and have penned in the giant cage on the north side of Silverwind Refuge. The rod will allow you to convince Ota and the other furbolg to rise up and attack the Horde.$B$BThen you may go wherever your path leads you. Just know that you have found a new friend for that which you have done.

identity.title: Gan'dranda
identity.objectives: Kill Gan'dranda.
identity.description: As fun as it is to butt heads with these trolls, we've got other things to do down here. It'd be nice to get this battle over with, aye?$B$BTheir commander, Gan'dranda, sits in the ruined walls to the southeast of the battlefield. Our boys have most of their forces locked up, so I want you to slip in there and take out Gan'dranda. When they see a $r standin' over the corpse of their biggest hero it should take some of the fight out of 'em!

PortraitGiverText.text: 如果除掉了这个莽夫，我们矮人士兵的胜算定会大大提高。
PortraitGiverText.english: Our dwarves stand a much better chance once this brute is dead on the ground.

identity.title: Prime Slime
identity.objectives: Collect a Direglob Sample from The Direglob.
identity.description: Not many dwarves know this, but to get a REAL kick out of my brew I add a wee bit of the oozes around here. Aye, the giant green dwarf-eatin' oozes, those ones.$B$BThis brew's gonna have a HUGE kick to it though, so we need a huge slime! There's one lurkin' down in Skulk Rock that's the mother o' them all, absolutely huge...the Direglob, we call it.$B$BIf you've got what it takes, head down there and take a chunk out of the Direglob for me!

PortraitGiverText.text: 尽量别靠得太近了…谁知道这玩意儿到底有什么能耐呢？
PortraitGiverText.english: Try not to get too close... Who knows what this thing is capable of?

identity.title: Tuning the Gnomecorder
identity.objectives: Go to the Lakeshire Graveyard to tune the Gnomecorder.
identity.description: The gnomecorder looks to be in working order. I've got you all hooked up, now we just need to tune the gnomecorder for reception.$B$BHead north out of Lakeshire and follow the road up to the graveyard. Once you reach the graveyard I'll attempt to transmit.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Reception coming in loud and clear!

AreaDescription.text: 在湖畔镇墓地测试侏儒通讯器。
AreaDescription.english: Test the Gnomecorder at the Lakeshire Graveyard

identity.title: Canyon Romp
identity.objectives: Collect 10 Redridge Gnoll Collars.
identity.description: <The gnomecorder hums.>$B$BThe first order of business is a romp through the Redridge Canyons, directly north of Lakeshire. Kill every gnome that you see... woops, did I say gnome? I meant gnoll. Kill every GNOLL that you see and take their collars as proof of deed.$B$BI must warn you, $n; while you are out there, watch out for ettins. My scouts have reported seeing huge, bloodthirsty ettins roaming the canyons lately. Stay out of their way if you want to remain alive.$B$BSolomon out. I'll be in touch.

PortraitGiverText.text: 当心峡谷双头魔！
PortraitGiverText.english: Watch out for canyon ettins!

PortraitTurnInText.english: These gnolls have wised up!

identity.title: Ongo'longo's Revenge
identity.objectives: Fight Ongo'longo until he breaks free.
identity.description: I've got a plan to pit troll against troll.$B$BThe Vilebranch have a big ol' dire troll locked up in a pit with some flimsy-lookin' chains. I've seen those things fight, and there's no way those'll hold if that big brute gets swingin' mad!$B$BI want you to find the dire troll and fight him, $n. Don't kill him... just smack him around til' he's seein' red, then let him break free and get out of his way! He'll be a big pain for the Vilebranch.

PortraitGiverText.text: 惹他发火，然后别挡他的道！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get him angry, then get out of his way!

identity.title: Heads Up
identity.objectives: Defeat Umboda Three-Heads and collect his head.
identity.description: Umboda Three-Heads is one o' the biggest trolls you'll see around. He's a savage butcher, takin' heads for his own collection, dwarf and troll alike! It's time he got what he deserved.$B$BLook for the big brute on the lower terraces, and you take his own head right back here!

PortraitGiverText.text: 拿到他的魔精。
PortraitGiverText.english: Bring back his head.  The middle one.

identity.title: Saving Foreman Oslow
identity.objectives: Use the Ettin Control Orb to control an Ettin and then use the Ettin Control Orb on your Subdued Canyon Ettin to lift the Huge Boulder off of Foreman Oslow at Lakeshire.
identity.description: <Upon touching the orb you hear a faint click.>$B$B<You remove the orb from the pedestal.>$B$B<You now control the orb, therefore you now control the ettins. Maybe you can use an ettin to remove the huge boulder currently crushing Foreman Oslow over at Lakeshire. Find an ettin and use the orb on the ettin. Then head over to Lakeshire.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 峡谷双头魔：又丑又坏。
PortraitGiverText.english: Canyon Ettins: Ugly and mean.

identity.title: Hunt the Keeper
identity.objectives: Kill Morta'gya the Keeper and obtain the Tablet of Shadra.
identity.description: Shadra the spider loa... the venom queen, a spirit of darkness and death! If there's been a sacrifice, they're trying to bring her forth as a last-ditch effort.$B$BIf the Vilebranch are performing rituals, I'm not going to let them finish.$B$BCheck the cave behind the altar at the top of Jintha'Alor. Deep within it, one of Shadra's keepers might still be lurking. Kill her and take whatever she carries back here so we can know what's going on.

PortraitGiverText.text: 毫无疑问，她肯定缩在洞穴的最深处。
PortraitGiverText.english: She'll be cowering in the back of the cave, no doubt.

identity.title: The Shell of Shadra
identity.objectives: Kill Qiaga the Keeper and collect the Shell of Shadra.
identity.description: The final piece is all we need to burn Shadra out for good.$B$BThe Shell of Shadra is held by the spider god's last living high priestess, Qiaga the Keeper. She stands atop the Altar of Zul, guarded by other fanatical zealots.$B$BYou've got to climb that altar to the top and take her out! She'll have the Shell in her possession. Bring it back here.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奇尔加是沙德拉的狂热信徒。她不会轻易放弃沙德拉之壳的。
PortraitGiverText.english: Qiaga is a devoted disciple of Shadra.  She will not part with the shell easily.

identity.title: They've Wised Up...
identity.objectives: Recover the Blackrock Orc Missive.
identity.description: <The gnomecorder crackles and pops.>$B$BIt would appear that the Blackrock orcs have finally wised up. I'm getting reports that they're joining forces with the gnolls and planning an attack. I want details, $n!$B$BI need you to check out Rethban Caverns, located in the western region of Redridge Canyons. Look for orcs with dark skin. Kill any that you encounter and search their corpses for information.$B$BSolomon, out.

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑石兽人就意味着麻烦。
PortraitGiverText.english: Blackrock orcs mean trouble.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Solomon: Fluent in orcish.

identity.title: Yowler Must Die!
identity.objectives: Kill Yowler and recover the Blackrock Invasion Plans.
identity.description: <The gnomecorder hums.>$B$BYou need to find Yowler, $n. He'll be located somewhere in the northern region of Redridge Canyons. Kill that mongrel and search his corpse for the Blackrock invasion plans. Should you succeed, bring the plans to me over at the town hall in Lakeshire.$B$BSolomon, out.

PortraitGiverText.text: 犹勒，犹勒之子
PortraitGiverText.english: Yowler, Son of Yowler

identity.title: Eliminate the Outcast
identity.objectives: Travel to the Ruins of Aboraz in the Cape of Stranglethorn and deal with Zanzil the Outcast.
identity.description: You are to kill Zanzil.  You rode on Hir'eek's wings and saw through Hir'eek's eyes; you know where Zanzil hides within the Ruins of Aboraz.  Travel there and kill him.$b$bOh, and $r: if we become separated, you should use this fetish.  It only works within Stranglethorn, but it will transport you back here to me should you need to return switfly.$b$bGood luck, $r.  Zanzil is no ordinary opponent.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他搅合药剂的日子结束了。
PortraitGiverText.english: His potion-mixing days are at an end.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Where has he gone?

identity.title: High Priestess Jeklik
identity.objectives: Destroy High Priestess Jeklik's body before Zanzil can resurrect her.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway.
identity.description: Ahead of you looms a ramp up to one of the city's many terraces.  The bat-shaped totems ahead of you indicate that this is the domain of High Priestess Jeklik, a follower of Hir'eek.$b$bJeklik was one of the Hakkar-worshipping priests that Zanzil was planning to resurrect.  Perhaps if you hurry, you can stop the resurrection!

PortraitGiverText.text: 蝙蝠之灵希里克的追随者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Follower of Hir'eek, the bat loa.

identity.title: High Priest Venoxis
identity.objectives: Deal with Zanzil the Outcast and High Priest Venoxis.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway.
identity.description: Venoxis was the second of the two priests that Zanzil planned to bring back from the dead.  You have already succeeded in destroying the body of High Priestess Jeklik... Venoxis must be the next.

PortraitGiverText.text: 盘蛇之灵赫希斯的追随者
PortraitGiverText.english: Follower of Hethiss, the snake loa.

identity.title: [NYI] Breaking Out is Hard to Do

Title.english: [NYI] Breaking Out is Hard to Do

identity.title: Weapons of War
identity.objectives: Recover Keeshan's Bow and Keeshan's Survival Knife.
identity.description: What I'm about to ask of you isn't going to be easy to accomplish, $n. Keeshan left everything back there in that orc prison, and I'm not just talking about his soul or his will to live.$B$BIf we're going to get Johnny ready for war, we need to recover his prized possessions. The orcs now hold Keeshan's bow and his survival knife.$B$BHead to Alther's Mill, east of here and look for two orc lieutenants, Murdunk and Homurk. They've got Keeshan's gear. Get it back.$B$BI'll be in touch via gnomecorder.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你派了那么多人，有一件事切不能忘记。带够裹尸袋。
PortraitTurnInText.english: You send that many, don't forget one thing. A good supply of body bags.

identity.title: His Heart Must Be In It
identity.objectives: Recover Keeshan's Red Headband and Keeshan's Jade Amulet.
identity.description: <The gnomecorder clicks.>$B$BHis gear alone won't be enough, $n. His heart must also be in this battle. To capture that, we need items of sentimental value. The Blackrock orcs of Render's Camp, located in the north, hold two such items that belong to Keeshan.$B$BGet up there and search their coffers for Keeshan's headband and a jade amulet left to him by his wife - who was brutally killed during a Blackrock orc invasion.$B$BBring them back to me should you succeed.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他们把他……榨干了。
PortraitGiverText.english: They shaved him... dry.

identity.title: Rock Bottom
identity.objectives: Kill Gorgonite.
identity.description: I've one more favor to ask, fleshling.$B$BThere is a basilisk, much larger and much older than the rest. Though we normally fear nothing from their kind, this one has become so potent as to petrify some of my sons. This shall not be abided.$B$BFind Gorgonite to the east and slay him. He has lived much longer than necessary.

PortraitGiverText.text: 柯尔之子的灾祸。
PortraitGiverText.english: Bane of the Sons of Kor.

identity.title: Wrath of the Fungalmancer
identity.objectives: Speak to Earthmender Norsala, then kill Fungalmancer Glop.
identity.description: Their leader hides within his hole ahead. He is the one that has brought the plague upon the crimson expanse.$B$BHe must be killed.$B$BOne of your Earthen Ring companions is already inside. You should speak with her.

PortraitGiverText.text: 毒菇怪客本尊。
