PortraitGiverText.english: The Shroomgroomer himself.

identity.title: Mok'rash the Cleaver
identity.objectives: Kill Mok'rash the Cleaver at Janeiro's Point.
identity.description: Mok'rash the Cleaver is the last of the lot.  And the largest, by my memory.  Taller than a wave in a windstorm, with a beard like a kelp forest and a hammer like an oak tree.$b$bHe taunts me from Janeiro's Point, the island right off the end of this very pier.  It's because of him that I'm still trapped here, living this lamentable landlubber's life.$b$bIf you can swim, then head out to Janeiro's Point and slay Mok'rash.$b$bTake care, $n.  Mok'rash will not lay down as easily as his brothers.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这是他们当中最厉害的一个。
PortraitGiverText.english: He's the biggest of 'em all.

identity.title: Mukla's Demise
identity.objectives: Slay King Mukla obtain the Shackle Key.
identity.description: $n, I now put my faith in you to help free me.  The great Skymane King Mukla is my captor.  He commands the beasts of this island, and they keep me here against my will with the aid of this chain.  If you can slay him and find the key to this shackle, I shall be indebted to you greatly.$B$BI often hear him to the southeast side of the island, but please be careful: he is not to be trifled with.

PortraitGiverText.text: 身躯庞大的蓝鬃猩猩没有天敌…除了你。
PortraitGiverText.english: The massive skymane knows no predators... except you.

identity.title: It's Never Over
identity.objectives: Take Keeshan's Riverboat to Camp Everstill in Redridge.
identity.description: Those Blackrock orcs are gonna need an army to handle the Bravo Company and you, $n. When you're ready to go, meet us at the dock facing Lake Everstill and we'll set off on my riverboat for Camp Everstill on the other side of the lake.$B$BSee you there, $n.

AreaDescription.text: 乘坐基沙恩的小船抵达目的地。

identity.title: An Old Sea Dog
identity.objectives: Bring the Weather-Beaten Coin to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
identity.description: This old, weathered coin was found on the body of the pirate "Good-Boy" Bruce.  Its front side bears the image of a large, unfamiliar pirate ship; on its back side, the term "Brashtide Crew".$b$bSomeone who has been in the piracy business for some time might know what this coin is, or what it means.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Bruce, before the sickness took hold.

identity.title: Death to Mor'ghor
identity.objectives: Slay Warchief Mor'ghor in Dragonmaw Port. You can still recruit Dragonmaw Merchants and Workers to help you.
identity.description: The time has come. Mor'ghor dies today.$B$BBe warned, $c. Demon blood courses through his wretched veins, and he channels unnatural power. He will be destroyed, yes. But it will not be an easy fight.$B$BYou remember where Mor'ghor resides, at the top of the camp. I will meet you there. Finish him!$B$BBe sure to recruit 3 Dragonmaw followers if you are short - you will need our help.

PortraitGiverText.text: 莫格霍尔逃得过外域，但逃不过今天了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Mor'ghor survived Outland. But he won't survive this.

identity.title: Troggzor the Earthinator
identity.objectives: Obtain the Earthinator's Cudgel.
identity.description: You have to put an end to this now!$B$BGo back northwest onto the front and kill their battle leader, Troggzor the Earthinator. Bring me his cudgel as proof.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在他毁掉这一地区之前阻止他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Stop him before he earthinates the countryside!

identity.title: Death From Below
identity.objectives: Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.
identity.description: This is bad. It seems the Daggerspines are amassing for an attack.$b$bNaga are known for their ruthlessness in battle. They will keep attacking until I am dead.$b$bI don't value my own life above that of my crew members, but you must help to defend me. The crew will not be able to make it back to Booty Bay without my knowledge of the seas.$b$bThe naga will be coming from the sea. I need you to remain up here with me to fend off the attack. Man the cannon and drive them back.$b$bAre you ready, $n?

identity.title: Looks Like a Tauren Pirate to Me
identity.objectives: Obtain a Cow Head and an Oversized Pirate Hat, then bring them back to Fleet Master Seahorn.
identity.description: Firallon wants MY head?  Now that's interesting.  But it's nothing we can't work around.$b$bThis Yancey character probably doesn't know my face too well.  Most non-tauren find us tauren indistinguishable from one another.  In fact... most non-tauren find us indistinguishable from... a certain four-legged farm creature.$b$bRikqiz the leatherworker keeps one of these creatures here in Booty Bay, and Narkk is my chief supplier for pirate hats.  Get a replacement head and a hat, then return with both.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 安息吧，甜心女王。您的牺牲我们不会忘记。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Good night, sweet queen.  Your sacrifice will not be forgotten.

identity.title: Prisoners of War
identity.objectives: Free the Prisoners of War locked up in the prison at Render's Valley.
identity.description: The Bravo Company field kit is ready, $n. I'm gonna equip you with it and you're gonna enter Render's Valley, southeast of here, and free our P.O.W.s.  I'm sending Jorgensen with you to watch your back.$B$BNow the prisoners are being held on the northeast side of the valley in a large cage, but the key to the cage is in a cave on the south side of the valley. You'll have to steal the key, create a distraction, and free the citizens.$B$BGood luck, $n! I'll be in touch through the field kit.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 我体内流淌着战争的热血。
PortraitTurnInText.english: War is in my blood.

identity.title: Ol' Blasty
identity.objectives: Practice using the cannon by hitting Smilin' Timmy Sticks 5 times with cannonballs from Ol' Blasty.
identity.description: We've got some work to do.  How much experience have you got with cannons?  Hmm... really?  Well, how about with ancient, fallin'-apart pirate cannons?$b$bWe've got a few cannons updecks that work the old-fashioned way: you load one cannonball in at a time, aim, lock it into place, and fire.  Works well if you're tryin' to hit the side of a three-sailer... not so well for rowboats and the like.$b$bWhy don't you head upstairs and lob a few shots at Smilin' Timmy Sticks?

PortraitGiverText.text: 真正的勇士。
PortraitGiverText.english: A real trooper.

identity.title: To Win a War, You Gotta Become War
identity.objectives: Use the Bravo Company Field Kit to plant a Seaforium Charge at the Blackrock Tower and Blackrock Munitions Hut.
identity.description: <The Bravo Company radio beeps.>$B$BDo you understand yet, $n? Do you now see what we gotta do to win a war against these monsters? YOU GOTTA BECOME WAR! NO MERCY!$B$BWith the P.O.W.s freed you're clear to plant the seaforium. Carefully make your way into each of the structures out there and plant a charge.$B$BPlant a seaforium charge at the Blackrock munitions hut and the Blackrock tower. Once you're done meet up with me and the rest of Bravo Company at Shalewind Canyon, east of Render's Valley.

PortraitGiverText.text: 要赢得战争，就要比战争还残酷。
PortraitGiverText.english: To win a war, you must become war.

identity.title: Resonating Blow
identity.objectives: Defeat Aeosera.
identity.description: On the western edge of the Pale Roost, you will find a resonating crystal. Strike it with the mallet and the broodmother will come.$B$BBe ready for battle. I will be there to aid you, but she will not be easily overcome.

PortraitGiverText.text: 石龙之母
PortraitGiverText.english: Broodmother of the Stone Drakes.

identity.title: Detonation
identity.objectives: Blow up Render's Valley.
identity.description: Those explosives you planted were high yield, $n. When I push this button on the Bravo Company field kit, that whole valley is gonna be consumed by a massive fireball of death.$B$BYou know, I think you should do the honors. You did all the hard work, after all.$B$BReady?

identity.title: The Insane Ghoul
identity.objectives: Retrieve Mary's Looking Glass from the Insane Ghoul.
identity.description: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident.  After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn.  There was an insane ghoul who used to roam back there.  Perhaps he picked it up.  Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

PortraitGiverText.text: 眼镜在他的手上，但他已经疯掉了。
PortraitGiverText.english: He carries the looking glass.  Also, he is insane.

identity.title: Classy Glass
identity.objectives: Kill Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and collect the Ogre Monocle.
identity.description: Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device.  Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort.  The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.$b$bThere is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood.  If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!

PortraitGiverText.text: 石拳氏族的勇士
PortraitGiverText.english: Champion of the Stone Fist Clan.

identity.title: Shadowhide Extinction
identity.objectives: Kill any 20 Shadowhide Gnolls.
identity.description: Now that every Blackrock orc south of Lake Everstill is nothing more than ash and cinder, we can turn our attention to the Shadowhide gnoll army of Galardell Valley, directly north of here.$B$BI want you to head out there and kill 'em all, $n! Initiate Operation: Extinction, soldier. For Bravo Company and for the Alliance!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Slay them all.

identity.title: The Dark Tower
identity.objectives: Recover the Key of Ilgalar.
identity.description: We got lucky with some vital intelligence from the locals of this valley. Those two behind us, the Ranthals, have informed me that the gnolls in Galardell Valley are being controlled by a powerful magus in the tower of Ilgalar. The problem is that the tower is sealed by a magical force field.$B$BThe first thing we need to do is get the key that will get you inside. The gnoll general, Fangore, has your ticket inside. Kill General Fangore and get the key.$B$BI'll be in touch.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Fangore was a chump.

identity.title: The Grand Magus Doane
identity.objectives: Kill Grand Magus Doane.
identity.description: <The Bravo Company field kit vibrates.>$B$BGood work, kid. I've got some vital intel for you. The magus in the tower is a human named Doane. Damned traitor is working for the Blackrock orcs. I want him dead.$B$BUse the key of Ilgalar and get inside that tower. Work your way to the top and show Doane what Bravo Company does with traitors.$B$BRendezvous back at Shalewind Canyon when the deed is done.$B$BKeeshan, over and out.

PortraitGiverText.text: 该让一个大法师像个小姑娘哭哭啼啼的了。别告诉梅森纳这是我说的。
PortraitGiverText.english: Time to make a magus cry like the little girl that he is. Don't tell Messner I said that.

identity.title: Bloodsail's End
identity.objectives: Speak with Kebok in Booty Bay to get a wind rider, then kill Fleet Master Firallon.
identity.description: We've nearly won the day, largely thanks to you.  One task remains, however... kill Fleet Master Firallon.$b$bIt looks like most of Firallon's crew is already dead, but I know that old sea dog well enough to know that he's not done yet.  No, he's cooped up tight in his cabin, ready to go down with his ship.$b$bSpeak with Kebok again to get a wind rider.  I'll try to hold off the cannonfire while you're on board.

PortraitGiverText.text: 是时候和血帆算总账了。杀死菲尔拉伦。
PortraitGiverText.english: It's time to end the Bloodsail, once and for all.  Kill Firallon.

identity.title: Showdown at Stonewatch
identity.objectives: Kill Tharil'zun and Gath'Ilzogg.
identity.description: Only the Blackrock high command remains, $n. They're all holed up in Stonewatch Keep, directly south of our position here at Keeshan's Post. I want you and the rest of Bravo Company to enter Stonewatch and put an end to the Blackrock orc invasion.$B$B$n, no survivors.

PortraitTurnInText.english: It's a trap! Get out!

identity.title: Darkblaze, Brood of the Worldbreaker
identity.objectives: Use the Horn of Summoning to call for Darkblaze. Defeat Darkblaze.
identity.description: As Troteman cuts out, the world around you grows eerily silent. In the distance you see a full grown black dragon!

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑暗烈焰必须死！
PortraitGiverText.english: Darkblaze must die!

identity.title: A Curse We Cannot Lift
identity.objectives: Search the Addle Stead for the Lurking Worgen and use Harris's Ampule to tranquilize it.
identity.description: What we do here is not a cure. The transformation cannot be removed once inflicted. But the mind...$B$BThe mind can be restored, through alchemy,  if enough is left intact. This worgen you've encountered sounds like he's fighting to stay aware, $n. We've got to find him again.$B$BIf he's fled the Yorgen Stead, search the Addle Stead to the south; he may be lurking in one of the buildings.$B$BInject him with this ampule to tranquilize him. You'll need to be quite close.

PortraitGiverText.text: 使用哈瑞斯的针剂使他平静下来。
PortraitGiverText.english: Use Harris's Ampule to tranquilize him.

identity.title: The Embalmer's Revenge
identity.objectives: Slay Stitches in Darkshire.
identity.description: You're not the first fool to be manipulated by Abercrombie! That doddering old man is known as The Embalmer to us. He's a vile necromancer and a blight upon this town.$B$BAnd now, sewn together and given life by the very materials you brought him, his horrible creation approaches!$B$BThat hideous creature will be upon us in mere moments! If you have any heart, $n, you'll help the Night Watch drive off the abomination and save our town!

PortraitGiverText.text: 缝合怪，藏尸者的礼物
PortraitGiverText.english: The Gift of the Embalmer

identity.title: The Fate of Kurzen
identity.objectives: Obtain the Kurzen Compound Prison Records and the Kurzen Compound Officers' Dossier.
identity.description: Hello, $c.$b$bWe are soldiers of Stormwind, and rebels from Kurzen's Compound, a large outpost that you'll find just to the southeast of here.  We were under the command of Colonel Kurzen, until he and those close to him started to descend into madness...$b$bWe rebelled, set up camp here, and stood against Kurzen.  Now, my sources are telling me Kurzen has disappeared.  I trust my source, but it would help to hear from a third party.  Please, head into the compound and find some documentation of his fate.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我要你去查一下库尔森到底发生了什么事。
PortraitGiverText.english: I need you to find out what happened to Kurzen.

identity.title: A Physical Specimen
identity.objectives: Obtain Gan'zulah's Body from Zul'Kunda.
identity.description: The soul is ready, but the body is not.  For a skull as well-formed, as marvelous, as beautiful as this... we will need a suitable body.$b$bThe chief of the Bloodscalps, Gan'zulah, won his throne with brute force.  If he still lives, you'll find him in Zul'Kunda, to the west.$b$bTaking his body won't be easy, but nothing a sturdy $c like yourself couldn't handle.  Bring it back here when you're done.

PortraitGiverText.text: 看……看那肌肉。
PortraitGiverText.english: Just... just look at that musculature.

identity.title: To Catch a Dragon
identity.objectives: Obtain a Dragon Snare from the Twilight Dragonstalkers.
identity.description: Having a dragon guard the fragment was a smart move on the enemy's part.  They can keep moving its location any time we get close to it.$B$BCatching Abyssion will be extremely difficult, but I have a plan that might help.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer uses magical traps to bind stone drakes to the ground while they drain their energy.$B$BIf we can get our hands on one of these, we might be able to ground the Twilight Dragon for just long enough.$B$BGo east of here, to the Alabaster Shelf, and obtain a trap.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他们在用圈捕器抓石幼龙。
PortraitGiverText.english: They're using snares to trap the stone drakes.

identity.title: Be Raptor
identity.objectives: Speak with Priestess Thaalia, then help the Captured Lashtail Hatchling escape from Zul'Gurub.
identity.description: Mind Control, very powerful, yes.$b$bWith luck, you can help Ohgan'aka escape from Zul'Gurub.$b$bThen, Ohgan'aka becomes $n'aka again!$b$bSpeak to Priestess, yes, and help $n'aka escape.

PortraitGiverText.text: 被困在祖尔格拉布！
PortraitGiverText.english: Trapped in Zul'Gurub!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Returned from the dead?

identity.title: The Mind's Eye
identity.objectives: Obtain the Mind's Eye from Mai'Zoth.
identity.description: One of the Vale's many treasures lies nearby, on OUR side of the giant whirlpool.  The Mind's Eye is held by an ogre mage, in the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound just to the northeast.  His name is Mai'Zoth.  From what I understand, he is vicious, and his magic is strong.$B$BAnd if he has the Mind's Eye, then his magic will be stronger still.$b$bThus far I've been unable to get near enough to take it from him.  Will you give it a try?

PortraitGiverText.text: 尽管强大，麦佐斯依然懦弱，多半会藏在他的洞穴深处。
PortraitGiverText.english: While powerful, Mai'Zoth is cowardly and will probably be hiding in the back of his cave.

identity.title: Eliminate the Outcast
identity.objectives: Travel to the Ruins of Aboraz in the Cape of Stranglethorn and deal with Zanzil the Outcast.
identity.description: You are to kill Zanzil.  You rode on Hir'eek's wings and saw through Hir'eek's eyes; you know where Zanzil hides within the Ruins of Aboraz.  Travel there and kill him.$b$bOh, and $r: if we become separated, you should use this fetish.  It only works within Stranglethorn, but it will transport you back here to me should you need to return switfly.$b$bGood luck, $r.  Zanzil is no ordinary opponent.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他搅合药剂的日子结束了。
PortraitGiverText.english: His potion-mixing days are at an end.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Where has he gone?

identity.title: High Priestess Jeklik
identity.objectives: Destroy High Priestess Jeklik's body before Zanzil can resurrect her.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
identity.description: Ahead of you looms a ramp up to one of the city's many terraces.  The bat-shaped totems ahead of you indicate that this is the domain of High Priestess Jeklik, a follower of Hir'eek.$b$bJeklik was one of the Hakkar-worshipping priests that Zanzil was planning to resurrect.  Perhaps if you hurry, you can stop the resurrection!

PortraitGiverText.text: 蝙蝠之灵希里克的追随者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Follower of Hir'eek, the bat loa.

identity.title: High Priest Venoxis
identity.objectives: Deal with Zanzil the Outcast and High Priest Venoxis.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
identity.description: Venoxis was the second of the two priests that Zanzil planned to bring back from the dead.  You have already succeeded in destroying the body of High Priestess Jeklik... Venoxis must be the next.

PortraitGiverText.text: 盘蛇之灵赫希斯的追随者
PortraitGiverText.english: Follower of Hethiss, the snake loa.

identity.title: Traitor's Bait
identity.objectives: Question Orgrimmar Skyway Peons around the Zeppelin Towers. Look for any Suspicious Peons. Try to flush out Sauranok the Mystic and kill him.
identity.description:
The Twilight's Hammer agents still lurk within the confines of Orgrimmar. I need someone I trust to collect the final evidence of treachery.

<Saurfang pulls you aside.>

I suspect that Sauranok the Mystic is involved. I need you to uncover the truth, $n.  The Twilight's Hammer has placed their agents within the ranks of the workers at the airship docks to spread their lies across th land. Speak with them. If you find evidence of Sauranok's guilt then show him what happens to traitors of the Horde.

PortraitGiverText.text: 和空港苦工交谈，找出萨乌拉诺克叛变的证据。然后杀死他。
PortraitGiverText.english: Talk to the Skyway Peons and find evidence of Sauranok's treachery. Then kill him.

identity.title: The Twilight Flight
identity.objectives: Defeat Zoltrik Drakebane.
identity.description: Terrath wants you to make your way to the far end of the precipice to fight Zoltrik Drakebane. He is on his way there as well, but he thinks Zoltrik is likely to take to the sky.$B$BQuite an impression you seem to have made, little one. Have you ever mused that none of this would have happened if I had just stepped on you during our first meeting? Fate is a strange thing.

PortraitGiverText.text: 深岩之洲的暮光驭龙者领袖。
PortraitGiverText.english: Leader of the Twilight Drakeriders in Deepholm.

identity.title: Rescue the Stonefather... and Flint
identity.objectives: Free Stonefather Oremantle.
identity.description: We found out where the Stonefather is being held and young Flint ran off on his own to rescue him!$B$BI don't have to tell you that this is bad. Flint is going to get himself captured as well, or worse!$B$BThe stone trogg chieftain, Bouldergut, is at the end of the ledges above Needlerock Chasm to the north.$B$BPlease, $n, you must go after Flint and free the Stonefather before we lose them both!

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死石胆，营救石父……还有弗林特！
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay the stone trogg chieftain to rescue the Stonefather... and Flint!

identity.title: A Tiny, Clever Commander
identity.objectives: Slay Commander Nazrim.
identity.description: We've dealt with kobolds in these lands for years. Not much other than a nuisance. But they've been getting craftier at their stealing.$B$BI think one of them's ended up smarter than usual. Won't be that way for long, though!$B$BI want you to go to the camp south of here and make sure there's not a "big shot" kobold stirrin' up the other ones. Make sure to check the cave; it's a likely spot.$B$BAnd don't be shy about clearing out the other kobolds along the way.

PortraitGiverText.text: 去找身上蜡烛最长的那个狗头人。
PortraitGiverText.english: Look for the kobold with the longest candle.

identity.title: A Pilot's Revenge
identity.objectives: Kill Mangeclaw.$B$BBring his Mangy Claw and Hildelve's Journal to Pilot Hammerfoot at the South Gate Outpost.
identity.description: Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear."  He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.$B$BJudging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.$B$BHowever, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:$B$BRevenge against Mangeclaw.

PortraitGiverText.text: 找到莫里·铁钻的尸体。那头熊肯定就在附近。
PortraitGiverText.english: Look around Hildelve's body.  The bear will certainly be nearby.

identity.title: Taragaman the Hungerer
identity.objectives: Take Taragaman the Hungerer's heart.
identity.description: The Searing Blade has managed to summon a foul demon they call Taragaman the Hungerer to lead the first attack in their takeover of Orgrimmar!$B$BMake haste and slay Taragaman in the name of the Warchief! Lok'tar ogar!

PortraitGiverText.text: 让他饱餐一顿拳脚刀剑吧。
PortraitGiverText.english: Time to feed him a heaping plate of pain.

identity.title: Depth of the Depths
identity.objectives: Find the Painite within the Crumbling Depths.
identity.description: <The ground trembles slightly, and the low, familiar voice of Diamant speaks as if from the stone itself.>$B$BWell done, $r.$B$BWithin the tunnels below, you will find the stone which you seek. Painite.$B$BThe dangers ahead are many...$B$BDangers that the Stone Lords themselves fear.$B$BRemain steady.$B$BRemain strong.$B$BThe strength of the rock itself is beneath your feet.

PortraitGiverText.text: 耐心者岱亚曼塔。永恒之石。冗长之石。
PortraitGiverText.english: Diamant the Patient. The Timeless. The Long-Winded.

identity.title: A Rock Amongst Many
identity.objectives: Return to Diamant at Lorthuna's Gate with the Painite Chunk.
identity.description: <The ground trembles slightly, and the low, familiar voice of Diamant speaks as if from the stone itself.>$B$BYou've done as I've asked.$B$BTurn back and escape the cave in one piece.$B$BDon't forget the gemstone.

PortraitGiverText.text: 耐心者岱亚曼塔。永恒之石。冗长之石。
PortraitGiverText.english: Diamant the Patient. The Timeless. The Long-Winded.

Title.text: 吉爾尼斯城不同步作弊

identity.title: Blackfathom Villainy
identity.objectives: Get the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.
identity.description: My strength has left me. I need your help!$b$bLong ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from below and tainted the sacred moonwell.$b$bAku'Mai, a servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.$b$bSlay Kelris and bring his head to Ashelan.

PortraitGiverText.text: 必须阻止克尔里斯！
PortraitGiverText.english: Kelris must be stopped!

identity.title: Nightmare of the Deeps
identity.objectives: Kill Aku'mai.
identity.description: In the darkest recesses of Blackfathom, a monster spawned by the Old Gods lurks. We know it only as Aku'mai.$B$BThe Old Gods and their servants are incredibly dangerous to our world. Long ago, they ruled over Azeroth and I fear that they seek to do so again, or destroy it while trying.$B$B$n, Aku'mai is a creature of untold nightmare. We simply cannot allow his continued existence. Destroy him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 上古众神的邪恶宠物。
PortraitGiverText.english: Foul pet of the Old Gods.

identity.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
identity.objectives: Obtain the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.
identity.description: Cultists...sacrifice...power...$B$BEnemy...awaken...$B$BOld God...imprison...me...$B$BLord...Kelris...$B$BBring head...revenge...$B$BERADICATE!!!

PortraitGiverText.text: 拿到他的徽记！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get his head!

identity.title: Get Back to Town Accepted Tracking Event

Title.text: 回到鎮上接受追蹤事件
Title.english: Get Back to Town Accepted Tracking Event

identity.title: Willix the Importer
identity.objectives: Escort Willix the Importer to the exit of Razorfen Kraul.
identity.description: At last, help has arrived!$b$bYou have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.$b$bYou see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that pig snouts were selling outrageously high in the market. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!$b$bAnyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.

AreaDescription.text: 帮助进口商威利克斯逃离剃刀沼泽
AreaDescription.english: Help Willix the Importer escape from Razorfen Kraul

identity.title: Agamaggan's Charge
identity.objectives: Take Charlga Razorflank's heart.
identity.description: Listen closely, mortal.$B$BThe Quilboar are my children. My blood runs deep in these lands.$B$BCharlga Razorflank has steered my children into darkness, driven into insanity by the Scourge.$B$BSlay her, $n. Slay her and open my childrens' eyes.$B$BGive the Quilboar the chance to return to their noble roots. Let them once more earn my blessing.$B$BBring me her heart!!!$B$B

PortraitGiverText.text: 把她的精华带给我！！！
PortraitGiverText.english: Bring me her heart!!!

identity.title: Agamaggan
identity.objectives: Talk to the Spirit of Agamaggan.
identity.description: I sense a being of immense power within these twisted thorns, $n. The entire area has come alive at its presence.$B$BIt must be the Spirit of Agamaggan! He was one of the first and most powerful beings to ever live - the Quilboar worship him fervently.$B$BAll the vines you see across the land are a result of his blood; of his sacrifice to save Azeroth in the War of the Ancients.$B$BIf there's any being that could steer the Quilboar towards their noble roots, it would be him.$B$BYou must seek him out.

PortraitGiverText.text: 找到他。
PortraitGiverText.english: Seek him out.

identity.title: Etched Letter
identity.objectives: Read the Etched Letter and speak to Ashley Blank in Northshire Valley.
identity.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Ashley Blank, our local hunter trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

PortraitGiverText.text: 阿什莉·布兰克就在治安官玛克布莱德的东边。
PortraitGiverText.english: Ashley Blank can be found just east of Marshal McBride.

identity.title: The Princess Unleashed
identity.objectives: Summon and defeat Myzrael at the Shards of Myzrael.
identity.description: Myzrael is a deceiver. She is an ancient force sealed long ago, and must be kept that way.$B$BYou must confront her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her.  Summon her with this scroll, and when she has been fully brought to the surface, defeat her. Then take the Eldritch Shackles from her body and place them on the Shards to keep her fully bound once more.$B$BGood luck, $n... may my past trouble you no more.

PortraitGiverText.text: 释放她……然后毁掉她。
PortraitGiverText.english: Set her free... then destroy her.

identity.title: Scholomancer
identity.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling within Andorhal.
identity.description: The Scholomance is one of the few Scourge holdouts remaining west of the Thondroril.  The headmaster of Scholomance, a cultist by the name of Darkmaster Gandling, has made an appearance on the battlefield.$b$bThis will be his final mistake.$b$bYou will find Gandling in a square near the southern end of town.  I want you to fight and weaken Gandling.  I will join you to help finish him off.

PortraitGiverText.text: 通灵学院的院长，安多哈尔天灾的首领。
PortraitGiverText.english: Master of the Scholomance, leader of the Scourge in Andorhal.

identity.title: Araj the Summoner
identity.objectives: Kill Araj the Summoner.  You may use Jearl's Hand Grenades to destroy Stickbone Berserkers.
identity.description: With the animus destroyed, the next logical step is to take out Araj himself, and to take a shard of his phylactery.  You've probably already seen him, lurking at the fountain in the center of town.$b$bTake my grenades with you.  They won't do anything to Araj, but if he decides to summon any of those skeletons, you can use them to blow them away.  Again.

PortraitGiverText.text: 记住，使用我的手雷来招呼他的骷髅们！
PortraitGiverText.english: Remember, use my grenades to take care of his skeletons!

identity.title: After the Crusade
identity.objectives: Scout the Scarlet Crusade camp located east of Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands.
identity.description: Our victories are quickly piling up, $n.  The Scarlet Crusade, which has long persecuted the Forsaken, is on its last legs.  While they still hold their monastery here in Tirisfal, they no longer occupy Hearthglen, or Tyr's Hand, far to the east.$b$bAs recently as last week, there have been reports of Scarlet Crusade activity at a small camp east of Felstone Field, but I have reason to believe that they too have been eliminated.  Travel there, and verify this information for me.

identity.title: The G-Team
identity.objectives: Kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
identity.description: I'd keep my distance from B.E Barechus and Murd Doc, neither is terribly stable.$B$BYou are, though, so let's get you to work! Go down into this tunnel until you get to Tinkers' Court. Hopefully you'll know what to do when you meet Mekgineer Thermaplugg.$B$BOur leader, Commando Hann Ibal waits somewhere in there. He'll reward you handsomely for all your work.$B$BProbably.

PortraitGiverText.text: 当心他的炸弹！
PortraitGiverText.english: Watch out for his bombs!

identity.title: The Dark Side of the Light
identity.objectives: Kill Interrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos.
identity.description: The Scarlet Crusade lures in anxious young warriors with their promise to eradicate the undead. What they don't see is the dark underbelly of the entire operation.$B$BInterrogator Vishas is the cruelest man I've ever had the displeasure to meet - he 'extracted' information from my mother during the initial outbreak of the plague. The merciless Bloodmage Thalnos watches over their graveyard.$B$BThe crusaders' zealous holy rage blinds them from their own darkness. Make them regret their hypocrisy.

PortraitGiverText.text: 该死的怪物。
PortraitGiverText.english: Damned monster.

identity.title: Stripping Their Defenses
identity.objectives: Eliminate Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan.
identity.description: We need to eliminate the Scarlet Monastery's defenses before a true invasion can begin. Venture deep into here, their library, and assassinate Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan. They maintain the powerful defenses that protect their comrades.$B$BMy own magic will ensure your actions go undetected by the rest of the monastery. Once they are dead, I can summon in additional reinforcements to aid in our attack.$B$BWe must be successful, $n, the Dark Lady will not tolerate failure in the slightest.

PortraitGiverText.text: 尽快收拾掉他。
PortraitGiverText.english: He needs to die quickly.

identity.title: Stripping Their Offense
identity.objectives: Kill Herod.
identity.description: As you can see, $n, our first assault on the Armory did not go as planned. We had taken the nearby courtyard until the Scarlet Champion, Herod, showed up.$B$BWe must continue our assault. The Scarlet Crusade will never be allowed to train another warrior here, let alone launch an attack on the Undercity.$B$BYour task should be obvious. Down the Scarlet Champion.

PortraitGiverText.text: 血色十字军勇士
PortraitGiverText.english: The Scarlet Champion

identity.title: Battle for the Scarlet Monastery
identity.objectives: Kill Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane.
identity.description: Behold the might of the Forsaken! The unstoppable will of the Dark Lady flows through our bodies! $B$BThe vast majority of the crusade's remaining forces have fled. Some, however, remain defiant.$B$BYou have been instrumental in this campaign's success. Sylvanas extends the honor of slaying her last remaining enemies to you, $n.$B$BShow no mercy.

PortraitGiverText.text: 让她吃点苦头，勇士。
PortraitGiverText.english: Make her suffer, champion.

identity.title: The Binding
identity.objectives: Kill High Priestess Lorthuna.
identity.description: A noise in the main chamber of the temple draws your attention. You hear a familiar laugh... Lorthuna. She's returned to interrupt the ritual - you must stop her!

PortraitGiverText.text: 深岩之洲残余暮光之锤教徒的领袖。
PortraitGiverText.english: Leader of the remaining Twilight's Hammer in Deepholm.

identity.title: The Only True Path
identity.objectives: Eliminate Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan.
identity.description: I think that the root of the crusade's corruption can be found here. Arcanist Doan watches over the library, and teaches many young recruits to wield the arcane arts.$B$BThe Light is the only true path! You must kill him, $c, and redeem this glorious movement!$B$B<Joseph the Awakened shifts nervously.>$B$BYou'll want to dispose of Loksey as well. His hounds seem to disapprove of our noble intent.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他以铁腕统治着血色图书馆。
PortraitGiverText.english: He rules the Scarlet Library with an iron shush.

identity.title: The False Champion
identity.objectives: Kill Herod.
identity.description: We...we...we had to kill them! They were coming right for us!$B$BYou believe me, don't you $n?$B$BHerod is not the true champion of the Scarlet Crusade. I am! He took what was rightfully mine!$B$BYou should kill him. He's...a menace! Trains the soldiers to kill anyone instead of just the undead!$B$BI'll reward you handsomely...

PortraitGiverText.text: 肮脏的小偷！
PortraitGiverText.english: A dirty thief!

identity.title: Rallying the Fleet
identity.objectives: Escort Prince Anduin to the Stormwind Docks and talk to Supply Sergeant Graves. If you get separated from the Prince, you'll find him in the Stormwind throne room.
identity.description: I am amassing a warfleet to assault Twilight Highlands and bring an end to Deathwing's lackeys. My soldiers are ready but fleet preparations lag behind.$B$BMy men at the docks need some inspiration and motivation. A visit from the Prince here should lift their spirits and remind them of the bright future they're fighting for.$B$BTake Prince Anduin to the docks with you and speak with Supply Sergeant Graves. I want Anduin to observe how a natural leader handles the situation.

AreaDescription.text: 将安度因王子护送到格雷夫斯处。

identity.title: Battle for the Scarlet Monastery
identity.objectives: Kill Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane.
identity.description: Oh, it's great to see you again $n! I'm afraid I'm going to need your help.$B$BYou see, Mograine's the Commander here along with High Inquisitor Whitemane, and they tried telling me that I wasn't really the new Scarlet Champion! 'Course, the boys and I didn't take kindly to that.$B$BWe're taking the Scarlet Monastery for our own and re-establishing the order as it always should have been - with me at the head of things! I'll take care of the Forsaken and the Scourge for good.$B$BHelp an old friend out?

PortraitGiverText.text: 解决掉她！
PortraitGiverText.english: Take her out!

identity.title: Right Under Their Noses
identity.objectives: Kill High Inquisitor Fairbanks.
identity.description: In the right side-room of the accursed cathedral ahead there is a torch on the wall. Move it and a secret door will open. Inside is High Inquisitor Fairbanks. He is now an undead.$B$BI need him taken care of. Kill him in his own room if possible, I'd strongly prefer the crusaders not see him. You know the deal - kill him, and I'll reward you. No other words are necessary between us.

identity.title: Silvermarsh Rendezvous
identity.objectives: Go to the Upper Silvermarsh in Deepholm.
identity.description: Excellent work, $n.  We know exactly where the meeting location is.$B$BThe Upper Silvermarsh is a mercury swamp to the east of here.  It's normally only inhabited by elementals and occasional stone troggs, but our scouts have seen some Twilight activity in the region.$B$BMake your way there and let's find a way to eavesdrop on the Forgemaster's meeting.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们对会面地点很熟悉。
PortraitGiverText.english: We're familiar with the meeting location.

PortraitTurnInText.english: We've arrived.

identity.title: The Coldbringer
identity.objectives: Kill Amnennar the Coldbringer.
identity.description: Amnennar the Coldbringer rules over the Razorfen Downs with very dark and powerful Scourge magic. I have managed to clear an opening in the thorns just above his seat of power, but his sorcery prevents me from launching an assault.$B$BIf you venture up the Spiral of Thorns and engage him, he will be distracted long enough for me to attack him briefly, weakening him before he can use his most deadly spells. Once he is weakened, destroy him without mercy.

PortraitGiverText.text: 当心他强大的魔法！
PortraitGiverText.english: Be wary of his powerful magic!

identity.title: Extinguishing the Idol
identity.objectives: Protect Belnistrasz.
identity.description: Near the entrance is an idol that functions as a macabre oven for the Quilboar; they...they literally consume their abductees from the Barrens.  I can shut down the idol and render it useless, but I need your aid in doing so.  My plan: escort me to the idol.  Once we arrive, I'll commence the ritual.  I'll barely be able to communicate with you, let alone defend myself.  Protect me while I shut down the idol.$B$BAre you with me, $r? Can I count on you to help me end their atrocities?

AreaDescription.text: 在奔尼斯特拉兹举行仪式关闭神像时保护他
AreaDescription.english: Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol

identity.title: Vyrin's Revenge
identity.objectives: Kill Ol' Sooty and obtain his head.
identity.description: I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.$b$bA year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.$b$bKill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.$b$bThe bear, Ol' Sooty, can be found around his lair in the cave to the north.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这是为了达瑞尔。
PortraitGiverText.english: Do it for Daryl.

identity.title: Fight Fire and Water and Air with...
identity.objectives: Acquire the Fire, Water, and Air Wards, and then slay Haethen Kaul.
identity.description: Did ye hear the blatherin' idiot while ye were up there? That's none other than Haethen Kaul, their leader.$B$BThe man's gone daft with power. He's pullin' it straight from them bound elementals, makin' him nigh invincible.$B$BThe only thing I can think of to get ye into proper shape fer a fight with him is fer ye to first kill all o' them elementals, gettin' their wards. That should protect ye from Haethen's spells.$B$BWell, most o' them anyway.

PortraitGiverText.text: 先获得火、水及空气结界，然后杀死他！
PortraitGiverText.english: First, get the fire, water, and air wards.  Then slay him!

identity.title: Fight Fire and Water and Air with...
identity.objectives: Acquire the Fire, Water, and Air Wards, and then slay Haethen Kaul.
identity.description: Did you hear the man going on with his incessant yelling while you were up there? That's Haethen Kaul, their leader.$B$BIt's a well known fact that he's gone insane from the power he's drawing from their bound elementals. Unfortunately, it makes him nigh invincible.$B$BIf you're to fight him, you'll first have to kill each of the elementals, gaining their wards in the process. That should protect you from Haethen's magic.$B$BWell, most of it anyway.

PortraitGiverText.text: 先获得火、水及空气结界，然后杀死他！
PortraitGiverText.english: First, get the fire, water, and air wards.  Then slay him!

identity.title: Peasant Problems
identity.objectives: Escort Prince Anduin to Farmer Wollerton at the Wollerton Stead within Stormwind City. If he's no longer with you, you can find him in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: I'm not quite ready to go back to the keep yet. Would you like to help me with something?$B$BRecently some of the local farmers were petitioning the King about some missing livestock. My father promised someone would investigate, but the city guard is stretched so thin it'll take weeks.$B$BI thought I would help! It'll encourage the farmers to see someone take action, especially from the royal family. Besides, it's just some missing cows. Nothing dangerous.$B$BTake me to Farmer Wollerton here in the city!

AreaDescription.text: 护送安度因去找沃勒顿

identity.title: Gahrron's Withering Cauldron
identity.objectives: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.
identity.description: My analysis is complete!  The blight that affects the animals here is no residual disease.  No, it is something new... and I think I know what it is.$b$bThe Cult of the Damned maintains a plague cauldron on a farm called Gahrron's Withering.$B$BThis farm is due southeast of us, close to where the Eastern Plaguelands begin.  I need a sample from this cauldron to verify my suspicions.$b$bEliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key.  You will then be able to access the cauldron and obtain my sample.

PortraitGiverText.text: 从护锅者身上弄到钥匙，然后激活大锅。
PortraitGiverText.english: Get the key from the cauldron lord, then activate the cauldron.

identity.title: Desperate Acts
identity.objectives: Kill Instructor Malicia and obtain her Cult Orders.
identity.description: The Cult of the Damned maintains a small camp to the east, Malicia Outpost, which they use for field training outside of the Scholomance.  We may have allowed them to proceed unchecked with this training for too long.$b$bIf cultists are truly using this plague to inoculate the wildlife, then Malicia Outpost must be where the inoculation is occurring.$b$bInstructor Malicia runs the outpost.  Find her, slay her, and find out who she's taking orders from.

PortraitGiverText.text: 她声称在战场上训练教徒，但我还有些其他的怀疑。
PortraitGiverText.english: She claims to be training cultists in the field, but I have other suspicions.

identity.title: The Twilight Overlook
identity.objectives: Speak to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.
identity.description: The dragon they're speaking of is Abyssion, $n.  It's not going to be easy to get the fragment off of him.$B$BMeet with Mylra again.  She is operating nearby at the Twilight Overlook.$B$BShe will tell you what our next move will be.

PortraitGiverText.text: 米尔拉已经占领了暮光瞭望台。去找她。
PortraitGiverText.english: Mylra has taken the Twilight Overlook.  Meet with her.

identity.title: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
identity.objectives: Kill Chief Ukorz Sandscalp.
identity.description: Take a good look, mon. Dis is how it goes, betrayal after betrayal. I backstab you for the sword, and den Chief Ukorz go and backstab me even better for it.$B$BThat's life, yah! Or was...$B$BNow, I know you don't got no love for Mazoga. But I know you goin' in der anyway. Kill him for me, mon. Spill more blood on the sand, an' give Chief Ukorz Sandscalp what every one of de Sandfury deserves...a gory death.$B$BMaybe I leave some of my belongin's without a curse before passin' on if you do, yah?

PortraitGiverText.text: 替我把他杀掉，伙计。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill him good for me, mon.

identity.title: Gor'kresh
identity.objectives: Defeat Gor'kresh.
identity.description: The ogre left to watch over these crude fools goes by the name of Gor'kresh. He's big enough to boss even these brutes around, and cunning to boot. Never assume an ogre's stupid, that's when they'll get you.$B$BIf you take him out, we'll show the Twilight's Hammer that Loch Modan isn't a stepping stone for them. Stand strong against Gor'kresh and drive these fools back into the highlands!

PortraitGiverText.text: 暮光之锤在我们的湖畔没有立锥之地。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Twilight's Hammer has no place here in our Loch.

identity.title: Cataclysm in the Catacombs
identity.objectives: Enter the Cathedral of Light and descend into the catacombs below. Slay the Black Bishop and disarm the Pile of Explosives nearby.
identity.description: Don't worry about me, $c. I've uncovered the Twilight's Hammer plot. They've been stealing and stockpiling explosives coming into Stormwind harbor. Somehow, they've gotten access to the catacombs underneath the Cathedral of Light. I've heard talk of someone called "The Black Bishop."$B$BThere's no time to warn the guard, $n! You've got just minutes to get into the catacombs and disarm that bomb. Go! Now! Or THOUSANDS of PEOPLE will DIE!

PortraitGiverText.text: 我认出了一个异教的首领。小心，他的行踪很诡秘。
PortraitGiverText.english: I've identified one of the cult ringleaders. Careful; he moves in mysterious ways.

identity.title: Deeper into Darkness
identity.objectives: Kill the Skitterweb Matriarch.
identity.description: The Skitterweb matriarch is nearby! You can put an end to the Skitterweb menace by killing her!$B$BFind the brood mother at the end of the cave in the Skittering Dark and destroy her!

PortraitGiverText.text: 十分致命！
PortraitGiverText.english: Deadly!

identity.title: Rise, Forsaken
identity.objectives: Raise 15 Forsaken by killing humans on Fenris Isle.
identity.description: Fenris Isle stands defiantly at the heart of Lordamere Lake - a cruel memory of a time long since passed.$B$BThough no longer infested by gnoll vermin, a new threat has emerged.  Human refugees, driven from their holdings in Hillsbrad, have fled to Fenris Isle in hopes of escaping defeat at our hands. A critical error on their part.$B$BYou are to take Agatha with you to Fenris Isle and slaughter all humans. She will raise the fallen as Forsaken, bolstering our forces in the process.$B$BDo not fail me, $n.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 成为被遗忘者之后他们能更好地服务。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The humans will fare better in the afterlife as Forsaken.

identity.title: No Escape
identity.objectives: Find the Refugee Leadership inside Fenris Keep.
identity.description: You must strike at their leaders, $n. You will find them holed up in the old keep. Battle your way inside and find the holdouts! Turn them for your queen!$B$BNone shall escape the mighty grasp of the Forsaken!

PortraitGiverText.text: 在二楼找到指挥室。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find the command room on the second floor.

identity.title: Maziel's Ascendancy
identity.objectives: Slay Maziel inside the Silverlight Cave in Deepholm.
identity.description: Maziel's journal chronicles a ritual of ascendancy that would transfigure his body to one of pure quicksilver.$B$BThe ritual would take place in the cave near the Lower Silvermarsh, where Maziel would feed upon the mercurial oozes until achieving full strength.$B$BPerhaps it is not too late to put an end to his madness.

PortraitGiverText.text: 终结他的疯狂。
PortraitGiverText.english: End his madness.

identity.title: Alzzin the Wildshaper
identity.objectives: Kill Zevrim Thornhoof and Alzzin the Wildshaper.
identity.description: The monster responsible for the ruin you see before you is called Alzzin the Wildshaper. To reach him, however, you will need to also slay Zevrim Thornhoof, the satyr who currently holds the still noble ancient Old Ironbark in his grasp.$B$BOnce Ironbark is free, he will help you make an entrance into Alzzin's domain. Enter and slay him without mercy, for there is no other way.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奥兹恩邪恶无比、狡诈多端。
PortraitGiverText.english: Alzzin is a foul trickster.

identity.title: A Villain Unmasked
identity.objectives: Unmask and slay Major Samuelson in the Stormwind Keep Throne Room.
identity.description: <You find a complete list of all the Twilight's Hammer cultists in Stormwind.>$B$B<More importantly, you discover a letter from Major Samuelson to his compatriots outlining this entire scheme. The Prince was right: Samuelson is the real villain here, using his connections as commander of the city guard to disguise cult activity.>$B$B<It's time to return to Stormwind Keep and bring Samuelson to justice!>

PortraitGiverText.text: 他一直待在暴风城的王座厅，就在国王右手边！
PortraitGiverText.english: He's been in the Stormwind throne room this entire time. Right next to the king!

identity.title: The Madness Within
identity.objectives: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.$B$BEnter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.$B$BReturn to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.
identity.description: This madness must come to an end. The age of the immortals has long since passed. Destroy the guardians surrounding the five pylons to lower the force field. When this is done, destroy Immol'thar. With the Prince's power greatly reduced from the demon's demise, attack and end him as well. Lay the spirits of this city to rest, adventurer, and make the Prince pay for his wrongdoings.

PortraitGiverText.text: 王子的力量之源。
PortraitGiverText.english: The source of the Prince's powers.

identity.title: Brute Strength
identity.objectives: Kill the Ravenian within Andorhal.
identity.description: Gandling has brought his lieutenant, the Ravenian, with him.  This lumbering brute is far more dangerous than any of the other Scourge you will find upon the battlefield... even the abominations.$b$bYou will find the Ravenian within a tower near the southern end of town.  I recommend caution before fighting him, $n.  He will not be a pushover.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在通灵学院外，拉文尼亚被削弱了…但依然强大。
PortraitGiverText.english: Outside of Scholomance, the Ravenian is weakened... but still powerful.

identity.title: King of the Gordok
identity.objectives: Kill King Gordok.
identity.description: In Gordok society, their king is simply their strongest warrior. If anyone, ogre or otherwise, kills the current king, they are automatically hailed as the new one.$B$BThe new king receives tribute from any living guards, Stomper Kreeg, and Captain Kromcrush. Find and kill King Gordok while killing as few of their other leaders as possible, and not only will your reward be great, you will be able to use your power as king to halt the Gordok invasion without conflict!

PortraitGiverText.text: 窃取他的宝座！
PortraitGiverText.english: Steal his throne!

identity.title: King of the Gordok
identity.objectives: Kill King Gordok.
identity.description: You kill Gordok leader, you new ogre king. If you king, then ogre leaders like Kromcrush and Kreeg that survive pay you big tribute and you stop Gordok invasion. If you do that, then me very happy ogre and we take Dire Maul FOR DA HORDE!!!$B$BGo, little $r! Kill ugly Gordok ogre king and maybe dis be new Stonemaul Hold! Yar!

PortraitGiverText.text: 窃取他的宝座！
PortraitGiverText.english: Steal his throne!

identity.title: Something that Burns
identity.objectives: Obtain the Burning Heart.
identity.description: Alright, we need something that's going to make the compound go, "Boom"!$B$BI'm all out of gun powder, but I think I know what we can use instead... the heart of my fire elemental!$B$BHere, take my fire totem east to the Blood Trail. Just flip the switch on it near any of the lava pools over there and Magmatooth should be summoned. Bring back his heart and we'll be in business.

PortraitGiverText.text: 金矿说弄到他的灼燃之心不会有什么问题，那大概就是不会有问题吧……
PortraitGiverText.english: Goldmine said it was okay to get his Burning Heart, so I guess it's okay....

identity.title: School's Out Forever
identity.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling.
identity.description: Darkmaster Gandling serves as headmaster of Scholomance, and is therefore responsible for countless deaths at the hands of his students. For that he must be punished.$B$BHe will not come out easily. Lure him out by slaying his six professors whose rooms connect to the Headmaster's Study. Be wary, for when the last falls he will come, and he will come infuriated with vast magic backing his assault. Don't let him make it out of here alive.

PortraitGiverText.text: 不要对他存有任何怜悯。
PortraitGiverText.english: Have no mercy on him.

identity.title: Taelan Fordring's Legacy
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Redpine Looters.
identity.description: Greetings.  How do you do?  My name is Daria.$b$bI am one of the priests in charge of preserving the peace here in Hearthglen.  One of my duties involves maintaining the tower down the trail to the southeast of Hearthglen.  This particular tower is of personal importance to the Highlord.  It's the place where his son was killed.$b$bWith the recent incursion of gnolls, however, maintenance of the tower has grown difficult.  Will you help me rid the trail of some of these gnoll vandals, so I can do my duty?

PortraitTurnInText.text: 对不起哦，我对你用了心灵视界，但愿你别介意。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Sorry, I hope you don't mind if I use Mind Vision on you.

identity.title: Unusual Behavior... Even For Gnolls
identity.objectives: Investigate the gnoll hideout along the trail to Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
identity.description: Allow me to concentrate for a moment.$b$b<You feel Daria's mind vision travel elsewhere, then it returns to you.>$b$bFurther down the trail, south of Taelan's Tower, the gnolls have carved out a small meeting area to the east of the main road.  Something is happening there... I'm not certain what.  We should investigate.  I will look for anything out of the ordinary... you just protect yourself.

PortraitGiverText.text: 豺狼人也叫人头痛啊。
PortraitGiverText.english: Gnolls can be such a headache.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你看见了吗？那个瓶子，那些补给，就在那地上！
PortraitTurnInText.english: Do you see that?  That bottle, those supplies, on the ground!

identity.title: The Good People of Hearthglen
identity.objectives: Speak with Morris Vant, Outfitter Mendelev, Bree Ironstock, and High Cleric Alphus within Hearthglen.
identity.description: See those reagents over there?  And these supplies right here?  Those belong to the Argent Crusade.$b$bGnolls are known for thievery, but as far as I know, Hearthglen hasn't had any incursions since the Redpine came.  Very suspicious.$b$bI know a few helpful folks within Hearthglen: Morris Vant, Outfitter Mendelev, Bree Ironstock, and High Cleric Alphus.  All can be trusted, and are well-connected.  Question them, to find out if they know anything about these lost supplies.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你得回城收集情报。
PortraitGiverText.english: You'll want to head back to town to gather information.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Bisp is our man.

identity.title: Bagging Bisp
identity.objectives: Speak with Magus Bisp atop the mage tower in Hearthglen.
identity.description: Magus Bisp is one of Hearthglen's most preeminent arcanists.  To imagine that he would be interacting with gnolls... and dabbling in necromancy?  Unthinkable.$b$bYou'll find him atop the tower near Hearthglen's main gate.  Hopefully he'll have an explanation for all of this.  If not, well... I wouldn't go to the top of that tower unprepared, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 但愿我们能和毕斯普避免冲突，他很能打。
PortraitGiverText.english: Hopefully we can avoid combat with Bisp.  He's quite skilled.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 毕斯普，豺狼人和死灵法师……哦，天啊。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Bisp, gnolls and necromancy... oh my.

identity.title: Turning Yourself In
identity.objectives: Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
identity.description: So... you killed a member of the Argent Crusade, inside of Hearthglen.  Usually that's not smiled upon, even in self-defense.$b$bI recommend you come back to Mardenholde Keep, and turn yourself in to Highlord Fordring.  Hopefully he will hear you out, and will be sympathetic with your situation.  I hope I haven't gotten you in any trouble.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你真的应该和提里奥谈谈，趁他还不知道你干了些什么。
PortraitGiverText.english: You should really speak with Tirion, before he finds out what you did.

identity.title: Drudges... <Sigh>
identity.objectives: Kill Shadril within the mine inside Hearthglen.
identity.description: Say, I never caught your name.  $n?  Pleased to meet you, $n.$b$bI've got one more problem that needs fixing, and you have a look about you that just screams "I'm a problem-fixer".$b$bThere's a small mine on the northern edge of Hearthglen, where we get most of the ore that the town needs.  My drudges who work the mine normally do a decent job.$b$bUnfortunately, it seems that a larger-than-average spider has taken up residence within this cave.  Think you can clear things up for me?

PortraitGiverText.text: 我给他们付钱不是来害怕蜘蛛的……是来干活的。
PortraitGiverText.english: I'm not paying them to be afraid of spiders... I'm paying them to work.

identity.title: Scholomancer
identity.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling within Andorhal.
identity.description: The Scholomance is one of the few Scourge holdouts remaining west of the Thondroril.  The headmaster of Scholomance, a cultist by the name of Darkmaster Gandling, has made an appearance on the battlefield.$b$bThis will be his final mistake.$b$bYou will find Gandling in a square near the southern end of town.  I want you to fight and weaken Gandling.  I will join you to help finish him off.

PortraitGiverText.text: 通灵学院的院长，安多哈尔天灾的首领。
PortraitGiverText.english: Master of the Scholomance, leader of the Scourge in Andorhal.

identity.title: Brute Strength
identity.objectives: Kill Rattlegore within Andorhal.
identity.description: Gandling has brought his lieutenant, Rattlegore, with him.  This clattering horror is far more dangerous than any of the other Scourge you will find upon the battlefield... even the abominations.$b$bYou will find Rattlegore within an old town-hall building, near the center of town.  I recommend caution before fighting him, $n.  He will not be a pushover.

PortraitGiverText.text: 通灵学院外，血骨傀儡被削弱了……但依然力量强大。
PortraitGiverText.english: Outside of Scholomance, Rattlegore is weakened... but still powerful.

identity.title: Araj the Summoner
identity.objectives: Kill Araj the Summoner.  You may use Lang's Hand Grenades to destroy Stickbone Berserkers.
identity.description: With the animus destroyed, the next logical step is to take out Araj himself, and to take a shard of his phylactery.  You've probably already seen him, lurking at the fountain in the center of town.$b$bTake my grenades with you.  They won't do anything to Araj, but if he decides to summon any of those skeletons, you can use them to blow them away.  Again.

PortraitGiverText.text: 记住，用我的手榴弹对付他的骷髅！
PortraitGiverText.english: Remember, use my grenades to take care of his skeletons!

identity.title: Uther's Blessing
identity.objectives: Enter Uther's Tomb, and use the Chillwind Tribute before his statue.
identity.description: These farmers from the south wish to take these farms, but I can't let them enter the plaguelands unprepared.  Even with the Scourge gone, danger still looms in the form of the Forsaken.  No, we must be ready to fight... and that includes our new visitors.$b$bBefore doing anything else, however, I would recommend that you travel to Uther's Tomb, to the east, and place this tribute before his statue to ask for his blessing.  Speak with the priest that tends to the tomb when you are finished.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他是洛丹伦有史以来最伟大的圣骑士之一。
PortraitGiverText.english: He was one of the greatest paladins Lordaeron had ever known.

identity.title: Just the Tip
identity.objectives: Obtain the Sultan's Staff, then use the Elaborate Disc to create the Shaft of the Stars.
identity.description: The etching around the surface of this object indicates that it is of ancient origins, and yet no signs of wear can be detected.$b$bA hole on its edge, full of splintered wood, assures you that it is meant to be mounted on a wooden pole of some sort.$b$bBefore showing this find to Doctor Jones, you set off to find the missing staff.

identity.title: Excising the Taint
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Bloodfang Stalkers.
identity.description: It looks like a group of the ambushers stayed behind. Make them pay for their insolence! Kill all of the Bloodfang stalkers at Olsen's Farthing. For Sylvanas! For the Horde!

PortraitTurnInText.text: 这些狗会为他们的傲慢而付出代价！
PortraitTurnInText.english: These dogs will soon learn the price of their arrogance!

identity.title: Do the World a Favor
identity.objectives: Kill 12 Mangy Hyenas.
identity.description: Hyenas, on their best day, are a nuisance.$b$bThese foul specimens have a particularly nasty disposition, are riddled with all manner of disease, and are simply a blight on the face of dogdom.$b$bDo the world a favor and rid the deserts of Uldum of this mangy menace.

identity.title: Seek and Destroy
identity.objectives: Search the Farmhouses at Olsen's Farthing.
identity.description: <The Banshee Queen's voice invades your thoughts once more.>$B$BSearch the nearby farmhouses for Alliance stragglers. Keep an eye out for any information that could lead us to Crowley and Bloodfang. Seek and destroy all that would stand in your way, $n!

PortraitGiverText.text: 搜索农舍！
PortraitGiverText.english: Search the farmhouses!

PortraitTurnInText.text: 他们会被逼上绝路，然后被碾碎！
PortraitTurnInText.english: They will be cornered and crushed!

identity.title: Cornered and Crushed!
identity.objectives: Report to Master Forteski at the Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine Forest.
identity.description: <The Banshee Queen speaks through your mind.>$B$BWe must act quickly, $n. They mustn't be given the chance to flee. I am dispatching a squadron of my most powerful troopers to the Deep Elem Mine. I'm also sending the Horseman with them to ensure that nothing goes wrong. Meet him at the Deep Elem Mine, east of Olsen's Farthing, and CRUSH those rats.

PortraitGiverText.text: 前往埃利姆矿洞。
PortraitGiverText.english: Go to the Deep Elem Mine.

identity.title: Nowhere to Run
identity.objectives: Escort Master Forteski through the Deep Elem Mine.
identity.description: The mistress has put me in charge of this lot. Our primary mission is to get in there, corner the rats, and kill 'em all, including Bloodfang.$B$BYou've done us a solid service in gettin' the information, $n. Join in the glory and help us drive a sword through their miserable skulls!$B$BLet me know when you're ready and I'll call for the charge.

AreaDescription.text: 护送士官长弗尔特斯基 通过埃利姆矿洞。
AreaDescription.english: Escort Master Forteski through the Deep Elem Mine.

identity.title: Siren's Song
identity.objectives: Slay Ophelia, the Siren of the Highlands.
identity.description: She's still out there... Ophelia, the Siren of the Highlands! Her terrible song will lure you to the depths. I've vowed to stay behind and avenge my fallen crewmates, $c. If you want to join me, just say the word.$B$BWe'll lash ourselves to the mast, we will. We'll shut our eyes. We'll stuff our ears with wax. And when her beautiful illusion drops... we'll strike.$B$BAre you in?

AreaDescription.text: 杀死奥菲莉亚并保护埃菲拉姆

identity.title: Aradne
identity.objectives: Slay Aradne atop the tower in western Andorhal.
identity.description: Our last hope of victory lies in defeating the val'kyr.  You've done well up until now... but you're only one $g man: woman; and there are literally dozens of them raining destruction on the battlefield.$b$bOne enormous val'kyr sits atop the tower to our south... you can see her from here.  Perhaps if we eliminate her, the remaining val'kyr will dissipate.$b$bThis is our only hope.  Bring some of Grant's men with you.  You'll need their protection for this battle.

PortraitGiverText.text: 她是安多哈尔瓦格里的头领。这是我们唯一的希望……
PortraitGiverText.english: She leads the val'kyr in Andorhal.  This is our only hope...

identity.title: The Dreadlord Balnazzar
identity.objectives: Kill Balnazzar.
identity.description: With the fall of the Scarlet Crusade, their disguised demon leader, Balnazzar, released the possessed body of Grand Crusader Dathrohan and went on a rampage, killing every remaining crusader here. He then used his necromantic power to raise them all as vile undead slaves.$B$BBalnazzar refers to his new army as the Risen. We cannot let him grow this army - they are extremely powerful and, unlike Arthas' Scourge, Balnazzar will not hold his forces back. Kill him while we still have a chance, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 复生者领主
PortraitGiverText.english: Lord of the Risen

identity.title: The End of the Deserters
identity.objectives: Defeat Gavis Greyshield aboard the ship southeast of Theramore.
identity.description: Now that we've eliminated the deserters from Theramore, it's time to complete this operation. My local contacts have reported that the deserters base their operations in a ship moored on a small island to the southeast of the docks.$B$BArresting their leader, Gavis Greyshield, should cause the others to lose their will to fight. Find him within the ship and convince him to surrender. I wouldn't be surprised if he puts up a bit of a fight for show, but then surrenders when he understands he can't win.

PortraitGiverText.text: 塞拉摩民兵前上尉。
PortraitGiverText.english: Former lieutenant of the Theramore militia.

identity.title: Take Down Tethyr!
identity.objectives: Use the mortars to defeat Tethyr.
identity.description: Sea monster or no, we're not going to risk the safety of our shipping. I've ordered our best marksmen to prepare for a confrontation with this Tethyr. The artillerymen have augmented the dock's defenses with three mortars.$B$BI'm going to order the lighthouse's lamp illuminated. If Tethyr does attack, it will be your job to operate the mortars and take down the beast before it can kill all of the marksmen. I wouldn't stand in one place too long, though. Using the mortars is likely to draw its attention.

AreaDescription.text: 从泰瑟尔手里保卫塞拉摩码头

identity.title: Lord Aurius Rivendare
identity.objectives: Kill Lord Aurius Rivendare.
identity.description: This Chapel is the last Light amongst so much darkness. Ras Frostwhisper took his own life in the slaughterhouse, carving his face into a macabre smile in front of the Lich King, who raised him into the Lich that now haunts Scholomance.$B$BThe ground where that atrocity occured is now Scourge holy ground, blessed by the Lich King with the very darkest magic. Lord Aurius Rivendare, new ruler of Stratholme, now guards it and continues his master's evil work. Slay him without pause.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他堕落得太深，必须要除掉。
PortraitGiverText.english: He has fallen too far to be left standing.

PortraitGiverName.text: 奥里克斯·瑞文戴尔领主

identity.title: Man Against Abomination
identity.objectives: Slaughter Ramstein the Gorger.
identity.description: Deep within, you will find Ramstein the Gorger. I cannot bear to tell you the atrocities this monster has commited. Know only this - he deserves to feel the full wrath of countless lost souls, a wrath you will bring upon him.$B$BHave no mercy. Be unwavering in your fury.

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀啊！
PortraitGiverText.english: Slaughter!

identity.title: SMASH BROODQUEEN
identity.objectives: Obtain the Broodqueen Pedipalp.
identity.description: <The following is written in very large print.>$B$BSPIDERS IN NORTH CAVE BAD. POISON OGRES. OGRES GET SICK. BAD!$B$BBIG BIG SPIDER IN CAVE MAKE MORE SPIDERS. MORE SPIDERS BAD!$B$BKILL BIG SPIDER, STOP MORE SPIDERS. KILL BIG SPIDER, GET BIG PRIZE! GOOD!$B$B<A crude drawing accompanies this.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 需要尽快打烂
PortraitGiverText.english: NEED SMASHED SOON

PortraitTurnInText.english: BAD SPIDER!

identity.title: Reinforcements from Fenris
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Hillsbrad Worgen.
identity.description: Those that survived your assault on Fenris managed to drink the blood of the wolf. They turned into ferocious worgen, hell-bent on vengeance. Now they paddle across Lordamere Lake and assault my sea dogs. Many have already been killed. The worgen monsters must be stopped!$B$BMake your way to the Decrepit Fields, east of here, and kill the Hillsbrad worgen that infest the area. Once you've killed them all, make your way to the Horde communication panel, located at the docks. I'll be in touch.

PortraitTurnInText.english: That was only the first wave!

identity.title: The Waters Run Red...
identity.objectives: Kill 50 Hillsbrad Worgen with the Horde Cannon.
identity.description: <The communication console hums.>$B$BThose worgen you killed were the scouting party. There are hundreds more incoming! Looks like Crowley and Bloodfang made the blood offering to every human in Lordaeron.$B$BGet in one of those Horde cannons and send them all back to their makers. Let the waters of Lordamere Lake run red with their blood!

PortraitGiverText.text: 洛丹米尔湖水将会被狼人的血染红！
PortraitGiverText.english: The waters of Lordamere Lake will run red with the blood of the worgen!

identity.title: Defias in Dustwallow?
identity.objectives: Obtain the Defias Orders from Garn Mathers.
identity.description: My scouts have reported a shipwreck just off the beach to the northeast. Shipwrecks aren't all that unusual out here, but the reports also indicated the survivors were all wearing red bandanas... the symbol of the Defias!$B$BThe reports indicate their leader resides on a large island just off the coast to the northeast of the tower. Kill him and retrieve any documents you find in his possession.

PortraitGiverText.text: 加恩·马瑟斯，迪菲亚兄弟会中尉
PortraitGiverText.english: Garn Mathers, Defias Lieutenant

identity.title: Survey Alcaz Island
identity.objectives: Speak to Cassa Crimsonwing and use one of her gryphons to survey Alcaz Island.
identity.description: It looks like Renn's hunch about Alcaz Island was right. We need to survey that island, but it would take a whole brigade of troops to fight our way in there.$B$BTheramore's defenses can't weather such a hit, so I've arranged with Cassa Crimsonwing, the apprentice to Theramore's gryphon master, to allow you to use one of her beasts to survey Alcaz from the air.$B$BAlcaz Island holds the key to the mystery of the Defias' involvement in this kidnapping.

identity.title: Questioning Reethe
identity.objectives: Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe.
identity.description: It took a long time, but I found Reethe. He hide good for a human.$b$bOgron worried that he might be crazy after so much time in swamp. You come with me for we go get answers from him.

AreaDescription.text: 和奥格隆一起盘问雷瑟

identity.title: The Deserters
identity.objectives: Get information about Reethe from Balos Jacken and the deserters in Dustwallow Marsh.
identity.description: It has been a struggle maintaining a presence in the marsh, but through strength of our resolve, we have been able to maintain several defensive watchtowers throughout the area.$b$bThe latest information and scouting reports I have received indicate that a group of deserters has squatted in our abandoned tower at Lost Point, southeast of the inn.$b$bThe local lieutenant seems to be Balos Jacken. See if you can get some information out of him.$b$bBe warned, $n. He may be a tough nut to crack.

PortraitGiverText.text: 巴鲁斯·加科因，背叛者的领袖
PortraitGiverText.english: Balos Jacken, Deserter Leader

identity.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: Isha Gloomaxe
identity.objectives: Slay Isha Gloomaxe.
identity.description: Sentinel training 101: take out their leaders and your enemy's forces will soon fall apart. We're going to do just that, $c.$B$BIsha Gloomaxe is the closest of the Grimtotem chiefs. Let's see if we can't take her measure.

PortraitGiverText.text: 由于对乱风岗犯下的罪行，她必须受到惩罚！
PortraitGiverText.english: She must be punished for her crimes against Freewind Post!

identity.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: Isha Gloomaxe
identity.objectives: Slay Isha Gloomaxe.
identity.description: Basic brave philosophy dictates that if you kill the leaders of your enemy's forces, they will soon fall into disarray. We are going to do just that, $c.$B$BIsha Gloomaxe is the closest of the Grimtotem chiefs. We will test her and her axe, and she will be found wanting.

PortraitGiverText.text: 由于对乱风岗犯下的罪行，她必须受到惩罚！
PortraitGiverText.english: She must be punished for her crimes against Freewind Post!

identity.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: Elder Stormhoof
identity.objectives: Slay Elder Stormhoof.
identity.description: Elder Stormhoof is a shaman of immense power. Supposedly, he is a direct disciple of Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone, leader of the Grimtotem clan.$B$BWe know that he's here and that he's been training their geomancers. We have to kill him, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 小心他操纵元素的能力！
PortraitGiverText.english: Beware his mastery of the elements!

identity.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: Elder Stormhoof
identity.objectives: Slay Elder Stormhoof.
identity.description: Elder Stormhoof is a shaman chief of immense power. He was taught by Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone, leader of the Grimtotem clan.$B$BWe know that he is here and that he has been training their geomancers. We have to kill him, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 小心他操纵元素的能力！
PortraitGiverText.english: Beware his mastery of the elements!

identity.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: Grundig Darkcloud
identity.objectives: Slay Grundig Darkcloud.
identity.description: One of the infamous Grimtotem leaders of the Stonetalon Mountains has returned home.$B$BWe should take this opportunity to make sure that he doesn't go anywhere else.

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑云峰的贵族。他的姓氏必须和他一起终结。
PortraitGiverText.english: Nobility of Darkcloud Pinnacle. His name must end with him.

identity.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: Grundig Darkcloud
identity.objectives: Slay Grundig Darkcloud.
identity.description: One of the most accomplished Grimtotem leaders of the Stonetalon Mountains has returned home.$B$BWe must make the most of this chance and put an end to his campaign of terror once and for all.

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑云峰的贵族。他的姓氏必须和他一起终结。
PortraitGiverText.english: Nobility of Darkcloud Pinnacle. His name must end with him.

identity.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: The Chief of Chiefs
identity.objectives: Slay Arnak Grimtotem.
identity.description: And now the time has come to take out the leader of all of the Darkcloud Pinnacle Grimtotem: Arnak Grimtotem.$B$BIt is said that he's the disgraced nephew of Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. Supposedly, his indiscretions have left him in a state of disfavor with her.$B$BBut none of that matters right now. All that matters is that we kill him. For good this time.

PortraitGiverText.text: 巫婆长老的侄子，酋长之首。击败他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Nephew of the Elder Crone. The Chief of Chiefs. Slay him!

identity.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: The Chief of Chiefs
identity.objectives: Slay Arnak Grimtotem.
identity.description: The time has come to deal with the leader of the Darkcloud Pinnacle Grimtotem: Arnak Grimtotem.$B$BHe is the disgraced nephew of Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. His indiscretions have left him in a state of disfavor with her.$B$BNone of that matters now. All that matters is that we deal with him. Once and for all.

PortraitGiverText.text: 巫婆长老的侄子，酋长之首。杀掉他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Nephew of the Elder Crone. The Chief of Chiefs. Slay him!

identity.title: Invoking the Serpent
identity.objectives: Defeat Arikara.
identity.description: I am familiar with these artifacts. I believe that they were brought here by Magatha Grimtotem herself. But she's not amongst the Grimtotem on Darkcloud Pinnacle. She disappeared right after she arrived, and no one knows where she is now.$B$BMaybe we can find out.$B$BTake the rattle, the writ, and the drum out to Arikara's Needle. If my guess is correct, the wind serpent will appear again. You'll have to defeat it to gain knowledge of where Magatha is hiding.

PortraitGiverText.text: 玛加萨·恐怖图腾的魔仆
PortraitGiverText.english: Familiar of Magatha Grimtotem.

identity.title: Invoking the Serpent
identity.objectives: Defeat Arikara.
identity.description: I am familiar with these artifacts. I believe that they were brought here by Magatha Grimtotem herself. But she's not amongst the Grimtotem on Darkcloud Pinnacle. She disappeared right after she arrived, and no one knows where she is now.$B$BMaybe we can find out.$B$BTake the rattle, the writ, and the drum out to Arikara's Needle. If my guess is correct, the wind serpent will appear again. You'll have to defeat it to gain knowledge of where Magatha is hiding.

PortraitGiverText.text: 玛加萨·恐怖图腾的魔仆
PortraitGiverText.english: Familiar of Magatha Grimtotem.

identity.title: Scouting the Shore
identity.objectives: Scout the Beach Head Control Point on the Twilight Shore. You don't need to capture it, but doing so will give your side a combat advantage and flag you for PvP.
identity.description: It's them or us, $c. Only one of us can command this beach.$B$BNorth of here you'll see a small hill with a commanding view of the shoreline. Whoever controls that hill will have the upper hand up and down the shore!$B$BI need to know what the current situation is. Scout the beach head control point, marked by that enormous flag, and return to me.$B$BYou don't have to try to capture it, unless you're spoiling for a fight...

identity.title: Break in Communications: Dreadwatch Outpost
identity.objectives: Investigate Dreadwatch Outpost.
identity.description: I'm not gonna lie to you, $n. What I'm about to ask you to do is suicide. Chance of failure is about 95%.$B$BAll communication from Dreadwatch Outpost has been severed. With the worgen constantly rushing us we have no means by which to get to Dreadwatch to check on our soldiers. I need you to head south to the outpost and check on our soldiers. I'll keep in contact through the Forsaken communication device - F.C.D. - from here on out.$B$BKEEP CLEAR OF THE MAIN ROAD.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 恐惧之卫是我们防守最严密的哨所。
