identity.objectives: Get a flight from Heartrazor to the Twilight Aerie and deal with Twilight Skymaster Richtofen.
identity.description: Twilight Skymaster Richtofen is at the Twilight Aerie up above and to the southeast. No matter what we do down here, if he's not dealt with, all hope is lost for Highperch.$B$BWhile Heartrazor is too injured to help you with the fight, he can fly you up there. The rest is up to you, $n.$B$BGood luck.

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死暮光天空之主里克托芬！
PortraitGiverText.english: Shoot him out of the skies!

PortraitGiverName.text: 暮光天空之主里克托芬

identity.title: Rasha'krak
identity.objectives: Obtain Rasha'krak's Bracers of Binding.
identity.description: Based on this information you've delivered, I believe that one of this "Archduke's" minions may already have turned its eyes toward Thorium Point.$b$bHis name is Rasha'krak, and he patrols the lava pools just to our south.  He looks like the latent fire elementals that rage nearby, except for one small difference: the bracers of binding that encircle his wrists.$b$bFind him and bring these bracers to me, $n.  I need proof that we are in danger before we involve ourselves in elemental wars.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他游荡到了瑟银哨塔的入口。他想干吗？
PortraitGiverText.english: He patrols the entrance to Thorium Point.  What does he want?

identity.title: The Gates of Grim Batol (DO NOT DELETE, DO NOT DEPRECATE!)

Title.english: The Gates of Grim Batol (DO NOT DELETE, DO NOT DEPRECATE!)

identity.title: Break the Unbreakable
identity.objectives: Slay Xavathras.
identity.description: With the claw, we are ready to break through the Jadefire's defenses.$B$BHead into the ruins to the northwest. Beyond the frontline of the satyr you'll find a narrow pass heading to their corrupted moonwell. An enormous wall of demonic flame bars the path, but the Claw of Tichondrius should be able to dispel it.$B$BBeyond the barrier you will find the leader of these forces, Xavathras, guarding the corrupted moonwell. Slay him once you are through!

PortraitGiverText.text: 碧火萨特的邪恶公爵。
PortraitGiverText.english: Vile Duke of the Jadefire.

identity.title: The Imprisoned Archmage
identity.objectives: You must kill Archmage Galus and return with his Staff from the Cursed Depths, just east of Baradin Hold.
identity.description: We have been trying to clear out the Cursed Depths cellblock since we landed on Tol Barad.  It seems that everytime we get close, that archmage shows up and pushes us back.$B$BNow that we have claimed the island, it's time we take another shot.  Head down there and bring me back his staff as proof that you have finished the job.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他拿着那把法杖的日子不会太长了。
PortraitGiverText.english: He won't have that staff for long.

identity.title: A Huge Problem
identity.objectives: You have been asked to kill Problim, a giant ettin that roams the paths of Tol Barad.
identity.description: We finally capture this godforsaken rock and then we find out that there is a huge ettin roaming around, taking out our sentry patrols!$B$B$n, I need you to round up a few friends and take that ettin down.  We can't have a beast like that roaming around, wreaking havoc.$B$BStay alert, reports from the front say that he is carrying a huge tree as a weapon, and he is not afraid to use it.

PortraitGiverText.text: 祝你好运。
PortraitGiverText.english: Good luck on this one.

identity.title: The Demon Prince
identity.objectives: Slay Prince Xavalis.
identity.description: The Jadefire satyr that have overrun so much of Felwood work directly with the Shadow Council.$B$BThese satyr answer directly to the ancient and powerful Prince Xavalis. Some say he is the son of Xavius, the first satyr, blessed by Sargeras himself.$B$BWhatever his nature, he must die if we are to scatter the Jadefire and reclaim our barrow dens. Journey deep into Shadow Hold and slay him. Show him no mercy; he will have none for you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 碧火萨特的主宰
PortraitGiverText.english: Overlord of the Jadefire Satyr

PortraitTurnInText.english: The Legion will be driven from the depths!

identity.title: Twin Temptresses
identity.objectives: Slay Moora and Salia.
identity.description: Moora and Salia are the personal servants of Shadow Lord Fel'dan. Do not be deceived by them!$B$BThese foul succubi use their wiles and foul magic to draw mortals deep into Shadow Hold. Those in their grasp undergo brainwashing, or are sacrificed by Fel'dan to his demonic masters.$B$BThe two fight as one and are never found apart, making them a considerable threat. Proceed further into Shadow Hold and slay them.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你必须抵御住她们罪恶的诱惑。
PortraitGiverText.english: You must resist their sinister temptations.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Fel'dan shall fall!

identity.title: Efficient Excavations
identity.objectives: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
identity.description: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to most efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in massive excavation projects.$b$bAfter a quick skim of the material, it becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here.$b$bA map on the back cover indicates that the author has a bunker in the southwest region of Uldum.$b$bPerhaps an introduction is in order.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你只能认为封面上画的是固执己见的作者像。
PortraitGiverText.english: You can only assume that the picture on the cover is of the self-absorbed author.

identity.title: Fury Unbound
identity.objectives: Travel to the Gullet and speak with Zaela. Kill Torth.
identity.description: Narkrall's drake Torth survived the failed attack on Thundermar, and now the creature is free from his former master.$B$BTorth seeks vengeance against the Dragonmaw, and has already strafed Bloodgulch once. He will keep returning until we skewer him for good. It is time to put the Demon Chain to work.$B$BTorth's old nest is a small cave in the hills west of here that we have turned into a small camp called "The Gullet."$B$BMeet me at the Gullet and we will finish Torth off.

PortraitGiverText.text: 到咽喉洞去见我，我们一起摧毁托斯。
PortraitGiverText.english: Meet me in the Gullet and we will destroy Torth together.

identity.title: Shadow Lord Fel'dan
identity.objectives: Slay Shadow Lord Fel'dan.
identity.description: Shadow Lord Fel'dan awaits further in the depths, $n.$B$BHis wrath will be unmatched now that you have slain his beloved pets. Even without Moora and Salia at his side, he is a terrible force to be reckoned with.$B$BBeware his dark powers; he is nearly more demon than orc by now.

PortraitGiverText.text: 暗影议会扭曲而堕落的首脑。
PortraitGiverText.english: The twisted and corrupted leader of the Shadow Council.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 我们的任务就要完成了。暗影堡终将被收复。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Our task is nearly done. Shadow Hold will be reclaimed.

identity.title: Lord Banehollow
identity.objectives: Slay Lord Banehollow.
identity.description: Only one final power remains lurking in the depths of Shadow Hold now: Lord Banehollow.$B$BThe Shadow Council here serves his whims, and even Fel'dan was a mere instrument for him to prepare this land for another invasion of the Burning Legion.$B$BProceed carefully, $n. A dreadlord is a terrifying foe. Stand tall and triumph!

PortraitGiverText.text: 他在暗影堡的最深处等待着。
PortraitGiverText.english: He awaits in the deepest corner of Shadow Hold.

identity.title: Deep Mine Rescue
identity.objectives: Escort Dumass to Safety!
identity.description: <You can hear Dumass speaking through the webbing.>$B$BHI! SPIDERS EVERYWHERE! THE CAPTAIN SENT ME TO SAVE THE WORLD AND CAPTURE HUMANS! WHAT IS THIS PLACE ANYWAY? IT'S SO HOT! I...$B$B<Dumass goes on and on about his situation.>$B$BPerhaps you should cut him free and get him back to safety. Or you can just leave him here, though it's your fault that he's stuck in this mine.

AreaDescription.text: 护送杜马斯抵达安全地点！

identity.title: The Doomstone
identity.objectives: Collect the Doomstone.
identity.description: At the core of Animus is an artifact known as the Doomstone. One of its properties is an ability to absorb a great deal of energy.$B$BThis is how the cultists are trying to set off the explosion... by overloading the stone and amplifying the power through the elemental.$B$BBring me the Doomstone. For safe keeping, of course.

PortraitGiverText.text: 从畸怒邪灵那里夺得末日石！
PortraitGiverText.english: He has the Doomstone within him!

identity.title: Svarnos
identity.objectives: You must kill Svarnos in the D-Block and return with his Cursed Collar.  Svarnos can be found in the D-Block, just northwest of Baradin Hold.
identity.description: Excellent work on the island capture, $c.  Now that we have claimed the island, we need to make these cellblocks useable for prisoners.  D-Block has been especially hard to clear out.  Unfortunately it has become overrun with demons of all sorts.$B$BWe have been able to thin out the demons but a large core hound has broken its way out of its cell and is wreaking havoc down there.  I need you to kill him and bring back his collar.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我从来都不喜欢绿色。
PortraitGiverText.english: Green never was my favorite color.

identity.title: No One Here Gets Out Alive
identity.objectives: Assess the situation at the Sludge Fields.
identity.description: This farm is under lockdown! Nothing gets in and nothing gets out! We're still assessing the situation to try and figure out exactly what happened, but my theory is that the laborers ate the mushrooms and somehow mutated into hideous undead monsters. I mean, how else could this have happened? This is just a farm! We grow mushrooms here! And sludge! Yes, sludge!$B$BTake a look around, $c, because now that you're here you can't leave until this issue is resolved.$B$BSee for yourself!

AreaDescription.english: Assess the situation at the Sludge Fields.

identity.title: Winna's Kitten
identity.objectives: Collect Kitty's Eartag from Winna's Kitten.
identity.description: Mr. Tauren here's told me a lot about what happened at Bloodvenom Post. He says Winna Hazzard is still there!$B$BShe's pretty far gone, but what's left of her is making a bunch of new slime. We've got to stop it!$B$BLuckily, I have a plan. Mr. Tauren said Winna used to have a kitten. She fed it corrupted slime water and it ran off into the woods. I saw something lurking to the southeast just past the Bloodvenom Tower, but it sure was bigger than a kitten! Go see if the kitty has a tag...

PortraitGiverText.text: 小猫长大了……
PortraitGiverText.english: Kitty has grown up...

identity.title: Hazzard Disposal
identity.objectives: Use Kitty's Eartag to get Winna Hazzard's attention, and then slay her.
identity.description: Winna's hooked tight into the source of the slime itself, at the very back of Bloodvenom Post to the west. She makes sure it keeps flowing, and it keeps her safe! But if you can get her attention...$B$BTake the eartag and show it to Winna. If there's even a little, tiny bit of her left, maybe it'll get through. Maybe her regret for her poor lost kitty will come to the surface and she'll feel sorry just one more time, and come out of the slime!$B$BAnd then maybe you can kill her and stop the slime. Yay!

PortraitGiverText.text: 她看起来有点不一样了……
PortraitGiverText.english: She looks a little different now...

identity.title: Magmalord Falthazar
identity.objectives: Collect Magmalord Falthazar's Head.
identity.description: I just heard the terrible news from the west - we've lost Humboldt's Stead. Wiped off the face of the planet in a wall of fire!$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer is to blame, and the survivors say it were the work of one Magmalord Falthazar. He's an ascendant - that's what they call the highest echelon of Twilight's Hammer cultists who become one with the elements. He's a creature of pure fire.$B$BAnd he'll soon be a creature of pure dead! Go kill Falthazar at the Humboldt Conflagration and bring me his head!

PortraitGiverText.text: 在火焰的中心找到他。
PortraitGiverText.english: Seek him out in the center of the blaze.

identity.title: Wanted: The Demon Hunter
identity.objectives: Slay Feronas Sindweller.
identity.description: Since reclaiming Jadefire Run from the satyr, the Emerald Circle has sent many druids to begin the long task of cleansing the ruins. Last night, several of them were murdered... by a night elf.$B$BThe witnesses say it was a demon hunter, a crazed disciple of Illidan. A rare sight. No doubt he's gone mad with power just like his master.$B$BI'll pay top bounty for proof of this murderer's death. He's been spotted just off the road to the north, in a valley beneath Jadefire Run.

PortraitGiverText.text: 将凶手绳之以法。
PortraitGiverText.english: Bring this murderer to justice.

identity.title: A Destiny of Flame and Sorrow
identity.objectives: Relive Illidan's battle with Arthas.
identity.description: My kind has always been hated for what we do... despised outcasts, accused of corruption beyond redemption.$B$BYet if it was not for a demon hunter, these very woods would be the greatest stronghold of the Burning Legion on Azeroth. I speak of my master, Illidan Stormrage, the "Betrayer".$B$BSee for yourself. See what occured here when Illidan was first freed, and the demonic forces of the dreadlord Tichondrius ruled this forest completely unopposed...

PortraitGiverText.text: 伊利丹同死亡骑士阿尔萨斯初次会面就打得不可开交。
PortraitGiverText.english: Illidan's first meeting with the death knight Arthas led to a fierce battle.

identity.title: The Warden
identity.objectives: You must kill Warden Silva in The Hole and return with his keys.  The Hole is just southwest of Baradin Hold.
identity.description: We have almost finished clearing out the revolting prisoners in The Hole, but one last problem remains.  The warden.$b$bWarden Silva is their master and they will do anything for him.  If we take him out, we take them all out.  Finish him off and bring me back his keys.  We can use those keys to explore deeper into the cellblock and possibly gain access to the water supply here on the island.

PortraitGiverText.text: 是时候让典狱官提前释放了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Time to give the warden an early parole.

identity.title: The Last Protector
identity.objectives: Defeat the Withered Protector.
identity.description: Ahhh... thank you, little $r. I and others have tried so many times to grow in this forest, without success.$B$BThe Withered Protector that lurks in the north is the only ancient to have grown to maturity since the ruining of the forest, but his body is sick and his mind is mad. Just as we gathered the spirits of the treants, I would save those that dwell in him rather than leave them behind.$B$BDefeat him, and let his spirits join me before I set my roots.

PortraitGiverText.text: 生命与重生，源自腐朽与苦难。
PortraitGiverText.english: From decay and suffering comes life and rebirth.

identity.title: Rejoining the Forest
identity.objectives: Bring the Flourishing Protector back to the hill in the center of Irontree Woods.
identity.description: It is time to say goodbye now. You have raised me from a seedling, brief though it was, but now I must rejoin the forest.$B$BTake me back to the hill you found me on. There I will set my roots, and grow in the shadow of the ancients that came before me.

identity.title: Strategic Cuts
identity.objectives: Use the Razor-Sharp Scorpid Barb on Voodooist Timan atop the Pillar of Ash, Worgmistress Othana in the worg pens, and Gorlop when he is near the lava pools.
identity.description: <Static> $n... $n, can you hear me?  It's Troteman.$b$bListen, we've just received the final bit of intel for your next mission.  There are three marks that we'd like you to take down.  The first is Voodooist Timan, whom you'll find atop the Pillar of Ash.  Worgmistress Othana is in the central worg pens.  Finally, Gorlop is near the lava pools to the south.$b$bYou will find the scorpid barbs you harvested packed along with your belongings.  Use the barbs on the marks when the time is right.

PortraitGiverText.text: 准备好采取行动了么？我已经准备好了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Ready for some assassinations?  I know I am.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你用起这种武器来很顺手，孩子。
PortraitTurnInText.english: You're pretty handy with a stinger, kid.

identity.title: Last of Her Kind
identity.objectives: Kill Obsidia.
identity.description: Obsidia is one of the last mature dragons that can continue the black dragonflight bloodline. She must be killed.$B$BIf you succeed in killing her, you should inform Lirastrasza immediately of your victory. She's been fighting a long time to see this done.$B$BThank you for being our fang in these battles. You've proven a powerful ally.

PortraitGiverText.text: 艾泽拉斯最后一条母黑龙。
PortraitGiverText.english: One of the last breeding black dragons in all of Azeroth.

identity.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
identity.objectives: Bring the Horn of the Callers back to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
identity.description: $n, it's Troteman.  I want you to hold onto that horn.  I'm sure we can improvise and find a way to work it into the plan.$b$bI'm more than a little concerned about what Kaoshin said about attacking Redridge.  We knew another attack was imminent, but our timetables were off by several days.$b$bReturn to me, with the horn.  We will talk again here, in Chiselgrip.  And try not to ruin that disguise.  You're not done with your undercover work yet.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这样一支号角可不仅仅能对科多兽起作用……
PortraitGiverText.english: A horn like that will work on more than just kodos...

identity.title: The Skull of Gul'dan
identity.objectives: Relive Illidan's battle for the Skull of Gul'dan.
identity.description: Illidan set out to find the Skull of Gul'dan. He fought through armies of demons to reach it, slaying them with the power that made him a hated outcast.$B$BSee him in battle, $c. Witness the one that fought the fiercest against the corruptors of Felwood, and struck at its source.

identity.title: The Fall of Tichondrius
identity.objectives: Relive Illidan's battle with Tichondrius.
identity.description: Yes, Illidan took the power of the Skull of Gul'dan for himself.$B$BBut did he flee with it into the night? Did he use it for his own glory? No... his very first action was to use his new power to assault the dreadlord Tichondrius!$B$BWitness his triumph, $c. Witness how Illidan reclaimed Felwood from the demons... and the thanks he was given.

PortraitGiverText.text: 纳斯雷兹姆的首领，费伍德森林的污染者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Leader of the Nathrezim and corruptor of Felwood.

identity.title: Deceivers In Our Midst
identity.objectives: Slay 12 Jadefire Shifters in Jadefire Run.
identity.description: Now that you've had a lesson in keeping an open mind, perhaps you'd like to learn WHY I killed those druids.$B$BThe answer is simple: They are not druids at all.$B$BDemons still roam the ruins, now hiding in plain sight in the guise of friendly caretakers. See for yourself...this blindfold is soaked in demon blood. Take it north up the hills to Jadefire Run and place it on your eyes. It will show even the most oblivious fool the true nature of any demon.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 初次使用的时间不要太长。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Do not drink too deep the first time.

identity.title: Navarax's Gambit
identity.objectives: Slay the demon impersonating Arch Druid Navarax.
identity.description: I have been preying on these demonic impostors for some time now, and I have finally gleaned the location of their leader. It is none other than Arch Druid Navarax, the leader of the Emerald Circle.$B$BThe demon shields himself with innocents. If I entered Whisperwind Grove to hunt him, I would be set upon by ignorant protectors... but you! You can catch him unaware.$B$BReturn to Whisperwind Grove. Climb the druid tower and you'll find Navarax at the top, in his room amidst the boughs.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这里潜藏着一颗恶魔的心。
PortraitGiverText.english: Inside lurks the heart of a demon.

identity.title: Abuse of Power
identity.objectives: Kill 5 Blackrock Sergeants using the Blackrock Cudgel of Discipline.  Defeat them quickly, before they have a chance to unmask you.
identity.description: $n?  Troteman here.$b$bIt sounds like you have earned Thorg'izog's trust, and he's assigned you to discipline duty.  This is fortunate.$b$bWe need you to take out his sergeants.  You'll find them on wolfback, outside of the Blackrock Stronghold in the Fields of Honor.  Use that cudgel on them, several times, until they die.  You'll have to act fast, because if they realize you're not one of them, they can unmask you.  Strike quickly and ferociously, $n.$b$bTroteman out.

PortraitGiverText.text: 希望伪装不会暴露……
PortraitGiverText.english: I hope that disguise holds together...

PortraitTurnInText.english: Hahaha!  Nice work!

identity.title: Narkrall, The Drake-Tamer
identity.objectives: Slay Narkrall Rakeclaw. Speak with Colin Thundermar when you're ready.
identity.description: There's one Dragonmaw among this lot, the one they call "Narkrall: The Drake-Tamer." I don't know where he gets his power over those beasts, but the black terror he rides is as nasty a brute as ever took the skies over the Highlands.$B$B$n, Narkrall is the fiend who took my father's life and left Thundermar in my hands.$B$BI can't take him on alone, but I've seen what you're capable of, $c. Maybe together we can end this.$B$BLet me know when you're ready, and we'll fight Narkrall together!

PortraitGiverText.text: 你准备好了就告诉我。我会把他从幼龙身上拽下来，但你得帮忙将他干掉……
PortraitGiverText.english: Speak to me when you're ready. I'll get him off his drake, but I'll need your help finishing him off...

identity.title: Enough Damage For One Day
identity.objectives: Return to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip.
identity.description: We do not have any further strategic need for Thorg'izog or the Blackrock ground troops.  We must continue to the next phase of the plan.$b$bWhen you are finished at the stronghold, return to us here in Chiselgrip.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你先回家吧，孩子。我们还有事情要做。
PortraitGiverText.english: Head on back home, kid.  We've got more work to do.

identity.title: Placing the Pawns
identity.objectives: Return to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
identity.description: $n.  It sounds like you and Keeshan have finished with your tasks.  I've also finished mine.$b$bReturn to Morgan's Vigil.  I've prepared a few packages to deliver to the Big Three: Thorg'izog, Neeralak, and Xi'lun.  You've already met General Thorg'izog.  This will be your chance to meet the other two.$b$bThat is, before we kill them.

PortraitGiverText.text: 回到摩根的岗哨。要运送的货物已经准备好了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Come back to Morgan's Vigil.  I've got some deliveries prepared.

identity.title: Locked and Loaded
identity.objectives: Report to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
identity.description: $n, come in.  Can you read me?$b$bThe battle is about to start.  I hope you've delivered all of those packages.$b$bI need you here in Morgan's Vigil, NOW.

PortraitGiverText.text: 立即返回摩根的岗哨！
PortraitGiverText.english: Get back to Morgan's Vigil ASAP!

identity.title: Angry Scrubbing Bubbles
identity.objectives: Kill 5 Angry Blight Slimes.
identity.description: These blight slimes seem to be really angry. They've even got a faint outline of an angry humanoid face in their ectoplasm. You don't think Hinott would be too happy about having non-compliant slimes working the slime pools.$B$BKill any angry blight slimes that you see and try to get a lock on a breeding pool.

PortraitGiverText.text: 或许它还是小软泥怪时就被咬了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Perhaps it was beaten as a young slime.

identity.title: Trail of Filth
identity.objectives: Kill Chet the Slime-Breeder.
identity.description: The trail of filth and anger leads into the ruined town hall. Surely there is a slime breeding pool inside the structure. Fight your way inside and deal with whatever angry slime-breeder that you encounter!$B$BShould you succeed Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore will surely want to hear about it.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你死定了，白痴！
PortraitGiverText.english: You're stewed, buttwad!

identity.title: *Gurgle* HELP! *Gurgle*
identity.objectives: Help Kingslayer Orkus get out of the water.
identity.description: *GURGLE*$B$BHELP!*GASP*$B$BORKUS IS DROWNING! HELP ME, QUEST GIVER $n!$B$B*GLUB*$B$BDwarf threw Orkus into the water! Must not die!$B$B*GURGLE*$B$BThe shame would be too great.

AreaDescription.english: Orkus Safely Escorted Out of the Water

identity.title: Stormpike Rendezvous
identity.objectives: Learn about the Stormpike Rendezvous from Orkus.
identity.description: I tracked down the decrepit necromancer, Helcular, in hopes of getting a lead on Alliance movement within Hillsbrad.$B$BHelcular tasked me with finding and killing worgen. Ordinarily this would not be a problem for Orkus, but I had just eaten several helpings of Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok chops, causing my bowels to cry out in anguish. That's when the trouble began and how I ended up in the water.$B$BHear Orkus out, $n.

identity.title: The Core of Kroshius
identity.objectives: Obtain Kroshius' Infernal Core.
identity.description: The most fearsome demon in Shatter Scar Vale is known as Kroshius. Though many have hunted him over the years, destruction has only made him stronger.$B$BTime after time, warlocks have come to this forest and reanimated Kroshius. He now lurks in the southeast, surrounded by demonic fire, awaiting any who come to try and claim his power.$B$BI will not have this corrupt cycle continue! Kill Kroshius, and bring his infernal core to me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 夺取他的核心将终结这场循环
PortraitGiverText.english: Taking his core will end this cycle.

identity.title: Fire in the Hole!
identity.objectives: Slay Grolvitar the Everburning.
identity.description: Land's sakes, pardner! You done shut off those valves but good.$B$BUnfortunately we've had a critical blowout in our gosh-darned central burnoff regulator! Missus Darla's done sent as many workers as she can rustle to go shut it off, but those flames have a mind of their own!$B$BLiterally! They're hoppin' up and grabbin' anyone who comes near! So Darla says if you can muster up out of that cave you're in and beat that elemental, she's got a mighty fine prize in store for ya!

PortraitGiverText.text: 这个大混账东西不在我们的工作流程里！
PortraitGiverText.english: This big ol' varmint don't belong in our pipelines!

identity.title: The Road to Purgation
identity.objectives: Accompany Kingslayer Orkus to Purgation Isle.
identity.description: The time of vengeance has come, $n. Kasha can once more fly, thanks to you. She will take us to Purgation Isle so that we may confront the Stormpike dwarf general, Vanndar Stormpike, and his captain, Balinda Stonehearth. BOTH will pay for what they have done.$B$BAre you ready? Orkus cannot do this alone.

identity.title: Glop, Son of Glop
identity.objectives: Speak to Earthmender Norsala, then kill Fungalmancer Glop.
identity.description: Glop had a son. In his grave hubris, he named it Glop. And so the line of fungalmancers continues.$B$BI require you to slay this new fungalmancer. Your shaman ally has already returned, and awaits you at his cave in the southwest of Verlok Stand.

PortraitGiverText.text: 蘑菇种植者本人。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Shroomgroomer himself.

identity.title: The Restless Brood
identity.objectives: Defeat Aeosera.
identity.description: Aeosera is restless and stubborn. She scoffs at our dominance, and she needs to be reminded of her place.$B$BI still have the mallet you retrieved for me. Return to the western edge of the Pale Roost and strike the resonating crystal.$B$BI will meet you there and lend what aid I can. Put her back in her place, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 不休的龙母。
PortraitGiverText.english: The restless broodmother.

identity.title: Heroes of the Horde!
identity.objectives: Steal the Alliance Battle Plans and Become Heroes of the Horde.
identity.description: Now to find their battle plans and take out their leaders! Should we succeed there is an orc high warlord who served in the war in Silverpine that is now stationed at Tarren Mill - located in the heart of Hillsbrad. He will grant both of us commendations for this! We will be heroes of the Horde, $n!$B$BOnward! Together we will defeat the Alliance filth!

identity.title: Strategic Cuts
identity.objectives: Use the Razor-Sharp Scorpid Barb on Voodooist Timan atop the Pillar of Ash, Worgmistress Othana in the worg pens, and Gorlop when he is near the lava pools.
identity.description: <You hear a buzzing in your ear.>$b$b$n?  It's Eitrigg.$b$bWe've just received the final bit of information for your next mission.  There are three marks that we'd like you to take down.  The first is Voodooist Timan, whom you'll find atop the Pillar of Ash.  Worgmistress Othana is in the central worg pens.  Finally, Gorlop is near the lava pools to the south.$b$bYou will find the scorpid barbs you harvested packed along with your belongings.  Use the barbs on the marks when the time is right.

PortraitGiverText.text: 该使用你收集的毒蝎钩刺了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Time to use those scorpid barbs you collected.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Nice work.

identity.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
identity.objectives: Bring the Horn of the Callers back to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
identity.description: $n, it's Eitrigg.  I want you to hold onto that horn.  I'm sure we can improvise and find a way to work it into the plan.$b$bI'm more than a little concerned about what Kaoshin said about attacking Redridge.  We knew an attack was imminent, but not this soon!$b$bReturn to me, with the horn.  We will talk again here, in Chiselgrip.  And try not to ruin that disguise.  You're not done with your undercover work yet.

PortraitGiverText.text: 那样的号角不止会对科多兽有用……
PortraitGiverText.english: A horn like that will work on more than just kodos...

identity.title: Abuse of Power
identity.objectives: Kill 5 Blackrock Sergeants using the Blackrock Cudgel of Discipline.  Defeat them quickly, before they have a chance to unmask you.
identity.description: $n?  Eitrigg here.$b$bIt sounds like you have earned Thorg'izog's trust, and he's assigned you to discipline duty.  This is fortunate.$b$bWe need you to take out his sergeants.  You'll find them on wolfback, outside of the Blackrock Stronghold in the Fields of Honor.  Use that cudgel on them, several times, until they die.  You'll have to act fast, because if they realize you're not one of them, they can unmask you.  Strike quickly and ferociously, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 该是对付那些军士的时候了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Time to turn the tables on these sergeants.

PortraitTurnInText.english: It is done.  Nice form, by the way.

identity.title: Enough Damage For One Day
identity.objectives: Return to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip.
identity.description: We do not have any further strategic need for Thorg'izog or the Blackrock ground troops.  We must continue to the next phase of the plan.$b$bWhen you are finished at the stronghold, return to my son and me, here in Chiselgrip.

PortraitGiverText.text: 返回凿握据点。我们很快就会继续前进。
PortraitGiverText.english: Return to Chiselgrip.  We move on soon.

identity.title: Placing the Pawns
identity.objectives: Return to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.
identity.description: <You hear a buzzing in your ear.>$b$b$n.  It sounds like you and Ariok have finished with your tasks.  I've also finished mine.$b$bReturn to Flame Crest.  I've prepared a few packages to deliver to the Big Three: Thorg'izog, Neeralak, and Xi'lun.  You've already met General Thorg'izog.  This will be your chance to meet the other two.$b$bThat is, before you kill them.

PortraitGiverText.text: 返回烈焰峰，我有些货物需要你运送。
PortraitGiverText.english: Return to Flame Crest.  I have a few packages for you to deliver.

identity.title: Locked and Loaded
identity.objectives: Report to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.
identity.description: $n, come in.  Can you read me?$b$bThe battle is about to start.  I hope you've delivered all of those packages.$b$bI need you here in Flame Crest, NOW.

PortraitGiverText.text: 赶快回到烈焰峰！战斗随时都会打响！
PortraitGiverText.english: Hurry back to Flame Crest!  It is nearly time for the battle!

identity.title: Yetimus the Yeti Lord
identity.objectives: Take Yetimus' Twisted Horn.
identity.description: For years the mountain yeti of this region have been allowed free reign. Our complacency in dealing with the yeti menace has resulted in an aberration! Yetimus, lord of all yetis, has grown to a size and strength that our guard simply cannot handle. We fear that should his appetite lead him near Tarren Mill he would devour us all.$B$BGather a party of suitable adventurers and dispatch the beast. He roams the countryside to the west.$B$BBring me one of his horns and I will reward you handsomely.

PortraitGiverText.text: 达隆山的天灾。
PortraitGiverText.english: The scourge of Darrow Hill.

identity.title: The Defense of Nahom
identity.objectives: Speak to a Ramkahen Sergeant and succeed in the Defense of Nahom.
identity.description: The enemy is coming... and in great numbers.$B$BWe will get no further reinforcements.  Let us hope we can stop the Neferset advance.$B$BIf Nahom falls, Ramkahen will follow.$B$BGo outside and speak to one of my sergeants when you're ready.  I will help you command the forces we have to the best of my ability.

identity.title: The Bandit Warlord
identity.objectives: Slay Warlord Ihsenn.
identity.description: Our law demands that those behind this attack face proper retribution.$B$BThe band of bandits' ringleader is a man known as Warlord Ihsenn.$B$BYou will find him in the far west of the desert.  Make sure his transgressions do not go unpunished.

PortraitGiverText.text: 让他受到应得的裁决。
PortraitGiverText.english: Give him the justice he rightfully deserves.

identity.title: March of the Stormpike
identity.objectives: See the March of the Stormpike.
identity.description: These plans you recovered weave an interesting tale, $n. The Stormpike have been moving their armies from Alterac Valley into the "four fingers" of Hillsbrad for over a month. Somehow they have managed to secretly get their installations set up without our forces knowing. Had we not received these plans they would have marched on us in a week's time, annihilating everything in their path.$B$BWith these plans, though, we can turn the tables.$B$BThis is what we must do...

AreaDescription.english: See the March of the Stormpike.

identity.title: Legacy of the High Elves
identity.objectives: Obtain the Memory of Zin-Malor from the spirit of Archmage Maenius.
identity.description: One hundred years ago...$B$BI and a small group of other High Elves traveled here from our homeland, Quel'thalas. We sought the ancient mysteries of Kel'thoril... to find why it was destroyed.$B$BWe found fragments in the ice, shards of the crystal. The Archmage we accompanied did not take long to fall under their sway. In our foolishness, we noticed too late.$B$BHis spirit wanders in the southeast, among those he drove to madness, still clutching the memory of the precious shard...

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们中某个人的痴迷招致了辛玛洛的诅咒。
PortraitGiverText.english: The obsession of one of our own brought the curse of Zin-Malor upon us all.

identity.title: The Fall of Neferset City
identity.objectives: Slay Dark Pharaoh Tekahn at Neferset City in Uldum.
identity.description: We are ready to strike now, $n.$B$BIf we take down Dark Pharaoh Tekahn, the immortal colossi will fall and our armies will be able to march into Neferset City.$B$BSeek him out and engage him without fear.  I will make sure you're not alone when it's time to bring him down.

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死黑暗法老，尼斐塞特就会随之陷落。
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay the Dark Pharaoh, and Neferset falls with him.

identity.title: In Pursuit of Shades
identity.objectives: Pursue and slay the Shade of the Spiritspeaker and obtain any evidence of its master.
identity.description: You say it spoke of a master? Of one who holds Zin-Malor?$B$BThis is grave news. You must act, $c! I saw the shade fly off to the south. Take the path to the upper ruins, and you may be able to climb the frozen waterfall after it!$B$BAnd do not let your guard down... it may be waiting for you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们必须找到是谁在控制这只怪兽！
PortraitGiverText.english: We must discover who commands this monstrosity!

identity.title: Cry of the Banshee
identity.objectives: Use the Banshee Mirror to capture 10 SI:7 Agents.
identity.description: So you are to be our savior? Very well then, I will bond myself with you. Through this bond I will be able to see through your eyes and communicate with you in the field.$B$BAccording to the plans you brought to us, the Stormpike have enlisted the aid of SI:7 at Sofera's Naze, to the north. SI:7 are comprised solely of humans - humans that we are able to use to our benefit.$B$BTake my mirror and travel north. Engage in combat with the SI:7 and bring them near death. Once they are injured, use the mirror.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 要做的事情还有很多。别沾沾自喜了。
PortraitTurnInText.english: There is much more work to be done. Do not grow complacent.

identity.title: Decimation
identity.objectives: Kill Captain Iceheart and 12 Stormpike Soldiers.
identity.description: <Melisara's image appears before you.>$B$BThe Stormpike forward camp sits atop Corrahn's Dagger, west of Sofera's Naze. You must enter the camp and slaughter every dwarf that you see. They must be taught what it means to fear and there is no finer lesson than absolute decimation.$B$BNo survivors, $n. Even their captain - especially their captain - must die.$B$BI will be in contact.

PortraitGiverText.text: 雷矛矮人会得到教训的。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Stormpike will learn what it means to fear.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Decimation leads to hesitation.

identity.title: Matters of Loyalty
identity.objectives: Speak to Drek'Thar.
identity.description: I have no authority over such matters. You must speak to our leader, Drek'Thar. I have already sent word of your arrival to Frostwolf Keep. Drek'Thar will be out to speak with you personally.

identity.title: Infiltration
identity.objectives: Kill Instructor Rufus, Drill Sergeant Magnus and Captain Crudbeard.
identity.description: For your next mission I want you to travel west to the Headland and infiltrate the Stormpike training grounds. Though there are hundreds of Stormpike trainees there, one of my banshees will disguise you to look like one of the humans captured earlier, allowing you to walk freely among the enemy.$B$BEnter the Headland and find the Stormpike instructors. Once found, coerce them into attacking you! When they attack, kill them. With their instructors dead, they will be unable to train more soldiers!

PortraitGiverText.text: 离间他们。
PortraitGiverText.english: Turn them against each other.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Confusion leads to chaos.

identity.title: Domination
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Stormpike Engineers.
identity.description: <Melisara's thoughts intermingle with your thoughts.>$B$BThe last task will be an assault against the siege technicians of Gavin's Naze, located west of the Headland. Venture to the final finger and lay waste to the dwarf and gnome engineers that build and fortify the Stormpike machines of war. Be sure to plant Cromush's final pocket-nuke as well.

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀戮带来胜利！
PortraitGiverText.english: Domination leads to victory!

identity.title: The Keys to the Hot Rod

Title.english: The Keys to the Hot Rod

identity.title: Bearzerker
identity.objectives: Slay Grolnar the Berserk.
identity.description: High Chieftain Winterfall's absence has done little to quell the rage of the Winterfall. In his absence, their greatest warrior has rose to a position of terrible power.$B$BGrolnar the Berserk lurks in the cave at the top of Winterfall Village, gorged on enough corrupt firewater to kill ten lesser furbolgs.$B$BHe has become a bloated and horrible beast! Our warriors have been unable to face him... do you have the strength to defeat him, $c?

PortraitGiverText.text: 狂饮了堕落的冬泉火酒之后，他的力量压倒所有熊怪。
PortraitGiverText.english: Gorged on corrupted firewater, he towers over all furbolg.

identity.title: Stormpike Apocalypse
identity.objectives: Witness the Stormpike Apocalypse.
identity.description: Before we continue, let us have a moment of silence for our fallen brother, Orkus, for without him, we would have been destroyed by the Stormpike onslaught. This is for you, brother!$B$B<Cromush takes a knee.>$B$BNow, $n, do not think that I forgot your part in all of this! That is why you get the honors of detonating the goblin pocket-nukes.$B$BAre you ready? FOR THE HORDE!

identity.title: The Perfect Horns
identity.objectives: Obtain Icewhomp's Pristine Horns.
identity.description: I can't make a yeti without horns!$B$BI've been looking for what seems like forever for the perfect set of horns... and no horn I find is good enough! But just the other day I saw the biggest yeti in Winterspring.$B$BI named him Icewhomp. His horns are the ones I've been looking for! He lurks all the way in the back of the cave along the eastern ridge of Ice Thistle Hills.$B$BBring me his horns... but be sure to check on Echo Three along the way!

PortraitGiverText.text: 看看那双漂亮的角！
PortraitGiverText.english: Just look at those beautiful horns!

identity.title: A Haunting in Hillsbrad
identity.objectives: Search Dun Garok for evidence of a haunting.
identity.description: The battle over Dun Garok was the bloodiest of all the Hillsbrad battles. The dwarves, outnumbered ten-to-one, fought until the bitter end. Every last one of 'em died in defense of that piece of land.$B$BNow I hear claims that the place is haunted. Nobody wants to go near it! Unfortunately I have orders to prepare Dun Garok for habitation.$B$BCould you do me a favor and go to Dun Garok and search for evidence of a haunting? It's far to the southeast.

AreaDescription.text: 调查丹加洛克的闹鬼事件。
AreaDescription.english: Search Dun Garok for Evidence of a Haunting.

identity.title: A Taste for Bear
identity.objectives: Kill 15 Shardtooth bears.
identity.description: Have you ever had the luxury of trying bear meat? I never had the chance to try it in Gilneas, but the bears here are simply exquisite.$B$BThe shardtooth bears that roam just to the south are well-marbled with fat from the cold here. I've been hunting them myself, and it's quite a lark, but I much prefer eating them!$B$BI recommend you try your hand at the hunt. Stick to the white-pelted Shardtooth bears, and the Captain will go to field to bring back any you kill.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Mmm... bear...

identity.title: The Owls Have It
identity.objectives: Slay 15 Winterspring Owls.
identity.description: I've been eatin' owls my whole life. Owls is good eatin', and my friend Jez agrees. I was the first one that told him to sell owl!$B$BMister fancy-pants worgen here says bears taste better, but don't pay him no mind. You should go hunt yourself some owl. There's plenty of 'em wandering just south of here. Stick to the gray ones for now, an' buzz me on the little talky-thing Jez gave you when you've racked up a few.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 这个喋喋不休的家伙令我很困惑。
PortraitTurnInText.english: This here fancy talky thing just confuses me.

identity.title: Ursius
identity.objectives: Kill Ursius.
identity.description: I've heard it said that you are what you eat. I don't know if I believe that, but if it's true... I'd prefer to eat the strongest creature that I can find.$b$bUrsius is the largest bear in Winterspring. He eats first when his pack of shardtooth brings down a chimaera or an owlbear. He claims the most comfortable cave in the shardtooth-held lands. And he has... considerable influence with the shardtooth females.$b$bHe is my kind of bear.$b$bI want to eat him.$b$bHis cave is near the maulers. Good luck!

PortraitGiverText.text: 尤西乌斯是我的。
PortraitGiverText.english: Ursius must be mine.

identity.title: Fresh Frostsabers
identity.objectives: Slay 15 Frostsabers or Frostsaber Stalkers.
identity.description: Doesn't that smell great? My smoked meats get top dollar, and nobody else provides the exotic flavors I've got out here in the hills. And it's efficient; you just do the hunting for a small fee, and my other fine friends drag the beasts back here for skinnin' and smokin'!$B$BI've got the market cornered on Frostsaber meat right now. Absolutely delicious stuff, makes great sausages. Head out and hunt those cats just west of here, and we'll call that a start!

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你继续狩猎，我继续烹饪！
PortraitTurnInText.english: You keep huntin' and I'll keep smokin'!

identity.title: Pride of the Dinner Table
identity.objectives: Slay 15 Frostsaber Huntresses or Frostsaber Pride Watchers.
identity.description: Alright kid, time to head out further into the field!$B$BThis haul's nice and good, but further to the west you'll find much bigger kitties. The pride watchers and huntresses have a lot more muscle on them, and it makes AMAZING burger patties. They sell like crazy!$B$BGimme a ping when you've cleared house and we'll see about you going after the main course.

PortraitGiverText.text: 狩猎很有趣！
PortraitGiverText.english: Huntin's good clean fun!

PortraitTurnInText.english: We got one more left!

identity.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Zephyrus
identity.objectives: Kill Zephyrus.
identity.description: Durnholde Keep has always been a place of strife. For years the humans used it as an internment camp and prison for the orcs. After that it was taken over by the Syndicate. Now? The Dark Lady captured and placed powerful elementals within its walls. She charged me with administering "The Durnholde Challenge." Any that can defeat all of the elementals will earn a grand prize! Take this guide and face your first challenge: Zephyrus!$B$BDurnholde is located just northeast of us.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奥拉基尔的爪牙
PortraitGiverText.english: Minion of Al'Akir

identity.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Teracula
identity.objectives: Kill Teracula.
identity.description: According to the guide, Teracula is your next challenge. It roams the path just outside of Zephyrus' lair.

PortraitGiverText.text: 塞拉赞恩的爪牙
PortraitGiverText.english: Minion of Therazane

identity.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Bloodvenom
identity.objectives: Kill Bloodvenom.
identity.description: According to the guide, Bloodvenom is your next challenge. The fearsome elemental can be found on the lower level of Durnholde Keep, near the western prisons.

PortraitGiverText.text: 耐普图隆的爪牙
PortraitGiverText.english: Minion of Neptulon

identity.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Infernus
identity.objectives: Kill Infernus.
identity.description: According to the guide, Infernus is your next challenge. This being, made of molten lava and raging fire, can be found on the lower level of Durnholde Keep, near the eastern prisons.

PortraitGiverText.text: 拉格纳罗斯的爪牙
PortraitGiverText.english: Minion of Ragnaros

identity.title: The Durnholde Challenge: D-1000
identity.objectives: Kill the D-1000.
identity.description: Imprisoned in the old Durnholde Keep arena is a being comprised of pure mercury. The Forsaken have dubbed it the D-1000. Kill the D-1000 and claim your prize!

PortraitGiverText.text: 布鲁的爪牙
PortraitGiverText.english: Minion of Blue

identity.title: A Huge Problem
identity.objectives: You have been asked to kill Problim, a giant ettin that roams the paths of Tol Barad.
identity.description: We finally capture this godforsaken rock and then we find out that there is a huge ettin roaming around, taking out our sentry patrols!$B$B$n, I need you to round up a few friends and take that ettin down.  We can't have a beast like that roaming around, wreaking havoc.$B$BStay alert, reports from the front say that he is carrying a huge tree as a weapon, and he is not afraid to use it.

PortraitGiverText.text: 祝你好运。
PortraitGiverText.english: Good luck on this one.

identity.title: The Imprisoned Archmage
identity.objectives: You must kill Archmage Galus and return with his Staff from the Cursed Depths, just east of Baradin Hold.
identity.description: We have been trying to clear out the Cursed Depths cellblock since we landed on Tol Barad.  It seems that everytime we get close, that archmage shows up and pushes us back.$B$BNow that we have claimed the island, it's time we take another shot.  Head down there and bring me back his staff as proof that you have finished the job.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他拿着那把法杖的日子不会太长了。
PortraitGiverText.english: He won't have that staff for long.

identity.title: Svarnos
identity.objectives: You must kill Svarnos in the D-Block and return with his Cursed Collar.  Svarnos can be found in the D-Block, just northwest of Baradin Hold.
identity.description: Excellent work on the island capture, $c.  Now that we have claimed the island, we need to make these cellblocks useable for prisoners.  D-Block has been especially hard to clear out.  Unfortunately it has become overrun with demons of all sorts.$B$BWe have been able to thin out the demons but a large core hound has broken its way out of its cell and is wreaking havoc down there.  I need you to kill him and bring back his collar.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我从来都不喜欢绿色。
PortraitGiverText.english: Green never was my favorite color.

identity.title: The Warden
identity.objectives: You must kill Warden Silva in The Hole and return with his keys.  The Hole is just southwest of Baradin Hold.
identity.description: We have almost finished clearing out the revolting prisoners in the hole, but one last problem remains.  The warden.$b$bWarden Silva is their master and they will do anything for him.  If we take him out, we take them all out.  Finish him off and bring me back his keys.  We can use those keys to explore deeper into the cellblock and possibly gain access to the water supply here on the island.

PortraitGiverText.text: 是时候让典狱官提前释放了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Time to give the warden an early parole.

identity.title: Captain P. Harris
identity.objectives: You have been tasked with killing Captain P. Harris at the Cape of Lost Hope.  The Cape of Lost Hope can be found northwest of here, along the coast.  Just look for the shipwrecks.
identity.description: The Cape of Lost Hope has been a sore in our side for weeks here on Tol Barad.  Half of our supply ships end up on the rocks down there.$b$bTo make matters worse, it's been overrun by a gang of undead sailors.  We have tried thinning the ranks, but they just seem to keep coming back.  Our last resort is to try and take out the captain that they report to.  You should be able to find him on a ship, just off the shoreline.$b$bOh, and I hope you are not too scared of sharks.

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死船长，他的爪牙们就会一哄而散了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Take out the captain, and his minions will fall.

identity.title: Shark Tank
identity.objectives: You have been tasked to kill Tank, a large shark cruising the waters of the Cape of Lost Hope.  The cape can be found north of here, along the northern coastline.
identity.description: I hate sharks.  All of my troops hate sharks too.  This is where you come in, $n.$b$bI need you to head up to the Cape of Lost Hope and take out a huge shark named Tank.  Tank is not to be trifled with so I would bring a few friends if I were you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这家伙咬人一点也不痛。
PortraitGiverText.english: Jaws has nothing on this guy.

identity.title: Claiming The Keep
identity.objectives: You have been asked to kill Keep Lord Farson at the Farson Hold.  Farson Hold can be found on the north side of the island.
identity.description: Have you seen the keep on the north side of the island, $n?  That is where Keep Lord Farson runs his operation from.$b$bFarson has a small group of dedicated followers and they have been giving us trouble since we got here.  We sent a small group to investigate and they reported back on his exact position within the keep.$b$bCan you finish him off for us?

PortraitGiverText.text: 他的追随者非常忠心。别低估他们。
PortraitGiverText.english: His followers are very loyal.  Do not underestimate them.

identity.title: First Lieutenant Connor
identity.objectives: Find and kill First Lieutenant Connor at Forgotten Hill.  You will find Forgotten Hill on the far west side of the island.
identity.description: The first time I heard about Lt. Connor, I was just a young recruit in Ragefire Chasm.  None of us could believe he ended up here on Tol Barad.  Sadly, he still roams these wretched islands, wreaking havoc on our troops morale.$b$bI need you to put an end to his misery... and ours.

PortraitGiverText.text: 没人想死在这里，但是天不遂人愿啊。
PortraitGiverText.english: No one wanted to end up here, but we don't always get what we want.

identity.title: WANTED: Foreman Wellson
identity.objectives: Kill Foreman Wellson at the Wellson Shipyard.  The shipyard can be found north of here, on the western coast.
identity.description: Foreman Wellson has been a pain in our side since we got here.  His shipyard holds a large amount of supplies that would be extremely useful to us... if we could get to them.$b$bHe keeps a close watch over his minions and makes it very difficult for us to get a foothold on the shipyard.  I need you to take out Wellson for good this time.  Be careful $n, we have been receiving reports of dirty Alliance all around the area.

PortraitGiverText.text: 曾经不可一世的工头维尔松，已然失宠。
PortraitGiverText.english: Once a great man, Foreman Wellson has fallen from grace.

identity.title: Taking the Overlook Back
identity.objectives: Private Sarlosk has asked you to kill Commander Largo at Largo's Overlook.  The overlook is just northeast of the base camp.
identity.description: There is only one way for us to take Largo's Overlook back.$b$bI think you know what we need to do $n.  Largo is pretty paranoid these days so you should be able to find him on top of the tower, looking for his imaginary navy to finally arrive.

PortraitGiverText.text: 祝你好运。
PortraitGiverText.english: Good luck with this one.

identity.title: A Little Gamy
identity.objectives: Kill 15 Shardtooth Maulers.
identity.description: Many find the meat of the Shardtooth bears to be too gamy for their taste. I disagree, though I'm not one to judge the tastes of others.$b$bThe Shardtooth Maulers, however - their brown-furred cousins, to the south - have much more tender flesh, particularly in their paws. And I've heard that the snout is also considered a delicacy.$b$bContinue your hunt, $n. Let's see if you can bag those maulers for ol' Francis.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我不在乎口感。
PortraitGiverText.english: I don't mind the taste.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 那边就有一些熊的肉很不错。
PortraitTurnInText.english: That's some good bear right there.

identity.title: Walk A Mile In Their Shoes
identity.objectives: Escort a Farson Keep Prisoner to safety.  The hold is located on the northern tip of the island.
identity.description: We have sent at least 3 different recon groups to investigate Farson Hold in the last few weeks.  Sadly, not one of them has returned back with any info.$B$BAt this point, all we can hope is that they are being held alive as prisoners.  I need you to infiltrate the keep and help get our soldiers back.  This won't be easy $n, but if anyone can help us, it's you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这家伙似乎需要一些帮助。
PortraitGiverText.english: This guy looks like he could use some help.

identity.title: Vile Touch
identity.objectives: Kill Githyiss the Vile at the northen end of the Shadowthread Cave.
identity.description: If these spiders are born with corruption in their veins, then their broodmother must be at the root of this evil.$B$BLet us make our way to the far north end of the cave and seek out Githyiss the Vile. The answers we seek lie with her.

PortraitGiverText.text: 基塞伊斯就是解开幽影谷和整个泰达希尔堕落的关键线索。
PortraitGiverText.english: With Githyiss lie clues to the corruption of Shadowglen and the rest of Teldrassil.

identity.title: This Can Only Mean One Thing...
identity.objectives: Take Finkle's Mole Machine to Blackrock Mountain.
identity.description: Raz and I were enlisted by the Guardians of Hyjal to investigate the re-emergence of Ragnaros into our world. Let me go ahead and confirm that he is back and he is angry! We also have evidence that these Twilight's Hammer cultists are moving elementals from here to Blackrock Caverns, over in the Eastern Kingdoms.$B$BRaz and I were about to head over there to investigate. We've got room for another in the mole machine if you're interested. Just meet us on the inside and we'll begin our journey.

identity.title: To the Chamber of Incineration!
identity.objectives: Kill Rom'ogg Bonecrusher.
identity.description: It was an ambush, $n! As soon as we walked in a super-fat ogre named Rom'ogg Bonecrusher attacked us! Raz bravely defended me while I ran off to hide. I watched as they beat him unconscious and then dragged him to a place the fat one called the "Chamber of Incineration." I think it's just down the hall across the bridge.$B$BI'm too scared to go any further. Take my all-purpose diving helm and search for Raz. I'll communicate with you through the helm.$B$BAnd if you find that ogre, kill him!

PortraitGiverText.text: 这就是绑架了拉兹的大胖子坏蛋。
PortraitGiverText.english: This is the fat piece of good-for-nothing that kidnapped Raz.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Follow Raz!

identity.title: What Is This Place?
identity.objectives: Kill Corla, Herald of Twilight.
identity.description: <Finkle's helm gives you a slight jolt.>$B$BWhat is this place? It looks like they're doing something terrible to that nether dragon. The energy is being siphoned from the creature into that lady! We need to stop this ritual!$B$BKill Corla to get past this hall!

PortraitGiverText.text: 她看起来很坏！
PortraitGiverText.english: She looks mean!

PortraitTurnInText.text: 没时间浪费了！拉兹需要我们的帮助！
PortraitTurnInText.english: There's no time to waste! Raz needs our help!

identity.title: The Twilight Forge
identity.objectives: Kill Karsh Steelbender.
identity.description: <Finkle's helm hums with energy.>$B$BDamn it! Raz won't stop! It's as if he were possessed with a burning vengeance for all things Twilight! It looks like if we're going to get past this room and catch up with Raz we'll need to take out the Twilight armorer, Karsh Steelbender. Kill him quick, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我想他也许能掰弯钢铁。
PortraitGiverText.english: I think he might be able to bend steel.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 拉兹就在附近。我能听到他的声音。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Raz is close. I can hear him!

identity.title: Do My Eyes Deceive Me?
identity.objectives: Kill Beauty.
identity.description: <Finkle's helm explodes with the sound of a loud girlish scream.>$B$BIT CAN'T BE! I... I was stuck inside one of those beasts for the better part of a month. Yes, literally stuck inside its stomach. If it weren't for my suit and the all-purpose helm I'd have died a fiery death! And look at that, it's had a litter of pups!$B$BY... You gotta stop that thing, $n! We can't let it or its pups make it out of here alive!

PortraitGiverText.text: 纯粹的邪恶景象！
PortraitGiverText.english: A vision of pure evil!

PortraitTurnInText.text: 我可以少接受几年心理治疗了。
PortraitTurnInText.english: That will save me from a few years of therapy.

identity.title: Ascendant Lord Obsidius
identity.objectives: Kill Ascendant Lord Obsidius.
identity.description: <Finkle's helm buzzes.>$B$BGOOD GOLLY! Look at this place! A... Are those Deathwing's claw marks on the ceiling?! And what's that creature in the center of the chamber?$B$BI don't see Raz anywhere. Let's take care of this monster and find Raz!

PortraitGiverText.text: 他曾是凡人，现在已升腾为元素领主了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Once mortal, now an ascended elemental lord.

identity.title: Shy-Rotam
identity.objectives: Slay Shy-Rotam.
identity.description: Time for the big kill, pal! Shy-Rotam lurks in the north, the largest frostsaber of them all.$B$BYou should feel honored. There's no fiercer game for a hunter to match their skills against... and if you saw the cash I'm being offered by gourmands that want a piece of this fellow, your eyes would pop out!$B$BOnce you've got her, head on back to camp. Don't want to totally exhaust our frostsaber population in one day...

PortraitGiverText.text: 冬泉谷的霜刃豹女王……难得的美味！
PortraitGiverText.english: Pridemother of the Winterspring Frostsabers... and a tasty meal!

identity.title: Screechy Keen
identity.objectives: Slay 15 Winterspring Screechers.
identity.description: Them smaller owls are sure tasty, but Goodgrub says there's even bigger ones further south. Screechers, the folk around here call 'em... they make a heck of a noise when you tussle with them!$B$BBut he says they're the best owls he's ever tasted or sold, and I believe him. Why don't you go rustle up some of those for us while I keep arguin' with Francis here?

PortraitGiverText.text: 迫不及待地想得到更多的枭！
PortraitGiverText.english: Can't wait for more of them owls!

PortraitTurnInText.text: 这个喋喋不休的家伙令我很困惑。
PortraitTurnInText.english: This here fancy talky thing just confuses me.

identity.title: Beating Them Back!
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Worgs.
identity.description: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...$B$B<McBride looks through some papers.>$B$B$n. It is $n, right?$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Blackrock Battle Worgs are fierce predators.

identity.title: Lions for Lambs
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
identity.description: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.$B$BIn the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!$B$BKill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

PortraitGiverText.text: 这是一名男性黑石间谍。黑石间谍中不乏女性成员。
PortraitGiverText.english: This is a male Blackrock orc spy. There are females amongst them as well.

identity.title: Vengeance for Orsis
identity.objectives: Slay Asaad.
identity.description: The great city of Orsis was attacked by the armies of air.$B$BWe were taken prisoner.  We were the lucky ones.$B$BMost died, trapped beneath the choking desert sands.$B$BAsaad, Al'Akir's caliph, ordered the attack... and he must pay with his life.

PortraitGiverText.text: 阿萨德在奥拉基尔的命令下，发动了毁灭奥西斯的战争。让他付出代价！
PortraitGiverText.english: Asaad, under Al'Akir's orders, oversaw the devastation of Orsis.  Make him pay!

identity.title: Join the Battle!
identity.objectives: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
identity.description: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, $n!$B$BFind Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

PortraitGiverText.text: 你可以在北郡修道院后的指挥营帐找到维里副队长。
PortraitGiverText.english: Sergeant Willem can be found at the command tent behind Northshire Abbey.

identity.title: Targets of Opportunity
identity.objectives: Slay General Husam and 2 Oathsworn Captains.
identity.description: We were part of a clandestine operation put together by Prince Nadun of Ramkahen.  We lost most of our unit during an ambush and we're now unable to finish our mission.$B$BShould you be up for it, I can arrange for a sizable reward for you.$B$BWe were instructed to take out any targets of opportunity that would damage the enemy's military infrastructure.$B$BWe've spotted General Husam and two of his captains up ahead.  Slaying them for us will be a great favor for Ramkahen.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们必须对尼斐塞特的指挥体系造成致命打击！
PortraitGiverText.english: We must deliver a fatal blow to the Neferset command structure!

identity.title: A Bird of Legend
identity.objectives: Slay Hell-Hoot.
identity.description: Local legend tells of a mighty owl that circles the mountaintops like death on wings.  They named her Deathwing.$b$bSoon afterwards, they were told that that name was already taken.  So they settled on a moniker that evoked a similar sense of horror and dread:$b$bHell-Hoot.$b$bHell-Hoot can be found atop the mountain to the southwest of our smoking pit.  Silence the infernal nocturnal... so we can eat her!

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死它！
PortraitGiverText.english: Go get her!

identity.title: The Source of Their Power
identity.objectives: Slay Siamat.
identity.description: We managed to do extensive scouting before our crew was ambushed.$B$BWe discovered that Deathwing's envoy, Siamat, is giving the Neferset their newfound power.$B$BThey claim it has restored them to the greatness of old, but something else has happened.  Their very souls have been corrupted.$B$BAs one of the four winds, Siamat is incredibly powerful.  But that power has been drained considerably by this process.$B$BStrike now, while it is possible for you to slay him and bring an end to this madness.

PortraitGiverText.text: 希亚玛特将他们新近获得的力量赐予了尼斐塞特！
PortraitGiverText.english: Siamat gives the Neferset their newfound power!

Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, $n!$B$BFind Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

identity.title: A Personal Summons
identity.objectives: Farseer Krogar wants you to meet him in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: <An unfamiliar feeling wells up from deep within you, flooding your mind with thoughts and images.>$b$bHear my words, $n.$b$bOur world finds itself in the grip of a terrible crisis.$b$bI call upon you to lend your aid in this desperate hour.$b$bI am Krogar.$b$bSeek me out at once, and your destiny shall be revealed.$b$bYou can find me north of the Drag in Orgrimmar.

identity.title: They Sent Assassins
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Goblin Assassins.
identity.description: Have you ever seen a goblin, $n? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.$B$BThe Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.$B$BI need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!

PortraitGiverText.text: 是地精刺客。邪恶的小怪物！
PortraitGiverText.english: This is a goblin assassin. Nasty little monster!

identity.title: Followers and Leaders
identity.objectives: Slay High Priestess Azil and 101 Devout Followers.
identity.description: The documents detail the arrival of High Priestess Azil to the depths of the Stonecore.$B$BAzil is described as a high-ranking member of the Twilight Council.  Additionally, her entourage of over a hundred devout followers is preparing for an unholy ritual of unforeseen darkness.$B$BSounds like an event you need to put a stop to.

PortraitGiverText.text: 超过一百名虔诚的追随者……
PortraitGiverText.english: Over a hundred devout followers...

identity.title: Twilight Documents
identity.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Documents.
identity.description: We've tailed one of the Twilight's Hammer operatives here.  He goes by the name of Millhouse Manastorm.$B$BWe have reason to believe he's carrying important documents.$B$BThis is as far as we can safely go, however, without neglecting our duty to defend the Temple of Earth's inner perimeter.$B$BTrack down Manastorm and retrieve the documents from him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 获得暮光文件。
PortraitGiverText.english: Obtain the Twilight Documents.

identity.title: Wayward Child
identity.objectives: Slay Ozruk.
identity.description: One of my children is not with me, $n.$B$BHe stayed behind with the Twilight's Hammer at the Stonecore deep within the Temple of Earth.$B$BI sent my other children to free him from the dark magic that was surely keeping him from returning here, but... no such magic was placed upon him.$B$BGo into the Stonecore and destroy Ozruk.  He must be reclaimed by the earth.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我的儿子……
PortraitGiverText.english: My son...

identity.title: A Personal Summons
identity.objectives: Speak to Naraat the Earthspeaker in Stormwind.
identity.description: <An unfamiliar feeling wells up from deep within you, flooding your mind with thoughts and images.>$b$bHear my words, $n.$b$bOur world finds itself in the grip of a terrible crisis.$b$bI call upon you to lend your aid in this desperate hour.$b$bI am Naraat.$b$bSeek me out at once, and your calling shall be revealed.$b$bI await you at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.

identity.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
identity.objectives: Slay Lady Naz'jar in the Throne of Tides.
identity.description: That vile worm has earned a thousand deaths!$b$bIt won't be easy. She and her minions are firmly entrenched in this place, but she's bound to be exhausted from her fight with Neptulon.$b$bNow is the time to strike! We won't have another opportunity like this.$b$bRun her through, $n!

identity.title: The Owlbeasts' Defense
identity.objectives: Obtain an Owlbeast Dreamcatcher from Dun Mandarr.
identity.description: What a shame. Whatever Umbranse has done, he has prevented me from undoing his magic.$b$bHe is wiser than I had anticipated.$b$bI do have a backup plan, however. I have seen owlbeasts enter and leave Mazthoril, even after Umbranse took control. Their ancient druidic magic must be capable of disabling Umbranse's. Luckily, I happen to be somewhat of an expert in their methods.$b$bTravel south, to Dun Mandarr. You will find a chest with a dreamcatcher in it.$b$bThat will be your first step.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 蓝龙一族也不能失去麦索瑞尔。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The blue dragonflight can't afford to lose Mazthoril, too.

identity.title: Magic Prehistoric
identity.objectives: Obtain the Essence of the Claw-Totem, the Essence of the Life-Totem, and the Essence of the Moon-Totem.
identity.description: The owlbeasts' sacred caves are located to the east. Within several of these caves, you should find totems. I want you to approach these totems and gather whatever essence you can from them. The dreamcatcher should absorb this essence for use within Mazthoril.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他们的图腾是圣物。他们会疯狂地保卫这些图腾。
PortraitGiverText.english: Their totems are sacred objects. They will defend them ferociously.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 枭兽的古老魔法非常强大，不过……
PortraitTurnInText.english: The ancient magic of the owlbeasts is powerful. But still...

identity.title: Winterwater
identity.objectives: Obtain 7 Winterwater from Ice Avatars in Frostwhisper Gorge.
identity.description: I don't want our gambit to fail, $n. Such a failure would only draw attention to our efforts, giving Umbranse an opportunity to hone his defenses. No, we have to do this right the first time.$b$bThe Frostwhisper Gorge, to the south, provides us access to powerful ice elementals. The water within these elementals' hulls should amplify the power of your dreamcatcher, ensuring our efforts.$b$bObtain this water, $n. Then return to our small camp.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们不能容忍失败。
PortraitGiverText.english: We can't abide failures.

identity.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
identity.objectives: Legionnaire Nazgrim wants you to slay Lady Naz'jar.
identity.description: Naz'jar! She's the one responsible for this mess.$b$bShe's in here somewhere, $n. She must be exhausted after that fight with Neptulon.$b$bNow is the time to strike! We won't have another opportunity like this.$b$bI'll handle anything that tries to aid her from this direction.$b$bFind her, $n, and run her through!

identity.title: Repel the Paratroopers Accepted Tracking Event

Title.text: 擊退傘兵接受的事件追蹤
Title.english: Repel the Paratroopers Accepted Tracking Event

identity.title: Kill the Courier
identity.objectives: Kill Drahga Shadowburner and grab his Missive to Cho'gall.
identity.description: Thank you, $c, for braving the horrors of this dark and terrible place.$B$BThe bowels of Grim Batol are the heart of Cho'gall's war machine. If we are to stop his machinations throughout the Highlands, we must learn all we can from these depths.$B$BSeek out Drahga Shadowburner within. He is Cho'gall's runner, the link between here and the Bastion of Twilight. We must learn the secrets he carries.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他是古加尔在格瑞姆巴托的眼线和耳朵。我们必须获悉他的秘密。
PortraitGiverText.english: He is Cho'gall's eyes and ears in Grim Batol. We must learn his secrets.

identity.title: Closing a Dark Chapter
identity.objectives: Slay Erudax, the Duke of Below.
identity.description: This terrible place was Alexstrasza's nightmare. During what mortals call the second war, she was chained in the depths below, her tormented offspring forced to serve the demon-corrupted Horde.$B$BAlexstrasza may be free, but the beast known as Erudax still corrupts her offspring below.$B$B<Baleflame's body tenses in anger.>$B$BDestroy him, $c. Crush him that we may end these horrors once and for all!

PortraitGiverText.text: 他潜伏在格瑞姆巴托最深的深渊中，继续着邪恶的工作。
PortraitGiverText.english: He lurks within the deepest depths of Grim Batol, his foul work unceasing.

identity.title: Northern Stranglethorn 4.x: PRK - E - Just Hatched FLAG

Title.english: Northern Stranglethorn 4.x: PRK - E - Just Hatched FLAG

identity.title: Warlord Halthar is Back
identity.objectives: Slay Warlord Halthar.
identity.description: He's at it again, $n. Warlord Halthar... terror of the shire. He and his drake were spotted causing trouble to the south, among the Thundermar Ruins.$B$BKill Halthar, $n! We'll send in some warbrands to help out once you engage.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他是个吐沫横飞、怒气冲天、风风火火的苦行僧。
PortraitGiverText.english: He's a whirling dervish of spittle-flinging fury.

identity.title: Bring Down the High Shaman
identity.objectives: Slay High Shaman MacKilligan.
identity.description: Our scouts in the field report that High Shaman MacKilligan has moved out of Thundermar and is fighting amidst the Thundermar Ruins northwest of here, across the river.$B$BHe's a dangerous one, $n, responsible for the deaths of many a Dragonmaw. He WILL be destroyed, that is not the question.$B$BThe question is: will you be the one to earn the glory of the kill?

PortraitGiverText.text: 不能让他再杀人了！
PortraitGiverText.english: Must not be allowed to kill again!

identity.title: Victory in Tol Barad
identity.objectives: Win a Tol Barad battle and return to Major Marsden at Baradin Base Camp in Tol Barad Peninsula.
identity.description: We fought hard to get a foothold on this ugly rock and there is no way we are going to let the Horde get in the way of our plans.  Keeping control of Tol Barad is our first priority and we need your help, $n.  Fight your way to victory in Tol Barad and return to me word of your triumph.

identity.title: Victory in Tol Barad
identity.objectives: Win a Tol Barad battle and return to Colonel Karzag at Hellscream's Grasp in Tol Barad Peninsula.
identity.description: Maintaining control of Tol Barad is the key to our strategic plans here in the Eastern Kingdoms, $r.  We must do whatever it takes to keep the Alliance off this island and that means we need your help.  Fight with everything you have to win control of Tol Barad and bring me word of victory.

Title.text: 随机英雄日常 （第一次）（大地的裂变）

identity.title: Honor the Flame
identity.objectives: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Hyjal.
identity.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?

AreaDescription.text: 祭拜海加尔的大地之环篝火。
AreaDescription.english: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Hyjal.

identity.title: Honor the Flame
identity.objectives: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Vashj'ir.
identity.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?

AreaDescription.text: 祭拜瓦丝琪尔的大地之环篝火。
AreaDescription.english: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Vashj'ir.

identity.title: Honor the Flame
identity.objectives: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Deepholm.
identity.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?

AreaDescription.text: 祭拜深岩之洲的大地之环篝火。
AreaDescription.english: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Deepholm.

identity.title: Beating Them Back!
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Worgs.
identity.description: Another Alliance recruit, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. We don't see many of your kind here, $r, but we could sure use the help.$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Blackrock Battle Worgs are fierce predators.

identity.title: Lions for Lambs
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
identity.description: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.$B$BIn the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!$B$BKill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

PortraitGiverText.text: 这是一名男性黑石间谍。黑石间谍中也不乏女性成员。
PortraitGiverText.english: This is a male Blackrock orc spy. There are females amongst them as well.

identity.title: Join the Battle!
identity.objectives: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
identity.description: I have here an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, $n!$B$BFind Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

PortraitGiverText.text: 你可以在北郡修道院后的指挥营帐找到维里副队长。
PortraitGiverText.english: Sergeant Willem can be found at the command tent behind Northshire Abbey.

identity.title: They Sent Assassins
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Goblin Assassins.
identity.description: Have you ever seen a goblin, $n? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.$B$BThe Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.$B$BI need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!

PortraitGiverText.text: 是地精刺客。邪恶的小怪物！
PortraitGiverText.english: This is a goblin assassin. Nasty little monster!

identity.title: Cruisin' the Chasm
