identity.objectives: Travel to Sentinel Hill in Westfall and climb aboard a Rental Chopper to tour the Raging Chasm with your orphan.
identity.description: One of my friends says that a steam tank mechanic in Westfall lets visitors use his choppers. My friend even got to ride one!$B$BI've seen people ride by the orphanage in choppers. They're real loud and just about the fastest thing I've ever seen! I want to try one out!$B$BCould we go to Sentinel Hill in Westfall and ride one of those choppers? Please? I promise to behave myself and we could see the crazy giant hole left when the world changed!

AreaDescription.text: 地怒裂口的摩托车之旅
AreaDescription.english: Chopper Tour of the Raging Chasm

identity.title: Punting Season
identity.objectives: Punt 5 Children of Tortolla into water.
identity.description: Baby turtles are sweet, even if they can be somewhat bitey.$b$b<Mylune holds up a bandaged finger.>$B$BBut they're so slow with their tiny little legs, they can't escape the fire creatures who are attacking Hyjal!$b$b<Mylune claps her hands together.>$b$bPLEASE save them, $n! Pick up the wee turtles and punt them into the water of the Ashen Lake. Don't worry about the kicking, they have hard shells.$B$BThey also have hard teeth, so don't pick them up by the mouth.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Poor little shelly-shells...

identity.title: To Fort Livingston
identity.objectives: Head to Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn Vale to find the Darkspear emissary.
identity.description: Da first place we check gonna be da place most likely to be attacked first.  You call it Fort Livingston.$b$bFort Livingston be surrounded by troll ruins... It make for an easy target.$b$bMaybe we find da emissary dere.  Hopefully it ain't too late.

AreaDescription.text: 前往北荆棘谷的利文斯顿营地。
AreaDescription.english: Head to Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: Nesingwary Will Know
identity.objectives: Warn the hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
identity.description: Great, just what we need, the Gurubashi on the rampage using serpents to lead the charge.  Well at least we know that much.$b$bIt's probably a safe bet that the hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition have some insight into this.  If they don't they at least know how to fight the serpents.$b$bHead there and let them know what you saw here.  Let them know that the trolls are using serpents as their weapon.

AreaDescription.text: 前往奈辛瓦里远征队营地。

identity.title: The Biggest Diamond Ever!
identity.objectives: Take your Human Orphan into Old Ironforge, beneath the High Seat. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you arrive.
identity.description: I heard that Magni Bronzebeard, who used to be the king of Ironforge, turned into a giant diamond! Is that true? How does someone just turn into a diamond? Maybe you have to be a king and that's why no one's done it before.$B$BCan we go see him? He should be in the part of Ironforge called Old Ironforge underneath the High Seat.

AreaDescription.text: 在旧铁炉堡中拜访麦格尼国王
AreaDescription.english: Visit King Magni in Old Ironforge

identity.title: Malfurion Has Returned!
identity.objectives: Take your Human Orphan to meet Malfurion Stormrage in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. If your orphan is not present when you arrive, call for him.
identity.description: I heard that Malfurion Stormrage came back from the Emerald Dream. I don't know where that is, but it sounds like it's really far away.$B$BAnyway, he's supposed to be at the top of the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus with the High Priestess. D'you think we could go meet him? He's got to be the most powerful druid in the history of Azeroth!

AreaDescription.text: 带领你的孤儿拜访玛法里奥·怒风
AreaDescription.english: Visit Malfurion Stormrage with your orphan

identity.title: The Hunter's Revenge
identity.objectives: Give Grent Direhammer the closure he needs by killing Mauti.
identity.description: The beast that's been hunting us... I've been hunting it.$b$bWe call him Mauti.  He's a clever one.  But he made a grave mistake when he killed my brother.  Now that mistake is going to cost him.  Ol' Direhammer has got his scent.$b$bI've noticed him roaming just above Kurzen's Compound.  If we act fast, we can take him down.$b$bAre you ready, $n?

AreaDescription.text: 带领格伦特·恐锤到玛乌提的尸体旁
AreaDescription.english: Bring Grent Direhammer to the body of Mauti

identity.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
identity.objectives: Purchase a Dragon Kite Two-Pack from Craggle Wobbletop in Stormwind and then use it to fly kites with your Human Orphan. If your orphan is not present, call for him.
identity.description: The other day, when some of us were out with the matron, I saw a gnome pushing a cart filled with toys. He had dolls, copper racers, leather balls, and some kites. I've always wanted to get a dragon kite and the matron said that if I saved all my money I could buy one, but that's going to be a long time.$B$BI think the gnome's name was Craggle Wobbletop or something like that. If we can find him, could we get some kites and fly them together? I saw him walking around the canals outside the Trade District.

AreaDescription.text: 和你的孤儿一同放起风筝龙
AreaDescription.english: Fly Dragon Kites with your orphan

identity.title: You Scream, I Scream...
identity.objectives: Purchase ice cream at The Cone of Cold and then share it with your orphan.
identity.description: There's a brand new ice cream shop in Stormwind, and it's not just any old ice cream either. This ice cream is made by mages! You don't think I'm going to be hungry fifteen minutes after eating it, do you?$B$BI bet it tastes really good. Let's go try it!$B$BI heard some of the other kids talking about it, and they were saying the store is called The Cone of Cold and it's over near the Blue Recluse in the Mage Quarter.

AreaDescription.text: 带你的孤儿去吃冰激凌。
AreaDescription.english: Take your orphan out for ice cream.

identity.title: Echoes of Nemesis
identity.objectives: Speak with Tooga to summon and kill Nemesis. Stand under Tooga's shell to protect you from Nemesis' Molten Fury.
identity.description: <Mylune's voice sings like a melody in your head.>$B$BRemember that awful fire turtle, Nemesis, from the Firelands? He's dead now (yay!) but echoes of him keep trying to break through to Mount Hyjal.$B$BGo to the shores of the Ashen Lake and speak with my friend Tooga. Let him know you're ready to fight an echo of Nemesis, and the turtles will draw him into this world. Then you can hit him! Hard!$B$BHide inside of Tooga's shell if he starts to erupt.

PortraitGiverText.text: 涅墨西斯的灵魂碎片仍旧残留在我们的维度之中。
PortraitGiverText.english: Portions of Nemesis' spirit still linger between our dimensions.

identity.title: Between the Trees
identity.objectives: Catch three Spirits of Malorne by walking close to them.
identity.description: Spirit fragments of Malorne - seen to us mortals as ghostly white deer - still frolic through these forests. While Malorne is no longer with us, these pieces of his spirit may be of use to us.$b$bTravel east and walk among the trees. If you are able to get close enough to one of the spirit fragments, it will bestow its power to you.$b$bOh, and take this staff. You may need it later.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 我已经能感受到你体内的白鹿之力了。
PortraitTurnInText.english: I can already sense the power of the stag within you.

identity.title: The Power of Malorne
identity.objectives: Use the Guardian's Staff to summon and defeat Galenges.
identity.description: <Matoclaw's voice continues.>$b$bThe portal that opened up to our east is guarded by a powerful flamewaker by the name of Galenges. We will need all of Malorne's help in defeating him.$b$bDo you remember the staff that I gave you? Place it in the pile of ash in front of the portal. Then pray that Malorne comes to your aid.

PortraitGiverText.text: 等候玛洛恩的进攻，然后全力开火！
PortraitGiverText.english: Wait for Malorne to attack, then unload on him!

identity.title: A Legendary Engagement
identity.objectives: Speak to Anachronos in the Caverns of Time.
identity.description: A pleasure, $c.$b$b<Ziradormi smiles.>$b$bIt was kind of you to arrive so quickly.$b$bFor reasons unknown to me, my master seeks audience with you.$b$bI would counsel you not to take this invitation lightly. Anachronos seldom has cause to interact with mortals. Wisdom would dictate that you seek him out in the Caverns of Time at once.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready and I shall personally deliver you.

identity.title: Defend the Rebel Camp
identity.objectives: Help defend the Rebel Camp for three minutes.
identity.description: We are in trouble here, $n.  Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that things were going to get serious, but I didn't think it would be this bad.$b$bWe are doing our best to hold off these trolls.  But any help you can offer would greatly help.

identity.title: A Legendary Engagement
identity.objectives: Speak to Anachronos in the Caverns of Time.
identity.description: I expected that I would find you here, $c. But then, we of the bronze flight have somewhat of an advantage when it comes to such things.$b$b<Coridormi smiles.>$b$bFor reasons unknown to me, my master seeks audience with you.$b$bI would counsel you not to take this invitation lightly, $n. Anachronos seldom has cause to interact with mortals. Wisdom would dictate that you seek him out in the Caverns of Time at once.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready and I shall personally deliver you.

identity.title: Ridin' the Rocketway
identity.objectives: Head to the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara and board the Redhound Two-Seater prototype at the top of the tower.
identity.description: I heard that the newest members of the Horde, the goblins, built a crazy road in Azshara and it's just for rockets! Can you imagine? Ever since I heard about it, I've wanted to pay a visit. I asked Matron Battlewail about it and she said it's called the Rocketway!$B$BShe even told me they're working on a prototype rocket with two seats. D'you wanna go there and see if we can try it out? I bet the experimental rocket is near the Secret Lab at the south end of the Rocketway...

AreaDescription.text: 带领你的孤儿去乘坐火箭车
AreaDescription.english: Take Your Orphan to Ride the Rocketway

identity.title: Call the Flock
identity.objectives: Use your Call the Flock ability to gather 12 Alpine Songbirds, 5 Forest Owls, and 2 Goldwing Hawks.
identity.description: Today, we have an opportunity to make another assault against one of Ragnaros' greater minions: Millagazor. However, we first need to get some assistance.$b$b<Matoclaw holds up a large, silky feather.>$b$bUse this artifact to invoke the power of Aviana. Once you have done so, travel northwest and gather some of her flock by calling out to them.$b$bOnce you have done so, we may proceed against Millagazor.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 我们已经准备好对米拉盖佐尔发动进攻了。
PortraitTurnInText.english: We are ready to take on Millagazor.

identity.title: Wings Aflame
identity.objectives: Use the Quill of the Bird-Queen to summon and defeat Millagazor.
identity.description: <Matoclaw's voice continues to echo within your head.>$b$bMillagazor is a creature of flame, but in many ways, he is not unlike the birds of this land. As such, Aviana's artifacts may still have the power to summon him.$b$bThe fiery portal to the west is where you will find him. Use the quill near the portal's entrance, then prepare for a fierce battle.

PortraitGiverText.text: 把他从传送门里拉出来，然后消灭他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Pull him out of that portal, and destroy him!

identity.title: The Zandalar Representative
identity.objectives: Meet Bwemba at Stormwind Harbor.
identity.description: $C!  Heed my call.  Stranglethorn Vale has need of your assistance! Long ago you helped da Zandalar out before.  We not be forgetting your deeds.  It be because of your past help dat we come to you for help.  Come to me at the harbor.

PortraitGiverText.text: 赞达拉代表
PortraitGiverText.english: Zandalar Representative

identity.title: Those Bears Up There
identity.objectives: Climb up trees in the Whistling Grove, grab stranded Hyjal Bear Cubs, and then hurl them at the Soft Target from the top of the tree. This is perfectly safe.
identity.description: Oh, raspberries! Just when we had saved the last bear cub from the treetops, the fires returned and scared them again!$b$bI don't know if you know this, but baby bears are precious and soft.$B$BGo to the Whistling Grove, far to the northwest. Climb the trees, grab the bear cubs, and chuck them - gently! - to the soft target in the center of the grove.$B$B<Without warning, Mylune suddenly smashes you against her bosom and begins sobbing.>$B$BLil' b-b-b-baby bears! Save them, $n!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Oh, yay!

identity.title: Nature's Blessing
identity.objectives: Use the Emerald of Aessina to summon and kill Pyrachnis.
identity.description: <Mylune's voice rings in your head, like the sound of birds chirping.>$B$BI love all creatures of the forest, even spiders, despite the fact that they are icky. But the spiders from the Firelands are worse than icky. They're burny, and don't belong here.$B$BFind the fire portal in the western Regrowth, and use the gem I gave you earlier to force it open. When a fire spider emerges, step on it! Unless it's big. Then, do something $cy to it.$B$BOh, and use the gem if spider venom makes you woozy!

PortraitGiverText.text: 使用翡翠来清毒！
PortraitGiverText.english: Use the Emerald to remove its poison!

identity.title: Perfecting Your Howl
identity.objectives: Use the Fang of the Wolf atop the corpses of 10 Firelands invaders within the Regrowth.
identity.description: The wolf ancient, Lo'gosh - or, if you prefer, Goldrinn - has many weapons available to him, but always the most underestimated is his howl. Today, we will use this weapon to summon and defeat Lylagar, one of the lieutenants of flame that lurk within the Firelands.$b$bDefeat any of the creatures of flame within the Regrowth, and then use the Fang of the Wolf while standing atop their corpse. Soon, your howl will echo across all of Kalimdor.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Your howl is inspired, friend.

identity.title: The Call of the Pack
identity.objectives: Use the Fang of the Wolf to summon and defeat Lylagar.
identity.description: <Matoclaw continues:>$b$bThe easternmost portal of flame is the domain of Lylagar. Stand before the portal, deliver a challenging howl, and then force the fiery beast to submit.

PortraitGiverText.text: 该是遛狗的时候了……然后干掉它。
PortraitGiverText.english: Time to take the dog out for a walk... and then KILL IT.

identity.title: The Banshee Queen
identity.objectives: Take your orphan to meet Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity. Call for your orphan if he is not present when you arrive.
identity.description: Lady Sylvanas is s'posed to be one of the best warriors in the Horde, maybe that's why she is warchief!$B$BI've always wanted to meet her, $n. Maybe an adventurer like you could get an audience with her! Would you take me to the Royal Quarter of the Undercity to meet Lady Sylvanas? It's a long way away and I bet the guards would never let me in by myself!

AreaDescription.text: 与希尔瓦娜斯·风行者女王见面

identity.title: Secondary Targets
identity.objectives: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub.
identity.description: The Gurubashi trolls have gathered their most powerful allies to rebuild Zul'Gurub and re-take Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BChief among them are two monstrous trolls: Kaulema the Mover and Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.$B$BThough they are not the leaders of Zul'Gurub, defeating these powerful minions will aid us greatly preventing the rise of the Gurubashi.

PortraitGiverText.text: 金度拥有强大的盟军。
PortraitGiverText.english: Jin'Do has powerful allies.

identity.title: The Beasts Within
identity.objectives: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub.
identity.description: <Maywiki shuffles nervously.>$B$BAfter the fall of Hakkar, the city of the Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and the jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own.  Several powerful beasts now reside in the cracks and hollows of the ancient city.$B$BWe have seen the powers that the Gurubashi priests wield - they turn the very plantlife against us with their venomous concoctions.  Please, heroes, dispose of these beasts, before they become mindless agents of Jin'Do and his minions!

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们不能让古拉巴什控制它们！
PortraitGiverText.english: We can't let the Gurubashi control them!

identity.title: The Beasts Within
identity.objectives: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: <Bloodslayer T'ara eyes you for a moment.>$B$BAfter de fall of Hakkar, de city of de Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and de jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own. Some powerful beasts now be livin' in da cracks an' hollows of de ancient city. $B$BWe seen de powers dem Gurubashi priests wield - dey turn de very plantlife against us wit' venomous concoctions. You tink you be strong? Dispose of dese beasts, before dey become mindless agents of Jin'do.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们不能让古拉巴什控制它们！
PortraitGiverText.english: We can't let the Gurubashi control them!

identity.title: Secondary Targets
identity.objectives: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: Da Gurubashi trolls gathered dere most powerful allies ta rebuild Zul'Gurub an' re-take Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BChief among dem be two monstrous trolls: Kaulema da Mover an' Mor'Lek da Dismantler, an' a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.$B$BDey don't be leaders of da Gurubashi, but killing dem powerful minions gonna help us prevent da rise of da Gurubashi.

PortraitGiverText.text: 金度拥有强大的盟军。
PortraitGiverText.english: Jin'do has powerful allies.

identity.title: Break Their Spirits
identity.objectives: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub.
identity.description: A city like Zul'Gurub is similar to one of the many towering trees you see nearby.$B$BThe trunk may be thick, and the canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from the roots far below, the tree will wither and fall.$B$BJin'Do's army is fed largely by the actions of two minor Gurubashi trolls.  Sever these roots, and the city will fall all the easier.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你必须破坏他们的供给线！
PortraitGiverText.english: You must disrupt their supply lines!

identity.title: Break Their Spirits
identity.objectives: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: A city like Zul'Gurub be similar ta one of de many towering trees you see nearby.$B$BDe trunk may be thick, and de canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from de roots far below, de tree gonna wither and fall.$B$BJin'do's army be fed largely by de actions of a couple a' minor Gurubashi trolls.  Sever dem roots, and de city gonna fall.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你必须破坏他们的供给线！
PortraitGiverText.english: You must disrupt their supply lines!

identity.title: The Fallen Chieftain
identity.objectives: Take your orphan to Red Rocks to visit the funeral pyre of Cairne Bloodhoof. Call for your orphan if he is not present when you arrive.
identity.description: Matron Battlewail says that when Cairne Bloodhoof died, the Horde lost a 'voice of wisdom'. I don't know what that means, but I always wanted to meet him. Some of the other orphans even have his hoofprint.$B$BWould you take me with you to Mulgore? Our tutor says tauren bring their dead to a place called Red Rocks to honor them. We should go there and see if we can find Cairne.

AreaDescription.text: 带领你的孤儿去访问赤色石
AreaDescription.english: Take Your Orphan to Visit Red Rocks

Title.text: 日常第二级，英雄（第一次）

identity.title: The Hex Lord's Fetish
identity.objectives: Obtain the Hex Lord's Fetish from Hex Lord Malacrass in Zul'Aman.
identity.description: Dis new warlord of da Amani, he be nothin' but an overgrown brute without da protection of a strong witch doctor and he has just dat.$B$BDa new warlord's ally be Hex Lord Malacrass, da most feared witch doctor to walk among da Amani in decades. Without da hex lord's say-so, Daakara won't be submitting his people to da control of da Zandalari.$B$BDefeat Hex Lord Malacrass, bring me his favorite fetish, and I be seein' that ya get a fittin' reward.

identity.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
identity.objectives: Purchase a Dragon Kite Two-Pack from Blax Bottlerocket in Orgrimmar's Drag then use it to fly kites with your Orcish Orphan. If your orphan is not present, call for him.
identity.description: The other day, when some of us were out with the matron, I saw a goblin pushing a cart filled with toys. He had dolls, copper racers, leather balls, and some kites. I've always wanted to get a dragon kite and the matron said that if I saved all my money I could buy one, but that's going to be a long time.$B$BI think the goblin's name was Blax Bottlerocket or something. If we can find him, could we get some kites and fly them together? I saw him pushing his cart around the Drag.

AreaDescription.text: 和你的孤儿一同放起风筝龙
AreaDescription.english: Fly Dragon Kites with your orphan

identity.title: You Scream, I Scream...
identity.objectives: Purchase ice cream at Cone of Cold and then share it with your orphan.
identity.description: There's a brand new ice cream shop in Orgrimmar, and it's not just any old ice cream either. This ice cream is made by a crazy goblin mage! You don't think it's going to disappear if I don't finish it in fifteen minutes, do you?$B$BI bet it tastes really good. Let's go try it!$B$BI heard some of the other kids talking about it, and they were saying the store is called the Cone of Cold and it's in the southern part of the Goblin Slums.

AreaDescription.text: 带你的孤儿去吃冰激凌。
AreaDescription.english: Take your orphan out for ice cream.

identity.title: To Bambala
identity.objectives: Head to Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn Vale to find the Darkspear emissary.
identity.description: Da first place we check gonna be da place most likely to be attacked first, Bambala.$b$bBambala be dangerously close to da troll city Zul'Gurub... It make for an easy target.$b$bMaybe we find da emissary dere.  Hopefully it ain't too late.

AreaDescription.text: 前往北荆棘谷的邦巴拉。
AreaDescription.english: Head to Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: Nesingwary Will Know
identity.objectives: Warn the hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
identity.description: So da Gurubashi be on da rampage an' dey usin' serpents to lead da charge.$b$bYou know who be good at keepin' da animal population in check?  Da hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition.$b$bHead over dere and see how dey doin'.  See if dey know a good way to get rid of da serpents.$b$bIf dey don't know, den you gotta at least warn dem dat dese serpents, it ain't all natural.

AreaDescription.text: 前往奈辛瓦里远征队营地。

identity.title: The Hunter's Revenge
identity.objectives: Give Grent Direhammer the closure he needs by killing Mauti.
identity.description: The beast that's been hunting us... I've been hunting it.$b$bWe call him Mauti.  He's a clever one.  But he made a grave mistake when he killed my brother.  Now that mistake is going to cost him.  Ol' Direhammer has got his scent.$b$bI've noticed him roaming just above Kurzen's Compound.  If we act fast, we can take him down.$b$bAre you ready, $n?

AreaDescription.text: 带领格伦特·恐锤到玛乌提的尸体旁
AreaDescription.english: Bring Grent Direhammer to the body of Mauti

identity.title: Defend Grom'gol
identity.objectives: Help defend Grom'gol Base Camp for three minutes.
identity.description: I hope you like to fight, $n.  Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that the Gurubashi were on the rampage.  I never thought the battle would be this glorious though.$b$bCome, join in our fight and let's show these Gurubashi trolls the might of the Horde!

identity.title: Break the Godbreaker
identity.objectives: Kill Jin'do the Godbreaker inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: <Bloodslayer Zala points at the temple in the distance.>$B$BWhen Jin'do was last ripped from dis world, he survived as a shade, weak and broken, in da spirit world.$B$BBut Jin'do always had power over da spirits.  One by one, he broke dem to his will, and wit' each soul devoured, Jin'do got closer ta' rippin' a hole through to dis world.$B$BTa be here now...$B$BDa spirits be wit' us, we must end Jin'do.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭他。
PortraitGiverText.english: Break him.

identity.title: Putting a Price on Priceless
identity.objectives: Investigate the Cache of Madness and find the Mysterious Gurubashi Bijou.
identity.description: Listen, friend.  I don't know you, and you don't know me.  But as long as we're both here, there's something Revilgaz wanted me to mention.$B$BMaybe you're taking a stroll through this troll-infested jungle-ocalypse.  Maybe you happen to find a priceless troll artifact or two.  Maybe you bring it back to me and I accidentally leave behind a little present for ya'.$B$BIf you must know, it's for a project.  And no, you can't ask what the project is.

PortraitGiverText.text: 调查疯狂之缘。
PortraitGiverText.english: Investigate the Cache of Madness.

identity.title: At One
identity.objectives: Speak to Kalecgos to agree to his proposition.
identity.description: I was charged with her protection, yet it was she who sacrificed herself for my sake.$b$bI cannot bear to lose her, $n. I must make a solemn request of you.$b$bNever has a mortal borne the essence of a true dragon, but with your permission I would make an exception.$b$bPlease, while there is life in her, will you allow me to bind Tarecgosa to you?

AreaDescription.text: 去考达拉跟卡雷苟斯谈一谈。

Title.text: 德魯伊之樹第三階段追蹤
德魯伊之樹第二階段追蹤
旗幟 - 傳送至瓦許伊爾
旗幟 - 傳送至地深之源
旗幟 - 傳送至火源之界
旗幟 - 傳送至海加爾

identity.title: Thanks, But No Thanks
identity.objectives: If you truly dislike your present, you can exchange it for gold by speaking to a Smokywood Pastures merchant.$b$bAll exchanges are final.
identity.description: A holiday sweater may not be for everyone.$b$bThe receipt says that you can exchange it for gold at any Smokywood Pastures merchant.$b$bAll exchanges are final.

AreaDescription.text: 你可以在烟林牧场商人那里把你的毛衫换成钱。一经兑换，概不负责。
AreaDescription.english: You may exchange your sweater for gold at a Smokywood Pastures merchant.  All exchanges are final.

identity.title: Thanks, But No Thanks
identity.objectives: If you truly dislike your present, you can exchange it for gold by speaking to a Smokywood Pastures merchant.$b$bAll exchanges are final.
identity.description: A holiday sweater may not be for everyone.$b$bThe receipt says that you can exchange it for gold at any Smokywood Pastures merchant.$b$bAll exchanges are final.

AreaDescription.text: 你可以在烟林牧场商人那里把你的毛衫换成钱。一经兑换，概不负责。
AreaDescription.english: You may exchange your sweater for gold at a Smokywood Pastures merchant.  All exchanges are final.

identity.title: Hero's Call: Mount Hyjal!
identity.objectives: Speak to Cenarion Emissary Jademoon to secure transportation to Moonglade.
identity.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.$B$BOur brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!$B$BSpeak with Cenarion Emissary Jademoon in Stormwind Keep to gain entry into Moonglade.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, $g brother:sister;!

identity.title: Missing Heirlooms
identity.objectives: Search the cabin of the Hired Courier's ship in Stormwind Harbor for evidence of what might be delaying him.
identity.description: The last of my belongings were supposed to be arriving from Theramore today. The ship has arrived, but I haven't heard from the courier. The crate he was transporting had items that've been in my family for generations.$B$BWill you go down to Stormwind Harbor and see what's keeping him?

Title.text: 旗幟 - 傳送至奧丹姆

identity.title: The Disciple's Challenge
identity.objectives: Defeat Jaomin Ro.
identity.description: $n, I see great strength and great courage in you, and an unsurpassed purity of soul.$B$BThe hour is young, but I think you may be ready to face a greater challenge.$B$BGo to the bottom of the stairs, and cross the bridge. There, you will find Jaomin Ro, one of our eldest students. Challenge and defeat him in honorable combat, and this first phase of your training will be complete.

identity.title: Missing Heirlooms
identity.objectives: Search the cabin of the Hired Courier's ship at the docks east of Orgrimmar  for evidence of what might be delaying him.
identity.description: I told that courier to take the zeppelin, but no, he had to use the goblin ship! Well, now he's late and my precious family heirlooms are with him.$B$BIf you're willing to help, would you go down to the docks east of Orgrimmar, board the goblin ship and see what's keeping him?

identity.title: Tonk Commander
identity.objectives: Use your Darkmoon Tonk to destroy 30 Tonk Targets in the time allowed.
identity.description: Welcome to our humble little steam tank battle simulator!$b$bFor one token, you can demonstrate your tactical mastery by navigating the course and destroying the targets.

PortraitGiverText.text: 摧毁目标！
PortraitGiverText.english: Destroy these targets!

identity.title: Your Time Has Come
identity.objectives: Speak to Ziradormi in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: <A pleasant image fills your mind's eye as a calm voice echoes through your being.>$b$bYoung $c, be still and hear my words.$b$bI am called to collect you, to deliver you, to one whose eye none can escape.$b$bFind me in Orgrimmar, mortal, for your time has come.

identity.title: Your Time Has Come
identity.objectives: Speak to Coridormi in Stormwind.
identity.description: <A pleasant image fills your mind's eye as a calm voice echoes through your being.>$b$bYoung $c, be still and hear my words.$b$bI am called to collect you, to deliver you, to one whose eye none can escape.$b$bFind me in Stormwind, mortal, for your time has come.

identity.title: War on the Ramparts
identity.objectives: Slay Watchkeeper Gargolmar, Vazruden the Herald and Vazruden's drake, Nazan.  Return Gargolmar's Hand and Nazan's Head to Stone Guard Stok'ton.
identity.description: Watchkeeper Gargolmar and Vazruden the Herald are in charge of defending these ramparts.$B$BIf you take them out, their forces will be in complete disarray.$B$BSlay them both and bring me proof so the invasion can begin!

PortraitGiverText.text: 靠近时要小心点。
PortraitGiverText.english: Approach with caution.

identity.title: War on the Ramparts
identity.objectives: Slay Watchkeeper Gargolmar, Vazruden the Herald and Vazruden's drake, Nazan.  Return Gargolmar's Hand and Nazan's Head to Advance Scout Chadwick.
identity.description: Hellfire Citadel's entire defensive network relies on the ramparts as a sort of early warning system.$B$BYou need to take out Watchkeeper Gargolmar and Vazruden the Herald. Without them, taking the ramparts will be simple.

PortraitGiverText.text: 靠近时要小心点。
PortraitGiverText.english: Approach with caution.

identity.title: Heart of Rage
identity.objectives: Fully investigate the Blood Furnace and then report back to Caza'rez.
identity.description: We know that the fel orcs are growing their forces by infusing orcs with demon blood.$B$BI need you to venture deep inside these unholy halls and find out how that's happening. We can't risk sending an army into this place until we know exactly what we're dealing with.

identity.title: Mind the Gap
identity.objectives: Kill Keli'dan the Breaker and return to Caza'rez.
identity.description: In all of the Blood Furnace, there is one area where our scryers cannot reach despite their efforts.$B$BThis 'gap', as they've been calling it, is fairly large, and must be where Magtheridon is being held captive..$B$BYou must find the source of the interference and dispose of it.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这个地方的深处有着非常强大的力量。
PortraitGiverText.english: Something very powerful lies deep within this place.

identity.title: Heart of Rage
identity.objectives: Fully investigate the Blood Furnace and then report back to Gunny.
identity.description: As it turns out, the eggheads back at Honor Hold can't see much into this place. Bunch of lying lazy mages, is what they are.$B$BEither way, we don't really know exactly what's going on in here. So, you're going in to find out!

identity.title: The Breaker
identity.objectives: Kill Keli'dan the Breaker and return to Gunny.
identity.description: So they've got this big ol' demon stashed away in this place, is what they're telling me. And there's an orc that's in charge of keeping him under wraps.$B$BKilling an orc is killing an orc, am I right? Doesn't matter what he did or what he's doin', orcs are always ripe for the slaughter!

PortraitGiverText.text: 给他点苦头尝尝。
PortraitGiverText.english: Make him suffer.

identity.title: Take Care of It
identity.objectives: Resolve the dispute any way you see fit.
identity.description: This looks bad... you'd better do something.

identity.title: The King's Command
identity.objectives: Find Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in the war room at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
identity.description: Greetings, $c.$B$BI have been asked to assemble a team for a high priority mission.$B$BPlease come to Stormwind Keep immediately for a briefing with King Varian Wrynn. I will be waiting in the King's war room.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这项任务非常紧急……而且要求严格保密。
PortraitGiverText.english: This is a matter of utmost urgency...and secrecy.

identity.title: The Heart of the Matter
identity.objectives: Bring The Invader's Claw and The Slave Master's Eye to Watcher Jhang.
identity.description: From what Nahuud has told me, two mighty creatures, Rokmar the Crackler and Quagmirran, were among the first enslaved by the naga when they arrived. They helped to subjugate many of the native races of Zangarmarsh.$B$BThough it pains me greatly to ask you to do so, you must put them down.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他已经没救了。
PortraitGiverText.english: He cannot be saved.

identity.title: Stalk the Stalker
identity.objectives: Bring the Brain of the Black Stalker to T'shu.
identity.description: The spore giants may be attacking my people today, but the marsh walkers have taken more innocent lives than any creature I've ever seen. They are our ancient enemies.$B$BTheir brood mother, the Black Stalker, resides deep within this bog. If you were to destroy her and bring me her brain as proof, I would tell tales of your bravery to my grandchildren.

PortraitGiverText.text: 比起她种群中的其他同类，她要强悍许多。
PortraitGiverText.english: Far more powerful than any other member of her brood.

identity.title: Undercutting the Competition
identity.objectives: Bring Shaffar's Wrappings to Artificer Morphalius.
identity.description: With his ward in place and his forces ready, Nexus-Prince Shaffar has been able to pillage this place for all it's worth without so much as an ounce of trouble.$B$BUnsurprisingly, Nexus-Prince Haramad isn't pleased by this, and has placed a hefty bounty on Shaffar's head.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他骁勇善战，补给充足，戒备森严，请小心行事。
PortraitGiverText.english: He is powerful, resourceful, and heavily guarded. Beware.

identity.title: Unbound
identity.objectives: Set 10 Captured Nectarbreeze Farmers free in Camp Gormal.
identity.description: Can you see them, $p? Farmers from the orchard, tied up and under inspection. Being hauled off in chains.$B$BThe mogu value strength above all else. Anyone deemed fit for work will be sent to toil under their cruel whips.$B$BAs for the others, well...$B$BLet's not waste any more time.

Description.text: 你能看见他们吗，$p？果农们都被绑起来了，并受到了严密监视。他们用锁链将果农们拉走。$B$B魔古最为看重力量。凡是还能干活的人都将沦为苦力，饱受鞭挞的折磨。$B$B至于其他人……$B$B别再浪费时间了，赶紧行动吧。
Description.english: Can you see them, $p? Farmers from the orchard, tied up and under inspection. Being hauled off in chains.$B$BThe mogu value strength above all else. Anyone deemed fit for work will be sent to toil under their cruel whips.$B$BAs for the others, well...$B$BLet's not waste any more time.

Title.text: 施法者傳說麵包屑追蹤器

identity.title: The End of the Exarch
identity.objectives: Kill Exarch Maladaar and return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.
identity.description: Exarch Maladaar performs his unholy work in the deepest part of the crypts. He poses a threat to both of our worlds if he is not stopped.$B$BYou must slay him for the benefit of us all, dead and alive.

PortraitGiverText.text: 是时候让他付出代价了。
PortraitGiverText.english: It is time for him to pay.

identity.title: Taretha's Diversion
identity.objectives: Travel to Durnholde Keep and set 5 incendiary charges at the barrels located inside each of the internment lodges using the Pack of Incendiary Bombs given to you by Erozion.$B$BSpeak to Thrall in the basement prison of Durnholde Keep when you have the Internment Lodges Set Ablaze.
identity.description: It was Taretha who created the original diversion at Durnholde, allowing Thrall to escape.$B$BNow the Infinite have captured Taretha. The diversion will not happen without our involvement. You must use the incendiary devices that I give you and burn down the internment lodges.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他需要你们的帮助！
PortraitGiverText.english: He needs your help!

identity.title: Tracking Event: Saw East Temple Arrival Cinematic

Title.english: Tracking Event: Saw East Temple Arrival Cinematic

identity.title: Terokk's Legacy
identity.objectives: Bring Terokk's Mask and Terokk's Quill to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls.
identity.description: Terokk, hero of the Arakkoa, mysteriously vanished one day, leaving only his mask and spear behind.$B$BDarkweaver Syth still holds his mask and Talon King Ikiss guards his spear.$B$BIt would mean a great deal to my people if these items were returned to us.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他肯定收藏着泰罗克的羽毛。
PortraitGiverText.english: He surely holds Terokk's Quill.

Title.text: 追踪事件：玩家首次到达

identity.title: The Art of War
identity.objectives: Speak to General Nazgrim in Grommash Hold.
identity.description: Lok'tar ogar, $r. I am Nazgrim.$b$bYou are hereby ordered to present yourself at Grommash Hold immediately.$b$bAll in service to the Horde are to swear an oath of allegiance to their new Warchief.$b$bDo not keep him waiting, $r.

identity.title: The Art of War
identity.objectives: Speak to General Nazgrim in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: Lok'tar Ogar, old friend. It has been too long since last we spoke.$b$bIt is good to see that you emerged safely from the depths of Vashj'ir.$b$bI am stationed here in Grommash Hold.$b$bAll in service to the Horde are to swear allegiance to their new Warchief.$b$bYou would do well not to keep him waiting, $n.

identity.title: A Proper Fate
identity.objectives: Kill Warlord Kalithresh and return to Watcher Jhang inside the Steamvault.
identity.description: Warlord Kalithresh is in charge of the entire Steamvault operation.$B$BI need you to kill him, $n. The naga have left us with no option but violence.$B$BShow him no mercy.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们必须阻止他。
PortraitGiverText.english: He must be stopped!

identity.title: Zhi-Zhi, the Dextrous
identity.objectives: Defeat Zhi-Zhi at the Tian Monastery.
identity.description: Upon the hills to my right, you will find a hozen named Zhi-Zhi. He, too, won enough sparring matches to move up the ranks. I think he will provide you with more of a challenge.$b$bChallenge him, and try to defeat him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 快拳如风，脑袋空空。
PortraitGiverText.english: Fights with blinding speed and a less-than-blinding intellect.

identity.title: Husshun, the Wizened
identity.objectives: Challenge and defeat Husshun at the Tian Monastery.
identity.description: The jinyu are long-standing allies of the pandaren, and we welcome any of their kind into our monastery. Husshun, one of their elder shaman, is one of our newest trainees.$b$bHis skills as a monk are mediocre at best, but he is still a fierce combatant. He should provide you with the challenge that you deserve.

PortraitGiverText.text: 毫无悬念，你肯定会在有水的地方找到他。
PortraitGiverText.english: Not surprisingly, you can find him by the water.

identity.title: Xiao, the Eater
identity.objectives: Challenge and defeat Xiao at the Tian Monastery.
identity.description: You may have already met my best student, Xiao, at the banquet tables. I personally would have graduated him several times over, but Instructor Xann insists that he needs more discipline.$b$bIf you ask me, discipline means very little if you win every fight you enter. I'm curious to see if Xiao can keep his streak alive against you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 小心：这家伙有乱扔食物的前科。
PortraitGiverText.english: Caution: has been known to throw his food.

identity.title: The Will of the Warchief
identity.objectives: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description: Kargath was once one of the Horde's greatest heroes.$B$BHe now wears the false mantle of Warchief. Bring me his namesake weapon so that we can remember the champion he once was, rather than the monster he's become.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他已经不再是过去的那个他了。
PortraitGiverText.english: His will is no longer his own.

identity.title: Turning the Tide
identity.objectives: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description: There is only one true way to end the fel orc threat to Honor Hold and the Alliance.$B$BTheir Warchief must be slain.$B$BBring me his namesake weapon, so that we can always remember his death.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭他是这场战争的主要目的。
PortraitGiverText.english: Eliminating him is a key goal in this war.

identity.title: With Great Power, Comes Great Responsibility
identity.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Mechano-Lord Capacitus in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: <A voice like the sound of light bells rings in your head.>$B$BThe Mechanar employs my race's technology to create manacells, objects which provide great amounts of power.$B$BI need you to eliminate Mechano-Lord Capacitus so that Kael'thas' forces cannot harvest that power.

PortraitGiverText.text: 不要害怕。
PortraitGiverText.english: Do not be alarmed.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Our work here is not yet complete.

identity.title: The Calculator
identity.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Pathaleon the Calculator in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: <A gentle wind caresses your face.>$B$BOne more task yet remains.$B$BPathaleon the Calculator oversees many of his master's operations. He is personally responsible for much of the recent torment that has plagued this world.$B$BI ask that you eliminate him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你必须践行我的意志。
PortraitGiverText.english: You must enact my will.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Hope yet remains.

identity.title: Lost Treasure
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Blinding Fury for A'dal from the Cache of the Legion in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: I sense that one of my kind's artifacts has been taken and stashed away in the Cache of the Legion.$B$BWe cannot give them time to discover its power. If you would kill the Gatewatchers and retrieve it for me, I would be most grateful.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们不能让它落入歹徒的手中！
PortraitGiverText.english: We cannot let it fall into the wrong hands.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Your efforts are appreciated.

identity.title: Saving the Botanica
identity.objectives: A'dal wants you to kill Commander Sarannis, High Botanist Freywinn, and Thorngrin the Tender inside the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: Kael'thas' forces in the Botanica were unsuccessful in handling the numerous creatures contained within. We must take action to right their wrongs.$B$BThe first step is to eliminate their forces so that they cannot cause further problems.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你能帮助我吗？
PortraitGiverText.english: Will you help me?

PortraitTurnInText.text: 现在，我们得收拾这场试验了。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Now, we must deal with the experiments.

identity.title: Culling the Herd
identity.objectives: A'dal has asked you to kill 6 Mutate Fleshlashers, 6 Mutate Fear-shriekers, 6 Mutate Horrors, and to obtain a Rapidly Evolving Frond from Laj in the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: It seems that Kael'thas' forces have twisted the Botanica's specimens beyond saving. I do not want to see them unleashed upon Outland as so many others have.$B$BThere is one, Laj, who I would like to examine. He is different somehow. Perhaps we can learn from him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们别无选择。
PortraitGiverText.english: We have no other choice.

PortraitTurnInText.english: This is all deeply concerning.

identity.title: A Most Somber Task
identity.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Warp Splinter in the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: I must now ask you to complete a most somber task.$B$BWarp Splinter used to act as guardian to all of the Botanica. He is now impure, and must be taken down.

PortraitGiverText.text: 真不愿看到这样的局面。
PortraitGiverText.english: I truly wish it had not come to this.

PortraitTurnInText.english: His spirit will move on.

identity.title: Maul Gormal
identity.objectives: Kill Subjugator Gormal in Camp Gormal.
identity.description: Thanks to you, there's a small militia of farmers hiding nearby. Hanae said something about giving them "liquid courage" which, I'm pretty sure, means they're sauced and ANGRY.$B$BThe mogu think they can walk all over us - we'll give them a fight that will open their eyes.$B$BFollow the trail through the ruins and down to the beach. Find their leader. When you engage him, we'll be there to back you up.

PortraitGiverText.text: 如果不阻止他，他会把所有的熊猫人都囚禁起来。
PortraitGiverText.english: He would see every last pandaren in chains if he is not stopped.

identity.title: The Opening of the Dark Portal
identity.objectives: Sa'at inside the Black Morass of the Caverns of Time has tasked you with defending Medivh until he succeeds in opening the Dark Portal.$B$BReturn to Sa'at should you succeed in your task.
identity.description: Here the Guardian Medivh feverishly works to open the Dark Portal.$B$BScattered across the morass, rifts will materialize. Infinite will pour out of the rifts and attempt to destroy Medivh's shields and, ultimately, Medivh.$B$BKill their rift lords and leaders until Medivh succeeds!

PortraitGiverText.text: 一定要让他顺利完成任务！
PortraitGiverText.english: He must succeed in his mission!

identity.title: Unbound Darkness
identity.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Zereketh the Unbound in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: <The sound of chimes enters your head, but it is distressed.>$B$BWe imprisoned the most dangerous beings we came across in our travels.$B$BZereketh is a powerful void lord. If he escapes into Netherstorm, he will feed off of the abundant void energy.

PortraitGiverText.text: 不能放走任何一个囚徒。
PortraitGiverText.english: None of the prisoners may be allowed to escape.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 糟糕的是，还有很多危险的囚徒已经逃跑了。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Unfortunately, yet more dangerous inmates have escaped.

identity.title: Hey There Dalliah
identity.objectives: A'dal has asked you to kill Wrath-Scryer Soccothrates and Dalliah the Doomsayer in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: Two powerful agents of the Burning Legion, Wrath-Scryer Soccothrates and Dalliah the Doomsayer, have begun rallying the demons on board together into a small army.$B$BYou cannot let their forces grow any larger, or the Arcatraz may soon become yet another Legion stronghold.

PortraitGiverText.text: 必须竭尽所能阻止燃烧军团。
PortraitGiverText.english: We must do all we can to stop the Legion.

PortraitTurnInText.english: The Light will prevail.

identity.title: Shu, the Spirit of Water
identity.objectives: Coax Shu, the spirit of water, into a game.
identity.description: Shu, the spirit of water, is sulking in the deep pool to the north. Cross the rocks and then drop the sun pearl in the center of the pool. He will know what this means.

identity.title: A New Friend
identity.objectives: Water walk into 5 of Shu's Water Spouts.
identity.description: He wants you to play with him. Go for it!

identity.title: Maximum Security Breakout
identity.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Harbinger Skyriss in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
identity.description: Harbinger Skyriss is the heart of the problem in the Arcatraz.$B$BHe corrupted Warden Mellichar and made him release many of the prisoners. It is only a matter of time before the Harbinger himself is let loose.$B$B$n, you cannot let a servant of the Old Gods live!

PortraitGiverText.text: 当心，他太强大了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Be careful, he is very powerful.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Their capabilities are most unsettling.

identity.title: Magisters' Terrace
identity.objectives: Captain Theris Dawnhearth wants you to find Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
identity.description: We recently sent in an expeditionary force to the Magisters' Terrace to stop the Legion forces there.$B$BHowever, we haven't heard from them since, and I fear the worst.$B$BWill you go there and try to find Exarch Larethor? He's in charge of the expedition.

identity.title: Severed Communications
identity.objectives: Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace wants you to find Tyrith, a blood elf spy.
identity.description: We've had a contact embedded in Magisters' Terrace gathering intelligence for us for some time now, but we've lost contact with him.$b$bThe information he was collecting is vital to our mission.

identity.title: Hard to Kill
identity.objectives: Kalecgos has asked you to defeat Kael'thas in Magisters' Terrace. You are to take Kael's head and report back to Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
identity.description: As you've now witnessed, the Legion forces work tirelessly, manipulating the Sunwell's power to achieve their malevolent ends.$b$bKael'thas has risen from the ashes of defeat and once more leads them in their efforts. He must be stopped.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这是最后的时刻。
PortraitGiverText.english: This is his final hour.

Title.text: 追踪事件：找到联盟旗帜
追踪事件：找到联盟宝箱

identity.title: The Jade Witch
identity.objectives: Defeat the Jade Witch.
identity.description: The Jade Witch must still have Shin.$b$bI... I can't do it! I don't want to see the witch. Can you please go talk to her and see if she has Shin?$b$bYou're an adult, I don't think she would try to turn you into jade.

PortraitGiverText.text: 她之所以被叫做“青玉巫婆”，是因为她院子里那些活灵活现的青玉雕像。
PortraitGiverText.english: Known to locals as "The Jade Witch" due to the lifelike jade statues she keeps in her yard.

identity.title: Monstrosity
identity.objectives: Collect sketches of each piece of the ancient statue.
identity.description: It's plain to see that this statue and the surrounding ruins are of ancient origin. Clearly, this land has a deep history, which means it could not have been born of the cataclysm.$b$bAnd yet these waters have been explored for ages now, with no record of anything here but open sea.$b$bPerhaps if you were to sketch the pieces of this broken statue, you might shed light on the continent's origins.

identity.title: An Urgent Plea
identity.objectives: Recover the Staff of Pei-Zhi and interrupt the mogu ritual in the center of the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
identity.description: <Your mind is racked with a howl. Beneath it, a wispy voice is barely audible, as if from far away.>$B$BPlease... help... heart of the ruins... a ritual... conjuring...$B$B...should not be here...$B$BMy staff... on the altar... take it. Please hurry.

PortraitGiverText.text: 去祭坛取回我的法杖，并用古代灵魂来为其充能！
PortraitGiverText.english: Take my staff from the altar and charge it with Ancient Spirits!

identity.title: Kung Din
identity.objectives: Obtain the Slingtail Key by slaying Kung Din.
identity.description: I hope you are capable of this next task, for our lives depend on it.$B$BThere is only one key that will unlock our chains. Unfortunately, the key hangs around the neck of the hozen's pet tiger, Kung Din.$B$BThey keep the tiger in the great pit to the north. The only way to retrieve the key will be to kill the beast.

PortraitGiverText.text: 那只巨兽看管着钥匙。
PortraitGiverText.english: The great beast holds the key.

identity.title: Stealing Their Thunder
identity.objectives: Defender Mordun has asked you to acquire the head of Ingvar the Plunderer.
identity.description: The vrykul are fearless in a fight. Seems they actually yearn fer a death in battle. With their numbers and that ferocity, we're doomed - plain and simple.$b$bThere's one they esteem though, goes by the name of Ingvar. Bring him down and you'll deal a mighty blow to their spirit.

PortraitGiverText.text: 乌特加德城堡的领主。
PortraitGiverText.english: Lord of Utgarde Keep.

identity.title: Do No Evil
identity.objectives: Kill Ruk-ruk, the Fe-Feng Chief.
identity.description: $n, I need you to understand that the way of the Huojin is not the way of violence. When fighting is needed, we will not hesitate, but when fighting is not needed, neither do we instigate. However, the direct solution is often cutting the head off the snake, as they say.$B$BThe hozen have a leader instigating these attacks. If we remove Ruk-Ruk, we won't have to wipe the hozen out entirely.$B$BI know you are not of the Huojin, but are you with me in what must be done, $n?

identity.title: An Ancient Evil
identity.objectives: Defeat the Vordraka, the Deep Sea Nightmare.
identity.description: $n, I was looking for you!$B$BOne of the escaping sailors just spotted Aysa in the wreckage of the ship, facing some enormous beast. She might need your help - you should go to her, quickly!

identity.title: Seein' Red
identity.objectives: Kill Konk.
identity.description: I was just about ta curl up an' die, mon.$b$bNow, dis!$b$bSnuff an' me go way back. Oh, da memories...$b$bNo way I can face Snuff in da afterlife without avengin' his death first, mon!$b$bDese hooligans be led by one named Konk. We gotta sniff him out an' den snuff him out - for Snuff!

identity.title: Tracking Event: Found Mishka at Plane

Title.text: 追踪事件：在飞机上寻找米希卡
Title.english: Tracking Event: Found Mishka at Plane

identity.title: Death to the Traitor King
identity.objectives: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub has tasked you with defeating Anub'arak. You are to return to A'zak with Anub'arak's Broken Husk.
identity.description: Anub'arak, the traitor king, makes his home in the once proud Kingdom of Azjol-Nerub.$b$bHe has twisted and perverted our homeland into the wretched squalor it is today. He rules over an army of undead nerubians who have pledged themselves to serving the Lich King.$b$bBring an end to his reign.

PortraitGiverText.text: 背叛者的国王
PortraitGiverText.english: The Traitor King

identity.title: Efficient Excavations
identity.objectives: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
identity.description: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to most efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in massive excavation projects.$b$bAfter a quick skim of the material, it becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here.$b$bA map on the back cover indicates that the author has a bunker in the southwest region of Uldum.$b$bPerhaps an introduction is in order.

PortraitGiverText.text: 据你推断，封面上那位自命不凡的大人物就是本书的作者。
PortraitGiverText.english: You can only assume that the picture on the cover is of the self-absorbed author.

identity.title: Pupil No More
identity.objectives: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet has tasked you with the assassination of Elder Nadox.
identity.description: I once called Elder Nadox my teacher.$B$BThat changed forever when I was forced to watch him mercilessly slaughter my friends and family as a servant of the damned.$B$BFind him within the depths and make him pay for his crimes, $r.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Well done.

identity.title: Reclaiming Ahn'Kahet
identity.objectives: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet wants you to kill 3 Eyes of Taldaram, a Bonegrinder, and Prince Taldaram.
identity.description: Prince Taldaram and his army of Scourge use the same wards we once used to hide our empire to keep themselves safe from the native denizens of the icy depths.$B$BDeactivate the wards and slaughter the Scourge guarding them. My forces will help the natives slaughter the rest.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们决不能失败。
PortraitGiverText.english: Failure will not be tolerated.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 我需要再请你帮我一个忙。
PortraitTurnInText.english: I must ask one more favor of you.

identity.title: Gal'darah Must Pay
identity.objectives: Tol'mar wants you to slay Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah in Gundrak.
identity.description: It musta been da most awful thing I ever seen. Da great Akali - slain right before my eyes. Horrible...$b$bMy job be to observe only. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah and his followers must pay!$b$bAvenge Akali's death, mon. It be da right thing ta do.

PortraitGiverText.text: 叛徒难逃一死！
PortraitGiverText.english: Da traitor deserves death!

identity.title: Gal'darah Must Pay
identity.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini wants you to slay Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah in Gundrak.
identity.description: Da mighty Akali has been slain, $r.$b$bMy role in life be to record, not fight. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah and his followers must pay!$b$bAvenge Akali's death, mon. It be da right thing ta do.

PortraitGiverText.text: 对他不能心慈手软！
PortraitGiverText.english: Show him no mercy!

identity.title: Champion of the Tournament
identity.objectives: Highlord Tirion Fordring has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
identity.description: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King.$B$B$n, fight with valor and honor. Every fighter here has gathered for the common good.$B$BTogether, we will stop Arthas!

PortraitGiverText.text: 我对你有信心。
PortraitGiverText.english: I have faith in you.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你令我对赢得这场战争的信心大增。
PortraitTurnInText.english: You bring me great hope for the success of this campaign.

identity.title: Working at the Source
identity.objectives: Argent Confessor Paletress wants you to slay Svala Sorrowgrave.
identity.description: We are hard at work ensuring that we minimize our losses to the Scourge war machine.$B$BThe vrykul here are undermining that mission by willingly joining the Lich King's ranks.$B$BPlease, brave champion, you must defeat their spiritual leader, Svala, before she leads her people into the eternal shadow!

PortraitGiverText.text: 她令我们的困境雪上加霜。
PortraitGiverText.english: She thrives on our pain.

identity.title: An Ancient Legend
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Song of the Vale from the Den of Sorrow.
identity.description: My father has dedicated his life to studying the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.$B$BThe Vale is a mythical place, sealed after the Pandaren revolution twelve thousand years ago. We know so little about it!$B$BMy father followed a trail of clues to the cave down the hill, seeking a very old poem known as the Song of the Vale, but he is in no condition to retrieve it. It is guarded by some sort of ancestor spirit.$B$BIf you are heading that way anyway, would you mind bringing it back to him?

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑暗之息在此处徘徊。
PortraitGiverText.english: A dark presence lingers here.

identity.title: Carp Diem
identity.objectives: Kill Chief Gukgut.
identity.description: Despite the hozen's apparent disarray, there is an order to their chaos. Their leader, Chief Gukgut, is the shrewd mastermind behind their attacks.$B$BHe is organizing their movements at the great pit at the hozen camp to the northwest.$B$BStrike now and show him no mercy, $n, for he will do the same.

PortraitGiverText.text: 吊尾猢狲的首领。
PortraitGiverText.english: The leader of the Slingtail hozen.

identity.title: Lupello
identity.objectives: Slay Lupello.
identity.description: I've been thinking... the wolves might stop attacking if we kill their pack leader.$b$bWe call him Lupello, and he patrols the opposite riverbank.$b$b<Francis' concentration is broken by another attack. Perhaps you should go deal with Lupello yourself.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 狼群的首领，羊羔吞食者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Leader of wolves, devourer of lambs.

identity.title: Kill Kher Shan
identity.objectives: Kill Kher Shan in Tigers' Wood.
identity.description: Kher Shan is one big dooker.$b$bGrooked all my sons! Ick Ick, Nab Nab, Eet Eet, Bitty Bitty, and the others I can't remember.$b$bWikket wanna help hozen? Go grook Kher Shan!$b$bThe dooker's over there.$b$b<Nibi Nibi points to the east.>

identity.title: The Warren-Mother
identity.objectives: Defeat Chufa, the Twitchheel Warren-Mother.
identity.description: We've dealt with the alpha males. Now, the alpha female.$b$bVirmen aren't terribly selective when it comes to breeding, but most broods will still have a dominant mother figure. She's usually bigger, meaner, and tougher than anyone else in the brood.$b$bYou know, I wouldn't mind testing my skills against a warren-mother. Mind if I fight alongside you?

PortraitGiverText.text: 不是说谁长得好看谁就能成为密径主母的。
PortraitGiverText.english: You don't get to be a Warren-Mother by virtue of good looks.

Title.text: 追踪事件：完成到达阶段

identity.title: Out of Sprite
identity.objectives: Defeat Cornan the Barley Barbarian.
identity.description: Just to be clear, what happened was an accident. What I did, I did for INDUSTRY!$b$bThere was no way I could have known that a sprite invasion would happen at any time, or that one of them would try to eat my new "Pan's Miracle Gro" formula.$b$bNow not only do they have a big sprite leading them, but he's one angry beast.$b$bIf I pay you, will you take him out?

PortraitGiverText.text: 当一个林精染指“潘的离奇增长”时会发生什么事呢。
PortraitGiverText.english: What happens when a forest sprite gets their hands on Pan's Miracle Gro formula.

identity.title: Mothallus!
identity.objectives: Bait and defeat Mothallus.
identity.description: The esteemed Journeyman Chu would appear to have created a monster. It is silken death with wings.$b$bMothallus.$b$bYou have already faced its brood. Now we ask that you help us face the creature itself.$b$bPlease, $c, venture into the pit and rifle the bait. This will bring the beast to you.$b$bOur mothfighters will assist you as you need, though silk tends to stick to them more than most so you may need to help them, should they become overwhelmed.

PortraitGiverText.text: 最巨型的飞蛾。
PortraitGiverText.english: The mightiest of moths.

identity.title: The Shadow of Doubt
identity.objectives: Defeat the Shadow of Doubt.
identity.description: A terrible manifestation of the sha has appeared to the south.$B$BIt is trying to destroy an ancient relic, the Bell of a Thousand Whispers.$B$BThis bell has never been rung in the temple's history, for it is rumored to be an ancient instrument of power.$B$BPlease go and defeat this demon where it stands! We must save this relic!

PortraitGiverText.text: 疑之煞的孽生先锋。
PortraitGiverText.english: A lieutenant of the Sha of Doubt.

identity.title: A Score to Settle
identity.objectives: Dark Ranger Marrah wants you to slay Prince Keleseth inside Utgarde Keep.
identity.description: Utgarde's forces are organizing under the advisory of Prince Keleseth, a san'layn ambassador of the Scourge.$B$BWe cannot allow the vrykul to benefit from his counsel any further. Silence him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 萨莱因的鲜血王子
PortraitGiverText.english: Blood-Prince of the San'layn

identity.title: Blind Them!
identity.objectives: Kill the Darnassian Outrider.
identity.description: These sunwalkers are a tiresome lot. I need soldiers with horde blood in their veins and honor in their hearts. Not some pacifist sun spirit filth.$b$bThe Alliance are here, $p. Followed us no doubt, or somehow tracked the same visions Leza had that led us here. It doesn't matter. I don't want them to know how divided we are at the moment. Go kill their scout south of here before it can report back.$b$bHellscream's eyes upon you.

Description.text: 这些烈日行者太烦人了。我需要的是真正流着部落热血，心怀部落荣耀的士兵，而不是一些崇拜太阳的和平主义渣滓。$b$b联盟也来到了这里，$p。他们可能是跟踪我们过来的，也可能是得到了和莱莎一样的预见。这就不用管了。但我不想让他们知道我们目前的分歧有多么严重。趁他们的斥候还没有回去报告，先去南边杀掉那些探子吧。$b$b地狱咆哮之眼注视着你。
Description.english: These sunwalkers are a tiresome lot. I need soldiers with horde blood in their veins and honor in their hearts. Not some pacifist sun spirit filth.$b$bThe Alliance are here, $p. Followed us no doubt, or somehow tracked the same visions Leza had that led us here. It doesn't matter. I don't want them to know how divided we are at the moment. Go kill their scout south of here before it can report back.$b$bHellscream's eyes upon you.

identity.title: Herbal Remedies
identity.objectives: Find 20 Imperial Lotus Leaves.
identity.description: Kang's remedy isn't working.$b$bThere is something else at work here. A power deep beneath the soil. It is sapping us of hope, hitting us with depression and despair.$b$bKang tells me this land has lotus plants. I might be able to make a tea that would hopefully lend Leza some strength.$b$bPlease, $p, search the ruins south and west of here for lotus leaves. I will pay you for your efforts.

Description.text: 康的药物不管用。$b$b这里有什么别的东西在作祟。这里的泥土深处有一种力量。它在侵蚀我们心中的希望，用沮丧和绝望腐蚀着我们。$b$b康说这里生长着一种莲花。我或许可以用它们做成一种茶，但愿那东西能给莱莎一些力量。$b$b拜托了，$p，请去南边和西边的废墟收集一些莲叶回来。我会报答你的。
Description.english: Kang's remedy isn't working.$b$bThere is something else at work here. A power deep beneath the soil. It is sapping us of hope, hitting us with depression and despair.$b$bKang tells me this land has lotus plants. I might be able to make a tea that would hopefully lend Leza some strength.$b$bPlease, $p, search the ruins south and west of here for lotus leaves. I will pay you for your efforts.

identity.title: Going West
identity.objectives: Find the Sunwalker Scout near the Crane Temple.
identity.description: Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living.$b$bKor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle.$b$bI sent a scout of my own to investigate the crane temple. Please, $p, seek out my scout, get their report, then meet up with Kor and lend what aid you can to him.$b$bWe will join you as quickly as we are able.

Description.text: 莱莎已经客死异乡，我现在必须以活着的人为重。$b$b科尔率领一队斥候深入进西边的丛林。$b$b我也派出了斥候去调查朱鹤寺。拜托了，$p，帮我找到那些斥候，拿到他们的情报，然后跟科尔碰头并尽可能地帮助他。$b$b我们会尽快赶上你们的。
Description.english: Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living.$b$bKor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle.$b$bI sent a scout of my own to investigate the crane temple. Please, $p, seek out my scout, get their report, then meet up with Kor and lend what aid you can to him.$b$bWe will join you as quickly as we are able.

Title.text: 追踪事件：挑选蓝色翔龙
追踪事件：挑选绿色翔龙
追踪事件：挑选金色翔龙

identity.title: Raid Leader Slovan
identity.objectives: Kill Slovan.
identity.description: The raiders are led by a particularly violent saurok known as Slovan. The Crane Temple usually comes to our aid when he attacks but now we find ourselves outmatched and outmaneuvered.$b$bPlease, $c, aid us by destroying this raid leader.$b$bYou can find him in his den behind the Krasari Falls.

PortraitGiverText.text: 瀑歌村的恐惧之源。
PortraitGiverText.english: The terror of the falls.

identity.title: For Family
identity.objectives: Search for Kor Bloodtusk.
identity.description: Kor should have caught up by now. He said he was going to secure the Ruins of Korja east of here and meet us to help with the mantid threat.$b$bHe may need help against Groundbreaker Brojai. Could you assist him? Kang and I will follow shortly.

PortraitGiverText.text: 复国领主
PortraitGiverText.english: The Lord Reclaimer

Title.text: 随机英雄日常 （第一次）（大地的裂变）

identity.title: Mushan Mastery: Darkhide
identity.objectives: Obtain Darkhide's Head.
identity.description: My boy here is a talented hunter... in training. Let's show him an old 'Nessy style hunt shall we?$b$bI saw a mighty big mushan east of here with a hide dark as night. It looked like it had taken down a number of hunters in its day.$b$bIf you want a big game hunt, go try an' take it on.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在当地广为流传的野兽。
PortraitGiverText.english: The beast of local legend.

identity.title: Parental Mastery
identity.objectives: Destroy Torjar's Bane.
identity.description: If them tablets were correct, all ay got ta do is a small dance ritual and the big thing o' the deep will be summoned.$b$bWhen it comes out, we'll get 'em and show me pop we are both true big game hunters like him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 传说中的野兽
PortraitGiverText.english: The Beast of Legend

identity.title: Re-Reclaim
identity.objectives: Recover 10 Mogu Artifacts.
identity.description: Mogu are thugs. They have always been thugs.$b$bOnly when they ruled their empires in the old stories did they ever know any kind of magic.$b$bBut these mogu are using arcane portals and spells. We need to stop them!$b$b$p, look for any artifacts the mogu are using to cast their magics with. I saw a number of their collectors and reclaimers to the west and north that were gathering these items.

Description.text: 魔古族就是群恶棍，他们一直就是群恶棍。只有在传说中的魔古帝国时期，他们才会使用一些魔法。$b$b但这些魔古族竟然会用奥术传送门和法术，我们必须制止他们！$b$b$p，去找出魔古族用来施展魔法的所有神器，我看到很多收集者和复国者在西北边收集这种东西。
Description.english: Mogu are thugs. They have always been thugs.$b$bOnly when they ruled their empires in the old stories did they ever know any kind of magic.$b$bBut these mogu are using arcane portals and spells. We need to stop them!$b$b$p, look for any artifacts the mogu are using to cast their magics with. I saw a number of their collectors and reclaimers to the west and north that were gathering these items.

identity.title: Sha Can Awe
identity.objectives: Kill sha near 10 Hopeless Monks or Acolytes to inspire them.
identity.description: The sha have the mysterious ability to evoke powerful, often overwhelming, emotional responses in their victims.$B$BAs we fled the temple, senior members of the Crane Wing order stayed behind to cover our escape. They are no doubt being subjected to intense emotional trauma, and I fear they are not all strong enough to resist falling into despair.$B$B$p, we have to show them there is still hope! Show them that despair CAN be defeated!

Description.text: 煞魔拥有神秘的力量，他们能使受害者产生强烈的情绪波动，直至崩溃。$B$B当我们从寺院逃离的时候，鹤翼的高手们奉命断后掩护我们。毫无疑问他们会遭受到巨大的精神冲击，而我担心他们还不够坚强，迟早会陷入绝望。$B$B$p，我们必须向他们证明一切还有希望！向他们证明绝望也是可以被打败的！
Description.english: The sha have the mysterious ability to evoke powerful, often overwhelming, emotional responses in their victims.$B$BAs we fled the temple, senior members of the Crane Wing order stayed behind to cover our escape. They are no doubt being subjected to intense emotional trauma, and I fear they are not all strong enough to resist falling into despair.$B$B$p, we have to show them there is still hope! Show them that despair CAN be defeated!

identity.title: In the House of the Red Crane
identity.objectives: Enter the basement of the Temple of the Red Crane and defeat the Sha of Despair.
identity.description: "Broken are the bodies wherein hopeless hearts reside - the blight of despair strikes forth from inside."$B$BThis was the last piece of wisdom the Red Crane imparted to me, just hours before the Sha outbreak.  It makes sense now...$B$B$p, when the Sha attacked, they broke forth from the temple's basement...$B$BAll of his teachings - the very Way of the Crane itself... it's all been preparation for facing the Sha of Despair.$B$BThe Red Crane has been expecting this conflict for centuries!

Description.text: “精钢之躯，溃于灰心——绝望总源于内心。”$B$B这是朱鹤在煞魔爆发前夕，给我上的最后一课。现在看来，这句话说得丝毫不差……$B$B$p，煞魔就是首先从寺院的地窖内发动攻击的……$B$B他的所有教诲，朱鹤之道……都是为了应对惘之煞而存在的。$B$B几个世纪以来，朱鹤一直在蓄势等待此战！
Description.english: "Broken are the bodies wherein hopeless hearts reside - the blight of despair strikes forth from inside."$B$BThis was the last piece of wisdom the Red Crane imparted to me, just hours before the Sha outbreak.  It makes sense now...$B$B$p, when the Sha attacked, they broke forth from the temple's basement...$B$BAll of his teachings - the very Way of the Crane itself... it's all been preparation for facing the Sha of Despair.$B$BThe Red Crane has been expecting this conflict for centuries!

PortraitGiverText.text: 一直徘徊在朱鹤寺的地下室中。
PortraitGiverText.english: Haunting the basement of the Temple of the Red Crane.

identity.title: The Arcanic Oubliette
identity.objectives: Find and disable the 3 Oubliette Shackles.
identity.description: An Alliance member? Here? Elune be praised.$b$bMy team has encountered a snag. We opened a portal to this land using some ancient scrolls we had found that predated Azshara's rule.$b$bUnfortunately, the coordinates provided on the tablets were warded and the portal that meant to take us to our destination landed us in this oubliette.$b$bWe have been trapped here for days, and it is slowly leaching our energies to power itself.$b$bCan you find the nearby shackles that bind the oubliette and disable them?

PortraitGiverText.text: 他的声音在你的脑海里萦绕。
PortraitGiverText.english: His voice echoes in your mind.

Title.text: 杀死指定的魔古杂种首领（对两个首领使用战士任务）

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找莱文·黎明之刃。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Kunzen Legend-Chief
identity.objectives: Obtain a Kunzen Legend-Book from a Kunzen Legend-Chief.
identity.description: I've heard people talk about the hozen like they're just some tribe of barely-functional idiots... but that's not true! They have brains, too - they just don't all like to use them that much.$b$bI've heard that the Kunzen tribe has two chiefs - one in charge of fighting, and one in charge of stories, lore, and history.$b$bWhat I wouldn't give to see what kind of stories they tell...

PortraitGiverText.text: 我其实不知道他的名字是什么——他们的传法酋长经常都会换人。
PortraitGiverText.english: I don't know what his name will be - they regularly elect new legend-chiefs.

identity.title: The Lesser of Two Evils
identity.objectives: Slay the Springtail Warren-Mother.
identity.description: Like any farming community, we have the occasional virmen troubles.$b$bThe most powerful Springtail virmen live high up in the cliffs to the north, and only come down when they run out of veggies to nibble on.$b$bFrankly, I've dealt with virmen before. They're nothing but a pest that must be kept in check, and there's no better way to do that than by killing their warren-mother. Easy as that.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你要明白“刀耕”的真正含义，邻居。
PortraitGiverText.english: Till and kill, neighbor. Till and kill.

identity.title: The Kunzen Hunter-Chief
identity.objectives: Slay the Kunzen Hunter-Chief.
identity.description: From what I've gathered, the Kunzen hozen have two chiefs. One is harmless - he deals with potions, medicines, and ancient fables. The other one is in charge of the Kunzen's hunters - and the only thing they've been hunting lately is our crops.$b$bThe Hunter-Chief is a problem waiting to be solved. I'm sure the local farmers would be grateful if you went up there and, you know, "took care" of him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 昆森狩猎酋长虽然都很勇敢，但通常都会摔下摩天山脊的悬崖。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kunzen Hunter-Chiefs, while brave, will regularly fall off the edge of the Skyrange.

identity.title: To the Waterline!
identity.objectives: Rig powder barrels in the hold of all six ships.
identity.description: This is Sky-Reaver Stormhowl, captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh and commander of this operation.$B$BYour first task is to burn the 7th Fleet to the waterline while it's still at anchor$B$BCaptain Drok's marines will hold the harbor entrance while your team works.$B$BRig powder barrels in the hold of every ship and then regroup at the harbor entrance to inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse, who will trigger the exposives and signal the airship forward.

PortraitGiverText.text: 行动指挥官兼“加尔鲁什之拳”飞艇的船长。
PortraitGiverText.english: Operation commander and captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 行动指挥官兼“加尔鲁什之拳”飞艇的船长。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Operation commander and captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh.

identity.title: Where are the Pools
identity.objectives: Obtain the Dojani Orders.
identity.description: Perhaps these mogu know where the pools are.$b$bOur scouts have reported seeing a commander along the southern side of the Ruins of Dojan.$b$bKill him and take whatever information he is carrying. They should lead you to the pool.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你与牧师之间建立了精神通道。
PortraitGiverText.english: The priest's mind touches yours.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你与牧师之间建立了精神通道。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The priest's mind touches yours.

identity.title: The Pools of Youth
identity.objectives: Obtain some of the Water of Youth.
identity.description: North! Go north to the Pools of Youth. Get some of the water but be on your guard.$b$bThe mogu list this as a "high value" target. Kang Bramblestaff will meet you there if he has not already arrived by your side.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你心中充满了紧迫感。
PortraitGiverText.english: A sense of urgency fills you.

identity.title: Squirmy Delight
identity.objectives: Gather 5 Intact Skitterer Glands.
identity.description: The hidden master may have to wait. Look at these people, $p.$b$BThey are so THIN! They must be starving.$b$BYou know what we need? A big steaming bowl of Squirmy Delight.$b$BIf you find yourself near a river, try rounding up some intact skitterer glands and I'll cook up a batch.

Description.text: 隐秘大师恐怕得等一等了。看看那些人，$p。$b$B瘦得只剩下皮包骨了！他们一定是饿坏了。$b$B知道我们需要什么吗？一大碗热气腾腾的飞掠杂碎汤。$b$B在你经过附近的河流时，请收集一些完整的飞掠者腺体来，我可以用它们做一顿大餐。
Description.english: The hidden master may have to wait. Look at these people, $p.$b$BThey are so THIN! They must be starving.$b$BYou know what we need? A big steaming bowl of Squirmy Delight.$b$BIf you find yourself near a river, try rounding up some intact skitterer glands and I'll cook up a batch.

identity.title: No Sister Left Behind
identity.objectives: Rescue 8 captives of the mogu.
identity.description: We were searching the ruins south of here when the mogu fell upon us out of nowhere.$b$BSome of us were able to retreat to this encampment but many others were captured. The mogu have also caught a number of the Horde who happened to be in the area as well.$b$bPlease, $p, rescue any sentinels that you can.$b$bLeave the Dawnchasers to their fate.

Description.text: 当时我们正在搜索南边的废墟，不知从哪儿突然冒出一群魔古族袭击了我们。$b$B我们中的一部分人好不容易突围撤回了营地，但大部分都被抓了。魔古族还抓了许多碰巧经过那里的部落人。$b$b求求你，$p，尽量多救出一些我们的哨兵。$b$b让那些逐晨者见鬼去吧。
Description.english: We were searching the ruins south of here when the mogu fell upon us out of nowhere.$b$BSome of us were able to retreat to this encampment but many others were captured. The mogu have also caught a number of the Horde who happened to be in the area as well.$b$bPlease, $p, rescue any sentinels that you can.$b$bLeave the Dawnchasers to their fate.

identity.title: Re-Reclaim
identity.objectives: Recover 10 Mogu Artifacts.
identity.description: Mogu do NOT use arcane magics.$b$bThey are thugs. They have always been thugs. Only when they ruled their empires in the old stories did they ever know any kind of magic.$b$bBut these mogu are using arcane portals and old artifacts. We need to stop them!$b$b$p, look for any artifacts the mogu are using to cast their magics with. I saw piles of these items being collected near the Ruins of Korja south of here.
