Description.text: 魔古族是不会使用奥术魔法的。$b$b他们就是群恶棍，他们一直就是群恶棍。只有在传说中的魔古帝国时期，他们才会使用一些魔法。$b$b但这些魔古族竟然会用奥术传送门和古代神器，我们必须制止他们！$b$b$p，去找出魔古族用来施展魔法的所有神器，我看到在南面的科夏废墟附近有很多这样的东西。
Description.english: Mogu do NOT use arcane magics.$b$bThey are thugs. They have always been thugs. Only when they ruled their empires in the old stories did they ever know any kind of magic.$b$bBut these mogu are using arcane portals and old artifacts. We need to stop them!$b$b$p, look for any artifacts the mogu are using to cast their magics with. I saw piles of these items being collected near the Ruins of Korja south of here.

identity.title: The Stoneplow Convoy
identity.objectives: Use Imperial Lotus Poultice on 7 Stoneplow Envoys.
identity.description: Help me, $p. These poor pandaren are in need of healing, and my powers are weakened.$b$bI did find an old tome in my collection that allowed me to convert the herbs you collected earlier into a healing poultice.$b$bUse this on the injured pandaren and it should get them back on their feet.

Description.text: 帮帮我，$p。这些可怜的熊猫人需要治疗，但我的力量已所剩无几。$b$b我在自己的藏书中找到一本古籍，上面记载了如何将你之前采集的草药制成药膏。$b$b把这种药膏涂到受伤的熊猫人身上，应该能让他们重新站起来。
Description.english: Help me, $p. These poor pandaren are in need of healing, and my powers are weakened.$b$bI did find an old tome in my collection that allowed me to convert the herbs you collected earlier into a healing poultice.$b$bUse this on the injured pandaren and it should get them back on their feet.

identity.title: The Lord Reclaimer
identity.objectives: Find Lyalia and kill Groundbreaker Brojai.
identity.description: They have my daughter! Brojai... that Lord Reclaimer! I can see him clearly through Lyalia's eyes.$b$bThat foolish girl must have tried to take him head on.$b$bPlease, $p! Go to the Ruins of Korja and try to free her.$b$bI'll get Kang and try to draw out Brojai from the ruins with a distraction.

Description.text: 他们抓走了我的女儿！勃罗耶……那个复国领主！我能透过丽娅拉的眼睛清楚地看到他的身影。$b$b那个傻姑娘一定是想凭一己之力把他干掉。$b$b拜托了，$p！快去科夏废墟把她救出来。$b$b我会找康一起试着吸引勃罗耶的注意力，把他从废墟里引出来。
Description.english: They have my daughter! Brojai... that Lord Reclaimer! I can see him clearly through Lyalia's eyes.$b$bThat foolish girl must have tried to take him head on.$b$bPlease, $p! Go to the Ruins of Korja and try to free her.$b$bI'll get Kang and try to draw out Brojai from the ruins with a distraction.

PortraitGiverText.text: 复国领主
PortraitGiverText.english: The Lord Reclaimer

identity.title: Hope Springs Eternal
identity.objectives: Speak with Loon Mai in Stoneplow.
identity.description: The Shado-Pan are likely dealing with similar outbreaks elsewhere in Pandaria.$B$BSeek out Loon Mai, the Shado-Pan Watch Commander in Stoneplow on the western end of the Valley of the Four Winds. Let him know that we have the situation here under control; the Shado-Pan need not send any aid.$B$BQuite the opposite, in fact - I will be sending many of my followers on pilgrimage, to bring a message of hope to those in need.$B$BThank you again, $p. Farewell.

Description.text: 影踪派可能正在潘达利亚的其他地方处理着类似的冲突。$B$B快去四风谷西部边陲的石犁村找影踪派指挥官麦龙吧。告诉他，我们已经控制了这里的局势；不需要影踪派再派援兵来了。$B$B事实上，正相反——我会派出许多前来朝拜的追随者，给有需要的人们带去希望的消息。$B$B再次感谢你，$p。再见。
Description.english: The Shado-Pan are likely dealing with similar outbreaks elsewhere in Pandaria.$B$BSeek out Loon Mai, the Shado-Pan Watch Commander in Stoneplow on the western end of the Valley of the Four Winds. Let him know that we have the situation here under control; the Shado-Pan need not send any aid.$B$BQuite the opposite, in fact - I will be sending many of my followers on pilgrimage, to bring a message of hope to those in need.$B$BThank you again, $p. Farewell.

identity.title: The Waters of Youth
identity.objectives: Give Vaeldrin's message to Lyalia.
identity.description: She is headstrong, my little Lyalia. I should have known she would try to challenge the Lord Reclaimer.$b$bSince her mother died, I forsook much of the time I should have spent with her in search of immortality, insisting that we could live forever, together.$b$bAnd now my obsession has cost my little Lyalia her life.$b$bPlease, $p, when she wakes, tell her I love her.

Description.text: 我的小丽娅拉，她就是太任性了。我早应该知道她会去挑战复国领主的。$b$b自从她母亲去世后，我牺牲了本该陪她的时间，一心扑在寻找长生不老药上，坚信着我们父女凭着这个就能永远在一起。$b$b现在看来，是我的执念让我的小丽娅拉付出了生命代价。$b$b帮帮我，$p，当她醒来的时候，告诉她我爱她。
Description.english: She is headstrong, my little Lyalia. I should have known she would try to challenge the Lord Reclaimer.$b$bSince her mother died, I forsook much of the time I should have spent with her in search of immortality, insisting that we could live forever, together.$b$bAnd now my obsession has cost my little Lyalia her life.$b$bPlease, $p, when she wakes, tell her I love her.

Title.text: 滨岸村野牛人入侵追踪事件
Title.english: Binan Village Intro Event Tracking Event

identity.title: Call Out Their Leader
identity.objectives: Slay 10 Bataari Tribe Members in the Kun-Lai Pass until the Bataari Fire-Warrior appears.  Then kill him.
identity.description: Clearly, you are a hero come to aid us.$B$BSlay the Bataari Tribe in the Kun-Lai Pass to the northwest until the Bataari Fire-Warrior is angered enough to appear.  Dispatch him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 去击败10个野牛人，把他引出来，然后干掉他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay 10 of the Bataari Tribe Members to anger him into appearing.  Then kill him!

identity.title: A Gift For Tina
identity.objectives: Obtain an Uncut Chrysoberyl.
identity.description: That Tina Mudclaw is in the Halfhill Market today, visiting her sister. She's really nice, but she's really hard to get gifts for!$b$bThere's a little jewel that can be found in the cliffs to the north. It's called a chrysoberyl, and it changes color when you hold it. I'll bet she doesn't have one of THOSE!$b$bLook inside the virmen caves. I bet you'll find one really fast.

PortraitGiverText.text: 她还真是衣食无缺啊！
PortraitGiverText.english: She already HAS everything!

identity.title: A Gift For Chee Chee
identity.objectives: Obtain an Authentic Valley Stir Fry.
identity.description: That crazy Chee Chee is actually pretty neat. Mah always said that hozen were nothing but trouble, but... I guess he's just a better hozen then the rest of them.$b$bWe should do something nice for him! Those mountain hozen in the west make some really fancy stir fry, and keep bowls of it inside their little hozen houses.$b$bI bet Chee Chee would love some!

PortraitGiverText.text: 曼说猢狲的嘴巴很脏。可在我看来还是挺干净的……
PortraitGiverText.english: Mah said hozen have filthy mouths. It looks pretty clean to me...

identity.title: A Gift For Sho
identity.objectives: Obtain a bowl of Yu-Ping Soup.
identity.description: Sho - that girl who lives up in the mountains - is in town today. I saw her walking toward the Halfhill Market.$b$bSuch a long walk... she must be hungry! And I think I know just the thing that she'll like.$b$bThe hozen up on the Skyrange cook a soup out of fish and apples. It sounds gross, I know... but it's awesome. You'll find it near their big, scary totem.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我可不想像她那样住在山里。
PortraitGiverText.english: I wouldn't want to live up in the mountains like her.

identity.title: A Gift For Fish
identity.objectives: Obtain a Yak Statuette from the inside of a Kunzen hozen hut.
identity.description: That Fish Fellreed is kind of weird. First of all, her name's Fish. That's weird.$b$bOnce you talk to her, though, she's really a nice lady. Did you know that she's an animal lover?$b$bI've got an idea! The Kunzen hozen, in the mountains to the west, make little animal statues and put them in their huts to scare off bad guys. I bet Fish would LOVE something weird like that!

PortraitGiverText.text: 哈哈！她居然叫玉儿。
PortraitGiverText.english: Ha ha! Her name is Fish.

identity.title: A Gift For Ella
identity.objectives: Obtain Spicy Shrimp Dumplings.
identity.description: That poor Ella. She's so shy! I saw her standing in the Halfhill Market, looking really hungry, but afraid to talk to any of the chefs.$b$bWe should bring her some food! And not any boring food - something special.$b$bThe Kunzen hozen make spicy shrimp dumplings from ingredients they've stolen from our farms. I don't like spicy food, but Ella might!

PortraitGiverText.text: 我大老远就听见她的肚子叫得震天响了！
PortraitGiverText.english: I can hear her stomach growling from way over here!

identity.title: A Gift For Fung
identity.objectives: Obtain a Bloody Plainshawk Leg from a Monstrous Plainshawk, and then bring it to Kol Ironpaw in the Halfhill Market.
identity.description: Farmer Fung is pretty mean, and just a little scary. Mah always said that he was one of the best farmers in the valley, though.$b$bI think I know the perfect gift for a mean, kind of scary guy like him.$b$bThere's some big plainshawks that circle the hills to the west of here. You should get one, find a big piece of meat, and then ask Kol Ironpaw to grill it up!

PortraitGiverText.text: 诺米说他连小孩子都吃。
PortraitGiverText.english: Nomi said that he eats cubs.

identity.title: A Gift For Old Hillpaw
identity.objectives: Find a Blue Freshwater Pearl.
identity.description: Old Hillpaw has about a million chickens on his farm... but that's not what he REALLY loves.$b$bI saw. He collects blue feathers.$b$bI don't realy know where to get a blue feather around here, but I do know where to find some blue pearls!$b$bCheck the oysters in Cattail Lake to the northwest. I'm sure a blue pearl will look nice with his feather collection!

PortraitGiverText.text: 那位老人家肯定很喜欢小鸡。
PortraitGiverText.english: That old guy sure likes chickens.

identity.title: A Gift For Haohan
identity.objectives: Obtain an Enormous Cattail Grouper Tooth.
identity.description: Haohan Mudclaw is the big boss of the Tillers union and the richest guy in the Valley! He's been nice to let me stay here, so I want to do something nice for him.$b$bHe likes expensive stuff, like ruby shards, but I don't have a lot of money, so I need to get him something else.$b$bI know! I've seen a great big fish in Cattail Lake! We should get one of its teeth as a gift!

PortraitGiverText.text: 如果我想成为农夫，就一定要跟他搞好关系！
PortraitGiverText.english: I need to be nice to him if I want to be a farmer someday!

identity.title: A Gift For Jogu
identity.objectives: Obtain 8 of Yoon's Apples and 50 of Yoon's Craneberries, then bring them to Bobo Ironpaw to brew into Apple-Berry Hooch.
identity.description: Sometimes I feel sad for Jogu. He's the only jinyu around, and I don't think he has any friends. Other than his smelly bottle, of course.$b$bYou know what? I've got an idea. Farmer Yoon has a basket of craneberries inside his house, and a few apples as well. I'm sure you could bring them to the stillmaster in the Halfhill Market and get him to brew something special for Jogu.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他呼出的空气闻着很像我叔叔。
PortraitGiverText.english: His breath smells like my uncle.

identity.title: A Gift For Gina
identity.objectives: Obtain a Goldenfire Orchid.
identity.description: Have you seen Gina Mudclaw, the market girl? She has it all - looks, brains, and nice big tummy. Could you deliver a gift for me?$b$bI wanted to pick some orchids that grow on top of the big hills to the west, but I can't climb that high. Could you pick a few and bring them to Gina?$b$bOh, and when you see her... tell her I said "hi".

PortraitGiverText.english: <Sigh...>

PortraitTurnInText.text: 我觉得她又善良又美丽。你可千万别告诉她这是我说的！
PortraitTurnInText.english: I think she is very nice and pretty. Don't tell her that I said that!

CompletionLog.text: 到恆春谷的雙子碑找倫·火舌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ren Firetongue at the Twin Monoliths in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Get Back Here!
identity.objectives: Report to Admiral Taylor in Pearlfin Village.
identity.description: Oh, before I forget, I have something I was asked to deliver to you. A letter from one of your companions, I assume.$b$bI was made to understand that your presence was urgently required, so I took the liberty of arranging your passage.$b$bSpeak to Ginsa Arroweye just south of here when you're ready. She has a kite waiting.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 海军上将泰勒正在等你回去。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Admiral Taylor is awaiting your return.

identity.title: Get Back Here!
identity.objectives: Return to General Nazgrim at Grookin Hill.
identity.description: Oh, before I forget, I have something I was asked to deliver to you. A letter from one of your companions, I assume.$b$bI was made to understand that your presence was urgently required, so I took the liberty of arranging your passage.$b$bSpeak to Ginsa Arroweye just south of here when you're ready. She has a kite waiting.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 纳兹戈林将军正在等你归队。
PortraitTurnInText.english: General Nazgrim is awaiting your return.

identity.title: Challenge Accepted
identity.objectives: Set the Yaungol Banner ablaze to summon Ur-Bataar, and then defeat him in combat.
identity.description:
The yaungol have always been a difficult, proud people, but never this violent or aggressive. 

I do not know what has prompted this change in their behavior, but we don't have time to find out, now. We fear for our lives and livelihoods as long as Ur-Bataar, leader of the Bataari yaungol, lives.

Go, set the banner in his camp ablaze to challenge him, and then defeat him in battle. Only then will we be secure.

PortraitGiverText.text: 厄尔巴塔尔，野牛人勇士
PortraitGiverText.english: Ur-Bataar, Champion of the Yaungol

identity.title: Challenge Accepted
identity.objectives: Set the Yaungol Banner at Fire Camp Bataar ablaze to summon Ur-Bataar, and then defeat him in combat.
identity.description:
The yaungol have always been a difficult, proud people, but never this violent or aggressive. 

I do not know what has prompted this change in their behavior, but we don't have time to find out, now. We fear for our lives and livelihoods as long as Ur-Bataar, leader of the Bataari yaungol, lives.

Go, set the banner in his camp ablaze to challenge him, and then defeat him in battle. Only then will we be secure.

PortraitGiverText.text: 厄尔巴塔尔，野牛人勇士
PortraitGiverText.english: Ur-Bataar, Champion of the Yaungol

identity.title: Haohan's Vote V: Chief Yip-Yip
identity.objectives: Kill Chief Yip-Yip at Kunzen Cave to the northwest.
identity.description: You ready for the final step of the plan?$B$BThe leader of the Kunzen hozen is a brute by the name of Chief Yip-Yip. It's said that he is nearly impervious to pain.$B$BI've injected the melons with a toxic mixture, so don't try eating them!$B$BOnce you get his attention, throw these melons onto the ground. Yip-Yip won't be able to resist a sweet striped melon.$B$BWhen he takes a bite, he'll be temporarily weakened, and you should find yourself an opening to attack.

PortraitGiverText.text: 昆森猢狲的首领。
PortraitGiverText.english: The leader of the Kunzen hozen.

identity.title: Fishing for a Bruising
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Riverblade Beach Raiders at Anglers Expedition, just west of Anglers Wharf.
identity.description: The riverblade saurok clan is attacking one of our local fishing expeditions!  They need help right away!$b$bThin those saurok out and help that expedition return safely!

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为凶猛的丛林战士，蜥蜴人可不是那么好对付的。
PortraitGiverText.english: Fierce jungle fighters, the Saurok are not to be trifled with.

identity.title: Bros Before Hozen
identity.objectives: Rescue Brother Yakshoe.
identity.description: While you were gone, I saw a group of grummles coming down the Burlap Trail. It was led by my Brother Yakshoe.$b$bBut then the Knucklethumps attacked. They took my brother and his grummles north.$b$bPlease, $p! Save my brother. He always has bad fortune and no luck, but he is my brother. Look for him at the alter in front of Fort Silverback.

Description.text: 在你离开的这段时间，有一群土地精来到了粗麻小径。是我的堂弟牦牛鞋带着他们来的。$b$b但是他们遭到了肘锤猢狲的袭击。他们把我的堂弟和他的族人抓到北边去了。$b$b请你帮帮我，$p！救救我的堂弟。虽然他总是霉运不断，但他毕竟是我的堂弟啊。去银背堡垒前面的祭坛找他。
Description.english: While you were gone, I saw a group of grummles coming down the Burlap Trail. It was led by my Brother Yakshoe.$b$bBut then the Knucklethumps attacked. They took my brother and his grummles north.$b$bPlease, $p! Save my brother. He always has bad fortune and no luck, but he is my brother. Look for him at the alter in front of Fort Silverback.

identity.title: The Leader Hozen
identity.objectives: Enrage Chomp Chomp and then defeat the Ook of Dook.
identity.description: The time has come to face the Ook of Dook. We beat him, and the hozen won't have someone telling them to ravage.$b$bHere is the plan: Yakshoe will lead Tassle in to arena and scare away Chomp Chomp.$b$bThen, you sneak in and fight the Ook of Dook while his hozen are distracted by the yeti rampaging through their home.$b$bWe'll meet you back at Kota Basecamp with a big reward. Good fortune to you, friend of grummles.

PortraitGiverText.text: 山地部族的首领。
PortraitGiverText.english: Leader of the mountain tribes.

identity.title: Armored Carp
identity.objectives: Use the Fishing Spear to catch 5 Armored Carp in the waters south of Anglers Wharf.
identity.description: Armored Carp are a delicacy around these parts.$b$bUnfortunately we can't fish them up since they snap our hooks with their powerful jaws.  Take this fishing spear and see if you can catch a few for us.

PortraitGiverText.text: 要捕这种鱼，用钩子是不行的。
PortraitGiverText.english: Hooks won't work on this one.

identity.title: Mogu?! Oh No-gu!
identity.objectives: Kill the Mogujia Soul-Caller.
identity.description:
I know your friends are worried about the animating statues over at Mogujia, but I'll tell you what you should really be worried about.

Where there are animated statues, there are mogu. I don't know if you've seen one before, but if you haven't...

Well, let's just say mogu are bad, bad, news.

While you're dealing with whatever else you're doing, you need to get the mogu behind the trouble!

PortraitGiverText.text: 魔古岬麻烦的真正源头……
PortraitGiverText.english: The real source of the problems at Mogujia...

identity.title: Mogu?! Oh No-gu!
identity.objectives: Kill the Mogujia Soul-Caller.
identity.description:
I know your friends are worried about the animating statues over at Mogujia, but I'll tell you what you should really be worried about.

Where there are animated statues, there are Mogu. I don't know if you've seen one before, but if you haven't...

Well, let's just say Mogu are bad, bad, news.

While you're dealing with whatever else you're doing, you need to get the Mogu behind the trouble!

PortraitGiverText.text: 魔古岬麻烦的真正源头……
PortraitGiverText.english: The real source of the problems at Mogujia...

identity.title: The Final Power
identity.objectives: Kill Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter.
identity.description: I never thought it would come to this!$B$BLeven went to face Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter at the top of the palace steps, but our reinforcements cannot get through!$B$BWe are the only ones who stand between him and the Vale's greatest... and most deadly... powers.$B$BPlease, $n, you must find a way to stop him!

PortraitGiverText.text: 韶天魔古族的首领。
PortraitGiverText.english: The leader of the Shao-Tien mogu.

identity.title: Tracking Quest: Opened the Golden Valley

Title.text: 追踪任务：开启金色谷入口
Title.english: Tracking Quest: Opened the Golden Valley

identity.title: Huff & Puff
identity.objectives: Use the Fishing Spear to kill 5 Prickly Puffer fish in Sarjun Depths and return with their spines.
identity.description: Have you heard of the prickly puffer fish $n?  Of course you haven't, you're new around these parts!$b$bThey can be found in the sarjun depths, due west of here.  Take this fishing spear and see if you can bring me back of few of their poison tipped spines.

PortraitGiverText.text: 小心，这些尖刺会留下讨厌的伤疤！
PortraitGiverText.english: Careful, those spines have been known to leave nasty scars!

identity.title: The Ordo Warbringer
identity.objectives: Kill Ordo Warbringer.
identity.description: <The shield is down. Time to head into the cave and slay the Warbringer of the Ordo yaungol!>

PortraitGiverText.text: 他失去了防护盾的保护！
PortraitGiverText.english: No longer protected by his shield!

identity.title: The Ordo Warbringer
identity.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
identity.description: <The shield is down. Time to head into the cave and slay the Warbringer of the Ordo!>

PortraitGiverText.text: 他失去了防护盾的保护！
PortraitGiverText.english: No longer protected by his shield!

identity.title: The Ordo Warbringer
identity.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
identity.description: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Go back there before the shield goes up again.$B$BTime to head into the cave and slay their chief!

PortraitGiverText.text: 他失去了防护盾的保护！
PortraitGiverText.english: No longer protected by his shield!

identity.title: The Ordo Warbringer
identity.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
identity.description: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Get back over there before they get that shield up again.$B$BSlay the Warbringer of the Ordo!

PortraitGiverText.text: 他失去了防护盾的保护！
PortraitGiverText.english: No longer protected by his shield!

identity.title: Misery
identity.objectives: Put Nahassa out his misery.
identity.description: While you are in the water below, you should slay Nahassa, the mortbreath patriarch. He suffers. I can feel his death cries ululating up to the surface of the lagoon.$b$bFind his cave, and put him out of his misery. Not because it will solve Marista's crocolisk problem. Simply out of mercy.

PortraitGiverText.text: 即使是野兽也需要慈悲。
PortraitGiverText.english: Even a great beast deserves mercy.

identity.title: Snapclaw
identity.objectives: Kill Snapclaw in a cave at the bottom of Narsong Trench and return with his claw as proof.
identity.description: A giant, poisonous crab is wrecking havoc on our local abalone stores.  I need you to go down into narsong trench and take it out!

PortraitGiverText.text: 钳爪正在大肆破坏当地的鲍鱼种群。
PortraitGiverText.english: Snapclaw has been wrecking havoc on the local abalone population.

identity.description: We regularly organize one-on-one duels with trainees that we think are well-suited for one another. We have found one such trainee for you, $n.$b$bHer name is Ellia Ravenmane. This will be her first duel, too. She will be waiting for you at the pavilion just to the south of here.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你的第一个挑战者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Your first challenger.

identity.title: Minh Do-Tan
identity.objectives: Defeat Minh Do-Tan.
identity.description: Your next challenger is another relatively new trainee. His name is Minh Do-Tan, and he has won his last two matches.$b$bHe will be waiting for you near the crane statue to the south.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你的下一个挑战者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Your next challenger.

identity.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Rematch
identity.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane near the base of the Pedestal of Hope.
identity.description: Ellia Ravenmane requested a rematch with you. She seems to identify you as her "rival".$b$bWe discourage rivalries here within the Cradle of Chi-Ji, but we rarely decline a rematch request. You will find Ellia near the Pedestal of Hope, on the island's eastern side.

PortraitGiverText.text: 她要求重赛！
PortraitGiverText.english: She demands a rematch!

identity.title: Fat Long-Fat
identity.objectives: Defeat Fat Long-Fat at the top of Angkhal Pavilion.
identity.description: You have been matched with a... special trainee. His name is Fat Long-Fat.$b$b<Thelonius chooses his words carefully.>$b$bFat Long-Fat... operates outside of the normal rules of combat. He does not fight every day, and when he does, he chooses his competitor. Today, for some reason... he has selected you.$b$bYou will find him atop Angkhal Pavilion.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他的名字叫肥龙。“肥”就是他最好的写照。
PortraitGiverText.english: Long-Fat is his name. Fat just describes him.

identity.title: Julia Bates
identity.objectives: Defeat Julia Bates.
identity.description: We welcome all kinds here within the Cradle, as long as they recognize and subscribe to the ideologies of the Red Crane. One of our new, more exotic trainees comes from the human kingdoms to the northeast. She goes by the rather foreign-sounding name of Julia Bates.$b$bShe is your next challenger. You will find her on the island's western shore.

PortraitGiverText.text: 潘达利亚的新访客。
PortraitGiverText.english: A recent arrival to Pandaria.

identity.title: Dextrous Izissha
identity.objectives: Defeat Dextrous Izissha.
identity.description: Jinyu normally avoid our order, but every few years, we find one that subscribes to the way of the Crane. One such jinyu is Dextrous Izissha.$b$bIzissha is your next challenger. He waits for you on the island's southwestern shore.

PortraitGiverText.text: 一个力量惊人的超级战士，但伊兹沙好像很内向。
PortraitGiverText.english: A surprisingly strong fighter, Izissha tends to keep to himself.

identity.title: Kuo-Na Quillpaw
identity.objectives: Defeat Kuo-Na Quillpaw.
identity.description: Most of the duels within the Cradle take place between two trainees. Rarely, when a trainee exhibits a rare amount of skill, they will have an opportunity to duel their trainer.$b$bToday, you duel against Kuo-Na. She will be waiting for you at the Pedestal of Hope.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这是你第一次和师父同场竞技！
PortraitGiverText.english: Your first sparring match against your trainers!

identity.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Revenge
identity.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane at Dome Balrissa.
identity.description: Your "rival" has appeared again. Ellia Ravenmane has been avoiding her duties on the island, instead focusing on personal training, with the intent to defeat you in battle.$b$b"I will destroy $n," she said.$b$bI have honored her request for a rematch, but I will be keeping a close eye on her. Her motives may be shifting in a dangerous direction.

PortraitGiverText.text: 艾黎亚回来了，她决心要打败自己的“死敌”。
PortraitGiverText.english: Ellia has returned, and she's determined to defeat her rival.

identity.title: Tukka-Tuk
identity.objectives: Defeat Tukka-Tuk.
identity.description: You are making a name for yourself, $n. I received a challenge from one of our more skilled competitors. He believes you are not as strong as you seem.$b$bHis name is Tukka-Tuk, the hozen. If you've ever fought against hozen before, you know that their apparent juvenility belies their battle acumen. Good luck.

PortraitGiverText.text: 前十场比赛中，他一场未败。
PortraitGiverText.english: Hasn't lost once in his last ten matches.

identity.title: Huck Wheelbarrow
identity.objectives: Defeat Huck Wheelbarrow.
identity.description: Usually our trainees are adventurers like yourself, or monks from Tian Monastery, or occasionally retired Shado-Pan. Very rarely, though, we will greet trainees that have no fighting experience whatsoever.$b$bHuck Wheelbarrow is one such trainee. He has requested a duel with you. Look for him on the island's western shore.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他是从北面农场迁过来的移民。
PortraitGiverText.english: An immigrant from the farmlands, to the north.

identity.title: Mindel Sunspeaker
identity.objectives: Defeat Mindel Sunspeaker.
identity.description: Our highest-ranked trainee is an outsider like you. It is both strange and exciting to live in a time when so many foreigners have embraced the way of the Crane.$b$bYour challenger's name is Mindel Sunspeaker, and he awaits you within Angkhal Pavilion.

PortraitGiverText.text: 米德尔跟你一样，从未尝过失败的滋味。
PortraitGiverText.english: Mindel, like you, is undefeated.

identity.title: Yan Quillpaw
identity.objectives: Defeat Yan Quillpaw at the Pedestal of Hope.
identity.description: You have already defeated Kuo-Na Quillpaw. You have not yet fought her brother, Yan.$b$bHe will meet you at the Pedestal of Hope, and he will not hold back. His reputation as a trainer is at stake.

PortraitGiverText.text: 燕在这个岛上已生活了数十载。战斗就是他的生命。
PortraitGiverText.english: Yan has been on this island for decades. Fighting is his life.

identity.title: Fat Long-Fat: Rematch
identity.objectives: Defeat Fat Long-Fat atop Dome Belrissa.
identity.description: Fat Long-Fat has requested another match with you. I find this strange. And concerning.$b$bHe will be waiting atop the Dome Belrissa.

PortraitGiverText.text: 迷一般的战士回来了。
PortraitGiverText.english: The enigmatic warrior returns.

identity.title: Thelonius
identity.objectives: Defeat Thelonius.
identity.description: When we last spoke, I promised to tell you the secret of Fat Long-Fat. I still plan to tell you that secret... after I determine your worth.$b$bI will meet you on the western shore, and we will duel.

PortraitGiverText.text: 塞隆尼斯的武艺超群、无人能敌。
PortraitGiverText.english: Thelonius' skill in battle is legendary.

identity.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Redemption
identity.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane atop the Pedestal of Hope.
identity.description: Ellia Ravenmane, your rival, has returned. She demands that you meet her atop the Pedestal of Hope.$b$bYou need to understand, $n... something horrible has happened to her. She has changed. You will see for yourself when you arrive at the pedestal.$b$bGood luck, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你的“死敌”回来了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Your rival returns.

identity.title: A Fair Trade
identity.objectives: Bring the Bundle of Kafa'kota Berries to the Lair of Kota Kon, near the top of Kota Peak.
identity.description: <The roar bellows out again, louder and more fierce than any of the yetis you've encountered so far. Again, a grummle voice replies...>$B$BEep! Please, great Kota Kon, forgive grummle. Let me go, I'll bring lots of kafa right away! Promise!$B$B<The beast called Kota Kon answers with another meaty roar.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 寇塔峰大魔王
PortraitGiverText.english: The Terror of Kota Peak

identity.title: Bright Bait
identity.objectives: Collect 7 Suncrawlers in the forest north of Anglers Wharf.
identity.description: Certain fish are only attracted to bright lights.  The forest north of here is home to a local pandaren firefly called a suncrawler.$b$bYou should be able to find them on the base of the tree trunks all around that area.  Bring me back a handful of them and I can use them for bait!

PortraitGiverText.text: 这些发光的小虫子可以在卡桑琅丛林的树根上找到。
PortraitGiverText.english: These small, glowing insects can be found on the roots of trees in Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Lord of the Shado-Pan
identity.objectives: Rid Taran Zhu of his possession by the Sha of Hatred.
identity.description: Our lord, Taran Zhu, has been overcome by a sha of pure hatred. The whole monastery has been lost!$B$B$C, you must find a way to free him of this possession. Last I knew, he was meditating in the Grove of Falling Blossoms.

PortraitGiverText.text: 解除恨之煞对他的控制！
PortraitGiverText.english: Free him from the grip of the Sha of Hatred!

PortraitGiverName.english: Taran Zhu, Lord of the Shado-Pan

identity.title: Regaining Honor
identity.objectives: Retrieve Zhen's Banner.
identity.description: $n, the yaungol warchief, Humongous, killed Shado-Master Zhen. He has his banner.$B$BYou have to kill Humongous and regain Zhen's honor! If you don't, I will.

PortraitGiverText.text: 从胡墨戈斯那里夺回陈大师的旗帜和荣耀！
PortraitGiverText.english: Retrieve the banner, and Zhen's honor, from Humongous!

identity.title: Jung Duk
identity.objectives: Plant the Shado-Pan Banner on the Ceremonial Pile, then kill Jung Duk.
identity.description: THIS. IS. WAR.$B$BI will have the heads of everyone who took Lin from me. EVERYONE!$B$BWe will begin with the Osul leader, Jung Duk.$B$BTake this Shado-Pan war banner and place it at the center of their camp.$B$BJung Duk will have no choice but to face you.$B$BShow him no mercy, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奥苏尔野牛人的首领。击败他！
PortraitGiverText.english: The leader of the Osul yaungol. Bring him down!

identity.title: A Spear Through My Side, A Chain Through My Soul
identity.objectives: Slay Dmong Naruuk, the shaman who holds Orbiss hostage.
identity.description: My fate is sealed. The yaungol put this spear in my side. The wound will kill me.$b$bThe yaungol hold me in place with their twisted, corrupted magic. The indignity of it hurts worse than my spear-wound.$b$bMy death, I cannot stop. My imprisonment... you may be able to help me with this.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奥苏尔部落里强大的迷雾萨满。
PortraitGiverText.english: A powerful mist-shaman of the Osul tribe.

identity.title: Mists' Opportunity
identity.objectives: Slay Jahesh of Osul.
identity.description: Now is the time to strike.$b$bGolgoss, Arconiss, and I will go east, into Jahesh's domain. Meet us there, and prepare for battle.$b$bToday, we restore the pride of our people.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奥苏尔迷雾萨满的首领。
PortraitGiverText.english: Leader of the Osul Mist-Shaman.

identity.title: The Fearmaster
identity.objectives: Kill the Fearmaster.
identity.description: I am not gonna take this anymore. My wife, bless her, poured her heart and soul in to that ranch making it what it is today.$b$bThem yaungol got a leader over there being all smug and what not. I'll pay you handsomely if you knock that smug smile off his filthy, stinking, good for nothing face.

PortraitGiverText.text: 比起穆山兽的力量，他更喜欢牦牛的灵活。
PortraitGiverText.english: He prefers the maneuverability of a yak versus the strength of a mushan.

identity.title: Justice
identity.objectives: Kill Captain Ripflesh and 6 Blackmane Mercenaries.
identity.description:
After the mercenaries robbed us, most left.

But one of them... after the others took all we had, he ran the rest of us through. For sport!

Get justice for the fallen. Perhaps news of their death will raise my spirits enough to go on.

You'll find them just west of here.

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑鬃雇佣兵的指挥官。
PortraitGiverText.english: The commander of the Blackmane Mercenaries.

identity.title: The Tongue of Ba-Shon
identity.objectives: Assist Lorekeeper Cho in performing the Binding of Ba-Shon.
identity.description: Thank you for coming, $p. I am sorry to have been so cryptic, but I could not risk alerting the mogu to my work here.$B$BThey are seeking something in the valley. Plundering the tombs of their old kings for relics of power.$B$BI could not observe them long before having to flee, but I did manage to recover a relic of my own.$B$BThe Tongue of Ba-Shon will let us communicate securely over long distances, but only after I have bound it to myself.$B$BI think I'm ready to begin, if you are.

Description.text: 谢谢你能过来，$p。请原谅我故作神秘，但我不能冒险惊动魔古族，让他们知道我在这里的工作。$B$B他们正在谷里找寻某些东西。他们盗掘历代国王的陵寝，搜寻能够获得力量的圣物。$B$B我没能观察太久，否则就被发现了，不过我还是找到了一件宝贝。$B$B巴匈之舌能让我们进行远距离的安全通话，不过我得先把它跟自己绑定起来。$B$B如果你准备好了，我随时可以开始。
Description.english: Thank you for coming, $p. I am sorry to have been so cryptic, but I could not risk alerting the mogu to my work here.$B$BThey are seeking something in the valley. Plundering the tombs of their old kings for relics of power.$B$BI could not observe them long before having to flee, but I did manage to recover a relic of my own.$B$BThe Tongue of Ba-Shon will let us communicate securely over long distances, but only after I have bound it to myself.$B$BI think I'm ready to begin, if you are.

identity.title: The Fall of Shai Hu
identity.objectives: Defeat Shai Hu. He can be found at the Waterspeaker's Sanctuary, the island in the center of Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
identity.description:
I can hear the voice of the Mere - it has been purified.

But, this chapter in my people's history will never be closed - not until we defeat Shai Hu.

He has retreated to the central island in the Mere, corrupting our holiest of sites.

Beware - he is strong. But, after all we have done, I am confident we will be stronger.

PortraitGiverText.text: 腐化墨鳃锦鱼人的罪魁祸首。如果我们想救其他锦鱼人，就必须杀了他。
PortraitGiverText.english: The corrupter of the Inkgill Jinyu. He must die if they are to be redeemed.

identity.title: Round 1: Brewmaster Chani
identity.objectives: Defeat Brewmaster Chani.
identity.description: Welcome, Challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.$b$bYour first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.$b$bFight with strength, fight with honor.

PortraitGiverText.text: 刚晋升为酒仙的她，酿出的酒苦得要命。
PortraitGiverText.english: New to her status as a Brewmaster, her brews are painfully bitter.

identity.title: Round 1: The Streetfighter
identity.objectives: Defeat the Streetfighter.
identity.description: Welcome, challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.$b$bYour first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.$b$bFight with strength, fight with honor.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这位著名的武僧在潘达利亚动荡之时负责保护潘达利亚的大小道路，使其不受侵扰。
PortraitGiverText.english: This famous monk defends the roads from the dangers of Pandaria.

identity.title: Round 2: Clever Ashyo & Ken-Ken
identity.objectives: Defeat Clever Ashyo and Ken-Ken.
identity.description: You may know your next challengers. They were arguing fiercely when they arrived, so I have charged them with fighting side by side.$b$bThis will teach them the strength of friendship, and possibly entertain me in the process.$b$bGo to the north eastern arena and face this jinyu and hozen.$b$bDo not be gentle, they need to learn to work together.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他们俩还是水火不容。
PortraitGiverText.english: These two traveling companions continue to harass each other.

identity.title: Round 2: Kang Bramblestaff
identity.objectives: Defeat Kang Bramblestaff.
identity.description: Your next challenger is a Bramblestaff. Strength is in their blood. I remember a full century of only Bramblestaff champions.$b$bNo pressure, little $r.$b$bGo to the eastern arena north of here and face this young challenger. See first hand if strength is earned or inherited.

PortraitGiverText.text: 棘杖家族长期占据着比赛的冠军宝座。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Bramblestaff family have long held the championship.

identity.title: Round 3: The Wrestler
identity.objectives: Defeat The Wrestler.
identity.description: Your next challenger is a favorite of mine. He draws strength from raw force and determination.$b$bPlus he has a mask.$b$bFace him in the western arena when you are ready, and good luck.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他从不摘下面具。
PortraitGiverText.english: He never removes his mask.

identity.title: Round 3: Master Boom Boom
identity.objectives: Defeat Master Boom Boom.
identity.description: Your next challenger found his strength on a beach. Particularly in a box labeled "dynamite."$b$bHe proves however that found strength can be as deadly as personal strength.$b$bWhen you are ready, face this Master Boom Boom in the Western Arena.

PortraitGiverText.text: 一个耍炸药的武僧。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Dynamite Monkey Monk.

identity.title: Terror of the Dread Wastes
identity.objectives: Defeat Norvakess, the Terror of the Dread Wastes.
identity.description: That thing is huge!$B$BThe Shado-Pan holding the battlefront were never trained for something like this... let's get down there and take it out ourselves.

identity.title: Round 4: Master Windfur
identity.objectives: Defeat Master Windfur.
identity.description: Well done, challenger. You have reached the final round.$b$bYour last opponent is a powerful master of the winds. He has defended his people for many years and stood as champion on more than one occasion.$b$bFace this Master Windfur in the main arena when you are ready.$b$bAnd challenger... good luck.

PortraitGiverText.text: 黎明之花镇长
PortraitGiverText.english: Mayor of Dawn's Blossom

identity.title: Round 4: The P.U.G.
identity.objectives: Defeat Hackiss, Healiss and Tankiss.
identity.description: And now the final round. I have selected three challengers for you to face. This may seem unfair... to a weakling. You are not a weakling, correct?$b$bGo to the main temple, stand in the grand arena, and face these three challengers. Prove you are stronger than their combined power!$b$bGood luck, Challenger!

PortraitGiverText.text: 他们每一个都有自己的看家本领。
PortraitGiverText.english: Each has a strength they lend to the fight.

PortraitGiverName.text: 哈吉斯、希利斯和坦齐斯。

identity.title: Greenstone Village
identity.objectives: Rescue all the villagers.
identity.description: Please help!$B$BWe paid some adventurers to run off all the elemental spirits and now they're back for revenge!

identity.title: Hui's Vengeance
identity.objectives: Defeat Vengeful Hui.
identity.description: I am ashamed to ask, but for Greenstone's sake... might we now trouble you to face Vengeful Hui on our behalf...?

PortraitGiverText.text: [PH]殺!
PortraitGiverText.english: [PH] KILL!

identity.title: The Sha of Hatred
identity.objectives: Defeat the Sha of Hatred.
identity.description: The end of our hunt is upon us. We have gathered the strongest the Shado-Pan have to offer, and with your strength to aid us, we will defeat the Sha of Hatred and choke out its influence on the world.$B$BWhen we enter the tunnel, stay close, and keep hatred clear from your heart. The fight ahead will put all of us to the test.$B$BWhatever happens, it has been an honor traveling beside you, $n.

identity.title: Devastation Below
identity.objectives: Defeat Voress'thalik with the aid of Hawkmaster Nurong.
identity.description: Let's get down there and finish that big bug off, you and I.

identity.title: Taoshi and Korvexxis
identity.objectives: Kill Korvexxis with the aid of Taoshi.
identity.description: Taoshi is setting up an ambush for one of the mantid leaders on the south side of Sik'vess. She is tasked with retrieving his crystal so that we can use it to open the door.$B$BTwo are stronger than one. I want you there to make sure it goes smoothly.

identity.title: Ancient Mogu Crypt
identity.objectives: Kill the possessed Shado-Pan Leader and cleanse the Pool of Life.
identity.description: Our scouting party got DESTROYED.  Help!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Great work!

identity.title: Psycho Mantid
identity.objectives: Investigate the mantid infighting at the Terrace of Gurthan.
identity.description: You aren't going to believe what I saw! Two mantid fighting each other, whipping some serious magic back and forth.$B$BOne of them didn't look like any mantid I've ever seen. Completely different color and dress to him, like some kind of... oracle or something. The other one was a total psycho, splashing sha energy around like it was a keg of Stormstout Special.$B$BLook, I gotta get back to my post, but those two are still fighting in the cave behind me and I have a feeling it's a big deal. Check it out?

PortraitGiverText.text: 螳螂妖像使用武器一样使用煞的力量？这怎么可能？
PortraitGiverText.english: A mantid wielding the power of sha like a weapon? How can this be?

identity.title: In Her Clutch
identity.objectives: Locate and waken the mantid paragon in The Clutches of Shek'zeer.
identity.description: The crystal sings to the Klaxxi. They sense a paragon in the clutch, east of the tower.$B$BClutch-keepers are trying to pollute this one. The Klaxxi will not permit this.$B$BGo and find the paragon. Place your hands on his chamber, and the Klaxxi will channel their whispers through you to break him free. Protect him if you can.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们在你附近的位置发现了一位英杰。
PortraitGiverText.english: We have found a paragon near your location.

identity.title: The Lorewalkers
identity.objectives: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have uncovered something tremendous in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. A great repository of books, scrolls, and lore that has remained untouched since the days of the mogu empire.$b$bPlease, join us at your earliest convenience. You can find this Seat of Knowledge by traveling to the infamous Mogu'shan Vaults, and then flying to the landing just above the entrance.$b$bI look forward to your arrival!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Description.text: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我们在锦绣谷中发现了一些惊人的东西。一座尘封的宝库，里面藏满了各种书籍、卷轴和知识，其历史可追溯到魔古帝国时期。$b$b请尽快来见我们。你可以先到声名狼藉的魔古山宝库，然后飞到宝库入口上方的平台，在这里你就可以找到这座闻道之座。$b$b期待你的到来！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
Description.english: Dear $p,$b$bWe have uncovered something tremendous in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. A great repository of books, scrolls, and lore that has remained untouched since the days of the mogu empire.$b$bPlease, join us at your earliest convenience. You can find this Seat of Knowledge by traveling to the infamous Mogu'shan Vaults, and then flying to the landing just above the entrance.$b$bI look forward to your arrival!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

identity.title: The Humble Grummle
identity.objectives: Bring The Humble Grummle to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have received your research on the grummles and believe we have a solid idea of their etimology and history.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Description.text: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我们收到了你关于土地精的调查报告，并确信我们已对他们的起源和历史有了明确的认识。$b$b如果你能来闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
Description.english: Dear $p,$b$bWe have received your research on the grummles and believe we have a solid idea of their etimology and history.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Title.text: 跟踪事件：已开始影踪派日常任务

identity.title: Between a Saurok and a Hard Place
identity.objectives: Bring Between a Saurok and a Hard Place to Lorewalker Cho.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have received your research on the saurok and believe we have pieced together clues about their past.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Description.text: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我们收到了你关于蜥蜴人的调查报告，并确信我们已经拼凑出蜥蜴人历史的线索。$b$b如果你能来闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
Description.english: Dear $p,$b$bWe have received your research on the saurok and believe we have pieced together clues about their past.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

identity.title: Lao-Chin and Serevex
identity.objectives: Kill Serevex with the aid of Lao-Chin the Iron Belly.
identity.description: Lao-Chin is facing off against the leader just above the entrance in the tree, on the north side of Sik'vess. He is to bring back the second crystal that we need to get into the mantid tunnel.$B$BGo there and lend him your aid.

identity.title: Nurong and Rothek
identity.objectives: Kill Rothek with the aid of Hawkmaster Nurong.
identity.description: Hawkmaster Nurong has gone ahead to the northwest of Sik'vess to make sure the last mantid leader cannot escape.$B$BCatch up with him and help him kill the mantid leader. Nurong will bring back the final crystal once you've aided him in this.

identity.title: The Heavens Hum With War
identity.objectives: Slay Azzix K'tai.
identity.description: The mantid don't ever make my job easy, but now they've gone too far.$b$bWe can fend off the occasional attack from Kor'vess, but now... now they're starting to surround us. What's worse, they're draining the amber from our tree.$b$bThis will not stand! We need that amber! To make beer!$b$bThey've dug a burrow into the south side of the tree. I'm short-handed here. Could you take care of them for me?

PortraitGiverText.text: 一只坏螳螂。
PortraitGiverText.english: One bad mantid.

identity.title: Uruk!
identity.objectives: Kill Uruk at Deadtalker's Plateau in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description: Uruk is the Deadtalker of the Townlong yaungol. Your mission will not be truly complete until you defeat him. Go to it!

PortraitGiverText.text: 螳螂高原的野牛人中堕落的死语者。
PortraitGiverText.english: The corrupted Deadtalker of the Townlong yaungol.

identity.title: Cheng Bo!
identity.objectives: Kill Cheng-Bo at Fire Camp Gai-Cho in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description:
Cheng Bo is the Warbringer of Fire Camp Gai-Cho. While you've made a dent in their operations, you now have an opportunity to strike a major blow. 

Slay the Warbringer!

PortraitGiverText.text: 铠胄野牛人的战争使者。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Warbringer of the Gai-Cho yaungol.

identity.title: The Challenger's Ring: Chao the Voice
identity.objectives: Challenge Chao the Voice, and then defeat her in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description:
It looks like you're quite the fighter, $p.

Chao heard about it, and she's been talking about how she'd kick your...

Well, let's just say I think you should challenge her and try to get her respect.

Description.text:
看来你是个不错的战士，$p。

超风听说你的事迹之后，就一直念叨着要怎样踢爆你的……

嗯，我觉得你应该挑战她一下，赢得她的尊重。
Description.english:
It looks like you're quite the fighter, $p.

Chao heard about it, and she's been talking about how she'd kick your...

Well, let's just say I think you should challenge her and try to get her respect.

PortraitGiverText.text: 体格强健（又喜欢夸夸其谈）的影踪派黑衣卫。
PortraitGiverText.english: An able bodied (and loud mouthed) Blackguard of the Shado-Pan.

identity.title: Fate of the Stormstouts
identity.objectives: Ask the inhabitants of The Sunset Brewgarden if they've seen any Stormstouts.
identity.description: $p! It is so great to see you healthy, and traveling so far. It would seem that our paths are quite tightly intertwined.$b$bI'm here looking for my family. I am told that several Stormstouts came across the wall to help face the mantid threat. I mean to find them, and join them.$b$bHave you seen anyone named Stormstout come through here? Would you mind helping me ask around?

Description.text: $p！看你远道而来，却如此神采奕奕，真让我高兴。看来我俩所走的道路交集真多。$b$b我来这儿寻找我的家人。我听说有几个风暴烈酒家的人越过了长城，来帮忙抗击螳螂妖了。我想找到并加入他们。$b$b你在这儿见过叫风暴烈酒的人吗？你能帮我四处打听一下吗？
Description.english: $p! It is so great to see you healthy, and traveling so far. It would seem that our paths are quite tightly intertwined.$b$bI'm here looking for my family. I am told that several Stormstouts came across the wall to help face the mantid threat. I mean to find them, and join them.$b$bHave you seen anyone named Stormstout come through here? Would you mind helping me ask around?

identity.title: Beating Them Back!
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Worgs.
identity.description: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...$B$B<McBride looks through some papers.>$B$B$n. It is $n, right?$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

PortraitGiverText.text: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Blackrock Battle Worgs are fierce predators.

identity.title: Lions for Lambs
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
identity.description: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.$B$BIn the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!$B$BKill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

PortraitGiverText.text: 这是一名男性黑石间谍。黑石间谍中不乏女性成员。
PortraitGiverText.english: This is a male Blackrock orc spy. There are females amongst them as well.

identity.title: Calligraphed Letter
identity.objectives: Read the Calligraphed Letter and speak to Bao in Northshire Abbey.
identity.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Bao, a pandaren who is visiting us from a faraway land. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

PortraitGiverText.text: 阿宝在北郡修道院的武器大厅中，他站在治安官玛克布莱德的身后。
PortraitGiverText.english: Bao can be found at the Hall of Arms inside Northshire Abbey, directly behind Marshal McBride.

identity.title: Join the Battle!
identity.objectives: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
identity.description: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, $n!$B$BFind Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

PortraitGiverText.text: 你可以在北郡修道院后的指挥营帐找到维里副队长。
PortraitGiverText.english: Sergeant Willem can be found at the command tent behind Northshire Abbey.

identity.title: They Sent Assassins
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Goblin Assassins.
identity.description: Have you ever seen a goblin, $n? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.$B$BThe Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.$B$BI need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!

PortraitGiverText.text: 是地精刺客。邪恶的小怪物！
PortraitGiverText.english: This is a goblin assassin. Nasty little monster!

identity.title: Meet the Cap'n
identity.objectives: Speak with "Soggy" Su-Dao in Soggy's Gamble.
identity.description: Alright, $p, I got another job for ya.$B$BYou see that lion seal in the pen over there? Name's Dog. He's been Soggy's pet for years.$B$BDog's acting up lately - I think he's getting restless in that pen. Why don't you go talk to Soggy and let him know.$B$BI'd say it's about time you meet the cap'n anyway.

Description.text: 好吧，$p，我还有一份工作要交给你。$B$B你看到那头关在围栏里的海狮了吗？他的名字叫狗狗。他是闷水壶多年以来的宠物。$B$B狗狗最近有些闹情绪——我想是关在围栏里让他不开心了。你应该去找闷水壶谈谈，告诉他这件事。$B$B我觉得，现在也是时候让你去见船长了。
Description.english: Alright, $p, I got another job for ya.$B$BYou see that lion seal in the pen over there? Name's Dog. He's been Soggy's pet for years.$B$BDog's acting up lately - I think he's getting restless in that pen. Why don't you go talk to Soggy and let him know.$B$BI'd say it's about time you meet the cap'n anyway.

identity.title: Slitherscale Suppression
identity.objectives: Kill the Slitherscale Lizard-Lord.
identity.description: The Slitherscale take orders from their leader, the Slitherscale Lizard-Lord. He can be found celebrating his victories on the southeastern corner of Windward Isle.$B$BIf we can destroy this leader, we can deal their tribe a great blow.$B$BWithout their lord, the Slitherscale will think twice before attacking the gentle cloud serpents of the east.

PortraitGiverText.text: 还有更大的威胁在等着我们。
PortraitGiverText.english: A greater threat still awaits.

identity.title: Target of Opportunity: Sra'thik Swarmlord
identity.objectives: Kill the Sra'thik Swarmlord at Sra'vess in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description:
While we're here, we should do one more thing.

The Sra'thik Swarmlord is responsible for directing the mantid forces from the air. If we leave it alive, it's going to cause trouble for the garrison.

So we're not going to leave it alive. Let's take it out, $p.

Description.text:
到这里时，我们还应该做一件事。

瑟拉提克统群者负责从空中指挥螳螂妖部队。如果我们让它活着，就会给守备部队带来麻烦。

所以我们不会让它活着。除掉它，$p。
Description.english:
While we're here, we should do one more thing.

The Sra'thik Swarmlord is responsible for directing the mantid forces from the air. If we leave it alive, it's going to cause trouble for the garrison.

So we're not going to leave it alive. Let's take it out, $p.

identity.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
identity.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
identity.description: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand or the bloodbowl in Zul'Drak, but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Twi-Hi, pal.$B$BYou're new to this pit, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match.$B$BIf you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?

PortraitGiverText.text: 血眼氏族对击溃对手颇有心得。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Bloodeye Clan's contribution to combatant crushing.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Gurg's right hand man.

identity.title: The Challenger's Ring: Hawkmaster Nurong
identity.objectives: Challenge Hawkmaster Nurong, and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description:
You've really been building up respect with the Shado-Pan, $n.

Nurong's interested in trying out his skills against you.

The good news is, if you win, I'll allow him to go with you on your missions.

The bad news is, I really don't think you'll win.

PortraitGiverText.text: 一位身手不凡的悟道者，喜欢带着爱鹰白羽一块儿旅行。
PortraitGiverText.english: A deadly Wu Kao who always travels with his beloved hawk, Whitefeather.

identity.title: The Challenger's Ring: Tenwu of the Red Smoke
identity.objectives: Challenge Tenwu of the Red Smoke, and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description:
So... you've been challenged by the infamous Tenwu of the Red Smoke.

That's what he calls himself, at least. He's a good fighter, and a good rogue, but it's a wonder he manages to sneak up on anyone with how loudly he brags about himself.

Anyways, I think you should answer the challenge. Maybe it'll give him a touch of humility. Maybe not. Either way, if you win, he'll probably be willing to go with you on your missions. 

And I get some entertainment.

PortraitGiverText.text: 一位身手不凡的悟道者盗贼，吹牛的功夫和他高超的战斗技巧有得一拼。
PortraitGiverText.english: A deadly Wu Kao rogue, almost as skilled at bragging as he is at combat.

identity.title: Profit Mastery: Chasheen
identity.objectives: Collect Ancient Tiger's Blood.
identity.description: I am totally on to another great scam!$b$bWhen I was flying overhead I saw a really ancient tigress prowling about.$b$bDo you know how much her blood would go for on the black market? Not to mention if I convince some warlocks it adds extra potency to their summoning spells or something.$b$bIf you bring me back some of her blood I will cut you in on the scam. She was prowling about on the far side of the Dojani River from here.

PortraitGiverText.text: 荒野女王
PortraitGiverText.english: Queen of the Deepwild

identity.title: Crane Mastery: Needlebeak
identity.objectives: Acquire the Needlebeak.
identity.description: So, now that you've got a vibe for how cranes fight, I've got a doozy for you.$b$bNeedlebeak!$b$bOr at least, that's what I'm calling him. Biggest crane I ever saw. And its beak is so sharp it's like a sword.$b$bNorthwest of here you'll find the big water fall that kicks off the Dojani River. Needlebeak likes to hang out by the waterfall.$b$bYou bring me its beak as a trophy and I will talk you up a good game to Nesingwary.

PortraitGiverText.text: 鸟群头领
PortraitGiverText.english: Lord of the Flock

Title.text: 標示－古代熊貓人釣魚竿

identity.title: Educating Saurok
identity.objectives: Defeat Leechfingers.
identity.description: The Spring Road is under the protection of her ladyship, the esteemed Madam Goya.$b$bThe saurok of Hatescale Burrow northeast of here require "education" in this fact. We have warned them before but sadly they seem to have a very short memory.$b$bTravel northeast to this burrow and find their shaman leader. Eliminate him and you will have the gratitude of her ladyship. As well as an appropriate bounty.

PortraitGiverText.english: Shaman of the Hatescale

identity.title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
identity.objectives: Defeat Julia Stevens in a pet battle.
identity.description: I can tell you have been honing your pet battle skills, $n.  I think it's time for you to take on a real challenge.$b$bJulia Stevens can be found at the Maclure Vineyards south of Stormwind.  She is an up and coming wild pet tamer and I think it's time you faced her in battle!

PortraitGiverText.text: 去挑战茱莉亚来证明一下你的实力吧！
PortraitGiverText.english: Put your skills to the test against Julia!

identity.title: Trouble Brewing
identity.objectives: Kill Yan-Zhu the Uncasked.
identity.description: With the brewery infested by hozen and... and who knows what else, I'm sure that the brewers are in trouble.$B$BWould you mind helping me find out what's going on, my friend?

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀了他，以救出高老伯。
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay him to rescue Uncle Gao.

identity.title: The Path to Respect Lies in Violence
identity.objectives: Kill the Sha of Violence.
identity.description: You have proven yourself in battle.$B$BStill, if you would aid us further, I must ask something else of you.$B$BThe Sha of Violence awaits beyond within the Sealed Chambers. Destroy it if you would earn my respect.

PortraitGiverText.text: 雪流大师让你杀死这个邪恶的怪物。
PortraitGiverText.english: Master Snowdrift has asked you to slay this vile creature.

identity.title: Mazu's Bounty
identity.objectives: Speak with Master Angler Ju Lien in Soggy's Gamble.
identity.description: That was some amazing work you and the captain did out there, $p! It's an honor to have you on the crew.$B$BOh! And Ju Lien survived! He swam ashore just after you started letting the harpoons fly. He was raving about some kind of gigantic egg or something that washed in with Jiao.$B$BGo check up on him, will you? He's probably hauled it out of the water by now.

Description.text: 你和船长所做的一些事情让人惊叹不已，$p！能够得到你的加盟，真是万分荣幸。$B$B哦！句连活下来了！就在你用鱼叉捕鱼的时候，他游到了岸边。他正在兴高采烈地向人介绍某种巨型的蛋或随着狡一起被冲到岸边的东西。$B$B你愿意去他那里看一下吗？他现在可能已经把那个东西弄出水面了。
Description.english: That was some amazing work you and the captain did out there, $p! It's an honor to have you on the crew.$B$BOh! And Ju Lien survived! He swam ashore just after you started letting the harpoons fly. He was raving about some kind of gigantic egg or something that washed in with Jiao.$B$BGo check up on him, will you? He's probably hauled it out of the water by now.

identity.title: Deep Doubts, Deep Wisdom
identity.objectives: Kill the Sha of Doubt.
identity.description: There is an ancient pandaren saying that states, "With deep doubts comes deep wisdom."$B$BThe Sha of Doubt has infested the Heart of Jade within the temple. It must be destroyed.$B$BI dare say that you are about to become all the wiser, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 清除寺庙的疑虑。
PortraitGiverText.english: Rid the temple of doubt.

identity.title: The Kunchong Whisperer
identity.objectives: Kill Oracle Hiss'ir and 10 Muckscale tribe members.
identity.description: To really connect with Kovok you need to challenge him mentally and physically. You must respect his strength and intelligence; only then will he allow you to really train him.$b$bThe muckscale tribe may provide an adequate test of his abilities and with you there he shouldn't be in danger.$b$bAdditionally, this will allow us to decrease their numbers in the Briny Muck.

PortraitGiverText.text: 泥鳞部族的高阶神谕者。
PortraitGiverText.english: High oracle to the Muckscale tribe.

identity.title: A New Lesson for the Master
identity.objectives: Kill Xin the Weaponmaster.
identity.description: A new king of the mogu has arisen: Xin the Weaponmaster.$B$BHe single-handedly subjugated the mogu clans, and now they and their new leaders vie for his favor.$B$BI've never seen or read of any who are his equal in battle. Do not underestimate Xin, $n.$B$BOur fate rests in your hands.

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死魔古族的新国王。
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay the new king of the mogu.

identity.title: That's a Big Bug!
identity.objectives: Kill Raigonn.
identity.description: The mantid have something they call Raigonn. It's a giant bug they're using to bust down the wall's gates!$B$BLet's keep that thing from getting into the vale!

PortraitGiverText.text: 不要让它冲进来！
PortraitGiverText.english: Keep it from busting through!

identity.title: Take Down the Wing Leader
identity.objectives: Kill Wing Leader Ner'onok.
identity.description: The mantid have lain siege to Niuzao Temple.$B$BEven now, Wing Leader Ner'onok and his forces work to cross the final chasm.$B$BYou must stop him before they reconstruct that bridge.

PortraitGiverText.text: 去桥的另一侧杀掉翼虫首领。
PortraitGiverText.english: Take him down over the bridge.

identity.title: Falling to Pieces
identity.objectives: Return the Glowing Amber to Kaz'tik the Manipulator.
identity.description: Why would the saurok have amber? More importantly, why would Oracle Hiss'ir be so protective of it?$b$bIt is unlikely this came from the heavily guarded Zan'vess, so where did it come from?$b$bPerhaps the Klaxxi will know what to make of it.

identity.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling.
identity.description: The key to lifting the curse of this place rests in the final death of Darkmaster Gandling.$B$BDo it, $p, and make him suffer!

Description.text: 要解除这个地方的诅咒，关键在于杀死黑暗院长加丁。$B$B杀掉他，$p，让他也尝一尝受苦的滋味！

identity.title: Just for Safekeeping, Of Course
identity.objectives: Collect the Codex of the Crusade.
identity.description: There is a book of great value to me here in the halls.$B$BUnfortunately, it's in the possession of Flameweaver Koegler. I've tried to get close to him before, but it's never quite worked out.$B$BYou might have better luck. Just watch out -- I hear that he's gone well and truly insane. The Flameweaver plans to burn every tome they have in the library.$B$BHe'll probably burn the Scarlet Halls down in the process.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他有十字军圣典。在他把它烧成灰烬前得到它。
PortraitGiverText.english: He has the Codex of the Crusade. Get it from him before he burns it to ashes.

identity.description: We honor strength here, not brutality. It is unfortunate but there are some who come to my doorstep oblivious to this distinction.$b$BI have turned away one such challenger. Title.text: 通往锦绣谷的大门打开

identity.title: Dark Huntress
identity.objectives: Kill the Windward Huntress.
identity.description: I have learned that a vicious beast, a Windward Huntress, terrorizes the wood on the northwest side of the island.$B$BShe has already slain several serpents, and injured more than one serpent rider sent to subdue her.$B$BShe must be removed before she can pose a danger to anyone else. Can you perform this task?

PortraitGiverText.text: 女猎手的洞穴就在临风岛的西北部。
PortraitGiverText.english: The huntress's den is in the northwestern part of Windward Isle.

identity.title: On The Prowl
identity.objectives: Kill the Windward Saber.
identity.description: I have heard report of a great white beast that stalks the wood on the northwestern side of the wild serpent island.$B$BThis savage creature is mate to the Windward Huntress, and already he has taken down several of the adult cloud serpent matriarchs.$B$BWe cannot have such a fearsome predator roaming the island unchecked.$B$BGo and deal with this creature. Let us see if your training has paid off.

PortraitGiverText.text: 临风岛之王。
PortraitGiverText.english: The king of the island.

identity.title: Madcap Mayhem
identity.objectives: Kill the Shadowfae Madcap.
identity.description: There is another task I must ask of you.$B$BThe leader of the woodland sprites is the Shadowfae Madcap.$B$BIf there is trouble brewing, he is the mastermind pulling the puppet strings.$B$BWe do not have time to deal with the sprites' tiresome pranks and insolence. Take out the Shadowfae Madcap, and be quick about it.

PortraitGiverText.text: 木精的首领。小心他的诡计。
PortraitGiverText.english: The leader of the wood sprites. Beware his tricks.

identity.title: The Cost of War
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Sha Haunts and 5 Sha Harbingers in Garrosh'ar Point.
identity.description: This whole place is going up in flames and the Skyfire is reporting that more of those... shadows are crawling up out of the ground. We need to get our people out of here.$B$BClear a path through the base on your way north and head for the town. I will rendezvous with you there.

Objectives.text: 杀死加尔鲁什尔前哨站里的$1oa个徘徊煞魔和5个煞魔先驱。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Sha Haunts and 5 Sha Harbingers in Garrosh'ar Point.

identity.title: [RESCUE GOLDEN LOTUS SQUAD] [GET RID OF THIS?]

Title.english: [RESCUE GOLDEN LOTUS SQUAD] [GET RID OF THIS?]

CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。
