identity.title: You're Either With Us Or...
identity.objectives: Attempt to enlist the help of Mayor Honeydew in Honeydew Village.
identity.description: The assistance of the nearby village has now become a necessity, $p.$b$bWe will need to use the village to regroup and tend to our wounded.$b$bPerhaps the villagers will join our cause after seeing the brutality unleashed by the alliance.$b$bYou will act as envoy for the Horde. Ensure the cooperation of their leader. Do not disappoint me!

Description.text: 我们需要附近村落的帮助，这点很有必要，$p。$b$b我们需要村子来重整部队、治疗伤员。$b$b或许在目睹联盟的暴行后，村民们会加入我们。$b$b你将作为我们部落的使节，确保他们的村长会乖乖合作。别让我失望！
Description.english: The assistance of the nearby village has now become a necessity, $p.$b$bWe will need to use the village to regroup and tend to our wounded.$b$bPerhaps the villagers will join our cause after seeing the brutality unleashed by the alliance.$b$bYou will act as envoy for the Horde. Ensure the cooperation of their leader. Do not disappoint me!

identity.title: The Darkness Within
identity.objectives: Slay Captain Doren.
identity.description: You didn't see Captain Doren while you were out there, did you?$b$bThat sniveling Alliance leader must be in hiding somewhere. If he wasn't in that airbase, he can't be far. Search the perimeter - try searching the cave southwest of the main airfield. I want the Alliance gone from here!

PortraitGiverText.text: 整个铁腕机坪都听命于多伦上尉的指挥。给我拿下他！
PortraitGiverText.english: The entirety of Strongarm Airstrip reports to Doren. Take him down!

identity.title: Tracking Quest: Opened the Golden Valley II

Title.text: 追踪任务：开启金色谷入口II
Title.english: Tracking Quest: Opened the Golden Valley II

identity.title: Zunta, The Pet Tamer
identity.objectives: Defeat Zunta in a pet battle.
identity.description: I can tell you have been honing your pet battle skills, $n.  I think it's time for you to take on a real challenge.$b$bZunta can be found near the Tor'kren Farm south of Orgrimmar.  He is an up and coming wild pet tamer and I think it's time you faced him in battle!

PortraitGiverText.text: 去挑战祖塔来证明一下你的实力吧！
PortraitGiverText.english: Test yourself against Zunta!

identity.title: Traitor Gluk
identity.objectives: Defeat Bill the Pirate in a pet battle.
identity.description: Are you up for an adventure? Bill the Pirate, local star tamer down in the Cape of Stranglethorn, has issued an open challenge to prepared trainers!$b$bYou can find Bill the Pirate in the southern Cape of Stranglethorn, walking the local roads to find potential fights.

PortraitGiverText.text: 把他逼到绝境！
PortraitGiverText.english: Make him walk the plank!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Wonderful!

Title.text: 追踪事件：联盟炮艇的离开

identity.title: Eric Davidson
identity.objectives: Defeat Eric Davidson in a pet battle.
identity.description: Ah, so you've braved the woods again to face me in battle. I accept your brazen challenge to my vicious spawn.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Splendiferous!

identity.title: Steven Lisbane
identity.objectives: Defeat Steven Lisbane in a pet battle.
identity.description: You dare to challenge me again? This time, I do believe our battle is going to sway in my favor!

PortraitTurnInText.english: What a spectacle!

identity.title: Audrey Burnhep
identity.objectives: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 去搞定他们吧！
PortraitGiverText.english: Go get 'em!

identity.title: Audrey Burnhep
identity.objectives: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你有着光明的前景！
PortraitGiverText.english: You've a bright future ahead of you!

identity.title: Audrey Burnhep
identity.objectives: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 愿你的道路正确如一。
PortraitGiverText.english: May your path be true.

identity.title: Audrey Burnhep
identity.objectives: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 让他看看你的实力！
PortraitGiverText.english: Show him what you've got!

identity.title: Varzok
identity.objectives: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Varzok in Orgrimmar. He has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 让女妖之王以你为傲吧！
PortraitGiverText.english: Make the Banshee Queen proud!

identity.title: Varzok
identity.objectives: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Varzok in Orgrimmar. He has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 让我们的人民以你为傲吧。
PortraitGiverText.english: Make our people proud.

identity.title: Varzok
identity.objectives: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Varzok in Orgrimmar. He has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 快踏上新的旅程吧！
PortraitGiverText.english: Make haste and begin your next journey!

identity.title: Varzok
identity.objectives: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Varzok in Orgrimmar. He has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 去扫平他们吧，勇士！
PortraitGiverText.english: Go get 'em, champ!

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Kalimdor
identity.objectives: Defeat Traitor Gluk, Grazzle the Great, Kela Grimtotem, Zoltan, and Elena Flutterfly in pet battles.
identity.description: Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full.$B$BThere are five tamers throughout Kalimdor that I'd like you to defeat: Traitor Gluk in Feralas, Grazzle the Great in Dustwallow Marsh, Kela Grimtotem in Thousand Needles, Zoltan in Felwood, and Elena Flutterfly in Moonglade.$B$BIf you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Wow! You really are impressive.

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Kalimdor
identity.objectives: Defeat Traitor Gluk, Grazzle the Great, Kela Grimtotem, Zoltan, and Elena Flutterfly in pet battles.
identity.description: Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full.$B$BThere are five tamers throughout Kalimdor that I'd like you to defeat: Traitor Gluk in Feralas, Grazzle the Great in Dustwallow Marsh, Kela Grimtotem in Thousand Needles, Zoltan in Felwood, and Elena Flutterfly in Moonglade.$B$BIf you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Well done!

identity.title: Grand Master Trixxy
identity.objectives: Defeat Stone Cold Trixxy in a pet battle.
identity.description: Word around the master tamers in Kalimdor is you're the new hotshot that's making such a buzz. Why don't you come down to my training grounds in the Ice Thistle Hills in Winterspring so I can show you how it's done?

PortraitGiverText.text: 你以为自己很了不起？
PortraitGiverText.english: Think you've got what it takes?

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Eastern Kingdoms
identity.objectives: Defeat David Kosse, Deiza Plaguehorn, Kortas Darkhammer, Everessa, and Durin Darkhammer in pet battles.
identity.description: Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full.$B$BThere are five tamers throughout the Eastern Kingdoms that I'd like you to defeat: David Kosse in The Hinterlands, Deiza Plaguehorn in Eastern Plaguelands, Kortas Darkhammer in Searing Gorge, Everessa in Swamp of Sorrows, and Kortas' brother, Durin Darkhammer, in Burning Steppes.$B$BIf you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Wow! You really are impressive.

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Eastern Kingdoms
identity.objectives: Defeat David Kosse, Deiza Plaguehorn, Kortas Darkhammer, Everessa, and Durin Darkhammer in pet battles.
identity.description: Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full.$B$BThere are five tamers throughout the Eastern Kingdoms that I'd like you to defeat: David Kosse in The Hinterlands, Deiza Plaguehorn in Eastern Plaguelands, Kortas Darkhammer in Searing Gorge, Everessa in Swamp of Sorrows, and Kortas' brother, Durin Darkhammer, in Burning Steppes..$B$BIf you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

PortraitTurnInText.english: I never doubted you.

identity.title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
identity.objectives: Defeat Lydia Accoste in a pet battle.
identity.description: The master tamers around the Eastern Kingdoms have been talking about you. You think yourself unstoppable? You believe that you are the true grand master?$B$BCome, then, $n. I await you in Deadwind Pass. Come, and know the crushing defeat that's always been yours.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你的胜利将在这里终结！
PortraitGiverText.english: Your victory streak ends here!

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Outland
identity.objectives: Defeat Nicki Tinytech, Ras'an, Narrok, and Morulu the Elder in pet battles.
identity.description: You've bested the master tamers of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, but your next challenge will be far more trying.$B$BThere are four tamers in Outland that you must now defeat: Nicki Tinytech in Hellfire Peninsula, Ras'an in Zangarmarsh, Narrok in Nagrand, and Morulu the Elder in Shattrath.$B$BYou must defeat them to proceed on the path to greatness.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你能行的！
PortraitGiverText.english: You can do it!

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你在成功道路上又迈出了一大步！
PortraitTurnInText.english: You're really coming along!

identity.title: Grand Master Antari
identity.objectives: Defeat Bloodknight Antari in a pet battle.
identity.description: I've seen the likes of you before. A young, naive tamer that thinks that they deserve victory handed to them on a silver platter.$B$BWell no more! I will be your reckoning, $c. I, Bloodknight Antari of Shadowmoon Valley, await the chance to show you how it feels to be obliterated in battle.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你毫无胜算。
PortraitGiverText.english: You don't stand a chance.

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Outland
identity.objectives: Defeat Nicki Tinytech, Ras'an, Narrok, and Morulu the Elder in pet battles.
identity.description: You've bested the master tamers of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, but your next challenge will be far more trying.$B$BThere are four tamers in Outland that you must now defeat: Nicki Tinytech in Hellfire Peninsula, Ras'an in Zangarmarsh, Narrok in Nagrand, and Morulu the Elder in Shattrath.$B$BYou must defeat them to proceed on the path to greatness.

PortraitGiverText.text: 祝你在战场上能载誉而归。
PortraitGiverText.english: May your battles be glorious.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你的另一段旅途又画上了一个完美的句号。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Another step in your journey, complete.

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Northrend
identity.objectives: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
identity.description: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!$B$BThere are four tamers that you must now defeat: Beegle Blastfuse in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak.$B$BIf you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!

PortraitGiverText.text: 全力应战！
PortraitGiverText.english: Show them your best!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Are you ready for this?

identity.title: Grand Master Payne
identity.objectives: Defeat Major Payne in a pet battle.
identity.description: In my opinion, my fellow tamers have been far too lenient on your training.$B$BTrue pet taming requires militaristic discipline. I shall honor you with the pleasure of seeing firsthand what that discipline can produce.$B$BCome to the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown and see firsthand what you could become!

PortraitGiverText.text: 为了联盟！
PortraitGiverText.english: For the Alliance!

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Northrend
identity.objectives: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
identity.description: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!$B$BThere are four tamers that you must now defeat: Beegle Blastfuse in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak.$B$BIf you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!

PortraitGiverText.text: 决不容许失败。
PortraitGiverText.english: Failure is not an option.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 最艰巨的挑战在等着你呢。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Your most difficult challenge yet now awaits you.

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Pandaria
identity.objectives: Defeat Hyuna of the Shrines, Farmer Nishi, Mo'ruk, Courageous Yon, Seeker Zusshi, and Wastewalker Shu in pet battles.
identity.description: You must now face the toughest tamers in all of Azeroth, $n. They make their home in Pandaria, training ground of the grand masters.$B$BThere are six grand masters left to defeat: Hyuna of the Shrines in The Jade Forest, Farmer Nishi in Valley of the Four Winds, Mo'ruk in Krasarang Wilds, Courageous Yon in Kun-Lai Summit, Seeker Zusshi in Townlong Steppes, and Wastewalker Shu in Dread Wastes.$B$BIf you think yourself ready, seek out these champions of the trade and prove yourself!

PortraitTurnInText.english: The end is near!

identity.title: Grand Master Aki
identity.objectives: Defeat Aki the Chosen in a pet battle.
identity.description: You have fought hard and well against the trainers of Azeroth. Even the grand masters have fallen to your cunning tactics.$B$BI now await you in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, for you have earned the privilege to face me in battle. Come, $n, and let us see if you have what it takes to defeat me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 是时候面对我了。
PortraitGiverText.english: It is time to face me.

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Pandaria
identity.objectives: Defeat Hyuna of the Shrines, Farmer Nishi, Mo'ruk, Courageous Yon, Seeker Zusshi, and Wastewalker Shu in pet battles.
identity.description: You must now face the toughest tamers in all of Azeroth, $n. They make their home in Pandaria, training ground of the grand masters.$B$BThere are six grand masters left to defeat: Hyuna of the Shrines in The Jade Forest, Farmer Nishi in Valley of the Four Winds, Mo'ruk in Krasarang Wilds, Courageous Yon in Kun-Lai Summit, Seeker Zusshi in Townlong Steppes, and Wastewalker Shu in Dread Wastes.$B$BIf you think yourself ready, seek out these champions of the trade and prove yourself!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Your final challenge awaits.

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Cataclysm
identity.objectives: Defeat Brok, Bordin Steadyfist, and Goz Banefury in pet battles.
identity.description: You have defeated Northrend's finest tamers, but you need more preparation before you are ready to face the grand masters of Pandaria. Ready yourself and hone your skills by defeating these elite tamers: Brok in Mount Hyjal, Bordin Steadyfist in Deepholm, and Goz Banefury in Twilight Highlands.$B$BOnce you have triumphed over them, you will be ready to journey to Pandaria to face the ultimate challenge.

PortraitGiverText.text: 全力应战！
PortraitGiverText.english: Show them your best!

PortraitTurnInText.english: Are you ready for this?

identity.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Cataclysm
identity.objectives: Defeat Brok, Bordin Steadyfist, and Goz Banefury in pet battles.
identity.description: Northrend has fallen to your hand, but you are not yet ready to face the grand masters of Pandaria. Defeat these tamers to harden your will for the coming challenges: Brok in Mount Hyjal, Bordin Steadyfist in Deepholm, and Goz Banefury in Twilight Highlands.$B$BOnly by defeating them will you be ready to journey to Pandaria.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你已历经千辛万苦，决不能半途而废。
PortraitGiverText.english: You have come too far to fail.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 准备好迎接下一场挑战了吗，驯宠师？
PortraitTurnInText.english: Think you're ready for the next challenge, tamer?

identity.title: Grand Master Obalis
identity.objectives: Defeat Obalis in a pet battle.
identity.description: You think yourself ready to challenge Pandaria? You truly believe that you can defeat the most powerful tamers in all of Azeroth?$B$BI shall be the judge of that notion, $r. Face me atop the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum, and we shall see if you are truly ready.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我等待着我们的对决。
PortraitGiverText.english: I await our battle.

identity.title: Audrey Burnhep
identity.objectives: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

PortraitGiverText.text: 去搞定他们吧！
PortraitGiverText.english: Go get 'em!

identity.title: Audrey Burnhep
identity.objectives: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
identity.description: Greetings, $n! My name is Audrey Burnhep. I've been hearing quite a lot about you recently. You're becoming quite the tamer!$B$BYou should come speak with me in Stormwind. I have connections with some of the finest tamers in all of Azeroth, and I can help you grow even more!

PortraitGiverText.text: 我想马上与你见面！
PortraitGiverText.english: I can't wait to meet you!

identity.title: Varzok
identity.objectives: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: Lok'tar, $n. My name is Varzok. I have heard much your accomplishments as a tamer recently, and I would like to introduce you to trainers around Azeroth so that you may further hone your skills.$B$BPlease speak with me in Orgrimmar so that we may begin.

PortraitGiverText.text: 期待与你会面。
PortraitGiverText.english: I look forward to meeting you.

identity.title: Once in a Hundred Lifetimes
identity.objectives: Speak to Klaxxi'va Ik in Klaxxi'vess.
identity.description: The time has come, wakener.$b$bThe council's power will combine to bring an end to the corrupted empress.$b$bThis ritual has not been witnessed in one hundred of your kind's lifetimes - and never by an outsider.$b$bIn exchange for your deeds on our behalf, I invite you to behold this great moment in our history.

PortraitGiverText.text: 返回卡拉克西维斯见证我族帝国的重生吧。
PortraitGiverText.english: Return to Klaxxi'vess and witness the re-making of our empire.

identity.title: Flying Tiger Gourami
identity.objectives: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
identity.description: You've caught a unique fish... with wings.  Perhaps it deserves the expert opinion of Nat Pagle in Anglers Wharf.

PortraitGiverText.text: 也许纳特知道这种罕见的鱼类？
PortraitGiverText.english: Maybe Nat would know more about this rare catch?

identity.title: We Will Rock You
identity.objectives: Slay 10 Orcs at Domination Point.
identity.description: The orcs can NOT be allowed a foothold in this land. They will defile it just as they did Kalimdor.$b$b$p, I need boots on the ground and horde in their graves. Get down to the coastline and bring the full force of Alliance wrath down on their heads!$b$bSlay any orcs you find. Take the wind out of their sails.$b$bFor the King!

Description.text: 我绝不允许兽人在这片土地上获得立锥之地。他们会污染这里，就如同他们在卡利姆多的所作所为。$b$b$p，我这儿正需要人手把部落送进坟墓。快到海岸上去，将联盟的怒火倾泻到他们的头上！$b$b干掉你见到的每一个兽人。让他们闻风丧胆！$b$b为了国王！
Description.english: The orcs can NOT be allowed a foothold in this land. They will defile it just as they did Kalimdor.$b$b$p, I need boots on the ground and horde in their graves. Get down to the coastline and bring the full force of Alliance wrath down on their heads!$b$bSlay any orcs you find. Take the wind out of their sails.$b$bFor the King!

identity.title: A Kind of Magic
identity.objectives: Find the three Scout-o-Matics in Domination Point.
identity.description: Greetings $p! I have heard a lot about your success in the field. I would like to use your services to test my latest "Siege-o-Matic", a device of terrible and varied abilities.$b$bI promise it is mostly harmless to its users.$b$bWhen you are around Domination Point be on the look out for my Scout-o-Meters. They have been dispatched to get info on good siege targets. When you find one, activate it and I will pilot a Siege-o-Matic to your location.$b$bSee you in the field... as it were.

Description.text: 欢迎你，$p！我听说过不少有关你的英勇事迹。我想请你帮忙测试一下我最新的“自动攻城器”，这可是一件具有可怕力量的多功能装置。$b$b我保证，它对使用者是绝对无害的。$b$b当你去统御岗哨时，请注意搜寻我的探查器。我先前已经派它们出去搜集攻击目标的情报。当你找到探查器时，就激活它，而我会把自动攻城器投放到你的位置。$b$b老规矩，我们战场见。
Description.english: Greetings $p! I have heard a lot about your success in the field. I would like to use your services to test my latest "Siege-o-Matic", a device of terrible and varied abilities.$b$bI promise it is mostly harmless to its users.$b$bWhen you are around Domination Point be on the look out for my Scout-o-Meters. They have been dispatched to get info on good siege targets. When you find one, activate it and I will pilot a Siege-o-Matic to your location.$b$bSee you in the field... as it were.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 说话声从某个隐蔽装置中传出。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Broadcasting to you from an assortment of hidden devices.

identity.title: Don't Lose Your Head
identity.objectives: Defeat Stone Guard Ruk'ra, Bombgineer Snicklefritz, and Or'Dac.
identity.description: My probes have detected three very dangerous targets in the courtyard of Domination Keep.$b$bThey have an ogre emissary, a Kor'kron officer, and an insane goblin bomb maker.$B$BMy siege-o-matics are not ready for one on one combat so it is up to you to eliminate the targets.$b$bGood luck! Report back to me on the Skyfire when done.

PortraitGiverText.text: 说话声从某个隐蔽装置中传出。
PortraitGiverText.english: Broadcasting to you from an assortment of hidden devices.

identity.title: Save Our Scouts!
identity.objectives: Rescue the three captured Sunreaver agents within the Ghost Iron Mines, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.
identity.description:
The heavy mogu presence in the mines let us know it was a place of great importance - but we needed to gather more information on their activities there, so we sent agents into the mines to spy on them.

Unfortunately, many were captured, and we've found that some are being tortured in the mines. You have to go rescue them - nobody deserves what they are going through...

And, when you finish, kill whoever captured them. No mercy, $p!

Description.text:
魔古族派重兵把守矿脉的做法表明这是一处重要地点——可我们需要搜集更多有关他们活动的情报。因此我们派了一些密探去打探情报。

不幸的是，许多人都被抓住了。我们发现其中有一些人正在矿脉中遭受折磨。你一定要救救他们——他们正在遭受非人的折磨……

还有，救出他们之后，请你把抓获他们的人都干掉。不要对那些人手软，$p！
Description.english:
The heavy mogu presence in the mines let us know it was a place of great importance - but we needed to gather more information on their activities there, so we sent agents into the mines to spy on them.

Unfortunately, many were captured, and we've found that some are being tortured in the mines. You have to go rescue them - nobody deserves what they are going through...

And, when you finish, kill whoever captured them. No mercy, $p!

identity.title: Kill mogu boss for key, use object behind jumping puzzle

Title.text: 殺死魔古首領取得鑰匙，使用後面的物品解謎@@@
Title.english: Kill mogu boss for key, use object behind jumping puzzle

identity.title: Preventing a Future Threat
identity.objectives: Frighten $1oa Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.
identity.description:
The creatures the Zandalari ride don't start out so big, nor do they start out the vicious and loyal creatures they become.

If you can frighten some of the hatchling skyscreamers away from the beach, perhaps they will have a chance at a real life.

Objectives.text: 在$1oa只啸天雏龙身边奔跑以惊吓它们。
Objectives.english: Frighten $1oa Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.

Title.text: 消灭游荡的巨魔战斗小队

identity.title: Tactical Mana Bombs
identity.objectives: Plant a Tactical Mana Bomb on an Alliance Ship, Alliance Supply Shipment, and on the Construct Ritual.
identity.description: Ah, $p, just the $r I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Violet Rise to the southeast.$b$bHere, take these. I do not trust our standard soldiers with such firepower. Oh... and don't shake them, whatever you do.$b$bPlant one of the Kirin Tor ships, another one near their supplies, and the last on the construct they are building.

Description.text: 啊，$p，你正是我要找的$r。我又得到了一批战术魔法炸弹，需要将它们安放在位于东南边紫罗兰高地对面的关键位置。$b$b这些就交给你了。我不放心让我们的常规步兵接触如此强力的军火。噢……切勿在任何时候摇晃它们。$b$b在其中一艘肯瑞托舰船上安放一枚，在他们的补给品附近安放一枚，最后再在他们正在建造的构造体上安放一枚。
Description.english: Ah, $p, just the $r I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Violet Rise to the southeast.$b$bHere, take these. I do not trust our standard soldiers with such firepower. Oh... and don't shake them, whatever you do.$b$bPlant one of the Kirin Tor ships, another one near their supplies, and the last on the construct they are building.

identity.title: Someone You Should See
identity.objectives: Find Chen Stormstout at Binan Village. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
identity.description: $p? It is good fortune I find you.$b$bChen Stormstout says to give this to you and ask you to meet him at Binan Village of the Kun-Lai Summit.$b$bHe found a friend of yours who needs much luck to get healthy.$B$BChen say speak to Tak-Tak for fast travels.

Description.text: $p？能找到你真是太走运了。$b$b陈·风暴烈酒让我把这个交给你，并要你去昆莱山的滨岸村见他。$b$b他遇见了你的一个朋友。不过那家伙能不能活下去就得看运气了。$b$b陈说，你可以让泰克泰克送你一程。
Description.english: $p? It is good fortune I find you.$b$bChen Stormstout says to give this to you and ask you to meet him at Binan Village of the Kun-Lai Summit.$b$bHe found a friend of yours who needs much luck to get healthy.$B$BChen say speak to Tak-Tak for fast travels.

identity.title: The Horde Is Family
identity.objectives: Escort Thrall to the Echo Isles.
identity.description: This hearthstone was part of a conversation Vol'jin and I shared a long time ago.$b$bHe believes his people are in danger. I don't know what all has transpired in my absence, but I can at least do this for my friend.$b$bCome, $p, travel with me to the Echo Isles. We must make sure that the Darkspear are safe.

Description.text: 这块炉石是我和沃金在很久以前一次谈话中的一部分。$b$b他认为他的人民正处于危险之中。虽然我不知道在我离开的这段时间究竟出了什么事情，但至少这件事我是能为朋友做的。$b$b来吧，$p，跟我去回音群岛。我们必须确保暗矛部族的安全。
Description.english: This hearthstone was part of a conversation Vol'jin and I shared a long time ago.$b$bHe believes his people are in danger. I don't know what all has transpired in my absence, but I can at least do this for my friend.$b$bCome, $p, travel with me to the Echo Isles. We must make sure that the Darkspear are safe.

identity.title: The Monkey King
identity.objectives: Help Anduin Wrynn find the Monkey King in the Valley of Emperors.
identity.description: Ever since the Horde captured the Divine Bell I have been searching for a means to counter its power.$b$bMy research got as far as this tomb. I am going inside. If you follow me, I will share the rest as we go.$b$bIf we get separated, meet me back here at the entrance to the tomb. Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

PortraitGiverText.text: 有时候，打败一个传奇的唯一办法，就是和另一个传奇联手。
PortraitGiverText.english: Sometimes the only way to beat a legend is with another legend.

identity.title: Get My Results!
identity.objectives: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.
identity.description: Ah, $p. The Warchief has instructed me to dispatch you to Silvermoon.$b$bHe grows impatient with the progress of Lor'themar's research and feels they might benefit from your... unique... experiences with the mogu.$b$bGo to Silvermoon and demand that Lor'themar increase the speed of his research.

Description.text: 啊，$p。酋长让我派你去银月城。$b$b他对洛瑟玛的研究进度很不满意，并认为你……对魔古族……的特殊认识或许会对他们有帮助。$b$b所以请你去一趟银月城，命令洛瑟玛加快研究速度。
Description.english: Ah, $p. The Warchief has instructed me to dispatch you to Silvermoon.$b$bHe grows impatient with the progress of Lor'themar's research and feels they might benefit from your... unique... experiences with the mogu.$b$bGo to Silvermoon and demand that Lor'themar increase the speed of his research.

identity.title: The Kirin Tor
identity.objectives: Use the Portal to the Purple Parlor in Lion's Landing and meet with Anduin Wrynn.
identity.description: $p, King Varian has asked that I send you after his son to Dalaran. He believes you can help negotiate the withdrawal of blood elves there.$b$bThese "Sunreavers" claim fealty to the Horde and represent a major threat to the war effort.$b$bNow that our very own Jaina Proudmoore is in charge of the Kirin Tor it should be easy to convince her to remove this Horde threat to her city.$b$bUse the portal here in Lion's Landing to go to the Purple Parlor and lend what aid you can to Prince Anduin.

Description.text: $p，瓦里安国王让我派你跟随他的儿子一起前往达拉然。他相信你能帮忙说服对方驱逐那里的血精灵。$b$b这些“夺日者”忠于部落，对我们的战局是个重大威胁。$b$b肯瑞托现在的领袖吉安娜·普罗德摩尔是我们自己人，要说服她赶走城市中的部落势力应该不难。$b$b你可以使用雄狮港的传送门前往紫色天台，并助安度因王子一臂之力。
Description.english: $p, King Varian has asked that I send you after his son to Dalaran. He believes you can help negotiate the withdrawal of blood elves there.$b$bThese "Sunreavers" claim fealty to the Horde and represent a major threat to the war effort.$b$bNow that our very own Jaina Proudmoore is in charge of the Kirin Tor it should be easy to convince her to remove this Horde threat to her city.$b$bUse the portal here in Lion's Landing to go to the Purple Parlor and lend what aid you can to Prince Anduin.

identity.title: The Harmonic Ointment
identity.objectives: Recover the Harmonic Ointment.
identity.description: Legends are not born, they are made.$b$BMuch like your next target, a mogu named "The Blade." $b$BIn his bags you will find,$b$bAn ointment whose sound plays with the mind.$b$bBring this nibby ointment to the Monkey King!$b$bAnd with it, he shall make the mallet sing!$b$bTravel north along the wall, and when you reach the end, turn left.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这名魔古刺客使用一种黑色的药膏，通过谐和的声率来杀戮他的敌人。
PortraitGiverText.english: This mogu assassin uses an ointment of dark, harmonic power to slay his opponents.

identity.title: Demonstrate Your Power
identity.objectives: Slay the demons who are attacking Akama's men in the Halls of Anguish.
identity.description: Akama and his men are under siege by the forces you unleashed in the Reliquary of Souls. $B$BDemonstrate your power to Akama by saving his men from the demonic forces!

AreaDescription.text: 在阿卡玛的手下死亡前击败恶魔
AreaDescription.english: Defeat the Demons before Akama's men are slain

identity.title: The Harmonic Mallet
identity.objectives: Find Anduin at the Tomb of Conquerors. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
identity.description: $p! Prince Anduin has somehow slipped his guards again. His control over the light is greatly increasing.$b$bHe was last seen heading to Kun-Lai Summit. He gave our mages the slip around the Valley of Emperors.$b$bCan you find him? He insists on searching for what he claims is a counter to the Divine Bell. Perhaps you can talk some sense into him before he seizes control of your mind and has you dance your way back here.$B$BTalk to Fennie for a ride into the mountains.

Description.text: $p！安度因王子不知怎么的又把他的警卫们给甩掉了。他对圣光的控制力正与日俱增。$b$b最后一次见到他的时候，他正前往昆莱山。他是在皇帝谷附近把我们的法师甩掉的。$b$b你能找找他吗？他坚持要去找那个所谓的能克制圣钟的东西。或许你可以在他控制你的心灵并让你一路手舞足蹈地跑回来之前，好好劝劝他。$B$B去和范妮谈谈，让她直接送你一程吧。
Description.english: $p! Prince Anduin has somehow slipped his guards again. His control over the light is greatly increasing.$b$bHe was last seen heading to Kun-Lai Summit. He gave our mages the slip around the Valley of Emperors.$b$bCan you find him? He insists on searching for what he claims is a counter to the Divine Bell. Perhaps you can talk some sense into him before he seizes control of your mind and has you dance your way back here.$B$BTalk to Fennie for a ride into the mountains.

identity.title: Trapping the Leader
identity.objectives: Weaken and capture Shan Kien at the Tomb of Shadows in Kun-Lai Summit.
identity.description:
It is time to make our move. Go to the Tomb of Shadows, weaken him, and take him captive.

I will stay here in case Garrosh arrives. He must be delayed so that we can take our prize before he destroys it in his anger.

Hurry!

PortraitGiverText.text: 寇茹魔古的首领。活捉他！
PortraitGiverText.english: The leader of the Korune. Take him alive!

identity.title: Pandaren Spirit Tamer
identity.objectives: Defeat all of the Pandaren Spirits in a pet battle.
identity.description: Legend tells of legendary pandaren spirits that roam the lands of Pandaria.  Find them and defeat them in a pet battle.

PortraitGiverText.text: 打败那些古灵！
PortraitGiverText.english: Take out those spirits!

CompletionLog.text: 到荊棘谷找林格·巴斯貝特。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Riggle Bassbait in Stranglethorn Vale.

CompletionLog.text: 到荊棘谷找林格·巴斯貝特。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Riggle Bassbait in Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: With the Wind's Blessing...
identity.objectives: Collect Charms of Good Fortune.
identity.description: <An urgent plea reaches your ears.>$b$b$n! My father's fleet is making its way to Pandaria. With favorable winds, they could arrive any moment.$b$bThe Pandaren have a blessing that will give us good luck with the weather and speed our ships to these shores. We just need to collect charms of good fortune to make it happen.$b$bAs our ships draw closer to the island, less charms will be required. But if you have enough, we can speed them here right away...

PortraitGiverText.text: 王子的召唤……
PortraitGiverText.english: A summons from the Prince...

identity.title: With the Wind's Blessing...
identity.objectives: Collect Charms of Good Fortune.
identity.description: <An urgent plea reaches your ears.>$b$b$n! The Horde fleet is making its way to Pandaria. With favorable winds, they could arrive any moment.$b$bThe Pandaren have a blessing that will give us good luck with the weather and speed our brothers and sisters to these shores. We simply need to collect charms of good fortune to gain fortune's favor.$b$bAs our ships draw closer to the island, less charms will be required. But if you have enough, we can speed them here right away...

PortraitGiverText.text: 烈日行者的召唤……
PortraitGiverText.english: A summons from the Sunwalker...

identity.title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
identity.objectives: Speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
identity.description: Ahhh, it seems you have found yourself the proud owner of a majestic cloud serpent.$B$BBefore you may fly the skies on this powerful creature, you must first earn the skill to ride it.$B$BThe Order of the Cloud Serpent can teach you the knowledge that you seek.$B$BIf you wish to follow our way, you should speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest.$B$BI wish you luck, $r.

PortraitGiverText.text: 只有少数人才能获得骑上云端翔龙的荣誉。
PortraitGiverText.english: To ride a cloud serpent is a privilege given to few.

Title.text: 追蹤事件:玩家回到從前
Title.english: Tracking Event: Player is Back in Time

identity.title: Honor the Flame
identity.objectives: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Dread Wastes.
identity.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?

AreaDescription.text: 祭拜恐惧废土的仲夏篝火。
AreaDescription.english: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Dread Wastes.

identity.title: Skin of the Saurok
identity.objectives: Go to Ihgaluk Crag and slay a Skumblade saurok.
identity.description: Ihgaluk Crag is a dangerous place. Luckily, you have the magic of the Sunreavers behind you.$b$bI can transform you into a saurok.$b$bI will perform the first half of the illusion on you now. Afterwards, you should go directly to Ihgaluk Crag and slay one of the Skumblade saurok. Once you have done this, I will contact you and complete the second half of the illusion.

PortraitTurnInText.english: I will transform you to look like a saurok.

identity.title: Preventing a Future Threat
identity.objectives: Frighten $1oa Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.
identity.description:
It pains me to think of the torture the poor skyscreamers  must endure as the trolls train them to become implements of war.

The hatchlings are quite fearful, and will fly away if you even get close them. Please, frighten some away before the Zandalari corrupt them.

Objectives.text: 在$1oa只啸天雏龙身边奔跑以惊吓它们。
Objectives.english: Frighten $1oa Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.

identity.title: Skin of the Saurok
identity.objectives: Go to Ihgaluk Crag and slay a Skumblade saurok.
identity.description: Ihgaluk Crag is a dangerous place. Luckily, you have the magic of the Kirin Tor behind you.$b$bI can transform you into a saurok.$b$bI will perform the first half of the illusion on you now. Afterwards, you should go directly to Ihgaluk Crag and slay one of the Skumblade saurok. Once you have done this, I will contact you and complete the second half of the illusion.

PortraitTurnInText.english: I will transform you to look like a saurok.

identity.title: Life Blood
identity.objectives: Use the Attuned Crystal to retrieve the Remnants of the Animus from the Dark Animus within the Throne of Thunder.
identity.description: Scouts unearthed this strange construct hidden within the Lightning Vein Mine. A secret weapon of the Thunder King no doubt.$b$bPerhaps, there is a chance we can use this discovery to our benefit. If we can re-animate it, we can study it. More importantly, we can discover its weakness.$b$bGo to the Throne of Thunder and use this crystal to capture whatever essence animates these constructs.$b$bReturn to me when the task is complete.

identity.title: The Zandalari Prophecy
identity.objectives: Bring The Zandalari Prophecy to Lorewalker Cho.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bI have read your reports on the Zandalari and believe I have some clues as to their most recent aggression.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Description.text: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我已经读过了你关于赞达拉巨魔的报告，并确信我已经拼凑出他们近期进攻的线索。$b$b如果你能到锦绣谷的闻道之座来一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
Description.english: Dear $p,$b$bI have read your reports on the Zandalari and believe I have some clues as to their most recent aggression.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

identity.title: Rumbles of Thunder
identity.objectives: Bring the Rumbles of Thunder to Lorewalker Cho.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bThe foreboding sound of thunder has haunted my people for generations. And as you have discovered in your own research, Lei Shen is at the heart of that fear.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Description.text: 亲爱的$p，$b$b滚雷的不详之音令我一代又一代的族人饱受困扰。正如你在自己研究中发现的那样，雷神正是那恐惧的源头所在。$b$b如果你能到锦绣谷的闻道之座来一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
Description.english: Dear $p,$b$bThe foreboding sound of thunder has haunted my people for generations. And as you have discovered in your own research, Lei Shen is at the heart of that fear.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

identity.title: Gods and Monsters
identity.objectives: Bring the Gods and Monsters to Lorewalker Cho.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bIs it true that the mogu are really connected to the titans? I find this very hard to believe. But looking over your research, some of the truth about the mogu begins to take shape.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Description.text: 亲爱的$p，$b$b魔古族当真与泰坦存在着某种关联吗？这简直太令人难以置信了。但在看过了你的研究报告后，关于魔古族的部分真相开始浮出水面。$b$b如果你能到锦绣谷的闻道之座来一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓

identity.title: Beasts of Fable
identity.objectives: Defeat the Elite Battle Pets of the Pandaren fables.
identity.description: Have you ever read the great Pandaren book of fables?  Pandaren pass these stories on to their cubs - stories of the cricket and the hawk, or the slow-moving turtle - to teach them lessons that they will find useful in life. What few cubs know is that these creatures exist, here, in Pandaria! Though the stories of their travels are made up, they are powerful denizens of this world. Should you happen upon them in your travels, you may test the might of your pets against their storied statures.

PortraitGiverText.text: 打败那些寓言之兽！
PortraitGiverText.english: Take on the fabled beasts!

identity.title: Tactical Mana Bombs
identity.objectives: Plant a Tactical Mana Bomb on a Sunreaver ship, the Scrying Crystals, and on the most inland bridge of Dawnseeker Promontory.
identity.description: Ah, $p, just the $r I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Dawnseeker Promontory to the northwest.$b$bHere, take these. It is time to give the Sunreavers a taste of their own medicine.$b$bPlant one on the Sunreaver ships, another one on their scrying crystals, and the last on the bridge that connects to their forward base.

Description.text: 啊，$p，你正是我要找的$r。我又得到了一批战术魔法炸弹，需要将它们安放在位于西北边寻晨者海角对面的关键位置。$b$b这些就交给你了。是时候让夺日者尝尝自己酿下的苦果。$b$b在其中一艘夺日者舰船上安放一枚，在他们的占卜水晶上安放一枚，最后再在通往他们前沿基地的桥梁上安放一枚。

identity.description: The time to attack the Thunder King has come!$b$bA small group of Sunreavers awaits you near the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.$b$bReport to Scout Captain Elsia for further instructions.

identity.title: Thunder Calls
identity.objectives: Report to Vereesa Windrunner at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description: The time to attack the Thunder King has come!$b$bA small group of Kirin Tor awaits you near the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.$b$bReport to Vereesa Windrunner for further instructions.

identity.title: Something Foul is Afoot
identity.objectives: Seek and destroy Flesh'rok the Diseased.
identity.description: You notice a stronger-than-usual smell permeating from ahead. Your stomach lurches as the thick smell fills your nostrils.$b $bYou recognize this smell, it's saurok. Rotting, discarded saurok flesh infused with the foul waste of the sewer.

PortraitGiverText.text: 弗赖什鲁克在远处怪笑并呻吟着。
PortraitGiverText.english: Flesh'rok gurgles and moans in the distance.

identity.title: Agony and Anima
identity.objectives: Slay Archritualist Kelada.
identity.description: You notice the initials A.K. skillfully and with calligraphic precision engraved onto the side of the Animus.$b$bBefore you stands Archritualist Kelada, the shaper of the Animus. By command of the Thunder King, Kelada worked tirelessly to craft the perfect vessel to harness the great power of the anima. Something functional, magnificent, sentient, but most importantly... something deadly.$b$bHe must be stopped before his next imagination is brought to life by the Thunder King.

PortraitGiverText.text: 大祭师克拉达愤怒地凝视着你。
PortraitGiverText.english: Archritualist Kelada glares at you indignantly.

identity.title: Zao'cho the Wicked
identity.objectives: Slay Zao'cho.
identity.description: Electricity hums in the distance, tickling your ears and sending impulses down your spine. Your fingers go numb, and  your heart races as you approach the door ahead.$b$bZao'cho stands arrogantly atop the steps ahead, weaving lightning between his fingers and smirking at you with demented glee.

PortraitGiverText.text: 径直凝视曹卓眼中的闪电，令你感到眼睛刺痛。
PortraitGiverText.english: Looking directly into the lightning in Zao'cho's eyes is painful.

identity.title: Rocks Fall, People Die
identity.objectives: Slay the Rocky Horror.
identity.description: Words fail to describe the massive horror of rock, bone, and blood that rumbles mindlessly and aimlessly ahead of you.$b $bMassive earthquakes crack the seemingly hollow shell of ground beneath the figure, leaving destruction in its wake. It appears that the creature is unaware of your presence.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在古代，也许有人会把这只生物当作低阶神祗来崇拜。
PortraitGiverText.english: In ancient times, one may have worshipped this creature as a lesser god.

identity.title: Taming the Tempest
identity.objectives: Slay No'ku Stormsayer.
identity.description: You hear a fierce and militant voice roaring in the distance. A crackling storm swells and swirls around a clouded, shadowy figure. Lightning flashes and No'ku Stormsayer appears, his scornful gaze aimed directly at you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 当诺库穿过庭院时，闪电如卷须般在他脚下环绕。
PortraitGiverText.english: Tendrils of lightning arc from No'ku's feet as he passes through the courtyard.

identity.title: Requiem for a Queen
identity.objectives: Put Monara to rest.
identity.description: A chilling breeze sweeps across your body, bringing with it a haunting drape of sadness. Your soul sinks as you hear the faint, melodic cries of Monara, the last Queen of the Mogu.$b$bHer sweet requiem creeps through the air, bending and shaping itself into a spectral hand, reaching for your heart. As it grabs hold, you see a brief flash of Monara's last moments... her brutal murder by the hand of Lei Shen.$b$bSong turns to sadness and Monara weeps, wailing louder and louder into the darkness.

PortraitGiverText.text: 莫纳拉——现知最后一位魔古皇后。
PortraitGiverText.english: Monara, the last known Queen of the Mogu.

identity.title: Eyes of the Thunder King
identity.objectives: Defeat the ambush!
identity.description: As the fog dissipates from the fallen sentries, you feel a sudden rumbling.$b$bThe rocks blocking the sewer tunnels tumble forward and crash into the outflow tanks below, as four putrid eyes lunge from the darkness.

PortraitGiverText.text: 坚定之眼扭动着。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Unblinking Eye twitches.

identity.title: Mogu Runes of Fate
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.
identity.description: Greetings, $n. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Mogu Rune of Fate, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently inside the palace of the Thunder King.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa枚次级好运护符。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.

identity.title: Wrath of Gronn
identity.objectives: Release $1oa Captive Gronn.
identity.description: The Thunderlord are capturing gronn for the Iron Horde. Show these fools why gronn are NOT pets. $b$bFollow us into Grulloc's Grotto and sunder the chains of the captive gronn. Let the beasts seek to gain their own vengeance against the Thunderlord.$b$bMeet us at Grulloc's Lair beneath the grotto when you are done.

Objectives.text: 释放$1oa个被俘的戈隆。
Objectives.english: Release $1oa Captive Gronn.

identity.title: Articles of the Fallen
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Fallen Frostwolf Artifacts.
identity.description: Even when on a mission of vengeance we must remember to uphold the honor that is required of a member of the Frostwolves.$b$bIn the grotto below are the fallen corpses of many good Frostwolf orcs. They must be remembered.$b$bWhile you carry out Ga'nar's task, look for articles of our fallen brethren. Bring these articles to me so that I might pass them to a shaman for final burial as is our tradition.

Objectives.text: 找回$1oa件霜狼烈士遗物。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Fallen Frostwolf Artifacts.

identity.title: Battlefield: Barrens
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.
identity.description: Ya want we work together on dis, ya gotta earn me trust.$b$bIn Northern Barrens, de Kor'kron be massin' for war. Hellscream's goons be stockpilin' lumber, oil, stone, an' meat. Supplies de Darkspear want ta use against' 'im.$b$bGo to de Barrens. Kill de Kor'kron. Bring me dem supplies! Fight dem wherever dey spring up, escort supply caravans, group up ta take down de dangerous ones. Whatever ya gotta do.$b$bProve ta me da Alliance wants dis! I be watchin'.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份库卡隆木材，$2oa份库卡隆原油，$3oa份库卡隆食用肉和$4oa份库卡隆石料。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.

identity.title: Complete "The Dark Heart of Pandaria" Scenario

Title.text: 完成“潘达利亚的黑暗之心”场景战役
Title.english: Complete "The Dark Heart of Pandaria" Scenario

identity.title: Battlefield: Barrens
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.
identity.description: Ta take down de warchief, I be needin' an army an' supplies. I got me an army. No shortage of hate for what Hellscream done to de Horde. But supplies! Lumber, stone, meat, oil. Dis be what we need.$b$bHellscream's Kor'kron be stockpilin' supplies in Northern Barrens, to de west. Kill de Kor'kron! Fight dem wherever dey spring up. Help our tauren bruddahs by escortin' their caravans, an' group up to take down Kor'kron leaders. Whatever it takes. Get me dem supplies!

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份库卡隆木材，$2oa份库卡隆原油，$3oa份库卡隆食用肉和$4oa份库卡隆石料。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.

identity.title: They Rely on Numbers
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Thunderlord at Daggermaw Ravine in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description: Thunderlord spend their days training to hunt as a team, but as individuals they are weak. Their only strength is in numbers.$b$bSo... to win, we must cull their numbers.$b$bAs we move up through the Daggermaw Ravine, slay any Thunderlord who stand in your way, and their clan will be made the weaker for it.

Objectives.text: 在霜火岭的刀喉峡谷消灭$1oa个雷神成员。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Thunderlord at Daggermaw Ravine in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: Garrison Campaign: Farseer's Rock
identity.objectives: Find Draka and Drek'Thar at Farseer's Rock in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description: Draka and Drek'Thar are travelling to Farseer's Rock. It is a sacred place, not a safe one. But Draka insists that Drek'Thar must rebuild his connection to the elements.$b$bI can feel the spirits of this land are becoming restless. Something is about to happen, and I suspect these two will need all the help they can get.$b$bPlease, $p, go to them and lend what aid you can. I care for these two a great deal.

Description.text: 德拉卡和德雷克塔尔正在前往先知岩。那是个神圣的地方，可是并不安全。可德拉卡坚称德雷克塔尔必须重建他与元素的联结。$b$b我能感觉到这片土地上的鬼魂变得焦躁不安。将要有事发生，这两个人肯定会需要帮助。$b$b拜托你了，$p，快去找他们，尽你所能提供帮助吧。他们的安全对我来说至关重要。
Description.english: Draka and Drek'Thar are travelling to Farseer's Rock. It is a sacred place, not a safe one. But Draka insists that Drek'Thar must rebuild his connection to the elements.$b$bI can feel the spirits of this land are becoming restless. Something is about to happen, and I suspect these two will need all the help they can get.$b$bPlease, $p, go to them and lend what aid you can. I care for these two a great deal.

identity.title: Only the Winner
identity.objectives: Collect Sky-Singer Strag's Totem.
identity.description: I am Gronnstalker Rokash, and I only serve the winning side.$b$bI have heard of some of your deeds, commander, and seen the corpses left in the wake of you and your forces.$b$bI have grown tired of my current clan. They are soft, weak, and losing.$b$bI offer you this challenge: enter Colossal's Fall to the north and slay Sky-Singer Strag. Claim her totem as a trophy and I will hail you as my new chieftain.

PortraitGiverText.text: 她代表铁狼挥斥方遒。
PortraitGiverText.english: She commands on behalf of the Iron Wolf.

identity.title: Fury of Frostfire
identity.objectives: Defeat Kron.
identity.description: The moment I begin the ritual to free Exurotus you can expect Kron to be drawn to us. $b$bIt would normally take an army of seasoned warriors to defeat a magnaron. We have only the three of us.$b$bLook for my fire totem upon the battlefield. I will try to gain what boons I can from Exurotus. Step near the totems and become one with the Fury.$b$bWith these boons, slay Kron! Lok'tar ogar!

PortraitGiverText.text: 灭焰者
PortraitGiverText.english: The Flame Breaker

identity.title: The Iron Wolf
identity.objectives: Enter the Hunter's Hall in Grom'gar and defeat the Iron Wolf.
identity.description: My brother Ga'nar stands beside me.$B$BWor'gol, Stonefang, and your garrison hold strong.$B$BOur clan is united, and the Thunderlord are already on the run. We are ready. The time has come to face this "Iron Wolf."

PortraitGiverText.text: 雷神氏族督军
PortraitGiverText.english: Warlord of the Thunderlord Clan

identity.title: Collect Karabor Axes
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Karabor Weapons.
identity.description: Some of our bravest champions have fallen today.$b$bTo make matters worse the Iron Horde has started using our own weapons against us. $b$bThe idea of my people being slain with the weapons forged by our ancestors makes me sick.$b$b$n, could you please retrieve these weapons and bring them back to me?

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个卡拉波武器。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Karabor Weapons.

identity.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
identity.objectives: Kill Zugunk Poisonfiend
identity.description: Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.$b$bHe has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.

identity.title: On the Offensive
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadowmoon Darkcasters or Shadowmoon Voidclaws.
identity.description: We cannot enter these gates, but you can, $c.$B$BYour mission is critical, and the Shadowmoon will kill you on sight. Do not hesitate to return the favor.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个影月暗法师或影月灵爪战士。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Shadowmoon Darkcasters or Shadowmoon Voidclaws.

identity.title: Secrets of the Timeless Isle
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Timeless Coins from creatures and events on the Timeless Isle.
identity.description: There is a currency minted only on this island - "timeless coins." They are immune to the island's temporal distortions... I would like to figure out why.$b$bGather some for me! Venture into the jungles of this forgotten paradise. Destroy the mysterious foes who lurk in this timeless place, discover hidden caches of treasure, and explore forgotten treasure hoards - whatever it takes. I will be waiting!

Objectives.text: 从永恒岛的怪物身上和事件中收集$1oa枚永恒铸币。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Timeless Coins from creatures and events on the Timeless Isle.

identity.title: Bad Feeling, Worse Result
identity.objectives: Defeat the Ghost of Lin Da-Gu.
identity.description: <As you open the scroll, you realize your worst fears have come true: the sha energies have corrupted the Lin recipe.>$B$B<Your only choice is to defeat the released energies in the hope that the scroll can be saved.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 击败林大顾的鬼魂！
PortraitGiverText.english: Defeat the Ghost of Lin Da-Gu!

identity.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa poisonous bunnies
identity.description: A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.$B$BIt might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

Objectives.text: 焚烧$1oa只中毒的兔子
Objectives.english: Burn $1oa poisonous bunnies

identity.title: Bounty: Twisted Ancient
identity.objectives: Collect Corrupted Lumber from a Twisted Ancient.
identity.description: The ancients of the Cursed Woods have been corrupted by demonic magic. Since they need to be destroyed, we might as well make use of their resources. Waste not, want not.$B$BBeware: these woodland behemoths are no easy targets. Gather trusted friends before you engage these twisted ancients.$B$B-- Baros Alexston

PortraitGiverText.text: 收集一根腐化的木材作为证明。
PortraitGiverText.english: Collect corrupted lumber as proof.

identity.title: A Curse Upon the Woods
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa fel-cursed creatures in the Cursed Woods.
identity.description: Cordana tells me that the creatures of the woods are cursed by the same fel energies keeping Khadgar from scrying into the orc village.$B$BThis will not do.$B$BIf we were on Azeroth, I could find a cure in a reasonable timeframe. However, we are not, nor do we have the luxury of time.$B$BBetter to put a swift end to their suffering rather than allow these poor creatures to linger with demonic energy.

Objectives.text: 在诅咒林地里消灭$1oa个被邪能诅咒的生物。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa fel-cursed creatures in the Cursed Woods.

identity.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa poisonous bunnies
identity.description: A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.$B$BIt might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

Objectives.text: 焚烧$1oa只中毒的兔子
Objectives.english: Burn $1oa poisonous bunnies

identity.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa poisonous bunnies
identity.description: A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.$B$BIt might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

Objectives.text: 焚烧$1oa只中毒的兔子
Objectives.english: Burn $1oa poisonous bunnies

identity.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
identity.objectives: Kill Zugunk Poisonfiend
identity.description: Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.$b$bHe has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.

identity.title: Gut Guttra
identity.objectives: Slay Guttra Wolfchew.
identity.description: Snowpaw was able to help me to here so that I might strike against their leader, Guttra, but I have lost too much blood. My time is near.$b$bDo you have the strength to help me avenge my fallen brothers and sisters and kill Guttra Wolfchew?$b$bThe monster resides in the tallest tower of Grimfrost.

identity.title: Warforged Seals
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.
identity.description: Greetings, $n. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Warforged Seal, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently as you pursue Garrosh.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa枚次级好运护符。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.

identity.title: Warforged Seals
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.
identity.description: Greetings, $n. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Warforged Seal, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently as you pursue Garrosh and his forces.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa枚次级好运护符。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.

identity.title: Cleaning Up Gul'var
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadow Council orcs at Gul'var.
identity.description: Just because we need to focus on Gul'dan doesn't mean we're not going to take down the Shadow Council in the process.$B$BThis village is filthy with Shadow Council villains. Let's do something about them.

Objectives.text: 在古尔瓦消灭$1oa个暗影议会兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Shadow Council orcs at Gul'var.

identity.title: Noodle Time
identity.objectives: Queue for and complete a shift at the Halfhill noodle stand.
identity.description: Hello, $n. Care to work the noodle stand again?$B$BJust let me know when you're ready to work another shift and I'll get everything set up.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 干得好！人们一听说你要制作汤面，就马上变得胃口大开。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Great work! Everyone always loves it when they hear that you'll be making noodle soup.

identity.title: Heart On Fire
identity.objectives: Collect the Fiery Heart from Krosnis.
identity.description: We have the shards, but now they must be combined. There's a forge here, but even its fires aren't hot enough for our purposes.$B$BHowever, there is a demon nearby that burns hot as the sun.$B$BGul'dan, or perhaps Razuun, has managed to summon an infernal. The thing calls itself Krosnis, which means "furnace."$B$BThe demon's heart burns hotly enough. All you need do is collect it.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭地狱火，并取回它的烈焰之心。
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay the infernal and take its fiery heart.

identity.title: Time In Your Hands
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Timeless Coins and introduce yourself to Mistweaver Ai and Mistweaver Ku.
identity.description: Inhabitants of this strange island barter with a special currency, immune from the fickle fluctuations of time.$b$bYou would do well to gather as many of these "timeless coins" as possible! They can be found hidden away in small caches, or gathered from creatures all around the island. Larger, rarer creatures are a better source of coins - you may find it profitable to venture forth as part of a group.$b$bIntroduce yourself to Mistweavers Ai and Ku across the Celestial Court, and gather some coins for me.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个永恒铸币，并向织雾者艾莉和织雾者顾严介绍你自己。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Timeless Coins and introduce yourself to Mistweaver Ai and Mistweaver Ku.

identity.title: Cleaning Up Gul'var
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadow Council orcs at Gul'var.
identity.description: Khadgar wants you to concentrate on Gul'dan, but that doesn't mean we're not going to take down the Shadow Council in the process.$B$BGul'var's filthy with Shadow Council villains. Let's do something about them.

Objectives.text: 在古尔瓦消灭$1oa个暗影议会兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Shadow Council orcs at Gul'var.

identity.title: Game of Thorns
identity.objectives: Kill King Deathbloom.
identity.description: <Jarrod is clearly injured. He winces in pain as he begins to talk.>$b$bMy lead forest operator, Shelly... she is being held not far from here...

identity.title: Armed and Dangerous
identity.objectives: Give weapons to $1oa Frostwolf Slaves.
identity.description: Ligra was sent with extra weapons to equip enslaved Frostwolves.$b$bArm the Frostwolf Slaves so they can cut their way from their slavers.

Objectives.text: 把武器送到$1oa位霜狼奴隶手上。
Objectives.english: Give weapons to $1oa Frostwolf Slaves.

identity.title: Noodle Time: Bonus
identity.objectives: Queue for a shift at the Halfhill noodle stand, then complete the bonus objective.
identity.description: Hello, $n. Think you're a truly extraordinary noodle chef?$B$BLet's see what you've got!

PortraitTurnInText.text: 你真是个顶呱呱的汤面大厨！再接再厉！
PortraitTurnInText.english: You truly are an amazing Noodle Chef! Keep up the good work!

identity.title: The Butcher of Bladespire
identity.objectives: Slay Dorogg the Ruthless.
identity.description: After Ga'nar advanced into the fortress, the Bladespire unleashed a giant creature on our forces.$b$bI am still weak after using my magic, but at least I can help this orc in her recovery.$b$bHelp take Dorogg down, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 刀塔屠夫
PortraitGiverText.english: Bladespire Butcher

identity.title: Eatercology
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Motes of Frostfire.
identity.description: Drek'Thar thinks the portions of Exurotus consumed by the goren might be worthless. I am not about to step before the fury without at least trying to recover as many of these "motes" as possible.$b$bSlay any goren you find at Magnarok and see if you can extract the motes of Frostfire from them.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个霜火微粒。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Motes of Frostfire.

identity.title: The Fall of the Warlord
identity.objectives: Kill Warlord Bult.
identity.description: You've managed to survive this long, stranger. All that remains to be done here is to fell the Warlord of the arena.$b$bThis will be your first true test here. Bult would provide a challenge to even a battle-hardened Frostwolf.$b$bPlace the heads you've collected on spikes in the Frostfire Arena. They are sure to enrage the warlord and lure him into battle.$b$bCome out of the arena victorious and it will show that Durotan's trust in you was not misplaced.

identity.title: The Farseer
identity.objectives: Get to the Pool of Visions and kill Warleader Gargrak.
identity.description: The Thunderlord warleader... $n, you have to stop him.$B$BHe went to attack Drek'Thar at the Pool of Visions to the northwest!

PortraitGiverText.text: 在他杀死先知德雷克塔尔之前干掉他！
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill him before he kills Farseer Drek'Thar!

identity.title: Unexpected Assault
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Bonechewer Orcs and direct $2oa Auchenai to safety in the Court of Souls.
identity.description: My scouts have reported that the Bonechewer clan is attacking Auchindoun, $n. The Auchenai guard are here, but I fear they won't be enough.$B$BI sense a dark presence nearby... we cannot chance leaving their defenses weak. Too much power lies within those hallowed halls.$B$BSlay the Bonechewer and direct any of the Auchenai injured back to their defensive line. I will direct my scouts throughout the area to try to ascertain the Bonechewers' motives.

Objectives.text: 在英灵之庭里消灭$1oa个噬骨兽人并指挥$2oa个奥金尼人前往安全地点。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Bonechewer Orcs and direct $2oa Auchenai to safety in the Court of Souls.

identity.title: The Ritual
identity.objectives: Kill Amnennar the Coldbringer.
identity.description: You are good to have come so quickly.  I must ask you to put your lives in danger once more in order to save Kalimdor.$B$BAmnennar's apprentice, Death Speaker Blackthorn, hopes to return his master to the realm of the living!  We must quickly make our way atop the Spiral of Thorns and defeat him before the ritual can be completed.  We must strike together, only with our combined force can we hope to stop him!

PortraitGiverText.text: 当心他强大的魔法！
PortraitGiverText.english: Be wary of his powerful magic!

identity.title: Felblood
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Felblood Samples by killing Stormreaver Fearmongers in the Court of Lights in Talador.
identity.description: Fascinating. The doomguard in the courtyard southwest of here have disguised themselves as orcs and do not die when defeated in battle.$B$BYou see, they are powerful magical beings, and their essence manifests nearby as a blood creature that revives its body upon reaching it.$B$BI would like to study these essences without dealing with the demons myself. Bring me a few samples, would you?

Objectives.text: 在塔拉多的光辉庭院里消灭暴掠威慑者，取得$1oa份魔血样本。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Felblood Samples by killing Stormreaver Fearmongers in the Court of Lights in Talador.

identity.title: These Colors Don't Run
identity.objectives: Use $1oa Frostwolf Banners on Bladespire Ogre corpses.
identity.description: Bladespire has been a plague on my people for many years.$b$bThat ends today!$b$bNow to explain it to the ogres in a way they will understand.$b$bIf you still wish to help us, place our banner in the corpses of our adversaries. $b$bTheir courage will falter as they behold a field of Frostwolf trophies!$b$bThis is our way. I will meet with you ahead when you have completed this deed.

Objectives.text: 把$1oa面霜狼军旗插到刀塔食人魔的尸体上。
Objectives.english: Use $1oa Frostwolf Banners on Bladespire Ogre corpses.

identity.title: Last Steps
identity.objectives: Climb the chain and kill Gorr'thog.
identity.description: In a rage, Ga'nar ascended to fight Gorr'thog, the ogre king.$b$bHe is alone, and the ramp to the throne room is now blocked.$b$bYou've proven resourceful. Perhaps you could find another way up?$b$bI sustained wounds on my way here, but I will work to cut my way through and up the ramp so we may rejoin.$b$bHurry traveler, ensure that the Frostwolf clan wins our assault on the citadel.

PortraitGiverText.text: 刀塔堡垒之王。
PortraitGiverText.english: Lord of Bladespire Citadel.

identity.title: The Laughing Skull
identity.objectives: Find a Laughing Skull clansman.
identity.description: Ah, $p, good. I need someone who is not of my clan to negotiate with the Laughing Skull.$b$bWe could use their help navigating this land, but they are dangerous and unpredictable, much like Gorgrond itself.$b$bFollow this road and seek out someone willing to speak with you.$b$bPerhaps they will see you as something new and be willing to talk first and stab later.

Description.text: 啊，$p，很好。我需要派个外族人去和嘲颅氏族谈判。$b$b我们可以让他们帮忙带路，可他们跟戈尔隆德一样，既危险又难以预料。$b$b顺着这条路往前走，看看你能不能找到愿意与你交谈的人。$b$b也许他们能用全新的眼光审视你，并愿意等你开口说完话再动手。
Description.english: Ah, $p, good. I need someone who is not of my clan to negotiate with the Laughing Skull.$b$bWe could use their help navigating this land, but they are dangerous and unpredictable, much like Gorgrond itself.$b$bFollow this road and seek out someone willing to speak with you.$b$bPerhaps they will see you as something new and be willing to talk first and stab later.

identity.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Acidtooth Devourers.
identity.description: We... we left the goren alone for too long. They have grown bold and forgotten who we are.$b$bKill them! Kill them all. Rip them apart until they scream. Remind them what happens to anyone who tries to attack a Laughing Skull village.$b$bOh, and welcome to Gorgrond.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个酸齿吞噬者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Acidtooth Devourers.

identity.title: We Die Laughing!
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Laughing Skull Masks.
identity.description: Are you here to help or hinder?$b$bThis village is being eaten, and we must move quickly to salvage what we can.$b$bGather the masks of our fallen Laughing Skull brothers and sisters and meet me on the western side of the village.$b$bI will need them if our clan is to rebuild.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个嘲颅面具。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Laughing Skull Masks.

Title.text: 戰利品：格古阿克的黑曜脊骨

identity.title: Eye Candy
identity.objectives: Collect Skothwa's Eye.
identity.description: You! Get in the fight or get out of our way.$b$bThis is no ordinary goren attack. Look over there, a gronnling is sacking our grubhall. That hunchbacked gorebucket bit a chunk out of my lovely Marrow!$b$bRip the eye out of its forehead and bring it to me.$b$bThat should buy me enough time to get her clear of this goren hole.

PortraitGiverText.text: 噬颅者
PortraitGiverText.english: The Skull Eater

identity.title: Pyrophobia
identity.objectives: Slay Sun-Sage Kairyx.
identity.description: W- we have done n-n-nothing to provoke the arakkoa... w-why would they attack Aruuna? What do they want from us?$B$BI want to run, but I'm... too afraid. That leader of theirs will burn me to a crisp, I just know it!$B$BH-he's just inside the inn...

identity.title: Kura's Vengeance
identity.objectives: Slay Wing-Guard Kuuan in Veil Shadar.
identity.description: I was a wing-guard myself, once upon a time.$B$BOne afternoon, I was caught away from my post. I just wanted an hour to watch the festival... Kuuan was supposed to cover for me, but instead he sold me out to gain favor with our superiors.$B$BThey plucked my eyes, broke my wings, and threw me off the spire.$B$BYet I am the fortunate one, for if Iskar hadn't found me, I'd have died there. And now Kuuan shows his face in Veil Shadar on the same day that you show up willing to kill for coin. Fortunate, indeed.

Title.text: 任务：打破堕落的逝网蛛卵

identity.title: A Flare for the Dramatic
identity.objectives: Shoot Penny's Flare Gun while in Deadgrin.
identity.description:
I received a strange object with a note attached. Here, it seems to be written in your tongue, commander.

<Dear Mister Durotan,

I'm Penny... you know, from Azeroth? We met briefly back at $p's garrison. 

Anyway, like I told you, I have a fifth degree black hammer in engineering and I'm eager to serve. The more danger the better!

You just fire this old flare whenever you're in trouble and I'll be there, quick as a quark!

Hopefully,

Penny>

Description.text:
我收到了一样奇怪的东西，还附了一张字条。你瞧瞧，好像是用你们的语言写的，指挥官。

<亲爱的杜隆坦先生，

我是佩妮……来自艾泽拉斯，你还记得吧？我们在$p的要塞有过一面之缘。

总之，就像我跟你说的那样，我具备了五级黑锤的工程学资质，迫切希望能够为你效劳。越是危险，我就越喜欢！

当你遇到麻烦时，发射这枚老旧的信号枪就行了，我会像闪电一般立即出现在你面前！

祝一切顺利，

佩妮>
Description.english:
I received a strange object with a note attached. Here, it seems to be written in your tongue, commander.

<Dear Mister Durotan,

I'm Penny... you know, from Azeroth? We met briefly back at $p's garrison. 

Anyway, like I told you, I have a fifth degree black hammer in engineering and I'm eager to serve. The more danger the better!

You just fire this old flare whenever you're in trouble and I'll be there, quick as a quark!

Hopefully,

Penny>

identity.title: To the Slaughter
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa ogres in Bladespire Citadel.
identity.description: This entrance to the fortress is clear again, thanks to your help.$b$bInside is another story. Find your way inside and leave no ogre standing as you go.

Objectives.text: 在刀塔堡垒里击败$1oa名食人魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa ogres in Bladespire Citadel.

Title.text: 寶藏：燒焦的鋼鐵部落斥候

identity.title: The Sacking of the Saberon
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Herb Bundles in saberon stashes at Steamscar Rise.
identity.description: The stash mostly contains bits of old animal parts and other junk. Upon closer inspection there are remains of a bundle of herbs and plants.$b$bRakthoth might be more willing to help if some of these herb bundles were found and gathered for her...

Objectives.text: 从汽痕高地的刃牙虎人储物箱里找到$1oa个草药包。
Objectives.english: Find $1oa Herb Bundles in saberon stashes at Steamscar Rise.

identity.title: Steamscar "Reagents"
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa saberon hearts from living saberon at Steamscar Rise.
identity.description: Now we get to the heart of the matter, heh. Saberon have strong hearts, our shaman find many uses for them.$b$bI will search for the ancient's magic if you get me those hearts. Do we have a deal?

Objectives.text: 从汽痕高地活着的虎人身上收集$1oa颗虎人心脏。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa saberon hearts from living saberon at Steamscar Rise.

identity.title: Plant Pruning
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa defenders at Dionor's Demise.
identity.description: I have a hunting den not far from here where I gather my trophies as well as reagents for the Laughing Skull. Not long ago this giant plant monster charged in from the overgrowth and was killed by several of the giant rock monsters. Since it died smaller plant beasts have sprung up and made a mess of the place.$b$bThey have also cut me off from my best source of reagents. Kill them, I will attempt to reach my den and salvage what I can...

Objectives.text: 在迪奥诺之劫消灭$1oa个守卫者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa defenders at Dionor's Demise.

identity.title: Taking the Death Bloom
identity.objectives: Take the Death Bloom from Smokemaster Snarl in Steamscar Rise.
identity.description: You have helped me and now I will help you, $p. The bloom you seek is within the nearby cave, being pawed over by the new leader of these saberon.$b$bKill him and take the bloom back to the ancient below. I hope this will clear out those plants and I can get back to my hunting...

Description.text: 你帮助了我，现在该换我帮你了，$p。你要找的花蕾就在附近的洞穴里，在这群虎人新头领的看管之下。$b$b去干掉他，然后把花蕾交给下方的古树。希望这样可以清除掉那些植物，好让我继续正常狩猎……
Description.english: You have helped me and now I will help you, $p. The bloom you seek is within the nearby cave, being pawed over by the new leader of these saberon.$b$bKill him and take the bloom back to the ancient below. I hope this will clear out those plants and I can get back to my hunting...

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭浓烟之主咆吼并夺取凋零之蕾。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill Smokemaster Snarl and take the Death Bloom.

identity.title: TASK: Kill Ogre Slavers
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Stonemaul ogres.

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa个石槌食人魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Stonemaul ogres.

identity.title: Too Many Irons in the Fire
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde on Orunai Coast.
identity.description:
We must not head into battle prematurely. Before we go after Orgrim, we must first deal with his troops.

If we are to succeed in our mission of wiping out the Iron Horde from Talador, we need to start on these shores.

Objectives.text: 在奥鲁纳海岸上消灭$1oa个钢铁部落成员。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Iron Horde on Orunai Coast.

identity.title: Vol. X Pages ?
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Manual Pages at Archenon Siegeyard.
identity.description:
The manual for the shredder was wedged in there, but it's missing lots of pages. We need to find as many pages of that manual as possible and I might--MIGHT--be able to get this shredder operational.

Based on the direction of the wind, I bet the pages flew toward Archenon Siegeyard.

Objectives.text: 在奥金诺攻城营地找到$1oa张手册内页。
Objectives.english: Find $1oa Manual Pages at Archenon Siegeyard.

identity.title: Born to Shred
identity.objectives: Kill $2oa Iron Horde in Tuurem using the Iron Shredder.
identity.description:
The Iron Shredder is operational! It should be primed and ready for you to shred our enemies in Tuurem!

Head inside and see what damage you can do. Can't say I'm not jealous.

Objectives.text: 在图雷姆用钢铁切割者消灭$2oa个钢铁部落成员。
Objectives.english: Kill $2oa Iron Horde in Tuurem using the Iron Shredder.

identity.title: Engineering Her Demise
identity.objectives: Defeat Ketya Shrediron at Tuurem.
identity.description: -- THE MOTHER HAS BEEN DETECTED. WARNING! WARNING! --

identity.title: In Short Supply
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Explosives.
identity.description:
The enemy has explosive devices stored on the beach below. We must recover them so they are not used against us.

Reports indicate that crates of explosives are scattered along the shoreline.

While you search, Durotan and I will carve deeper into Iron Horde territory.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份钢铁部落炸药。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Explosives.

identity.title: Iron Them Out
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Iron Horde Siege Engines.
identity.description:
