The orcs themselves are not the only threat. We may have weakened them considerably, but they still have siege weapons of significant power.

Sabotage siege weapons you find with the explosives you collected from the beach.

Objectives.text: 破坏$1oa辆钢铁部落攻城车。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Iron Horde Siege Engines.

identity.title: Strike While the Iron Is Hot

Title.english: Strike While the Iron Is Hot

identity.title: Burning Sky
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Adherent Invaders in Aruuna and the Aruuna Crystal Mine.
identity.description: It happened so fast. A white-hot flash of light ignited the nearby woods, followed by terrible winds that swept the flames across Aruuna.$B$BMoments later, arakkoa began descending through the smoke.$B$BI need to get Melani to the Pilgrim's Road. From there we can head for Anchorite's Sojourn and the protection of the vindicators. With the arakkoa roaming the area freely, I fear we'll be run down or worse: taken by the spreading wildfires.

Objectives.text: 在阿鲁纳和阿鲁纳水晶矿洞消灭$1oa个信徒入侵者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Adherent Invaders in Aruuna and the Aruuna Crystal Mine.

identity.title: Fiona's Solution
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Riverbeast Heart, $2oa Swamplighter Venom, $3oa Riotvine, and $4oa Moonlit Herbs.
identity.description: Gidwin was attacked by one of those plant creatures.$b$bFrom the looks of it, he is suffering from some kind of paralysis.$b$bI can make a cure, but I'll need some local ingredients.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个淡水兽之心、$2oa份沼泽荧光虫毒液、$3oa株暴虐藤蔓和$4oa株荧月草。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Riverbeast Heart, $2oa Swamplighter Venom, $3oa Riotvine, and $4oa Moonlit Herbs.

identity.title: The Great Salvation
identity.objectives: Free $1oa Draenei Prisoners from their cages.
identity.description: We've located the prisoners. They are being held in captivity here, inside the Shadowmoon fortress.$B$BPlease rescue as many of them as you can. And hurry. We can hear their screams out here.

Objectives.text: 帮助$1oa名德莱尼囚犯逃脱牢笼。
Objectives.english: Free $1oa Draenei Prisoners from their cages.

identity.title: Across the Stars
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Star Readings.
identity.description: A key source of the Shadowmoon clan's power comes from their understanding of the stars and their omens.$B$BFor centuries, they have recorded the patterns of the stars and their interpretations.$B$BWhile you are in the fortress, collect some of these documents for me.$B$BWe will take their own knowledge and use it against them.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份星图。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Star Readings.

identity.title: Free Our Brothers and Sisters
identity.objectives: Free $1oa Frost Wolves or Wor'gol Villagers.
identity.description: These Thunderlord curs use coward's weapons like nets and chains.$B$BMany of our villagers and wolf-brothers and sisters have been trapped.$B$BIf you free them, they will fight at your side with honor.$B$BWe must quell this attack with haste so I may return to Bladespire Citadel and continue my preparations.

Objectives.text: 解救$1oa个霜狼或沃高尔村民。
Objectives.english: Free $1oa Frost Wolves or Wor'gol Villagers.

identity.title: Swamplighter Queen
identity.objectives: Obtain The Swamplighter Queen's Tail for Fiona in Shadowmoon Valley.
identity.description: It looks like those plant creatures used some kind of poison when they attacked Gidwin.$b$bIt's a powerful concoction to say the least.$b$bIf we are going to cure Gidwin we need one more special ingredient. This one might be a bit harder to obtain than the others.$b$bYou up to the challenge, $n?

identity.title: Where's My Wolf?!
identity.objectives: Slay Beastmaster Torash and free Nerok in Grom'gar.
identity.description: My frost wolf, Nerok, was captured with me and the others. I do not know where they are keeping him, but I'll bet the so-called "beastmaster" who dragged us here does.$B$BHe is at the beast pens nearby, boasting about his catch to the younger hunters.$B$BWe'll see how he boasts with my axe in his skull.

identity.title: The Master Siegesmith
identity.objectives: Slay Master Siegesmith Uratok in Grom'gar.
identity.description: Not long ago, the most advanced weapon a Thunderlord could make was a really, really big spear. The Blackrock orcs must have shipped in a fearsome master to have them producing cannons so rapidly.$B$BWe need to find that master.

PortraitGiverText.text: 借调自黑石铸造厂。
PortraitGiverText.english: On loan from the Blackrock Foundry.

PortraitGiverName.text: 攻城锻造大师乌拉托克

identity.title: Wanted: Kuu'rat's Tusks
identity.objectives: Slay Kuu'rat and bring her tusks to Eremor at Embaari Village.
identity.description: Posted by: Eremor$B$BA ferocious elekk of unprecedented size has been seen near Gloomshade Grove.$B$BKnown to some as the ivory death, she is abnormally aggressive and has already taken the lives of several unwary travelers.$B$BThe rangari have as yet been unable to corner this creature. Anyone capable of taking down this beast should exchange proof of her demise to Eremor for a hefty bounty.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭她，把她的獠牙拿回来。
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay her and retrieve her tusks.

identity.title: Wanted: Kliaa's Stinger
identity.objectives: Kill Kliaa and bring its stinger to Dyuna at Embaari Village.
identity.description: Posted by: Dyuna$B$BA vicious queen swamplighter has made the northern forests of Shadowmoon its home.$B$BUnfortunately, this poisonous pest terrorizes the forest between Embaari Village and Shattrath. As local traders put their lives at risk, prices of goods will continue to rise.$B$BAnyone who can put an end to the beast should detach its stinger as proof and bring it to Dyuna in Embaari Village. The merchant traders will reward generously.

PortraitGiverText.text: 取得它的毒针。
PortraitGiverText.english: Retrieve its stinger.

identity.title: Wanted: Maa'run's Hoof
identity.objectives: Collect Maa'run's Hoof.
identity.description: Posted by: Orrin$B$BA wild talbuk called "Maa'run" wanders the hills southeast of Embaari Village and west of The Draakorium.$B$BMy brother was injured by this foul beast, and now lays in recovery.$B$BFor the safety of all the nearby villages, we must put an end to this vicious, rampaging creature!$B$BA handsome reward will be given to anyone who can bring me his hoof as proof of his demise.

PortraitGiverText.text: 拾取它的蹄子，并领取奖励。
PortraitGiverText.english: Collect his hoof, collect the reward.

identity.title: Smeltcraft
identity.objectives: Use Na'Shra's Mining Pick to collect $1oa Fomic Ore.
identity.description: Stranger! Thank the spirits for them sending you to me now. I am forging a blade and cannot leave it at this delicate state.$b$bBut I need more ore to complete this task.$b$bHere, take my mining pick. It is crafted from the teeth and acid of the local goren and will cut through the ore of this area as if it were air.$b$BBring me the ore and I will lend this blade to your cause.

Objectives.text: 用纳什拉的矿镐采集$1oa块弗米克矿石。
Objectives.english: Use Na'Shra's Mining Pick to collect $1oa Fomic Ore.

identity.title: Vignette: Broodmother Reeg'ak
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
identity.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人卵簇、$2oa个冰铸噬铁者和巢母里戈艾克。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.

identity.title: Aruumel's Rest
identity.objectives: Enter the Spirit Realm and destroy the Memory of Arumel.
identity.description: It is my job to see what others cannot. I keep the memories and read them for others, but I can no longer do so because of my son.$b$bMy son turned his back on the light. When he perished I could not stand the thought that his spirit might not be welcomed into Auchindoun.$B$BI interfered and trapped him here. Now he twists and tortures the memories until they cannot be read.$b$bYou must do what I cannot bear to do myself. Use this elixir to enter the spirit realm...$B$B...and destroy my son's spirit.

identity.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
identity.objectives: Destroy 15 Goren Stonechewers and their leader, Pastrok within the Jorune Quarry.
identity.description: I was all set to take a little trip to the nearby quarry when all of the sudden a bunch of goren bust out of the ground and started wreaking havoc!$b$bIt would be a shame for all of those beautiful gems to be destroyed by those filthy creatures. All they do is eat them! Can you believe that?!$b$bBe a dear and dispose of them. Make sure you get rid of the leader or they will only come back.

identity.title: Sher'KHAAAAAAANNNN!
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Sharpfang Stalkers and Destroy Sher'khaan.
identity.description: The tigers here have gotten out of control! They're everywhere and meaner than ever!$b$bSher'khaan is the worst of them! He's huge and mean! Maybe a brave adventurer like you could take care of Sher'khaan and the other tigers once and for all.

identity.title: Slaying Slavers
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Sootstained Ogres.
identity.description:
These ogres keep takin' my clan and turnin' them into slaves!

Slay some ogres and I'll hold 'em off if they try to run.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个污煤食人魔。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Sootstained Ogres.

Title.text: 寶藏：競技場大師的號角

identity.title: Disrupting the Flow
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Burning Resonators in the Burning Front.
identity.description: You there, we need to stop the flow of demon reinforcements!$B$BDo you see the floating fel crystals spread throughout the front? Those resonators are powering the portals unleashing hell on our forces. I need you to take them out!

Objectives.text: 在燃烧前线上摧毁$1oa个燃烧的共鸣水晶。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Burning Resonators in the Burning Front.

identity.title: Wanted: Grondo's Bounty
identity.objectives: Kill Grondo in the Crackling Plains.
identity.description: Grondo, a mad gronn, has been seen roaming the Crackling Plains.$b$bThis beast has been killing entire herds of clefthoof and devouring innocent frost wolves. We must destroy this threat before it reaches the Garrison.

identity.title: Wanted: Gutsmash the Destroyer
identity.objectives: Kill Gutsmash the Destroyer in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description: Gutsmash has proven to be more than a worthy adversary. Gather a small group together and end his reign of terror once and for all.

identity.title: The Heart of Auchindoun
identity.objectives: Defeat O'mogg Blackheart and retrieve Karab'uun in the Burning Front.
identity.description: A band of Shadow Council orcs stole the Heart of Auchindoun!$B$BThe Heart powers all of Auchindoun's defenses. Thankfully we were able to save its core and one of its four pieces.$B$BThe warlock O'mogg Blackheart is using Karab'uun, one of the stolen pieces, to power the largest portal in the Burning Front. Return Karab'uun to me.

identity.title: Stolen Axes
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Stolen Frostwolf Axes.
identity.description:
The saberon usually keep to themselves, but sometimes they range out of their dens and attack.

A pride of them live in the Windswept Lowland and have been coming too close for comfort, especially at night.

They even attacked a shipment of axes and took them back to their den!

Objectives.text: 找回$1oa把失窃的霜狼大斧。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Stolen Frostwolf Axes.

identity.title: Saberon Matriarch
identity.objectives: Slay the Saberon Pridematron.
identity.description:
The current matriarch of the Windswept Lowland saberon pride is bold.

She leads her pride in ambushes and attacks that some consider organized raids on our supply lines.

The intelligence she displays  is becoming a legitimate threat.

Take her out and perhaps she'll be replaced with a less dangerous leader.

Title.text: 德萊尼營地爆炸追蹤器
寶藏：迪賽西雅的悶燒長靴

identity.title: Into the Hollow
identity.objectives: Kill Xanatos the Defiler in Deathweb Hollow and retrieve Sha'tari.
identity.description: I've learned that the Shadow Council is using the nearby deathweb spiders' venom to spread fel corruption and augment their forces after their defeat at the Burning Front.$B$BOne of my soulbinders saw a dreadlord headed into the eastern mines with Sha'tari, one of the remaining pieces of the Heart of Auchindoun.$B$BI need you to wrest Sha'tari from the dreadlord's quivering corpse and bring it to me, champion.

identity.title: Antivenin
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Deathweb Fangs in Deathweb Hollow.
identity.description: I'm worried about Nyami. She's so focused on retrieving the Heart of Auchindoun that she seems to have lost sight of everything else.$B$BI'm sorry, I'm not trying to belittle her wisdom, but look around! Every soldier we sent into the mine has been gravely injured by the deathweb spiders. Their wounds need immediate attention!$B$BPlease, can you retrieve some fangs from the spiders? I can use them to create an antivenin, but I need to stay here and keep them stable until then.

Objectives.text: 去逝网之谷收集$1oa枚逝网蛛牙。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Deathweb Fangs in Deathweb Hollow.

identity.title: Vile Defilers
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Defiling Crystals in Deathweb Hollow.
identity.description: The spiders in the nearby overrun mine are feared by many, for their venom twists the very form of their victims. Many of the locals stay far away from their hollow, but I fear the Shadow Council has become privy to this information.$B$BOur scouts report that their warlocks are infusing these spiders with fel energy so that their venom turns their victims into demonic minions!$B$BWe must destroy the defiling crystals so this madness does not spread.

Objectives.text: 去逝网之谷摧毁$1oa块污染水晶。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Defiling Crystals in Deathweb Hollow.

identity.title: Into the Hollow
identity.objectives: Kill Xanatos the Defiler in Deathweb Hollow and retrieve Sha'tari.
identity.description: I've learned that the Shadow Council is using the nearby deathweb spiders' venom to spread fel corruption and augment their forces after their defeat at the Burning Front.$B$BOne of my soulbinders saw a dreadlord headed into the eastern mines with Sha'tari, one of the remaining pieces of the Heart of Auchindoun.$B$BI need you to wrest Sha'tari from the dreadlord's quivering corpse and bring it to me, champion.

identity.title: Antivenin
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Deathweb Fangs in Deathweb Hollow.
identity.description: I'm worried about Nyami. She's so focused on retrieving the Heart of Auchindoun that she seems to have lost sight of everything else.$B$BI'm sorry, I'm not trying to belittle her wisdom, but look around! Every soldier we sent into the mine has been gravely injured by the deathweb spiders. Their wounds need immediate attention!$B$BPlease, can you retrieve some fangs from the spiders? I can use them to create an antivenin, but I need to stay here and keep them stable until then.

Objectives.text: 去逝网之谷收集$1oa枚逝网蛛牙。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Deathweb Fangs in Deathweb Hollow.

identity.title: Vile Defilers
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Defiling Crystals in Deathweb Hollow.
identity.description: The deathweb spiders are remarkable creatures. Their venom twists the very form of their victims.$B$BWe are not the only ones privy to this information. The Shadow Council has already dispatched its warlocks to Deathweb Hollow to infuse the spiders with fel energy so that their venom turns creatures into demonic minions!$B$BWe must destroy the defiling crystals to prevent all of Talador from bending to Teron'gor's will!

Objectives.text: 去逝网之谷摧毁$1oa块污染水晶。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Defiling Crystals in Deathweb Hollow.

identity.title: Dying Wish
identity.objectives: Recover Ahm's Heirloom from Blademaster Bralok.
identity.description:
I am too far gone to rescue, but thank you for speaking with me.

Blademaster Bralok had his men starve and beat me, and he stole an heirloom that has been in my family since before we arrived on Draenor.

Should you find it, please let me see it once more so I may die in peace.

identity.title: The Final Piece
identity.objectives: Take Auch'naaru from Vorpil Ribcleaver in Telmor.
identity.description: I am too injured to fight, $c. I have failed my city and its people. This battle is yours.$B$BVorpil waits just ahead. He's trying to use Auch'naaru's powers for some sort of dark ritual.$B$BYou must do what I could not. Cut Vorpil down and retrieve Auch'naaru so the Heart of Auchindoun can be whole once more!

identity.title: Invasion of the Soul Eaters
identity.objectives: Use torches from a forge to burn $2oa body piles in Telmor.
identity.description: <The note is scrawled hurriedly across the parchment.>$B$BTelmor is lost. The Shadow Council is dragging our fallen into piles and feeding the souls to their leader. There is blood on my hands...$B$BPlease, if anyone reads this message, burn the bodies of our fallen so our enemy cannot use them.$B$B- Restalaan, Captain of the Guard

Objectives.text: 在泰尔莫用熔炉点燃火把，焚烧$2oa个遗物堆。
Objectives.english: Use torches from a forge to burn $2oa body piles in Telmor.

identity.title: Need More Teeth
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Putrid Brown Ogre Teeth.
identity.description: <Prowler Sasha silently holds out his hand to reveal a necklace crafted of stained leather and putrid brown ogre teeth. All have a matching tone of rot to them.>$b$b<It has several knots that appear to be missing additional teeth.>

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa颗腐臭的棕黑食人魔牙齿。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Putrid Brown Ogre Teeth.

identity.title: The Captive Engineer
identity.objectives: Find Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.
identity.description: Argh... I'm sorry, $p, but I'm too weak to fight. They kept me alive, but just barely.$B$BI'll keep an eye on the mole machine while you look for Thaelin. He should be somewhere close!

Description.text: 啊……真抱歉，$p，可我已经没力气战斗了。他们虽然没有杀死我，但也只不过给我留了口气罢了。$B$B你去找塞林吧，我会留下照看钻探机。他应该就在附近！
Description.english: Argh... I'm sorry, $p, but I'm too weak to fight. They kept me alive, but just barely.$B$BI'll keep an eye on the mole machine while you look for Thaelin. He should be somewhere close!

identity.title: Something to Remember Me By
identity.objectives: Place $1oa Dark Iron Mines in the Iron Siegeworks.
identity.description: The Iron Horde want my inventions so bad? Then we'll leave some behind.$B$BThese little beauties will blow the treads clear off a tank AND melt her chassis into the dirt. Let's see them try and drive their shoddy cannons out of this place!

Objectives.text: 在钢铁军工厂里放置$1oa枚黑铁地雷。
Objectives.english: Place $1oa Dark Iron Mines in the Iron Siegeworks.

identity.title: Privileged Information
identity.objectives: Loot Thaelin's Notebook from Overlord Blackhammer in the Iron Siegeworks.
identity.description: I'm not the only prize the Iron Horde brought back after raiding my workshop.$B$BOverlord Blackhammer, the maniac in charge of this operation, took my notebook as his own personal treasure.$B$BManufacturing techniques; schematics for new inventions; embarrassing doodles.$B$BIt's got all my secrets!$B$BCan I count on you to help me get it back?

PortraitGiverText.text: 从技术上讲，他那把锤子应该是煤灰色。但没人有胆量指出这一点。
PortraitGiverText.english: Technically, his hammer is more of a charcoal color. Nobody has dared to correct him.

identity.title: Wanted: Overlord Blackhammer
identity.objectives: Slay Overlord Blackhammer in the Iron Siegeworks.
identity.description: So, we COULD just leave now. We got what we came for, and I even did a little charity work to help Thaelin escape.$B$BBut there's also this.$B$B<Gazlowe holds up a scrap of paper showing a hand-drawn depiction of an especially mean looking orc.>$B$BIt's an SI:7 bounty for one Overlord Blackhammer, who just happens to operate out of this very facility. You help me take him out, I pay you. Then I take his head to the Alliance and collect on the bounty. Everyone wins!$B$BWell, everyone except for Blackhammer.

PortraitGiverText.text: 技术上讲，他那把锤子应该是煤灰色。但没人有胆量指出这一点。
PortraitGiverText.english: Technically, his hammer is more of a charcoal color. Nobody has dared to correct him.

identity.title: A Fellow Gearhead
identity.objectives: Find Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.
identity.description: There's no way Thaelin sold out. NO way! They gotta be holdin' him here somewhere.$B$BCome on, $p. I know he's with the Alliance, and I know they aren't your favorite people, but we do NOT want the Iron Horde having access to his work - trust me!

Description.text: 这一定不是塞林卖给他们的。决不可能！他们肯定是把他关在这附近了。$B$B快来，$p。我知道他跟联盟在一起，而且我也明白你跟联盟是死对头，可我们都不愿意让他的作品落在钢铁部落的手里——相信我！
Description.english: There's no way Thaelin sold out. NO way! They gotta be holdin' him here somewhere.$B$BCome on, $p. I know he's with the Alliance, and I know they aren't your favorite people, but we do NOT want the Iron Horde having access to his work - trust me!

identity.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
identity.objectives: Find Ner'zhul.
identity.description: <Prophet Velen's voice continues.>$B$BYrel and I have located Warlord Ner'zhul. He is meeting with Grommash Hellscream atop the highest altar overlooking Anguish Fortress.$B$BMeet us there. We must stop him.

identity.title: Vul'gath's End
identity.objectives: Kill General Vul'gath within Agurak's Fall.
identity.description: Vul'gath's time has come to an end, $n. My daughter's blood is upon his hands, now his blood will be on ours!$b$bShow no mercy and strike him down!

PortraitGiverText.text: 不管走到哪，都带着他的宠物“裂肠”。
PortraitGiverText.english: Takes his pet "Gutgore" with him everywhere.

identity.title: Too Many Irons in the Fire
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde at Mor'gran Logworks.
identity.description:
We must slay the Iron Horde troops who infest our lands.

Find those who would sully our great forest and show them the hand of justice.

Objectives.text: 在莫戈兰伐木场消灭$1oa个钢铁部落。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Iron Horde at Mor'gran Logworks.

identity.title: In Short Supply
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Explosives.
identity.description:
The Iron Horde has explosive devices stored throughout the heart of their logging camp.

We must recover them so they are not used against us.

I will keep an eye on Maraad... I worry for him in his anger.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa包钢铁部落炸药。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Explosives.

identity.title: Vol. X Pages ?
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Manual Pages on orcs at Archenon Siegeyard.
identity.description:
That shredder had a manual jammed in the cockpit, but it's missing a lot o' pages. If we can find those manual pages, I'd bet my third toe I can get the prototype shredder working again.

I coulda swore I saw a few of those pages floatin' about in  Archenon Siegeyard. Maybe the orcs there carry them.

Objectives.text: 从奥金诺攻城营地的兽人身上找到$1oa张手册内页。
Objectives.english: Find $1oa Manual Pages on orcs at Archenon Siegeyard.

identity.title: Iron Them Out
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Iron Horde Siege Engines.
identity.description:
The orcs themselves are not the only threat. They still have siege weapons of significant power.

They've already been used against Tuurem, and we must not allow for their continued operation.

Sabotage siege weapons using the explosives you collected from the logging camp.

Objectives.text: 破坏$1oa辆钢铁部落攻城车。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Iron Horde Siege Engines.

identity.title: Born to Shred
identity.objectives: Kill $2oa Iron Horde in Tuurem using the Iron Shredder.
identity.description:
I've got this prototype shredder operating on most cylinders.

Boy, will they be surprised when you stomp them with their own machine!

Can't wait to watch you from the safety of the Observicopter.

Objectives.text: 在图雷姆用钢铁切割者消灭$2oa个钢铁部落成员。
Objectives.english: Kill $2oa Iron Horde in Tuurem using the Iron Shredder.

identity.title: Engineering Her Demise
identity.objectives: Defeat Ketya Shrediron.
identity.description: -- THE MOTHER HAS BEEN DETECTED. WARNING! WARNING! --

Title.text: 插曲：亞魯梅爾的毀損戰錘

identity.title: Wanted: Kil'uun
identity.objectives: Hunt Kil'uun and bring its beak to Patrick Messer.
identity.description: I have a bounty set on a bird, commander. Yes, a bird.$B$BThe issue is this thing is massive, and it was last sighted a stone's throw away from the Horde base to the south in the forest. The locals call it Kil'uun.$B$BIf you'd like to track the creature down and bring back its beak I wager it would fetch a sack or two of gold for your coffers!

identity.title: Wanted: Hilaani
identity.objectives: Kill Hilaani and bring the Pile of Riverbeast Meat to Patrick Messer.
identity.description: O'riley wants to thank our peasants for their hard work with a riverbeast dinner.$B$I don't want to waste your time asking you to slaughter the things all day, commander. We've gotten reports of a huge riverbeast called Hilaani that would feed the whole fort twice over living in the lake to the south.$B$BIf you have a chance to bring cuts of her meat back, the men would be grateful.

identity.title: Wanted: Ra'tok the Hammer
identity.objectives: Dispatch Ra'tok the Hammer in the Orunai Coast.
identity.description: I've got an issue that could use your assistance, commander.$B$BA few of our men spotted an Iron Horde lieutenant wandering in the cliffs near here. We suspect she's directing their forces to strategic ground as they land on the Orunai Coast.$B$BI would feel much better about the safety of this fort if you could take her out.

identity.title: Wanted: Ra'tok the Hammer
identity.objectives: Kill Ra'tok the Hammer in the Orunai Coast.
identity.description: The Iron Horde have no honor. They disgust me.$B$BWe spotted one of their lieutenants wandering the cliffs not far from our base. I believe that she is tracking our movements to prepare for some sort of assault from the Orunai Coast.$B$BI understand you have much to do, commander. If you have the time, I believe it would be beneficial to our position's integrity.

identity.title: Wanted: Hilaani
identity.objectives: Slay Hilaani and bring a Pile of Riverbeast Meat to Beastmaster Tagh.
identity.description: We need more meat, commander.$B$BI know what you're thinking. What about all of that meat right behind me?$B$BThat's the problem. It'll be gone in a day if we're lucky.$B$BThere's a riverbeast that lives in the lake to the south. Locals call her Hilaani. Massive, lots of meat.$B$BIf you would take down the beast and bring me her meat, your wolves will be better off for it.

identity.title: Wanted: Kil'uun
identity.objectives: Bring Kil'uun's Beak to Beastmaster Tagh.
identity.description: It's that damned bird!$B$BEvery few hours, this blasted thing flies right past here, and none of these idiots will stop it.$B$B"It's got the crazy in its eyes," they tell me. Pah!$B$BCommander, this bird will be the end of me. If you see it, could you cut off its stupid head and give it to me?$B$BIt'd make me feel better.

identity.title: Ogre Diplomacy
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ango'rosh in the Ango'rosh Ruins.
identity.description: They may be spirits, but the Ango'rosh are still ogres. Even with their books in hand, they won't respect you until you prove yourself, and there's only one way to earn that.$B$BBy killing them.$B$BYou should take out as many of the Ango'rosh spirits and their pets as you can while in the ruins.

Objectives.text: 在安葛洛什废墟里消灭$1oa个安葛洛什食人魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ango'rosh in the Ango'rosh Ruins.

identity.title: Retribution for the Light
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa demons in Gul'rok.
identity.description: There are agents of darkness everywhere, fighting tooth and nail to envelop the world. The Light relies on us to balance the scale.$B$BYou have the power needed to destroy Teron'gor's demonic minions once and for all. Send them to the Twisting Nether in pieces!

Objectives.text: 在古尔罗克消灭$1oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa demons in Gul'rok.

identity.title: What Must Be Done
identity.objectives: Collect the Mother of Wolves' Remains and bury it at the graveyard outside of northern Throm'var.
identity.description: I believe we have seen this demonic corruption your friends speak of.$B$BThe Mother of Wolves has not been herself lately. Now, her pack has her surrounded.$B$BThe wolves are protecting our hunters and will not let them near. They're not likely to stop you, though.$B$BIf the alpha mother is infected with this fel-energy, then she must be put down.$B$BYou would greatly honor the Frostwolves by returning with her corpse and giving it a proper burial.

PortraitGiverText.text: 结束她的痛苦，并把她的尸骸埋进墓地吧。
PortraitGiverText.english: End her suffering and bury her remains in the graveyard.

identity.title: A Clew of Worms
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Wastes Rockworms.
identity.description: While I was scouting, I noticed that most of Frostwind Crag is crawling with an odd species of worm.$B$BThe worst thing about them is that these things burrow under the ground and then spring on you from out of nowhere.$B$BI saw the worms attacking the frost wolves and other wildlife in the wastes. I'm certain the orcs would appreciate you helping out.

Objectives.text: 杀死$1oa只废土岩虫。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Wastes Rockworms.

identity.title: The Sleeper Has Awakened
identity.objectives: Kill Shui Halad.
identity.description: Something has awakened the great Shui Halad. She is causing the ground to quake.$B$B<The farseer makes a sign of warding in the air, and then continues.>$B$BPerhaps those who have disturbed the great worm are the same ones your friends are tracking down?$B$BEither way, Shui Halad must be put to eternal rest before her thrashing collapses all of the north into the ocean.

PortraitGiverText.text: 你必须消灭那只巨虫！
PortraitGiverText.english: You must slay the great worm!

identity.title: Eye Need That
identity.objectives: Collect the All-Seeing Ring from Ogzor the Necrothurge.
identity.description: The Mother of Wolves was infected with demon magic. The Shadow Council must have hoped to spread the corruption to the other frost wolves and then to Throm'var.$B$BThe hunters are reporting they've seen glowing green eyes down in the Icescar Boneyard to the west. We both know what that means.$B$BI have an idea... we're going to use the Shadow Council's "eyes" against them to reveal their base. All we need is the lead warlock's All-Seeing Ring.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭他，并夺取他的全视指环。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill him and take his All-Seeing Ring.

identity.title: Payback
identity.objectives: Rout $1oa Shadow Council forces in Telmor.
identity.description: We thought we were safe behind Leafshadow's cloaking veil.$B$B<Vindicator Kaluud wipes the blood from his face.>$B$BSomeone told the Shadow Council's forces how to disable it. We were able to hold them off at first...$B$BMost of the town was slaughtered in the attack. Please, you must avenge our fallen. Rout these invaders out from Telmor forever!

Objectives.text: 在泰尔莫击溃$1oa个暗影议会的成员。
Objectives.english: Rout $1oa Shadow Council forces in Telmor.

identity.title: They Took My Father
identity.objectives: Collect Anchorite Dolruu's three notes.
identity.description: $p! I have a lead on what happened to my father. There have been reports that he was seen in the presence of Shadow Council orcs in ____.$b$bMy father was a powerful Anchorite with a vast amount of ancient knowledge. I dread to think what those within the Shadow Council would do to him to get that knowledge. $b$bCan you go to ___? Hunt down their officers and see what they know?

Description.text: $p！我得到关于父亲下落的线索了。有人报告说在____看见他跟暗影议会的兽人们在一起。$b$b我父亲是位造诣极深的学者，有着渊博的古老学识。我真不敢想象暗影议会为了得到那些知识会对他做出什么事情来。$b$b你能去____吗？抓住他们的军官，看看他们都知道些什么？
Description.english: $p! I have a lead on what happened to my father. There have been reports that he was seen in the presence of Shadow Council orcs in ____.$b$bMy father was a powerful Anchorite with a vast amount of ancient knowledge. I dread to think what those within the Shadow Council would do to him to get that knowledge. $b$bCan you go to ___? Hunt down their officers and see what they know?

identity.title: The Fate of Gordawg
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Heart of the Fury.
identity.description: Looming monstrously between us and the inner chamber is the great fury we have sought to return to the Throne of Elements.$b$bGordawg stands before us enthralled; a slave to the pale and their mysterious master. My heart is heavy with grief to see such a great creature mindless and enslaved by evil.$b$bThere is no going back, in order to push forward you must go through Gordawg.$b$bIt pains me, but Gordawg must be slain.$b$bWhen the deed is done, we will return the fury's heart to the Throne of Elements.

PortraitGiverText.text: 只有死亡，才能帮助伟大的大地之怒摆脱古加尔的魔爪。
PortraitGiverText.english: Death is the only way to free the great fury from Cho'gall's grasp.

identity.title: Stop the Flow
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Summoning Circles.
identity.description: The Shadow Council down in the boneyard are going to have magic circles. It's not enough to simply kill them; we also have to eliminate their infernal devices.$B$BIf you destroy the circles, you'll stop the flow of demons they're summoning to inhabit the bones of the dead.

Objectives.text: 摧毁$1oa个召唤法阵。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Summoning Circles.

identity.title: Desecration of the Dead
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Necrophytes and Fel Wolves.
identity.description: These filthy warlocks are desecrating the dead in the boneyard!$B$B<The farseer trembles as he fails to keep his composure.>$B$BI WANT THEM DEAD!$B$BDestroy the necrophytes. Destroy their demonic abominations.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个死灵侍僧和魔狼。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Necrophytes and Fel Wolves.

identity.title: Out of the Chains
identity.objectives: Obtain the Bloodmaul Shackle Key and free Owynn Graddock.
identity.description: They roughed me up real good an' I have a splitting headache but I'll survive. I need to get out of this bit o' chain here though.$b$bCould ye get the key to it for me? A big ogre called Nub has it, he's over on the far side of the terrace.

identity.title: Cleansing the Souls
identity.objectives: Cleanse $1oa Crazed Souls.
identity.description: Not all spirits are destroyed by the Soulgrinder. Some souls manage to survive more or less intact like myself. Others have become twisted and maddened.$B$BEnd their misery, take my soul shard and use it to purify them. Their rage will blind them to the effects of its energy so you must defeat them before you use it.

Objectives.text: 净化$1oa个疯狂之魂。
Objectives.english: Cleanse $1oa Crazed Souls.

identity.title: The Totems That Bind
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa of Borgal's Totems.
identity.description: Before Borgal began to use the Soulgrinder, he used totems to bind spirits to his service.$b$bIf we can get a few of those totems I may be able to use the spiritual connection he's forged with them to force a link. He'll be compelled to appear before us!$b$bGo find me a few of those totems and I might be able to pull this off, I think five should do it.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个波加尔的图腾。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa of Borgal's Totems.

identity.title: Soulgrinder Survivor
identity.objectives: Place Borgal's totems so that Orlana can begin the ritual, then kill Borgal.
identity.description: It is time for Borgal to die.$b$bWe must travel to a location of power where I have room for the ritual. There is a ruined tower to the northwest that will be perfect for this. Meet us there and place the totems in the areas of power you will find there. Once they are placed I will do the ritual that will summon Borgal to us.$b$bYour job will be the difficult one, kill him!

identity.title: Have a Heart
identity.objectives: Collect the Heart of Fernus from Fernus.
identity.description: Did you notice the magical barrier protecting the cave's entrance? It's being powered by demon crystals.$B$BThe Burning Legion has a habit of making demon parts serve as the keys to such devices.$B$BTravel west to the Ruins of Ata'gar. Look for a powerful demon therein and bring me its heart.$B$BI'll project an image of myself into the ruins. You won't have to come back here until we're done.

PortraitGiverText.text: 那颗恶魔的心脏是进入深黯峰，接近古尔丹的关键所在。
PortraitGiverText.english: The infernal's heart is the key to gaining access to Gul'dan inside the Gloomspire.

identity.title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadow Council members at the Ruins of Ata'gar.
identity.description: Those ruins are going to be full of Shadow Council flunkies. We can't afford to let them scatter all over Draenor once you've dealt with Gul'dan.$B$BNo, we need to eliminate every one of them down to the last orc.

Objectives.text: 去阿塔加废墟消灭$1oa个暗影议会成员。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Shadow Council members at the Ruins of Ata'gar.

identity.title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadow Council members at the Ruins of Ata'gar.
identity.description: These ruins are full of Shadow Council adherents. We can't afford to let them scatter all over Draenor once Gul'dan has been dealt with.$B$BNo, we need to eliminate every one of them down to the last orc.

Objectives.text: 去阿塔加废墟消灭$1oa个暗影议会成员。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Shadow Council members at the Ruins of Ata'gar.

identity.title: Out of the Chains
identity.objectives: Obtain the Bloodmaul Slave Key and free Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja.
identity.description: Lissen mon, dem ogres, got da jump on me wid an artifact wid powerful mojo. Next t'ing I know I wake here wid broken bones an' dis chain on me leg. I called to da spirits ta break it, but da spirits here no answer.$b$bGotta go wid da old methods ta get out. Dere be a big ogre in da cave here called Rugrum who has da key to me shackle. Could ye go put a blade in his belly and get me dat key?

identity.title: The Totems That Bind
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa of Borgal's Totems.
identity.description: Before Borgal began to use the Soulgrinder, he used totems to bind spirits to his service.$b$bIf we can get a few of those totems I may be able to use the spiritual connection he's forged with them to force a link. He'll be compelled to appear before us!$b$bGo find me a few of those totems and I might be able to pull this off, I think five should do it.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个波加尔的图腾。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa of Borgal's Totems.

identity.title: Soulgrinder Survivor
identity.objectives: Place Borgal's totems so that Orlana can begin the ritual, then kill Borgal.
identity.description: It is time for Borgal to die.$b$bWe must travel to a location of power where I have room for the ritual. There is a ruined tower to the northwest that will be perfect for this. Meet us there and place the totems in the areas of power you will find there. Once they are placed I will do the ritual that will summon Borgal to us.$b$bYour job will be the difficult one, kill him!

identity.title: Ashes Of The Past
identity.objectives: Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory wants you to bring him $1oa Piles of Elemental Ash.
identity.description: The ogres are a plague upon my kind. They summon my kin and force them into servitude, working them without rest till their heat fades away and they crumble into dust.$b$bTheir ashes must return to the lava flows so that they can be reborn!$b$bThe Ogres keep the dust in pouches on their person thinking it would enhance their strength. Go slay them and recover the ashes of my people!

Objectives.text: 血槌领地里的莫斯隆要求你给他带去$1oa堆元素灰烬。
Objectives.english: Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory wants you to bring him $1oa Piles of Elemental Ash.

identity.title: Flames Of The Earth
identity.objectives: Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory wants you to use the Flamewrought Jewel to free $1oa Magma Elementals.
identity.description: I've searched the depths of the earth and found the means to break the spells that hold my people captive, but it only functions to free one who is completely bound. I would be unable to prevent myself from becoming bound by the same magic.$b$bYou, flesh creature, are not of the flames below so their binding spells should not affect you.$b$bPlease take my jewel, use its power to free my people!

Objectives.text: 血槌领地里的莫斯隆想让你用烈焰锻铸的宝石解救$1oa个被束缚的熔岩元素。
Objectives.english: Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory wants you to use the Flamewrought Jewel to free $1oa Magma Elementals.

identity.title: Lurkers
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa doses of Lurker Venom.
identity.description: Dis be a dangerous place, boss-mon.$b$bFilled with big monsters and savage giants.$b$bWell, like my family loa say, 'If ya can't beat it, poison it.'$b$BWe gonna be needin' some venom from the lurkers out there on the Cracking Plains. Dem lurkers be mighty sneaky, and mighty creepy. Be watchin the ground for rumbles and shakes.$b$bI'll be stayin' here to make a cure in case you accidentally get too poisoned.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa剂潜伏者的毒液。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa doses of Lurker Venom.

identity.title: Poulticide
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Frostbloom Leaves.
identity.description: We be huntin' something so big, so savage, we gonna need anotha poison. We gonna need a big ol' poultice of poison!$b$bSo...  boss-mon? Ya think ya up for a little flower pickin'? We gonna need the leaves of them frostbloom plants that be growing along the shadows of rocks and ledges along the sides of the Cracking Plains.$b$bBe careful when pickin' them,  boss-mon! They not always be by themselves...

Objectives.text: 采集$1oa片雪霜花叶片。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Frostbloom Leaves.

identity.title: Frosted Fury
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Frostshards.
identity.description: The furies of Draenor are different than the elementals of Azeroth. But don't be fooled. Some be wicked, boss-mon. Wicked.$b$bThe trap we are making be needing some proper frostshards. You can get them, if ya willing, from the ice furies.$b$bDey be wandering the Cracking Plains, freezin' all dat dey touch, an' bein' wicked.$b$bBring us some o' these frostshards,  boss-mon, an' we gonna whip ya up one deadly trap.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa块严霜碎片。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Frostshards.

identity.title: The Real Prey
identity.objectives: Find Iceblister Den and then slay Grosh the Mighty.
identity.description: Eh boss-mon. Time for us to be huntin' the real prey now. To the north, there be a cave. In the cave, there be right mean ogron dey call "Grosh the Mighty." That ogron got a big stash of pillaged hides and leathers we gonna be needin' for the troops at the garrison.$b$bI made a special poison from the stuff ya gathered. Dis be a magic poison, and it gonna put that ogron down to sometin' a bit more manageable. $b$bTake these vials to the cave and see if ya can't win us a treasure.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这畜生从死在他手里的受害者身上积累了不少财富啊。
PortraitGiverText.english: This brute has accumulated a hoard of wealth from his victims.

identity.title: We Must Construct Additional Pylons
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Arkonite Crystals and an Arkonite Pylon from the Tomb of Lights.
identity.description: We came here to retrieve a reserve pylon to power Auchindoun's defenses, but we've been pinned to this position by the Shadow Council for hours!$B$BI need to get these injured back to Exarch's Refuge, but we still need the backup system!$B$BPlease, gather Arkonite crystals and an Arkonite pylon from the tomb and meet me at the refuge as quickly as you can!

Objectives.text: 前往圣光之墓收集$1oa块阿肯尼特水晶和1个阿肯尼特晶塔。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Arkonite Crystals and an Arkonite Pylon from the Tomb of Lights.

identity.title: Darktide Defender
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Darktide Pilferers and $2oa Darktide Engineers.
identity.description: <Rexxar looks at you as you inspect the dead goblin. It's clear what he wants you to do.>

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个黑潮盗贼和$2oa个黑潮工程师。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Darktide Pilferers and $2oa Darktide Engineers.

identity.title: The Shadow Gate
identity.objectives: Defeat Grubnor Wargut and follow after Borgal.
identity.description: Okay, we're gonna have to be quick. $b$bI've seen Borgal form magical portals before so he might try to use one to escape. If he does that our only option will be to follow after 'em. On top of that he always keeps his lieutenant Grubnor nearby so we may have a bit of a tussle in store.$b$b<Owynn peeks into the cave.>$b$bKeep yer head down, something's going on in there.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他有点慢。
PortraitGiverText.english: He's a bit slow.

identity.title: Back to Work
identity.objectives: Mark $1oa Trees.
identity.description:
Alright, boss. We're gonna need some lumber if we're gonna get this garrison started off right.

If you mark some trees to be cut down, your peons will do the rest.

Objectives.text: 标记$1oa棵树。
Objectives.english: Mark $1oa Trees.

identity.title: The Shadow Gate
identity.objectives: Defeat Grubnor Wargut and follow after Borgal.
identity.description: Dere be ogres in da cave, I smell de stink of 'em.$b$bKeep ye weapon handy, we gonna have ta move quick and take down de ogres before dey start tossing da mojo.$b$b<Bwu'ja peeks into the cave.>$b$bWatch ye self mon, something be going down in dere.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他有点慢。
PortraitGiverText.english: He's a bit slow.

identity.title: Frenzied Manafeeders
identity.objectives: Use the Arcane Dissipator on $oa Frenzied Manafeeders.
identity.description: There is a rare breed of moth in Talador known as the Manafeeder. These moths sustain themselves by feeding on arcane crystal dust from the mine.$b$bTypically speaking, these moths are nothing more than an occasional nuisance. However, they are now gorging themselves upon the intense arcane energy flooding out of the mine and have become highly territorial and aggressive.$b$bI have attuned this crystal to disperse arcane energy. Please use it on the Frenzied Manafeeders to soothe them.

Objectives.text: 对$oa只狂怒汲魔蛾使用奥术驱散器。
Objectives.english: Use the Arcane Dissipator on $oa Frenzied Manafeeders.

identity.title: Arcane Essence
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Essence.
identity.description: Kaelynara will not stop until she has drained every last drop of arcane energy from the crystal...and destroyed this entire mine in the process. The arcane shield she guards herself with cannot be penetrated by normal means, but I have a plan.$b$bIf I had a focusing crystal powerful enough to momentarily pierce her shield, Kaelynara could then be dealt with.$b$bFortunately, we are in the perfect place to build one. Start by bringing me arcane essence from the creatures rampaging throughout the mine.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa份奥术精华。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Essence.

identity.title: Arcane Essence
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Essence.
identity.description: Kaelynara's lust for arcane power has consumed her and she threatens the safety of all in this mine. She must be stopped.$b$bUnfortunately, there is nothing we can do while she shields herself. We will need to find a way to penetrate her shielding spell.$b$bPerhaps if I were to build a focusing crystal, I could use it to lower her shield...I'll need you to search the crystal mine for the necessary components.$b$bFirst, I'll need arcane essence from the Crystal Ragers and Arcane Wraiths in the mine.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa份奥术精华。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Essence.

identity.title: Crystals of Unusual Power
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Unrefined Power Crystals.
identity.description: Arcane crystals of this size and power are quite rare even on Draenor. It is no coincidence that the Draenei built Shattrath and Auchindoun so close to this mine.$b$bI am interested in learning more about these particular crystals and their arcane nature.$b$bReturn to me with any unrefined power crystals that you may find and I will make sure that you are adequately compensated for your effort.

Objectives.text: 收集$oa块能量水晶原石。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Unrefined Power Crystals.

identity.title: Caught In The Chaos
identity.objectives: Rescue $oa Injured Miners.
identity.description: Not all of the Draenei miners made it out when the chaos erupted, $n. Many of them are injured and still trapped inside the mine.$b$bKaelynara's disruption has caused all hell to break loose. Arcane Wraiths are forming from the unleashed energy and attacking everything they see. The elementals that slumbered beneath the ground are emerging from the rocks frenzied and dangerous.$b$bPlease find as many injured miners as you can and ensure that they return safely.

Objectives.text: 救出$oa位受伤的矿工。
Objectives.english: Rescue $oa Injured Miners.

identity.title: Holding the Line
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa demons in the Burning Front.
identity.description: It is good to see you again, champion.$B$BDemons are assaulting Auchindoun and we are barely standing our ground against them.$B$BWe need to push our front lines forward lest our losses reach critical mass.$B$BIf your blade is with us, shove it into these foul creatures' throats.

Objectives.text: 在燃烧前线上消灭$1oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa demons in the Burning Front.

identity.title: An'dure The Giant
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Crystal Giant Heart.
identity.description: In order to break through Kaelynara's arcane shield, we will need a focusing crystal of rare power and quality.$b$bWithin the mine is a crystal giant known to the Draenei as An'dure. The giant has slept beneath the rocky earth for ages, but due to Kaelynara's recklessness it has awakened.$b$bThe heart of a crystal giant is a truly powerful artifact. Defeat An'Dure and return to me with a crystal giant heart. Once I have the heart, I will have everything I need to construct the focusing crystal!

PortraitGiverText.text: 德拉诺的第八大奇迹。
PortraitGiverText.english: The eighth wonder of Draenor.

identity.title: An'dure The Giant
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Crystal Giant Heart.
identity.description: In order to break through Kaelynara's arcane shield, we will need a focusing crystal of rare power and quality.$b$bWithin the mine is a crystal giant known to the Draenei as An'dure. The giant has slept far beneath the earth for ages, but due to Kaelynara's recklessness it has awakened.$b$bThe heart of a crystal giant is a truly powerful artifact. Defeat An'Dure and return to me with a crystal giant heart.$b$bWhen you return I will construct the focusing crystal and together we will stop Kaelynara.

PortraitGiverText.text: 德拉诺的第八大奇迹。
PortraitGiverText.english: The eighth wonder of Draenor.

identity.title: Holding the Line
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa demons in the Burning Front.
identity.description: Auchindoun is under attack!$B$BThe Auchenai are valiant warriors in their own right, but they cannot hold against these endless demon hordes alone. We came here to stop the Legion from engulfing Draenor... working together is our best shot.$B$BI need you to thin out the demons' numbers so we can regroup our forces safely and push forward into the Burning Front.$B$BWe will stop their march here and now!

Objectives.text: 在燃烧前线上消灭$1oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa demons in the Burning Front.

identity.title: Keli'dan the Breaker
identity.objectives: Slay Keli'dan the Breaker.
identity.description: One of Ner'zhul's lieutenants remains, up ahead. The exit to the cave isn't much farther past him.$b$bI will go back and tell Khadgar that the cave is clear. We will rendezvous once you've taken care of Keli'dan!

PortraitGiverText.text: 耐奥祖的副官。影月氏族的大巫师。
PortraitGiverText.english: Lieutenant to Ner'zhul. Master Sorcerer of the Shadowmoon.

identity.title: Rylak Rescue
identity.objectives: Kill Razz Ricketroz at Darktide Roost.
identity.description: I managed to squeeze even more information out of our little friend here.$b$bThe Darktide Matriarch is at the top of the hill.$b$bOne of their lead engineers is attempting to tame the matriarch with his technology. We must stop him, $n.

identity.title: Cleansing the Souls
identity.objectives: Cleanse $1oa Crazed Souls.
identity.description: Not all spirits are destroyed by the Soulgrinder. Some souls manage to survive more or less intact like myself. Others have become twisted and maddened.$B$BEnd their misery, take my soul shard and use it to purify them. Their rage will blind them to the effects of its energy so you must defeat them before you use it.

Objectives.text: 净化$1oa个疯狂之魂。
Objectives.english: Cleanse $1oa Crazed Souls.

Title.text: 奖励目标：消灭邪恶之息

identity.title: Declawing The Competition
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Saberon Claws.
identity.description: These saberon freaks have cost me a lot of money, $c.$b$bI'm not one to forgive a debt and it's time to collect!$b$bThe saberon that have been causing us the most trouble are the ones living in Sabermaw. They keep ambushing our trade shipments along the road.$b$b<Pyxni grins.>$b$bIt's time to declaw the competition. Bring me their claws; we'll sell the best ones as good luck charms here at the arena.$b$bIf the claw sales don't cover their debt, we'll just have to charge them an arm and a leg too!

Objectives.text: 收集$oa只刃牙虎人爪子。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Saberon Claws.

identity.title: WANTED: Razorpaw!
identity.objectives: Defeat Razorpaw.
identity.description: Wanted for crimes against the innocent at the Ring of Trials!$b$bRazorpaw is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against travelers on the road near Sabermaw.$b$bLast seen in the vicinity of the saberon den known as Sabermaw.$b$bExercise extreme caution!$b$bUpon completion, this bounty will be fulfilled by Pyxni Pennypocket of the Steamwheedle Cartel.

PortraitGiverText.text: 滥杀无辜的通缉犯！
PortraitGiverText.english: Wanted for crimes against the innocent!

identity.title: They've Got The Goods!
identity.objectives: Recover $oa Stolen Goods.
identity.description: The Saberon...they weren't just after prisoners...$b$b<Cough>...they took all the merchandise too.$b$bKidnapping is one thing...but stealing a goblin's merchandise? That's making things personal!$b$b<Cough>...Pyxni ain't going to be happy unless you get all of the stolen goods back. Make your way into Sabermaw and steal back all our merch.$b$bWhen you're done, make your way back to Pyxni at the Ring of Trials.$b$bShe'll make it worth your while...

Objectives.text: 取回$oa件失窃的货物。
Objectives.english: Recover $oa Stolen Goods.

identity.title: Gobnapped
identity.objectives: Rescue $oa Goblin Traders.
identity.description: We never even saw the ambush coming...$b$bThe saberon hit us so hard and fast we barely had time to think.$b$bThose overgrown mongrels dragged the others away and left me here for dead...they probably thought I was too close to dying.$b$bI hear they like their meat fresh...$b<cough>....well I ain't going down that easy!$b$bDon't worry about me...<cough>...I've been through worse! You're gonna have to go to Sabermaw and get the other merchants out though.$b$bThey've probably got 'em all caged up in there...

Objectives.text: 救出$oa名地精商人。
Objectives.english: Rescue $oa Goblin Traders.

identity.title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode - Consolation (Nth)

Title.text: 影月墓地挑戰模式－安慰獎(第N次)
Title.english: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode - Consolation (Nth)

identity.title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode - Bronze Addition (Nth)

Title.text: 影月墓地挑戰模式－青銅勳章(第N次)
Title.english: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode - Bronze Addition (Nth)

identity.title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode - Silver Addition (Nth)

Title.text: 影月墓地挑戰模式－白銀勳章(第N次)
Title.english: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode - Silver Addition (Nth)

identity.title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode - Gold Addition (Nth)

Title.text: 影月墓地挑戰模式－黃金勳章(第N次)
Title.english: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode - Gold Addition (Nth)

identity.title: Vignette: Yaga the Scarred
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
identity.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人卵簇、$2oa个冰铸噬铁者和巢母里戈艾克。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.

identity.title: Obliterating Ogres
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
identity.description: With actual ogre mages present, the Highmaul have been increasing patrols and aggression.$b$bThinning their ranks will go a long way to deterring the Highmaul from making a comeback in Nagrand.$b$bHead up to my sister Mirana afterwards, she should have more news.

Objectives.text: 在马尔高克岗哨消灭$1oa个食人魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.

identity.title: Iridium Recovery
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Iridium Dust from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim.
identity.description: Ared used to always teach me that the purity of the metal is key. If the metal isn't pure it will crack under stress and be of no use to anyone.$b$bFor the artillery tower to function I'll need to make metal as pure as my master would, and for that I need a strong flux.$b$bThe dust from crushed iridium geodes would work in a pinch, but we need to find some first. They tend to congregate underground, so check out the mine in Kuuro's Claim nearby.

Objectives.text: 从库洛的领地的铱金晶簇上采集$1oa份铱金之尘。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Iridium Dust from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim.

identity.title: Iridium Recovery
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Iridium Dust from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim.
identity.description: My goods used to be for the very best, now the Iron Horde make copies out of poor metal and give them to everyone.$b$bI'm going to show them what a real smith can do in your arsenal, but first I'm going to need a powerful flux to make the metal as pure as it can get.$b$bThe dust from crushed iridium geodes would work in a pinch but we need to find some first. They tend to congregate underground, so check out the mine in Kuuro's Claim nearby.

Objectives.text: 从库洛的领地的铱金晶簇上采集$1oa份铱金之尘。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Iridium Dust from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim.

identity.title: Gas Guzzlers
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa samples of Goren Gas from Glowgullet Shardshedders and Glowgullet Devourers within Kuuro's Claim.
identity.description: $g Sir:Ma'am;, to make the best equipment for your arsenal I need not only the best materials, but to use the best techniques.$b$bOver the years I've developed a method to greatly strengthen my metal, but it does require an exotic resource: goren gut gas!$b$bThe nearby mine at Kuuro's Claim just came down with an infestation of the things. Could you collect a few samples for the arsenal supplies? Just kill a few goren and give their bodies a good prod with this gas extractor.

Objectives.text: 从库洛的领地的亮喉切割者和亮喉吞噬者身上取得$1oa份鬣蜥人气体样本。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa samples of Goren Gas from Glowgullet Shardshedders and Glowgullet Devourers within Kuuro's Claim.

identity.title: Looking for Lumber
identity.objectives: Mark $1oa trees.
identity.description: Some of the trees around here look small enough that the workers should be able to down them in no time.$b$bWe can leave the hard labor to Shelly's men, but if you'd be willing to mark the trees for them to start with, we should be able to get this operation rolling much faster.

Objectives.text: 标记$1oa棵树木。
Objectives.english: Mark $1oa trees.

identity.title: Quakefist
identity.objectives: Kill Quakefist.
identity.description: I'm getting reports of a giant in the forest.$b$bA few of the Karabor peacekeepers have followed it to a cave. In all honesty I don't think any of our troops are willing to engage the beast.$b$bMaybe you could investigate? I'm sure the peacekeepers would appreciate the help.

identity.title: A Gronnling Problem
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Frostfire Gronnlings.
identity.description:
It's gonna be quite a task to build you a fortress if there's gronnlings rampaging around.

I don't think anyone else here can handle taking those big beasts out, so you might need to take care of it yourself.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa只霜火小戈隆。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Frostfire Gronnlings.

identity.title: Removing the Paper Trail
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Boxes of Ogre Research at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
identity.description: This box is filled with writings and diagrams that oddly resemble research into the nullification of magic.$b$bIt would be best to ruin these efforts by destroying any research found.

Objectives.text: 在马尔高克岗哨摧毁$1oa个食人魔研究盒。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Boxes of Ogre Research at Mar'gok's Overwatch.

identity.title: Creating the Ink
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Pulsating Pustules from Sporebats and Fungal Giants in Zangarra.
identity.description: We need a way to create an artificial nexus at your tower.$B$BI know where we can get the conduit to do that, but it's well-guarded. We need to keep our cool and do this the right way.$B$BI have a plan - a scroll of mass teleportation.$B$BThe fungal giants and shamblers down below are covered with pustules full of an oily substance. We can use the oil to craft a makeshift ink substitute for the scroll.

Objectives.text: 从赞加拉的孢子蝠和真菌巨人身上收集$1oa个脉动的脓包。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Pulsating Pustules from Sporebats and Fungal Giants in Zangarra.

identity.title: Forming the Scroll
identity.objectives: Rip $1oa Pieces of Bark off of Slumbering Ancients in Zangarra.
identity.description: We'll need arcane parchment to make the scroll.$B$BThe arcane energy everywhere at this nexus froze the ancients in place and settled in their bark.$B$BIf we take pieces from the few that haven't been destroyed by the fungal creatures, I can mold them into parchment.

Objectives.text: 从赞加拉休眠的古树上收集$1oa块树皮。
Objectives.english: Rip $1oa Pieces of Bark off of Slumbering Ancients in Zangarra.

identity.title: Ravenous Ravens
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Lunarfall Ravens.
identity.description: Do you see that? There is a gigantic raven just past the tree line.$b$bI'm not getting anywhere near that. In fact, I'm not sure any of the men are sufficiently equipped to deal with a threat like that. $b$bDo you want to handle this one yourself, commander?$b$bOnce those ravens are gone we can start sending more troops into the woods. So we will be killing two birds with one stone... or should I say kill five birds with...$b$b<Confused by his own analogy, Baros scratches his head.>$b$bYou get the point.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa只坠月渡鸦。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Lunarfall Ravens.

identity.title: Gathering the Spark
identity.objectives: Harvest $1oa Arcane Vortexes in Zangarra.
identity.description: We need arcane energy to complete our scroll. It needs that to coalesce the scroll together.$B$BI have an artifact that can capture energy vortexes in the caldera below, so let's get moving.

Objectives.text: 在赞加拉收集$1oa个奥术漩涡。
Objectives.english: Harvest $1oa Arcane Vortexes in Zangarra.

identity.title: Gas Guzzlers
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa samples of Goren Gas from Glowgullet Shardshedders and Glowgullet Devourers within Kuuro's Claim.
identity.description: To complete my master's designs and to stock up the artillery tower we need to use an exotic resource, namely goren gut gas.$b$bThe nearby mine at Kuuro's Claim just came down with an infestation of the things. Could you collect a few samples for me? The stuff is concentrated, so only a few are needed. Just kill one and give its body a good prod with this gas extractor.

Objectives.text: 从库洛的领地的亮喉切割者和亮喉吞噬者身上取得$1oa份鬣蜥人气体样本。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa samples of Goren Gas from Glowgullet Shardshedders and Glowgullet Devourers within Kuuro's Claim.

identity.title: Creating the Ink
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Pulsating Pustules from Sporebats and Fungal Giants in Zangarra.
identity.description: We're going to need a way to create an artificial nexus at your tower.$B$BI know where we can get what we need, but it's heavily protected. We don't have the firepower to just waltz in the front door.$B$BI have a plan - a scroll of mass teleportation.$B$BThe fungal giants and spore creatures down below are covered in pustules filled with an oily substance. If we gather enough of the oil I can craft a makeshift ink substitute for the scroll.

Objectives.text: 从赞加拉的孢子蝠和真菌巨人身上收集$1oa个脉动的脓包。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Pulsating Pustules from Sporebats and Fungal Giants in Zangarra.

identity.title: Forming the Scroll
identity.objectives: Rip $1oa Pieces of Bark off of Slumbering Ancients in Zangarra.
identity.description: For this plan to work, we'll need infused parchment.$B$BThe latent arcane energy at this nexus quickly froze the ancients in place and settled in their bark.$B$BIf we rip off strips from the few that haven't been destroyed by the fungal creatures, I can form them into parchment.

Objectives.text: 从赞加拉休眠的古树上收集$1oa块树皮。
Objectives.english: Rip $1oa Pieces of Bark off of Slumbering Ancients in Zangarra.

identity.title: Gathering the Spark
identity.objectives: Harvest $1oa Arcane Vortexes in Zangarra.
identity.description: We need to get our hands on arcane energy to complete our scroll. It needs that fiery kick.$B$BI have a device capable of capturing energy in the space below, so let's get moving. The infused creatures shouldn't be an issue for the two of us.

Objectives.text: 在赞加拉收集$1oa个奥术漩涡。
Objectives.english: Harvest $1oa Arcane Vortexes in Zangarra.

identity.title: Adherents of the Sun God
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Adherent Bladewings.
identity.description: The arakkoa from Skyreach are all ruled by the Adherents of Rukhmar. They revile those of us who bear the Curse of Sethe, and decree that we must be purged in the name of their sun god.$B$BSoon their gaze will turn to lands beyond Arak.$B$BChallenge their warriors. Buy me time to prepare my escape, and help me set into motion their downfall.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名信徒刀翼战士。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Adherent Bladewings.

identity.title: Orders From On High
identity.objectives: Loot the Adherent Proclamation from Sun-Sage Rathyx.
identity.description: The Adherents of Rukhmar are the ruling body atop the spires. Their influence is absolute. Their proclamations taken as the will of Rukhmar Herself.$B$BThe herald leading this purge is surely carrying out such orders - likely no more than a list of names and places they plan to erase.$B$BThat list would prove invaluable in the days to come. Acquire it for me, and shut that herald up!

identity.title: The Crone
identity.objectives: Speak the password to Ornekka at Crow's Crook.
identity.description: Do you remember our greeting, $p?$B$B"Shadows gather when the raven swallows the day."$B$BIt is more than an old verse - it is a call to action. Followers of the old ways are gathering, and I must join them. You are needed, too, I should think$B$BFollow this road down to Crow's Crook. There you will find the home of an old crone. Greet her as you greeted me, and she will guide the way.$B$BYou will not see me, but I will be close behind.

Description.text: 你还记得我们的问候语吗，$p？$B$B“暗影蔽日，渡鸦吞天。”$B$B那不仅是一句古老的诗文——还是行动的召唤。老派的追随者们正在集结，而我必须加入他们。我想他们也需要你。$B$B沿着这条路前往乌鸦小屋。你会找到某个老太婆的家。用你跟我打招呼的方式去问候她，然后她会为你指明方向的。$B$B尽管你看不见我，可我就跟在你身后。
Description.english: Do you remember our greeting, $p?$B$B"Shadows gather when the raven swallows the day."$B$BIt is more than an old verse - it is a call to action. Followers of the old ways are gathering, and I must join them. You are needed, too, I should think$B$BFollow this road down to Crow's Crook. There you will find the home of an old crone. Greet her as you greeted me, and she will guide the way.$B$BYou will not see me, but I will be close behind.

identity.title: Ring of Trials: Crushmaul
identity.objectives: Defeat Crushmaul in the Ring of Trials.
identity.description: So you want to fight in the Ring of Trials do you? It's your funeral, bub!$b$bYour first fight is against an exceptionally large and angry ogre named Crushmaul. That's not all though, you'll have to take out his armored boar companion too; Crushmaul never goes into the ring without him!$b$bI hope your affairs are in order, because the last gladiator that fought Crushmaul went home in a body bag...$b$bI'm counting on you! Get your ass inside the arena and speak with my associate Guzrug to start the fight!

PortraitGiverText.text: 你的第一个对手是碾槌！
PortraitGiverText.english: Your first match is against Crushmaul!

identity.title: Ring of Trials: Raketalon
identity.objectives: Defeat Raketalon in the Ring of Trials.
identity.description: You may have defeated Crushmaul, but the party's over now...you've got another fight!$b$bThe Highmaul take gladiatin' seriously; so when they built the Ring of Trials, they searched far and wide for the most brutal creatures they could find!$b$bYou're up against a dread raven the ogres are calling Raketalon! I'm telling you, $n, something about that bird just ain't right...I think it truly enjoys the act of killing!$b$bRaketalon toyed with the last gladiator for hours before eating him.$b$bTry not to die!

PortraitGiverText.text: 不被犁爪吃掉的秘诀，就是避开它的鸟喙！
PortraitGiverText.english: The key to not being eaten by Raketalon is to avoid the beak!

identity.title: Ring of Trials: Hol'yelaa
identity.objectives: Defeat Hol'yelaa in the Ring of Trials.
identity.description: You won your first two fights, but it's only going to get tougher from here!$b$bYour next fight is against Hol'yelaa, a former rangari who is as crazy as they come.$b$bNo, really... Hol'yelaa is bonkers!$b$bYears ago, while on a scouting mission, he single handedly saved his entire rangari unit from a pack of Garn. But something inside of him snapped....$b$bIt wasn't long before Hol'yelaa went completely marbles and turned on his own unit!$b$bAlright, the pep talk is over! Get in there and kick some ass!

PortraitGiverText.text: 曾是精英游侠组织的成员，他的攻击带有致命的精准性。
PortraitGiverText.english: A former member of the elite rangari, he attacks with deadly precision.

identity.title: Ring of Trials: Captain Boomspark
identity.objectives: Defeat Captain Boomspark in the Ring of Trials.
identity.description: You've been making a name for yourself in the arena, $n!$b$bDon't get too excited though...fame has its consequences! You've been challenged by an up-and-coming gladiator who is looking to make a name for himself, sound familiar?$b$bYour next fight is against Captain Boomspark, a mercenary who came here to fight for the Iron Horde.$b$bThe Iron Horde ain't exactly throwing piles of gold around, so now he's here!$b$bHe's got a shredder, so watch out for the blades... and the fire too... especially the fire!

PortraitGiverText.text: 击败爆火上尉和他的武装切割机！
PortraitGiverText.english: Defeat Captain Boomspark and his weaponized shredder!

identity.title: Ring of Trials: Roakk the Zealot
identity.objectives: Defeat Roakk in the Ring of Trials.
identity.description: The final match is at hand, $n! You've decimated all of the best challengers! There's nowhere to go from here but the very top...the reigning champion of the Ring of Trials!$b$bThe current champ is an arakkoa named Roakk the Zealot. Roakk is a lunatic! He says he's on some divine crusade for the sun or something.$b$bCrazy or not, he's one of the most dangerous fighters I've ever seen and has even fought in the Highmaul Coliseum!$b$bI'm not going to lie, you're probably going to die in there...good luck!

PortraitGiverText.text: 试炼竞技场的卫冕冠军，也是首屈一指的致命角斗士！
PortraitGiverText.english: The reigning champion of the Ring of Trials, and one of the deadliest combatants the arena has ever seen!

identity.title: The Rise of Aku'mai
identity.objectives: Kill Aku'mai the Devourer
identity.description: We barely escaped the Twilight's Hammer sacrificial altar, but there are others who need help deeper within these caves. If these cultists complete their blood ritual, they will unleash Aku'mai the Devourer onto the world. You cannot let this happen.

PortraitGiverText.text: 小心阿库麦尔的头。
PortraitGiverText.english: Beware the heads of Aku'mai.

identity.title: The Rise of Aku'mai
identity.objectives: Kill Aku'mai the Devourer
identity.description: We barely escaped de Twilight's Hammer sacrificial altar, but others be needin' help deeper in. If de blood ritual be complete, they be unleashin' Aku'mai da Devourer. Don let this be happenin', mon.

PortraitGiverText.text: 小心阿库麦尔的头。
PortraitGiverText.english: Beware the heads of Aku'mai.

identity.title: Krav'ogra
identity.objectives: Slay Slavemaster Ok'mok by using the Challenge Gong in Stonemaul Arena.
identity.description: Stonemaul has chieftain, and it has slavemaster. Today, we kill both.$b$bFirst, Slavemaster Ok'mok. Me fight in arenas since me your size. Me know cruelty. Slavemaster Ok'mok is cruelty.$b$bWant to be true gladiator? Go to Stonemaul Arena, bang challenge gong in center of arena, and face beasts of slavemaster.$b$bMaybe you make Ok'mok so mad he jump down himself to kill you. If he do, kill him instead.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奴隶头子
PortraitGiverText.english: Peddler of Flesh

identity.title: The Axe of Kor'gall
identity.objectives: Kill Kor'gall and retrieve his axe, Serathil.
identity.description: Time for vengeance! We are going to kill Kor'gall and you are going to take his axe.$b$bShatter this feeble barrier, follow the bridge beyond until you reach the chieftain's throne.$b$bYou freed us, so the honor of first blood is yours. Strike the first blow and we will join you in the cutting.

PortraitGiverText.text: 石槌食人魔的残暴酋长
PortraitGiverText.english: The cruel chieftain of Stonemaul

identity.title: Vignette: Jehil the Climber
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
identity.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人卵簇、$2oa个冰铸噬铁者和巢母里戈艾克。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.

identity.title: Operation: Just Arrowhead
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.
identity.description: It goes without saying that we'll help you kill any of the Warsong out in the open down there.$B$BYou just start the fight, and we'll end it with extreme prejudice.

Objectives.text: 在塔拉消灭$1oa名战歌兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.

identity.title: Operation: Just Arrowhead
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.
identity.description: It goes without saying that the Warsong in Telaar need to be dealt with. Rangari Ogir and his forces on the overlook will help you kill any of the orcs that are out in the open.$B$BYou just start the fight, and they'll end it with extreme prejudice.

Objectives.text: 在塔拉消灭$1oa名战歌兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.

identity.title: Blood Oath of Na'Shra
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。
PortraitGiverText.english: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

identity.title: Blood Oath of Lokra
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

identity.title: Keli'dan the Breaker
identity.objectives: Slay Keli'dan the Breaker.
identity.description: One of Ner'zhul's lieutenants remains, up ahead. The exit to the cave isn't much farther past him.$b$bI will go back and tell Khadgar that the cave is clear. We will rendezvous once you've taken care of Keli'dan!

PortraitGiverText.text: 耐奥祖的副官。影月氏族的大巫师。
PortraitGiverText.english: Lieutenant to Ner'zhul. Master Sorcerer of the Shadowmoon.

identity.title: Shields Down!
identity.objectives: Destroy the Arkonite Crystal and Collect the Garrison Blueprints from Packleader Kargora.
identity.description: Did you hear that? They got the shield up. There'll be no getting into Telaar now.$B$BYou must get that shield down. The only way to do it is to destroy the Arkonite crystal.$B$BDon't worry about me. You're going to kill two birds with one stone; Packleader Kargora is the one who stole your blueprints.

PortraitGiverText.text: 她身上有图纸。干掉她并摧毁阿肯尼特护盾。
PortraitGiverText.english: She has the blueprints. Kill her and destroy the arkonite shield.

identity.title: Clear!
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Zapper Sacs from Lakebottom Zappers in Talador.
identity.description: You gotta help me fix this robot. I'm friggin' hungry!$B$BI built the Pleasure-Bot 8000 to locate Draenor truffles, and what does it do? It swims to this stupid island and shorts its power fluctuator.$B$BI got it hooked up to these batteries, but it ain't enough juice to jump it.$B$BBe a doll and get me the zapper sacs from the electric eels in the lake, would ya? They oughta be enough.

Objectives.text: 从塔拉多的湖底杀手身上收集$1oa个电磁囊。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Zapper Sacs from Lakebottom Zappers in Talador.

identity.title: A Charming Deception
identity.objectives: Use $1oa Illusion Charms to draw out Adherent Harriers.
identity.description: Reshad is more than he appears; a mottled old crow with his beak in a book, certainly, but we need him.$B$BShadows gather beneath the lonely spire, in Veil Terokk. Reshad must make it there safely.$B$BAlong the path you'll find charms primed with illusion spells. You need only touch them to take on Reshad's image.$B$BAdherent assassins are on the prowl for an old outcast with scrolls on his back. They will fall upon you.$B$BOh, but won't they be surprised when the illusion fades?! Kee-hee-hee!

Objectives.text: 使用$1oa个幻影护符来吸引信徒追猎刺客。
Objectives.english: Use $1oa Illusion Charms to draw out Adherent Harriers.

Title.text: 財寶：庫爾克洛什的戰備資金

identity.title: Clear!
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Zapper Sacs from Lakebottom Zappers in Talador.
identity.description: Oh, the gnomanity!$B$BThe Pleasure-Bot 8000 broke before it could bring me a single Draenor truffle. It swam here and shorted its power fluctuator.$B$BAGAIN!$B$BI have power going to it, but it isn't enough to override the fluctuator.$B$BCould you get me the sacs from the electric eels in the lake? I think that would be just the ticket!

Objectives.text: 从塔拉多的湖底杀手身上收集$1oa个电磁囊。
