Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Zapper Sacs from Lakebottom Zappers in Talador.

identity.title: The Den of Skog
identity.objectives: Kill Skog.
identity.description: So this gronn infestation ain't gonna solve itself. You're gonna have to show them who's boss, Horde style!$b$bWith this many gronnlings around there is bound to be a full grown, big mama of a gronn. Find him... it... her... or whatever, and take it out, and the rest of those gronnlings might lose interest in our little operation here.

PortraitGiverText.text: 当地小戈隆的妈妈和/或爸爸。
PortraitGiverText.english: Mother and/or father of the local gronnlings.

identity.title: Logistical Nightmare
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Sacks of Supplies and $2oa Garrison Records.
identity.description: Commander, I am afraid I have... troubling... news.$B$BThese saberon followed our encampment from Gorgrond, and have been stealing our supplies, ransacking our ledgers, and slaughtering our peons!$B$BI hate to ask of your time to deal with the matter, but all of our men are stationed guarding the camp from any further raids. We desperately need those supplies so we may enact your will!

Objectives.text: 找回$1oa个补给袋和$2oa份要塞记录。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $1oa Sacks of Supplies and $2oa Garrison Records.

identity.title: Why Is The Brew Gone?
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Footman Longswords and $2oa Thunderbrew Kegs.
identity.description: Commander, we have a bit of a... uh... problem.$B$BThis group o' saberon followed us from Gorgrond, and they've been stealin' our footmen's swords an' slaughtering our peasants!$B$BI hate to ask fer your time, but all of yer men are guardin' the camp from any further raids. Plus...$B$B<Quartermaster O'Riley lowers her voice to a whisper.>$B$BThey took our beer!

Objectives.text: 取回$1oa把步兵长剑和$2oa个雷酒桶。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $1oa Footman Longswords and $2oa Thunderbrew Kegs.

identity.title: Defenstrations
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadowmoon Raiders or Dark Priestesses.
identity.description: No sooner does power rush to the crystal outside than you hear distant war cries and shouts of alarm. Elodor is being attacked!$b$bIf you want your laborers to come home in one piece, you'd best help with the defense of the town. Defeat the invasion and then return to the control console to reset the defenses.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名影月袭击者或影月黑暗女祭司。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Shadowmoon Raiders or Dark Priestesses.

identity.title: Fun with Fungus
identity.objectives: Use the Shimmershrooms to safely gather $oa Volatile Spores.
identity.description: It is our mission as rangari to explore and understand this world. Around you is the Umberfen. Many draenei lost their lives when we first discovered this place. The volatile spores burst whenever anyone approaches.$b$bBut we watched... and we learned.$b$bAround the swamp you'll notice "Shimmershrooms," distinguished by their orange glowcaps. Their dust will make you invisible to the volatile spores. Grab the spores - gently! - and bring them to me.$b$bWe will forge this savage world into a weapon.

Objectives.text: 用荧光蘑菇安全地采集$oa个不稳定的孢子。
Objectives.english: Use the Shimmershrooms to safely gather $oa Volatile Spores.

identity.title: Engorged Goren
identity.objectives: Collect $1Oa Crystallized Goren Scales from Crystalmaw goren in the Elodor Dig.
identity.description: You must be the $c that so impressed Exarch Hataaru. Can you help?$b$bThe Elodor Dig just behind me is overrun by strange stone creatures. These so-called goren actually devour minerals, metabolize them, and grow crystalline structures from their arms and back. Like most of the wildlife on this world, they completely baffle us.$b$bPlease slay as many as you can and gather their crystal scales for me. You'll be protecting our earthworkers and aiding our research at the same time.

Objectives.text: 从艾洛多尔挖掘场里的晶喉鬣蜥人身上收集$1Oa块晶化鬣蜥人鳞片。
Objectives.english: Collect $1Oa Crystallized Goren Scales from Crystalmaw goren in the Elodor Dig.

identity.title: A Pilgrimage Gone Awry
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Prowler Blood, $2oa Snapdragon Fronds, and a Riverhopper Eye.
identity.description: I am a humble pilgrim, I swear. Please don't hurt me!$B$BMy sister and I were traveling to Auchindoun to pay our respects to my grandmother when we hit an overturned rock and lost control of our caravan. I managed to survive, but my sister...$B$B<Nadur cries.>$B$BPlease, you have to help me. I'm desperate. If you could bring me some prowler blood, snapdragon flowers, and a riverhopper eye, I can fashion a potion to bring her back. I just know it....

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份徘徊者的血、$2oa片金鱼草复叶和1只跳蛙眼。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Prowler Blood, $2oa Snapdragon Fronds, and a Riverhopper Eye.

identity.title: A Pilgrimage Gone Awry
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Prowler Blood, $2oa Snapdragon Fronds, and a Riverhopper Eye.
identity.description: My sister and I were traveling to Auchindoun to pay our respects to my grandmother when we hit an overturned rock and lost control of our caravan. I managed to survive, but my sister...$B$B<Nadur cries.>$B$BPlease, I need your help. If you could bring me some prowler blood, snapdragon flowers, and a riverhopper eye, I can fashion a potion to bring her back... I just know I can...

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份徘徊者的血、$2oa片金鱼草复叶和1只跳蛙眼。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Prowler Blood, $2oa Snapdragon Fronds, and a Riverhopper Eye.

identity.title: Send Them Running
identity.objectives: Slay Vicegnaw just outside Vol'jin's Pride.
identity.description: Your scouts have located the saberon's alpha male just outside our gates!$B$BCommander, I believe that dispatching this target will send any of these remaining vermin running back to their caves.$B$BI do not wish to ask more of you, but you are the only one capable of this task, $gsir:ma'am;.

identity.title: Not In Your House
identity.objectives: Slay Ripgut just outside Fort Wrynn.
identity.description: $GSir:Madame;, we have located the saberon's alpha male just outside our gates!$B$BWe believe that slaying him will send any remaining saberon running with their tails between their legs, but the beast is positively massive!$B$BI do not wish to call upon you once more, but you are the only one capable of this task.

identity.title: Echo Hunters
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Echo Hunters.
identity.description: I am no sorcerer, but I've picked up a few spells in my time - enough for me to pass unseen by the naked eye.$B$BUnfortunately, the vampire bats in these woods don't use their eyes. They will hear my shuffling robes and Percy's incessant clucking a mile away.$B$BClear them away from the path, would you?

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa只回声猎手。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Echo Hunters.

identity.title: More Lazy Peons
identity.objectives: Motivate $1oa Lazy Peons.
identity.description: We have a rare opportunity to strike at the heart of the Warsong. But, we need your wisdom and leadership.$B$BThe most important decision will be your choice between building a corral or a tankworks. This choice will setup our approach to the fight against the Warsong.$B$BThazz'ril will head up our building efforts. Will you give him a hand?$B$BIt looks like he's having trouble motivating his peons to work.

Objectives.text: 激励$1oa名懒惰的苦工。
Objectives.english: Motivate $1oa Lazy Peons.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这是胜利的敌人！这会阻碍部落的成功！适当激励他一下！
PortraitGiverText.english: This is the enemy of Victory! This stands in the way of the Horde's success! Properly motivate him!

identity.title: A Lesson in Mineralogy
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Earthen Cores.
identity.description: <Gazmolf gestures at the large machine nearby.>$b$bI built this machine to break down elementium minerals into base elements. You see, it's not just what's buried within the ground that can be valuable; but also the ground itself!$b$bTake, for example, the earth elementals below us; inside every earth elemental is an earthen core, dense in precious metal!.$b$bThose elementals are going to make us rich! Collect several earthen cores, place them in the Gold-O-Matic 9000, and I'll give you a cut!

Objectives.text: 收集$oa个大地之核。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Earthen Cores.

identity.title: Good Help is Hard to Find
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Nagrand Antiquities.
identity.description: The excavation team is on strike!$b$bForeman Thazwix and his cronies think they can squeeze the Steamwheedle Preservation Society for some extra dough by refusing to work.$b$bWhat I need is a scab, a strikebreaker; someone to put some pressure on them by doing the job they refuse to do!$b$bGo down into the gorge, dig up some antiquities for me, and I'll pay you what I would have payed those lazy numbskulls!

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa件纳格兰古董。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Nagrand Antiquities.

identity.title: Fruitful Ventures
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Nagrand Cherries.
identity.description: Oh no! They must be vegetarians.$B$BWhat these elekk need is fruit and lots of it. There are cherries all over the place around here under the trees.$B$BYou wouldn't mind grabbing me some, would ya?

Objectives.text: 采集$1oa颗纳格兰樱桃。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Nagrand Cherries.

identity.title: What We Need
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Drudgeboat Salvage.
identity.description: I heard you guys hijacked and wrecked a ship on your way out of Tanaan.$b$bIt's like my daddy always said: One man's wreck is another goblin's workshop.$b$bYou should head down to the coast west of the garrison and see if you can't find any materials we might salvage. Oh, and uh... should probably watch yourself. I hear there are ogre raiders in the area.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份奴隶船残骸。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Drudgeboat Salvage.

identity.title: The Ogron Live?
identity.objectives: Slay Groog.
identity.description: Commander, our Frostwolf allies reportin' dat the Bladespire ogres have an outpost to our west led by an ogron.$b$bI heard tales of da ogron but never seen one. Dey be brutes, creatures from a time that was best left forgotten. Dey say most were slain during the forming of the original horde. What dey lack in wisdom they make up for in violence, force, and greed.$b$bI counsel dispatchin' dis creature as soon as possible.

PortraitGiverText.text: 奴隶主
PortraitGiverText.english: The Slave Maker

identity.title: The Friend of My Enemy
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
identity.description: Hallvalor is the ancestral home of the Burning Blade clan. Since they're such fast friends, the Warsong have allowed the blademasters to remain in Nagrand.$B$BWe are fierce, but we won't win if the Burning Blade attack us. It would be wise to strike first.

Objectives.text: 在哈瓦洛消灭$1oa名火刃兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.

identity.title: New Neighbors
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Shattered Hand orcs in Camp Thornscar.
identity.description: The Shattered Hand clan is made up of orcs who can call no other clan home. They are sadistic warriors who maim their bodies, perhaps in a show of solidarity or perhaps because they simply enjoy the pain.$B$BIt does not matter. What matters is that they are expanding their territory, butchering anyone in their path.$B$BThey must be dealt with.

Objectives.text: 在棘痕营地里消灭$1oa个碎手兽人。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Shattered Hand orcs in Camp Thornscar.

identity.title: Lunarblossom
identity.objectives: Pick $1oa Lunarblossoms.
identity.description: How I long to hold Kat'la.$b$bNo star or moon can compare to her beauty.$b$bAlas, I am but a simple boar farmer.$b$bIf only I could find time to sneak away from this pathetic excuse for a job and pick some lunarblossoms for Kat'la.$b$bI wouldn't dare confess my love to her without a gift.

Objectives.text: 摘取$1oa朵萤月花。
Objectives.english: Pick $1oa Lunarblossoms.

identity.title: The Blade Itself
identity.objectives: Retrieve Lantresor's Blade from Instructor Luhk.
identity.description: When they clapped me in irons, the Burning Blade instructor, Luhk the Keen-Eyed, took my blade. He's an honorable orc, even if his training techniques are counter-productive.$B$BI want my blade back, $c. Then, I'll break myself free.

PortraitGiverText.text: 剑圣训练师拿走了兰特瑞索的长剑。
PortraitGiverText.english: This trainer of blademasters has Lantresor's Blade.

identity.title: Vignette: Gruuk
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
identity.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人卵簇、$2oa个冰铸噬铁者和巢母里戈艾克。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.

identity.title: Tracking Flag: Orcs Kicked Out of Cave

Title.text: 跟蹤目標：被逐出洞穴的獸人
Title.english: Tracking Flag: Orcs Kicked Out of Cave

identity.title: Prized Repossessions
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Gordunni "Toothpick's" from Gordunni Bashers or Gordunni Cleavers within Gordal Fortress.
identity.description: The Gordunni were given copies of my blades as a gift from the Iron Horde. But what do they use them for? Toothpicks!$b$bSure the blades are low grade copies but it's still MY design and I can't stand to think of them in those ogre hands for a moment longer!$b$b$gSir:Ma'am;, While we are in here can you do me a favor and get those blades out of their hands!

Objectives.text: 从古尔达要塞的戈杜尼痛击者或戈杜尼劈砍者身上收集$1oa根戈杜尼“牙签”。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Gordunni "Toothpick's" from Gordunni Bashers or Gordunni Cleavers within Gordal Fortress.

identity.title: Supply Recovery
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Iron Horde Shipments.
identity.description: We seem to have arrived at just the right time!$b$bThe Gordunni have been enchanting armaments for the Iron Horde and it looks like they haven't picked up the latest shipment.$b$bWe could put that gear to far better use! Lets go hunt down their shipping containers. I brought some signal flares that we can use to call in an air pick-up when we've secured the shipment.

Objectives.text: 取回$1oa份钢铁部落货物。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Iron Horde Shipments.

identity.title: Tastes Like Chicken
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Raw Windroc from windroc in Nagrand.
identity.description: You got a moment, $g bub:beautiful;? I've got an elekk-sized problem.$B$BSomeone, um, sold me... yeah, sold me these two, but they're sick. I've tried everything, but nothing I do makes any difference!$B$BI think they must be starving. I heard that elekk like raw windroc. Gross if you ask me.$B$BAnyway, while you're out doing your thing, you mind picking me up some bird meat?

Objectives.text: 从纳格兰的风鹏身上取得$1oa块生风鹏肉。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Raw Windroc from windroc in Nagrand.

identity.title: The Lord of the Gordunni
identity.objectives: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk within Gordal Fortress and obtain "Fury of the Forge".
identity.description: Witch Lord Morkurk is the leader of the Gordunni. He's the one that set up the Iron Horde trade and, even worse, my former boss gave him one of my best maces!$b$bWe got to get my mace back! I mean... we need to kill him to secure the jovite for your arsenal!$b$bMorkurk is an accomplished mage so you better be prepared. Here, take the rocket pack and use it if you need to dodge an attack quickly or something.$b$bAlso, if you happen to find my mace I'd like to get it back.

Title.text: 重拾珍貴的財產任務追蹤

identity.title: Dropping In
identity.objectives: Help Magister Krelas destroy $1oa Gordunni Boulderthrowers.
identity.description: Witch Lord Morkurk is no fool.$B$BHe has catapults set up throughout the foothills leading into their compound.$B$BNo matter, I have a way to handle them.$B$BTake out the ogres guarding the siege weapons and mark them once they're clear. I'm readying a vortex spell that will handle things from there.$B$BWe'll meet just outside their gate afterwards.

Objectives.text: 帮助魔导师克雷拉斯摧毁$1oa辆戈杜尼投石车。
Objectives.english: Help Magister Krelas destroy $1oa Gordunni Boulderthrowers.

identity.title: Blades in the Dark
identity.objectives: Slay Malrok Thornscar in Veil Akraz.
identity.description: Those orcs got hold of Ishaal's orb, did they? That would explain the dangerous-looking fellow who crossed into this realm shortly before you.$B$BNot everyone handles the transition as... gracefully as you did. The oaf is still grappling with his own mind, stumbling about and muttering nonsense.$B$BSoon he will be drawn to the orb again, which would presumably lead him to Veil Terokk.$B$BBetter to take him out now while he's still befuddled.

PortraitGiverText.text: 因闯入暗影界而变得精神失常。仍然很危险。
PortraitGiverText.english: Driven mad by crossing into the shadow realm. Still dangerous.

identity.title: A Feast of Shadows
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Shadow Dust.
identity.description: Many arakkoa died in Veil Akraz. From the outside, all seems still. Empty.$B$BBut in this place between worlds, death never goes unnoticed.$B$BStray life essence seeps through from the other side; a feast for the beings who prowl here.$B$BSlay the shadow creatures here, and gather from their corpses the fine dust they produce. I will need much of it to perform the rites of the Talon King.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份暗影之尘。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Shadow Dust.

identity.title: Mother of Thorns
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Shadeback Ravagers and the Shadeback Thornmother.
identity.description: <Beneath Skizzik's outstretched hand, letters are scrawled into the dirt:$B$Bt h o r n$B$Bm o t h e r$B$BRavagers brought in by the Shattered Hand have taken over the aviary and are breeding fast. If left alone, they could be swarming the entire area - including Veil Terokk - in a matter of days.>

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个影背掠食者和影背棘母。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Shadeback Ravagers and the Shadeback Thornmother.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭她和她的掠食者。
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay her and her ravagers.

identity.title: Baby Bird
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Ravager Grubs in the Shadowglade.
identity.description: <Ikky cheeps again, then begins gnawing on his foot.$B$BLooking out across the nearby hillside, you spy tiny ravager grubs inching along the grass.>

Objectives.text: 在黯影丛林里收集$1oa只掠食蛆虫。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Ravager Grubs in the Shadowglade.

identity.title: While We're in the Neighborhood
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Gordunni Runebeads.
identity.description: Ah, the hubris of ogres.$B$BIt always backfires.$B$BMorkurk has been using enchanted bracelets to empower his minions with arcane strength.$B$BWe can disenchant these bracelets into reagents that will no doubt be useful to your arcane sanctum. What do you think about collecting some while we're here?

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa颗戈杜尼符文珠。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Gordunni Runebeads.

identity.title: Orbs of Power
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Astral Wards.
identity.description: There's a minor fire we'll need to put out before we can enact my plan.$B$BMorkurk has placed powerful wards throughout Gordal Fortress that will prevent any sort of mass summoning - awfully detrimental to our scroll of mass teleportation.$B$BThankfully, no ogre would ever consider that a single enemy or two would have the gall to breach their walls.

Objectives.text: 摧毁$1oa个星界结界。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Astral Wards.

identity.title: The Final Step
identity.objectives: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk and retrieve the Arcane Nexus in Gordal Fortress.
identity.description: It's time to fight fire with fire.$B$BWe have Morkurk cornered. His protections gone. Use the scroll once you engage Morkurk...$B$B...and enjoy the fireworks.

identity.title: Rangari Roundup
identity.objectives: Find the $1oa Hidden Rangari.
identity.description: You have a keen eye, $c.$b$bThere are Rangari like myself hidden throughout the Nightmarsh.$b$bI need reports from each of them to ensure the area is safe.$b$bPerhaps you can help me?

Objectives.text: 找到$1oa名潜伏的游侠。
Objectives.english: Find the $1oa Hidden Rangari.

identity.title: New Babies
identity.objectives: Coax $1oa Tenderhoof Meadowstompers.
identity.description: That's better, but there's still something wrong. I'm getting desperate here, $n.$B$BCan I call ya, $n? Great.$B$BLook, I think I have it now. I know what's wrong.$B$BThey miss their babies.$B$BYeah! When they first came here, the, uh... the bastard hunters that... abandoned them said they left the babies behind.$B$BIf we're going to save them from a life of misery, if we're going to save those babies, <under his breath> and turn a tidy profit, we've got to get them some new babies!

Objectives.text: 诱捕$1oa只软蹄草地践踏者。
Objectives.english: Coax $1oa Tenderhoof Meadowstompers.

Title.text: 插曲/寶藏：澙湖水池/巨蚌

identity.title: While We're in the Neighborhood
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Gordunni Runebeads.
identity.description: Ogres from the empire are known for being cold and calculating.$B$BWe are fortunate that their calculations are rarely spot on.$B$BMorkurk has been using enchanted bracelets to empower his minions with arcane strength.$B$BSince we're going to have to dispatch them anyways, we might as well get some reagents out of it.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa颗戈杜尼符文珠。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Gordunni Runebeads.

identity.title: Orbs of Power
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Astral Wards.
identity.description: Minor issue, I'm afraid.$B$BMorkurk has placed powerful wards throughout Gordal Fortress that will prevent any sort of mass summoning - not wonderful considering our plan.$B$BThankfully, no ogre would ever consider that a single enemy or two would attack, so we should be able to slip through their fortress relatively easily.

Objectives.text: 摧毁$1oa个星界结界。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Astral Wards.

identity.title: The Final Step
identity.objectives: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk and retrieve the Arcane Nexus in Gordal Fortress.
identity.description: We have Morkurk cornered. He's all ours now. Use the scroll once you engage Morkurk...$B$B...and enjoy the blizzard of your forces raining down on his head.

identity.title: Dropping In
identity.objectives: Help Magister Serena destroy $1oa Gordunni Boulderthrowers.
identity.description: Witch Lord Morkurk, the leader of the fortress, has catapults set up along the road into their compound.$B$BThat won't be a problem for us.$B$BTake out the ogres around the catapults and mark them for me. This vortex spell I have prepared will handle the rest.$B$BWe'll meet at the gate to the fortress once the catapults are gone.

Objectives.text: 帮魔导师赛琳娜摧毁$1oa辆戈杜尼投石车。
Objectives.english: Help Magister Serena destroy $1oa Gordunni Boulderthrowers.

identity.title: I Help Ya Kill Dem
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.
identity.description: Warsong come in an' kill de draenei rangers. No lettin' dem have dis place.$B$BYou an' me, Commanda. We gonna kill dem all.$B$BYou be distractin' dem an' I usin' me Loa ta finish dem off. You see.

Objectives.text: 在塔拉消灭$1oa名战歌兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.

identity.title: Shields Down!
identity.objectives: Kill Packleader Kargora and destroy the Arkonite Shield.
identity.description: De time has come, commanda. Packleader Kargora an' de Arkonite Shield no longa protected.$B$BWe need ta kill her an' destroy de shield crystal.

PortraitGiverText.text: 决不能让她把塔拉打造成战歌氏族铜墙铁壁般的基地。
PortraitGiverText.english: Keep her from using Telaar as an impenetrable base for the Warsong clan.

identity.title: Words of the Raven Mother
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Ravenspeaker Scroll Fragments.
identity.description: We came here to perform the ritual of calling to bring the return of the Raven Mother. We had distributed parts of the scroll to everyone and had just begun when we were attacked by the Bloodmane. Now most of the flock has been killed and fragments lay scattered across our homeland.$b$bThe ritual was a failure but we will not allow these mongrels to break our faith. We must continue our prayers here but we would be grateful if you can recover the scroll fragments for us.

Objectives.text: 找回$1oa个鸦语者卷轴残片。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Ravenspeaker Scroll Fragments.

identity.title: The Bloodmane
identity.objectives: Slay Huntmaster Sorrowfang and $1oa Bloodmane Razorclaws.
identity.description: We had just arrived and begun the service of the headless fowl when the Bloodmane attacked out of nowhere.$b$bClearly, this means that the Raven Mother wishes to test the worthiness of her children. Fear not, we are steadfast and will fervently continue our prayers regardless of what may come!$b$b<Sekara leans in and whispers to you.>$b$bAlthough, if you can get rid of the Bloodmane and their leader that would be a blessing as well.

Objectives.text: 消灭狩猎大师哀牙和$1oa个血鬃刀爪战士。
Objectives.english: Slay Huntmaster Sorrowfang and $1oa Bloodmane Razorclaws.

identity.title: The Egg Thieves
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Dread Raven Eggs.
identity.description: The Bloodclaw are sadistic creatures. They have attacked the Ravenskar before and have stolen the eggs of the sacred ravens.$b$bWhile you are within the Bloodclaw lands keep an eye out for the eggs.$b$bI'll be waiting for you at the nest with as many baskets for them as I can gather.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa枚恐惧渡鸦的蛋。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Dread Raven Eggs.

Title.text: 寶藏：席娜女士的特別寶藏
寶藏：史卡吉特的特別寶藏

identity.title: Ralshiara's Demise
identity.objectives: Kill Ralshiara.
identity.description: It was said in the Journal of the Rising Sun that eating in the mornings cannot be done without harming a few eggs.$b$bThe Bloodmane matron, Ralshiara, feasts upon sacred raven eggs for her snacks. How dare she! She must die for her sins!$b$bTake the path south over the mountains to reach the accursed home of the Bloodmane.$b$bTake this trinket, it fell to us from the heavens as a sign of the Raven Mother's favor and with it you might have a chance.

identity.title: Declawing The Bloodmane
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Bloodclaw Shaman Paws.
identity.description: It is written in the Scroll of Sermons to "Bite the claw that strikes you."$b$bTake the path south from here that leads over the mountain to the Bloodmane valley in the west. There you will find those of their tribe who can use a primitive form of magic. Slay them and remove their paws.$b$bOnce you have obtained a few bring them back to me in the nest so that they may be offered to the Raven Mother!

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa只血爪萨满的爪子。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Bloodclaw Shaman Paws.

identity.title: The Debt We Share
identity.objectives: Speak with Gar'rok.
identity.description: These mortal shells that we call bodies are not ours to keep. The body is a gift of earth that must one day be returned from whence it came.$b$bThe time has come for this body to return to the elements.$b$bKnow that you have lifted the weight from an old heart, $n. As I pass on from this realm, I do so without regret. I have fought on behalf of my people and my land, I have served the elements, and I have loved.$b$bIt would honor me if you would stay during these final moments, $c.

identity.title: Dreadpiston
identity.objectives: Defeat Dreadpiston.
identity.description:
Nearby, a group of Iron Horde took over a key strategic position with surprising alacrity.

They used a machine they call Dreadpiston to terrible effect in the siege, and I believe we need to destroy that machine before moving against the Iron Horde in Tuurem.

identity.title: The Friend o' My Enemy
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
identity.description: Hallvalor is the ancestral home o' the Burning Blade clan. Since they be such fast friends, the Warsong allow the blademasters an' their shaman to remain in Nagrand when all o' the other clans are forced out.$B$BBlah, blah, blah.$B$BI say, if they're the friend o' my enemy, then they're my enemy, and that's all I need to know!

Objectives.text: 在哈瓦洛消灭$1oa名火刃兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.

identity.title: Blood of the Burning Blade
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
identity.description: Hallvalor is the ancestral home of my clan, the Burning Blade. When the new warlord and his family came to power, I was exiled for being a half-breed.$B$BI want justice.$B$BI suspect you won't mind killing along the way. Not that you'll have any choice.

Objectives.text: 在哈瓦洛消灭$1oa名火刃兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.

identity.title: The Blade Itself
identity.objectives: Retrieve Lantresor's Blade from Instructor Luhk.
identity.description: When they clapped me in irons, the Burning Blade instructor, Luhk the Keen-Eyed, took my blade. He's an honorable orc, even if his training techniques are counter-productive.$B$BI want my blade back, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 剑圣训练师拿走了兰特瑞索的长剑。
PortraitGiverText.english: This trainer of blademasters has Lantresor's Blade.

identity.title: Dreadpiston
identity.objectives: Defeat Dreadpiston.
identity.description:
The Iron Horde overtook a peaceful draenei outpost without mercy.

They used a machine they call Dreadpiston to level the town in minutes.

Destroy it.

identity.title: The Land Provides
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Frozen Plant Matter.
identity.description: The icevines of the Shivering Trench have developed a powerful resistance to cold temperatures. Integrating them into the construction materials of the garrison should prove useful.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份冰冻植物提取物。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Frozen Plant Matter.

identity.title: Supply Recovery
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Iron Horde Shipments.
identity.description: We seem to have arrived at just the right time!$b$bThe Gordunni have been enchanting armaments for the Iron Horde and it looks like they haven't picked up the latest shipment.$b$bWe could put that gear to far better use in our artillery tower! Lets go hunt down their shipping containers. I brought some signal flares that we can use to call in an air pick-up when we've secured the shipment.

Objectives.text: 取回$1oa份钢铁部落货物。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Iron Horde Shipments.

identity.title: Prized Repossessions
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Shattrath Guardian Maces from Gordunni Bashers or Gordunni Cleavers within Gordal Fortress.
identity.description: The Gordunni have plagued the people of Shattrath ever since the city was founded. Over time they amassed quite a hoard of weapons they captured from our defenders in raids.$b$bGetting these weapons in the hands of our soldiers would be practical and I personally would like to get them out of the hands of the ogres.$b$bWhile we are in here can you do me a favor and gather up any of those weapons you come across.

Objectives.text: 从古尔达要塞的戈杜尼痛击者或戈杜尼劈砍者身上收集$1oa把沙塔斯守卫战锤。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Shattrath Guardian Maces from Gordunni Bashers or Gordunni Cleavers within Gordal Fortress.

identity.title: The Lord of the Gordunni
identity.objectives: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk within Gordal Fortress.
identity.description: Witch Lord Morkurk is the leader of the Gordunni. We need to kill him to secure the jovite for use in our artillery tower.$b$bMorkurk is an accomplished mage so you better be prepared. Here, take the rocket pack and use it if you need to avoid any of his deadly magic.$b$bArchenon poros!

Title.text: 重拾珍貴的財產任務追蹤

identity.title: To the... Rescue?
identity.objectives: Rescue "Tillik" from the beast Stonescale in Gnarlwood Pass.
identity.description: The Parchment of Dust reads: "Put the featherless against one another so that our claws remain unsullied!" How wise the high Ravenspeaker is to foresee this day.$b$bThere is a great beast on the hillside to the west by the name of Stonescale. It has abducted one of the flock and despite our many attempts we have been unable to defeat it. $b$bGo, prove yourself by slaying the beast and rescuing Tillik! Fulfill your destiny in the name of the Raven Mother!

identity.title: Botani Beatdown
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Botani.
identity.description: Gidwin is doing much better. Thank you, $n.$b$bI can't believe the draenei have lived alongside those horrible monsters for so long.$b$bMaybe we should show these beasts what happens when you mess with an Azerothian.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个木精。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Botani.

identity.title: Rotting Riverbeasts
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Blooming Mandroga.
identity.description: The botani are infecting the local riverbeasts with some kind of strange flesh-eating plant.$b$bI fear this infection could spread to our people.$b$bIf you see any infested riverbeasts, kill the blooming plants that inhabit their bodies... before they kill you.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个密林妖花。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Blooming Mandroga.

identity.title: Hatred Undying
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Congealed Blood of Sethe from Sethekk Holllow.
identity.description: The blood of the dead god, Sethe, lingers in the pools here. And with it, his hatred of Rukhmar and Anzu.$B$BSo strong was this hate that it animates the blood even now, eons after he was slain by his fellow gods.$B$BI need the congealed blood that holds those spiteful creatures together.$B$BThere is nothing the Adherents fear more than the power of this curse - what if we could brandish it against them?

Objectives.text: 从塞泰克山谷里收集$1oa滴塞泰的凝固之血。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Congealed Blood of Sethe from Sethekk Holllow.

identity.title: Gaze of the Raven God
identity.objectives: Use the Eye of Anzu at $1oa Wind Serpent Nests.
identity.description: The Sethekk are breeding vile wind serpents from Sethe's blood and bones. With these creatures, they will tear apart the sky.$B$BThe nests are protected by powerful magic, but Anzu's gaze should penetrate them with ease.$B$BLet us visit the nests and destroy them!

Objectives.text: 对着$1oa个风蛇巢穴使用安苏之眼。
Objectives.english: Use the Eye of Anzu at $1oa Wind Serpent Nests.

identity.title: Servants of a Dead God
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Sethekk Prophets and $2oa Sethekk Chosen in Sethekk Hollow.
identity.description: Even in death, Sethe exerts influence. The Sethekk cult was born of this influence: led by a false king in service of the dead god.$B$BSilence their prophets, for they seek a future of black seas and blighted skies.$B$BDefeat their chosen champions, for they have pledged themselves to a lie.

Objectives.text: 在塞泰克山谷杀死$1oa名塞泰克预言者和$2oa名塞泰克选民。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Sethekk Prophets and $2oa Sethekk Chosen in Sethekk Hollow.

identity.title: The False Talon King
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Scuffed Bangle from Talon King Ikiss.
identity.description: Ikiss was once a respected sage among the Adherents, but his search for the truth of Terokk's fall led to his own banishment.$B$BIkiss became obsessed with Terokk, even claiming to be the old hero reborn. He commands the Sethekk, promising untold power in a new age of darkness.$B$BKnow this: Ikiss is no Talon King. Slay the delusional fool, and search him for anything useful. He is known to collect powerful trinkets.

PortraitGiverText.text: 一位疯狂的奥术师，坚信自己是泰罗克转世。
PortraitGiverText.english: A crazed arcanist who believes himself to be Terokk reborn.

identity.title: Sethe, the Dead God
identity.objectives: Help Anzu defeat Sethe in the Broken Spire.
identity.description: The time has come to put an end to Sethe. I killed him before, and with your help I shall do it again.$B$BReady yourself for a fight - the cultists will not stand idly by while we stamp out their god.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在塞泰克手中重生。
PortraitGiverText.english: Reborn at the hands of the Sethekk.

identity.title: Gestating Genesaur
identity.objectives: Kill the genesaur.
identity.description: This is bad. A genesaur is starting to sprout right here in the bloom.$b$bThis is the first reported case of a genesaur being born in draenor in over three hundred years.$b$bNo wonder the botani have been acting so crazy. They are bringing back bodies to fertilize that monstrosity.$b$bWe have to kill it before it gets any larger. Once fully grown there is no stopping that beast.

identity.title: Basic Skulltaking
identity.objectives: Take the skulls from $1oa dead Skulltakers.
identity.description: My hunters are all dead, you will be my hunting pack now.$b$bFind their bodies and take their skulls.  I will choose which to honor and which to cast aside.  It is our way.$b$bI will go further and see what other skulls may be found here.

Objectives.text: 从$1oa名死亡的割颅者身上拿下面具。
Objectives.english: Take the skulls from $1oa dead Skulltakers.

identity.title: Skulltaker's Revenge
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Fungal Lurchers.
identity.description: The others... gone or wandered into the haze.  It called to me as well but I am too strong.  I chose to kill until they crushed my body.  I haven't killed enough of them yet $p, not enough!  Go.  Kill more of them and tell my hunt leader that I don't go alone into the dark.

Objectives.text: 杀死$1oa只真菌侦察者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Fungal Lurchers.

Description.text: 其他人……都死了，或是游荡到浓雾深处去了。它同样也在召唤我，但我的意志足够强大。我选择杀死他们，直到我的身体被他们击垮。但我还没杀够，$p，还不够！去吧，去杀死他们，告诉我的猎队领袖，当走进黑暗时，我不是孤身一人。
Description.english: The others... gone or wandered into the haze.  It called to me as well but I am too strong.  I chose to kill until they crushed my body.  I haven't killed enough of them yet $p, not enough!  Go.  Kill more of them and tell my hunt leader that I don't go alone into the dark.

identity.title: Echoes of the Past
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Tormented Echoes.
identity.description: When a spirit is consumed by the void, an echo of the soul is all that is left behind.$b$bNeither in the physical or spiritual sense of the word would these echoes be considered 'alive.' The echo is merely a twisted reverberation of the anguish left behind by the soul as it is consumed.$b$bIf left unchecked, the echoes will lash out against the living and stir the spirits of the dead from their graves.$b$bIn order to restore peace to the Ancestral Grounds, these echoes must be put to rest.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个受难残影。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Tormented Echoes.

identity.title: Golmash Hellscream
identity.objectives: Defeat the spirit of Golmash Hellscream.
identity.description: Those who die in brutal combat often enter the spirit world in unrest. So it was with Golmash, father of Grommash Hellscream.$b$bCrushed within the jaws of a hulking gronn, Golmash still found the strength to bury his axe Gorehowl deep into the eye of the monster. When they fell, it was the gronn who died first.$b$bSuch is the heroic death that every Warsong dreams of, yet few attain. But Golmash's mighty spirit lingers restlessly, stirring the other spirits into unrest.$b$bPut his mighty soul to rest, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 必须让高尔玛什·地狱咆哮的灵魂安息！
PortraitGiverText.english: The spirit of Golmash Hellscream must be put to rest!

identity.title: On the Mend
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Quenching Waters from Steamfury elementals.
identity.description: Nisha will heal.$b$bThis ordeal has taken a toll on her. She needs water and rest.$b$bI will bring her to my camp and make her comfortable.$b$bWill you meet us there with some fresh water?

Objectives.text: 从汽怒元素身上找到$1oa个淬火之水。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Quenching Waters from Steamfury elementals.

identity.title: Clearing the Way
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Fungus Covered Shamblers.
identity.description: The dead ones were the strong ones it seems. The weak ones wander about killing invaders to this marsh.$b$bIt feels... wrong... to kill them, but they are worthless and get in our way. Kill these shambling fools so we can move further into the marsh easily.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个覆菌蹒跚者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Fungus Covered Shamblers.

identity.title: The Secret of the Fungus
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Glowing Mushrooms.
identity.description: It smells here and there are whispers.$b$bI feel there is a connection between the plants and beasts here. Special mushrooms seem to focus the beasts' attention.$b$bGo and get some of these for me. I... need... them.

Objectives.text: 采集$1oa朵荧光蘑菇。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Glowing Mushrooms.

identity.title: A Grim Harvest
identity.objectives: Bring Grulkor $1oa Spore Pods from the Fungal Stompers.
identity.description: The larger monsters are the key to my destiny, I can feel it. The pods growing on them are even bigger than the one you brought me earlier.  Get me a few of these, they will be... helpful... soon.

Objectives.text: 从真菌践踏者身上收集$1oa枚孢子囊，并把它们带给戈鲁科尔。
Objectives.english: Bring Grulkor $1oa Spore Pods from the Fungal Stompers.

identity.title: A Heartfelt Search
identity.objectives: Investigate the strange presence at Crimson Fen.
identity.description: I can feel a powerful presence in the marsh $p.  I feel drawn to it.  We must go and take what is there.  Go on ahead, I must finish consuming these mushrooms.

Description.text: 我能感觉到在沼泽中存在一股强大的力量，$p。它在吸引着我。我们必须前去弄清真相。你先走一步吧，我得把这些蘑菇吃完。
Description.english: I can feel a powerful presence in the marsh $p.  I feel drawn to it.  We must go and take what is there.  Go on ahead, I must finish consuming these mushrooms.

identity.title: Into Anguish
identity.objectives: Use the Fragment of Anguish at the main doorway. Then destroy the Mark of Darkness, Mark of Shadows, and Mark of Anguish.
identity.description: Rulkan's gift to you, the Fragment of Anguish, will allow you to pass into the fortress unhindered. Go up these stairs to the doorway, then use the fragment to enter the compound.$B$BOnce you are inside, you will find three altars powering the magical barrier around their stronghold.$B$BDestroy these runes, and Yrel and I will be able to join you in finding Ner'zhul.

PortraitTurnInText.english: Good work.

identity.title: Seedbearers of Bad News
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa Ancient Seedbearer corpses.
identity.description: When these seedbearers are slain their seeds survive. From them spring new seedbearers, not over years, but hours.$b$bLeaving their remains here would soon cause your camp to be overrun.$b$bBurn them, outsider, if you wish your camp to endure.

Objectives.text: 焚烧$1oa具古树携种者的尸体。
Objectives.english: Burn $1oa Ancient Seedbearer corpses.

identity.title: What the Bony Xuk?
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Goren Crystals from Longtooth Gorgers.
identity.description: Good to see your bones are still intact, $n. Xuk's too.$b$bWhen you set off into the heart of the canyon, Xuk came to offer my services. Xuk not letting you take all of the skulls!$b$bXuk will share with you powerful spirit magics my clan has passed down for many generations. While Xuk make preparations, you must gather the reagents.$b$bFirst, we'll need crystals from husks of goren corpses. You can find their bodies in the canyon.

Objectives.text: 从长牙吞噬者身上收集$1oa块鬣蜥人水晶。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Goren Crystals from Longtooth Gorgers.

identity.title: Terms of Surrender
identity.objectives: Address Uruk Foecleaver at Lok-rath.
identity.description: Believe it or not, I have good news: we've already taken Lok-rath.$B$B<The vindicator beams with pride.>$B$BOur soldiers have captured most of the Warsong, including their leader, Uruk Foecleaver.$B$BI saved the honor of accepting his surrender for you. They're waiting for you inside, commander.

PortraitGiverText.text: 谈妥投降条件，并把他带回伊瑞尔的哨所。
PortraitGiverText.english: Secure terms of surrender and escort him back to Yrel's Watch.

identity.title: The Pride of Lok-rath
identity.objectives: Kill Uruk Foecleaver.
identity.description: You think the Warsong are so easily defeated?$B$B<There's a rasping sound, like rope on metal.>$B$BI'm already tired of you Alliance, and you've just invaded my homeland.$B$B<The sound becomes more pronounced as Uruk Foecleaver looks you straight in the eye.>$B$BThere will be no surrender. The Warsong bow to no one!

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死洛克拉斯的战歌指挥官乌鲁克·破敌。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill the Warsong Commander of Lok-rath.

identity.title: A Harvester Has Come
identity.objectives: Slay Harvester Ommru.
identity.description: This is what happens when one stands in the path of a genesaur. And where a genesaur walks, the botani follow.$b$bI saw one entering our shelter cave along the northern side of the camp.$b$bIt is commanding the podlings to gather the corpses of our fallen brethren and must be stopped.$b$bI must tend to our wounded, and gather supplies for our departure.$b$bIf you are serious about being a hero, venture into the cave and slay this botani.

PortraitGiverText.text: 它是原祖荆兽艾韵的武器。
PortraitGiverText.english: He is a weapon of the genesaur, Iyu.

identity.title: Silence the War Machines
identity.objectives: Destroy the $1oa Iron Horde War Machines.
identity.description: The Iron Horde supplied Lok-rath with war machines from Ironfist Harbor. It won't take long for them to level Yrel's Watch.$B$BSomeone has to silence those war machines!

Objectives.text: 摧毁$1oa辆钢铁部落战争机器。
Objectives.english: Destroy the $1oa Iron Horde War Machines.

identity.title: If They Won't Surrender...
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa enemy forces at Lok-rath.
identity.description: This is the backbone of the army we intend to send against Garrosh Hellscream and Grommashar.$B$BIf they won't surrender, we have no choice but to eliminate the Warsong.

Objectives.text: 在洛克拉斯消灭$1oa个敌人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa enemy forces at Lok-rath.

identity.title: Terror of Nagrand
identity.objectives: Collect Shagor's Collar from Shagor.
identity.description: <The body of a fallen soldier lies here. Blood and gore trail back from the corpse to the entrance of the cave just to the north.>$B$B<Judging by the howls and the carnage surrounding the den, something truly terrifying must be in there.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 获得沙戈尔的项圈。别让阵亡的将士们白死。
PortraitGiverText.english: Get Shagor's Collar. Don't let the fallen soldier's death have been in vain.

identity.title: Clearing Out Before Cleaning Up
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Crimsonwing Wasps.
identity.description: Here's the situation.$b$bWe need to get this salvage operation moving ASAP, but the ship went down right in the middle of the wasp nests.$b$bThe ugly bugs are all over the place, and I can't call my team in here to start work until they're taken care of.$b$bGo kill as many of 'em as you can and I'll cut you in on some of the haul.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个赤翼巨蜂。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Crimsonwing Wasps.

identity.title: Disrupt the Rituals
identity.objectives: Destroy the Ritual Totems.
identity.description: No longer do the Warsong seek to be one with the elements; instead they abuse their power by using it to channel the darkness of the void.$b$bI will not tolerate these rituals to continue. Locate the ritual totems the Warsong use to channel the void and destroy them.$b$bThe gift of the elements was not given to the orcs only to be defiled and used as a plaything.

PortraitGiverText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitGiverText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

identity.title: Silence the Call
identity.objectives: Slay Kuhlrath and $2oa Warsong shaman.
identity.description: The Warsong clan, in their lust for dominance, have turned to the darkness of the void for power. Dark shamanism is a loathsome, dangerous practice that abuses the elemental gift I have bestowed upon them.$b$bThere is one among the Warsong that calls out the loudest to the void, an elder shaman named Kuhlrath. Slay him and the rest of his dark shaman.$b$bI will not allow the Warsong to abuse the elements and desecrate tradition.

Objectives.text: 消灭库拉斯和$2oa位战歌萨满祭司。
Objectives.english: Slay Kuhlrath and $2oa Warsong shaman.

PortraitGiverText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitGiverText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

identity.title: Through the Nether
identity.objectives: Use a Void Beacon to travel to the Twisting Nether.
identity.description: The rituals have been disrupted, yet the nether beacons still glow with power....$b$bThis can only mean that the beacons are powered from within the Twisting Nether itself!$b$bThe connection to the void must be severed! There is but one way to accomplish this; you must slay the void creature that maintains the connection with our world.$b$bLay your hands upon a beacon and travel into the Twisting Nether. When you have arrived on the other side, locate a Shamanstone and use it to contact me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitGiverText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

identity.title: The Void March
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Void Terrors and $2oa Void Tendrils.
identity.description: Hidden behind the veil of the Twisting Nether, the abominations of the void march upon Oshu'gun. The great void growing deep within the mountain has drawn them like moths to a flame.$b$bWave upon wave, the creatures of the void march upon the mountain and sacrifice themselves to Invalidus. The void lord Invalidus cannot be allowed to feast upon the other void creatures, else it will become too powerful to stop.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa只虚空恐魔和$2oa根虚空触须。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Void Terrors and $2oa Void Tendrils.

PortraitGiverText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitGiverText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

identity.title: The Nether Approaches
identity.objectives: Collapse $oa Void Portals.
identity.description: By connecting with the Twisting Nether, the Warsong shaman have created a ripple effect that they could not have anticipated.$b$bLook around and you will see countless portals beginning to open, signs that the Twisting Nether seeks to connect to Draenor.$b$bShould these portals successfully open, the path will be clear for all manner of demons and void creatures to rampage across this valley.

Objectives.text: 摧毁$oa座虚空传送门。
Objectives.english: Collapse $oa Void Portals.

PortraitGiverText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitGiverText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

identity.title: The Shadow of the Void
identity.objectives: Summon and defeat Invalidus.
identity.description: The moment has come to take on the void lord. Invalidus grows more powerful by the minute, so you must move with haste if you are to defeat the monster.$b$bAt each of the Warsong ritual locations there is a void crystal; these crystals are used to channel the energy of the void from within the Twisting Nether.$b$bDisturb the crystal, and Invalidus will sense your presence below.$b$bBe ready, as soon as the crystal is disturbed, Invalidus will waste no time hunting you down.

PortraitGiverText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitGiverText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 卡拉迪奥斯的低语声随风飘进你的耳中。
PortraitTurnInText.english: The voice of Kalandrios whispers to you upon the wind.

identity.title: Skimming Off the Top
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Volatile Oil.
identity.description: That flying machine is our ticket out of here but its fuel tank is bone dry!$b$bWe're right next to the oil fields but with the infected out there we don't have time to run a line up here so we need to improvise.$b$bThe oil creatures moving next to the pumps out there are full of a highly potent mixture that I can drop right into the tank. Grab some of that oil for me and we'll be one step closer to getting out of here.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份易燃油膏。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Volatile Oil.

identity.title: Sporicide
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Spore Shamblers in Pinchwhistle Point.
identity.description: It's revolting, absolutely disgusting, infuriating even!$b$bI'm talking about seeing those spore creatures walking around Pinchwhistle Point.$b$bWhile I'm working on the machine here how about you go out and kill off some of those spore creatures? I'll feel a bit better knowing there are less of those things moving around.

Objectives.text: 在宾奇维斯拓殖点消灭$1oa个孢子蹒跚者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Spore Shamblers in Pinchwhistle Point.

identity.title: Terms of Surrender
identity.objectives: Address Uruk Foecleaver at Lok-rath.
identity.description: I have good news, commander: we've already taken Lok-rath.$B$B<The warchief grins.>$B$BThe Horde's soldiers have captured most of the Warsong, including their leader, Uruk Foecleaver.$B$BI saved the honor of accepting his surrender for you. They're waiting for you inside, commander.

PortraitGiverText.text: 谈妥投降条件，并把他带回河畔岗哨。
PortraitGiverText.english: Secure terms of surrender and escort him back to Riverside Post.

identity.title: The Pride of Lok-rath
identity.objectives: Kill Uruk Foecleaver.
identity.description: You think the Warsong are so easily defeated?$B$B<There's a rasping sound, like rope on metal.>$B$BI'm already tired of you Horde, and you've just invaded my homeland.$B$B<The sound becomes more pronounced as Uruk Foecleaver looks you straight in the eye.>$B$BThere will be no surrender. The Warsong bow to no one!

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死洛克拉斯的战歌指挥官乌鲁克·破敌。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill the Warsong Commander of Lok-rath.

identity.title: Silence the War Machines
identity.objectives: Destroy the $1oa Iron Horde War Machines.
identity.description: The Iron Horde supplied Lok-rath with war machines from Ironfist Harbor. It won't take long for them to level Riverside Post.$B$BSomeone has to silence those war machines!

Objectives.text: 摧毁$1oa辆钢铁部落战争机器。
Objectives.english: Destroy the $1oa Iron Horde War Machines.

identity.title: If They Won't Surrender...
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa enemy forces at Lok-rath.
identity.description: This is the backbone of the army we intend to send against Garrosh Hellscream and Grommashar.$B$BIf they won't surrender, we have no choice but to eliminate the Warsong.

Objectives.text: 在洛克拉斯消灭$1oa个敌人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa enemy forces at Lok-rath.

identity.title: Terror of Nagrand
identity.objectives: Collect Shagor's Collar from Shagor.
identity.description: <The body of a fallen soldier lies here. Blood and gore trail back from the corpse to the entrance of the cave just to the north.>$B$B<Judging by the howls and the carnage surrounding the den, something truly terrifying must be in there.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 获得沙戈尔的项圈。别让阵亡的将士们白死。
PortraitGiverText.english: Get Shagor's Collar. Don't let the fallen soldier's death have been in vain.

identity.title: Fair Warning
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ogron Spinecrushers and Borogahn.
identity.description: The ogron here are far from brilliant, but they are more intelligent than the gronn. They're large, and even stronger than they look.$b$bTheir leader, Borogahn, is especially formidable. Despite several fights, I have not yet managed to kill him.$b$bHeed my words, friend. Take caution as you explore their lair.$b$bNisha is ready to move. Ask her to take you to the mouth of the cave, and I'm sure she would be happy to.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个独眼魔碎脊者和波罗戈。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ogron Spinecrushers and Borogahn.

identity.title: Chains of Iron
identity.objectives: Defeat Captain Brak and find the Heart of the Magnaron.
identity.description: The artifact we seek is within our grasp.$b$bBe prepared for a fight. If they truly have learned how to control gronn, this may be more difficult than I anticipated.$b$bI will join you in this battle as soon as you arrive.

identity.title: THAELIN!
identity.objectives: Capture $1oa Baby Goren.
identity.description: That little...!$B$B<Yrel tries to maintain her composure.>$B$BThaelin Darkanvil sent us a shipment. It was supposed to be engineering parts.$B$BInstead, when we just opened one of the crates, out popped a baby goren. Do you know how destructive those things are?$B$BAnd, of course, the one baby immediately set about letting all the other ones loose.$B$BWant to help me get some revenge?

Objectives.text: 抓住$1oa只小鬣蜥人。
Objectives.english: Capture $1oa Baby Goren.

identity.title: Carrier Has Arrived
identity.objectives: Deliver the Baby Goren Carrier to Thaelin Darkanvil at Telaari Station.
identity.description: We're going to get some payback on that little stinker.$B$BPut the baby goren into one of those carriers and then make a special delivery to Thaelin.

PortraitGiverText.text: 把鬣蜥人当礼送。
PortraitGiverText.english: Give the gift of goren.

identity.title: Blood of the Burning Blade
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
identity.description: Hallvalor is the ancestral home of my clan, the Burning Blade. When the new warlord and his family came to power, I was exiled for being a half-breed.$B$BI want justice.$B$BI suspect you won't mind killing along the way. Not that you'll have any choice.

Objectives.text: 在哈瓦洛消灭$1oa名火刃兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.

identity.title: Dark Binding
identity.objectives: Free $1oa elemental spirits.
identity.description: Even as we speak, the pale within Shadowfall Canyon are enslaving the elements to their will. Many elemental spirits have already been enthralled, and more will follow.$b$bThe pale must be stopped and the elementals they enslave set free.$b$bJourney into Shadowfall Canyon and set free those elemental spirits which are not fully enthralled by the pale. As for the elementals already enslaved by the pale, the only mercy we can give them now is to release their bonds through death.

Objectives.text: 释放$1oa个元素之灵。
Objectives.english: Free $1oa elemental spirits.

identity.title: The Pale Threat
identity.objectives: Kill Greyseer and $2oa Pale orcs.
identity.description: The Pale are wretched creatures that hide beneath the ground, ever plotting against those who dwell upon the surface. They stalk the Underpale, a twisted and dark cavern beneath Oshu'gun.$b$bIf we are to succeed in stopping Cho'gall we must fight our way through their ranks beneath the earth.$b$bMake your way into the cavern, slay the vile creatures within and take out the Pale leader... the one known as Greyseer.

Objectives.text: 消灭格雷希尔和$2oa个白鬼兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill Greyseer and $2oa Pale orcs.

identity.title: Obliterating Ogres
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
identity.description: We got more of those magic tossing ogres here which is never a good thing.$b$bThese new ogres are especially bossy and have increased work being done here.$b$bDo you know what stops ogres from working hard? Dying.$b$bKill some ogres here and get this camp back to its normal boring self.

Objectives.text: 在马尔高克岗哨消灭$1oa个食人魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.

identity.title: Removing the Paper Trail
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Boxes of Ogre Research at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
identity.description: This box is filled with writings and diagrams that oddly resemble research into the nullification of magic.  It would be best to ruin these efforts by destroying any research found.

Objectives.text: 在马尔高克岗哨摧毁$1oa个食人魔研究盒。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Boxes of Ogre Research at Mar'gok's Overwatch.

identity.title: Removing the Reinforcements
identity.objectives: Destroy the Portal to Highmaul.
identity.description: Its not good $p, these smart ogres have got a portal working up there and they are bringing in more ogres from somewhere else.$b$bIt looks like it takes a lot of effort to keep it open though. If you take it down I'm guessing they will be delayed quite a while.

Description.text: 情况不妙，$p。这些聪明的食人魔在这里设立了一座传送门，并不断把别处的食人魔带到这里来。$B$B不过要维持这座传送门似乎要花不少气力。假如你把它关上，或许可以拖延他们一段时间。
Description.english: Its not good $p, these smart ogres have got a portal working up there and they are bringing in more ogres from somewhere else.$b$bIt looks like it takes a lot of effort to keep it open though. If you take it down I'm guessing they will be delayed quite a while.

identity.title: Ship Salvage
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa crates of Drudgeboat Salvage.
identity.description: Commander, we are running low on supplies.$b$bMaybe we can salvage materials from that ship you arrived on?$b$bAt the rate folks are coming through the portal we are going to be out of everything by sundown... or moondown?$b$bI'm still getting used to this place.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa箱奴隶船残骸。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa crates of Drudgeboat Salvage.

identity.title: Consumed by Vengeance
identity.objectives: Kill Worgskin the Savage.
identity.description: They... they came out of nowhere. From that direction.$B$B<The young girl points vaguely west through her tears.>$B$BThey were on their nasty wolves.$B$BPlease, commander, my family's honor is at stake. Will you get vengeance for me?

PortraitGiverText.text: 制裁这个战歌兽人，为奥格拉的家人报仇。
PortraitGiverText.english: Exact vengeance upon this Warsong orc for what he did to Olgra's family.

identity.title: Pale Moonlight
identity.objectives: Kill Gnaw Bloodseeker and $2oa Pale Devourers.
identity.description: We are getting strange reports of an orc attack on a nearby draenei settlement called Eventide Landing.$b$bI'm hearing these particular orcs are unlike any we have encountered before.$b$bThey seem... sickly, and are pale in color.$b$bThe locals could use our help, commander. This seems like the perfect opportunity to test our garrison's capabilities.

Objectives.text: 消灭诺恩·觅血者和$2oa名白鬼搜寻者。
Objectives.english: Kill Gnaw Bloodseeker and $2oa Pale Devourers.

identity.title: An Ancient Threat
identity.objectives: Kill Eldermoss.$B$BIf you lose your disguise, kill Sargerei enemies to collect a Sargerei Cowl, Sargerei Robe, and Sargerei Slippers to create a Sargerei Disguise.
identity.description: To the northwest, an Ancient has settled into a forest glade.$B$BI need someone to take care of this nuisance.$B$BThis should be a simple matter, even for an initiate like you.

identity.title: Facing Demons
identity.objectives: Defeat Invokaz, and destroy the demon gate.
identity.description: Time is running out, $n. The Sargerei have opened a summoning portal on the hill to the west.$B$BI believe they are going to use this portal to bring an army of demons here, to Shadowmoon Valley.$B$BWe must stop them before this happens, no matter what the cost. Use this arcane bomb to destroy the portal.$B$BWe may blow our cover, but stopping the portal is more important right now.

identity.title: Socrethar's Fury
identity.objectives: Confront Socrethar, then collect the Sargerei Battle Plans from Soulbinder Zamaya.
identity.description: <Upon opening the scroll, you find a message from Anchorite Laanda.>$B$BI write this message hastily. I've been discovered. I'm being taken in front of Socrethar.$B$BYou must carry on our mission. I've learned that Soulbinder Zamaya holds a detailed plan of Socrethar's next attack.$B$BShe still trusts you, so you should be able to enter the main building. Please, find those plans, $n!

identity.title: Xuk Me, Right?
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Goren Shells from Boneyard Gorgers.
identity.description: The magics Xuk is weaving will let you perform great acts, but preparations must be made before the spirits will bless us with their power.$b$bXuk needs many shells from the pesky goren. To gather them, Xuk will share a secret.$b$bApproach their tunnel craters and the goren will pour out. This way, you kill many at once.

Objectives.text: 从骨园暴食者身上获得$1oa份鬣蜥人甲壳。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Goren Shells from Boneyard Gorgers.

identity.title: Pollen Power
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Potent Pollen.
identity.description: The botani use monstrous insect-like creatures to pollinate their bloom.$b$bThe pollen they carry has a number of powerful properties that would be of use to your garrison forces.$b$bIf you bring me a reserve of this pollen I should be able to convert it to something of value.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份强效花粉。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Potent Pollen.

identity.title: Burn the Bodies
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa Mulching Bodies.
identity.description: You don't understand. Anythin' these plant people don't infest they fatten up and then turn inta mulch.$b$bI say we take out their food source.$b$bThese botani got a few corpses lying around that I saw. Might be a good idea to burn those bodies.$b$bLet's find out if they can infest ash.

Objectives.text: 焚烧$1oa具被覆盖的尸体。
Objectives.english: Burn $1oa Mulching Bodies.

identity.title: Bushwhacker
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Bloom Weavers.
identity.description: We are continuing the search for Thaelin's people, but these botani, they are a larger threat than we ever realized.$b$bTo infest their victims... monstrous.$b$bPlease, commander, if you find yourself in Evermorn Springs to our west, slay as many of those creatures as you can.$b$bStop them from committing such acts of horror. Bring them to justice.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名繁花编织者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Bloom Weavers.

identity.title: Coalpart's Revenge
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Dew Masters.
identity.description: I'm so full I can't swing an axe even if I had one.$b$bTell ya what, we got a mutual interest here. I need yer help to get a little vengeance on the big botani at the back of this bloom. In return, I'll point ya in the right direction fer gettin' a secret weapon the botani keep.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名晨露大师。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Dew Masters.

identity.title: The Life Spring
identity.objectives: Collect Waters of Utrophis.
identity.description: So we came here cause we needed a weapon we saw the botani using.$b$bHansel grabbed the artifact an' Scorchbrow an' I were supposed to grab the special water the thing runs on.$b$bWe didn't know that water so full of life forms an elemental.$b$bIf ya mosey up to the cauldron at the base of that fancy lookin' ancient artifact in Evermorn Springs, you'll be findin' this beast. If ya can kill it and get its water, we can use it when we get the rest of the artifact.

PortraitGiverText.text: 生命之水的化身
PortraitGiverText.english: Manifestation of living water.

identity.title: Preventing the Worst
identity.objectives: Place $1oa Firebombs within Pinchwhistle Point.
identity.description: Have you seen all the fungus on the buildings in Pinchwhistle Point? It's only a matter of time 'til it releases enough spores to infest the whole coastline!$b$bThe remaining infected that are in Pinchwhistle Point will be too far gone for us to save later on, so let's do the right thing and put them out of their misery and prevent an even worse outbreak.$b$bI made some firebombs that will burn the fungus down, but I'll need you to place them while I set up the detonator.$b$bAre you up for it?

Objectives.text: 在宾奇维斯拓殖点安放$1oa枚火焰炸弹。
Objectives.english: Place $1oa Firebombs within Pinchwhistle Point.

identity.title: The Infested
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Infested.
identity.description: D'kaan did not say it, but there were more rangari taken by the botani than the ones you found.$b$bHe believes they were slain. I fear worse.$b$bYou might dare to venture into the Razorbloom. If you do, you may discover what the botani do to their... "prisoners."$b$bGive these poor souls a proper release.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名被感染者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Infested.

identity.title: The Voice of Iyu
identity.objectives: Slay the Voice of Iyu.
identity.description: Journal Entry 25 -$b$bThe botani got themselves a leader who calls himself... er... herself... er... itself the Voice of Iyu.$b$bSeems the botani see the genesaur as gods and only the most bossy of the botani get to speak on behalf of the genesaur.$b$bWhen we tried askin' it about the artifact we found back at the base it got all angry and sent off Lera and Nori and I ain't seen either of them since.$b$bI got a bad feelin' about this thing.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他代表原祖荆兽说话。
PortraitGiverText.english: He speaks for the genesaur.

identity.title: Firing the Mayor
identity.objectives: Kill Mayor Nurg Boltsnap.
identity.description: The bottle has a large stopper in it with the label "Property of Mayor Nurg Boltsnap."$b$bAs you gaze at the bottle you hear the sound of heavy machinery coming from the nearby marshland. $b$bAn investigation would be prudent. If the mayor has turned he will also need to be put down.

identity.title: Ogre Diplomacy
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ango'rosh in the Ango'rosh Ruins.
identity.description: Ogres are ogres. Spirits or not, the Ango'rosh are not different.$B$BEven with their ritual books, they won't relinquish their power to you until you prove yourself.$B$BI've fought ogres my entire life, and there's only one way to earn that.$B$BKilling them outright.$B$BThe more Ango'rosh spirits and their pets as you take out while you're there, the more respect you'll command among them.

Objectives.text: 在安葛洛什废墟消灭$1oa个安葛洛什食人魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ango'rosh in the Ango'rosh Ruins.

identity.title: Firing the Mayor
identity.objectives: Kill Mayor Nurg Boltsnap.
identity.description: Ever since this zombie outbreak began I haven't seen the mayor at all. If he is infected then we could be in for a huge problem if he can escape out of town. Damn, we could be in for another zombie outbreak even!$b$bWe got to find him and make sure he doesn't escape! He used to ride in his custom shredder down on the shore line before the fungus started covering up everything. You might find him down there.

identity.title: Down the Goren Hole
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa goren in Moira's Reach.
identity.description: These beasts came at us so fast we didn't have time to mount a proper defense. They went right for the metal and chewed through any wall we had.$b$bIf we don't kill some of them soon they'll bring the whole fortress down on us.

Objectives.text: 在茉艾拉堡垒消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa goren in Moira's Reach.

identity.title: Iyu
identity.objectives: Defeat Iyu.
identity.description: Did ya hear that?$b$bSounds like that genesaur wants its 'will' back. I told ya this place is nuthin' but bad luck.$b$bI'll git that shot ya gave me loaded properly and see if I can't weaken that thing up. You better get up there and deal with it though...

PortraitGiverText.text: 原祖荆兽来了。
PortraitGiverText.english: The genesaur has come.

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。
PortraitGiverText.english: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

identity.title: A Harsh Reminder
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa denizens of the wasteland in Affliction Ridge.
identity.description: Welcome to the front lines, outsider, where the wastelands and the jungle collide.$b$bWhen their forces forget about the ferocity of the Laughing Skull, this is where we come to make them remember.$b$bBy fierce and merciless destruction we survive. This is the way of Gorgrond.$b$bJoin in! Let us see if you can withstand the brutality of our land.

Objectives.text: 在苦痛山脊消灭$1oa个荒地住民。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa denizens of the wasteland in Affliction Ridge.

identity.title: Retribution for the Light
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa demons in Gul'rok.
identity.description: There are agents of darkness everywhere, fighting tooth and nail to envelop the world. The Light relies on us to balance the scale.$B$BYou have the power needed to destroy Teron'gor's demonic minions once and for all. Send them to the Twisting Nether in pieces!

Objectives.text: 在古尔罗克消灭$1oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa demons in Gul'rok.

identity.title: Legacy of the Apexis
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Solar Cores from Apexis Guardians.
identity.description: The Apexis are long gone, but their legacy lies preserved in ancient chambers beneath Arak.$B$BLegions of dormant constructs; crystals flush with solar energy; magical techniques lost to the ages - the Apexis left behind caches of immense power, which the Adherents of Rukhmar have begun to unearth.$B$BBring me the cores of the re-activated constructs patrolling the excavation site. Those crystals are the basis of Apexis technology, and the key to our enemy's devastating power.

Objectives.text: 从埃匹希斯卫士身上收集$1oa份太阳之核。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Solar Cores from Apexis Guardians.

identity.title: Sol Sisters
identity.objectives: Slay Sol-Shaper Veoryx and Sol-Shaper Krashyx.
identity.description: When I was still a guard in Skyreach, I was tasked with protecting the sisters Veoryx and Krashyx.$B$BThey were prodigies. At an age when most sun acolytes could barely read, the sisters conjured familiars of pure sunlight to illuminate their textbooks in the small hours.$B$BNow they unravel the secrets of Apexis technology, and their excavation has just breached two ancient chambers.$B$BEnter those chambers and cut down the sisters before they reap the terrible rewards of their discovery.

PortraitGiverText.text: 塑日者双子。
PortraitGiverText.english: The twin Sol-Shapers.

PortraitGiverName.text: 维奥里克斯和卡拉什克斯

identity.title: Hardly Working
identity.objectives: Use Illusion Effigies to create decoys for $1oa Enslaved Outcasts.
identity.description: Those who were not incinerated at Veil Akraz are forced to help the Adherents excavate the very weapons aimed at their heads.$B$BAnyone trying to escape is vaporized by the overseer's Apexis turret.$B$BWith these effigies, they won't know anyone has left! Place one near an enslaved worker and observe as it creates a perfect copy. It even cloaks the subject in shadow, so they can slip away safely!

Objectives.text: 使用幻影雕像来创造$1oa个被奴役的流亡者的幻影。
Objectives.english: Use Illusion Effigies to create decoys for $1oa Enslaved Outcasts.

identity.title: Shot-Caller
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Apexis Interface from Overseer Akrath.
identity.description: <Solar energy courses through the slumbering constructs, their ancient servos whirring to life all around you. It is too late to shut them down now.$B$BOutside, an arakkoa overseer bellows commands, each answered by the buzz of an Apexis beam carving away at the mountain.$B$BThat turret would make short work of the constructs - if you can command it.>

identity.title: Hot Seat
identity.objectives: Use the Overseer's Chair to take control of the Apexis Turret and slay $1oa Apexis Destroyers and $2oa Adherent Sol-Shapers.
identity.description: <Apexis constructs are about to emerge from their ancient chambers on a warpath. The arakkoa are sure to send more sol-shapers to support them.$B$BThe interface and the turret hum in soft resonance.>

Objectives.text: 使用指挥椅控制埃匹希斯炮塔，消灭$1oa个埃匹希斯毁灭者和$2oa名信徒塑日者。
Objectives.english: Use the Overseer's Chair to take control of the Apexis Turret and slay $1oa Apexis Destroyers and $2oa Adherent Sol-Shapers.

Title.text: 风暴烈酒酿造厂奖励任务

identity.title: That Pounding Sound
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Pairs of Leatherhide Ears from Leatherhide clefthoof.
identity.description: Commander. The rangari and I were just discussing the merits of various 'hunting' approaches.$B$BI assured her that the SI:7 are well-equipped to deal with any situation, even ones out in the wild.$B$BShe seems to think that we don't know what we're doing when it comes to bringing down game in 'her land.'$B$BWe're not going to let her get away with saying that, right? Let's take down some clefthoof.

Objectives.text: 从厚皮裂蹄牛身上取得$1oa对厚皮耳朵。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Pairs of Leatherhide Ears from Leatherhide clefthoof.

identity.title: Shooting the Breeze
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Breezestrider Horns from Breezestrider talbuk.
identity.description: Kia and I are having a spirited debate over who kills more efficiently: SI:7 or rangari.$B$BCare to get in on the wager, commander?$B$BI've been focusing on talbuk because of their fierce majesty. They truly encapsulate the grandeur of Nagrand as any native of Draenor knows.

Objectives.text: 从风蹄塔布羊身上取得$1oa个风蹄羊角。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Breezestrider Horns from Breezestrider talbuk.

identity.title: A Parting Favor
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Spectral Essences from restless spirits inside the garrison and use them to convince Alice Finn of her fate.
identity.description: I don't know what happened. My crew and I must have been the first to fall.$B$BMy wife, the innkeeper, is in the same stupor you found me in. I can feel it... and there are others with her.$B$BPlease, give the townsfolk peace and show their essences to my wife. That should bring her back from that cold abyss.

Objectives.text: 从要塞狂躁的幽灵身上收集$1oa份鬼灵精华，并用它们来说服爱丽丝·费恩接受她的命运。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Spectral Essences from restless spirits inside the garrison and use them to convince Alice Finn of her fate.

identity.title: Defection of Gronnstalker Rokash
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。
PortraitGiverText.english: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

identity.title: Queen of the Clefthoof
identity.objectives: Collect the Horn of Banthar from Banthar.
identity.description: Laara told me that they have Banthar here! Or rather, that she's still alive back now. Did what I just said make any sense?$B$BThis is our chance, commander. We can defeat a younger, more powerful version of Banthar and really stick it to these rangari.$B$BWe'll show Laara how a true professional works.

PortraitGiverText.text: 比外域的更加年轻，更加强壮。把她的犄角带来。
PortraitGiverText.english: A younger, more powerful version than the one on Outland. Return with her horn.

identity.title: A Piece of the Puzzle
identity.objectives: Kill the Horrific Aberration in the basement of the inn.
identity.description: I... I remember now. Watch Commander Branson told us to stay in the inn... he said we would be safe here.$B$BThen...$B$BThen that THING broke through and slaughtered everyone!$B$BThe last thing I remember seeing was it descending into the larder.

identity.title: King of the Breezestriders
identity.objectives: Collect Tall Buck's Tail from Tall Buck.
identity.description: Let me guess, you found it in a talbuk's flank?$B$B<Laara seems lost in thought for a moment.>$B$BThat arrow was intended for Tall Buck, king of the Breezestriders. Another talbuk - the one you killed - jumped in the way as I was taking my shot.$B$BI suggest you go after the king. When I was hunting him, he seemed fond of the pond at Lonely Falls to the south.

PortraitGiverText.text: 纳格兰的塔布羊之王
PortraitGiverText.english: King of all the talbuk in Nagrand.

identity.title: That Pounding Sound
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Pairs of Leatherhide Ears from Leatherhide clefthoof.
identity.description: Commander.
