The frostwolf and I were just discussing the merits of various 'hunting' approaches.$B$BI assured her that the shadow hunters are well-equipped to deal with any situation, even ones out in the wild.$B$BShe seems to think that we don't know what we're doing when it comes to bringing down game in 'her land.'$B$BWe're not going to let her get away with saying that, right? Let's take down some clefthoof.

Objectives.text: 从厚皮裂蹄牛身上取得$1oa对厚皮耳朵。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Pairs of Leatherhide Ears from Leatherhide clefthoof.

identity.title: Queen of the Clefthoof
identity.objectives: Collect the Horn of Banthar from Banthar.
identity.description: Ogka told me that they have Banthar here! Or rather, that she's still alive back now. Did what I just said make any sense?$B$BThis is our chance, commander. We can defeat a younger, more powerful version of Banthar and really stick it to these frostwolves.$B$BWe'll show Ogka how a true professional works.

PortraitGiverText.text: 比外域的更加年轻，更加强壮。把她的犄角带来。
PortraitGiverText.english: A younger, more powerful version than the one on Outland. Return with her horn.

identity.title: Shooting the Breeze
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Breezestrider Horns from Breezestrider talbuk.
identity.description: Taz and I are having a spirited debate over who kills more efficiently: shadow hunters or frostwolves.$B$BCare to get in on the wager, commander?$B$BI've been focusing on talbuk because of their fierce majesty. They truly encapsulate the grandeur of Nagrand as any native of Draenor knows.

Objectives.text: 从风蹄塔布羊身上取得$1oa个风蹄羊角。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Breezestrider Horns from Breezestrider talbuk.

identity.title: King of the Breezestriders
identity.objectives: Collect Tall Buck's Tail from Tall Buck.
identity.description: Let me guess, you found it in a talbuk's flank?$B$B<Ogka seems lost in thought for a moment.>$B$BThat axe was intended for Tall Buck, king of the Breezestriders. Another talbuk - the one you killed - jumped in the way as I was taking my shot.$B$BI suggest you go after the king. When I was hunting him, he seemed fond of the pond at Lonely Falls to the south.

PortraitGiverText.text: 纳格兰的塔布羊之王
PortraitGiverText.english: King of all the talbuk in Nagrand.

identity.title: The Void March
identity.objectives: Destroy $oa Void Creatures.
identity.description: Legions of void terrors are marching upon Oshu'gun and sacrificing themselves to the void lord Invalidus.$b$bAs they die Invalidus grows stronger. It is as if the lesser creatures only serve to feed the void lord.$b$bWe must stop Invalidus from becoming so powerful that it cannot be stopped.$b$bSlay as many void monsters as you can, to slow the growth of Invalidus. In the meantime, I will search for a way to encounter Invalidus before it is too late to stop it.

Objectives.text: 摧毁$oa只虚空生物。
Objectives.english: Destroy $oa Void Creatures.

identity.title: The Nether Approaches
identity.objectives: Collapse $oa Void Portals.
identity.description: By drawing upon the power of the void, the Warsong have thinned the veil that shields our world from the Twisting Nether.$b$bPortals are opening within the nether that threaten to connect the terrors of the void to Draenor.$b$bShould these portals fully open, the path will be clear for all manner of demons and void creatures to rampage across Nagrand.$b$bGo and collapse the portals before they become functional!

Objectives.text: 摧毁$oa道虚空传送门。
Objectives.english: Collapse $oa Void Portals.

identity.title: The Fate of Gordawg
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Heart of the Fury.
identity.description: Looming monstrously between us and the inner chamber is the great fury we have sought to return to the Throne of Elements.$b$bGordawg stands before us enthralled; a slave to Cho'gall. My heart is heavy with grief to see such a great creature mindless and enslaved by evil.$b$bThere is no going back, in order to push forward you must go through Gordawg.$b$bIt pains me, but Gordawg must be slain.$b$bSlay Gordawg and return the fury's heart to the Throne of Elements where it belongs.

PortraitGiverText.text: 只有死亡，才能帮助伟大的大地之怒摆脱古加尔的魔爪。
PortraitGiverText.english: Death is the only way to free the great fury from Cho'gall's grasp.

identity.title: The Pale Threat
identity.objectives: Kill Greyseer and $2oa Pale orcs.
identity.description: If we are to succeed in stopping Cho'gall from destroying the naaru, we will need to fight our way through the Underpale; a dark, winding cavern infested with the Pale.$b$bThe Pale are fallen orcs that despise all that is good and holy. The longer they are left to their devices beneath the ground, the further their dark plots progress.$b$bMake your way into the Underpale, slay the vile creatures within and take out their leader, Greyseer.

Objectives.text: 消灭格雷希尔和$2oa个白鬼兽人。
Objectives.english: Kill Greyseer and $2oa Pale orcs.

identity.title: Dark Binding
identity.objectives: Free $1oa elemental spirits.
identity.description: Even as we speak, the pale are enslaving an army of elementals in Shadowfall Canyon. Many have already been enslaved and if we do not lend our aid, more will follow.$b$bGo to Shadowfall Canyon and set free the elemental spirits which are not yet fully enthralled by the pale. As for those already enslaved, the only mercy we can give them now is a swift death.

Objectives.text: 释放$1oa个元素之灵。
Objectives.english: Free $1oa elemental spirits.

identity.title: The Infested
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Infested Orcs.
identity.description: I understand Kaz's desire to rescue her people, but her plan is reckless and she is not telling us everything.$b$bI came along to make sure she wasn't devising a plan against us and now I see this... this... horror.$b$bWhat did the botani do to these orcs?$b$bThese infested souls need to be put to rest. Give them peace.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名被感染的兽人。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Infested Orcs.

identity.title: The Voice of Iyu
identity.objectives: Slay the Voice of Iyu.
identity.description: The botani and their wretched minions take and take and take.$b$bThey want food, they take our land. They want an army, they take our people.$b$bIt is important to strike fear into the shrubby hearts of these plant people.$b$BLook for their leader, the Voice of Iyu. It is a botani who speaks on behalf of their genesaur master.$b$bKill their precious leader in the safety of his precious bloom.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他为原祖荆兽代言。
PortraitGiverText.english: He speaks for the genesaur.

identity.title: Punishable by Death
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa garrison traitors.
identity.description: Traitors, the lot!$B$BYou're looking at the last bastion of forces still loyal to Admiral Taylor and the Alliance.$B$BI'll be damned if the defectors get away clean.$B$BYou look like you're ready. Show them how we deal with their kind during times of war.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名要塞叛徒。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa garrison traitors.

identity.title: Prime the Cannons
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Ironcoat Cannonballs and $2oa Armory Cannon.
identity.description: The armory is lost to the traitors. All we have left are these few cannons with no ammunition.$B$BSoldier, I need you to recover cannonballs so we can get these things running.$B$BActually, one more cannon wouldn't hurt, either.

Objectives.text: 获得$1oa枚铁舰炮弹和$2oa门军械库火炮。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Ironcoat Cannonballs and $2oa Armory Cannon.

identity.title: Pollen Power
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Potent Pollen.
identity.description: Those of us who grew up in Gorgrond have long learned a few secrets of the botani that can be used to grow our own plants.$b$bThere is no such thing as a hungry Laughing Skull for this reason.$b$bThe ravagers are the key.$b$bOutside of Evermorn Springs you will find ravagers of every type. Slay them and bring me the pollen they carry, and I can cultivate it to be of use to your garrison.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份强效花粉。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Potent Pollen.

identity.title: Bushwhacker
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Bloom Weavers.
identity.description: Kaz is using us, I am sure of it. She is a Laughing Skull and must NOT be trusted.$b$bFor now, I am willing to play along until we can learn more. $b$bKaz is going to ask for you to travel to Evermorn Springs. When there, I recommend you slay any botani you encounter.$b$bCulling the numbers of these horrific casters will hopefully save future orcs from such a infested fate.$b$bI will stay with Kaz and keep a close eye on her.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名繁花编织者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Bloom Weavers.

identity.title: Cut Them Down
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Dew Masters.
identity.description: They steal children? Children?!$b$bHad you not rescued Kaz's child, he would be reduced to mulch just like the others.$b$bYou should send them a message they will understand. Cut down their great dew casters. Rip them apart.$b$bLet them know that it is not okay to take our children.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名晨露大师。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Dew Masters.

identity.title: The Life Spring
identity.objectives: Collect the Waters of Utrophis.
identity.description: It sounds like these... "dwarves"... you found managed to steal a powerful botani artifact.$b$bBut the fools didn't know they need a special water to power it.$b$bTo the north is a well along the Evermorn Rise.$b$bThere you will find a guardian, a creature of water we have named Utrophis.$b$bSlay it and take its essence and you will be one step closer to claiming the power of the botani and their genesaur.

PortraitGiverText.text: 液体形态的生物。
PortraitGiverText.english: A creature of liquid life.

Title.text: 俄特加德之巔 - 額外目標獎勵
俄特加德之巔 - 額外目標獎勵

identity.title: Attack of the Iron Horde
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Grunts.
identity.description: We received reports of the Dark Portal turning red right before the attack. They call themselves the Iron Horde, yet they seem to have no affiliation with the Horde we know.$b$bTheir army is extremely well equipped, and their numbers appear to be unending.$b$bThey have already taken Nethergarde Keep. Our troops on the frontlines could use your help, $c.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名铁军步兵。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Grunts.

identity.title: Under Siege
identity.objectives: Sabotage $1oa Iron Demolishers.
identity.description: Those Iron Horde cannons are laying waste to our troops. I'm not sure how much more of this we can handle. Our forces are already spread too thin.$b$bThere has to be a way to stop those war machines.

Objectives.text: 破坏$1oa辆钢铁攻城车。
Objectives.english: Sabotage $1oa Iron Demolishers.

identity.title: Subversive Scouts
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde scouts.
identity.description: We have been unable to execute a vast majority of our battleplans. We are definitely being watched.$b$bThe Iron Horde must have scouts planted throughout the Blasted Lands. Victory is slipping away from us.

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa名钢铁部落斥候。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Iron Horde scouts.

identity.title: Ending Executions
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Executioners
identity.description: We arrived as soon as we could... but we are too late. Nethergarde has fallen. The Iron Horde has taken a number of Nethergarde warriors prisoner.$b$bNo doubt they are trying to squeeze vital information out of our troops.$b$bI fear once they are done with their interrogation they will not hesitate to execute their prisoners. Time is running out.

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa名铁军处决者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Executioners

identity.title: We Burn the Dead
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa Bodies.
identity.description: I saw lots of bodies here. Kaz always said to burn the bodies.$b$bThat way they can't come back as the mean greens.$b$bWe should burn the bodies.

Objectives.text: 烧光$1oa具尸体。
Objectives.english: Burn $1oa Bodies.

identity.title: Death to the Dreadmaul
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Dreadmaul Ogres.
identity.description: The stupidity of the Dreadmaul ogres never ceases to amaze me. The Iron Horde is clearly using them to further their own nefarious agenda.$b$bRegardless, we must show the ogres what happens when you confront the Alliance. I think it's time we send the Dreadmaul ogres a message.

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa名巨槌食人魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Dreadmaul Ogres.

identity.title: Toothsmash the Annihilator
identity.objectives: Kill Toothsmash the Annihilator
identity.description: If the battleplans you brought back are true, the Dreadmaul ogres are as much to blame for this devastation as the Iron Horde. It's time we send those ogres a message.$b$bIt looks like the Iron Horde's main contact is a large ogre in Dreadmaul named Toothsmash. Killing him will put a dent in their battleplans.

identity.title: Gar'mak Bladetwist
identity.objectives: Kill Gar'mak Bladetwist.
identity.description: With the intelligence you have gathered we have learned this assault is being led by a powerful Iron Horde orc named Gar'mak Bladetwist. He is hunkered down inside Okril'lon Hold.$b$bKilling him will not win this war, but it will surely break down the Iron Horde's communication. This will buy us valuable time while we gather more forces and outline a battleplan to deal with this new threat.

identity.title: Doomshot
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Doomshot.
identity.description: This ominously large explosive appears to be ammunition for the primary cannon that the Bastion is built around.$b$bThe loading assembly must be on a lower floor, but this ammo did not make it that far.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa颗末日之击炮弹。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Doomshot.

identity.title: Growing Wood
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Ancient Growth Sap from botani or ancients within Tangleheart.
identity.description:
I found this dwarf, Thuldren, runnin' out of Tangleheart like his boots were on fire.

Says his mole machine showed up here and he barely made it out alive. And another called Frenna might still be inside.

One useful thing he told me is that the creatures in there have sap that can be used to grow things real fast.

By the way, I'm gonna go lookin' for Thuldren's mole machine. Find me in Tangleheart when you're done.

Objectives.text: 从丛林之心的木精或古树身上收集$1oa份古树生长液。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Ancient Growth Sap from botani or ancients within Tangleheart.

identity.title: Down the Goren Hole
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa goren in Moira's Bastion.
identity.description: Dwarves are dumb. Don't they know that if you dig a deep hole you are going to have goren attack?$b$BIf you are going to go into that iron fort you better kill a bunch of goren otherwise they are going to chew the walls enough to cause a cave-in.$b$bI would do it myself but I'm still stuffed from all that fruit the botani made me eat.

Objectives.text: 在茉艾拉堡垒消灭$1oa个鬣蜥人。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa goren in Moira's Bastion.

identity.title: Chapter I: Plant Food
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Pollen Pods.
identity.description:
There are strange, glowing objects within Tangleheart, seemingly pollinated by a variety of stinging creature.

The botani sometimes collect whatever the pods produce. I can't be sure what it is, but it might be dangerous to us.

- Frenna

Objectives.text: 摧毁$1oa个花粉豆荚。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Pollen Pods.

identity.title: Iyu
identity.objectives: Defeat Iyu.
identity.description: There is a genesaur here!$b$bIt wants its artifact back.$b$bKaz and Draka are fighting it now on the surface but they need you. Draka said I could fire the big gun. So I will stay here and do that.

PortraitGiverText.text: 最原始的生命。
PortraitGiverText.english: The most primal of life.

Title.text: 乌特加德城堡奖励任务

identity.title: Chapter III: Ritual of the Charred
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ancients.
identity.description:
I have seen a strange ritual performed by ancients. They step into fire, burning the leaves from their branches and charring their bark.

I call it the Ritual of the Charred. If we want to weaken the ancients, we can get rid of them before they become even stronger.

- Frenna

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa棵古树。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ancients.

identity.title: Chapter II: The Harvest
identity.objectives: Kill Ontogen the Harvester.
identity.description:
I have seen a creature working with the ancient saplings, imbuing them with anger and hatred toward creatures unlike them.

Perhaps it is this botani who is responsible for the unusually aggressive nature of ancients here in Tangleheart.

Would killing this botani do us good? I fear I would be no match for it alone.

- Frenna

identity.title: Scout Forensics
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Rangari Pouches from dead Rangari.
identity.description: My entire squad is gone. Some are dead; that much is obvious. The others though... they must be further in.$b$bGo and search the bodies of my squad that you find, each will carry a small pouch of personal items. I would like to return these to their families.$b$bI will go ahead and meet you inside the marsh.

Objectives.text: 从死亡的游侠身上收集$1oa只游侠钱袋。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Rangari Pouches from dead Rangari.

identity.title: Vengeance for the Fallen
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Fungal Lurchers.
identity.description: I... almost made it out.  Most of us... dead. The others... they are no longer themselves.$b$bThese lurching spore beasts are the cause, dragging us further into the marsh... stop them.

Objectives.text: 杀死$1oa只真菌侦察者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Fungal Lurchers.

identity.title: Mercy for the Living
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Fungus Covered Shamblers.
identity.description: You can see that the dead were the lucky ones. Those that live wander about attacking anything not infected with these vile spores.$b$bI cannot bring myself to slay them, but if you could bring mercy to those poor people I would be very grateful.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个覆菌蹒跚者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Fungus Covered Shamblers.

identity.title: The Secret of the Fungus
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Glowing Mushrooms.
identity.description: I'm beginning to sense a strong... connection... between the fungus and the creatures that inhabit it. There are certain mushrooms that are stronger than others.$b$bI believe if I had some samples of these I could use them, track the source of this foul fungus and... deal with it.

Objectives.text: 采集$1oa颗荧光蘑菇。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Glowing Mushrooms.

identity.title: A Grim Harvest
identity.objectives: Bring Khaano $1oa Spore Pods from the Fungal Stompers.
identity.description: The spores grow thick further into the marsh, but those larger fungus beasts are the key.$b$bYes, kill them and take their spore sacs. I will need them to refine my... search.

Objectives.text: 从真菌践踏者身上收集$1oa枚孢子囊，并把他们带给卡诺。
Objectives.english: Bring Khaano $1oa Spore Pods from the Fungal Stompers.

identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ancients.

I have seen a strange ritual performed by ancients. They step into fire, burning the leaves from their branches and charring their bark.

I call it the Ritual of the Charred. If we want to weaken the ancients, we can get rid of them before they become even stronger.

- Frenna

Would killing this botani do us good? I fear I would be no match for it alone.

identity.title: Growing Wood
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Ancient Growth Sap from botani or ancients.
identity.description:
We got the lumber mill good an' built, but we be needin' more wood!

The Rangari tol' me there's botani usin' some kinda sap to grow ancients fast as you like.

Get yer hands on some o' that sap and I betcha I can put it work.

What? Oh, Glyza here? Found 'er crashed here and she knows a thing or two about lumberjackin'. I'll take her back to the outpost later.

I'll meet ya inside Tangleheart if I can find it.

Objectives.text: 从木精或古树身上收集$1oa份古树生长液。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Ancient Growth Sap from botani or ancients.

There are strange, glowing objects within Tangleheart, seemingly pollinated by a variety of stinging creature.

The botani sometimes collect whatever the pods produce. I can't be sure what it is, but it might be dangerous to us.

- Frenna

Objectives.text: 摧毁$1oa个花粉豆荚。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Pollen Pods.

identity.title: A Heartfelt Search
identity.objectives: Investigate the strange presence in the Crimson Fen.
identity.description: I can feel a powerful presence in the marsh $p, it is not far from here.$b$bGo see what is there while I finish my grim feast.  I will catch up...

Description.text: 我能感觉到这沼泽中有一股强大力量，$p。它就离这不远。$B$B我要把这些恶心的东西吃完，你先帮我过去看看吧。我会跟上的……
Description.english: I can feel a powerful presence in the marsh $p, it is not far from here.$b$bGo see what is there while I finish my grim feast.  I will catch up...

identity.title: A Lesson in Teamwork
identity.objectives: Retrieve $oa Mysterious Artifacts.
identity.description: One of the most important skills an archaeology team needs is good teamwork. The key to teamwork is knowing when to give and when to take.$b$bThe Highmaul ogres have been excavating mysterious artifacts from the gorge. I want you to team up with the Highmaul ogres in the name of good archaeology!$b$bRemember what I said about giving and taking? The ogres have given us their hard work to excavate the artifacts. Now I want you to take those artifacts from them and bring them here!$b$bIt's teamwork!

Objectives.text: 取得$oa件神秘的圣物。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $oa Mysterious Artifacts.

identity.title: Seedbearers of Bad News
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa Ancient Seedbearer corpses.
identity.description: When these seedbearers are slain their seeds survive. From them spring new seedbearers, not over years, but hours.$b$bLeaving their remains here would soon cause the outpost to be overrun.$b$bWe have learned that burning their remains prevents this from happening.

Objectives.text: 焚烧$1oa具古树携种者的尸体。
Objectives.english: Burn $1oa Ancient Seedbearer corpses.

identity.title: Wanted: Keeho's Severed Paw
identity.objectives: Retrieve Keeho's Severed Paw from Keeho the Savage.
identity.description: Posted by: Taskmaster Gornek$B$BThe saberon known as Keeho poses a serious threat to Axefall.$B$BHe has taken to slaughtering peons on the night shift and dragging their corpses to his den in the pridelands.$B$BAnyone who can bring me his severed paw as proof of his demise will be rewarded greatly.

identity.title: Wanted: Spineslicer's Husk
identity.objectives: Retrieve Spineslicer's Husk from Spineslicer.
identity.description: Posted by: Killga$B$BI will greatly reward anyone who brings me Spineslicer's husk.$B$BI wish to fashion fine ravager armor, but do not have the skills to take down such a beast.$B$BDon't tear too many holes in it.

identity.title: Wanted: Venombarb
identity.objectives: Kill Venombarb.
identity.description: Posted by: Hutou Featherwind$B$BVenombarb is feared in the skies above Arak, even by the high arakkoa.$B$BShe has made air travel difficult for our riders, preventing vital supplies from reaching Axefall.$B$BI require no proof of her demise, simply ensure her screech never again echoes among the spires.$B$BShe nests above the howling crag to the northeast.

identity.title: Wanted: Keeho's Severed Paw
identity.objectives: Retrieve Keeho's Severed Paw from Keeho the Savage.
identity.description: Posted by: Lieutenant Willem$B$BKeeho, a monstrous saberon, has taken to raiding Southport at night. We're losing men left and right.$B$BI offer a hefty bounty to anyone able to track down Kreeho and bring his severed paw to me.

identity.title: Wanted: Spineslicer's Husk
identity.objectives: Retrieve Spineslicer's Husk from Spineslicer.
identity.description: Posted by: Quartermaster Jolie$B$BWe're running out of supplies to repair our troops' armor.$B$BI'll pay handsomely for the husk of the mighty ravager Spineslicer. It would provide us with repair materials for weeks.

identity.title: Wanted: Venombarb
identity.objectives: Kill Venombarb.
identity.description: Posted by: Falrogh$B$BVenombarb taunts me every day. Screeching and killing me buzz.$B$BSomebody, anybody, kill the beast. I don't want proof, I want peace and quiet.

identity.title: Reclaiming the City
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Sargerei Insignias.
identity.description: The Shattrath offensive is going well, but Socrethar refuses to show himself.$B$BDespite our best efforts, we are unable to break into the inner city of Shattrath. The dome's defenses are simply too strong.$B$BHowever, we think we can lure Socrethar out of hiding. Defeat his lieutenants and warriors, and gather their medallions of service.$B$BWhen we show him proof of their demise, his pride will surely force him to face us.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份萨格雷徽记。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Sargerei Insignias.

identity.title: Reclaiming the City
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Sargerei Insignias.
identity.description: The Shattrath offensive is going well, but Socrethar refuses to show himself.$B$BAnd despite our best efforts, we are unable to break into the inner city, where he resides.$B$BHowever, we think we can lure Socrethar out of hiding. Defeat his lieutenants and warriors, then gather their medallions of service.$B$BWhen we show him proof of their demise, his pride will surely force him to face us.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份萨格雷徽记。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Sargerei Insignias.

identity.title: Socrethar's Demise
identity.objectives: Kill Socrethar.
identity.description: Meet me down by the entrance to the Shattrath dome.$B$BThere, we will issue our challenge to the Sargerei leader. If he accepts our challenge, it is there that he shall meet his end.$B$BThe creature that calls himself Socrethar was once my brethren. I can only hope that there is still some Light left within him.

identity.title: Socrethar's Demise
identity.objectives: Kill Socrethar.
identity.description: Meet me down by the entrance to the Shattrath dome.$B$BThere, we shall issue our challenge to the Sargerei leader. If he accepts, it is there that he shall meet his end.$B$BI must admit, $n, I am looking forward to this.

identity.title: A Harsh Reminder
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa denizens of the wasteland in Affliction Ridge.
identity.description: Welcome to the front lines, commander, where the wastelands and the jungle collide.$b$bThe battle below rages on, but I believe one side is beginning to overwhelm the other. This cannot be allowed to happen.$b$bThe gronnlings are gaining an upper hand and must be stopped before they pose a threat to Highpass.$b$bI will get closer to the battle while you thin their ranks. Meet me within Affliction Ridge when you are done.

Objectives.text: 在苦痛山脊消灭$1oa个荒地住民。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa denizens of the wasteland in Affliction Ridge.

identity.title: Chains of Iron
identity.objectives: Defeat Captain Brak and find the Heart of the Magnaron.
identity.description: The artifact we seek is within our grasp.$b$bBe prepared for a fight. If they truly have learned how to control gronn, this may be more difficult than I anticipated.$b$bI will join you in this battle as soon as you arrive.

identity.title: When All Is Aligned
identity.objectives: Fly upon Ka'alu and kill $1oa Adherents.
identity.description: The ravenspeaker acolytes have been equipped with Apexis interfaces, they just need to get close enough.$B$BCome, let us take to the skies and secure the Terrace of Dawn.$B$BWhen all is aligned, we shall turn the false suns against one another and the spires shall burn like torches!$B$BI look forward to penning your actions into history.

Objectives.text: 骑在卡鲁背上，消灭$1oa名信徒。
Objectives.english: Fly upon Ka'alu and kill $1oa Adherents.

identity.title: Sticky Situation
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Submerged Batteries.
identity.description: We were hauling batteries to the excavation site and I crashed my freakin' car!$B$BMy sister didn't even look back. I took the turn a little fast, so what? It happens!$B$BPoint is, the batteries went flying everywhere and I'm in no condition to lift them out.$B$BSo what do you say? Wanna help me out?

Objectives.text: 获得$1oa枚浸水的电池。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $1oa Submerged Batteries.

identity.title: Sticky Situation
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Submerged Batteries.
identity.description: A squadron of arakkoa spotted us while we were en route to the excavation site and took out our caravan. My brother made it to safety in the chaos.$B$BLucky son of a tinker.$B$BI can't leave without the batteries for our drill, but they all fell into the bog and I can't even get them to budge.$B$BAny chance you could retrieve them for me?

Objectives.text: 获得$1oa枚浸水的电池。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $1oa Submerged Batteries.

identity.title: The Talon King
identity.objectives: Use the Effigy of Terokk to re-live Terokk's battle with the Bloodmane. Slay $1oa Bloodmane Shortfangs, $2oa Mature Bloodmane saberon, and Pridelord Karash.
identity.description:
<As Reshad begins reciting a tale of Terokk's glory days, your eyes fall to the twin swords at the effigy's belt.

They had seemed so plain in Skettis, but now they thrum with power, as if reacting to the scrollkeeper's words.>

Objectives.text: 使用泰罗克雕像重现泰罗克与血鬃虎人的战斗。消灭$1oa名血鬃短齿战士、$2oa名成年血鬃虎人，以及虎王卡拉什。
Objectives.english: Use the Effigy of Terokk to re-live Terokk's battle with the Bloodmane. Slay $1oa Bloodmane Shortfangs, $2oa Mature Bloodmane saberon, and Pridelord Karash.

identity.title: All Natural
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fresh Charcoal from ancients.
identity.description: So you have a smuggler's den, huh?$B$BI'd love to trade with ya, toots, I really would, but my laser cannon isn't even functional right now.$B$BI'll tell you what. See all the ancients around here? They got toasted good by the arakkoa's weapon, and they're practically walking piles of charcoal.$B$BBring me some charcoal to power this thing and you've got a deal.

Objectives.text: 从古树身上收集$1oa份新鲜的木炭。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Fresh Charcoal from ancients.

identity.title: All Natural
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fresh Charcoal from ancients.
identity.description: Oh, you have a trading post?$B$BFantastic!$B$BLet's make a deal. You help me power up my laser cannon, and I'll trade some of this... thermo... ultra... obsidiglass with you for some weapons.$B$BThe ancients all around here are practically made of charcoal after the arakkoa weapon hit, you should go get some of that!

Objectives.text: 从古树身上收集$1oa份新鲜的木炭。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Fresh Charcoal from ancients.

identity.title: Ending Executions
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Executioners
identity.description: We arrived as soon as we could... but we be too late. Da Iron Horde has taken our warriors prisoner.$b$bNo doubt they be trying ta squeeze info out of da troops.$b$bI fear once they are done with da interrogation they gonna execute their prisoners. Time be running out.

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa名铁军处决者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Executioners

identity.title: Attack of the Iron Horde
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Grunts.
identity.description: We received reports of the Dark Portal turning red right before the attack. They call themselves the Iron Horde.$b$bTheir army is extremely well equipped, and their numbers appear to be unending.$b$bThey have already taken Okril'lon Hold and Nethergarde Keep. Our troops on the frontlines could use your help, $c.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名铁军步兵。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ironmarch Grunts.

identity.title: Under Siege
identity.objectives: Sabotage $1oa Iron Demolishers.
identity.description: Those Iron Horde cannons are laying waste to our troops. I'm not sure how much more of this we can handle. Our forces are already spread too thin.$b$bThere has to be a way to stop those war machines.

Objectives.text: 破坏$1oa辆钢铁攻城车。
Objectives.english: Sabotage $1oa Iron Demolishers.

identity.title: Subversive Scouts
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde scouts.
identity.description: We have been unable to execute a vast majority of our battleplans. We are definitely being watched.$b$bThe Iron Horde must have scouts planted throughout the Blasted Lands. Victory is slipping away from us.

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa名钢铁部落斥候。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Iron Horde scouts.

identity.title: Toothsmash the Annihilator
identity.objectives: Kill Toothsmash the Annihilator
identity.description: If the battleplans you brought back are true, the Dreadmaul ogres are as much to blame for this devastation as the Iron Horde. It's time we send those ogres a message.$b$bIt looks like the Iron Horde's main contact is a large ogre in Dreadmaul named Toothsmash. Killing him will put a dent in their battleplans.

identity.title: Death to the Dreadmaul
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Dreadmaul Ogres.
identity.description: The stupidity of the Dreadmaul ogres never ceases to amaze me. The Iron Horde is clearly using them to further their own nefarious agenda.$b$bRegardless, we must show the ogres what happens when you confront the true Horde. I think it's time we send the Dreadmaul ogres a message.

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa名巨槌食人魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Dreadmaul Ogres.

identity.title: Gar'mak Bladetwist
identity.objectives: Kill Gar'mak Bladetwist.
identity.description: With the intelligence you have gathered we have learned this assault is being led by a powerful Iron Horde orc named Gar'mak Bladetwist. He is hunkered down inside Okril'lon Hold.$b$bKilling him will not win this war, but it will surely break down the Iron Horde's communication. This will buy us valuable time while we gather more forces and outline a battleplan to deal with this new threat.

identity.title: I See Dead Arakkoa
identity.objectives: Use the Ghostogrifier 12000 and kill the spirit of Talonpriest Zekk.
identity.description: I've got a strange problem and I'm hoping you might be able to help. I don't know who else could help, to be honest.$B$BMy workers keep saying they're seeing the ghost of the arakkoa that used to head up this place.$B$BI know, I know, it's crazy but could you take my Ghostogrifier 12000 to her body and check?$B$BIf there's a ghost around here, it'll find it. If there's not, then my workers are trying to slack off on the clock.

identity.title: I See Dead Arakkoa
identity.objectives: Use the Ghostogrifier 12000 and kill the spirit of Talonpriest Zekk.
identity.description: Say, while you're here would you mind helping me out with a major problem?$B$BThe workers keep saying that they're seeing the ghost of the head arakkoa that used to be here.$B$BI don't believe it for a second but could you take my Ghostogrifier 12000 to her body and check?$B$BIf they're not crazy, it'll prove it.

identity.title: The Ebon Hunter
identity.objectives: Collect an Organic Laser Apparatus from the Ebon Hunter.
identity.description: The laser should be good to go once we get it set up, there's just one more thing I need.$B$BThere's a spore walker that hunts on the delta just southeast from here. It has an apparatus on its face that can fire a powerful laser - way more powerful than what we have hooked up.$B$BI want it.$B$BWe'll be mining faster than you can imagine once we get that bad boy hooked up!

identity.title: I Drew Aggro...culture
identity.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Wildwood Wash.
identity.description: $p? Boy am I glad to see ya.$b$bI was tryin' ta ditch that genesaur when I stumbled across this rangari camp.$b$bNext thing I know, the ground is creepin' up and spittin' out all sorts of angry plants.$b$bI barely made it out of me tank before that genesaur threw it like it was an empty beer mug.$b$bI'm gonna make my way back to the road an' look fer me tank.$b$bI'll see ya there when yer done.

Description.text: $p？见到你真是太好了。$b$b我当时正想甩掉那个原祖荆兽，结果就闯到这个游侠营地里来了。$b$b还没等我反应过来，大地就开始震颤，不知打哪冒出来好多愤怒的植物。$b$b我好不容易才从坦克里爬出来，眼睁睁地看着那个原祖荆兽把坦克像空啤酒杯那样抛了出去。$b$b我得沿路返回，找找我的坦克。$b$b等你完成这里的任务后，我们到那见吧。
Description.english: $p? Boy am I glad to see ya.$b$bI was tryin' ta ditch that genesaur when I stumbled across this rangari camp.$b$bNext thing I know, the ground is creepin' up and spittin' out all sorts of angry plants.$b$bI barely made it out of me tank before that genesaur threw it like it was an empty beer mug.$b$bI'm gonna make my way back to the road an' look fer me tank.$b$bI'll see ya there when yer done.

identity.title: Wake of the Genesaur
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Wild Overgrowth.
identity.description: One moment we see a great metal beast rolling into our camp, the next a genesaur follows it and sends a wave of pure chaotic life at us.$b$bThe manifestations left behind by the genesaur must be culled so we have time to salvage what we can before leaving.$b$bIf you are here to help, then start killing as many of the violent plants that are assailing us as possible.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个野性生长物。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Wild Overgrowth.

identity.title: The Ebon Hunter
identity.objectives: Collect an Organic Laser Apparatus from the Ebon Hunter.
identity.description: We're ready to set up the laser, but we're going to need more firepower to cut through this stuff.$B$BThe Ebon Hunter stalks the delta just southeast from here. It has an apparatus on its face that can fire a laser way stronger than what we have hooked up.$B$BWe need that.$B$BYou should go get it while we set up the laser.

identity.title: Putting Down the Packleader
identity.objectives: Slay Packleader Vor'gash.
identity.description: Operations at Mok'gol Watchpost are entrusted to a mighty warrior named Packleader Vor'gash.$B$BIf we can take out this fierce leader, we can shut down their communications temporarily.$B$BYou can find Vor'gash patrolling the compound to the northeast.$B$BSlay him.

identity.title: Putting Down the Packleader
identity.objectives: Slay Packleader Vor'gash.
identity.description: Da one in charge a Mok'gol Watchpost be Packleader Vor'gash.$B$BWe take him out, we shut dem down.$B$BYa ken find 'im patrolling da compound ta da nor'east.$B$BKill 'im.

identity.title: Basilisk Butcher
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Basilisk Meat from Stoneshamble Basilisks or Decaying Basilisks.
identity.description: Basilisk is one of Nisha's favorite meals. This is where she hunts, and that's likely how those Iron Horde bastards were able to capture her.$b$bWhy would they go to the trouble to subdue her this way? Perhaps together, you and I might learn the answer as we punish them for their transgressions.$b$bFor now, Nisha's going to need some food. While I tend to her, will you do her hunting for her?

Objectives.text: 从履岩蜥蜴或腐烂的蜥蜴身上收集$1oa份蜥蜴肉。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Basilisk Meat from Stoneshamble Basilisks or Decaying Basilisks.

identity.title: Safety Measures
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa bog denizens.
identity.description: As it turns out, the resonance frequency of the batteries has really upset the local wildlife. I... I think one of the boars looked and me and licked its lips just a moment ago.$B$BI'll make it worth your time if you just... get rid of anything you come across down there. Doesn't matter what it is, just kill it, okay?

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个沼泽居民。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa bog denizens.

identity.title: Safety Measures
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa bog denizens.
identity.description: The batteries I lost in the bog have really ticked off the wild creatures. It's going to be impossible to remove them without fighting through who knows what.$B$BIf you're up for it, why don't you 'take care' of any critters you come across? I don't want some giant beast stalking me back to the excavation site.$B$BI'll make it worth your while.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个沼泽居民。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa bog denizens.

identity.title: The Interest of Bruto
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。
PortraitGiverText.english: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

identity.title: The Fists of Vaandaam
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。
PortraitGiverText.english: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

identity.title: Terokk's Fall
identity.objectives: Use the Effigy of Terokk to re-live Terokk's fall. Find Lithic, rally $2oa Outcast Talon Guards, slay $3oa Crazed Outcasts, and use the Eye of Anzu.
identity.description:
<Once again, Reshad's voice envelops you.>

Terokk was a powerful and respected king, beloved by his people.

His sages, however, were not so loyal. Hungry for control of Skyreach, they conspired against him.

Objectives.text: 使用泰罗克雕像重现泰罗克被贬落时的情形。找到蕾希，集结$2oa名流亡者利爪卫士，消灭$3oa名疯狂的流亡者，再使用安苏之眼。
Objectives.english: Use the Effigy of Terokk to re-live Terokk's fall. Find Lithic, rally $2oa Outcast Talon Guards, slay $3oa Crazed Outcasts, and use the Eye of Anzu.

PortraitGiverText.text: 认真聆听泰罗克的贬落。
PortraitGiverText.english: Listen carefully to the tale of Terokk's Fall.

identity.title: The Avatar of Terokk
identity.objectives: Speak with Shade of Terokk to accept his power. Slay $1oa Shattered Hand combatants, $2oa Shattered Pit-Masters, and confront Kargath Bladefist.
identity.description:
My long sleep was disturbed by dreams of the past. I cut down my old enemies again. I watched my daughter die again.

You were there. I felt your presence in these dreams. And your past was revealed to me as well.

Someone has woven our fates together. My people are yours to protect, and your enemies are mine to destroy.

The Shattered Hand are rallied in Bladefist Hold. Left to their own, they would claim this land for the Iron Horde.

Take my power, and together we shall break them.

Objectives.text: 与泰罗克之影交谈来获得他的力量。消灭$1oa个碎手战士、$2oa个碎手地穴主宰，然后面对卡加斯·刃拳。
Objectives.english: Speak with Shade of Terokk to accept his power. Slay $1oa Shattered Hand combatants, $2oa Shattered Pit-Masters, and confront Kargath Bladefist.

identity.title: Internal: Default Invasion Reward
identity.objectives: Repel the Breaker invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw again to begin)
identity.description: Quakes have been shaking the garrison for the last hour, and a few of our scouts aren't reporting in.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 格里姆加，镇子里最厉害的家伙……之类的。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Grimjaw, the best in town or something.

identity.title: Nisha's Vengeance
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Grom'kar Grunts.
identity.description: Since I left on my last hunt, the Iron Horde have drawn nearer and reinforced their positions.$b$b<A grin spreads across Rexxar's lips.>$b$bThey've created a target-rich environment.$b$bI must continue nursing Nisha to health for now. You go in my stead, friend. Fill them with the fear and pain that they inflicted on her.$b$bMake their screams fill the canyon!

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa名格罗姆卡步兵。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Grom'kar Grunts.

identity.title: Peckers the Majestic
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。
PortraitGiverText.english: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

identity.title: Ogre Onslaught
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Ogres and $2oa Ogron.
identity.description: Those ogres are standing in the way of a full Steamwheedle Preservation excavation.$b$bThey are brutal, violent, horrible smelling beasts. And if I'm being completely honest with myself, I'm pretty mad they broke my glider.$b$bDo me a favor will ya? Wipe 'em off the face of Draenor.$b$bIt will make everyone's life easier, or at the very least, it will make my life easier.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个食人魔和$2oa个独眼魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Ogres and $2oa Ogron.

identity.title: Brokyo Beatdown
identity.objectives: Kill Brokyo.
identity.description: I'm almost done here, but I can't leave in good conscience.$b$bI spotted an ogron named Brokyo that is wearing a priceless ring. Priceless as in crazy expensive.$b$bI'm sure Nixxie will give me a promotion if I bring that ring back to her.

identity.title: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Abrogator Stones from creatures in Highmaul. Your garrison followers may also be able to locate stones in certain missions.
identity.description: For over a thousand years, the ogre sorcerer kings maintained an iron grip over their empire using a variety of artifacts. Trusted lieutenants were given magical gems that allowed them to enforce the emperor's will out in the field. These "Abrogator Stones" still maintain their power even today, and can be found scattered throughout the Highmaul complex. Sometimes in clusters.$b$bCollect $1oa of these Abrogator Stones for me!

Objectives.text: 从悬槌堡的怪物身上收集$1oa块消魔之石。你要塞的追随者们或许也能在某些特定的任务中找到石头。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Abrogator Stones from creatures in Highmaul. Your garrison followers may also be able to locate stones in certain missions.

Description.text: 在过往一千多年的岁月里，食人魔巫师之王凭借各类神器维护着统御帝国的铁腕政权。受信任的副官们手中握有魔法宝石，可以在战场上行使帝王的意志。这些“消魔之石”直到今天仍然力量不减，就散落在悬槌堡的各处。有时是数块成群。$b$b帮我找$1oa块消魔之石来！
Description.english: For over a thousand years, the ogre sorcerer kings maintained an iron grip over their empire using a variety of artifacts. Trusted lieutenants were given magical gems that allowed them to enforce the emperor's will out in the field. These "Abrogator Stones" still maintain their power even today, and can be found scattered throughout the Highmaul complex. Sometimes in clusters.$b$bCollect $1oa of these Abrogator Stones for me!

identity.title: Might of the Elemental Lords
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Elemental Tablets. Assemble the tablets by collecting Elemental Runes from bosses in the Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: Somehow, the Blackrock Clan has forged an alliance with the creatures of fire and stone. I must know how!$b$bSearch the entirety of the Blackrock Foundry. We are looking for stone tablets dating back to the prehistory of Draenor. They will likely be broken apart into fragments that you'll need to assemble by hand. Look for elemental runes carried by high-ranking members of the Iron Horde.$b$bAssemble them and bring me those tablets, $n. I will use their power to augment the powers of your ring!

Objectives.text: 收集$oa块元素石板。从黑石锻造厂的首领身上收集元素符文，把石板拼合起来。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Elemental Tablets. Assemble the tablets by collecting Elemental Runes from bosses in the Blackrock Foundry.

identity.title: Extrinsic Motivation
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Shattered Sightless, $2oa Shattered Harvesters, and $3oa Shattered Blood-Singer.
identity.description: The Shattered Hand aren't strangers to pain. They each cut off their own hand as a sign of their allegiance to Kargath.$B$BIf you're going to get them to talk, it might take more than my poison.$B$BSlaughter them all. We'll see how far they're willing to go for their beloved warlord.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个碎手盲眼行者、$2oa个碎手收割者和$3oa个碎手吟血者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Shattered Sightless, $2oa Shattered Harvesters, and $3oa Shattered Blood-Singer.

identity.title: Extrinsic Motivation
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Shattered Sightless, $2oa Shattered Harvesters, and $3oa Shattered Blood-Singer.
identity.description: The Shattered Hand are nae strangers tae pain. They each cut off their own hand as a sign o' their allegiance to Kargath.$B$BIf you're going tae get the information we need, it might take more than my poison.$B$BSlaughter them all. We'll see how far they're willing tae go fer their beloved warlord.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个碎手盲眼行者、$2oa个碎手收割者和$3oa个碎手吟血者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Shattered Sightless, $2oa Shattered Harvesters, and $3oa Shattered Blood-Singer.

identity.title: Gardul Venomshiv
identity.objectives: Defeat Gardul Venomshiv in Shattered Rise.
identity.description: We need to take out Gardul and take his poison recipe while we still have the element of surprise on our side. We need it to craft the antidote. This may be our only opportunity.$B$BIf what you learned is true, his camp is just south of here. You take him down, and I'll make sure none of his guards interfere.$B$BLet's get moving.

identity.title: Gardul Venomshiv
identity.objectives: Defeat Gardul Venomshiv in Shattered Rise.
identity.description: We need tae take out Gardul and take his poison recipe while we still have the element o' surprise on our side. We need the recipe tae figure out the antidote. This may be our only opportunity.$B$BIf what ye learned is true, his camp is just south of here. Ye take him down, and I'll make sure none of his guards interfere.

identity.title: We Have Him Now
identity.objectives: Collect Venomshiv's Secret Formula and $2oa Poison Barrels.
identity.description: We have Gardul right where we want him, commander.$B$BYou're far more equipped to face him than I am. Dispose of him, take his formula from his corpse, and grab as many barrels of poison as you can.$B$BI'll guard this ramp and make sure no reinforcements come to his aid.

Objectives.text: 收集毒刃的秘密配方和$2oa个毒药桶。
Objectives.english: Collect Venomshiv's Secret Formula and $2oa Poison Barrels.

identity.title: We Have Him Now
identity.objectives: Collect Venomshiv's Secret Formula and $2oa Poison Barrels.
identity.description: We have Gardul right cornered, commander.$B$BYe have a much better chance against him than me. Take him out, grab the formula from his corpse, and grab as many barrels o' poison as ye can carry.$B$BI'll stay here and make sure nae reinforcements come to Gardul's aid.

Objectives.text: 收集毒刃的秘密配方和$2oa个毒药桶。
Objectives.english: Collect Venomshiv's Secret Formula and $2oa Poison Barrels.

identity.title: A Worthy Vessel
identity.objectives: Awaken the Talon King.
identity.description:
The time has come, $p.

Awaken the Talon King from his long slumber. Call him into this world so that he may destroy our enemies!

Description.text:
时机到了，$p。

从长眠中唤醒利爪之王。将他召唤到这个世界中来，帮忙消灭我们的敌人！
Description.english:
The time has come, $p.

Awaken the Talon King from his long slumber. Call him into this world so that he may destroy our enemies!

identity.title: Seal of Tempered Fate: Apexis Crystals

Title.text: 钢化命运印记：埃匹希斯水晶
Title.english: Seal of Tempered Fate: Apexis Crystals

identity.title: On Ebon Wings
identity.objectives: Slay $2oa Adherents and Windkeeper Koreyx. Speak with Ka'alu for a ride to Windswept Terrace.
identity.description: Now we bring our fight to the Adherents. Raastok is certain his new invention will give us control of the Apexis weapons, but we must get close - very close.$B$BKa'alu and her ravens will fly us to the Windswept Terrace. We shall gain a foothold there before pressing on to the Terrace of Dawn.

Objectives.text: 消灭$2oa名信徒和风卫士科雷克斯。与卡鲁交谈飞往啸风平台。
Objectives.english: Slay $2oa Adherents and Windkeeper Koreyx. Speak with Ka'alu for a ride to Windswept Terrace.

identity.title: The Trial of Courage
identity.objectives: Kill Everburn.
identity.description: An Exarch must be a pillar of strength, and no greater strength is there than the courage to face danger.$B$BFar to the northwest, among the snowy crags of Frostfire Ridge, lives a primal fury named Everburn.$B$BOnly when you face one of these creatures eye to eye, will you know the extent of your courage.

identity.title: Friendly Competition
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Shadowmoon Hides and $2oa Silverwing Talons and return to Fanara before the other competitors.
identity.description: So you wish to join the competition, $n? Best of luck to you.$B$BBe the first to gather a sack full of hides and talons from local wildlife and return them to me before the other competitors!$B$BWinner earns the opportunity for an apprenticeship under craftsman Garaal.$B$BGood luck!

Objectives.text: 赶在其他竞争对手之前收集到$1oa块影月皮革和$2oa个银翼利爪，并回去交给法娜拉。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Shadowmoon Hides and $2oa Silverwing Talons and return to Fanara before the other competitors.

identity.title: The Crystal Shard
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Goren Crystals from Longtooth Gorgers.
identity.description: I'm glad you arrived when you did.$b$bThe Laughing Skull orcs practice some strange spirit magic, but one of their traditions could be quite useful in our situation.$b$bWhile I make preparations, can you gather the reagents?$b$bFirst, we'll need crystals from the husks of goren corpses. You can find their bodies in the canyon.

Objectives.text: 从长牙吞噬者身上收集$1oa块鬣蜥人水晶。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Goren Crystals from Longtooth Gorgers.

identity.title: Hard Shell
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Goren Shells from Boneyard Gorgers.
identity.description: I have already learned much from watching the Laughing Skull.$b$bTraveling through goren tunnels was thought to be impossible due to the acid they leave behind, but the orcs found a way around it.$b$bWe will need some of the shells of goren within the canyon.$b$bIf you see any of their tunnel craters ready to burst, approach them and goren will come pouring out. This way, you can kill many at once and find the shells more quickly.

Objectives.text: 从骨园暴食者身上获得$1oa份鬣蜥人甲壳。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Goren Shells from Boneyard Gorgers.

identity.title: How Tough Are You?
identity.objectives: Kill Lug'dol and present his head to Kroggol the Wall outside the Gorian Proving Grounds.
identity.description: Mogor's holding a special match over at the Ring of Blood to crown the new Blood Champion and I think you have what it takes!$B$BNow, these ogres respect one thing and one thing only: badass...ness. They have a big fella at the front door making sure only the toughest gladiators enter the proving grounds.$B$BIf you're in, kill the grizzled gladiator Lug'dol at the tower just up the road and present his head to Kroggol the Wall. That oughta show 'em what you're made of.

identity.title: Entry Fee
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Blood Stones and bring them to Wodin the Troll Servant.
identity.description: You looking for da Ring of Blood? HAH! That good one. Not just anybody able to compete in da ring. You gotta pay the entry fee: fifty blood marks.$B$BHow do you get them? Oh, tiny one, you killing me!$B$B<Kroggol hands you a small stone caked in blood.>$B$BDat one is yours. You kill others in da proving grounds to get da rest. Take dem to Wodin da troll servant by Mogor when you done.$B$BDon't talk to Mogor, though. Mogor da boss.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa块鲜血之石，并把它们交给巨魔仆从伍迪。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Blood Stones and bring them to Wodin the Troll Servant.

identity.title: The Champion of Blood
identity.objectives: Speak to Gurgthock to participate in the Blood Champion fight.
identity.description: You have da blood stones required as proof of your worth. Hmm. Yes, you might be da champion Mogor be lookin' for.$B$BYou be one of only two to complete da blood stone trial. Da two of ya be fightin' for da glory of becoming Blood Champion.$B$BSpeak to Gurgthock and we be seein' if you be a champion... or just another stain on da arena floor.

identity.title: The Restless Spirit
identity.objectives: Slay Kurgthuk the Merciless and use Waruk's hammer to salvage equipment from the Thunderlord orcs.
identity.description: This hammer was once used to craft magnificent weapons for my Frostwolf brothers and sisters.$B$BWhen I was taken prisoner by the Thunderlords, however, I refused to wield it. How could I craft weapons to be used against my own people?$B$BIt saddens me to see that it has been damaged and abused.$B$BI wished to one day pass it down to Kugra, but now, her anger prevents her from even visiting my grave.$B$BPlease $p, can you help me repair my hammer and seek revenge on those that caused this?$B$BFor Kugra....

Description.text: 这把锤子曾经是用来为我的霜狼兄弟姐妹们打造威风的武器。$B$B当我被雷神氏族抓为俘虏时，我拒绝使用它。我怎么能帮敌人铸造武器，让他们拿来对付我自己的族人呢？$B$B眼睁睁地看着这把锤子落到恶人手中，损坏得面目全非，我的内心感到非常难过。$B$B希望有一天，我能把它传给库格拉，可现在她却愤怒得连来坟墓祭拜我都不肯。$B$B拜托了，$p，你能帮我修好锤子，并向那些造成今日悲惨结局的人复仇吗？$B$B为了库格拉……
Description.english: This hammer was once used to craft magnificent weapons for my Frostwolf brothers and sisters.$B$BWhen I was taken prisoner by the Thunderlords, however, I refused to wield it. How could I craft weapons to be used against my own people?$B$BIt saddens me to see that it has been damaged and abused.$B$BI wished to one day pass it down to Kugra, but now, her anger prevents her from even visiting my grave.$B$BPlease $p, can you help me repair my hammer and seek revenge on those that caused this?$B$BFor Kugra....

identity.title: Mending A Broken Heart
identity.objectives: Meet Waruk at Stonefang Outpost.
identity.description: $p, thank you for avenging my death... but I have just one more favor to ask of you.$B$BIf you help me see this through, I will forever be in your debt.$B$BTake these items and meet me at the forge in Stonefang Outpost.$B$BI have imbued them with a portion of my essence, but we still need the aid of another to reforge the hammer.$B$BIt is time for me to reconcile with Kugra, so that we both may finally find peace....

Description.text: $p，谢谢你为我报了仇……可我还要请你帮个忙。$B$B如果你能帮我做成这件事，我将永远不会忘记你的恩情。$B$B拿上这些东西，到岩牙岗哨的熔炉那找我。$B$B我将自己的一部分精华灌注到了这些东西里面，可我们还需要找别人帮忙来熔铸锤子。$B$B现在到了跟库格拉言归于好的时候了，只有那样我们两个才都能得到安宁……
Description.english: $p, thank you for avenging my death... but I have just one more favor to ask of you.$B$BIf you help me see this through, I will forever be in your debt.$B$BTake these items and meet me at the forge in Stonefang Outpost.$B$BI have imbued them with a portion of my essence, but we still need the aid of another to reforge the hammer.$B$BIt is time for me to reconcile with Kugra, so that we both may finally find peace....

identity.title: Whacking Weeds
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Spiteleaf podlings.
identity.description: Something needs to be done about the podling menace in Spiteleaf Thicket!$b$bAlongside Hemet Nesingwary, I've hunted some of the largest and most terrifying beasts around. Never in my life have I encountered a creature as vile, depraved, nefarious or degenerate as a podling!$b$bThe vicious little monsters spread themselves like weeds and if something isn't done, they'll spread across the entire continent!$b$bMake your way into Spiteleaf Thicket and slay as many podlings as you can find!

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个怨叶魔荚人。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Spiteleaf podlings.

identity.title: A Fascinating Fungus
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fungal Spores.
identity.description: The Zangar Shore is home to many peculiar strains of fungi, some of which are similar to those of our native Azeroth. However, one strain in particular is most fascinating!$b$bI call it "Zangarium Draenormycota," due to its prevelance in Draenor's fungal ecosystem. This unique strain of fungus is highly adaptable and can be found on many of the living organisms throughout Zangar Shore.$b$bWhy does it exist? What properties does it hold?$b$bTo answer these questions, I will need additional spore samples.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个菌类孢子。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Fungal Spores.

identity.title: Dirgemire
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Fungal Brain from Dirgemire.
identity.description: In order to fully understand the nature and properties of the Zangarium Draenormycota, I need to examine the strain within a complex fungal structure. The fungal brain of a spore giant would do nicely.$b$bNot just any spore giant will serve though, it needs to be big... mean... primordial... the perfect specimen!$b$bIn a cavern deep below the surface is an ancient spore giant the locals fearfully refer to as Dirgemire. Slay the monster, but be sure to carefully preserve the fungal brain for our research!

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们必须获得真菌组织！
PortraitGiverText.english: We must acquire a fungal brain!

identity.title: Phylarch the Evergreen
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: [PHYLARCH ACQUISITION TEXT GOES HERE]

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。
PortraitGiverText.english: New to the rank of Blademaster, Na'Shra is a formidable warrior and master of arms.

identity.title: Restoration
identity.objectives: Retrieve the sample for Artificer Baleera.
identity.description: As mentioned, our larger defense crystals have been drained of power, creating gaps in our defenses. The crystal you brought me is only a reminder of the severity of this situation. It's Shadowmoon magic to blame, I'm sure of it.$B$BOne of our rangari scouts spotted an orc fleeing north, past Palemoon Village, and into the valley beyond. Go, find this orc, and see if you can't retrieve whatever vessel he's storing the power inside of. If we get it back, I'm sure I can restore the crystals.

identity.title: Egg Punt
identity.objectives: Kick $1oa Ravager Eggs in Camp Thornscar.
identity.description: <A sweaty, pulsing egg - no doubt flush with ravager larvae.$B$BA swift kick should take care of these.>

Objectives.text: 在棘痕营地里踢掉$1oa枚掠食者的卵。
Objectives.english: Kick $1oa Ravager Eggs in Camp Thornscar.

identity.title: Curing With Force
identity.objectives: Cure $1oa Infected Goblins.
identity.description: The infection is getting stronger so I made some adjustments and I'm pretty sure I have the right formula now.$b$bIt should now work but it needs to have less competition with the infected blood for it to have any effect.$b$bThis means you will need to weaken them before you apply the serum for it to function properly.$b$bThe infection is getting more advanced and will soon be untreatable so we have this one shot to save as many as we can.

Objectives.text: 治愈$1oa个被感染的地精。
Objectives.english: Cure $1oa Infected Goblins.

Title.text: 山脈 - 寶藏 008 - 走私的頂尖神器

identity.title: Plant Pruning
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa defenders at Dionor's Demise.
identity.description: There may be more to this aberrant growth than it seems, but we will need to clear the way a bit before we can get to the bottom of this, yes?$b$bI suggest clearing out some of the angrier defenders to be on the safe side.

Objectives.text: 在迪奥诺之劫消灭$1oa个守卫者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa defenders at Dionor's Demise.

identity.title: Saberon Population Reduction
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa saberon at Steamscar Rise.
identity.description: We are closer to our goals but a host of sharp toothed saberon bar our way.$b$bIf we are to get anywhere up here, some of the more aggressive ones will need to be put down I think.

Objectives.text: 在汽痕高地消灭$1oa个刃牙虎人。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa saberon at Steamscar Rise.

identity.title: Reclaiming Property
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Herb Bundles in saberon stashes at Steamscar Rise.
identity.description: You are attracted by a low green glow to the container.  Inside there is a glowing bundle of herbs that was most likely stolen from the overgrowth below.$b$bIt would be best to collect all of these so the saberon don't continue their dabbling in plant magic and irritating the nearby magnaron.

Objectives.text: 从汽痕高地的刃牙虎人储物箱里找到$1oa个草药包。
Objectives.english: Find $1oa Herb Bundles in saberon stashes at Steamscar Rise.

identity.title: Taking the Death Bloom
identity.objectives: Take the Death Bloom from Smokemaster Snarl in Steamscar Rise.
identity.description: Your work has born fruit. Inside the nearby cave a powerful saberon shaman is learning to channel the genesaur magic using the Death Bloom we seek. The solution is before us: kill the shaman, take the Death Bloom, return it to Birchus. That should improve the safety of our outpost.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭浓烟之主咆吼并夺取凋零之蕾。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill Smokemaster Snarl and take the Death Bloom.

identity.title: Reduction in Force
identity.objectives: Collect the Head of Alexi Barov.
identity.description: I was a fool to trust him after the fiasco over the Barov family fortune! What I should have done is killed him the first chance I had.$B$BAnd now he thinks he's going to plumb this land for all that it's worth and cut me out?!$B$BNo, dear brother, not this time! There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries and it will be me.$B$BMy peasant friend, you must do me this service. Find my brother, Alexi, and serve him a notice of termination!$B$BYou will likely find him out in the wilds, near small timber.

PortraitGiverText.text: 曾经的兄弟，卑鄙的叛徒。
PortraitGiverText.english: Ex-brother and traitorous filth.

identity.objectives: Kill the Infested Ogron.
identity.description: Kaz always told me green ogron are bad.$b$bThe botani here have a green ogron and it is mean.$b$bIt was strong enough to take out my dad's entire hunting party.$b$bAre you strong enough to kill it?

PortraitGiverText.text: 木精领地中更具危险性的被感染生物之一。
PortraitGiverText.english: One of the more dangerous infested creatures in the botani arsenal.

identity.title: A Green Ogron?
identity.objectives: Kill the Infested Ogron.
identity.description: Them botani got themselves a green ogron. A green ogron!$b$bI mean I may not know much about plant people but that canno' be a good thing.$b$bThink ya can take it in a fight?

PortraitGiverText.text: 木精领地中更具危险性的被感染生物之一。
PortraitGiverText.english: One of the more dangerous infested creatures in the botani arsenal.

identity.title: Finding Nat Pagle
identity.objectives: Travel to the Angler's Wharf in Krasarang Wilds and talk to Nat Pagle.
identity.description:
Now that you have proof, we might just have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.

Last I heard, he was in fishing with the local Angler's faction out in Pandaria.  Somewhere off the coast of  Krasarang Wilds.  Head out there, show him your catch and see if you can get him to come back with you!

PortraitGiverText.text: 艾泽拉斯最具知名度的钓客。
PortraitGiverText.english: Azeroth's most famous angler.

identity.title: The Great Angler Returns
identity.objectives: Return to Rak'jin with Nat's journal page as proof that you found him.
identity.description:
What's this species, a molten catfish you say? I have never even heard of a fish like this, much less seen one in person!

I have to find more fish like this, it's what I live for! And if the fishing is as good as you say it is, there is just no way I can pass this opportunity up.  Take this page from my journal as proof that you found me and I will meet you back at your Garrison.

PortraitGiverText.text: 来自德拉诺霜火岭的罕见鱼种。
PortraitGiverText.english: A rare species of fish from Frostfire Ridge in Draenor.

identity.title: Botani Invasion!
identity.objectives: Repel the botani invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw again to begin)
identity.description: There's a weight in the air. Reminds me of battles in Stranglethorn Valley. Jungle warfare is good for axe-play.

PortraitTurnInText.text: 格里姆加，镇子里最厉害的家伙……之类的。
PortraitTurnInText.english: Grimjaw, the best in town or something.

identity.title: Ogre Waygates
identity.objectives: Collect 25 Ogre Waystones and use them to activate an Ogre Waygate in Draenor.
identity.description: Six unique gates exist in Draenor, built by ogre magi in ages past.  We've discovered their potency has not diminished over the millennia.$b$bIf you can collect enough ogre waystones to activate one of these ancient waygates, we can build a one-way portal from your garrison to that location.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这些传送门是食人魔在德拉诺建立的古老旅行枢纽，现在能够为我们所用了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Once an ancient travel network for the Ogres of Draenor, these waygates are now available for our use.

identity.title: The Great Angler Returns
identity.objectives: Return to Segumi with Nat's journal page as proof that you found him.
identity.description:
What's this species, an arcane trout you say? I have never even heard of a fish like this, much less seen one in person!

I have to find more fish like this, it's what I live for! And if the fishing is as good as you say it is, there is just no way I can pass this opportunity up.  Take this page from my journal as proof that you found me and I will meet you back at your Garrison.

PortraitGiverText.text: 来自德拉诺影月谷的罕见鱼种。
PortraitGiverText.english: A rare species of fish from Shadowmoon Valley in Draenor.

identity.title: Warning Orgrimmar
identity.objectives: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang.
identity.description: We have slowed the Iron Horde down, but this war is far from over... I'll stay here and continue our efforts to hold back the Iron Horde.$b$bThe Warchief needs to know about what we have accomplished here today, and the threat we face in the future.$b$bIt is probably best if you report to High Overlord Saurfang yourself, $c.

PortraitGiverText.text: 部落的军事统帅。
PortraitGiverText.english: Military leader of the Horde.

identity.title: Report to the King
identity.objectives: Speak with King Anduin Wrynn.
identity.description: We have slowed the Iron Horde down, but this war is far from over... I'll stay here and continue our efforts to hold back the Iron Horde.$b$bThe King needs to know about what we have accomplished here today, and the threat we face in the future.$b$bIt is probably best if you report to King Wrynn yourself, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 联盟的军事统帅。
PortraitGiverText.english: Military leader of the Alliance.

identity.title: Scraps of Iron
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Scraps from Iron Horde on Draenor.
identity.description:
At the armory, we can take scraps of Iron Horde armor that you collect and turn them into new gear. It's not the strongest stuff in the world, but it looks good.

Get some Iron Horde scraps and come back my way. I'll set you up with a nice tabard for your troubles.

Objectives.text: 从德拉诺的钢铁部落成员身上收集$1oa块钢铁部落碎片。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Scraps from Iron Horde on Draenor.

identity.title: Lost in Transition
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Crate of Surplus Materials.
identity.description:
$GSir:Ma'am;, the storehouse is fully operational and I've seen to it that your supplies are safely stored away and accounted for.

Unfortunately, during the rest of my audit I found that we are missing a few crates of surplus material - probably misplaced by one of the porters.

If you happen to come across any of the surplus crates while making your rounds, please bring them to me and I'll update our ledger.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa箱剩余物资。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Crate of Surplus Materials.

identity.title: An Ogre Without His Sword...
identity.objectives: Retrieve Tormmok's Favorite Sword from Vizier Dar'gud at Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
identity.description: Before I was shipped off to Gorgrond, I was stationed at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand, maintaining order over the unruly dredges. Vizier Dar'gud refused to let me take my favorite sword; he told me "I wouldn't need it where I was going."$B$BI want it back, commander, and we are powerful enough together to take it from Dar'gud's bloody corpse.$B$BIt would mean a great deal to me. An ogre without his sword isn't an ogre at all.

identity.title: The Light of Exodus
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Light of Exodus from Ambassador Hellmaw at Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath City in Talador.
identity.description: My grandfather always told me stories of a powerful crystal made of the Light that would grant power to those who intended to use it for good. He called it the Light of Exodus.$B$BI never believed him... until now.$B$BYour scouts have found a crystal that sounds just like it. It has been taken by a terrible demon and is being corrupted at the Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath.$B$BWe have to hurry!

identity.title: Settling Grievances
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Light of Exodus from Ambassador Hellmaw at Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath City in Talador.
identity.description: Our scouts have found a powerful draenei crystal being corrupted by Ambassador Hellmaw at the Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath. The draenei call it the Light of Exodus.$B$BCommander, I'd like to accompany you on this mission. Hellmaw slew my brother in Outland... this is personal.

identity.title: Unwelcome Memories
identity.objectives: Retrieve Infested Orc Remains from Acanthus at Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
identity.description: The botani in the Everbloom Wilds are doin' some sorta foul magic to create these plant... well... zombies, basically.$B$BI've seen what happens with armies o' mindless slaves. The Lich King...$B$B<Delvar's eyes close.>$B$BNo matter. We cannae let this escalate any further. I heard o' a particularly nasty one they've just made... let's kill it and see what makes it tick.

identity.title: The Dark Lady's Concern
identity.objectives: Retrieve Infested Orc Remains from Acanthus at Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
identity.description: The botani in the Everbloom Wilds kill anything foolish enough to wander too close to their blooms and are raising their corpses as mindless soldiers.$B$BThis is all too reminiscent of the Scourge... and the Dark Lady has taken notice. She has a special mission for us, commander.$B$BThere is a particularly large infested creature that was recently raised. We are to destroy it and retrieve its remains.

identity.title: Scrying Hard or Hardly Scrying
identity.objectives: Retrieve Urna's Fathomstaff from Urna Darkfathom at Shadowmoon Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.
identity.description: There are others that harness the shadows to do their bidding. You know of them, commander... the Shadowmoon orcs.$B$BThey have begun to master their craft... they call to the shadows beyond this realm...$B$BI desire their power. They have one who possesses a staff of particular interest... we should claim it as our own.

identity.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
identity.objectives: Retrieve Leorajh's Prayer Beads from Kirox the Wind Dancer in Skettis.
identity.description: When Leorajh became shaman, pridelord gave prayer beads. Beads help Leorajh hear elements.$B$BOne day bird-men attacked and took prayer beads. Took them to Skettis.$B$BMaster, you help Leorajh get prayer beads back?

identity.title: Call of the Talon King
identity.objectives: Speak with the Shade of Terokk in Veil Terokk.
identity.description:
$p, you have done much for my people. I wish to thank you on their behalf.

Please visit Veil Terokk when you can.

Description.text:
$p，你为我的人民提供了很多帮助。我希望能代他们当面感谢你。

有空的时候，请来泰罗克鸦巢一叙。
Description.english:
$p, you have done much for my people. I wish to thank you on their behalf.

Please visit Veil Terokk when you can.

PortraitGiverText.text: 利爪之王召你回泰罗克鸦巢。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Talon King calls you back to Veil Terokk.

Vizier Dar'gud refused to let me take my favorite sword; he told me "I wouldn't need it where I was going."$B$BI want it back, commander, and we are powerful enough together to take it from Dar'gud's bloody corpse.$B$BIt would mean a great deal to me. An ogre without his sword isn't an ogre at all.

They have one who possesses a staff of particular interest... we should claim it as our own.

identity.title: They Came From the Sea
identity.objectives: Obtain the Head of Fathom-Commander Zarrin, and slay $2oa of his naga troops.
identity.description: You're looking for Prince Farondis?$b$b<The ghostly elf narrows her eyes warily.>$b$bI can take you to Farondis... but first things first. These naga attacked suddenly. They take orders from one called Zarrin, in the low hills to the west.$b$bHelp me take Zarrin's head, and you'll have my ear.

Objectives.text: 获得深海指挥官扎林的徽记，并消灭他的$2oa个纳迦部下。
Objectives.english: Obtain the Head of Fathom-Commander Zarrin, and slay $2oa of his naga troops.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭他和他手下的纳迦！
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay him and the naga he commands!

identity.title: Our Very Bones
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Pilfered Night Elf Bones.
identity.description: You seek the Tidestone of Golganneth?$b$bYes, I know where it lies. It is in a place to which I prefer not to return.$b$bYou may be of use to me. In the midst of this naga attack, those horrid fish-men flopped their way onto my lands and raided our graveyards. They steal the bones of our ancestors, and indeed, the very bones of my people.$b$bHelp me bring some solace to my people. Then I shall tell you more about the Tidestone.

Objectives.text: 获得$1oa块失窃的暗夜精灵遗骨。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Pilfered Night Elf Bones.

identity.title: A Lack of Wasps
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Widow Wasps.
identity.description: The stings! These cursed wasps drone day and night and their constant aggression taxes me so.$b$bI shall do nothing about your offer until these nuisances are dealt with.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa只寡妇毒蜂。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Widow Wasps.

identity.title: The Blood of Demons
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fel Blood from any demon on the Broken Isles.
identity.description:
The time has come to make contact with the Master's soul. It is somewhere in the endless expanse of the Twisting Nether. Luckily, so is Mardum.

Such a thing is not unheard of, but it will be exceedingly difficult, even here. In addition to what the matron mother had us gather, we need a great deal of demon blood.

Like, a lot of it!

Objectives.text: 从破碎群岛的任意恶魔身上取得$1oa份魔血。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Fel Blood from any demon on the Broken Isles.

identity.title: The Tidestone: Shattered
identity.objectives: Collect the $1oa Tidestone Shards.
identity.description: I suppose you can go in, then.$b$bThe shattered pieces of the Tidestone of Golganneth are contained within the academy's eastern wing. Even as curator, I cannot attest to their condition, as I have not been in to inspect them in many millennia.$b$bOh, young $n? Please do not touch anything.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa块潮汐之石碎片。
Objectives.english: Collect the $1oa Tidestone Shards.

identity.title: Nar'thalas Still Suffers
identity.objectives: Defeat Athissa.
identity.description: They have not forgiven me. I cannot blame them.$b$bPast crimes aside, I am still their prince. Even in death, I will do what I can to protect my people.$b$b$n. Act as my champion. Find and defeat the creature that leads this naga attack against the people of Nar'thalas. After all these years, you - |5$r $c, of all things - may be the instrument of my redemption.

PortraitGiverText.text: 积怨潮汐主母
PortraitGiverText.english: Tidemistress of the Hatecoil
