identity.title: Round 1, Fight!
identity.objectives: Have Sternfathom throw you into the arena, defeat Boss Whalebelly, and then find Okuna Longtusk inside Oceanus Cove.
identity.description:
All of my gladiators are out of commission!

It's down to you, $n. Bilgerudder's going to pit his three champions against you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在竞技场里活下来，并最终消灭鲸腹老板。
PortraitGiverText.english: Survive the arena until you eliminate Boss Whalebelly.

identity.title: No Time for Tryouts
identity.objectives: Deliver a beatdown to Ooker Dooker.
identity.description:
We don't have time for you to go through a lengthy set of tryouts. But, fighting in the arena is our best chance at getting you in good with the giants.

That kind-hearted giant over there that's losing against Bilgerudder is Sternfathom. If you were to defeat his hozen champion, you'd make yourself a spot on his team.

Looks like Ooker Dooker's taking a rest between bouts. Now's the time to deliver a good ol' monkey beatdown.

PortraitGiverText.text: 赶走这个家伙，这样你才能取代他在尾锚队伍里的位置。
PortraitGiverText.english: Send this guy packing so that you can take his place on Sternfathom's team.

identity.title: The Right Weapon for the Job
identity.objectives: Arm $1oa Shipwrecked Captives.
identity.description:
<You and Okuna were going to arm the captives in here. The idea was to free them and cause as much chaos as possible. It's the only sure way to be able to get close to the prince.>

<You still have the weapons. You're just going to have to be careful sneaking around the giants.>

Objectives.text: 武装$1oa名海难俘虏。
Objectives.english: Arm $1oa Shipwrecked Captives.

identity.title: The Prince is Going Down
identity.objectives: Free Okuna Longtusk and kill Prince Oceanus.
identity.description:
$n! I knew you'd come.

Quick, let me out of here and we'll take this giant down.

PortraitGiverText.text: 消灭欧逊努斯王子，让巨人们群龙无首。
PortraitGiverText.english: Cast the giants into disarray by killing their prince.

identity.title: Demon Souls
identity.objectives: Trap $1oa demon souls on the Faronaar Front.
identity.description:
I need to extract information about the Burning Legion from these foul creatures. But living, the demons are almost impossible to break.

However, like you, I wield a powerful artifact -- the Scythe of Souls.

Take one of my soul gems. If you place it next to a demon's corpse, it will rip the 'soul' out. Then, we will see if the scythe can get them to talk.

Objectives.text: 在法罗纳尔前线捕获$1oa个恶魔之魂。
Objectives.english: Trap $1oa demon souls on the Faronaar Front.

identity.title: Fel Machinations
identity.objectives: Free $1oa Demon Hunters from Soul Harvesters.
identity.description:
My force wiped out the demons' forward base here. But, an imp mother and her brood took the rest of my demon hunters hostage, including Cyana Nightglaive.

We need to free the Illidari and destroy the Burning Legion.

Objectives.text: 从灵魂收割器救出$1oa个恶魔猎手。
Objectives.english: Free $1oa Demon Hunters from Soul Harvesters.

identity.title: Making the World Safe for Profit
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa gilblin and/or makrura at Mak'rana and slay their leader, Queen Kraklaa.
identity.description:
Might I ask a small favor, my friend? These creatures in the tide pools to the east are starting to frighten me. Our efforts to trade with them have been rebuffed at every turn with aggression. This is not good; neither for running a business, nor for profit.

Sadly, I must admit the time for talk has come to an end.

Might you be willing to serve as my representative in dealing with the denizens of Mak'rura and their "queen"?

I can assure you that your efforts will be rewarded commensurately.

Objectives.text: 在玛拉纳消灭$1oa个海地精或者龙虾人，并解决他们的领袖卡卡拉女王。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa gilblin and/or makrura at Mak'rana and slay their leader, Queen Kraklaa.

PortraitGiverText.text: 杀死女王，并清除你面前的一切阻碍。
PortraitGiverText.english: Slay the queen and deal with anything or anyone that gets in your way.

identity.title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Council Nightblades within Lion's Watch.
identity.description: I need your help. Iskar has gone missing. I have reason to believe he has followed the remnants of the Sethekk who have been gathering here in Tanaan. I've been investigating and... what was that?$b$b<Reshad's voice drops to a whisper>$b$bThere is movement in the shadows, we are being watched!$b$bTake these vials, they form a gas with a terrible smell when the liquid comes in contact with the air. Smells terrible, they won't be able to resist it. Use them to drive our watchers out of hiding.

Objectives.text: 在雄狮岗哨杀死$1oa名议会夜刃刺客。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Council Nightblades within Lion's Watch.

identity.title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Council Nightblades within Vol'mar.
identity.description: I need your help. Iskar has gone missing. I have reason to believe he has followed the remnants of the Sethekk who have been gathering here in Tanaan. I've been investigating and... what was that?$b$b<Reshad's voice drops to a whisper>$b$bThere is movement in the shadows, we are being watched!$b$bTake these vials, they form a gas with a terrible smell when the liquid comes in contact with the air. Smells terrible, they won't be able to resist it. Use them to drive our watchers out of hiding.

Objectives.text: 在沃玛尔杀死$1oa名议会夜刃刺客。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Council Nightblades within Vol'mar.

identity.title: The Magister of Mixology
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Arcane-Infused Eggs.
identity.description:
As you must know, I'm a connoisseur of drinks... specifically, arcane-infused spirits. Cocktail mixing is alchemy, and as everyone knows, alchemy is magic.

My latest drink must be more exotic than anything I've conjured before. I already have most of what I need. But there are a couple of items left on the list.

Notice the herons down in the lagoon? As with many of the creatures on Azsuna, the magic coursing through the island permeates them.

Their eggs will do nicely.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个充满魔力的蛋。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Arcane-Infused Eggs.

identity.title: Presentation is Everything
identity.objectives: Collect the Six Eyes of Gangamesh.
identity.description:
The eggs will provide the 'oomph' to my drink's character. But there's another element, and this must not be underestimated!

Presentation.

Now, you could go with your standard olive skewered on a toothpick. Maybe a carrot stalk stuck slapdash out of a glass.

But then, you wouldn't be me.

No, my friend. What MY drink needs to sell it visually comes from a one-of-a-kind creature. I'm only going to serve it once and so my drink deserves something unique.

The eyes of Gangamesh are what I need.

PortraitGiverText.text: 魔导师加鲁霍德需要贡戈麦什的全部六颗眼球，来装点他最新最伟大的鸡尾酒。
PortraitGiverText.english: Magister Garuhod wants all six of this beast's eyes to top off his latest, greatest cocktail.

identity.title: Walled City: Brackenspore
identity.objectives: Defeat Brackenspore in Highmaul.
identity.description: The Iron Horde is just one of the threats we must deal with on Draenor. We must also clean up the chaos they are leaving in their wake.$b$bBrackenspore, ancient walker of the deep, was drawn from the waters near Highmaul by the presence of the Iron Horde. He spreads his fungal growth in his wake and will eradicate all of us if left unchecked.$b$bTravel to Highmaul and defeat Brackenspore.

identity.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
identity.objectives: Defeat Ko'ragh in Highmaul.
identity.description: Forget all you know of the ogres on Azeroth, $n. On Draenor they commanded a once-mighty civilization. Even now they threaten to reclaim their former glory.$b$bHighmaul excavations in Nagrand unearthed a mysterious relic. The only ogre to survive direct exposure to this relic was Ko'ragh; he was left with a near-complete immunity to all magic.$b$bKo'ragh must be killed before the ogres learn to replicate his unique powers. Travel to Highmaul and defeat Ko'ragh!

identity.title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
identity.objectives: Defeat Imperator Mar'gok in Highmaul.
identity.description: The conditions are ripe for a decisive attack against the Highmaul, commander. Will you engage?$b$bDescended from a long line of sorcerers, Imperator Mar'gok is the grand Imperator of Highmaul. He is both cunning and brutal, and allied himself with the Iron Horde when he recognized what it would be to oppose them.$b$bTravel to Highmaul and defeat Imperator Mar'gok. Without their leader, the Ogre Empire will descend into chaos for many years.

identity.title: Slagworks: Heart of the Mountain
identity.objectives: Defeat the Heart of the Mountain at the Blast Furnace in Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: Blackrock orcs fight like no other clan. They rely on arms and armor forged in the heart of their unnatural crucibles.$b$bDeep within the Foundry of the Blackrock clan is a furnace powered by a primal force known as the Heart of the Mountain. Destroy it, and deprive our foe of the arms they rely on.$b$bTravel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat the Heart of the Mountain.

identity.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
identity.objectives: Defeat Kromog in Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: Commander. Frostwolf scouts report that blackrock miners dug up a magnaron, and they've coerced the beast into helping them to create their infernal machines. They call it "Kromog."$b$bWe must destroy it, $n. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Kromog.

identity.title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
identity.objectives: Defeat Admiral Gar'an in Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: Our forces are making progress on land, but victory at sea still eludes us. We must take out the Iron Horde leadership while they are in harbor.$b$bGar'an, Admiral of the Iron Horde fleet and first of the so-called Iron Maidens, is tactically brilliant. She, along with her lieutenants, Marak, and Sorka, have crushed all who have been sent to oppose them.$b$bTravel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Admiral Gar'an.

identity.title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
identity.objectives: Defeat Blackhand in the Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: Grommash Hellscream relied on the strength of his Warlords to keep the Iron Horde under his control. It is time to strike a decisive blow.$b$bBlackhand, Warlord of the Blackrock clan, is a dauntless warrior and ruthless tyrant. He is second only to Grommash within the Iron Horde and oversees operations in the Foundry from atop its Crucible.$b$bTravel to the Blackrock Foundry and defeat Blackhand.

identity.title: Walled City: Brackenspore
identity.objectives: Defeat Brackenspore in Highmaul.
identity.description: If it ain't one threat, it's another - I swear this light-forsaken world would try to eat us alive even without no Horde to fight.$b$bBrackenspore, ancient walker of the deep, was drawn from the waters near Highmaul by the presence of the Iron Horde. That thing is already spreading like a disease, $n. Ye got to put it down!$b$bTravel to Highmaul and defeat Brackenspore before he gets too powerful to stop.

identity.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
identity.objectives: Defeat Ko'ragh in Highmaul.
identity.description: Ye know the name "Ko'ragh?" One of them Highmaul ogres. They dug up a relic some time ago that killed everyone it touched but for Ko'ragh... givin' him a near-complete immunity to all magic.$b$bOgres ain't meant to have that kind of power! Travel to Highmaul and defeat Ko'ragh, before they learn to use him against us.

identity.title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
identity.objectives: Defeat Imperator Mar'gok in Highmaul.
identity.description: I never thought much of them ogres, not until I saw a Highmaul legion on the march. Like a wall o' armored muscle, backed by the magics o' the emperor's best sorcerers. Never underestimate an ogre.$b$bImperator Mar'gok is the grand Imperator of Highmaul. Aye, he's a cunning one - allied himself with the Iron Horde, he did. If we're to break up the party, we'd best start at the top.$b$bTravel to Highmaul and defeat Imperator Mar'gok!

identity.title: Slagworks: Heart of the Mountain
identity.objectives: Defeat the Heart of the Mountain at the Blast Furnace in Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: Blackrock warriors use weapons forged in cursed fire by the breath of a creature o' pure flame: The Heart o' the Mountain. Let's disarm 'em, $gboy:lass;! Destroy that infernal creature, and the Blackrock won't have enough heat to fuel their Blast Furnace.$b$bTravel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat the Heart o' the Mountain.

identity.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
identity.objectives: Defeat Kromog in Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description:
Yer garrison scouts report that blackrock miners dug up a magnaron, and that the filthy beast has begun helpin' those brutes churn out their infernal machines. They call it "Kromog."

Travel to Blackrock Foundry and slay that fiend!

identity.title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
identity.objectives: Defeat Admiral Gar'an in Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: "If ye want to topple a wall, start with the foundation." It's an old Dwarf saying. If we take out the Iron Horde's leadership, the whole thing tumbles.$b$bGar'an is the Admiral o' the Iron Horde fleet and first of the so-called "Iron Maidens." She, along with her lieutenants, Marak, and Sorka, have dominated the seas of Draenor.$b$bNo more, $n. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Admiral Gar'an.

identity.title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
identity.objectives: Defeat Blackhand in the Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: Ol' Grommash cannot rule the Iron Horde without his Warlords keeping the clans in line. Let's deal 'em a blow that they can't recover from! Blackhand, Warlord of the Blackrock clan, is a dauntless warrior and ruthless tyrant. He's second only to Grommash within the Iron Horde and oversees operations in the Foundry from atop its Crucible.$b$bTravel to the Blackrock Foundry and defeat Blackhand.

identity.title: Death to Amethon!
identity.objectives: Retrieve a Humming Draenite Spike from Amethon above Kuuro's Claim in Talador.
identity.description: Foreman Eksos down in your Talador outpost figures he has the answer for why there's been so much seismic activity recently.$B$BSee, there's this giant, ah... earth fury, I think they're called, and it's covered in these powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. The crystals hum real loud and we think it's driving the fury crazy!$B$BProblem is, nobody's got the firepower to take the thing down so we can examine a sample. Think you could lend us a hand, commander?

identity.title: Death to Gor'thul!
identity.objectives: Slay Gor'thul at Bloodmane Pridelands in Spires of Arak.
identity.description: Saberon spirit army. I ain't pullin' your leg, commander, that's what we've got coming for us if we don't act fast.$B$BThe Shattered Hand shaman Gor'thul was spotted down in Spires of Arak in the Bloodmane Pridelands right about the same time we started hearing reports of saberon spirits raiding our supply caravans.$B$BI don't want to take any chances, commander. I think you should personally head down there and put a stop to this before it starts.

identity.title: Death to Undertow!
identity.objectives: Kill Undertow in the Tanaan Channel north of Umbrafen in Shadowmoon Valley.
identity.description: Good day to ya, commander!$B$BI have bad news.$B$BWe've been contracting out some spy work to the local fisherman - we pay 'em some coin, they take their boats out north of Umbrafen and see what the Iron Horde's up to. Win-win, right?$B$BWell, it turns out... no. Every boat that goes out never comes back. Apparently this giant water elemental, Undertow I think it was, is murdering the snot out of everyone that passes through.$B$BAny chance you could clear it out for us, commander?

identity.title: Death to Tremor!
identity.objectives: Kill Tremor west of Gorgorek's Fall in Gorgrond and obtain the Pile of Partially Digested Lobstrok Meat.
identity.description: Your outpost in Gorgrond has a serious saberon problem, commander, and we can't really afford to keep sending more troops to help 'em out. So I have an idea.$B$BThere's an enormous worm beast on the west coast of Gorgrond called Tremor, better known as the devourer of lobstroks. If you took that thing down and brought the, well, pile of partially digested lobstrok meat back here, we can cook it here, ship it back there, use it to calm the saberon for a good long time!

identity.title: Death to Hivelord Ik'rix!
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Iceshatter Carapace from Hivelord Ik'rix at Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description: We've got a radical new idea to try using ice ravager carapaces in our tempering process for armor and weapons. It's the sort of trailblazing work we strive for, commander!$B$BOnly problem is, ravagers apparently aren't keen on our guys and gals taking their carapaces off of them. There's this particular ravager at the Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge called Hivelord Ik'rix - if you could take him down we wouldn't need more for weeks!

identity.title: Auchindoun
identity.objectives: Defeat Teron'gor in Auchindoun.
identity.description: Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devouring the countless souls within. We must not let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength.$B$BEnter the holy mausoleum of Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest of the Shadow Council before more damage is done.

identity.title: Bloodmaul Slag Mines
identity.objectives: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
identity.description: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart of gems and ore, never to return.$B$BWe suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthing an ancient relic of immense power for their sorcerer-king.$B$BThe ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.

identity.title: Grimrail Depot
identity.objectives: Defeat Skylord Tovra in Grimrail Depot.
identity.description: We must move quickly, commander. As we speak the Grimrail is preparing to depart Grimrail Depot to deliver a massive battalion of troops to Shattrath. Rumor has it that they have outfitted the train with a weapon strong enough to shatter the shield protecting the inner city.$B$BSkylord Tovra has taken to guarding the train on its journey to Talador. You must stop Tovra and the Grimrail before it reaches Shattrath!

identity.title: Iron Docks
identity.objectives: Defeat Skulloc in the Iron Docks.
identity.description: The Iron Docks is one of the Iron Horde's greatest assets in this war. Our scouts have reported that the docks are alight with activity, indicating imminent attack.$B$BSkulloc, son of Gruul, was seen leaving the Blackrock Foundry, armed to the teeth with powerful cannons, and has been loaded onto their mightiest warship. It does not matter where they intend to strike, commander - you must sack the Iron Docks and defeat Skulloc before they ever leave.

identity.title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds
identity.objectives: Defeat Ner'zhul in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
identity.description: Ner'zhul was once a noble orc - he was the wise chieftain and elder shaman of the Shadowmoon clan. In his desperate bid to join the Iron Horde he has spat on all he once stood for and twisted his ancestors' spirits to tap into dark, forbidden power... all to please Hellscream.$B$BThe Shadowmoon has fallen, commander. Enter their ancestral burial grounds and put an end to Ner'zhul's madness before he pulls all of Draenor into the engulfing maw of the void.

identity.title: Skyreach
identity.objectives: Defeat High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
identity.description: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastating crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.$B$BThe arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison, commander.

identity.title: The Everbloom
identity.objectives: Defeat Yalnu in the Everbloom.
identity.description: The Kirin Tor created an outpost in Gorgrond with a portal to Stormwind to facilitate quick reinforcements in the assault on the Blackrock Foundry. In their infinite wisdom they built it in the heart of the Everbloom, home to the botani and the mightiest of the genesaur - Yalnu.$B$BThe outpost has already been overrun and it is only a matter of time before the overgrowth spreads to Stormwind... and with it the whole of Azeroth.

identity.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
identity.objectives: Defeat Warlord Zaela in Upper Blackrock Spire.
identity.description: Hellscream's Ironmarch vanguard managed to reach Blackrock Mountain and has allied with Warlord Zaela of the Dragonmaw clan. Even now the Iron Horde readies to invade Azeroth while Zaela prepares a doomsday weapon in the heart of the mountain to ensure nothing stands in their way.$B$BYou must put a stop to Zaela once and for all, commander. She has been a thorn in our side for too long.

identity.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
identity.objectives: Defeat Warlord Zaela in Upper Blackrock Spire.
identity.description: Hellscream's Ironmarch vanguard managed to reach Blackrock Mountain and has allied with Warlord Zaela o' the Dragonmaw clan. Even now the Iron Horde readies to invade Azeroth while Zaela prepares a doomsday weapon in the heart o' the mountain to ensure nothing stands in their way.$B$BYou must put a stop to Zaela once and for all, commander. She's been a thorn in our side for too long.

identity.objectives: Defeat Yalnu in the Everbloom.
identity.description: The Kirin Tor created an outpost in Gorgrond with a portal to Stormwind to facilitate quick reinforcements in the assault on the Blackrock Foundry. Unfortunately they built it in the heart o' the Everbloom, home to the botani and the mightiest o' the genesaur - Yalnu.$B$BThe outpost has already been overrun and it is only a matter o' time before the overgrowth spreads to Stormwind... and with it the whole of Azeroth.

identity.description: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastatin' crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.$B$BThe arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison!

identity.objectives: Defeat Ner'zhul in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
identity.description: Ner'zhul wasn't always evil - once he was the wise chieftain and elder shaman o' the Shadowmoon clan. In his desperate bid to join the Iron Horde he's forsaken all he once stood for and twisted his ancestors' spirits to tap into dark, forbidden power... all to please Hellscream.$B$BEnter their ancestral burial grounds and put an end to Ner'zhul's madness before he pulls all o' Draenor into the engulfing maw o' the void.

identity.objectives: Defeat Skulloc in the Iron Docks.
identity.description: The Iron Docks is one o' the Iron Horde's greatest assets in this war. Our scouts have reported that the docks are alight with activity, indicatin' imminent attack.$B$BSkulloc, son o' Gruul, was seen leavin' the Blackrock Foundry, armed to the teeth with powerful cannons, and has been loaded onto their mightiest warship. It doesn't matter where they intend to strike, commander - you must sack the Iron Docks and defeat Skulloc before they ever leave!

identity.objectives: Defeat Skylord Tovra in Grimrail Depot.
identity.description: We must move quickly, commander. As we speak the Grimrail is preparing to depart Grimrail Depot to deliver a massive battalion o' troops to Shattrath. Rumor has it that they have outfitted the train with a weapon strong enough to shatter the shield protectin' the inner city.$B$BSkylord Tovra has taken to guardin' the train on its journey to Talador. You must stop Tovra and the Grimrail before it reaches Shattrath!

identity.title: Bloodmaul Slag Mines
identity.objectives: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
identity.description: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart o' gems and ore, never to return.$B$BWe suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthin' an ancient relic o' immense power for their sorcerer-king.$B$BThe ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.

identity.title: Auchindoun
identity.objectives: Defeat Teron'gor in Auchindoun.
identity.description: Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devourin' the countless souls within. We mustn't let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength.$B$BEnter the holy mausoleum o' Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest o' the Shadow Council before more damage is done.

identity.title: Death to Amethon!
identity.objectives: Retrieve a Humming Draenite Spike from Amethon above Kuuro's Claim in Talador.
identity.description: Foreman Grobash in da Talador outpost figures he knows why der's been so much seismic activity recently.$B$BDer be an earth fury called Amethon that be covered in powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. Da crystals' hummin' be drivin' da fury crazy!$B$BWe want a sample to see if we can figure out why da crystals are so powerful. I wouldn't be askin' ya if I thought anybody else could do it, commander.

identity.title: Death to Gor'thul!
identity.objectives: Slay Gor'thul at Bloodmane Pridelands in Spires of Arak.
identity.description: We been hearin' 'bout some real, real bad voodoo in Spires of Arak, commander.$B$BDa Shattered Hand shaman Gor'thul be seen sneakin' about da spires the same time we be hearin' of saberon spirits attackin' our supply caravans and our arakkoa allies.$B$BI think it best if we take no chances. You should deal with da shaman personally before dis matter gets out of hand.

identity.title: Death to Undertow!
identity.objectives: Kill Undertow in the Tanaan Channel north of Umbrafen in Shadowmoon Valley.
identity.description: We be havin' a problem, commander.$B$BWe been sendin' some small boats into the Tanaan Channel north of da Umbrafen in Shadowmoon ta spy on da Alliance base der as well as da Iron Horde in Tanaan Jungle.$B$BDa problem is dat every boat we send out come back in pieces, if it come back at all. We think a water elemental called Undertow is da culprit.$B$BI know you be busy, but destroyin' that creature would be very helpful to our efforts.

identity.title: Death to Tremor!
identity.objectives: Kill Tremor west of Gorgorek's Fall in Gorgrond and obtain the Pile of Partially Digested Lobstrok Meat.
identity.description: Da Gorgrond outpost be havin' troubles with saberon, and we can't afford ta throw troops at the problem any longer. Don't worry, I be havin' an idea.$B$BThere be an enormous worm beast on the west coast of Gorgrond called Tremor, da devourer of lobstroks. If you killed da beast and brought da pile of lobstrok meat back here, we can cook it 'ere, send it to da outpost, and use it to calm da saberon for good!

identity.title: Death to Hivelord Ik'rix!
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Iceshatter Carapace from Hiveord Ik'rix at Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description: We been tryin' out a new way to temper weapons with ice ravager carapaces. Der icy hides are perfect for da process.$B$BHivelord Ik'rix in da Southwind Cliffs nearby is rumored to be da largest ravager we ever seen - if you could bring its carapace back, we'd be able to make all sorts of things!

identity.title: The Shadow War
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Shadow Council members in the Den of Secrets.
identity.description: The Shadow Council are more entrenched than you expected. A large contingent seems focused on infiltrating the draenei Exarch Council in the town above.$b$bKhadgar certainly wouldn't complain if you did a little... "housecleaning."

Objectives.text: 在秘密巢穴里消灭$1oa名暗影议会成员。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Shadow Council members in the Den of Secrets.

identity.title: The Death of the Eldest
identity.objectives: Slay Leyworms to obtain $1oa Crackling Leyworm Cores, then drop them into Senegos's pool.
identity.description: I will do what I can to stabilize him, but I will need your help.$b$bThe small amount of energy he has left is coming from the mana pool he rests in.$b$bFollow the whelplings' lead. Dropping ley crystals into the pool gives him a bit of energy - buying him a few more breaths.$b$bThey seem to be getting the crystals from inside that cave to the north.

Objectives.text: 消灭魔虫以取得$1oa个开裂的魔虫核心，然后放进塞纳苟斯的法力池。
Objectives.english: Slay Leyworms to obtain $1oa Crackling Leyworm Cores, then drop them into Senegos's pool.

identity.title: The Withered
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa withered in the Azurewing Whelplands.
identity.description: The withered are the worst kind of pest. They capture our whelplings, knock them unconscious, and then drink whatever mana they can from the helpless babes.$b$bNormally our drakes and keepers would fend them off. Today, it looks like we may need your help.

Objectives.text: 在蓝翼繁育地消灭$1oa个枯法者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa withered in the Azurewing Whelplands.

identity.title: The Consumed
identity.objectives: Find a Dim Ley Crystal, then revive $2oa Mana-Drained Whelplings.
identity.description: <The whelpling is alive, but unconscious. One of the withered must have already drained it of mana.>$b$b<You've already learned that exposed ley crystals contain a small amount of magical energy. Perhaps you can use one to revive some of the whelps.>

Objectives.text: 找到一个黯淡的魔网水晶，然后用它使$2oa条法力枯竭的雏龙复苏。
Objectives.english: Find a Dim Ley Crystal, then revive $2oa Mana-Drained Whelplings.

identity.title: The Nightborne Prince
identity.objectives: Slay Ael'Yith.
identity.description: <Senegos is focused.>$b$bI sense it now. In the ruined building, to the east. One of these cretins must have tapped deep into the ley line.$b$bI suspect he will be heavily defended, $n. Once again, the well-being of my brood is in your hands.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他一直从废墟上方对你进行骚扰。也许是时候去会会他了……
PortraitGiverText.english: He's been pestering you from atop his ruins. Maybe it's time to pay him a visit...

identity.title: Clearing the Docks
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde orcs and $2oa ogron.
identity.description: Our salvage team thought these here docks would be abandoned, but they're crawlin' wit' remnants of the Iron Horde. Gul'dan's cronies are convertin' anyone they can and evacuatin' everyone to Tanaan Jungle.$b$bCommander, if yeh can clear this place out, my team can salvage some of this equipment.$b$bPlus, ev'ry orc yeh kill here is one less ta worry about in Tanaan!

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个钢铁部落兽人和$2oa个独眼魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Iron Horde orcs and $2oa ogron.

identity.title: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak

Title.english: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak

identity.title: Runas the Shamed
identity.objectives: Slay Runas the Shamed.
identity.description: I fell so quickly, $n. I am not as strong as I once was. We truly do need your help.$b$bOne of these disgusting creatures ran off with several of the whelplings. I heard him called by name:$b$bRunas.$b$bI will survive. Home is not far. You still have strength, though. Slay this Runas before he does any more damage to our brood.

identity.title: Bringing the Bass
identity.objectives: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
identity.description:
You know what would boost morale around here?

Bass. Beats. Music!

Everyone loves a party! You go out and get me some hardware, and I'll make a system that will shatter Draenor itself.

identity.title: Dream of Argus: The First Fragment
identity.objectives: Follow the clue from the journal to find Lor Stonefist. Defeat her and claim the Rough Crystal Shard.
identity.description:
In his quest to restore the Dream of Argus, Maatun enlisted the help of three orcs. These same orcs betrayed him and took the crystal shards before they could be combined. If you find these orcs, they may still have them.

The first target shouldn't be far. The journal reads:

"I was told she spent most of her time in the crystal cave to the north of the encampment. There she studied the native crystals for ways to improve their potential abilities."

PortraitGiverText.text: 影月氏族的战士，也是研究当地水晶的专家。
PortraitGiverText.english: A warrior of the Shadowmoon clan, as well as an expert on the native crystals.

identity.title: Dream of Argus: The Second Fragment
identity.objectives: Follow the clue in the journal to find Vok Blacktongue. Defeat him and claim the Cracked Crystal Shard.
identity.description:
The second orc that Matuun mentioned was a master runecarver and sorcerer. He should be located somewhere in the main camp. The journal reads:

"She mentioned that the orc could normally found in one of the runemaster's huts in the southern part of the camp. They could be identified by the standing stones surrounding the structure, as well as the floating runestones above."

PortraitGiverText.text: 符文大师，影月氏族的高阶仪祭师。
PortraitGiverText.english: Master runecarver and high ritualist of the Shadowmoon.

identity.title: Dream of Argus: The Final Fragment
identity.objectives: Follow the clue in the journal to find Koros Soulsplinter. Defeat him and claim the Smooth Crystal Shard.
identity.description:
The last orc to be found was a hermit who kept away from the bulk of the Shadowmoon orcs at the Pillars of Fate camp, but was often seen in the high hills above. The journal reads:

"It is said, however, that he can often be seen among the graves upon the high hill, overlooking the camp below.  There he would commune with the dead ancestors, whom it is said he preferred over his living brethren."

PortraitGiverText.text: 选择与亡者为伴的神秘隐士。
PortraitGiverText.english: A mysterious hermit who prefers the company of the dead.

identity.title: The World Famous Ring of Blood!
identity.objectives: Become Lord of the Ring at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand.
identity.description: Dear Unadulterated Badass,$B$BIf you're reading this, you're exactly the sort of tough-as-nails champ in the making we need down at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand.$B$BYou and two friends are cordially invited to fight for your lives against the toughest creatures this side of Gorgrond. It's positively brutal - and the crowd loves it!$B$BCome talk to me to start your first fight - beat four of the fiercest creatures I've got and you'll get a shot at the champ himself!$B$B-Gurgthock

AreaDescription.text: 成为纳格兰鲜血竞技场的竞技场之王。
AreaDescription.english: Become Lord of the Ring at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand.

identity.title: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak

Title.english: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak

identity.title: Feasting on the Dragon
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa withered in Azurewing Repose.
identity.description: You killed their leader, so they came here? Understandable. These creatures crave only one thing - magic - and they can sniff it out from leagues away.$b$bWithout a leader, they will soon wither and die. Our only recourse in the meantime is to put as many as possible down before they take these dragons with them!

Objectives.text: 在蓝翼栖地消灭$1oa个枯法者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa withered in Azurewing Repose.

identity.title: A Royal Summons
identity.objectives: Use the Royal Summons and follow Sky Admiral Rogers through the portal to Stormwind Harbor.
identity.description: Well met, $p. I have come on behalf of King Anduin Wrynn.$B$BMy crew is preparing for a special mission, and the king would like you to join us. Please review this official summons and, if you are satisfied, return with me to Stormwind Harbor.$B$B<Rogers hands you a sealed envelope.>

Description.text: 幸会，$p。我代表安度因·乌瑞恩国王欢迎你的到来。$B$B我的队伍正准备执行一项特殊的任务，而国王陛下希望你也能加入。请查阅这份皇家召令，如果没有异议的话，就请你随我一起返回暴风城港口。$B$B<罗杰斯递给你一份密封的信函。>
Description.english: Well met, $p. I have come on behalf of King Anduin Wrynn.$B$BMy crew is preparing for a special mission, and the king would like you to join us. Please review this official summons and, if you are satisfied, return with me to Stormwind Harbor.$B$B<Rogers hands you a sealed envelope.>

identity.title: Supplies From the Skies
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Skyfire First Aid Kits.
identity.description: Are you feeling alright? Say 'ah.'$B$B<Mishka attempts to depress your tongue with a damp twig.>$B$BSorry... we are in desperate need of medical supplies here. The infirmary on the Skyfire was well-stocked, but it's all scattered to the winds now.$B$BAnything you can salvage from the wreck will save lives!

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个天火急救包。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Skyfire First Aid Kits.

identity.title: Boarded!
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Forsaken Bat-Riders or Forsaken Deathstalkers.
identity.description: Glad to see you survived the crash. Unfortunately, so did most of the enemy's boarding party.$B$BJust the thought of those monsters setting foot on my ship makes me sick. Wipe them out, $p. For my crew... For King Wrynn...$B$BFor the Alliance!

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个被遗忘者蝙蝠骑手或亡灵哨兵。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Forsaken Bat-Riders or Forsaken Deathstalkers.

Description.text: 很高兴看到你在空难中幸存了下来。不幸的是，大部分登船的敌人也活了下来。$B$B一想到那些怪物登上了我的船，我就直犯恶心。去干掉他们，$p。为了我的船员……为了乌瑞恩国王……$B$B为了联盟！
Description.english: Glad to see you survived the crash. Unfortunately, so did most of the enemy's boarding party.$B$BJust the thought of those monsters setting foot on my ship makes me sick. Wipe them out, $p. For my crew... For King Wrynn...$B$BFor the Alliance!

identity.title: The Lost Legion
identity.objectives: Locate the missing 7th Legion Dragoons.
identity.description: The heroic men and women of the 7th Legion stayed at the front of the ship to fight off storm drakes while the crew evacuated.$B$BNone of them have returned.$B$BPlease find them, $p!

Description.text: 第七军团的英雄们当时都留在了飞艇的前部迎战风暴幼龙，掩护船员撤离。$B$B但他们至今未归。$B$B请你去找到他们，$p！
Description.english: The heroic men and women of the 7th Legion stayed at the front of the ship to fight off storm drakes while the crew evacuated.$B$BNone of them have returned.$B$BPlease find them, $p!

identity.title: Lightning Rod
identity.objectives: Charge the Transponder by absorbing Storm Drake lightning attacks.
identity.description: <Overspark's tiny hands move like lightning, affixing coils and tubes to the device before cramming it into a parachute pack.>$B$BPut this on.$B$BJust up the hill you'll find the front half of the Skyfire - and the big nest of storm drakes it crashed into! We can use the energy from those drakes to charge the transponder.$B$BYou'll have to incite them, of course, but the device should draw most of the power.$B$BThe probability of you being electrocuted is well within acceptable parameters!

identity.title: Pins and Needles
identity.objectives: Release $1oa 7th Legion Dragoons from static fields.
identity.description: Hngghh!$B$BNope, can't stand yet. It's all pins and needles.$B$BSmall fries like this are usually no problem for the 7th, but we weren't prepared for their electrical attacks. Before I knew it, I was trapped in some kind of static field. Couldn't move a muscle until you came along.$B$BMy comrades were carried deeper into the cave. Get 'em out before they become whelp chow!

Objectives.text: 从静电力场中救出$1oa名第七军团龙骑兵。
Objectives.english: Release $1oa 7th Legion Dragoons from static fields.

identity.title: Signal Boost
identity.objectives: Use the Skyfire Propeller to broadcast a distress signal, then hold out until help arrives.
identity.description: The Skyfire's starboard propeller came to rest on the cliffs overlooking our camp - we're gonna use it like a big antenna and push our distress signal so far that even Mekkatorque's alarm clock could pick it up!$B$BUnfortunately, it might attract some unwanted attention.$B$BWe're braced for enemy contact down here at the camp - fire up that signal and be ready to defend the antenna!

identity.title: Out of the Dream
identity.objectives: Awaken $1oa Druids of the Claw.
identity.description: Malfurion Stormrage... A name I have not heard in centuries.$B$BHe was teacher to many of us. If he seeks my audience, I cannot refuse.$B$BI will go to the Grove of Cenarius, but first, we must awaken the rest of my clan. They slumber with no way of waking.$b$bA mysterious force of great power is at work against us.$B$BI am still too weak from my hibernation. Please, stranger, go and free them from their dreams.

Objectives.text: 唤醒$1oa名利爪德鲁伊。
Objectives.english: Awaken $1oa Druids of the Claw.

identity.title: The Ancient Trials
identity.objectives: Find Havi near Aggramar's Vault.
identity.description:
<As the raven stares into your eyes, an odd voice fills your mind.>

I know who you are, champion, and I know what you seek.

Come to me, if you think yourself truly worthy.

PortraitGiverText.text: 不知为何，这个奇怪的维库老人好像很了解你……
PortraitGiverText.english: This strange old vrykul seems to know you somehow...

identity.title: Death to the Witchmother
identity.objectives: Slay Magula.
identity.description: The numberless years of my life have been dedicated to learning and perfecting the arts of healing and restoration.$b$bNothing in this world pains me more than taking a life, traveler.$b$bIt is with a heavy heart that I must commission the death of Magula, the leader of the harpies that threaten this grove.$b$bMay her death save the lives of more noble beings.

identity.title: This IS In My Contract.
identity.objectives: Help Daglop complete his ritual.
identity.description: To perform my ritual I need to use a special cave I have prepared at Gloombound Barrow.$b$bMeet me there and I will "give" you your reward. Hee hee.

PortraitGiverText.text: 特德的主人-上上任
PortraitGiverText.english: Tehd's Master-Before-Last

identity.title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
identity.objectives: Speak with King Varian Wrynn inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
identity.description: Your garrison is in an uproar. King Varian Wrynn himself is visiting your fortress to discuss your invasion plan for Tanaan Jungle.$b$bThe King is ready for you inside your town hall along with his full retinue. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...

PortraitGiverText.text: 乌瑞恩国王在等你。
PortraitGiverText.english: King Wrynn is waiting for you.

identity.title: Hook, Line, and... Sink Him!
identity.objectives: Use a Blackrock Grapple to reach Knar's bunker. Slay him to obtain Roark's Shipyard Blueprints.
identity.description: I can build you a shipyard. And not some wasteful piece of over-engineering like this place.$b$bBut I'm going to need my blueprints. My work was confiscated when Gul'dan turned this harbor over to Admiral Knar.$b$b<Roark spits.>$b$bGul'dan's green poison courses through Knar's veins. He's calling the shots from on high. We'll need to grapple up there to take him out.

identity.title: Spirits of the Bleeding Hollow
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Enraged Blood Spirits.
identity.description:
It is clear the cave is protected by powerful ghosts, ancestors of the Bleeding Hollow.

Whatever is down there, it will be easier to deal with if many of the spirits were dealt with first.

Objectives.text: 杀死$1oa只被激怒的血魂。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Enraged Blood Spirits.

identity.title: The Warchief Beckons
identity.objectives: Read the Royal Summons and follow Nathanos Blightcaller through the portal to Durotar.
identity.description: Greetings, $p. I am here on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. I should hope you recognize the name.$B$B<Nathanos thrusts a sealed envelope into your hand.>$B$BRead it and follow me.$B$BYou can read, can't you?

Description.text: 你好，$p。我代表希尔瓦娜斯·风行者欢迎你的到来。我想你应该对这个名字很熟悉。$B$B<纳萨诺斯将一封密函塞到你手里。>$B$B读完之后跟我走。$B$B你识字的吧？
Description.english: Greetings, $p. I am here on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. I should hope you recognize the name.$B$B<Nathanos thrusts a sealed envelope into your hand.>$B$BRead it and follow me.$B$BYou can read, can't you?

identity.title: Eyes in the Overlook
identity.objectives: Recover the SI:7 Intel from Spymaster Knockwhistle in Blackbeak Overlook.
identity.description: Alliance personnel from the Skyfire were spotted parachuting into Blackbeak Overlook.$B$BI was unable to confirm numbers or positions during my flyover, but I did see parachutes tangled in treetops and a LOT of ravenbears on the ground.$B$BIf anyone is up there, they must be laying low and keeping an eye on us.$B$BI have posted a rider at the top of the overlook to keep watch while I press forward into Stormheim.$B$B- Liza Cullen, Dread-Rider - 1st Wing

PortraitGiverText.text: 库伦肯定是在动身执行其他任务之前写了这份报告留给纳萨诺斯。
PortraitGiverText.english: Cullen must have left this report for Nathanos before heading off on another mission.

identity.title: A Little Kelp From My Foes
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa pieces of seaweed from Kvaldir Mistcallers and Soulflayers in Helheim.
identity.description:
I'm not sure what yer doin' here, but ye have my thanks. If ye want to get any further, though, ye'll need to get past that foul dog, Guarm.

I've tried meself a few times, and I think I have a plan. If we can get some of the seaweed these kvaldir wear, we might be able to trick the mutt. Guarm's mean, ye see, but not too smart.

What do ye say? Think ye can take on a few kvaldir?

Objectives.text: 从冥狱深渊的克瓦迪尔召雾者和掠魂者身上收集$1oa片海草。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa pieces of seaweed from Kvaldir Mistcallers and Soulflayers in Helheim.

identity.title: Numismatics
identity.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
identity.description:
I hate to be too cynical, but I don't think we're gonna find Nolan in one piece. Or in a lot of pieces.

Nolan was a nut for finding rare coins. He's been from one end of the world to the other finding them, and now he's gone and gotten himself killed looking for more mint condition Draenei coins. Tell you what - let me show you what these coins look like, you bring me a few more of them and I'll set up an exhibit in his honor.

AreaDescription.text: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。
AreaDescription.english: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

identity.title: Numismatics
identity.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
identity.description:
I told him this was a fool's errand. Of course he would get himself killed over a handful of coins! Oh well, there are always new lovers to find.

You'll have to do in the mean time. And you are quite easy on the eyes, aren't you? Be a dear and find me more coins that look like this one? I need them for... research.

AreaDescription.text: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。
AreaDescription.english: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

identity.title: Bringing the Bass
identity.objectives: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
identity.description:
It's a bit quiet around here, in between the invasions and all.

You're in luck though, Commander! I can fix that, and boost morale among your troops all at the same time.

All you need to do is bring me a few items from around Draenor, and I'll fill your garrison with music. I'll even throw in a few music rolls from my own collection to get you started!

What do you say?

identity.title: Side Effects May Include Mild Undeath
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Volatile Bears or Volatile Sailors.
identity.description: Exposure to this particular "byproduct" is quite nasty.$B$BRapid cell degeneration quickly reduces the subject to a shambling husk incapable of any reason or thought beyond a violent, throbbing hatred for the warmth of life.$B$BAs you might imagine, the local fauna have been affected by the spill. Oh, and most of the crew as well...$B$BAnyway, good luck!

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个变异熊或变异水手。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Volatile Bears or Volatile Sailors.

identity.title: Wrath of the Blightcaller
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa 7th Legion Paratroopers or Skyfire Gryphon-Riders.
identity.description: The Alliance dogs have bitten off more than they can chew. They have attacked the Banshee Queen, and invoked the wrath of her champion!$B$BLike my bow, my axes, and my hounds, you will be an agent of vengeance. Pile the bodies high, $c, and know that I am doing the same. When next we meet, I expect to see blood upon your hands.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个第七军团伞兵或天火号狮鹫骑士。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa 7th Legion Paratroopers or Skyfire Gryphon-Riders.

identity.title: Completionism
identity.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
identity.description: Interesting - the coins you've brought back from your Garrison are slightly different than the ones Nolan collected in Outland. Y'see here, the markings along the edge? Very interesting stuff! This requires some more study an' that means more coins! Bring them to me and I'll see if I can scrounge up something for your trouble.

AreaDescription.text: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。
AreaDescription.english: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

identity.title: Completionism
identity.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
identity.description:
This is intolerable! The coins you brought me do not match the rest of the coins I already have! You aren't counterfeiting these are you? No? Hrumph. In that case I'm sorry we fought, dearie.

There's only one thing to do, buttercup: we need to complete the new set you've discovered. Bring me more misprinted coins!

AreaDescription.text: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。
AreaDescription.english: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

identity.title: A Curious Oddity
identity.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
identity.description: I've been looking at some of the other coins in circulation plus the ones you've brought back. Some o' these are misprints... others are just plain wrong. Look 'ere. This one's got two heads. And the second one is smiling at me, where it wasn't before.$b$bThere's a bigger mystery in play here and these misprints are the key to figuring it out. I'm gonna need even more.

AreaDescription.text: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。
AreaDescription.english: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

identity.title: A Curious Oddity
identity.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
identity.description: Well sweet pea, I have good news and bad news for you. The good news is that you brought me enough coins to complete this new misprint set! The bad news is that not a single one of them has matched the original partial set.$b$bSee here - this coin has two heads. And the face on the reverse is grinning at me, where he was looking so dour only an hour ago. This one squints when I shine a light on it. Such a mystery! I must have more!

AreaDescription.text: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。
AreaDescription.english: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

identity.title: The Same, But Different
identity.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
identity.description: I'm beginning to suspect these here coins are demonic. See? This one's got three eyes! This one always comes up tails. And over here - the ones you brought me earlier? They dissolved in holy water.$b$bI need to make absolutely sure this isn't a fluke - bring me a huge pile of coins to sort through so nobody can refute m'theory.

AreaDescription.text: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。
AreaDescription.english: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

identity.title: The Same, But Different
identity.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
identity.description: A most intriguing theory has been put forth by an associate of mine that may explain what's wrong with these coins. We believe they might be demonic in origin. See? This one's got three eyes. And this one always comes up tails. And THIS one whispers to me at night - on now, don't be jealous sweetheart. You're still my favorite.$b$b...Provided you bring me more coins so I can confirm our theory. Run along!

AreaDescription.text: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。
AreaDescription.english: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

identity.title: New Goods
identity.objectives: Talk with Sergeant Crowler.
identity.description: New items are available from Sergeant Crowler.  I suggest you stop by and take a look at his new goods as soon as you can!

PortraitGiverText.text: 在你的要塞里找到克劳勒中士。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Sergeant Crowler in your Garrison.

identity.title: The Sargerei Menace
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Sargerei.
identity.description:
An attack such as this was unexpected. They have deployed heavily and it will take me some time to marshal enough forces to root them out.

Any Sargerei you can slay will make retaking this area much easier commander.

Objectives.text: 杀死$1oa名萨格雷。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Sargerei.

identity.title: New Goods
identity.objectives: Talk with Sergeant Grimjaw.
identity.description: New items are available from Sergeant Grimjaw.  I suggest you stop by and take a look at his new goods as soon as you can!

PortraitGiverText.text: 在你的要塞里找到格里姆加中士。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Sergeant Grimjaw in your Garrison.

identity.title: The Ancient Trials
identity.objectives: Find Havi near Aggramar's Vault.
identity.description:
<As the raven stares into your eyes, an odd voice fills your mind.>

I know who you are, champion, and I know what you seek.

Come to me, if you think yourself truly worthy.

PortraitGiverText.text: 不知为何，这个奇怪的维库老人好像很了解你……
PortraitGiverText.english: This strange old vrykul seems to know you somehow...

identity.title: Part of the Team
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa demons within Felsoul Hold.
identity.description: You're a blacksmith?$b$b<The elf looks down at your hammer.>$b$bStill working in leystone, are you? I might be able to help you out.$b$bAlliances out here are hard-won. You've got a pretty face, but that's no guarantee that you aren't working for the demons. I can't afford to trust you yet.$b$bDon't come back until you're caked in demon's blood. Then we'll talk smithing.

Objectives.text: 在邪魂堡垒消灭$1oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa demons within Felsoul Hold.

identity.title: The Sargerei Menace
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Sargerei.
identity.description:
This attack surprised our defenders. Forces are marshalling to push them out, but it will take some time for them to arrive.

Any Sargerei you can slay will make retaking this area much easier commander.

Objectives.text: 杀死$1oa个萨格雷。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Sargerei.

identity.title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
identity.objectives: Speak with Warchief Vol'jin inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
identity.description: Your garrison is in an uproar. Warchief Vol'jin himself is visiting your fortress to discuss your invasion plan for Tanaan Jungle.$b$bThe Warchief is ready for you inside your Town Hall. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...

PortraitGiverText.text: 大酋长在等你。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Warchief awaits.

identity.title: Clearing the Docks
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde orcs and $2oa ogron.
identity.description: We need to get control of this situation. We thought these docks would be all but abandoned. Instead, Gul'dan has ordered the Iron Horde to retreat to Tanaan, and many are using this harbor to make their getaway.$b$bWe need to clear a path for your salvage team. Lay waste to them! Every foe we slay here is one less convert for Gul'dan's wretched demon-worshipping army.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个钢铁部落兽人和$2oa个独眼魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Iron Horde orcs and $2oa ogron.

identity.title: Hook, Line, and... Sink Him!
identity.objectives: Use a Blackrock Grapple to reach Knar's bunker. Slay him to obtain Roark's Shipyard Blueprints.
identity.description: I can build you a shipyard. And not some wasteful piece of over-engineering like this place.$b$bBut I'm going to need my blueprints. My work was confiscated when Gul'dan turned this harbor over to Admiral Knar.$b$b<Roark spits.>$b$bGul'dan's green poison courses through Knar's veins. He's calling the shots from on high. We'll need to grapple up there to take him out.

identity.title: Infrastructure Improvements
identity.objectives: Place $1oa G-X3 Telemetry Beacons.
identity.description:
$G Sir : Ma'am;, we built a vehicle to take ya up to the Throne of Kil'jaeden but whenever we try a test flight the navigation system goes crazy!$b$bIn my expert opinion it's 'cause of that crazy demon magic the Iron Horde is playing around with up there.

If you could travel up there and place these telemetry beacons we can program the vehicle and give you a stable flight all the way up.

Just be sure to have some friends with you, the demons up there look especially vicious!

Objectives.text: 放置$1oa个G-X3遥测信标。
Objectives.english: Place $1oa G-X3 Telemetry Beacons.

identity.title: Setting the Signal
identity.objectives: Place $1oa Pentangulate-o-tron 2000s.
identity.description:
$G Sir : Ma'am;, we built a vehicle to bypass the Horde camp and take you to the Throne of Kil'jaeden! There's one problem, the concentrated fel energy up there is causing the navigation system to go haywire!

I'll need you to place some sensors along the edge of the summit. With them in place we can stabilize the flight controls.

Just be sure to have some friends with you, the demons up there look especially vicious!

Objectives.text: 放置$1oa个五角电子分析器2000型。
Objectives.english: Place $1oa Pentangulate-o-tron 2000s.

identity.title: Children of the Night
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Risen Assassins, Black Rook Falcons, or Risen Hounds.
identity.description: I am no enemy to these people, but there is no convincing them of that.$B$BTheir village has come under attack by some very old friends of mine. Friends who are no longer... living.$B$BThere's no telling who or what controls them, but in life these noble soldiers would never engage in such acts. That's a mystery for another time.$B$BFor now, help me earn the trust of these villagers. Strike down the Black Rook enemies who are terrorizing their citizens.

Objectives.text: 杀掉$1oa个复生的刺客、黑鸦猎隼或复生猎犬。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Risen Assassins, Black Rook Falcons, or Risen Hounds.

identity.title: Root Cause
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Corrupted Root Samples.
identity.description: The massive roots of Shaladrassil are spreading a horrible corruption throughout the forest.$b$bIf we are to save Val'sharah, we will need to find a way to stop the encroachment of the world tree.$b$bIf you bring me enough corrupted root samples, I may be able to discover their secrets.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个腐化根茎样本。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Corrupted Root Samples.

identity.title: Reading the Leaves
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Corrupted Petals.
identity.description: $n, my friend. You must succeed where I have failed. You must find our dear Malfurion.$b$bAs the Nightmare consumes my thoughts, I hear the voices of these twisted trees. I must cling to sanity long enough to aid you.$b$bVenture into Ash'theran and bring me Corrupted Petals from the fallen denizens there.$b$bWith them, I might find your Archdruid while my mind is still my own.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa片腐化花瓣。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Corrupted Petals.

identity.title: Competitive Exorcise
identity.objectives: Kill 15 Burning Legion invaders in 10 minutes or less.
identity.description:
Think you're good at sending demons back to the hell from whence they came? Show me!

I once bagged 15 in under 10 minutes. Do better than that and there'll be brew money waitin' for ya.

identity.title: Black Rook Prison
identity.objectives: Kill Araxxas and collect the Prison Keys.
identity.description: I did not come this far to lose her in the final moments.$B$BMaiev must be in the cells beneath Black Rook Hold.$B$BI scouted above, and the entrance to the prison is guarded by a fearsome jailor.$B$BI will sneak past and take out the guards inside. Defeat Araxxas, take the keys, and then meet me within.

PortraitGiverText.text: 万能钥匙在他手上。
PortraitGiverText.english: He holds the master key.

identity.title: Lieutenant of the Tower
identity.objectives: Kill Desdel Stareye.
identity.description: All of your instincts were correct. Gul'dan raised Lord Ravencrest, and his ghostly army, from beyond the grave. Now, they serve the Legion, protecting secrets within the tower.$B$BAlthough Ravencrest commands from above, Lieutenant Desdel Stareye operates the prisons.$B$BHe tormented me these past few moons, but I did not yield.$B$B<Maiev runs a finger along her curved blade.>$B$BHis life must be ended.

PortraitGiverText.text: 拉文凯斯领主的副官。
PortraitGiverText.english: Second-in-command to Lord Ravencrest.

identity.title: Stop Gul'dan!
identity.objectives: Enter the Vault of the Betrayer, kill Crusher and Sledge, and take their fel power.
identity.description:
After his defeat at the Black Temple, we brought Illidan's lifeless body here, to be interred forever within the Vault of the Wardens.

Gul'dan has found his way through our defenses and is trying to steal the Betrayer's corpse.

Even in death, Illidan's body can be used by the Burning Legion. Gul'dan CANNOT succeed.

PortraitGiverText.text: 尽力阻止他。
PortraitGiverText.english: Stop him if you can.

identity.title: The Keystone
identity.objectives: Kill Brood Queen Tyranna and take the Sargerite Keystone. Then, join the others down-below in the portal chamber.
identity.description:
$n, Brood Queen Tyranna is just ahead in the command chamber. The others already charged in. She has the Sargerite Keystone in her possession.

Finally, the object of all our sacrifice is at hand.

PortraitGiverText.text: 从她的尸体上拿到萨格里特钥石！
PortraitGiverText.english: Take the Sargerite Keystone from her corpse!

identity.title: Before We're Overrun
identity.objectives: Slay Doom Commander Beliash and take his power for your own.
identity.description:
The doomguard commander and his queen must be dealt with. His eredar are summoning in a huge number of reinforcements.

We need to put an end to him before the Legion overruns our new foothold up in the volcano!

As an added benefit, you can steal his demonic power.

PortraitGiverText.text: 燃烧军团的指挥官就在火山下方的低地里。将他的力量占为己有。
PortraitGiverText.english: This is the Legion leader in the lowlands below the volcano. Take his power for youself.

identity.title: Where Respect is Due
identity.objectives: Mine for leystone $1oa times while using Ronos's Glass Pick.
identity.description: Leystone is a sensitive ore. Our smiths can coax great power out of it, but as miners, we must treat it with respect, or else its power will retreat inward.$b$b<The tauren hands you what appears to be a GLASS mining pick.>$b$bThe next time you mine some leystone ore, use this pick. It will break if you strike too hard. THIS is the respect that leystone requires.

Objectives.text: 使用罗诺斯的水晶矿锄对魔石进行$1oa次开采。
Objectives.english: Mine for leystone $1oa times while using Ronos's Glass Pick.

identity.title: Thieving Thistleleaf
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Stolen Lunarwing Eggs in the Lunarwing Shallows.
identity.description: Why the Thistleleaf are collecting the Lunarwing eggs is anyone's guess, but you can be sure it's not to give them a loving home.$b$bSaylanna Riverbreeze will know what to do with these.

Objectives.text: 在月翼浅滩收集$1oa枚失窃的月翼龙蛋。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Stolen Lunarwing Eggs in the Lunarwing Shallows.

identity.title: Not Dead Yet!
identity.objectives: Use the Nitro-Electric Jumpstarter to resurrect 5 Gadgetzan Bruisers.
identity.description: They're not dead yet! A little nitro here, a jolt of electricity there... we can bring 'em back! And then, they can pay me! Whaddya say, $n? Wanna go into business with me?

identity.title: Scouting Report
identity.objectives: Find Goblin Intel from any Steamwheedle Scout in Tanaris.
identity.description:
We were supposed to meet back here, and then sneak back to Gatgetzan. That was hours ago, $n! The others fanned out across all of Tanaris to gather intel.

Anything you can find will help in the defense of Gadgetzan. Keep your eyes open, $n!

identity.title: Tearing down the Legion
identity.objectives: Kill 15 Legion Invaders while piloting a vehicle during a Tanaris invasion.
identity.description:
A piece of paper is tacked to the controls. On it is a tally of demons slain by the previous pilot.

Your ego demands satisfaciton.

identity.title: Rocs vs Eagles
identity.objectives: Save $1oa Captive Great Eagles.
identity.description: High Crawliac has taught her witches how to curse our beloved eagles into the vile rocs you see assaulting the valley.$b$bThere is no way to break this curse once it has taken hold.$b$bWe will take to the skies and do battle with the rocs, but we need your help on the ground.$b$bHead north through Darkfeather Valley and release any eagles that you find.$b$bEvery eagle you save is one less roc we must kill later.

Objectives.text: 解救$1oa只被捕获的巨鹰。
Objectives.english: Save $1oa Captive Great Eagles.

identity.title: The Skyhorn Tribe
identity.objectives: Meet Lasan Skyhorn at Skyhorn.
identity.description: The Skyhorn people are some of the greatest pathfinders and hunters this world has ever known.$b$bThey are a proud people, but should be willing to listen to reason.$b$bIf the roads feel unsafe, you may ask any flight master in Highmountain to fly you there.$b$bPlease, $p, go to their leader Lasan and remind him that only together, we are Highmountain.

Description.text: 天角牛头人是举世闻名的探路者和猎手。$b$b他们是一个骄傲的部族，但应该听得进道理。$b$b如果觉得路途危险的话，至高岭任何一个飞行管理员都能带你飞去那儿。$b$b$p，请你去找到他们的领袖拉善，告诉他我们应该是团结一致的高岭部族。
Description.english: The Skyhorn people are some of the greatest pathfinders and hunters this world has ever known.$b$bThey are a proud people, but should be willing to listen to reason.$b$bIf the roads feel unsafe, you may ask any flight master in Highmountain to fly you there.$b$bPlease, $p, go to their leader Lasan and remind him that only together, we are Highmountain.

identity.title: Ashran Dominance
identity.objectives: Defeat the enemy faction at the event locations in Ashran and slay their leader within their base.
identity.description: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

PortraitGiverText.text: 大元帅泰布雷德是联盟在阿什兰部队的领袖。
PortraitGiverText.english: Grand Marshal Tremblade leads the Alliance forces in Ashran.

identity.title: Continue the Domination
identity.objectives: Defeat the Alliance at the event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
identity.description: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

PortraitGiverText.text: 大元帅泰布雷德是联盟在阿什兰部队的领袖。
PortraitGiverText.english: Grand Marshal Tremblade leads the Alliance forces in Ashran.

identity.title: Ashran Dominance
identity.objectives: Defeat the enemy faction at the event locations in Ashran and slay their leader within their base.
identity.description: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

PortraitGiverText.text: 沃拉斯是部落在阿什兰部队的领袖。
PortraitGiverText.english: Volrath leads the Horde forces in Ashran.

identity.title: Continue the Domination
identity.objectives: Defeat the Horde at all event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
identity.description: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

PortraitGiverText.text: 沃拉斯是部落在阿什兰部队的领袖。
PortraitGiverText.english: Volrath leads the Horde forces in Ashran.

identity.title: Unbearable
identity.objectives: Investigate the Shivering Ashmaw Cub in southern Val'sharah.
identity.description: Not far away, a bear cub looks to be in some distress. Perhaps you should investigate?

identity.title: Sew It Begins
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Shal'dorei Silk. You can find Shal'dorei Silk on humanoids within the Broken Isles, obtain some from a fellow adventurer, or you may visit the Auction House and buy some.
identity.description: Every time Dalaran takes us to a new shore, I get anxious over what types of fabric and cloth we might find below.$b$bThreads imbued with magic? Something demonically-tinged?$b$bUgh, I hope it's not FURS again.$b$bYou're an adventurer... and tailor to boot. Head on down there and see what you can scrounge up!

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa块夏多雷丝绸。你可以通过其他冒险者、拍卖行，或者破碎群岛的人形生物获取夏多雷丝绸。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Shal'dorei Silk. You can find Shal'dorei Silk on humanoids within the Broken Isles, obtain some from a fellow adventurer, or you may visit the Auction House and buy some.

identity.title: Runic Catgut
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa pieces of Runic Catgut.
identity.description: Let me guess... thread troubles? Mm-hm.$bI suspected as much. My people weave sumptuous silks, but those silks can be fickle about the types of thread they'll accept.$b$bShal'dorei silk has a bit of ley energy woven right into it. You need something that's learned to coexist with the ley energies of this land.$b$bI'm talking about owlcats, my good friend! They have what you need. You'll find them amongst the ruins of Llothien.

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa条符文肠线。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa pieces of Runic Catgut.

identity.title: A Needle Need
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Spritethorns.
identity.description: This shop has almost everything we need. Unfortunately, the quality of your sewing needles is lacking.$b$bI do know where you can get better needles. The sprites of Val'sharah are covered with spines which, fortuitously, are perfect for the type of sewing we need.$b$bI hate to be such a prickler stickler, but these needles really will make a difference.

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa份林精棘针。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Spritethorns.

identity.title: Taking Inspiration
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Runed Breeches.
identity.description: I wish I had more patterns to share, but my notebook was lost along with my shop. We'll need to come up with some patterns on our own.$b$bI've been thinking about the leather breeches that the Stormheim vrykul wear. They're certainly much thicker and heavier than anything we could sew, but their embellishing runework is quite impressive.$b$bIf I had a few pairs, perhaps I could re-imagine this runework on a more... refined garment.

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa条符文马裤。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Runed Breeches.

identity.title: The Right Color
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Helsquid Ink.
identity.description: Your assistance, $n, if you have a moment.$b$bI've been attempting to reproduce a pattern for footwear that I spotted a while back, but I'm having trouble getting the right color for my dye. Our black dye is too dark, our blue dye is too bright, and mixing the two doesn't look right.$b$bThe color I'm looking for is more of a squid-ink blue. If, in your travels, you come across any dyes of this color, would you do me the favor of bringing some to me?

Objectives.text: 获得$1oa份冥界鱿鱼墨汁。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Helsquid Ink.

identity.title: Lining Them Up
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Bear Furs.
identity.description: Since you're heading to Azsuna, you may as well gather some lining for our projects.$b$bThe bears of Azsuna are known for how soft, yet durable their fur is.$b$bHunt them in the woods around Llothien and bring their fur back with you.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa张熊皮。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Bear Furs.

identity.title: Proof of Loyalty
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa withered within Suramar.
identity.description: <Tytallo listens as you recount what happened with Lyndras.>$b$bI see. You sound almost... sympathetic to the wretch.$b$bThe nightfallen are liars and thieves. ALL of them. Lyndras included.$b$bI will not tolerate a student that has any respect or sympathy for those... things. And have you witnessed what they turn into at the depths of their depravity?$b$bIf you want to get on my good side, do not return until you are covered in the blood of the withered.

Objectives.text: 在苏拉玛消灭$1oa个枯法者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa withered within Suramar.

identity.title: The Call of Icecrown
identity.objectives: Use your Death Gate ability to travel to Icecrown and obtain the Blades of the Fallen Prince.
identity.description: <A powerful presence again touches your thoughts.>$b$bI have ordered your brethren to Icecrown to prepare for the coming conflict, but I have a more important fate in mind for you. You, $n, will be the hand of our vengeance!$b$bUse the Death Gate to return to Acherus and I shall reveal your role in this.

identity.title: We Don't Need No Library Card
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Tomes of Chaos from bosses in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description: If history is any indication, Gul'dan is training a whole generation of warlocks to marshal against us. If we act fast, we can stem the tide and make things easier on ourselves.$b$bAs you and your fellow heroes venture into the depths of the Hellfire Citadel, seek out Tomes of Chaos from Gul'dan's lieutenants.$b$bThey're dangerous, so don't read any of them. Not even the pictures.$b$b<Khadgar shudders.>$b$bESPECIALLY the pictures.

Objectives.text: 从地狱火堡垒的首领身上收集$oa本混沌魔典。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Tomes of Chaos from bosses in Hellfire Citadel.

identity.title: The Drogbar
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Drogbar in Riverbend.
identity.description: It wasn't enough for Dargrul to just destroy this village. He has also sent his Stoneraiders to take what is left.$b$bPlease champion, prove to my people that you are the hero I foresaw.$b$bSlay enough of these Stoneraiders that it breaks their resolve.

Objectives.text: 在河湾消灭$1oa个卓格巴尔。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Drogbar in Riverbend.

identity.title: Eye On the Prize
identity.objectives: Kill Inquisitor Baleful and take his power.
identity.description:
This demon has proved less than useful. I have been using the Scythe of Souls on it, but so far, it has resisted my inquiries. We will see how long that lasts.

I have a different idea...

There is a fresh inquisitor demon ahead. They are horrific fel casters who see through their floating eyes and specialize in dark pacts. If you steal its power, Jace Darkweaver could use some of it in his ritual to spy on the Legion.

Better yet, you will gain its power by ripping it from its smoking corpse.

PortraitGiverText.text: 夺取他的精华并让自己变得更加强大。
PortraitGiverText.english: Steal his essence and become more powerful.

identity.title: Let's Get To Work
identity.objectives: Meet Solog at the dry docks.
identity.description: Now that the shipyard is complete, we need to get busy making ships!  Solog ran off to the dry docks, why don't you meet him down there?  He said he had a plan.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在干船坞与索洛格碰头。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Solog Roark at the dry docks.

identity.title: Shriek No More
identity.objectives: Find Rotbeak along the Bradensbrook, and collect the beast's head.
identity.description: Papa loved this village. He'd never hear of leaving, even in these dread times.$B$BBefore he died, he told me what attacked him: a monstrous falcon we call Rotbeak.$B$BYou're fighting these undead, aren't you? Will you avenge my father? If so, you can find the beast northwest of here, patrolling our western route to the sea.

identity.title: No Time to Talk
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Enraged Ambershard.
identity.description: Dargrul has sent his pets to do battle with us.$b$bWe need to crush these elementals before their rage swarms into Thunder Totem.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个暴怒的琥珀碎片。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Enraged Ambershard.

identity.title: Wrathshard
identity.objectives: Slay Wrathshard.
identity.description: The Underking has used the Hammer of Khaz'goroth to render the mountainside into a weapon against us. The hammer is a tool for creation, not a weapon for his amusement!$b$bEven now, his crystal servant, Wrathshard, is driving these elementals out of the mountain down upon my people.$b$bWe must hold the bridge against this onslaught.$b$bEnter the cave, find Wrathshard, and send him back to his master in pieces.

PortraitGiverText.text: 受卓格巴尔召唤前来摧毁雷霆图腾。
PortraitGiverText.english: Summoned by the drogbar to destroy Thunder Totem.

identity.title: Moose on the Loose
identity.objectives: Collect the antlers of the cursed ancient spirit, Morashu.
identity.description:
There's been chatter around the hunters' lodge about a crazed moose that is terrorizing the basin. 

I've never laid eyes on the beast myself, but they say its antlers are illuminated with magic. 

Where other lesser hunters have tried and failed, you will prevail, and collect me a one-of-a-kind trophy!

identity.title: Pits of Mannoroth
identity.objectives: Defeat Kormrok in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
In the Hellfire Citadel, they work to corrupt a magnaron with fel energy within the Pits of Mannoroth.

If you delve into the fel pools of that place, be on your guard.

identity.title: Maw of Souls
identity.objectives: Defeat Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
Falling into the heart of the mausoleum in Auchindoun, Teron'gor gorged upon hundreds of draenei souls, becoming a bloated abomination in the process. 

No longer recognizable as an orc, Teron'gor gave up his old name and has taken on the mantle of Gorefiend.

identity.title: Temple of Tyranny
identity.objectives: Defeat Tyrant Velhari in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
Tyrant Velhari was once a promising vindicator, but has turned to Shadow for reasons known only to her.

Purge this Eredar of darkness.

identity.title: Destructor's Rise
identity.objectives: Defeat Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
We believed we were done with Mannoroth, at least for a time. But Gul'dan is more powerful than we had predicted.

Mannoroth is nearly back in this world. His bones have been seen within the citadel, and he must be destroyed before he can reach his full power.
