identity.title: The Black Gate
identity.objectives: Defeat Archimonde in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
We have heard rumors that one of the strongest of the eredar could soon enter this world through the Black Gate.

If these rumors are to be believed, it could even be Archimonde the Defiler. Should he arrive uncontested, Draenor itself is likely to fall.

identity.title: Let's Get To Work
identity.objectives: Meet Solog at the dry docks.
identity.description: Now that the shipyard is complete, we need to get busy making ships!  Solog ran off to the dry docks, why don't you meet him down there?  He said he had a plan.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在干船坞与索洛格碰头。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Solog Roark at the dry docks.

identity.title: Pits of Mannoroth
identity.objectives: Defeat Kormrok in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
In the Hellfire Citadel, they're corruptin' a magnaron with fel energy in the Pits o' Mannoroth.

If ye delve into the fel pools of that place, be on yer guard.

identity.title: Maw of Souls
identity.objectives: Defeat Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
Falling into the heart o' the mausoleum in Auchindoun, Teron'gor gorged upon hundreds o' draenei souls, becoming a bloated abomination in the process. 

No longer recognizable as an orc, Teron'gor gave up his old name and has taken on the mantle of Gorefiend.

identity.title: Temple of Tyranny
identity.objectives: Defeat Tyrant Velhari in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
Tyrant Velhari was once a promising vindicator, but has turned to Shadow for reasons known only to her.

Purge this Eredar of darkness.

identity.title: Destructor's Rise
identity.objectives: Defeat Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
We believed we were done with Mannoroth, at least for a time. But Gul'dan is more powerful than we thought.

Mannoroth is nearly back in this world. His bones have been seen within the citadel, and he must be destroyed before he can reach his full power.

identity.title: The Black Gate
identity.objectives: Defeat Archimonde in Hellfire Citadel.
identity.description:
We've heard rumors that one o' the strongest eredar might enter this world through the Black Gate soon.

If these rumors are to be believed, it could even be Archimonde the Defiler. If he arrives unchallenged, Draenor itself is likely to fall.

Title.text: 额外目标：阿什兰挖掘场

identity.title: Strange Tools
identity.objectives: Speak with Yanas Seastrike at the dry docks.
identity.description: We are well on our way to building our first ship, but unfortunately, I am not the orc for the job.  I have no idea how to work with these human tools.  Your shipwright, Yanas Seastrike, is going to take over from here on out.$b$bI will be here at the dry docks if you need anything from me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在干船坞与亚纳斯·蹈海谈谈。他的造船功夫远近闻名。
PortraitGiverText.english: Speak with Yanas Seastrike at the dry docks.  His shipbuilding work is renowned.

identity.title: The Witchqueen
identity.objectives: Slay High Crawliac, the Witchqueen.
identity.description: The time has come to assault High Crawliac, the Witchqueen.$b$BYou should know that one does not become queen of the harpies through kindness.$b$bThis creature has killed, betrayed, and tormented countless tauren, harpies, kobolds, and anything else she had to in order to secure her position as queen.$b$bCome, friend, let us finish this.

PortraitGiverText.text: 鹰身人女王。
PortraitGiverText.english: Queen of the harpies.

identity.title: Lining the Crucible
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Blood of Sargeras, $2oa Felhide, $3oa Felwort, and $4oa Yseralline Seeds.
identity.description: The first step in making this crucible useful is to restore the lining of its interior. That's going to require supplies you'll either gather yourself or obtain through trade with fellow adventurers.$b$bFelwort and yseralline seeds are familiar to herbalists.$b$bFelhide is obtained through skinning.$b$bBlood of Sargeras can be found all over the Broken Isles.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份萨格拉斯之血，$2oa张魔皮，$3oa个邪能球茎，以及$4oa颗伊瑟拉莱之种。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Blood of Sargeras, $2oa Felhide, $3oa Felwort, and $4oa Yseralline Seeds.

identity.title: Vault of the Wardens: Demon's Bile
identity.objectives: Craft a Skaggldrynk, then go to the Vault of the Wardens and bathe the crucible in the bile of Grimoira.
identity.description: The key to a crucible like this is that it must be bathed in the foulest of fel energy. I hate to say it, but the most efficient method of accomplishing such a feat is to subject it to the bile of a demon.$b$bYes, I said the bile of a demon. Ready to get to work?$b$bIn the Vault of the Wardens, such a demon exists. An imp mother by the name of Grimoira.  The door to her room is sealed by an invisible lock.$b$bI'd suggest bringing some Skaggldrynk with you. Use it when you get to her door.

PortraitGiverText.text: 务必带上一些隐形饮剂，以便进入她的房间。
PortraitGiverText.english: Make sure to bring some skaggldrynk to get into her room.

identity.title: The Price of the Black Market
identity.objectives: Collect a Silver Hair of Khadgar, a Blood of Sargeras, $3oa Kaldorei Ginger Wine and $4oa Moist Azsunian Feta.
identity.description: I may have what you're looking for, burettes you say? Not a very common item.$b$bFor that, I require a moderate favor. Nothing too big, just a few things really.$b$bA silver hair from a high-ranking archmage... the blood of a titan, and, oh... some wine and cheese.$b$bWhat?! I have appetites that need satiating.

Objectives.text: 取得卡德加的银发，1份萨格拉斯之血，$3oa份卡多雷姜酒，以及$4oa份阿苏纳湿乳酪。
Objectives.english: Collect a Silver Hair of Khadgar, a Blood of Sargeras, $3oa Kaldorei Ginger Wine and $4oa Moist Azsunian Feta.

identity.title: Wisp in the Willows
identity.objectives: Guide the Wisp through the Hidden Pools to grow $2oa trees.
identity.description: Wisps are the spirits of our night elven brethren who have become one with the forest. But their minds and the way they perceive things are very different than in life.$b$bYou should bond with this little one. See through its eyes as it travels to the hidden pools and grows some trees.

Objectives.text: 引导小精灵穿过隐秘之池并种下$2oa棵树木。
Objectives.english: Guide the Wisp through the Hidden Pools to grow $2oa trees.

identity.title: Witch of the Wood
identity.objectives: Defeat the Witch of the Wood.
identity.description:
You saved me at Riverbend not long ago. It is the reason I vouched for you as emissary to this tribe, and the only reason you're alive here now. I consider my debt to you paid.

You must prove yourself to the Bloodtotem chieftain before he will speak with you.

Within the forest is the Witch of the Wood, a harpy mother who recently descended into this territory. If you are able to defeat her and show her carcass to the Bloodtotem, they might allow you an audience with Torok.

identity.title: Hags of a Feather
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Hag Feathers from Witchwood Hags in the Witchwood.
identity.description:
The drogbar you freed me from were unusually aggressive. The tribe in the nearby caves seems to be apart from the rest of them, but that didn't stop the Bloodtotem from going on the offensive just in case, capturing some of their number.

That move left the woods exposed to the harpies, however. Your help dealing with these witches would not go unnoticed by Torok. Bring back their feathers as proof of death.

Objectives.text: 从巫林女巫身上收集$1oa片女巫之羽。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Hag Feathers from Witchwood Hags in the Witchwood.

identity.title: Dishonored
identity.objectives: Slay Xandris the Dishonored.
identity.description: Xandris the Dishonored was among the first to betray his brethren and accept the curse of Xavius.$B$BDuring the great war, it was he who led the slaughter of many of my dearest friends.$b$bThe last time I met him on the battlefield he fled. Help me to finally dispense justice on this foul being.

identity.title: The Corruptor
identity.objectives: Slay Kagraxxis the Corruptor.
identity.description: Xandris has been slain, but there are others that must be dealt with if my grove is to be saved.$b$bDuring the great war, Kagraxxis took great pleasure in corrupting the lands he once called home.$b$bWere it not for the foolish mercy of my fellow druids, I would have slain him myself.$b$bFind the demon and bring justice upon him.$b$bI must entrust this task to you alone, for I sense an even darker presence here... one that requires my personal attention.

identity.title: Bear Huntin'
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Bristlefur Pelts within the Fields of An'she.
identity.description:
They say a single hair from the back of a bristlefur bear is sharp enough to cut a dwarf's beard. But if the fur doesn't kill ya, the maul will.

Some lesser hunters have been a meal for those bears. 

Show me you're more than a snack and bring me back a few of those bristlefur pelts.

Objectives.text: 在安瑟平原收集$1oa块蓟鬃熊皮。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Bristlefur Pelts within the Fields of An'she.

identity.title: Hex-a-Gone
identity.objectives: Slay Hexweaver Akara.
identity.description:
The harpies are relentless in their pursuit to control the basin. They are able to craft bags of foul magic as quickly as we can destroy them.

The Skyhorn cannot gain the upper hand as long as their hexweaver lives. She must be stopped.

identity.title: Shipyard Report
identity.objectives: Return to your shipyard in Lunarfall.
identity.description: Commander!  We have received reports from the shipyard that things are getting serious.  Can you head back to Lunarfall and check in with Merreck?  Every ship we build gives us another advantage over Gul'dan's new Horde.

PortraitGiverText.text: 返回你的船坞，并与梅里克会面。
PortraitGiverText.english: Return to your shipyard and meet with Merreck.

identity.title: Shipyard Report
identity.objectives: Return to your shipyard in Frostwall.
identity.description: Commander!  We have received reports from the shipyard that things are getting serious.  Can you head back to Frostwall and check in with Rolosh?  Every ship we build gives us another advantage over Gul'dan's new Horde.

PortraitGiverText.text: 返回你的船坞，并与若洛什会面。
PortraitGiverText.english: Return to your shipyard and meet with Rolash.

identity.title: Blood Debt
identity.objectives: Defeat Torok Bloodtotem at Torok's Bluff.
identity.description:
You have proven a much greater ally than the Bloodtotem ever were. With my focus crystal, my wounds are healed. I fear Frag was too far gone to revive.

Torok and his Bloodtotem will suffer for what they have done to us. Let's pay them a visit before they can mount an attack against the cave of my people.

identity.title: Assaulting the Haglands
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Crawliac Harpies and $2oa Skywhisker Loyalists in the Haglands.
identity.description: Proceed on foot into the Haglands and slay any harpies you find.$b$bQuell their numbers!$b$bWe will provide air support and force your prey to the ground where you can deal with them.$b$bShow these witches the fury of your... well... your "you."

Objectives.text: 在女巫秘地消灭$1oa个紫喉鹰身人和$2oa个天须死忠者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Crawliac Harpies and $2oa Skywhisker Loyalists in the Haglands.

identity.title: Unseen Influence
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Fel-Corrupted Apexis Fragments from any Treasure or from any Rare or Rare Elite creature in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: The corruption in the Apexis has begun to affect many of my people. We are so accustomed to the power it grants us that more succumb to the whispers every day. You must bring me more samples so I can free my people from yet another curse.

Objectives.text: 从塔纳安丛林的任意宝藏、稀有生物或稀有精英生物身上收集$oa枚被邪能腐蚀的埃匹希斯碎片。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Fel-Corrupted Apexis Fragments from any Treasure or from any Rare or Rare Elite creature in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Deep in the Cavern
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa murlocs in Stonedark Cavern.
identity.description:
We're getting tired of those murlocs. They skitter around the cavern like they own it. They stole some of our most precious relics and got their fishy fins all over them. 

Kill a few of them so they know they don't run things around here.

Objectives.text: 在黯石洞穴消灭$1oa个鱼人。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa murlocs in Stonedark Cavern.

identity.title: Guhruhlruhlruh
identity.objectives: Defeat Guhruhlruhlruh.
identity.description:
The murlocs are usually pretty scared of us, but some bigger one led them into our cavern and they're getting too brave.

Kill their leader. I think its name is something like "Guhruhlruhlruh."

PortraitGiverText.text: 咕咕噜咕噜噜咕噜！噜咕咕咕！
PortraitGiverText.english: Ruhrul gulul gruhhln! Lulhulghnnn!

identity.title: Crystal Fury
identity.objectives: Slay Gelmogg.
identity.description:
A drogbar stonecaster known as Gelmogg entered our sacred water caverns and aims to draw its power into himself.

We must destroy him before he gets too powerful.

He is in the upper caverns.

identity.title: Balance of Elements
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Empowered Crystals.
identity.description:
The drogbar place their foul crystals in our cave to absorb the magic within, and then they collect them when they are saturated with power.

We must recover the crystals so the magic might dissipate and be suffused back into the waters, or else the drogbar will find ways to corrupt the magic to their own purposes.

Objectives.text: 找回$1oa个强能水晶。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Empowered Crystals.

identity.title: Invading Spelunkers
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Drogbar Manathirsters or Violent Crageaters.
identity.description:
The drogbar and their earthen furies have overrun the cavern. They're perverting the magic within and destroying the elementals that have forever dwelled in this place.

Let's work together to remove them from this sacred cave.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个卓格巴尔嗜魔者或凶猛的食岩元素。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Drogbar Manathirsters or Violent Crageaters.

identity.title: Infestation
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Diseased Grubs and $2oa Overgrown Larva at Earthmother's Bounty.
identity.description:
Those bugs are destroying our crops and attack any of us who get near them.

Would you exterminate some of those vile creatures?

Objectives.text: 在大地母亲之赐杀掉$1oa条生病的幼虫和$2oa条过度生长的幼虫。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Diseased Grubs and $2oa Overgrown Larva at Earthmother's Bounty.

identity.title: Ormgul the Pestilent
identity.objectives: Slay Ormgul the Pestilent and acquire his Bug Sprayer.
identity.description:
We've lived at peace with the drogbar for years--our tribe even more than the others. But we were betrayed in our last trade with them at Riverbend.

They usually supply us with potent alchemy to prevent insects from infesting our fields. This time, led by Ormgul, they have attacked the crops that sustain us all.

Ormgul the Pestilent is the one who brought the infection to our farmland. Destroy him, and bring me whatever he uses to attract the bugs to our land.

identity.title: Hidden No More
identity.objectives: Kill Fel Lord Caza and take his fel power.
identity.description:
Now that you've uncovered the demons, I can sense them, too. Specifically, I sense a very powerful fel lord deeper in the cave. You need to grab his power while you still can.

If you can deal with their leader, we will take care of the rest of his forces in that cave.

PortraitGiverText.text: 获取他的力量，避免伊利达雷据点的部队遭受伏击。
PortraitGiverText.english: Take his power and keep your army at the Illidari Foothold from being ambushed.

identity.title: The Flow of the River
identity.objectives: Meet with Angler Creel in Whitewater Wash.
identity.description:
We can leave Farmer Maya in charge of the farmland now that the greatest threat has been reduced.

But we aren't out of hot water just yet, $n. The fisheries are just as important as our fields, and they are in even greater danger than the farm if what Angler Creel says is true.

identity.title: Bloodied Blades of Zeth'Gol
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Bleeding Hollow Ritual Blades from Bleeding Hollow orcs in Zeth'Gol.
identity.description: Them Bleeding Hollow orcs do blood magic - like voodoo but it hurt more. They cut their own flesh. Most of 'em carry curved ritual blades for carvin' themselves up.$b$bBring me them blades, commander. We can turn their power against 'em.

Objectives.text: 从泽斯高的血环氏族兽人身上收集$oa柄血环仪祭之刃。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Bleeding Hollow Ritual Blades from Bleeding Hollow orcs in Zeth'Gol.

identity.title: A Little Wetwork
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Iron Horde Naval Manifests from forces in Ironhold Harbor.
identity.description: What be left of the Iron Horde is comin' to Tanaan through Ironhold Harbor. If we knew who was comin' and when, we could use our shipyard to cause some chaos.$b$bGo to Ironhold Harbor and fish up some intelligence!

Objectives.text: 在铁城港的士兵身上收集$oa张钢铁部落海军机要。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Iron Horde Naval Manifests from forces in Ironhold Harbor.

identity.title: Blood of Fallen Brothers
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Vials of Fel Blood from fel orcs throughout Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Orcs that drink Gul'dan's poison turn into fel beasts. Soulless savages.$b$bLady Liadrin an' the Blood Knights think maybe there be a way back. They be wantin' samples of blood from freshly turned orcs. Get their blood, $n!$b$bYou be findin' fel orcs all over Tanaan, but the Iron Front, the Fel Forge, and the Throne of Kil'jaeden is where you find the most.

Objectives.text: 在塔纳安丛林的邪兽人身上收集$oa个魔血之瓶。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Vials of Fel Blood from fel orcs throughout Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Secrets of the Shadow Council
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Shadow Council Missives from shadow council representatives in the Ruins of Kra'nak or the Throne of Kil'jaeden.
identity.description: Gul'dan be growin' his Shadow Council like a spider spin a web. But some of this new blood, they not so smart. They write down the secrets but don't burn 'em.$b$bCatch his minions out in the open and bring their secrets back to me! You find them workin' with the arakkoa in da Ruins of Kra'nak or atop the Throne of Kil'jaeden.

Objectives.text: 从卡纳克废墟或基尔加丹王座的暗影议会代表身上搜集$oa封暗影议会密函。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Shadow Council Missives from shadow council representatives in the Ruins of Kra'nak or the Throne of Kil'jaeden.

identity.title: Disarming Sha'naar
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Unrefined Draenic Crystals from the mines located within the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Draenei at the Temple of Sha'naar would mine these mountains for perfect crystals used to channel their magics. Now demons be lootin' the place. We gotta keep those crystals out of demonic hands, commander!$b$bAttack the mines behind the temple and grab them crystals.

Objectives.text: 从塔纳安丛林的沙纳尔神殿后面的矿井中收集$oa块德拉诺水晶原石。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Unrefined Draenic Crystals from the mines located within the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
identity.objectives: Slay $oa demons in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Look to the north, $c. The sky is turning a sickly green. Gul'dan's summoning portals are not yet at full strength, but already the stench of demon is on the wind.$b$bSlay them, $n. Destroy as many beasts as you can before they find a way to Azeroth. The Temple of Sha'naar is infested, as is the Throne of Kil'jaeden, although you may find others wandering about the jungle.

Objectives.text: 在塔纳安丛林击杀$oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Slay $oa demons in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Wrath of Azshara Heroic Reward Quest

Title.english: Wrath of Azshara Heroic Reward Quest

identity.title: Tooth and Claw
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Tanaan Jungle Teeth from the various wildlife within Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Beyond the meager shelter of these fortress walls, the jungle closes in. Can you feel it? That is the untamed wilderness, $c, calling forth our primal instincts. There is no better way to feel alive than to court death.$b$bJoin me in the hunt, $n! Collect teeth from the wild beasts. The ravagers in Thornmire, the raptors in Zorammarsh - even the sea creatures along the strand and the little podling plants themselves all have teeth. Bring them to me!

Objectives.text: 从塔纳安丛林的各种野生动物身上搜集$oa枚塔纳安丛林利齿。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Tanaan Jungle Teeth from the various wildlife within Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
identity.objectives: Slay $oa Iron Horde orcs in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Ever since the fall of Blackrock Foundry, Gul'dan has been turning the Iron Horde into... something worse. The orcs who once flocked to Grommash's banner, through either fear or thirst for revenge, are now embracing the fel.$b$bWade into the battlefields of Tanaan and lay waste to Gul'dan's forces. Orc or fel orc makes no difference. Gut what remains of the Iron Horde!

Objectives.text: 在塔纳安丛林击杀$oa名钢铁部落兽人。
Objectives.english: Slay $oa Iron Horde orcs in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Bloodied Blades of Zeth'Gol
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Bleeding Hollow Ritual Blades from Bleeding Hollow orcs in Zeth'Gol.
identity.description: The Bleeding Hollow clan is infamous for their blood rituals. The brutes carve sigils into their flesh and create potions from the blood of their strongest warriors.$b$bThe curved ceremonial blades they use have a power all their own. Gather some of these for me. We will deprive them of these weapons and learn something about our enemy at the same time.

Objectives.text: 从泽斯高的血环氏族兽人身上收集$oa柄血环仪祭之刃。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Bleeding Hollow Ritual Blades from Bleeding Hollow orcs in Zeth'Gol.

identity.title: A Little Wetwork
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Iron Horde Naval Manifests from forces in Ironhold Harbor.
identity.description: The shattered remnants of the Iron Horde pour into Tanaan through Ironhold Harbor. If we knew more about their fleet we could dispatch countermeasures from your shipyard in Shadowmoon.$b$bPerhaps you could gather some naval intelligence for our cause?

Objectives.text: 在铁城港的士兵身上收集$oa张钢铁部落海军机要。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Iron Horde Naval Manifests from forces in Ironhold Harbor.

identity.title: Breaking Their Fel Bonds
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Vials of Fel Blood from fel orcs throughout Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Gul'dan's fel poison turns already ferocious orcs into hateful, vicious creatures with no soul. But were he here to guide us, Prophet Velen wouldn't give up on the whole race. If you could find samples of their blood, maybe we can reverse the process?$b$bYou'll find fel orcs all over Tanaan, but the Iron Front, the Fel Forge, and the Throne of Kil'jaeden are the most densely populated.

Objectives.text: 在塔纳安丛林的邪兽人身上收集$oa个魔血之瓶。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Vials of Fel Blood from fel orcs throughout Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Secrets of the Shadow Council
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Shadow Council Missives from Shadow Council representatives in the Ruins of Kra'nak or the Throne of Kil'jaeden.
identity.description: Gul'dan has been building a spy network for himself - the so-called "Shadow Council". As they struggle to control Tanaan, the Shadow Council has grown careless. Their members are out in the open, recruiting arakkoa at the Ruins of Kra'nak or summoning demons at the Throne of Kil'jaeden.$b$bFind members of the Shadow Council and acquire any intelligence they were foolish enough not to destroy!

Objectives.text: 从卡纳克废墟或基尔加丹王座的暗影议会代表身上搜集$oa封暗影议会密函。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Shadow Council Missives from Shadow Council representatives in the Ruins of Kra'nak or the Throne of Kil'jaeden.

identity.title: Disarming Sha'naar
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Unrefined Draenic Crystals from the mines located within the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Draenei at the Temple of Sha'naar would mine these mountains for perfect crystals to power our arcane devices. Sadly, the temple is lost to us - we have been betrayed by the Sargerei.$b$b$n, it is imperative that you venture into those mines and secure those crystals before the Sargerei use them in their demonic rituals. If you must kill our former brothers and sisters, so be it.

Objectives.text: 从塔纳安丛林的沙纳尔神殿后面的矿井中收集$oa块德拉诺水晶原石。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Unrefined Draenic Crystals from the mines located within the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
identity.objectives: Slay $oa demons in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Demons! Hate 'em!$b$bGul'dan is spinning up more summoning portals with each passing hour. There's only one way to stem the tide, $n.$b$b<Parvink smashes her gauntleted fist against her open palm.>$b$bSmash 'em!$b$bThe Temple of Sha'naar is a good place to start, or head up to the Throne of Kil'jaeden if you're looking for a real challenge.

Objectives.text: 在塔纳安丛林击杀$oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Slay $oa demons in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Tooth and Claw
identity.objectives: Collect $oa Tanaan Jungle Teeth from the various wildlife within Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: These wimps lugging wood around the jungle keep talking about how dangerous it is. You know, between the ravager den to the south or the raptors that stalk Zorammarsh - hey, even the beach creatures or podlings have teeth!$b$bWhat do you say you and I do a little hunting? Collect teeth from wild beasts. The bigger the beast, the more teeth. Meet me back here and we'll compare our haul!

Objectives.text: 从塔纳安丛林的各种野生动物身上搜集$oa枚塔纳安丛林利齿。
Objectives.english: Collect $oa Tanaan Jungle Teeth from the various wildlife within Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
identity.objectives: Slay $oa Iron Horde orcs in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: Ever since we humiliated 'em at Blackrock Foundry, the Iron Horde has been on the run. Gul'dan is converting them all into fel orcs, but I ain't scared. A bloodlusting orc is twice as strong but twice as stupid.$b$bHey! Let's wade into the battlefields of Tanaan and lay waste to as many orcs as we can. Orc or fel orc - doesn't matter to me.

Objectives.text: 在塔纳安丛林击杀$oa名钢铁部落兽人。
Objectives.english: Slay $oa Iron Horde orcs in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: They Will Pay With Blood
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Feltotem Tauren.
identity.description:
The tauren go too far. I did not escape their outpost for fear that they would attack the cave and slaughter my people.

It looks like they planned to do it all along. Slay some of the Feltotem. Thin the herd.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个邪能图腾牛头人。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Feltotem Tauren.

identity.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
identity.objectives: Meet Vindicator Krethos at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description:
Commander, we must expand our fleet if we hope to stand a chance against the Iron Horde.

We have heard reports from Tanaan that a new Alliance faction can supply us with the plans to build battleships.  Head out there as soon as you can and investigate!

PortraitGiverText.text: 在塔纳安的雄狮岗哨找到守备官科索斯。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Vindicator Krethos at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
identity.objectives: Meet Shadow Hunter Denjai at Vol'mar in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description:
Commander, we must expand our fleet if we hope to stand a chance against the Iron Horde.

We have heard reports from Tanaan that a new Horde faction can supply us with the plans to build battleships.  Head out there as soon as you can and investigate!

PortraitGiverText.text: 在塔纳安的沃玛尔找到暗影猎手德恩加。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Shadow Hunter Denjai at Vol'mar in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Fish Out of Water
identity.objectives: Return $1oa Whitewater Carp to the river.
identity.description:
The drogbar are on a rampage! They're smashing everything they can find and are throwing fish to the shore.

Worst of all, it is the wrong time to harvest fish. They must be returned to the waters so they can breed.

Objectives.text: 把$1oa条白水鲤鱼放回河里。
Objectives.english: Return $1oa Whitewater Carp to the river.

identity.title: Equipping Our Fleet
identity.objectives: Meet Salty Jorren at the docks.
identity.description: Commander, our fleet is going to require some custom naval equipment if we hope to stand a chance in this war.  Find Salty Jorren down at the docks, he should be able to help us out.

PortraitGiverText.text: 前往码头找到“老水手”乔伦。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Salty Jorren on the docks.

identity.title: If At First You Fail, Try Again!
identity.objectives: Meet Solog Roark at the dry docks and build another Destroyer.  Once the Destroyer is complete, send it on a new mission.
identity.description:
Looks like that Submarine had a bit more firepower than we thought!  They used First Strike to hit us before we even saw it coming.

Losing ships is a part of naval battles, Commander.  Luckily, we were prepared for this exact sort of situation.  Speak with Solog down at the dry docks, he should be able to help us quickly produce another Destroyer.  Head back here when the ship is complete, we will have a new mission ready for you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在干船坞与索洛格碰头。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Solog Roark at the dry docks.

identity.title: Equipping Our Fleet
identity.objectives: Meet Kronk Rustspark at the docks.
identity.description: Commander, our fleet is going to require some custom naval equipment if we hope to stand a chance in this war.  Find Kronk Rustspark down at the docks, he should be able to help us out.

PortraitGiverText.text: 在干船坞与库隆克·锈火碰头。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Kronk Rustspark at the dry docks.

identity.title: Forged in Fire
identity.objectives: Kill Immolanth and take his power.
identity.description:
The fearsome demon, Immolanth, led a Legion army that conquered and eventually ruled a distant nexus world. 

Somehow, the Wardens imprisoned him, then kept him locked up in the chamber to our left. He is contained, but not for long.

The demon's power is a valuable prize to any demon hunter who can defeat him. Whoever can do so will gain power beyond imagining.

I believe that person could be you, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 伊莫拉斯充斥着凝聚的纯粹邪能。
PortraitGiverText.english: Immolanth is full of pure, coalesced fel power.

identity.title: Between Us and Freedom
identity.objectives: Kill Bastillax and take his power.
identity.description:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他守卫着地窟出口。
PortraitGiverText.english: He guards the vault exit.

identity.title: The Call of War
identity.objectives: Speak to Jace Darkweaver in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: Welcome to Stormwind, the heart of the human kingdom. But today, sorrow grips this bastion of the Light.$b$bKing Varian Wrynn has fallen in battle, leaving the crown to his son Anduin.$B$BThe leaders of the Alliance have gathered to pay their respects. No doubt they will have need of your unique skills.$b$bYou will find the king upon the throne of Stormwind Keep, attended by one of your fellow Illidari. I am needed in Dalaran.$b$bGood luck, $p.

Description.text: 欢迎来到暴风城，这里是人类王国的心脏。不过，这座圣光之城现在被悲伤所笼罩。$b$b瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王战死沙场，留下了他的儿子安度因继承大统。$B$B联盟的领袖们在这里汇聚，祭奠英雄的离去。$b$b毫无疑问，你的特殊能力不可或缺。$b$b你可以在暴风要塞的王座厅找到新任国王，他身边有你的一位伊利达雷同伴。我得去达拉然一趟。$b$b祝你好运，$p。
Description.english: Welcome to Stormwind, the heart of the human kingdom. But today, sorrow grips this bastion of the Light.$b$bKing Varian Wrynn has fallen in battle, leaving the crown to his son Anduin.$B$BThe leaders of the Alliance have gathered to pay their respects. No doubt they will have need of your unique skills.$b$bYou will find the king upon the throne of Stormwind Keep, attended by one of your fellow Illidari. I am needed in Dalaran.$b$bGood luck, $p.

identity.title: Between Us and Freedom
identity.objectives: Kill Bastillax and take his power.
identity.description:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他守卫着地窟出口。
PortraitGiverText.english: He guards the vault exit.

identity.title: Ironhorn Leysmithing
identity.objectives: Gather scrap metal around the Ironhorn Enclave. Then use the Greenhoof's Anvil and Forge to craft a Scrapmetal Handguard, a Scrapmetal Palmplate, a Scrapmetal Cuffplate, and $4oa Scrapmetal Fingerplates.
identity.description: I sense great strength in you, yet you refuse to wield it. We Ironhorn use double the metal of any normal blacksmith to craft our wares.$b$bThere is also a technique in how you hammer such quantities of leystone that I will instruct you on.$b$bUse our scrap metal and hammer out the pieces for a gauntlet. I will weld the pieces together when you are finished.

Objectives.text: 在铁角飞地附近收集金属废料，然后使用绿蹄的铁砧和熔炉制作废金护手、废金护掌、废金腕甲，以及$4oa个废金护指。
Objectives.english: Gather scrap metal around the Ironhorn Enclave. Then use the Greenhoof's Anvil and Forge to craft a Scrapmetal Handguard, a Scrapmetal Palmplate, a Scrapmetal Cuffplate, and $4oa Scrapmetal Fingerplates.

identity.title: Smashing Squashlings
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Growing Squashlings.
identity.description: The Bonefleet once raided trading ships traveling the waters of Draenor. One such ship carried farming supplies intended for Elodor.$B$BNow, they use these supplies to sow their plague into our earth. From the putrid mounds sprout vegetative horrors. These abominations must be destroyed, before they can spread across the landscape.

identity.title: Paradise Lost
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
identity.description: Archmage Khadgar was planning an expedition to Azsuna - you should seek him out at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran immediately.

PortraitGiverName.text: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

identity.title: Mutiny on the Boneship
identity.objectives: Kill Bonerender.
identity.description: Each year, around this time, there is a strange surge of spiritual energy across Draenor. Beckoned by this phenomenon, a ghastly fleet of undead pirates emerges from the mist. We call it the Bonefleet.$B$BThe Bonefleet is led by a savage pirate known as Bonerender. He seeks nothing more than the complete destruction of all of the living of Draenor.$B$BSeek out Bonerender and defeat him, before he sails back into the mist once again.

identity.title: Foul Fertilizer
identity.objectives: Destroy 8 kegs of Dread Fertilizer.
identity.description: The Bonefleet wants nothing more than to spread their undead curse onto dry land. Like a sickness, it will slowly overtake the landscape if left unchecked.$B$BThe stench of undeath permeates the barrels of fertilizer they use to sow their dread crops. They are the source of the spreading plague, and must be destroyed.

identity.title: Culling the Crew
identity.objectives: Destroy 12 Boneship crew members.
identity.description: If we're going to protect Draenor from the Bonefleet menace, we'll need to thin out the crew.$B$BSee to a swift reduction in their numbers, and we might just push them back into the sea for another year.

identity.title: ...And the Anvil
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Black Rook Breastplates from the elves of Black Rook Hold.
identity.description: If you truly wish to see my work then you'll have to go and retrieve it as my shop has been raided of everything I've made.$b$bThe breastplates of the Black Rook soldiers were one of my greatest accomplishments. They're light, yet strong and offer great mobility$b$bRelinquish my cursed brethren of their breastplates and bring them back to me. I will explain the finer points of how I made them upon your return.

Objectives.text: 从黑鸦堡垒的精灵身上取得$1oa件黑鸦胸甲。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Black Rook Breastplates from the elves of Black Rook Hold.

identity.title: The Lone Mountain
identity.objectives: Speak to Warbrave Oro at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
identity.description: Our sources tell us that a Highmountain tauren emissary has recently arrived in Dalaran. We don't know his intentions, but his people could be an invaluable contact in the region.$B$BKhadgar is greeting the emissary at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran - you should seek him out.

PortraitGiverName.text: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

identity.title: Stormheim
identity.objectives: Speak to Sky Admiral Rogers at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
identity.description: Sky Admiral Rogers has sent word for you to meet her in Dalaran.$B$BShe should be waiting for you in the Violet Citadel. It sounded important.

PortraitGiverName.text: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

identity.title: For Whom the Fel Tolls
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Fel Energy Cores from Wyrmtongue Minions in Suramar. Bring them back to Matthew in Dalaran when you are finished.
identity.description: <Matthew eyes you up and down, growling slightly>$b$bYou wish me to help you understand this rock? First you do something for me.$b$bThe legion has brought many of its fel machines to conquer this world. Those machines are powered by cores filled with fel energy. And those cores are carried by the lowliest of their minions for distribution.$b$bBring me some cores and I'll give you the information you need.

Objectives.text: 从苏拉玛的虫语爪牙身上取得$1oa个邪能之核。完成以后，把它们交给达拉然的马修。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Fel Energy Cores from Wyrmtongue Minions in Suramar. Bring them back to Matthew in Dalaran when you are finished.

identity.title: Wax On, Wax Off
identity.objectives: Recover the Skull of Bossing Around from the Bluewax Skullcaptain.
identity.description:
I've been dead for centuries without having my grave so disturbed... The leader of the local kobolds has stolen my skull from my grave and wears it upon his head!

He's down in the cave below, but a gate blocks your path from retrieving it directly. Kobolds know their leadership by the skulls they wear, and they are unintelligent enough to believe you their leader if you have one yourself.

Kill one of their Skullcaptains and recover his Skull of Bossing Around, and they may let you into the cave.

identity.title: Candle to the Grave
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Bluewax Graverobbers.
identity.description:
These kobolds are taking advantage of the attacks against the Skyhorn tribe. They disturb our graves and steal anything they can get their paws on.

I can do nothing to stop them! Please rid this sacred burial ground of the kobold.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个蓝烛盗墓贼。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Bluewax Graverobbers.

identity.title: Can't Hold a Candle To You
identity.objectives: Recover Oenia's Skull from the Candleking.
identity.description: Okay guess you can go say hi to Candleking now.

identity.title: Buy Us Time
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Mightstone drogbar.
identity.description: We need time to evacuate Snowmane Village. Can you take the fight to these Mightstone drogbar and cull their numbers?$b$bI will direct my healers to get everyone that is unable to fight to safety.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个巨石卓格巴尔。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Mightstone drogbar.

identity.title: Neltharion's Lair
identity.objectives: Recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.
identity.description: I will direct my people to clear a path through this rubble and assault Dargrul's forces directly.$b$bIt will be a ruse.$b$BNavarrogg proposed a plan that I believe has merit. He knows of a side entrance that might lead directly to Dargrul.$b$bMuster what allies of yours you can and strike at them through this side passage. Recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth before that villain brings the mountain down on top of us.$b$bWe will provide the distraction you need to get a shot.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他拿着失窃的卡兹格罗斯之锤。
PortraitGiverText.english: He wields the stolen Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

identity.title: A Stone Cold Gamble
identity.objectives: Collect Stonefang's Jaw from Stonefang in Stonescar Gorge.
identity.description:
The second target is a basilisk called Stonefang that lives off the bank of the nearby river. 

I put a bigger wager on him, so if you can take him out I'll make sure you get a cut.

I'll need his jaw to verify the kill. Hurry, before those tauren get him first!

PortraitGiverText.text: 一只让风暴峡湾的维库人惊恐万分的巨型蜥蜴。
PortraitGiverText.english: A massive basilisk terrorizing the vrykul of Stormheim.

identity.title: Rigging the Wager
identity.objectives: Lure down and defeat Spitefeather to collect Spitefeather's Beak in the Stormtorn Foothills.
identity.description:
Care to help settle a bet, chum?

Those tauren are Skyhorn, and they fancy themselves big-time hunters. I bet them a pretty penny that they wouldn't be able to take out some of the biggest beasts in Stormheim.

If you take em out before they do, I'll split the wager. Deal?

The first is a big eagle nesting in the foothills. They call him Spitefeather. You can bait him with some meat, but he's up pretty high, so you'll need a grapple gun to get there. I think there's one of them layin around here...

PortraitGiverText.text: 一只在裂风丘陵上空捕猎的巨鹰。
PortraitGiverText.english: A giant eagle that hunts the Stormtorn Foothills.

identity.title: A Stack of Racks
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Meaty Racks of Musken Ribs from Stout Highland Runehorns in Jotunnwood.
identity.description:
So while we're waiting here, maybe you could fetch us up some grub. Them tauren were runnin low on meats, so I'm sure they'd be thankful to have more.

I hear that musken ribs are the specialty here.  The wild musken here are too lean for any good meat, but across the river there are some nice fat ones. Maybe you should check those out!

Don't worry, I'm pretty sure there aren't any dragons over there...

Objectives.text: 在尤顿林地从健壮的高地符角牛身上收集$1oa块多肉的麝牛肋排。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Meaty Racks of Musken Ribs from Stout Highland Runehorns in Jotunnwood.

identity.title: Cold Hard Coin
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Sightless Eyes.
identity.description: I am not interested in gold. Your aboveground currencies have little use down here.$b$bI am, however interested in Sightless Eyes. I will gladly accept some as payment for my services.

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa个盲目之眼。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Sightless Eyes.

identity.title: The Siegebrul
identity.objectives: Slay Siegebrul Olgrul.
identity.description: Worms do not like battle or the surface. They only go where their master tells them.$b$bSo, when in war, kill the master.$b$bSiegebrul Olgrul is the master of worms for the Mightstone drogbar who attack us from the north.$b$bSlay him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 巨石首领
PortraitGiverText.english: The Mightstone Leader

identity.title: Stormheim
identity.objectives: Speak to Nathanos Blightcaller at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
identity.description: Nathanos Blightcaller, Champion of the Banshee Queen herself, sent for you in Dalaran.$B$BHe should be waiting for you in the Violet Citadel. It sounded urgent.

PortraitGiverName.text: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

identity.title: I'm Not Lion!
identity.objectives: Collect a hunting trophy from the lion that Ellias claims to have seen in Pinerock Basin.
identity.description:
I've hunted many exotic beasts in my day, but I've never seen a lion like the one I encountered while scouting the basin.

The beast's amber eyes locked on mine, luring me closer. I was helpless to this predator's enchanting gaze. It was only when the lion pounced did the stupor break.

I've told Hemet of this magical beast, but he laughs. I'm not lying, $n! The lion exists.

If you find the beast, bring me a trophy of your kill, and I'll reward you handsomely.

identity.title: Toll for the Soul
identity.objectives: Defeat Helya and free the Valarjar.
identity.description:
[PH] As foretold, you have arrived... Helya is foolish to think I'll let her ferry me into Helheim. Odyn has already smiled upon me, my soul belongs in Valhallas. 

Make no mistake, I am not a prisoner. Before my death Odyn appeared to me in the form of a raven. He praised my battles in life and gave me a quest no vrykul could refuse. The Helerjar arrived... and I let them slay me.

Prisoner-- nay, I am a liberator, sent by Odyn to free the souls of Valarjar.

identity.title: The Last Few
identity.objectives: Create $1oa Enchant Ring - Word of Versatility vellums for Ildine. You can acquire vellums from a scribe, or from the Auction House.
identity.description: As you can see, $n, we're hard at work producing enchants for the battle against the Legion. Since you're here, we could really use your help wrapping up one of our orders.$b$bIf you could, acquire some vellums and start enchanting them with Versatility. Here, I'll teach you the formula.

Objectives.text: 为伊尔蒂制作$1oa张附魔戒指 - 全能真言卷轴。你可以从抄写员或拍卖行处获得羊皮纸。
Objectives.english: Create $1oa Enchant Ring - Word of Versatility vellums for Ildine. You can acquire vellums from a scribe, or from the Auction House.

identity.title: In the Loop
identity.objectives: Use the enchanting vellums on $1oa Demon Hunters at the Illidari Stand.
identity.description: We could use your help down here, $n. Some of our hunters would benefit greatly from having those vellums applied to their rings right now.$b$bHere take a few. I'll give the rest to one of my other soldiers to hand out.$b$bMy hunters probably won't stop to let you apply the enchants, so you'll just have to do your enchanting even if they're in the midst of battle.

Objectives.text: 在伊利达雷哨所对$1oa名恶魔猎手使用附魔羊皮纸。
Objectives.english: Use the enchanting vellums on $1oa Demon Hunters at the Illidari Stand.

identity.title: Strong Like the Earth
identity.objectives: Defeat Enraged Ambershards and collect $b$1oa of their Ambershard Crystals. Bring them back to Guron in Thunder Totem.
identity.description: There are many types of spirits in this world, $n. Some benevolent, some troubled.$b$bThey all resonate with different reagents which we use to enchant our armor. One such reagent are the crystals of the ambershards.$b$bThey are a violent creature born of the earth and have recently been disturbed by the drogbar. However, disturbed or not, the crystals they bear are of great use to my people for enchantments. Bring me some and I'll show you what I mean.

Objectives.text: 击败暴怒的琥珀碎片，收集$1oa个琥珀碎片水晶，并交给雷霆图腾的古隆。
Objectives.english: Defeat Enraged Ambershards and collect $b$1oa of their Ambershard Crystals. Bring them back to Guron in Thunder Totem.

identity.title: Waste Not
identity.objectives: Go to the Crystal Fissure and search for discarded armor. Disenchant the armor and bring back $1oa Thunder Dust to Guron.
identity.description: While fighting the ambershards for their crystals, you may come across enchanted armor from our fallen braves. The ambershards care not for such things, but our tribe does not believe in letting anything go to waste.$b$bI'd like you to retrieve our braves' armor and disenchant them into the components from which they were imbued.$b$bBring me back the reagents so my tribe may use them to enchant new armor.

Objectives.text: 前往水晶裂隙，寻找废弃的护甲。分解护甲并为古隆带回$1oa份雷霆之尘。
Objectives.english: Go to the Crystal Fissure and search for discarded armor. Disenchant the armor and bring back $1oa Thunder Dust to Guron.

identity.title: No Longer Worthy
identity.objectives: Kill night elves within the grounds of Black Rook Hold and collect their Enchanted Raven Sigils. Disenchant the sigils and bring back $1oa Raven Dust to Nalamya as proof of their defeat.
identity.description: The elves of Black Rook Hold have decided to turn their backs on us. They stay inside their keep, attacking any outsider who dare try to enter.$b$bSuch behavior is intolerable... especially after all the help they've received from my folk and the others of this land.$b$bI want you to do me a favor, $n. Take their enchanted sigils and reduce them to dust. Bring me back the dust as proof of your deeds.

Objectives.text: 在黑鸦堡垒消灭暗夜精灵，并收集他们的魔法渡鸦徽记。分解徽记，然后把$1oa份渡鸦之尘交给娜拉米娅，作为你消灭他们的证据。
Objectives.english: Kill night elves within the grounds of Black Rook Hold and collect their Enchanted Raven Sigils. Disenchant the sigils and bring back $1oa Raven Dust to Nalamya as proof of their defeat.

identity.title: Sentinel's Final Duty
identity.objectives: Slay Fathom-Commander Eksis. Return to Alynblaze at the Crumbled Palace when you are through.
identity.description: Now that I'm stronger, it's time to test your mettle, and mine. As I mentioned earlier, there is a powerful naga I wish to kill.$b$bHis name is Fathom-Commander Eksis. He was responsible for slaying many of my kin before he retreated into hiding, commanding his troops from the shadows.$b$bI've finally discovered his whereabouts in a cave just east of here. Let us bring vengeance upon him for my lost brothers and sisters.

PortraitGiverText.text: 这只凶猛的纳迦一路打拼，现在的头衔是深海指挥官。
PortraitGiverText.english: A fierce naga who has moved up the ranks and gained the title of Fathom-Commander.

identity.title: Turnabout Betrayal
identity.objectives: Defeat demons at the Felblaze Ingress. Take their Fel-crusted Runes and disenchant them into $1oa Dust of Foul Lies. Return to where you met the Fallen Priestess when you are done.
identity.description: Enchantress Ilanya remembers me?$b$b<The satyr pauses to wipe a tear away.>$b$bI made a fool's bargain ten millennia ago. I learned of the queen's alliance with the Legion and betrayed my heart to join their side. I was transformed into a monstrosity, only to die in battle against the mortals.$b$bNow the Legion returns, but I linger as an impotent spirit. Be my vessel and slay the demons ahead of us. Take their demonic runes and render them to dust.

Objectives.text: 在邪焰隘口消灭恶魔。取得他们的邪壳符文并分解出$1oa份邪污谎言之尘。完成以后回去找堕落的女祭司。
Objectives.english: Defeat demons at the Felblaze Ingress. Take their Fel-crusted Runes and disenchant them into $1oa Dust of Foul Lies. Return to where you met the Fallen Priestess when you are done.

identity.title: Smashing Herbs
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Roseate Pigments and $2oa Sallow Pigments. Pigments are obtained by milling herbs.
identity.description: Now that the formalities are out of the way, let's have you do something actually useful.$b$bOn the islands below, there's a plethora of new and exotic herbs that we've yet to experiment with.$b$bI'd like you to get some of those herbs and create some new pigments from them. Once you have enough, come back to me and I'll see what you've come up with.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa份玫红颜料和$2oa份蜡黄颜料。颜料可以通过研磨草药获得。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Roseate Pigments and $2oa Sallow Pigments. Pigments are obtained by milling herbs.

identity.title: Fish Ink
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Mak'rana Oil, $2oa Hatecoil Naga oil, and $3oa Salteye Oil, then combine them into a Piscine Pigment.
identity.description: You know, herbs aren't the only ways to obtain ink. Other materials can be inkified.$b$bSlightly related! I've been tinkering with the idea of creating my own type of Darkmoon card. Surely if those troggish carnival people can do it, then so can I.$b$bTo do so, we'll need some special reagents. Go down to Azsuna and collect some oils for me, then mill them into a suitable ink.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa份玛拉纳油脂，$2oa份积怨之鳞碎片和$3oa份盐目油脂，然后调配成鱼鳞颜料。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Mak'rana Oil, $2oa Hatecoil Naga oil, and $3oa Salteye Oil, then combine them into a Piscine Pigment.

identity.title: The Card Shark
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Hearthstone Cards at the Legerdemain Lounge.
identity.description: We have the pigment, but we still require one more ingredient.$b$bVisitors at the Legerdemain Lounge will often play card games, and occasionally their cards are discarded. Go see if you can find some loose cards that players may have gotten rid of between matches.

Objectives.text: 在魔术旅馆收集$1oa张炉石卡牌。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Hearthstone Cards at the Legerdemain Lounge.

identity.title: The Price of Power
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa demons at Illidari Strand.
identity.description: You wish to learn what it is to be a demon hunter? That may take some time.$b$bThe first thing you can do is fight alongside us. Battle the demons with us and observe how we use their strength against them.$b$bReturn to me when you are finished.

Objectives.text: 在伊利达雷哨所消灭$1oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa demons at Illidari Strand.

identity.title: Opposites Repel
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Ley Dust from the nightfallen and withered in the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar, then mix it into a Ley Pigment.
identity.description: There's a balance that must be struck, $n, when becoming a demon hunter. In order to maintain that balance, we must infuse ourselves with opposite forces of nature.$b$bFel energy is counteracted by arcane energy. We mark our bodies with arcane runes to keep our fel forces in check.$b$bYou are a scribe, yes? Then you should have no trouble mixing a suitable ley pigment from the ley dust on the creatures in the ruins up ahead.

Objectives.text: 从扎赫纳尔魔网废墟的堕夜精灵和枯法者身上收集$1oa份魔尘，然后调配成魔力颜料。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Ley Dust from the nightfallen and withered in the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar, then mix it into a Ley Pigment.

identity.title: Runes of Power
identity.objectives: Study $1oa Fel Power Runes.
identity.description: Look closely, scribe, and you may learn. As the demons spread out over a region, the more clever ones will inscribe runes upon the ground. The fel taint pervades this entire hillside, but the corruption is darkest around these runes, disallowing anything pure to grow ever again.$b$bStudy these runes.

Objectives.text: 研究$1oa个邪能符文。
Objectives.english: Study $1oa Fel Power Runes.

identity.title: Runes Within the Ruins
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Ancient Vrykul Rune Tablets within Haustvald.
identity.description: Unfortunately, Pallin's codex isn't complete. There are many symbols here that simply cannot be deciphered with what we've learned.$b$bLooks like we'll need to go and collect more tablets down in the area that the vrykul call Haustvald.

Objectives.text: 在霍斯瓦尔德收集$1oa块古代维库符文石板。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Ancient Vrykul Rune Tablets within Haustvald.

identity.title: Halls of Valor: Vision of Valor
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Valarjar Rune-Sigils from the Halls of Valor.
identity.description: I think it's time for another field trip, $n. To the Halls of Valor!$b$bThe Valarjar are masters of all types of runecraft. Perhaps we can find something useful for a new recipe.

Objectives.text: 从英灵殿取得$1oa个瓦拉加尔符印。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $1oa Valarjar Rune-Sigils from the Halls of Valor.

identity.title: Demon Ink
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Vials of Felsoul Blood and $2oa Blood of Sargeras, then mix them into Felsoul Ink.
identity.description: These sigils would make for a fantastic new tarot card. Quite powerful, in fact. We simply require an ink sturdy enough to inscribe them.$b$bFortunately, I have students like you that excel at fetching hard-to-get items.$b$bFor this project, I require ink mixed from demonic blood. The blood of the demons at Felsoul Hold will serve as a suitable base. You will also need Blood of Sargeras, of course.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa瓶邪魂鲜血和$2oa份萨格拉斯之血，并把它们混合成邪魂墨水。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Vials of Felsoul Blood and $2oa Blood of Sargeras, then mix them into Felsoul Ink.

identity.title: Skin Deep
identity.objectives: Acquire $1oa Stonehide Leather and $2oa Stormscales. If you are not a skinner, you may acquire them from the auction house or other players.
identity.description: Welcome, $n. It's an honor to be working with someone of your caliber.$b$bIn order for us to begin our work together, we'll first need to collect some materials.$b$bThe Broken Isles are home to many strange, exotic creatures which no doubt have interesting hides to experiment with. We'll need scales to make mail armor with as well.$b$bGo and collect some materials for us so we may begin working.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa张石皮皮革和$2oa份风暴之鳞。如果你不是剥皮师，那么可以通过拍卖行或者其他玩家来获取材料。
Objectives.english: Acquire $1oa Stonehide Leather and $2oa Stormscales. If you are not a skinner, you may acquire them from the auction house or other players.

identity.title: Trouble for Okuna
identity.objectives: Search for Okuna Longtusk.
identity.description:
<You open the bottle and find a message inside.>

Help! I need somebody... but not just anybody. I need a champion! I finally escaped the grasp of Prince Oceanus only to be hunted by his father, King Deepbeard.

I was enjoying my freedom and decided to go fishing when that giant attacked. I've been running around these islands trying to avoid that creature ever since... if anyone gets this message, please send help!

identity.title: Kill Azshara
identity.objectives: xxxxx
identity.description: xxxxx

identity.title: Huln's War - The Arrival
identity.objectives: Defeat $2oa Legion.
identity.description:
Huln Highmountain is the origin of our strength as a tribe. He bested the Legion when last they threatened our survival and unified many disparate tribes.

Live his story, and you will know why his name imbues courage in the cowardly and sows fear in the fearless.

Objectives.text: 消灭$2oa个燃烧军团恶魔。
Objectives.english: Defeat $2oa Legion.

identity.title: Khadgar's Discovery
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
identity.description: Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately.$B$BI have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

identity.title: Desperation Breeds Ingenuity
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Chewed Aethril Stems from Withered in Azsuna.
identity.description: I believe we may be able to use this clue to our advantage, $n.$b$bThe withered are notoriously thirsty for mana, and will stop at nothing to get it. Perhaps we can study how they use the aethril and use the results to improve our own harvesting methods.

Objectives.text: 从阿苏纳的枯法者身上取得$1oa块被咬过的安瑟里尔根茎。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Chewed Aethril Stems from Withered in Azsuna.

identity.title: An Empathetic Herb
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Healthy Dreamleaf and $2oa Blight-Infested Dreamleaf.
identity.description: Something is different about this dreamleaf, though. It is less than pure.$b$bI have a theory.$b$bThe wilds of Val'sharah have been blighted by a nightmarish curse. Sensitive herbs like this may be susceptible to such a blight.$b$bI need more information before I can draw any conclusions. Find me some healthy samples and some blight-infested samples, and we can continue.

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa株健康的入梦叶和$2oa株染病的入梦叶。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Healthy Dreamleaf and $2oa Blight-Infested Dreamleaf.

identity.title: One Dead Plant is One Too Many
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa satyrs within Val'sharah.
identity.description: We must exact VENGEANCE for this. While I understand the importance of the balance between the Emerald Dream and the Nightmare, this time it's corruption has gone TOO FAR!$b$bSatyrs. I blame the satyrs for this. Make them pay! Make them pay, and Elune will reward you with her bounty!

Objectives.text: 在瓦尔莎拉消灭$1oa个萨特。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa satyrs within Val'sharah.

identity.title: Foxflower Sample
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa samples of Foxflower, then bring them to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
identity.description: Something about this herb catches your eye... and your nose.$b$bYour herbalism trainer in Dalaran would certainly be interested in studying some samples of this piquant new flower.

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa株狐尾花样本，带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa samples of Foxflower, then bring them to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.

identity.title: Fjarnskaggl Sample
identity.objectives: Bring $1oa Fjarnskaggl to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
identity.description: To one not trained in herbalism, this brambly bush might appear to be entirely useless. Your training, however, reveals this to be a very special plant indeed.$b$bYour herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see some more samples of this.

Objectives.text: 把$1oa个夏斯卡格草带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
Objectives.english: Bring $1oa Fjarnskaggl to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.

identity.title: The Gentlest Touch
identity.objectives: Attempt to harvest $1oa more Starlight Roses.
identity.description: Sadly, I don't have any special techniques that can help you here. You'll simply need to practice your methods. Get back out there, and focus on a gentle touch when dealing with starlight roses.

Objectives.text: 尝试采集$1oa株星光玫瑰。
Objectives.english: Attempt to harvest $1oa more Starlight Roses.

identity.title: Nature vs. Nurture
identity.objectives: Talk to $1oa Swamprock Tadpoles.
identity.description:
I appreciate murloc-kind far too much to tell you to go kill all the adults.

What we should be doing is setting up the next generation to be more peaceful; Murky is the best representative for this. 

Bring him to talk to the murloc tadpoles. He'll get them on our side.

Objectives.text: 和$1oa只沼岩蝌蚪谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Talk to $1oa Swamprock Tadpoles.

identity.title: I'll Huff, I'll Puff...
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Pufferfish Eggs.
identity.description:
Murky is my favorite little fella. However, in order to lead a change in the murloc population here, he needs some awesome abilities.

There are a lot of pufferfish around in the water, and I think that they could be a good resource for him. 

Kill a few and collect their eggs for Murky.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个河豚鱼卵。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Pufferfish Eggs.

identity.title: Slime Time
identity.objectives: Feed Murky $1oa Bunches of Slimeweed by swimming through them.
identity.description:
Murky's a growing boy, he needs to eat! What better than slimeweed for a young murloc?

There's plenty of it around in the water amongst the murlocs; swim through it and feed Murky!

Objectives.text: 在污泥草中穿梭游弋，用$1oa束污泥草给奔波尔霸喂食。
Objectives.english: Feed Murky $1oa Bunches of Slimeweed by swimming through them.

identity.title: The Price of Power
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa demons to help lessen the invasion.
identity.description: I see, you wish to augment your powers through script. I believe we can kill two birds with one stone then.$b$bI need help here reducing the demon threat. Perhaps some more engagement with our enemy will inspire you.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个恶魔，减轻入侵的威胁。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa demons to help lessen the invasion.

identity.title: Tamer Takedown
identity.objectives: Kill Tamer Korgrul within Rockcrawler Chasm.
identity.description:
The drogbar will continue to breed vicious worms as long as their tamer lives. 

Korgrul is responsible for turning fledgling rockcrawlers into the monstrous siege worms that are ridden into battle.

Head deep into the chasm and end his life, so that we may also see the end of these unnatural creatures.

identity.title: The Invasion Begins
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa demons and change the Legion banner to take control of Despair Ridge.
identity.description:
Our advance force of demon hunters is here and has engaged the Legion.

Make our presence known. Let's send a shiver down every demon spine. Raise our colors with pride, $n.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个恶魔，并换掉燃烧军团的旗帜以控制绝望岭。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa demons and change the Legion banner to take control of Despair Ridge.

identity.title: Murlocs: The Next Generation
identity.objectives: Mindmeld with Murky and slay $2oa Cavemoss Clackers.
identity.description:
The time has come! Murky and his followers need a place to hide out and train--away from the mature murlocs--so that they can prepare to take over in the future.

There's a nice cave not too far away... only problem is that it's filled with makrura.

This would be a good base for the tadpoles. Murky must go show them what for!

Mindmeld with Murky in his egg and show him how it's done!

Objectives.text: 与奔波尔霸精神交流，并消灭$2oa个苔穴龙虾。
Objectives.english: Mindmeld with Murky and slay $2oa Cavemoss Clackers.

identity.title: Repairing the Source
identity.objectives: You have found a damaged power core for an arcane construct. It seems like you could repair the device.
identity.description: <A glint catches your eye in the dirt. A brief excavation yields a mostly intact piece of an arcane construct's power core. The breaks appear to be clean, perhaps you could repair it if you find the other fragments.>

identity.title: Stonehide Leather Sample
identity.objectives: Bring the Stonehide Leather Sample, along with $1oa additional pieces of Stonehide Leather, to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
identity.description: The quality of this leather scrap appears representative of the beast hides found in the Broken Isles.$b$bYour skinning trainer in Dalaran would be interested in seeing this.

Objectives.text: 把石皮皮革样本以及额外的$1oa块石皮皮革交给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
Objectives.english: Bring the Stonehide Leather Sample, along with $1oa additional pieces of Stonehide Leather, to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.

identity.title: Highmountain Hides
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Bear Hides, $2oa Elderhorn Hides, and $3oa Saber Hides by skinning the creatures of Highmountain.
identity.description: So, ye're a skinner too, aye?$b$bThat's great news, $n! I don't think I ever knew we shared that in common.$b$bYe've GOT ta see some o'the hides we've got here in Highmountain. Why, I'd give me spare monacle just t'get me hands on some o'those fine, silky hides...

Objectives.text: 对至高岭的生物进行剥皮，获取$1oa张熊皮，$2oa张大角鹿皮，以及$3oa张刃豹皮。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Bear Hides, $2oa Elderhorn Hides, and $3oa Saber Hides by skinning the creatures of Highmountain.

identity.title: The Freedom to Roam
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Musken Hides, $2oa Lion Seal Hides, $3oa Boar Hides, and $4oa Wolf Hides.
identity.description: I remember bein' young, $n. D'ye remember it? So much less responsibility... I could just run around as I pleased. Now, I'm pretty much stuck with my hunting crew, here in Highmountain.$b$bThere're so many interestin' creatures in the other regions o'the Broken Isles, though. I'll mark yer map, you get out there and do some skinnin'!

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa张麝牛皮、$2oa张海狮皮、$3oa张鹿皮，以及$4oa张狼皮。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Musken Hides, $2oa Lion Seal Hides, $3oa Boar Hides, and $4oa Wolf Hides.

identity.title: Halls of Valor: The Hide of Fenryr
identity.objectives: Obtain the Hide of Fenryr by skinning Fenryr in Valhallas.
identity.description: While you be here, I got a favor t'ask you.$b$bI been hearin' whispers about one big, nasty wolf dat's been causin' all kinds of trouble up in de vrykul lands. His name be Fenryr.$b$bI want his hide.

PortraitGiverText.text: 维库狩猎圣地中那头几近无敌的狼。
PortraitGiverText.english: The nigh-unkillable wolf of the vrykul's holy hunting grounds.

identity.title: The Core of the Stormscale
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Stormscale Sparks by skinning scaled creatures in the Broken Isles.
identity.description: Ahh, yes. The elusive stormscale.$b$bI have seen similar scales in Northrend, and some in Skywall, but it would appear that such a scale is common here. My colleagues that specialize in mail armor will be happy to learn this.$b$bTo more efficiently harvest this type of scale, you must first understand its power. Look for broken, unusable scales on your quarry, and remove the sparks within them. Once you have seen the sparks, you will better understand the stormscale.

Objectives.text: 对破碎群岛上长有鳞片的生物进行剥皮，获取$1oa个风暴之鳞电弧。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Stormscale Sparks by skinning scaled creatures in the Broken Isles.

identity.title: Under Down
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Hippogryph Scales.
identity.description: I can train you, though.$b$bEveryone knows about the bright stormscales on the hippogryph's hindquarters, but did you know that they also have a few scales beneath their feathers? You just need to know where to look.$b$b<The night elf spirit indicates a few places near the hippogryph's wing joints.>$b$bNow go see if you can get some on your own.

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa块角鹰兽鳞片。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Hippogryph Scales.

identity.title: Red-Eyed Revenge
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Adult Squallhunters.
identity.description: It came out of nowhere. I was waiting for mother to finish skinning her half of the drake when the biggest storm dragon I'd ever seen came and... and...$b$b<Seymour finds his resolve.>$b$bI want you to kill as many of them as you can. Skin them, don't skin them, I don't care. Just get revenge for mother!

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa条成年猎风者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Adult Squallhunters.

identity.title: Drakol'nir Must Die
identity.objectives: Obtain the Scale of Drakol'nir.
identity.description: The dragon that took Mother's life was named Drakol'nir.$b$bMother always wanted to wear his scale as a pendant, but we never got a chance to skin him because I couldn't kill him alone, and she didn't care much for killing. Only skinning.$b$bYou... you wouldn't mind bringing it for her, would you?

PortraitGiverText.text: 母亲希望能够终结它的生命。
PortraitGiverText.english: Mother would have wanted him dead.

identity.title: Eye of Azshara: The Scales of Serpentrix
identity.objectives: Obtain the Scales of Serpentrix by skinning Serpentrix in the Wrath of Azshara dungeon.
identity.description: I got ta ask you a favor.$b$bI haven't been ta Azsuna, and I don't see myself leavin' Suramar anytime soon. Problem is, dere's a big ol' serpent out dere dat's just beggin' ta be skinned. Just BEGGIN' for it.

PortraitGiverText.text: 生活在雷电之王宫殿地下的可怕生物之一。
PortraitGiverText.english: One of the many horrible things living beneath the Thunder King's palace.

identity.title: Darkheart Thicket: Demons Be Different
identity.objectives: Go to Darkheart Thicket and kill Dresaron. Skin him and bring his hide back to Ske'rit in Suramar.
identity.description: Oh yes, I've seen me fair share of demons while in dese lands. And skinnin' dem ain't no easy task.$b$bTheir hides are tougher than normal animals, fibrous, see? But if you be wantin' to make da most of their skins, den ya need to be practicin' more.$b$bThere be a creature I've heard of in da Darkheart Thicket whose hide's as tough as a demon's. When ya go ta skin him, try cutting with da grain in one even stroke.$b$bBring me his skin to show me you be picking up on what I'm sayin'.

PortraitGiverText.text: 它曾是一条绿龙，如今被梦魇所吞噬。
PortraitGiverText.english: Once a green drake, now engulfed in Nightmare.

identity.title: Stormheim Savagery
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Vrykul Leather Bindings.
identity.description: There's a land below - Stormheim, they call it - that's inhabited by vrykul. I remember the vrykul from my days in Northrend.$b$bWhat I remember most was how well-crafted their armor was.$b$bIf the vrykul here are as skilled as the ones in Northrend, then I'm certain we can learn something by studying their armaments.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa条维库皮革腰带。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Vrykul Leather Bindings.

identity.title: Black Rook Bandit
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa pieces of Black Rook Armor.
identity.description: I've heard rumors of a grand castle in Val'sharah that's known to house an impressive army. Surely, the armor they wear ain't made of sticks and hay.$b$bI'm willing to bet they've fashioned some mail armor at some point fer their troops and it's just sitting there, ripe for the taking.$b$bHow about ye head over there and see what ye can "borrow" from their armory.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa件黑鸦护甲。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa pieces of Black Rook Armor.

identity.title: Drogbar Durability
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa drogbar to prove your worth to Hrul.
identity.description: We are currently at war with a race known as the drogbar. We have long maintained peace with the drogbar, but lately, they have no respect for anyone but themselves.$b$bSlay them. Prove your worth as an ally of the tauren. Do this, and I will reward you with knowledge.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个卓格巴尔，向何鲁尔证明你的能力。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa drogbar to prove your worth to Hrul.

identity.title: Naga Know-How
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Naga Shoulderguards.
identity.description: The naga of this region wear little armor, but what they do wear is particularly durable.$b$bIf you wish to make a strong shoulder piece, I would first study the naga's armor and then create a pattern of similar construct.$b$bThe city nearby is overrun by naga. Slay them and bring me their armor and I will show you what I mean.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa件纳迦护肩。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Naga Shoulderguards.

identity.title: Claw of the Land
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Stalker Claws.
identity.description: Personal experience has taught me to use stronger materials when crafting armor pieces. They last longer, and you don't need quite as many of them.$b$bFor example, I utilize the claws of the pinerock stalkers. If you acquire some for me, perhaps I can show you how better materials can increase your efficiency.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa个追猎者的爪子。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Stalker Claws.

identity.title: Reclaimed Cargo
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Mail Armor Shipments.
identity.description: The same ship that my brother was on also carried shipments of exceptional mail armor. Knowing the giants, they probably had no use for them and left them scattered around their caves.$b$bIf you could recover those shipments and bring them here, I can explain the techniques used to fashion them. That should give you a good idea of how to improve your processes.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa份锁甲货物。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Mail Armor Shipments.

identity.title: The Necessary Materials
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Stonehide Leather.
identity.description: In order to make this barding, we'll need a lot of leather. And I mean a LOT of leather.$b$bI'll solidify our plans on fitting the pieces together. You go gather the leather.$b$bOnce that's done, we can begin crafting.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa块石皮皮革。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Stonehide Leather.

identity.title: Rats!
identity.objectives: Go into the Underbelly and recover $1oa Highmountain Leatherworking Patterns.
identity.description: I tell you, $n, I have the worst luck sometimes.$b$bA package recently arrived from Hrul containing leatherworking patterns, and while my back was turned, some filthy rats came in and ran off with them down into the sewers!$b$bProbably building nests with them as we speak. Please, $n, can you go down there and see if you can retrieve any of them?

Objectives.text: 前往达拉然下水道，找回$1oa份至高岭制皮图样。
Objectives.english: Go into the Underbelly and recover $1oa Highmountain Leatherworking Patterns.

identity.title: Evolution of the Past
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Basilisk Hides.
identity.description: As we make stronger armor, the creatures we battle adapt and learn to defeat us. We in turn create better armor, and they in turn learn to defeat it yet again.$b$bFor centuries, my people have battled the basilisks of the mesas below. They have adapted to us as thoroughly as we have to them.$b$bGo, kill these basilisks and take from them their hides. Return them to me so I may show you how they have evolved.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa张蜥蜴皮。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Basilisk Hides.

identity.title: Eye of Azshara: Scales of the Sea
identity.objectives: Go to the Eye of Azshara and obtain Warlord Parjesh's Hauberk.
identity.description: When we first met, I spoke of the naga, and the armor they're able to craft. No grander armor is worn, however, than by their top warlords.$b$bOne in particular resides within the Eye of Azshara itself. His name is Warlord Parjesh, and the hauberk he wears is one of legend.$b$bRepel his forces, and obtain his armor. Do this, and I will teach you more of the Azsunian way of leatherworking.

PortraitGiverText.text: 指挥纳迦军团的勇猛战士。
PortraitGiverText.english: A fierce warrior who commands legions of naga.

identity.title: Scales of the Earth
identity.objectives: Obtain the Axetail Basilisk Matriarch Scales.
identity.description: While leather armor is strong on its own, integrating scales into the design is what truly sets it apart.$b$bThe type of scales you use will determine how many you'll need to fully protect the wearer. And one of the strongest type of scales are basilisk scales.$b$bA fully matured basilisk has the strongest of course. Near the village of Llothien is a basilisk den. Kill the matriarch and return her scales to me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 当心她的尾巴。那就跟巨龙的獠牙一样锋利。
PortraitGiverText.english: Beware her tail. It's as sharp as a dragon's fang.

identity.title: Hounds Abound
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Fel Hound Corpses.
identity.description: I'll invite him to tea. That'll show him! He'll see the leather doll and say, "When did SHE get here?!"$b$bI mean... sorry, $n. My mind goes to strange places. You want to know about the demons, the ones with durable hides?$b$bBefore I was exiled I saw such beasts roaming our cities. Fel hounds, they are called. Slay them and bring me their corpses.$b$bWe can discuss their hides afterwards.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa具恶魔犬尸体。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Fel Hound Corpses.

identity.title: Thorny Dancing
identity.objectives: Defeat $1oa Thistleleaf Thorndancers in the Lunarwing Shallows.
identity.description: The Thistleleaf sprites have gone completely mad.$b$bI suspect they are being manipulated by some very mischievous Thorndancers.$b$bPlease, friend of the forest, seek out these seductive troublemakers and bring peace to the shallows.

Objectives.text: 在月翼浅滩击败$1oa个蓟叶刺舞者。
Objectives.english: Defeat $1oa Thistleleaf Thorndancers in the Lunarwing Shallows.

identity.title: The Imp Mother's Tome
identity.objectives: Obtain the Tome of Fel Secrets.
identity.description:
See this giant cave? There's a terrifyingly powerful imp mother inside.

But that's not the good part. The good part is what she has.

Apparently, she's some kind of keeper of fel secrets. She's in there performing profane Legion rites and scribing them into a book.

We need that power! We need her tome!

PortraitGiverText.text: 夺取邪魔之秘魔典，让你和你的伊利达雷变得更加强大。
PortraitGiverText.english: Steal her Tome of Fel Secrets so that you and your Illidari can become more powerful.

identity.title: Bad Intentions
identity.objectives: Speak with Thaedris Feathersong in Tel'anor.
identity.description: Suramar is lost.$b$bOur leaders struck a dark bargain, accepting the Legion as our allies. We were meant to be heroes, guardians - the people resting here. We are not like them any more. I cannot live with them.$b$bBut cut off from the Nightwell, we wither and devolve into a mindless existence. An existence without release or dignity, as you can see even here...$b$bI rejected both of these options and found myself here. I will find a third way.

AreaDescription.text: 与泰德里斯·羽歌谈一谈。

identity.title: Scout It Out
identity.objectives: Kill Irewing after sending up a flare, signaling his location.
identity.description:
You've proven that a gnome can shoot a rifle, and that's no easy feat, but a true test of Addie's skill will be to see if she can track down an elusive beast.

Rumor has it that a ravenous roc circles the basin, cursed by harpy magic, but no one's seen the beast up close.

Take this flare, and shoot it into the sky once you've spotted the roc. When we see the signal, the huntin' party will rush in and help bring down that magnificent bird!

identity.title: Oh, the Clawdacity!
identity.objectives: Mindmeld with Murky and defeat Clawdayshus.
identity.description:
The leader of the Cavemoss makrura, Clawdayshus, has been ordering raids into the Cavemoss village to steal the young for snacks.
