This isn't going to do at all. In order to prove their power, Murky and the tadpoles must destroy him as well!

This is a job for murlocs.

Mindmeld with Murky in his egg and show him how it's done!

PortraitGiverText.text: 海边最肆意妄为的龙虾人。
PortraitGiverText.english: The most audacious makrura by the sea.

identity.title: Abrogator Arbitrator
identity.objectives: Kluk'kluk wants you to bring him $1oa Apexis Crystals.
identity.description: Da bums in Highmaul refuse to see dey are on da way out. Me, I'm gettin' while da gettin' is good. Da sooner youse bring me a bunch of Apexis Crystals, da sooner I can get off dis stupid island. Da amount required is very precise!

Objectives.text: 库克库克要你为他带$1oa块埃匹希斯水晶来。
Objectives.english: Kluk'kluk wants you to bring him $1oa Apexis Crystals.

identity.title: Work Work Stoppage
identity.objectives: Bring $1oa Apexis Crystals to the Renegade Ironworker.
identity.description: We've had enough! The working conditions in the Foundry are intolerable with all the fire and the ogron and the flames and the fire elementals and infernos and marauding adventurers! But especially the heat.$b$bI've had enough! Me and the boys are going to start a work stoppage but we need to hire some security muscle and the only goon from Highmaul I could get to agree to the job only takes payment in Apexis Crystals.

Objectives.text: 将$1oa块埃匹希斯水晶交给变节的钢铁工人。
Objectives.english: Bring $1oa Apexis Crystals to the Renegade Ironworker.

identity.title: Stop Gul'dan!
identity.objectives: Enter the Vault of the Betrayer, kill Crusher and Sledge, and take their fel power.
identity.description:
After his defeat at the Black Temple, we brought Illidan's lifeless body here, to be interred forever within the Vault of the Wardens.

Gul'dan has found his way through our defenses and is trying to steal the Betrayer's corpse.

Even in death, Illidan's body can be used by the Burning Legion. Gul'dan CANNOT succeed.

PortraitGiverText.text: 尽全力阻止他。
PortraitGiverText.english: Stop him if you can.

identity.title: Forged in Fire
identity.objectives: Kill Immolanth and take his power.
identity.description:
The fearsome demon, Immolanth, led a Legion army that conquered and eventually ruled a distant nexus world. 

Somehow, the Wardens imprisoned him, then kept him locked up in the chamber to our left. He is contained, but not for long.

The demon's power is a valuable prize to any demon hunter who can defeat him. Whoever can do so will gain power beyond imagining.

I believe that person could be you, $n.

PortraitGiverText.text: 伊莫拉斯凝聚着纯粹的邪能。
PortraitGiverText.english: Immolanth is full of pure, coalesced fel power.

identity.title: Between Us and Freedom
identity.objectives: Kill Bastillax and take his power.
identity.description:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他守卫着地窟出口。
PortraitGiverText.english: He guards the vault exit.

identity.title: Between Us and Freedom
identity.objectives: Kill Bastillax and take his power.
identity.description:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他守卫着地窟出口。
PortraitGiverText.english: He guards the vault exit.

identity.title: The Lost Advisor
identity.objectives: Collect 8 Cliffthorn.
identity.description: You may as well assist me while you are here. I require a potion to be made, one that will set things right.$b$bI must conserve my energy until my task is finished, lest I become like these miserable wretches scrabbling at the cobblestones. There is coin in it for you, since I will not be needing it soon.$b$bThe harpies around here cannot resist cliffthorn. It is what drew them to Tel'anor in the first place. $b$bYou should find plenty just outside this building.

identity.title: Tools of the Trade
identity.objectives: Retrieve burial objects for Thaedris.
identity.description: I used to visit here before the barrier was raised. While the ruling council and the Grand Magistrix argued and politicked I watched the caretakers  perform their rituals and venerate the dead.$b$bI would honor the spirits here one last time. I am headed to the tombs. If some of the sacred oils, burial shrouds, or incense survived the ages then bring them to me.

identity.title: The Last Chapter
identity.objectives: Find the Encyclopedia Botanica.
identity.description: The next step of my journey requires a tome, but I find that I am still unable to idly sit by as this place continues to fall into disrepair.$b$bI will tidy up the memorials while you go fetch me the tome. It is called the Encyclopedia Botanica and you can find it in the library near the main plaza.

identity.title: Glaive Circumstances
identity.objectives: Retrieve Lyana Darksorrow's glaives.
identity.description: I came here on a mission to slay the demon eredar, Azoran. During my infiltration, I was shot down from my felbat and captured.$b$bI'm not going to mince words, $n. Azoran plans to use the Burning Legion command ship to destroy Dalaran.$b$bTo stop him, I will need my warglaives that were lost during my fall from the sky. I would retrieve them myself, but I'm still weakened from my imprisonment.$b$bSearch for the warglaives on the northern side of the crater, where I was shot down.

AreaDescription.text: 找到莉安娜·悲夜的战刃。

identity.title: Fragments of Memory
identity.objectives: Retrieve 15 Tel'anor Mementos.
identity.description: <The beautiful elven burial urn is shattered carelessly on the ground. It was clearly handled roughly, but not scratched by the talons of the harpies.>$b$b<You find a trail of shards leading towards a cave. Those responsible are certainly within. Thaedris would be interested in the relics and their safe return.>

identity.title: End of the Line
identity.objectives: Speak with Thaedris at the upper landing of Tel'anor.
identity.description: I cannot call Suramar my home any more, and I refuse to become a withered abomination. There is no place for me anymore, don't you understand?$b$bWe only need one last ingredient to complete the elixir. You will help me, won't you?

AreaDescription.text: 与泰德里斯·羽歌谈一谈。

identity.title: The Final Ingredient
identity.objectives: Find Latara's bow.
identity.description: The potion is complete, $n. Soon our journey will be over. There is one last thing I would have you do for me, then you shall have your reward.$b$bMy wife's bow was kept here, but I have not been able to find it after searching everywhere. There is potent magic in it.$b$bI fear one of the restless spirits may have taken it, but it would take a powerful force to pick up an item such as this. Be careful.

identity.title: Feathersong's Redemption
identity.objectives: Slay the Cliffclutch Matriarch.
identity.description: I must confess I was not entirely honest with you, $n. I meant to drink the potion and join my wife.$b$bAnd even she was taken from her rest... I cannot fail her again. I must live and do what I can to stop this coming storm to be worthy of joining her.$b$bCome, young one. Let us take care of the harpy matriarch and restore Tel'anor to its former glory. We cannot let this poison go to waste, eh?

identity.title: Cave of the Blood Trial Treasure

Title.english: Cave of the Blood Trial Treasure

identity.title: Scattered Memories
identity.objectives: Inspect $1oa pages of Kel'danath's Notes.
identity.description:
<As your fingers trace the elegant symbols on the page, a voice dictates the words in your mind.

It seems the nightborne have elevated even simple note-taking to a sorcerous art.

Arcanist Kel'danath was definitely working in this area. There must be more of his notes scattered around.>

Objectives.text: 阅读$1oa张凯尔丹纳斯的笔记。
Objectives.english: Inspect $1oa pages of Kel'danath's Notes.

identity.title: A Fate Worse Than Dying
identity.objectives: Open $1oa Soul Engine Cages.
identity.description: When the Burning Legion takes a prisoner, it is not an act of mercy.$b$bWhile death is the destruction of the mortal body... if you are captured by the Legion, they will seek to destroy your soul.$b$bThe Burning Legion uses sacrificial souls to power their demonic machinations of war. The soul engine is where the harvested souls are collected and stored.$b$bThough countless have already perished in the soul engine, you may yet save those still alive inside.$b$bHurry and release them before it is too late!

Objectives.text: 打开$1oa个灵魂引擎牢笼。
Objectives.english: Open $1oa Soul Engine Cages.

identity.title: Something in the Water
identity.objectives: Slay 12 Mana-corrupted Waterspawn.
identity.description: There is something fouling these waters, $c.$b$bWe will need to purify the waters in order to restore balance to the elemental forces below this ruin.$b$bThe magic here has warped the elementals and they are beyond restoration. Release their corrupted forms so that they may be reborn pure.

AreaDescription.text: 消灭12个被法力腐蚀的水之子。

identity.title: Turtle Powered
identity.objectives: Collect 7 Shimmering Snapper Scales.
identity.description: In order to locate and purify the source of the corruption I am going to need an elemental focus.$b$bThe turtles around here have developed scales that can focus and amplify their innate magics. Bring back some snapper scales and we will have these waters purified in no time!

AreaDescription.text: 收集7份闪光的钳嘴鳞片。

identity.title: Purge the Unclean
identity.objectives: Defeat the corruption in the Azurefall Guardian.
identity.description: Do you feel it in the air, $r? The stage is set for us to make things right.$b$bWhile you were busy I was able to track down the elder elemental that rules these waters. Its name is the Azurefall Guardian and it resides within the channels below Tel'anor.$b$bTake the ritual focus, it should help you during the battle.

PortraitGiverText.text: 使用净化仪式焦镜寻找腐化的源头！
PortraitGiverText.english: Use the Cleansing Ritual Focus to find the source of the corruption!

AreaDescription.english: Defeat the corruption in the Azurefall Guardian.

identity.title: Take Me To Your Leader
identity.objectives: Meet with Khadgar in Suramar.
identity.description: I am glad you are here, $n.$b$bThis... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.$b$bHe wishes to meet us at the entrance to the city as soon as possible.$b$bWill you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

AreaDescription.text: 到苏拉玛与卡德加见面。

identity.title: A Way Back In
identity.objectives: Find the smuggler.
identity.description: I must get back into Suramar.$b$bI was exiled unfairly! I cannot live out here like this. I need the Nightwell's energies...$b$bI saw a message carved into a wall a few days ago. There is someone in the Water Gardens who can smuggle people into the city.$b$bIt said "We shall drink of the Well again."$b$bI cannot survive a confrontation with the guards again. Will you go in my stead? Once I am back in the city I can repay you.

identity.title: A Desperate Journey
identity.objectives: Follow the lamp posts to take Iadreth to Astoril.
identity.description: The city's entrances are under heavy guard. He must have another way.$b$bThanks to this wine I am strong enough to make the journey to him. I fear that I will not be able to defend or run if I come under attack.$b$bYou will accompany me, $r. You and this Astoril are my only chance at surviving now. $b$bI remember when I was leaving the city that there were lamps guiding me here. We should be able to retrace our steps by following them.

AreaDescription.text: 带艾德瑞斯去找阿斯托里尔。

identity.title: Final Preparations
identity.objectives: Recover 6 stashed supplies.
identity.description: We will need supplies for our trip into Suramar. We cannot exactly stop for refreshments at the gate with you two in tow, can we?$b$bThe water gardens were a place to socialize and relax. Before the patrols arrived it was rather trivial to hide some mana wine for later retrieval.$b$bThat's where you come in. Fetch some supplies and bring them to your friend, then meet me at the ruins north of the city. We will be ready to depart soon.

AreaDescription.text: 拿回6份藏起来的补给品。

identity.title: Quality of Life
identity.objectives: Follow Iadreth.
identity.description: I am afraid, $n. We're so close to home, so close to salvation...$b$bAstoril says he knows the rest of the way through and can get us there safely. I believe him, but you've come this far to see us safe. Will you see this through to the end?

identity.title: Truly Outrageous
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Gem Chips for Tiffany Cartier. Gem chips can be acquired through Prospecting raw ore or purchased off the auction house.
identity.description: Ore prospecting is our primary method of gem acquisition. And while prospecting... you're bound to find small, unusable gem chips.$b$bMany gem shops simply discard the small gem chips they find, but we here at Cartier & Co. let nothing go to waste.

Objectives.text: 帮蒂凡妮·卡蒂亚收集$1oa块宝石碎片。宝石碎片可以通过选矿获得，也可以通过拍卖行购买。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Gem Chips for Tiffany Cartier. Gem chips can be acquired through Prospecting raw ore or purchased off the auction house.

identity.title: The Charge Within
identity.objectives: Use the Conducting Jewel on the corpses of $1oa Squallhunter storm drakes.
identity.description: Before Jabrul shares his designs with you, he needs you to help him with a special project.$b$bJabrul has a jewel that can trap storm energy. The more lightning it traps, the brighter it shines.$b$bJabrul thinks the storm drakes' power would be better spent in his jewel than terrorizing the skies of Stormheim.$b$bDon't you?

Objectives.text: 对$1oa具猎风龙的尸体使用传导珠宝。
Objectives.english: Use the Conducting Jewel on the corpses of $1oa Squallhunter storm drakes.

identity.title: Eyes of Nashal
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.
identity.description: Deadly eye of prophecy... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.$b$bHere stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.$b$bAscend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa颗纳沙尔之眼。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.

identity.title: Eyes of Nashal
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.
identity.description: Quick dawnlight... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.$b$bHere stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.$b$bAscend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa颗纳沙尔之眼。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.

identity.title: Eyes of Nashal
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.
identity.description: Masterful shadowruby... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.$b$bHere stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.$b$bAscend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa颗纳沙尔之眼。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.

identity.title: A Personal Touch
identity.objectives: Obtain a Nightborne Loupe, a Custom Jewelry Order, and $2oa Nightborne Jewelry Cases.
identity.description: $n, great to see you again. It feels like forever since last we spoke.$b$bWe've received some information about a group of jewelcrafting nightborne in Suramar that are doing fantastic things with necklaces. I'd like to take a look at some of their gems.$b$bAnd their designs.$b$bAnd... a new loupe might be nice, too. I hear the city inspectors carry them.

Objectives.text: 获得一个夜之子透镜、一份定制珠宝订单，以及$2oa个夜之子珠宝匣。
Objectives.english: Obtain a Nightborne Loupe, a Custom Jewelry Order, and $2oa Nightborne Jewelry Cases.

identity.title: Paying Respects
identity.objectives: Slay 8 Disturbed Apparitions or Disturbed Spectres.
identity.description: All I see is despair.$b$bLook, $r. The grounds are overwhelmed with these wraiths, spirits of those interred here. Something has made them angry and they are lashing out. I can feel their pain.$b$bI will go look for remaining relics, and there is a tomb I must see. It is too late for these unfortunate souls. Please defeat any you find and return them to the rest they deserve.

AreaDescription.text: 消灭被惊扰的幽魂或者被惊扰的鬼魂。
AreaDescription.english: Slay Disturbed Apparitions or Disturbed Spectres.

identity.title: Turn Around, Nighteyes
identity.objectives: Help Lilryia Dawnwind find Nighteyes.
identity.description: Stranger, you must help me!$b$bNighteyes, my old friend... he was scouting ahead and I heard him cry out a warning. I tried to run after him, but in my carelessness I stepped in this trap.$b$bHe's so close, just on the other side of this ridge. Please find him!

AreaDescription.text: 帮助莉莉娅·晨风寻找夜眼。

identity.title: A Different Source
identity.objectives: Find a Fel Deconstructor for Kyrtos.
identity.description: I need you to fetch me something.$b$bI think I might be on the verge of a breakthrough of a new source of magic, but I require tools. $b$bI can no longer access my workshop, but I have seen the smaller demons below using tools. Bring me one of their tools and I can save our people.

AreaDescription.text: 帮凯托斯找一个邪能解离器。
AreaDescription.english: Find a Fel Deconstructor for Kyrtos.

identity.title: Take Me To Your Leader
identity.objectives: Meet with Khadgar in Suramar.
identity.description: I am glad you are here, $n.$b$bThis... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.$b$bHe wishes to meet us by the entrance to the city as soon as possible.$b$bWill you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

AreaDescription.text: 到苏拉玛与卡德加见面。

identity.title: Power! Get The Power!
identity.objectives: Collect 8 Fel Essence for Kyrtos.
identity.description: I need more power. I need more!$b$bI can control the energies, and they are enough to sustain me. For now.$b$bI will not end up withered, like those weaklings.$b$bGo out into Felsoul Hold and slay the demons. Bring me their essence and make it quick!

AreaDescription.text: 帮凯托斯收集8个邪能精华。

identity.title: The Road to Fel
identity.objectives: Gather 10 Fel-Infused Plates for Kyrtos.
identity.description: An early step to understanding how magic works is to understand and study materials made using that magic. That was how I made my breakthrough on warlock soul crystals, after all. $b$bThe wyrmtongue minions in this pit hammer plates into their structures for support and maintenance. Those will be a good starting point. Fetch me some, my faithful assistant!

identity.title: Discovery Requires Experimentation
identity.objectives: Collect 8 Felfire Spines from Felfire Basilisks.
identity.description: I can sense residues of magic all over you. You will be useful.$b$bI must study how the demon bodies can handle the fel energies in such large quantities. I have plenty of flesh to sample, but there must be something...$b$bGo retrieve some spines from the nearby basilisks so that I may analyze their magical residues. No sense in both of us getting our hands dirty, is there?

identity.title: One Small Step for Magic
identity.objectives: Speak to Kyrtos and assist him with his ritual.
identity.description: It is time to embrace the future.$b$bI have mastered every magic known to our kind. I will master this one.$b$bBy applying the principles of arcane magic it is fairly trivial to control the primitive fel energies within the material you have given me. I need to move to live prey next.$b$bLet us start with a small summoning. Defeat the creature for me and watch how a true scholar works!

identity.title: The Black Tome
identity.objectives: Obtain the Black Tome.
identity.description: I have made a great discovery, $n.$b$bThere is a powerful warlock in the Soul Engine, in possession of a powerful tome. It contains forbidden secrets to summoning the most powerful of demons.$b$bEven the Legion is afraid to call on these fel lords, but now I possess knowledge beyond theirs.$b$bFetch me the tome and I will never want for magic again.

identity.title: The Call To War
identity.objectives: Meet with Duke Lankral at Krasus' Landing.
identity.description: <A chilling thought brushes your mind.>$b$bHear me, $n.$b$bThe Legion has returned. They hope to control us, to bend us to their will. Fools - they only walk back within reach of our blades.$b$bYour brethren within Dalaran have begun to gather at Krasus' Landing. Go, meet with Duke Lankral and all will be explained.

identity.title: The Dead and the Damned
identity.objectives: Travel to Dalaran and fly upon Zeomus to Darkstone Isle. While there, travel through the Demon Portal, find Baron Sliver, and obtain the Maw of the Damned.
identity.description: <A powerful mind again touches your thoughts.>$b$bGorelix the Fleshripper is a monstrous demon. The butcher of a thousand worlds, he has exterminated countless races with his axe, the Maw of the Damned.$b$bA group of Ebon Blade was dispatched to slay him but they have gone missing. You will succeed where they failed.$b$bYou will not be alone in this, I've sent Baron Sliver ahead to assist you.$b$bGo, obtain the Maw of the Damned and ensure that Gorelix is no more.

identity.title: An Ancient Recipe
identity.objectives: Collect 6 Harpy Talons.
identity.description: Suramar is... was... an intellectual's dream.$b$bWe studied everything in there, from alchemy and the arts to the very nature of magic itself. How could we be so foolish as to accept them in?$b$bLook at me, lost in the clouds again when there is much to be done. My work requires some fairly difficult ingredients, $r. Perhaps you would help me procure them?$b$bI am going to need some harpy talons. Crushed into a powder, they will be a potent reagent.

identity.title: A Token of Remembrance
identity.objectives: Place 4 Bouquets of Moon Lilies.
identity.description: The flower rests peacefully in your hand, glowing softly.$b$bWhile it doesn't appear to be growing anywhere nearby, there are small bouquets of the flower on some of the memorials around here.$b$bPerhaps laying down some flowers on the remaining graves will ease the gloom.

identity.title: Cling to Hope
identity.objectives: Deliver a letter to Absolon's Wife, Noressa.
identity.description:
Your kindness has inspired me, friend.

I thought I would wander forever among the empty husks of the Withered, but Thalyssra invited me in.

I have chosen to remain here with my people and together we will take back Suramar.

For now I have but one request.

Take this letter to my wife. She should know that I still live, among other things.

Give her the hope that you gave me.

identity.title: The Latest Fashion: Headguns!
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Fel Critters using Flintlocke's Headgun Prototype.
identity.description: So Grapplehammer's got hisself a whole lotta extra guns, right? Glorious! An'it got me ta thinkin', "What if we put 'em on our heads?"$b$bHear me out!$b$bSee, yer hands are already busy with yer current weapons, but what's yer head doin'? It's just sittin' there LOOKIN' at stuff. That's me plan. Weaponize yer head!$b$bYou, me lucky $glad:lass;, can test it out. Strap this on. Now, go blast some fel-tainted critters down below. Blammo!

Objectives.text: 用弗林特洛克的头戴式机枪原型杀死$1oa只被邪能污染的小动物。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Fel Critters using Flintlocke's Headgun Prototype.

identity.title: In My Sights
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Deployable Bullet Dispenser Parts around Moonrest.
identity.description: I used up all me bullets on a wee invention of mine. I call it: Tha Deployable Bullet Dispenser!$b$bOh aye. It shoots in-der-scriminantly wit'out all that messy and time-consumin' "aiming" or "thinkin'" that us people-folk are wont ta do.$b$bWe had deployed quite a few of 'em east o' here when this swarm of plants came a'thrashin from tha trees.$b$bI didn't 'ave time ta go back an' get me turrets. Would ye mind gettin' them back fer me? Or at least, what's left of 'em?

Objectives.text: 在眠月河滩回收$1oa个便携式洒弹器零件。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Deployable Bullet Dispenser Parts around Moonrest.

identity.title: All Charged Up
identity.objectives: Use Flintlocke's Gunpowder Charges to kill $1oa Shimmering Oleanders.
identity.description: If yer gonna wander inta these woods, ye'll be wantin' somethin' with some punch. These plants are a might grabby.$b$bI've got me special explosive charges here that should send those fertilizer mutations back to the dirt.$b$bTake 'em with yeh and give them viney beasties a what-fer!

Objectives.text: 用弗林特洛克的火药炸弹消灭$1oa个荧光夹竹桃。
Objectives.english: Use Flintlocke's Gunpowder Charges to kill $1oa Shimmering Oleanders.

identity.title: The Shell, You Say?
identity.objectives: Slay murlocs to collect  $1oa of their shells for Fargo Flintlocke.
identity.description: I know ol' Hobart sent me down 'ere to acquire 'is precious murloc glass thingies, but I have designs of me own!$b$bI've seen those murlocs carrying interesting lookin' shells that would go perfectly into me music box I've been workin on.$b$bYa lead the charge an'a I'll be right behind ya.

Objectives.text: 消灭鱼人，帮法戈·弗林特洛克收集$1oa个贝壳。
Objectives.english: Slay murlocs to collect  $1oa of their shells for Fargo Flintlocke.

identity.title: Bubble Baubles
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Murloc Trinkets from around their camps.
identity.description: Ol' Hobart wanted me ta gather up these shiny, glass trinkets the murlocs carry around, but those bloody buggers ain't willin' to jes' hand 'em over!$b$bI tried the dip-ler-matic approach, but I don't speak murloc, so I just end up shootin' 'em.$b$bMaybe you might have better luck gettin' them baubles.

Objectives.text: 在鱼人营地附近收集$1oa件鱼人饰品。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Murloc Trinkets from around their camps.

identity.title: Going Out With a Bang
identity.objectives: Use the Gunshoes to skim across the water while picking up $1oa pieces of Gunpack Debris.
identity.description: While I was, eh, testin' out this new flight pack fer Hobart, it sorta exploded an' sent me flyin' back over 'ere.$b$bYou can see all the pieces out there in tha water.$b$bNow, I've got these boots 'ere that Hobart gave me to test out too, but they're not quite me size.$b$bI figure we could kill two birds with one stone and 'ave ye test 'em out while pickin' up the broken bits of the pack.$b$bMind tha sharks while yer out there.

Objectives.text: 用火枪鞋在水面上滑行，并收集$1oa块枪械包残片。
Objectives.english: Use the Gunshoes to skim across the water while picking up $1oa pieces of Gunpack Debris.

identity.title: Keep Yer Powder Dry
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Barrels of Gunpowder and return them to Fargo in Azsuna.
identity.description: So while we've got all tha parts for tha pack again, I'm afraid I'm all outta gunpowder.$b$bThis is the worst thing ta ever happen ta me.$b$bBut there's hope. Just o'er to tha north are caves filled with crashed ships. Chances are them sea giants crashed one or two ships with cannons. And cannons mean gunpowder, sweet gunpowder.$b$bSearch their caves fer sum powder an' bring it on back.

Objectives.text: 在阿苏纳收集$1oa桶火药，然后带回去交给法戈。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Barrels of Gunpowder and return them to Fargo in Azsuna.

identity.title: I'd Do It Myself, But...
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Hatecoil Slavemasters in the Oceanus Cove.
identity.description: If yer headed over ta tha sea giant caves, do me a favor give those slimy naga a right bludgerin'.$b$bThey done run oft with me rogue friend an' I figure some revenge is in order.$b$bI'd do it meself but ol' Hobart would give me wut-fer if I abandoned his stuff.

Objectives.text: 在欧逊努斯海窟消灭$1oa个积怨奴隶主。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Hatecoil Slavemasters in the Oceanus Cove.

identity.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Cheating Death
identity.objectives: Craft $1oa Failure Detection Pylons. Go to the Violet Hold and recover a Plasmatic Laser Bolt and return everything to Didi the Wrench in Dalaran.
identity.description: Hobart was showing me a copy of a design you found, and it got me to thinking of a new module for Reaves.$b$bUnfortunately I didn't have the materials required to test it.$b$bCould you make me a couple Failure Detection Pylons?$b$bI'll also need a plasmatic laser bolt. You should be able to find one in the Violet Hold.

Objectives.text: 制作$1oa个故障检测晶塔。前往紫罗兰监狱并获取一个离子激光螺栓。然后把所有东西交给达拉然的钳工蒂迪。
Objectives.english: Craft $1oa Failure Detection Pylons. Go to the Violet Hold and recover a Plasmatic Laser Bolt and return everything to Didi the Wrench in Dalaran.

identity.title: Fresh Meat
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fresh Fel-Flesh.
identity.description: This crater is infested with felfire basilisks.$b$bThey may not be the most cunning of creatures, but they are as vile and dangerous as any demon.$b$bHowever, they may yet prove useful to us. Slay the basilisks, but return to me with chunks of their fel-infused flesh.$b$bI have plans to make use of their freshly carved flesh...

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa块新鲜的邪火蜥蜴肉。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Fresh Fel-Flesh.

identity.title: Black Rook Hold Normal Reward Quest

Title.text: 普通难度黑鸦堡垒奖励任务
Title.english: Black Rook Hold Normal Reward Quest

identity.title: Black Rook Hold Heroic Reward Quest

Title.text: 英雄难度黑鸦堡垒奖励任务
Title.english: Black Rook Hold Heroic Reward Quest

identity.title: Fel Bent for Leather
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Felbat Hide Scraps for Kyrtos.
identity.description: Ah, my faithful assistant. I have just the task for you.$b$bAs you have seen, fel power permeates living tissue and can easily be coaxed out.$b$bAlso, these damned bats are driving me to my wits' end. There is an opportunity to kill two bats with one blade, it seems. Your blade.$b$bTake this crystal. It should rip those hellions from the sky and into your waiting arms.$b$bYou may as well bring back their hides, if only to shut up that fellow in the corner for a few moments.

Objectives.text: 帮凯托斯收集$1oa块魔蝠皮碎片。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Felbat Hide Scraps for Kyrtos.

AreaDescription.text: 帮凯托斯收集100块魔蝠皮碎片。
AreaDescription.english: Collect 100 Felbat Hide Scraps for Kyrtos.

identity.title: Symbols of Power
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Legion Emblems.
identity.description: This demon has information that could lead us to those in charge.$b$bUnfortunately, he is more fearful of his master than he is of us. We need to change his mind about that.$b$bThe most powerful Burning Legion soldiers often carry an emblem of their rank and status within the demon army.$b$bSeek out the stronger demons in Felsoul Hold, slay them, and return to me with their emblems.$b$bWe will show this wyrmtongue servant who it is he should fear...

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个军团徽记。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Legion Emblems.

identity.title: Apocalypse
identity.objectives: Start your search for Apocalypse at Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood.
identity.description:
<The Lich King's chill voice fills your mind once again>

There is an ancient blade, lost in the echoes of time, that has the power to bring my vengeance upon the Legion. 

It is known as Apocalypse.

I've sensed the blade in the possession of the Dark Riders of Deadwind Pass. Their magic conceals them from my sight but they cannot hide from the scourge! They were last seen by my agents near a place called Manor Mistmantle.

Go there, $n. Defeat the Dark Riders, and claim the blade!

identity.title: Shard of Vorgos
identity.objectives: Collect the Shard of Vorgos.
identity.description: According to the wyrmtongue servant, there is a portal that will take you into the Burning Legion command ship. However, the portal is locked to those without the keys.$b$bThe first key shard is held by an Ered'ruin known as Vorgos. He resides within the Fel Breach, which is at the end of the Arcway.$b$bSlay Vorgos and place the key shard into its position next to the portal.

PortraitGiverText.text: 沃格斯手里有碎光之地的钥匙之一。我们必须从他手里抢过来。
PortraitGiverText.english: Vorgos possesses one of the keys to the Lightbreaker. We must take it from him.

identity.title: Shard of Kozak
identity.objectives: Collect the Shard of Kozak.
identity.description: The demon leading the operation in Felsoul Hold is an eredar named Azoran. In order to get to him, we will need to open a portal to the Burning Legion command ship.$b$bAzoran has a demon jailer in his service known as Kozak the Afflictor.$b$bKozak the Afflictor holds one of the key shards necessary to open a portal to the ship. He can be found in the prison quarters known as the Halls of the Eclipse in the lower portion of Felsoul Hold.$b$bSlay Kozak and place his key shard next to the portal.

PortraitGiverText.text: 找到拷问者考扎克，并从他手里夺走军团战舰传送门的钥匙碎片。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find Kozak the Afflictor and claim his key to the Legion ship.

identity.title: Bad Apples
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Shadowbloom.
identity.description: That fruit over there? That's a pale imitation to what I can grow.$b$bBut that accursed Daglir somehow manages to gain the favor of the courts, so we must dine on mediocrity!$b$bWe must teach Daglir a lesson for stealing my crop, but we must be discreet.$b$bOutside the shield grows a purple flower called Shadowbloom. Fetch some for me and we'll make sure that he pays dearly for his insolence!

Objectives.text: 采集$1oa朵暗影花。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Shadowbloom.

identity.title: The Champion's Return
identity.objectives: Teleport to the Hall of the Guardian and return to Meryl Felstorm.
identity.description:
I can sense the power of the artifact you hold. It will do well against the Legion as it is, but we have the ability to unlock its power even further. 

You must return to the Hall of the Guardian. You can use the incantation I taught you before to pass through the runes.

identity.title: An Artisan's Mark
identity.objectives: Obtain Lespin's Signet Ring.
identity.description: You there! Do you have a moment?$b$bI need you to meet with my friend in the Promenade and retrieve a signet ring. I would send my oaf of an apprentice, but he is not finished with the simple task I gave him.$b$bI am expecting a guest at any moment and I simply must have it before he arrives. Can you help me, friend?

identity.title: Elegant Design
identity.objectives: Convince Lady Anastae to give you the Gemcutter's Tome.
identity.description: Amateur merchants complain about supply and demand. Masters create their own.$b$bYou have done well retrieving the last two pieces I requested, but they are baubles compared to this.$b$bYour target is the Lady Anastae, and she has something very valuable of mine: A design for a masterwork gem cut. $b$bGo and get it from her by any means necessary, but take care. She is a master manipulator and will tell you all manner of lies.

AreaDescription.text: 说服安娜丝黛夫人把宝石切割大师的图鉴集交给你。
AreaDescription.english: Convince Lady Anastae to give you the Gemcutter's Tome.

identity.title: A Re-Warding Effort
identity.objectives: Activate $1oa Arcane Wards in Ambervale.
identity.description:
<This small device of elegant nightborne design crackles gently with arcane power.

Kel'danath's notes mention wards that keep the withered at bay. It seems he found some form of spellcasting that does not tempt their ravenous appetite for magic.

These may prove useful in your search for the missing arcanist.>

Objectives.text: 在琥珀谷激活$1oa个奥术结界。
Objectives.english: Activate $1oa Arcane Wards in Ambervale.

identity.title: Corrupted Studies
identity.objectives: Survey digsites in Stormheim and bring Brann back $1oa War of the Ancients Fragments.
identity.description: Stormheim is steeped with artifacts from tha War of the Ancients. Demon artifacts ta be exact.$b$bI think these artifacts can clue us into some knowledge about their leader, Sargeras. I've already found some fragments to a titan disc, but need ta find the rest of 'em.$b$bI need ya ta dig around Stormheim and see if ye can find any more fragments so we can reassemble the disc.

Objectives.text: 在风暴峡湾的挖掘场进行勘测，为布莱恩带回$1oa块上古之战碎片。
Objectives.english: Survey digsites in Stormheim and bring Brann back $1oa War of the Ancients Fragments.

identity.title: And Into the Fel Fire
identity.objectives: Survey digsites in Azsuna and find $1oa missing Parts of the Infernal Device and bring them back to Brann.
identity.description: I found something, $n. Well, a couple of things actually.$b$bFirst I found an ancient text talking about a demon who harnessed the power of the titan disc I've been searching for.$b$bThen I found a device which supposedly is used to summon 'im! Only, it's missin' some pieces from what I can make out.$b$bI'm sure if we survey around Azsuna some more, those missin' pieces are sure ta turn up.

Objectives.text: 在阿苏纳的挖掘场进行勘测，找到$1oa个遗失的地狱火装置零件，然后把它们带回去交给布莱恩。
Objectives.english: Survey digsites in Azsuna and find $1oa missing Parts of the Infernal Device and bring them back to Brann.

identity.title: Deciphering Demonology
identity.objectives: Crate artifacts into $1oa Restored Artifacts and find $2oa Chamber Key Fragments and bring them to Brann.
identity.description: I found a piece of what appears to be a key to something. I'm certain I can restore it if we can find the other bits.$b$bAfter that, we need to figure out what it's a key to. An' I think I know how to do that.$b$bI've been studying some of the artifacts I've found, and they seem to be pointing to a hidden chamber. I jes' need some more artifacts to study.

Objectives.text: 获得$1oa件修复的遗物，并找到$2oa块密室钥匙碎片，然后把它们交给布莱恩。
Objectives.english: Crate artifacts into $1oa Restored Artifacts and find $2oa Chamber Key Fragments and bring them to Brann.

identity.title: Echoes of My Ancestors
identity.objectives: Complete $1oa Highborne Archaeology Projects.
identity.description: This land holds many secrets and many artifacts of ancient times.$b$bFrom what I've been able to discern there's an artifact of great power close to here. I just need to narrow down its location.$b$bI'd like you to dig up more artifacts and learn what you can. When you feel you've done enough research, come back to me and share your knowledge.

Objectives.text: 完成$1oa项上层精灵考古工程。
Objectives.english: Complete $1oa Highborne Archaeology Projects.

identity.title: Sifting Through the Rubble
identity.objectives: Survey different areas around Suramar until you find the $1oa missing Jewels of the Crown.
identity.description: Then I believe it's clear what we must do next. Find the jewels.$b$bThey're bound to be here somewhere in Suramar, so we better start looking.$b$bI'll coordinate the search from here, while you and my assistants look for the jewels.

Objectives.text: 在苏拉玛的各个地方进行勘测，直到你找到$1oa件遗失的皇冠珠宝。
Objectives.english: Survey different areas around Suramar until you find the $1oa missing Jewels of the Crown.

identity.title: Explosive Results
identity.objectives: Use the goblin explosives to free $1oa Artifact Fragments from their geological prisons.
identity.description: As you may or may not have heard, I've been working with the goblins on using a new way of uncovering our artifacts.$b$bAnd if you know anything about goblins, you know that I'm talking about explosives.$b$bWe've only run a few tests here at my camp, but I would appreciate your help in testing this method out in the field.$b$bI've marked a location on your map that has some particularly difficult digs.

Objectives.text: 使用地精炸药，从地质环境中释放$1oa块神器碎片。
Objectives.english: Use the goblin explosives to free $1oa Artifact Fragments from their geological prisons.

identity.title: Narrowing Down
identity.objectives: Survey Suramar and uncover $1oa Tattered Highborne Scrolls.
identity.description: I was right about the nightborne here having objects of great power. I found an ancient text referring to such an object called the Orb of Sciallax.$b$bFrom what I recall in studying the War of the Ancients, Sciallax was a demon lord who came to Suramar and offered the elves at the time a powerful artifact in return for their servitude to the Legion.$b$bI haven't discovered the exact location yet as to the whereabouts, but perhaps some digging can yield us an answer.

Objectives.text: 在苏拉玛进行勘测，找到$1oa个破烂的上层精灵卷轴。
Objectives.english: Survey Suramar and uncover $1oa Tattered Highborne Scrolls.

identity.title: Tried and True
identity.objectives: Find the remaining $1oa Azsunian Key Mold Pieces and return them to Tae'thelan.
identity.description: I have realized through experience that the old methods are usually the best and for good reason. I'm done with alternate means of digging for now, and wish to focus on the right way to do things.$b$bThat being said, I believe I've found a new powerful artifact and I'll do literally anything to have it.$b$bI've uncovered a fragment that appears to be a mold for a key. I now simply need the other pieces.

Objectives.text: 找到其余的$1oa块阿苏纳钥匙模具组件，然后把它们交给泰瑟兰。
Objectives.english: Find the remaining $1oa Azsunian Key Mold Pieces and return them to Tae'thelan.

identity.title: Laying to Rest
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Bone Fragments of Eche'ro and return them to Lessah in Highmountain. Then observe the burial ceremony Lessah performs.
identity.description: If I was able to find a bone fragment in what appeared to be a random location, then that means Eche'ro's bones must be scattered around Highmountain.$b$bWe must find his remains and give him the proper burial he deserved.$b$bOh, I'm sorry, in case you weren't aware, Eche'ro was Huln Highmountain's mount and companion.$b$bHe deserves to be honored as Huln once was.

Objectives.text: 在至高岭找到$1oa块艾特洛的遗骨残片，并交给莱莎。然后旁观莱莎举行的葬礼。
Objectives.english: Find $1oa Bone Fragments of Eche'ro and return them to Lessah in Highmountain. Then observe the burial ceremony Lessah performs.

identity.title: They Become The Hunted
identity.objectives: Slay 6 Nightborne Trappers.
identity.description: The trapper you slew was but one of many.$b$bThe Nightborne are subjugating the local creatures, creating a sort of pleasurable exhibit. I think we can strike them in two places at once.$b$bDescend upon these trappers, $r. Let us teach them a lesson in respecting their prey.

identity.title: Survival of the Fittest
identity.objectives: Free $1oa exhibits from the Menagerie.
identity.description: The collar you took from the trapper is simple, but effective. Affixing the collar to a target will make them complacent and obedient to their Nightborne masters. Lilryia was able to reverse the spell using the traps you found.$b$bThe magics in the collar can now be used to cancel out the other collars.$b$bHow about giving the Nightborne a reminder that nature always finds a way?

Objectives.text: 在动物园释放$1oa个展览生物。
Objectives.english: Free $1oa exhibits from the Menagerie.

AreaDescription.text: 在动物园释放$1oa个展览生物。

identity.title: Into The Pit!
identity.objectives: Escort Angus to Felmaw Cavern in Felsoul Hold.
identity.description: The felstalker pits?!$b$bThere's no time to waste, $n!$b$b I canna' tell ye what the Burnin' Legion has planned for ol' Brambley, but it canna' be good!$b$bHurry! We've got to find him before the Burnin' Legion has their way with him!

AreaDescription.text: 护送安古斯到邪魂堡垒中的邪喉洞穴。
AreaDescription.english: Escort Angus to Felmaw Cavern in Felsoul Hold.

identity.title: Trapping Evolved
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Arcane Traps for Lilryia.
identity.description: The Nightborne are using magic for everything, even trapping.$b$bNighteyes saw them at work, laying down magical snares to capture prey rather than the kind our people use. $b$bBring me their traps so that I may study their make.

Objectives.text: 帮莉莉娅收集$1oa个奥术陷阱。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Arcane Traps for Lilryia.

identity.title: Apex Predator
identity.objectives: Find and slay the Nightborne keeping Su'esh obedient.
identity.description: I have good news and bad news, $r.$b$bThe bad news is that they somehow managed to capture and train a Devilsaur.$b$BThe good news is that it doesn't seem to have a collar and is tame. I imagine it must think that one of the Nightborne in there is its master. Find the pack leader and take him out, and we will set quite a beast upon them.

AreaDescription.text: 找到并消灭维持苏伊什驯服状态的夜之子。
AreaDescription.english: Find and slay the Nightborne keeping Su'esh obedient.

identity.title: Blast of Spice Fish
identity.objectives: Collect Toad Gizzards for Keelay.
identity.description: I have an ingredient that will make my fruit irresistible.$b$bNot many remember the delicacy of manatrout liquor. Its pungent aroma, the unctuous mouthfeel...$b$bThe toads near the northern river concentrate this additive in their gizzards. Fetch some stomachs for me, and we will have plenty.

identity.title: Fruit of the Doom
identity.objectives: Poison 3 Bowls of Fruit.
identity.description: Now is the time to strike.$b$bShadowbloom has... potent digestive qualities. Go sprinkle some on Daglir's fruit bowls and watch the show.$b$bMeanwhile, I will use the manatrout liquor to cement my position as the premier fruit vendor in the city.

Title.text: 紧急产品订单：夏斯卡格草

identity.title: All That Glitters
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Glowlamps.
identity.description: Now that the shield is down, the older settlements outside the city have been on my mind.$b$bDid you know that I helped create the filigree on the arcane lamps that are used throughout the city? A simple task, one of my first...$b$bNo matter. Nostalgia is the enemy of progress. The lamps are made of material better used in my new works.$b$bThose wretched harpies probably have several decorating their nests. Bring back any you find.

Objectives.text: 取回$1oa盏魔法路灯。
Objectives.english: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Glowlamps.

identity.title: Pry It From Their Cold, Feral Claws
identity.objectives: Retrieve 8 Harpy Necklaces for Lespin.
identity.description: The shield being lowered presents a unique opportunity for new styles.$b$bFeathers, bone and other primitive materials are suddenly fashionable again. Who would have thought they could grow tired of my masterpieces?$b$bVenture out of the city and collect necklaces from the harpies on the southern cliffs. Etching my mark into them should net me a tidy profit.

AreaDescription.text: 为勒斯平取得8件鹰身人项链。

Title.text: 毫无刮痕的角鹰兽鳞片
需要的補給品：石皮皮革
苏拉玛贵族区奖励任务

identity.title: Suramar Noble District Heroic Reward Quest

Title.text: 苏拉玛贵族区史诗奖励任务
Title.english: Suramar Noble District Heroic Reward Quest

identity.title: Estate Jewelry: A Braggart's Brooch
identity.objectives: Retrieve Lespin's Brooch from Naltethis Springblade.
identity.description: Amateur merchants worry about losing face from bad products. Masters worry about losing face from bad customers.$b$bNaltethis Springblade has grown too bold for his station, and as such has lost much standing in the eyes of the city's elite.$b$bI sold this man a brooch, a clasp he wears on his cape. I am careful to only sell to those above my station.$b$bMy pieces never tarnish, but my name and reputation are much more fragile. Relieve him of my property before he lowers me further.

AreaDescription.text: 从纳特西斯·冰刃那里取得勒斯平的胸针。
AreaDescription.english: Retrieve Lespin's Brooch from Naltethis Springblade.

identity.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
identity.objectives: Find and retrieve Lespin's 'art' from Mornath.
identity.description: An amateur merchant looks back on their previous work as a learning experience. A master knows that some things are better left forgotten.$b$bI was... vain, centuries ago. Desperate to prove myself, I took on a bold commission.$b$bFind him and bring... it... back. You will know what I am talking about when you see it.$b$bHe resides near the villa south of this courtyard.

AreaDescription.text: 从莫纳斯那里找到并取回勒斯平的“作品”。
AreaDescription.english: Find and retrieve Lespin's 'art' from Mornath.

identity.title: Felsoul Teleporter Online!
identity.objectives: Infuse the Beacon with Ancient Mana.
identity.description: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

AreaDescription.text: 为安娜丝黛夫人取得5张魔刃豹皮。
AreaDescription.english: Obtain 5 Mana Saber Hides for Lady Anastae.

identity.title: Taking a Promenade
identity.objectives: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.
identity.description: We must learn much about our long-lost kin if we are to fight them.$b$bWe dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and gather intelligence. The Sentinels sent their own scout as well, hopefully she is smart enough to not get herself killed before reporting in.$b$bThey have not returned in some time, and we must suspect the worst.$b$bFind them and we shall see what we are up against.

AreaDescription.english: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.

identity.title: A Forgotten Enemy
identity.objectives: Activate the Ethereal Communication Device at the Azure Dragonshrine.
identity.description:
The device still hums with power. It must have been abandoned not long ago.

The nearby switch appears to activate it.

identity.title: Eyes of the Dragon
identity.objectives: Scout out the key locations in Coldarra.
identity.description:
You should travel at once to Coldarra in Borean Tundra, $n. There, I would recommend you scout out a few key locations and report back to me. 

I know the area well, and should be able to tell you how to proceed.

Make haste!

identity.title: Harnessing the Holy Fire
identity.objectives: Empower yourself with Unstable Holy Energy by defeating Wraths of the Light or siphoning from Breaches of Holy Energy around the foundation of the Nexus.
identity.description:
The energy from Light's Wrath lashes out from within the weakened Nexus Vault.  We may be able to use this raw, chaotic energy to our advantage.

If we can harness this energy and feed it into the Surge Needles, it should cause a rather... destructive reaction.

identity.title: Unleashing Judgment
identity.objectives: Use your built up Unstable Holy Energy to destroy the Surge Needles in Coldarra.
identity.description:
You have the power you need to destroy the Surge Needles. 

At the location of the breaches where the Surge Needles pierce the ground, there will be a large concentration of void energy. Focus the power of Light's Wrath into these points of focused void, and the reaction should cause an overload, destroying the Surge Needle above.

You must act quickly. The Ethereum likely won't sit idly by as you lay waste to their machinations.

identity.title: The Nexus Vault
identity.objectives: Defeat Nexus-Prince Bilaal and claim Light's Wrath.
identity.description:
If the Ethereum managed to capture Azuregos, then they are more powerful than I imagined. 

We have not always seen eye to eye, Azuregos and I, but he is still my kin. Since you seek to put an end to the ethereals and claim Light's Wrath, I would ask that you also free my brother from their grip.

With the Surge Needles destroyed, the shield has dissipated. The Nexus awaits, $n.

Title.text: 产品订单：阿苏奈特黄晶吊坠
产品订单：深海琥珀指环

identity.title: Work Order: Word of Critical Strike

Title.english: Work Order: Word of Critical Strike

Title.text: 产品订单：头戴式瞬发机枪
产品订单：泵动式绷带枪
危险：考勒里安、奥特莉娅和塞莱妮

identity.title: The Gates of Valor
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Chipped Titan Disc Fragments by surveying near the Gates of Valor in Stormheim.
identity.description: Ye'd not normally know it, but the terraced entrance to the vrykul's Halls o' Valor is a fine place for findin' ancient artifacts. Problem is, the place is just a big mess with demons at the time.$b$bWell, ye've not got much choice. If the disc isn't elsewhere in Stormheim, it most likely lies at the Gates of Valor. Good luck, $n.

Objectives.text: 在风暴峡湾的勇者之门附近进行勘测，取得$1oa块破损的泰坦圆盘碎片。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Chipped Titan Disc Fragments by surveying near the Gates of Valor in Stormheim.

identity.title: The Masks We Wear
identity.objectives: Speak with $3oa Masqued Revelers while in costume, then speak with Ly'leth Lunastre.
identity.description:
Many nightborne had pinned their hopes on Thalyssra deposing the Grand Magistrix. Since she disappeared, dissenting voices have grown silent.

We must spread the word, discreetly, among the populace. Ly'leth Lunastre will be a perfect ally in this. She is a socialite with many connections, and she is no friend of the Legion.

Ly'leth hosts a masquerade party at her estate where rumors are traded like coin - and brandished like daggers.

Let us invite ourselves in.

Objectives.text: 乔装打扮后与$3oa名假面狂欢者谈一谈，然后去找莉莉丝·月郡。
Objectives.english: Speak with $3oa Masqued Revelers while in costume, then speak with Ly'leth Lunastre.

Title.text: 奈萨里奥的巢穴：黯石奴隶
奈萨里奥的巢穴：晶化碾压者

identity.title: The Master's Legacy
identity.objectives: Investigate the Gemcutter's Tomb.
identity.description: You work for a murderer and a thief.$b$bThat design he wants? It is called the magistrix cut, and it was perfected by my husband. He was killed by Lespin for his secret.$b$bI had him entombed in a small cave north of the city, for we could not make the trip to Tel'anor. Buried with him is a tome that contains the secrets of the design.$b$bRetrieve the design and keep it out of his hands!

AreaDescription.text: 调查宝石切割大师的墓穴。

identity.title: A Better Future
identity.objectives: Rescue $1oa Shal'dorei Insurgents in the Grand Promenade.
identity.description: We must move quickly, $n. I must save as many of my people as I can before the attack begins.$b$bWord has gotten out in the city that there is a safe haven with us and some no longer fear exile.$b$bVenture into the Grand Promenade, champion. Find those willing to join us and let them know it is time they made their escape.

Objectives.text: 在大步道营救$1oa名夏多雷起义者。
Objectives.english: Rescue $1oa Shal'dorei Insurgents in the Grand Promenade.

identity.title: A Forgotten Enemy
identity.objectives: Activate the Ethereal Communication Device at the Azure Dragonshrine.
identity.description:
The device still hums with power. It must have been abandoned not long ago.

The nearby switch appears to activate it.

identity.title: Eyes of the Dragon
identity.objectives: Scout out the key locations in Coldarra.
identity.description:
You should travel at once to Coldarra in Borean Tundra, $n. There, I would recommend you scout out a few key locations and report back to me. 

I know the area well, and should be able to tell you how to proceed.

Make haste!

identity.title: Harnessing the Arcane
identity.objectives: Empower yourself with Unstable Arcane Energy by defeating Arcane Aberrants or siphoning from Breaches of Arcane Energy around the foundation of the Nexus.
identity.description:
The energy from Aluneth lashes out from within the weakened Nexus Vault.  We may be able to use this raw, chaotic energy to our advantage.

If we can harness this energy and feed it into the Surge Needles, it should cause a rather... destructive reaction.

identity.title: Arcane Unleashed
identity.objectives: Use your built up Unstable Arcane Energy to destroy the Surge Needles in Coldarra.
identity.description:
You have the power you need to destroy the Surge Needles. 

At the location of the breaches where the Surge Needles pierce the ground, there will be a large concentration of void energy. Focus the power of Aluneth into these points. The reaction should cause an overload, destroying the Surge Needle above.

You must act quickly. The Ethereum won't sit idly by as you lay waste to their machinations.

identity.title: The Nexus Vault
identity.objectives: Defeat Nexus-Prince Bilaal and claim Aluneth, Greatstaff of the Magna.
identity.description:
If the Ethereum managed to capture Azuregos, then they are more powerful than I imagined. 

We have not always seen eye to eye, Azuregos and I, but he is still my kin. Since you seek to put an end to the ethereals and claim Aluneth, I ask that you also free my brother from their grip.

With the Surge Needles destroyed, the shield has dissipated. The Nexus awaits, $n.

identity.title: The Twilight Master
identity.objectives: Defeat the Mistress of Twilight.
identity.description: There is only one more thing that remains, Farseer $n. We must confront the leader of the Twilight's Hammer and put an end to their sinister plot once and for all.$b$bWithout their so-called master, the remaining cultists will be forced to retreat from Deepholm.$b$bOnly when The Twilight's Hammer has been crushed and Deepholm has been saved, will we have the support of Therazane against the demons of the Burning Legion.

identity.title: Knocked for a Loop
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Salteye Bangles.
identity.description: While you're focused on murlocs...$b$bMany murlocs are known to wear jewelry to attract a mate. I'm willing to bet that we can use some of the same jewels they use.$b$bCollect some of their jewelry and bring it back to me. The wetter, the better!

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个盐目手镯。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Salteye Bangles.

identity.title: Shipwrecked Sailors
identity.objectives: Put $1oa Queen's Reprisal Sailors out of their misery.
identity.description:
<The gilblin and makrura of Mak'rana have captured the forsaken sailors from the nearby shipwreck.>

<It looks like the sailors are being poisoned and worse. Best to put them out of their misery.>

Objectives.text: 为$1oa名女王的复仇号水手终结痛苦。
Objectives.english: Put $1oa Queen's Reprisal Sailors out of their misery.

identity.title: Scouting the Crimson Thicket
identity.objectives: Find Lilryia Dawnwind in Dawncleft.
identity.description: If you are heading east, there is something I would ask of you.$b$bWhile we struck camp some of our caravan left to scout around the city. Lilryia Dawnwind has been gone too long.$b$bI would be most grateful if you would go check on her safety. She said she was going to scout out the ruins of Dawncleft.

AreaDescription.text: 在晨曦裂口寻找莉莉娅·晨风。

identity.title: Breaking the Seal
identity.objectives: Break the Seal of the Tides, Seal of the Earth and Seal of the Sky.
identity.description:
<As you behold the relic, Thalyssra's voice echoes in your mind.>

You found it! But it is sealed away tight.

Search the room for a way to break those seals.

identity.title: The Valewalker's Burden
identity.objectives: Activate the Fal'adora Beacon in Temple of Fal'adora.
identity.description:
The seed is awakening. Without power it will quickly wither and die.

We must carry the seed out of here and plant it somewhere safe.

I am not strong enough to bear this burden. But you... you are brimming with power. I can sense it. 

Please take the seed.

identity.title: Halls of Valor: The Bear King

Title.english: Halls of Valor: The Bear King

identity.title: Halls of Valor: A Worthy Challenge

Title.text: 英灵殿：激动人心的挑战
Title.english: Halls of Valor: A Worthy Challenge

identity.title: Halls of Valor: A Gift for Vethir

Title.english: Halls of Valor: A Gift for Vethir

identity.title: Shipwrecked Sailors
identity.objectives: Rescue $1oa Queen's Reprisal Sailors.
identity.description:
<The gilblin and makrura of Mak'rana have captured the forsaken sailors from the nearby shipwreck.>

<The sailors are being treated very poorly. It looks like a rescue operation is in order.>

Objectives.text: 解救$1oa名女王的复仇号水手。
Objectives.english: Rescue $1oa Queen's Reprisal Sailors.

identity.title: Their Dying Breaths
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Cracked Ley Crystals, then use them to resuscitate the Mana-Drained Whelplings.
identity.description: I have precious little time. As we speak, my troops are defending against an onslaught of withered elves.$b$bThese four whelplings are near death. Their lives are of the utmost importance to our flight, as they may be some of the last whelplings Senegos can rear.$b$bSome cracked ley crystals should bring them back to their senses.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa块开裂的魔网水晶，并用它们使法力枯竭的雏龙复苏。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Cracked Ley Crystals, then use them to resuscitate the Mana-Drained Whelplings.

identity.title: The Bigger They Are, The Harder They Fel
identity.objectives: Assist Kyrtos with his ritual.
identity.description: I have had it with these small fry, assistant. Time to go straight to the top.$b$bThe tome is the key! The key to unlocking the potential within our people.$b$bDo not worry, young one. I have enough power to complete the task at hand. Let us harness fel magic and change the future.$b$bFollow me and witness the redemption of the shal'dorei!

identity.title: Arkethrax
identity.objectives: Slay Arkethrax.
identity.description: Within the Ingress is a demon who must die.$b$bArkethrax is a creature of cunning evil. If left unchecked he will be able to use the Ingress as a staging point for targeted assaults that will decimate our forces.$b$bI, for one, have no intention of underestimating this opponent and shall join you on the battlefield when you are ready to fight him.

PortraitGiverText.text: 邪焰隘口的指挥官
PortraitGiverText.english: Commander of Felblaze Ingress

identity.title: Wanding 101
identity.objectives: Practice using your wand on $1oa Wand Targets.
identity.description: We'll start with some wand work. You have your wand with you? Good.$b$bI've set up a number of targets around the hall. Use your wand to hit as many as you can.$b$bAnd no point-blank shots! That's cheating.

Objectives.text: 练习用魔杖击中$1oa个魔杖目标。
Objectives.english: Practice using your wand on $1oa Wand Targets.

identity.title: Aid for the Ashen
identity.objectives: Defeat $1oa Eredar Soul Lashers and free their captives.
identity.description: Turn your eyes above and you will see the cause of our misfortune. Ever since that ship appeared the attacks have been relentless. Many of the Ashen have been captured and even now I can hear their screams of torture.$b$bPlease, go out there and rescue as many of my followers as you can. They do not deserve the fate that awaits them if left in the Legion's grip.

Objectives.text: 击败$1oa个艾瑞达鞭魂者，救出他们手里的俘虏。
Objectives.english: Defeat $1oa Eredar Soul Lashers and free their captives.

identity.title: Put It All on Red
identity.objectives: Collect Steelscale's Fin from Steelscale in Citrine Bay.
identity.description:
All right, I've got one last beasty to send you after. He's a bit far out, but trust me, it'll be worth it. This one I put a huge wager on!

Along the eastern coast swims a great shark the locals call Steelscale. They say his hide is near impenetrable.

But you're gonna prove them wrong, aren't ya chum? Bring me his fin, and those tauren will have to fork over a princely sum.

PortraitGiverText.text: 黄金海湾的威胁。
PortraitGiverText.english: The menace of Citrine Bay.

identity.title: Finishing the Job
identity.objectives: Assassinate Cade Shadowgaze at the Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands and search his body for information.
identity.description: Garona set out to assassinate the leaders of a Legion cult some time ago. We haven't heard from her since.$B$BTo make matters worse, she took the Kingslayers with her. She knows they bring out the worst in her!$B$BYour best bet to find Garona is by continuing her work. Our intel points to a warlock by the name of Caden Shadowgaze inducting new recruits at the Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands. See if he has anything useful in his pockets.$b$bOnce he's dead, I mean.

identity.title: No Sanctuary
identity.objectives: Assassinate Felcaller Whitley at Raven Hill in Duskwood and search his body for information.
identity.description: We have one other lead that may prove useful. Goes by Felcaller Whitley, another of the cult's elite. He's eluded our agents at every turn.$B$BOur latest reconnaissance report puts him somewhere in the village of Raven Hill in Duskwood. He's sure to have information vital to your search.$B$BYou know what to do.

identity.title: Move Like No Other
identity.objectives: Chase down the Sneaky Imp and recover the Grimoire of Arcane Ways.
identity.description:
Sorry about the holographic projection... I literally need to be in two places at once these days.

A holy barrier that protects against fel magic, you say? I have just the thing to bypass it and enable Malevolence's teleport.

<The high elf rummages around in his pack, a shocked look quickly coming over his face.>

Sneaky! Look there... that imp just made off with it!

PortraitGiverText.text: 捉住鬼祟的小鬼，找回魔典：奥术之道。
PortraitGiverText.english: Catch the imp and recover the Grimoire of Arcane Ways!

identity.title: Mountainstrider Round-Up
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Frightened Mountainstriders and return them to Liza Galestride's stable.
identity.description:
Stranger! You are the one I have heard of?

When the kerfuffle with the drogbar happened, some of the young moose ran off!

I can't chase them down or the others might wander off as well.

Could you bring them back here?

Objectives.text: 找到$1oa头惊恐的山地鹿，并把它们带回莉萨·驭风的兽栏里。
Objectives.english: Find $1oa Frightened Mountainstriders and return them to Liza Galestride's stable.

identity.title: Ceremonial Drums
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Large, $2oa Medium, and $3oa Small Ceremonial Drums in Thunder Totem.
identity.description:
Those foolish calves!

They've made off with our ceremonial drums again, treating them as toys... as... common drums!

Can you help me find them? They must be scattered to all corners of Thunder Totem by now, discarded as soon as the fun dries up.

Objectives.text: 在雷霆图腾找到$1oa面大型、$2oa面中型、以及$3oa面小型仪式用鼓。
Objectives.english: Find $1oa Large, $2oa Medium, and $3oa Small Ceremonial Drums in Thunder Totem.

identity.title: Bolas Bastion
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Coven attackers.
identity.description:
I received word that a coven of harpies and their rocs plan to attack in force.

They'll be coming from the mountains to the north.

Use one of the bolas launchers and I'll man the other.

Quick!

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个巫环攻击者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Coven attackers.

identity.title: Confrontation at the Black Temple
identity.objectives: Use the Gateway to the Black Temple and confront Akama.
identity.description:
The book from Lan'dalock is very enlightening. It describes a technique which will provide a simple and elegant bypass around the Black Temple's holy barriers.

I will need but a moment to summon a gateway. Stand back, please.

PortraitGiverText.text: 前往黑暗神殿与阿卡玛对峙。说服他加入你的队伍，一起对抗燃烧军团。
PortraitGiverText.english: Travel to the Black Temple and confront Akama. Convince him to join forces with you in the fight against the Burning Legion.

identity.title: Return to the Fel Hammer
identity.objectives: Speak with Battlelord Gaardoun on the Fel Hammer.
identity.description:
$n, Battlelord Gaardoun asked me to retrieve you. He says there is a very important matter that he needs your help with.

He requests your presence back on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible.

PortraitGiverText.text: 指挥官，请尽快返回邪能之槌号。
PortraitGiverText.english: Return to me on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible, commander.

identity.title: Demonic Improvements
identity.objectives: Listen to Loramus Thalipedes' story and then upgrade your Class Hall.
identity.description:
Having Loramus back will work greatly to our advantage, despite the fact that he's trapped inside Razelikh's body... and also that the demon sometimes takes control.

Still, he was one of our most powerful demon hunters. And now, he also has the knowledge of a dreadlord at his disposal.

I think we should have him share his knowledge and wisdom with us to improve our odds in this war.

PortraitGiverText.text: 虽然他的样子是污染者拉瑟莱克，但实际是恶魔猎手洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯的灵魂在控制这个恐惧魔王……大多数时候是这样。
PortraitGiverText.english: He may look like Razelikh the Defiler, but the soul of the demon hunter, Loramus Thalipedes is actually in control of this dreadlord... mostly.

identity.title: You Never Know Until You Scry
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Hatecoil Glyptics.
identity.description: In order to find the spirits of our family, I will need materials to scry their location.$b$bThe naga carry magical trinkets imbued with ley energy that is better-attuned to this land than anything we have in Dalaran. If I had a few of those, I could do some real scrying.

Objectives.text: 取得$1oa块积怨宝石。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Hatecoil Glyptics.

identity.title: Noggenfogger's Reasonable Request
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Aethril.
identity.description:
Oh, the gall of that little green-skinned twerp! Marin Noggenfogger is blackmailing us. He says that if we do not meet his "very reasonable requisition request", he is going to close off access to the crucible.

Marin's asking for a hefty amount of Aethril. He said something about you recently holding a blade to his throat and that he's simply returning the favor.

Of course, if you would rather, I can eliminate him.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa株安瑟瑞尔花。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Aethril.

identity.title: Deadlier Warglaives
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Obliterum, which can be obtained either from your Forge of Fate in Dalaran's Magus Commerce Exchange or from the Auction House.
identity.description:
Loramus has researched a way to make our warglaives even deadlier, especially against demons.

If he's to be trusted, he says that all he needs is an amount of Obliterum. Normally, the substance is used to improve the protection of armor, but Loramus insists he can use it for our warglaives.

I am certain we will all benefit from their increased deadliness on the battlefield.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份抑魔金。你可以从达拉然魔法商业区的命运熔炉获得抑魔金，也可以在拍卖行购买。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Obliterum, which can be obtained either from your Forge of Fate in Dalaran's Magus Commerce Exchange or from the Auction House.

identity.title: A Very Special Kind of Fuel
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Sovereign Souls from bosses in Legion dungeons.
identity.description:
All Legion constructs, including the Fel Hammer, are powered by souls. If we are going to take the command center to Niskara, we are going to need some very powerful souls, indeed!

You are a very creative person, $n. I am certain that you will find a way to get what we need from the right sorts of creatures.

Objectives.text: 在《军团再临》地下城里收集$1oa个优质灵魂。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Sovereign Souls from bosses in Legion dungeons.

identity.title: Malace in Vrykul Land
identity.objectives: Grab a flight from Aludane Whitecloud and find Malace Shade in Stormheim.
identity.description:
I did some recon in Stormheim. What I discovered is that the Tideskorn are a tribe of vrykul who have been cut-off from the sea by their kvaldir brethren. Many of the Tideskorn have pledged their services to the Legion and become Felskorn.

Malace Shade was last seen heading toward the Felskorn Warcamp. It is likely that she was captured.

I have arranged a flight to Stormheim for you. When you are ready, you can use the gateway to travel to Dalaran and speak with Aludane Whitecloud at Krasus' Landing.

PortraitGiverText.text: 到风暴峡湾找到这个守望者。她之前朝蔑魔战争营地去了。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find this Warden in Stormheim. Last seen heading toward the Tideskorn Warcamp.

identity.title: Rune Ruination: Runeskeld Rollo
identity.objectives: Collect Rollo's Rune.
identity.description: <Collect the rune from Runeskeld Rollo to deactivate this runestone.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 除掉他，拿到他手里的符文。
PortraitGiverText.english: Kill him and take the rune he is guarding.

identity.title: Rune Ruination: Runelord Ragnar
identity.objectives: Collect Ragnar's Rune.
identity.description: <Collect the rune from Runelord Ragnar to deactivate this runestone. If you do not already have one, obtain a grapple launcher in order to scale the walls of Hrydshal.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 你需要他的邪能符文来使符文石失效。
PortraitGiverText.english: You need his fel rune to deactivate the runestone.

identity.title: Rune Ruination: Runesage Floki
identity.objectives: Collect Floki's Rune.
identity.description: <This runestone is entrapping Malace Shade. It can only be destroyed by using Runesage Floki's rune upon it.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 找到并消灭弗洛奇。拿走他的符文，这样你才可以救出玛拉丝。
PortraitGiverText.english: Hunt down and slay Floki. Take his rune so that you can set Malace free.

Title.text: 黑心林地：被维护的维护者

identity.title: Where the Wildkin Are
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Owlbeasts and $2oa Undulating Boneslimes within Lostlight Grotto.
identity.description:
Owlbeasts are often charged with protecting places of importance to Elune. But if her influence over them wanes or is cut off, the creatures can become dangerous.

These wildkin, unfortunately, must be dealt with. The recent disturbances in Val'sharah have driven these creatures to madness.

Once an individual is lost, there is only one way to address the problem.

I cannot bring myself to kill one of Elune's creations, but I know what must be done.

Objectives.text: 在失落之光岩洞中杀掉$1oa只枭兽和$2oa只波动的骨质软泥怪。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Owlbeasts and $2oa Undulating Boneslimes within Lostlight Grotto.

identity.title: Emerald Sisters
identity.objectives: Rescue $1oa Sisters of the Moon in Lostlight Grotto.
identity.description:
The owlbeasts here are disconnected from Elune.

A contingent of dryads went into their territory to find out what went wrong, but none of them have returned.

I fear the worst, and I believe they are  in need of rescue.

While I try to learn if the owlkin can be saved, I would appreciate your help in freeing any Sisters you find in the grotto.

Objectives.text: 在失落之光岩洞援救$1oa名月之姐妹。
Objectives.english: Rescue $1oa Sisters of the Moon in Lostlight Grotto.

identity.title: Strange Bedfellows
identity.objectives: Meet Malace Shade on the bridge at the Gates of Valor and then slay Lochaber.
identity.description:
The reason why I came out here was to capture or kill a fel lord named, Lochaber. I am no longer in a capturing mood.

I'll grab my weapon and then head up to the bridge in front of the Gates of Valor. That place is a scary mess full of Felskorn vrykul and demons.

How do you think I got caught?

So, I'd rather not go back in there. But, I think I know a way to get the demon to come out to us.

PortraitGiverText.text: 帮玛拉丝·夜影消灭这个邪能领主，然后她就会告诉你怎么取回萨格里特钥石。
PortraitGiverText.english: Help Malace Shade kill this fel lord and she will tell you how to recover the Sargerite Keystone.

identity.title: Moon Reaver
identity.objectives: Defeat Boneflux and rescue Keeper Remulos in The Undergorge.
identity.description:
We must not delay! If Keeper Remulos is in danger, he must be protected.

With the dreamcatcher, we should be able to enter the lair of the owlbeast Boneflux.

It must be defeated so Keeper Remulos can break free!

Title.text: 艾萨拉之眼：阿苏纳珍珠

identity.title: Maw of Souls: Menace of the Seas

Title.english: Maw of Souls: Menace of the Seas

Title.text: 群星庭院：机器里的鬼魂
Title.english: Court of Stars: Wraith in the Machine

identity.title: Court of Stars: Bring Me the Eyes

Title.text: 群星庭院：把眼镜带给我
Title.english: Court of Stars: Bring Me the Eyes

identity.title: Keeping the Peace
identity.objectives: Exorcise $1oa spirits.
identity.description: The lost souls roaming the cemetery grounds have been drawn to the realm of the living in the wake of the Light's disturbance. In truth, they merely seek comfort... as we all do in these dark times since Highlord Tirion's passing.$B$BHowever, their unrest threatens the very sanctity of the tomb we have sworn to protect. If we are to restore peace here, then they must be exorcised.

Objectives.text: 清除$1oa个灵魂。
Objectives.english: Exorcise $1oa spirits.

identity.title: Maw of Souls: From Hell's Mouth

Title.english: Maw of Souls: From Hell's Mouth

identity.title: Court of Stars: Disarming the Watch

Title.text: 眾星之廷：解除崗哨的武裝
Title.english: Court of Stars: Disarming the Watch

identity.title: Court of Stars: The Deceitful Student

Title.english: Court of Stars: The Deceitful Student

identity.title: Maw of Souls: Return of the Beast

Title.english: Maw of Souls: Return of the Beast

Title.text: 危险：镰刀大师希尔拉曼

identity.title: The Scarlet Commander
identity.objectives: Slay High Commander Goodchilde.
identity.description: There is only one more obstacle standing between us and the tomb of Sally Whitemane.$b$bHigh Commander Goodchilde guards the path to the tomb. Although he is a zealot and a murderer, he is still a hardened knight who has dedicated his life to the eradication of our kind.$b$bHe should not be underestimated...$b$bSlay him and our work here will be nearly done.

identity.title: Moist Around the Hedges
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Moist Grizzlecombs  in Grizzleweald.
identity.description:
These fruit appear to be food to grell.

Old Grizzleback might appreciate it if they were removed from the village.

Objectives.text: 在灰白原野中收集$1oa个潮湿的刺肉果。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Moist Grizzlecombs  in Grizzleweald.

identity.title: Grell to Pay
identity.objectives: Defeat Enderkind in Grizzleweald.
identity.description:
The ringleader of the grell must be sent to his final rest.

You will know him by the white of his skin and the bite of his tongue.

PortraitGiverText.text: 劣魔头目。首席捣蛋鬼。暴力又难以捉摸。满嘴恶言。
PortraitGiverText.english: Ringleader of the grell. Chief mischief maker. Violent and unpredictable. Foulmouthed.

identity.title: All Grell Broke Loose
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Wildeyed Undergrell in Grizzleweald.
identity.description:
The grell are in a frenzy, attacking my brethren and destroying our village!

Please, stranger, help us send these wicked miscreants to the soil.

Objectives.text: 在灰白原野杀掉$1oa个怒目地劣魔。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Wildeyed Undergrell in Grizzleweald.

identity.title: Grassroots Effort
identity.objectives: Use Old Grizzelback's Staff to destroy $1oa snarled brambles in Grizzleweald.
identity.description:
When I arrived at my home, the front door was barred by magical roots.

I was able to remove them, but few of my tribe possess the necessary ability to do so themselves.

Take my staff. Its powers will easily disentangle the obstructing roots.

Objectives.text: 在灰白原野中使用老灰背的法杖摧毁$1oa个纠缠的荆棘。
Objectives.english: Use Old Grizzelback's Staff to destroy $1oa snarled brambles in Grizzleweald.

identity.title: The Way Back Home
identity.objectives: Activate the beacon.
identity.description: Hello? This is Chief Telemancer Oculeth. I see you have emerged safely!$B$BI am locking in your location as we speak. I will need you to activate the beacon on your end so we can establish a teleportation link.$b$bGot it? Good.

PortraitGiverText.text: 激活传送门，并返回沙尔艾兰。
PortraitGiverText.english: Activate the portal and return to Shal'Aran.
