identity.title: Confrontation at the Black Temple
identity.objectives: Use the Gateway to the Black Temple and confront Akama.
identity.description:
The book from Lan'dalock is very enlightening. It describes a technique which will provide a simple and elegant bypass around the Black Temple's holy barriers.

I will need but a moment to summon a gateway. Stand back, please.

PortraitGiverText.text: 前往黑暗神殿与阿卡玛作战。说服他加入你的队伍，一起对抗燃烧军团。
PortraitGiverText.english: Travel to the Black Temple and confront Akama. Convince him to join forces with you in the fight against the Burning Legion.

identity.title: Vault of the Wardens: Startup Sequence

Title.english: Vault of the Wardens: Startup Sequence

identity.title: Vault of the Wardens: A Grim Matter

Title.text: 守望者地窟：严峻的问题
Title.english: Vault of the Wardens: A Grim Matter

identity.title: Stone Drake Rescue
identity.objectives: Rescue $oa Stone Drakes in the Pale Roost by defeating the troggs that torment them.
identity.description: When that demon of yours fell into my realm he must have done something to the troggs. They were never a threat to my beloved stone drakes before.$b$bNow they're loose all over the Pale Roost, subduing drakes on the ground. Put a stop to this insult at once, and free those drakes! They may be of use to us later.

Objectives.text: 在苍白栖地击败折磨幼龙的穴居人，救出$oa只石龙。
Objectives.english: Rescue $oa Stone Drakes in the Pale Roost by defeating the troggs that torment them.

identity.title: A Royal Audience
identity.objectives: Report to King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: $n,$B$BMy father lived by the sword, as you do. He taught me that if we truly want peace for our kingdom then we must be willing to fight to preserve it, as you have fought.$B$BYou have demonstrated valor of the highest order - bravery unsurpassed in the ranks of the Alliance. Valor that must be recognized.$B$BPlease join me in Stormwind Keep at once so that you can be properly rewarded for your service.$B$B- King Anduin Wrynn

identity.title: A Royal Audience
identity.objectives: Report to Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
identity.description: $n,$B$BThose who do not stand with the Horde stand against it. You, champion, have cut down such enemies in droves.$B$BI admire your dedication. It is through you that we will rise up, more powerful than ever, and put the Alliance in their place once and for all.$B$BJoin me in the Undercity at once. Your victories must be met with due reward.$B$B- Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner

Title.text: 危险：符文先知希格维德

identity.title: Return to the Chamber of Shadows
identity.objectives: Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in the Chamber of Shadows.
identity.description:
Lord Jorach Ravenholdt sent me out to find you, $n. He wants your counsel on some matter of importance.

He requests your presence back at the Chamber of Shadows.

PortraitGiverText.text: 等你有了时间，就尽快返回暗影大厅。
PortraitGiverText.english: Return to me in the Chamber of Shadows at your earliest convenience.

identity.title: What Winstone Suggests
identity.objectives: Speak to Winstone Wolfe.
identity.description:
If anyone can improve the way things run around here, it's Winstone Wolfe. I tell ya, the man is a miracle-worker!

Now that he's workin' for us, shall we pick his brain an' see what he suggests?

PortraitGiverText.text: “孤狼”是来帮助我们解决问题的。他才智过人、魅力非凡，同时还散发出一丝可怕的杀气。
PortraitGiverText.english: The Wolf is here to solve problems for us. He's brilliant and charming with an extra helping of deadly piled on top.

Title.text: 危险：被遗忘的妮拉西娅

identity.title: Uniting the Isles
identity.objectives: Earn at least Friendly reputation with the factions of the Broken Isles.
identity.description: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们需要你的帮助！
PortraitGiverText.english: We need your help!

identity.title: A Hero's Weapon
identity.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Seed of Ages and raise your weapon.
identity.description: $ct, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Circle.$b$bWe are inspired by your determination and have developed a new technique that will bind the power of your weapon with the Emerald Dream itself!$b$bEverything is prepared. When you are ready we shall begin.

Description.text: $ct，虽然我们相处的时间尚短，但你已经为我们的议会做了太多的贡献。$b$b在你执著精神的激励下，我们找到了一种新的方法，它可以将翡翠梦境的力量赋予你的武器！$b$b一切都已就绪，只要你做好准备，我就可以开始。
Description.english: $ct, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Circle.$b$bWe are inspired by your determination and have developed a new technique that will bind the power of your weapon with the Emerald Dream itself!$b$bEverything is prepared. When you are ready we shall begin.

identity.title: A Hero's Weapon
identity.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Felblood Altar and raise your weapon.
identity.description: $ct, our research into the Felblood Altar has proven useful. We've developed a ritual that should unleash the full powers of your artifact weapon!$b$bSay the word, and we shall begin the ritual at once!

Description.text: $ct，我们对魔血祭坛的研究果然是值得的。我们发明了一种仪式，它可以解放这把武器真正的力量！$b$b只要你下令，我们就可以立刻开始仪式！
Description.english: $ct, our research into the Felblood Altar has proven useful. We've developed a ritual that should unleash the full powers of your artifact weapon!$b$bSay the word, and we shall begin the ritual at once!

identity.title: A Hero's Weapon
identity.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Forge of the Guardian and raise your weapon.
identity.description: $ct, in our short time together you have done much for our order.$b$bThrough your words and deeds we've been inspired to redouble our efforts and I'm proud to report that we've discovered a new technique that may be of use to you.$b$bIf you have a moment, $ct, I would be pleased to show you the fruit of our research.

Description.text: $ct，虽然我们相处的时间尚短，但你已经为我们做了太多的贡献。$b$b在你的一言一行激励下，我们无不加倍努力。我很荣幸地宣布，我们找到了一种新的方法，它或许可以帮助到你。$b$b如果你有时间的话，$ct，我很乐意向你展示一下我们的研究成果。
Description.english: $ct, in our short time together you have done much for our order.$b$bThrough your words and deeds we've been inspired to redouble our efforts and I'm proud to report that we've discovered a new technique that may be of use to you.$b$bIf you have a moment, $ct, I would be pleased to show you the fruit of our research.

identity.title: A Hero's Weapon
identity.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Altar of Light and Shadow and raise your weapon.
identity.description: $ct, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Conclave. Now, with the work upon the Altar of Light and Shadow complete, it is time that we aid you. We have discovered a method to awaken the full power of your weapon!$b$bPlease, step before the altar and raise your weapon high.

Description.text: $ct，虽然我们相处的时日尚短，但你已经为议会做出了伟大的贡献。现在，光影祭坛已经改造完成，该轮到我们祝你一臂之力了。我们发现了一种方法，可以唤醒武器中的沉睡力量！$b$b请走到祭坛面前，并高举你的武器。
Description.english: $ct, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Conclave. Now, with the work upon the Altar of Light and Shadow complete, it is time that we aid you. We have discovered a method to awaken the full power of your weapon!$b$bPlease, step before the altar and raise your weapon high.

identity.title: A Hero's Weapon
identity.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Altar of Ancient Kings and raise your weapon.
identity.description: $ct, you've brought together the Silver Hand like no $ct has done before. You've shown us that with determination and faith in the holy light we can overcome any challenge.$b$bFollowing in your example our workmen have toiled hard to improve the Altar of Ancient Kings, allowing it to unlock the true potential of your weapon.$b$bTheir work is now complete! Step forward when you are ready and we shall begin.

Description.text: $ct，你将白银之手骑士团重新团结为一个整体，从来没有哪个$ct能做到这一点。你的行动向我们表明，在圣光的引领下，我们坚定的信仰可以战胜任何挑战。$b$b在你的激励下，我们的工匠奋发努力，力图强化远古君王祭坛。它将为你解放这把武器的真正力量。$b$b现在，他们的工作终于完成了！当你准备好之后，请走上前来，并与我们一同开始仪式。
Description.english: $ct, you've brought together the Silver Hand like no $ct has done before. You've shown us that with determination and faith in the holy light we can overcome any challenge.$b$bFollowing in your example our workmen have toiled hard to improve the Altar of Ancient Kings, allowing it to unlock the true potential of your weapon.$b$bTheir work is now complete! Step forward when you are ready and we shall begin.

Title.text: 通缉：末日领主卡兹洛克

identity.title: Mother Ozram
identity.objectives: Kill Mother Ozram.
identity.description: The fiendish imps in this region are an incessant pain on our allies defending the camps below.$B$BThey are the spawn of a wicked imp-mother named Mother Ozram, who has been seen on a hill to the south.$B$BDestroy her, and we will end her brood as well.

identity.title: Blood for the Wolfe
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fel Blood.
identity.description:
We have a request in from Winstone Wolfe. He says that he needs a rather large amount of demon blood. He was not specific what for, and I did not ask.

I am inclined to do this for him with all expediency. The Wolf rarely asks for anything, so when he does, we jump. He gets results, one-hundred percent of the time and then some.

We should show him the same professional courtesy.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份魔血。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Fel Blood.

identity.title: Tempering Darkness
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Blood of Sargeras.
identity.description: I do not doubt Senegos' plan, but I do have some concerns about the Heart's volatility, especially when combined with nightmare energy.$B$BDespite its name, Blood of Sargeras is often used as a tempering agent by master craftsmen. I believe it would work for our ritual as well.$B$BYou should keep an eye out for it during your travels - we'll need a substantial amount to ensure that everything goes smoothly.

Objectives.text: 获得$1oa份萨格拉斯之血。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Blood of Sargeras.

identity.title: Essence of Power
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Corrupted Essence from the Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher.
identity.description: Now that we have a better understanding on the Heart's capabilities, it is time we tap into its true potential.$B$BIn the Emerald Nightmare you will find creatures that should not be; monsters that defy all that the Dream stands for.$B$BAll that the green flight itself stands for.$B$BEach of these fiends carry within them corrupted essence, as Oakheart did, but far more potent. Gather all that you can, and we will turn their corruption against them.

Objectives.text: 在普通或更高难度的翡翠梦魇中收集$1oa份堕落精华。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Corrupted Essence from the Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher.

identity.title: Into the Nighthold
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Nightshards from the Nighthold on Normal difficulty or higher.
identity.description: Our work is very nearly complete. Now that the Heart can safely absorb power from fel magic, we need the strongest sources of it that we can get our hands on.$B$BGul'dan has called the nightborne's elite back to the Nighthold to aid him. The storm of fel energy above the palace has seeped into the very fabric of their being, even making its way into the crystallized pieces of the Nightwell that many carry with them.$B$BThose shards are exactly what we need, $n. Save as many as you can in your assault.

Objectives.text: 在普通或更高难度的暗夜要塞中收集$1oa个暗夜碎片。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Nightshards from the Nighthold on Normal difficulty or higher.

identity.title: I Believe I Can Fly!
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Molted Feathers for Snicarus Dungleflight.
identity.description: Let's not bother explaining how this happened, just know that I have the plan of all plans to escape this... this... <Looks over his hand-crafted outfit, then quickly glances to a pile of droppings nearby.>$B$BThis place stinks! But you can help!$B$BThese feathers here will help craft my escape plan. If you wouldn't mind, I'm sure there's enough for the both of us!

Objectives.text: 為Snicarus Dungleflight收集$1oa根脫換的羽毛。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Molted Feathers for Snicarus Dungleflight.

identity.title: Ephemeral Manastorm Projector
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Warp-Resistant Plating from Chronarch Defenders.
identity.description:
Oculeth's theory is sound. Reckless, but sound.

A small warp-field could trap and excite ambient mana in the conduit, thus creating a manastorm similar to when the arcan'dor fell out of balance.

I can build a device to generate the warp-field, but I need materials.

Specifically, warp-resistant alloys - such as the armor plating of high-end security constructs in the noble district.

Those constructs are deadly. If anyone owes you a favor, now is the time to call it in.

Objectives.text: 从时空防御者身上收集$1oa份抗迁跃镀层。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Warp-Resistant Plating from Chronarch Defenders.

identity.title: All In
identity.objectives: Complete the "All In" scenario.$B$BChief Telemancer Oculeth can begin the scenario.
identity.description:
It is time to put our plan into action.

Oculeth will send you, Arluin and myself into the Arcway, where we shall trigger a manastorm in the Nightflow Conduit.

Valtrois will stay here and prepare Shal'Aran for a massive jolt of arcane power - hopefully enough to satisfy the arcan'dor.

$p... We have a saying... "To lead is to stand alone." It means only those who bear the weight of leadership can truly appreciate it.

Thank you for standing beside me. In truth, I do not feel alone.

Description.text:
是时候把我们的计划付诸实施了。

欧库勒斯将把你、阿鲁因还有我一起送入魔法回廊。进入后，我们需要在夜流水渠制造一场法力风暴。

瓦尔托伊将会留这里，让沙尔艾兰做好准备，迎接如潮的奥术能量——希望这足以让阿坎多尔满意。

$p……我们这儿有句老话……“领袖总是孤独的”。这句话的意思是，只有那些背负领导重担的人，才会真正懂得这种责任。

感谢你与我同行。其实，我觉得不孤独了。
Description.english:
It is time to put our plan into action.

Oculeth will send you, Arluin and myself into the Arcway, where we shall trigger a manastorm in the Nightflow Conduit.

Valtrois will stay here and prepare Shal'Aran for a massive jolt of arcane power - hopefully enough to satisfy the arcan'dor.

$p... We have a saying... "To lead is to stand alone." It means only those who bear the weight of leadership can truly appreciate it.

Thank you for standing beside me. In truth, I do not feel alone.

identity.title: Shalassic Park
identity.objectives: Ride Su'esh and defeat $3oa adversaries.
identity.description: We have a Devilsaur.$b$bI think she sees you as the pack leader now. She should obey your commands.$b$bShe looks hungry. Why don't you let her off the leash a little bit?

Objectives.text: 骑乘苏伊什并击败$3oa个敌人。
Objectives.english: Ride Su'esh and defeat $3oa adversaries.

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
identity.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.
identity.description: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

AreaDescription.text: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。
AreaDescription.english: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
identity.objectives: Defend the Leyline Feed and infuse it with Ancient Mana.
identity.description: <This feed appears to draw power from the leyline in order to become fully operational.$b$bYou should be able to imbue it with mana, but it will take a few minutes to draw enough leyline energy to accept the infusion.$b$bBeware, for creatures may notice the surge of arcane energy...>

AreaDescription.text: 保护魔网能量并注入远古魔力。
AreaDescription.english: Defend the Leyline Feed and infuse it with Ancient Mana.

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Moonfall
identity.objectives: Find the Broken Leydar Dish and repair the leyline feed.
identity.description: <This leyline feed appears to be damaged. The large collector at the top is broken.$b$bThe broken piece must be around here somewhere. There are rough scuff marks on the floor that appear to be made by something larger than the creatures inside.$b$bMuch, much larger.>

AreaDescription.text: 找到破损的魔力圆盘并修复魔网能量。
AreaDescription.english: Find the Broken Leydar Dish and repair the leyline feed.

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
identity.objectives: Collect 6 Leyline Feed Fragments and infuse the feed with ancient mana.
identity.description: <This leyline appears to be damaged and needs repair.$b$bSeveral large chunks of the main column are missing and arcane energy is crackling in the gaps.$b$bThe elementals nearby seem to pick up debris and absorb it into their bodies as they move around. Maybe they have the missing pieces...>

AreaDescription.text: 收集6块魔网能量碎片，并向魔网能量注入远古魔力。
AreaDescription.english: Collect 6 Leyline Feed Fragments and infuse the feed with ancient mana.

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Arcway
identity.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.
identity.description: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

AreaDescription.text: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。
AreaDescription.english: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Depths
identity.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.

identity.title: Nobundo's Last Stand
identity.objectives: Defend Farseer Nobundo from the Legion Assault.
identity.description: The Exodar shook from the force of the Legion's arrival. Before we could react, demons were running rampant through the halls, slaughtering everything in their path. If it were not for the Prophet, we would have all perished in the initial assault.$B$BI was charged with evacuating the Crystal Hall, which is when my Broken and I were separated from the main force.$B$BWe fell back into the collapsed hall to make our last stand.$B$BWith your aid, we may survive this invasion.

AreaDescription.text: 保护预言者努波顿，抵御燃烧军团的袭击。
AreaDescription.english: Defend Farseer Nobundo from the Legion Assault

identity.title: Down to Business
identity.objectives: Enter the Grand Promenade and slay $1oa defenders.
identity.description: First things first, $n: we must set up our camp.$b$bWe do not have the time or resources for a prolonged siege. It is not like we can starve them out. No, we must be swift and sure as an arrow, piercing their heart in one strike.$b$bThey are drawing up their battle lines within the city, but could attack us while we are setting up our defenses.$b$bVenture forth and show them what the kaldorei have learned from thousands of years of war. Discover their weaknesses so that we may exploit them.

Objectives.text: 进入大步道，消灭$1oa个卫兵。
Objectives.english: Enter the Grand Promenade and slay $1oa defenders.

identity.title: Down to Business
identity.objectives: Enter the Grand Promenade and slay $1oa defenders.
identity.description: Time to get to business, $n. We cannot afford to tarry.$b$bWhile we are not setting up for a prolonged engagement, we must still have a war camp of some sorts. I do not expect the Nightborne to stay patiently in their city while we plant stakes.$b$bThey are starting to build their defenses. Go in there and see what we are up against. You will strike them from within while we finalize our preparations.

Objectives.text: 进入大步道，消灭$1oa个卫兵。
Objectives.english: Enter the Grand Promenade and slay $1oa defenders.

identity.title: Expanding Your Horizons
identity.objectives: Speak with Aggra to choose a second artifact to pursue.
identity.description: You are a fast study, $ct $n. The elements speak through you - it is rare to have such a connection to the world.$b$bA true shaman must walk many paths. For every role, one must have the right tools at hand. Only the most powerful weapons can lead us to victory against the Legion. Perhaps it is time to seek out another?$b$bSpeak with me and let us discuss your options.

Description.text: 你真是善于学习啊，$ct $n。元素们与你进行了沟通——这种沟通在这个世界中可不常见。$b$b一个真正的萨满必须踏上多条道路。而在扮演每一种角色时，你都需要称手的工具。只有最为强大的武器才能带领我们战胜燃烧军团。也许，我们应该再寻找一把强大的武器。$b$b我们应该谈一谈，然后告诉我你的选择。
Description.english: You are a fast study, $ct $n. The elements speak through you - it is rare to have such a connection to the world.$b$bA true shaman must walk many paths. For every role, one must have the right tools at hand. Only the most powerful weapons can lead us to victory against the Legion. Perhaps it is time to seek out another?$b$bSpeak with me and let us discuss your options.

identity.title: A Falling Star
identity.objectives: Find the Mysterious Lightbound Object.
identity.description: $ct $n, thank you for coming. I have a matter of some urgency that requires your unique talents.$B$BThe Order of the Silver Hand have reported that an extraordinarily luminescent object has emerged from the Felstorm and is currently falling towards the coast of Suramar. What I find most curious about this occurrence is that the object was reported as having "cut a swath" through the Felstorm itself.$B$BWill you investigate? There is a gryphon awaiting your arrival at Krasus' Landing.

Description.text: $ct$n，谢谢你能赶过来。我有一件急事需要借助你独一无二的能力。$B$B根据白银之手的报告，邪能风暴中出现了一个非同寻常的发光物体，目前正朝着苏拉玛海岸的方向坠落。我对这件事最感到好奇的是，它在邪能风暴之中切开了一条光带。$B$B你可以去调查一下吗？克拉苏斯平台那里有一只狮鹫在等着你。
Description.english: $ct $n, thank you for coming. I have a matter of some urgency that requires your unique talents.$B$BThe Order of the Silver Hand have reported that an extraordinarily luminescent object has emerged from the Felstorm and is currently falling towards the coast of Suramar. What I find most curious about this occurrence is that the object was reported as having "cut a swath" through the Felstorm itself.$B$BWill you investigate? There is a gryphon awaiting your arrival at Krasus' Landing.

identity.title: Return to the Fel Hammer
identity.objectives: Speak with Battlelord Gaardoun on the Fel Hammer.
identity.description:
$n, Battlelord Gaardoun asked me to retrieve you. He says there is a very important matter that he needs your help with.

He requests your presence back on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible.

PortraitGiverText.text: 指挥官，请尽快返回邪能之槌号与我会面。
PortraitGiverText.english: Return to me on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible, commander.

Title.text: 危险：海底之王泰德罗斯

identity.title: Aggra's Guidance
identity.objectives: Seek out Aggra at the Storm's Eye Overlook within the Heart of Azeroth.
identity.description: $ct, have you met the shaman Aggra? Born of a shattered world, she learned the ways of the elements among the Mag'har orcs of Outland. On the eve of the Cataclysm she took it upon herself to complete Thrall's shamanistic training. Our younger initiates are fortunate to have her among us to guide them.$b$bIf you wish to seek out a second artifact, Aggra can assist you. She is training new recruits above us on the Storm's Eye Overlook.

Description.text: $ct，你见过萨满阿格娜了吗？她出生在外域这个破碎的世界，并从那里的玛格汉兽人处学会了元素之道。在大灾变的前夕，她亲自帮助萨尔完成了萨满训练。年轻的新兵们能有她作为导师真是太幸运了。$b$b如果你想找到第二件神器，阿格娜一定能帮到你。她正在我们上方的风暴之眼瞭望台训练新兵。
Description.english: $ct, have you met the shaman Aggra? Born of a shattered world, she learned the ways of the elements among the Mag'har orcs of Outland. On the eve of the Cataclysm she took it upon herself to complete Thrall's shamanistic training. Our younger initiates are fortunate to have her among us to guide them.$b$bIf you wish to seek out a second artifact, Aggra can assist you. She is training new recruits above us on the Storm's Eye Overlook.

PortraitGiverText.text: 阿格娜兰，大家叫她阿格娜。
PortraitGiverText.english: Aggralan, known as Aggra.

identity.title: Felspawns of Lothros
identity.objectives: Defeat Lothros.
identity.description:
These Felspawns are endless! I can't cut them down quickly enough to get to the dreadlord within the mausoleum.

Master Illidan, will you come with me so we can take down Lothros together?

identity.title: Hunter of Night
identity.objectives: Defeat Malvingeroth
identity.description:
A glorious battle indeed!

If I am correct, we can expect something a bit more deadly at any moment.

The Legion often uses fodder such as these to prepare the way for a more worthy foe.

My axe is sharp and ready.

identity.title: Khadgar's Discovery
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
identity.description: Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately.$B$BI have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

identity.title: Finite Numbers
identity.objectives: Close $1oa Portals and slay $2oa Demons in Deadwind Pass.
identity.description: It seems not all the protections I put in place have been defeated. The Legion isn't able to open portals inside or near the tower... at least, not yet.$b$bThey appear to be bringing reinforcements in through the catacombs running beneath Deadwind Pass. Disable them and you just might buy us the time we need to drive them out of Karazhan.

Objectives.text: 在逆风小径关闭$1oa个传送门，消灭$2oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Close $1oa Portals and slay $2oa Demons in Deadwind Pass.

identity.title: Growing Strong
identity.objectives: Reach Revered with The Nightfallen.
identity.description: Magic has long been a vice of the elves. It shaped us, and lifted us out of the darkness - but without balance, it also threatens to unmake us.$B$BThe shal'dorei are too proud to admit it, but they are the product of indulgence. They live without harmony.$B$BBut I sense potential among the Nightfallen. Losing everything has humbled them. It has made them stronger.$B$BStay the course, $p. Help the Nightfallen rise up.

Description.text: 魔法已经钳制精灵太久了。它造就了我们，让我们摆脱蒙昧——但失去平衡的魔法也会毁了我们。$B$B夏多雷太过骄傲，不愿承认这一点。他们就是放纵魔瘾的产物。他们的生活极其不和谐。$B$B但我感觉到了堕夜精灵的潜力。失去一切令他们变得谦卑。这也让他们更加坚强。$B$B坚持下去，$p。帮助堕夜精灵崛起吧。
Description.english: Magic has long been a vice of the elves. It shaped us, and lifted us out of the darkness - but without balance, it also threatens to unmake us.$B$BThe shal'dorei are too proud to admit it, but they are the product of indulgence. They live without harmony.$B$BBut I sense potential among the Nightfallen. Losing everything has humbled them. It has made them stronger.$B$BStay the course, $p. Help the Nightfallen rise up.

identity.title: Honor the Flame
identity.objectives: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Spires of Arak.
identity.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?

AreaDescription.text: 祭拜阿兰卡峰林的仲夏篝火。
AreaDescription.english: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Spires of Arak.

But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence or crushing our enemies into dust!$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?

identity.title: We'll Need Some Obliterum
identity.objectives: Find Camille Kleister in the Magus Commerce Exchange district of Dalaran.
identity.description:
Loramus Thalipedes has offered to improve our armaments. He says that he pried a secret out of Razelikh. Apparently, the demon knows how to work a material known as Obliterum.

I myself have coerced some information out of the demons. One of the souls trapped in my scythe has whispered the name, Camille Kleister. All I know is that she is somewhere in Dalaran. For the rest, you are on your own.

PortraitGiverText.text: 去达拉然找这个人类女子吧。
PortraitGiverText.english: Find this human woman in Dalaran.

identity.title: Ancient Mana
identity.objectives: Gather from $1oa Ancient Mana nodes.
identity.description: Without the Nightwell to feed upon, my comrades and I will have to live off the land itself.$B$BAncient mana from the underground leylines can reach the surface in many forms, most commonly as crystals or gems.$B$B<Thalyssra picks up a small stone and, whispering words of power, traces a rune upon it with her fingertip.>$B$BThis stone will glow when ancient mana is nearby. Please gather as much as possible! It will be a precious resource in the weeks to come.

Objectives.text: 从$1oa个远古魔力节点进行采集。
Objectives.english: Gather from $1oa Ancient Mana nodes.

identity.title: Stormheim
identity.objectives: Speak to Sky Admiral Rogers at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
identity.description:
It is good we found you, $n!

Sky Admiral Rogers has sent word for you to meet her in Dalaran. It sounded important. She awaits your presence in the Violet Citadel.

Make haste!

PortraitGiverName.text: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

identity.title: Stormheim
identity.objectives: Speak to Nathanos Blightcaller at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
identity.description:
It is good we found you, $n!

Nathanos Blightcaller, Champion of the Banshee Queen herself, sent for you in Dalaran. He made it sound urgent. He should be waiting for you in the Violet Citadel.

Make haste!

PortraitGiverName.text: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

identity.title: A Call to Action
identity.objectives: Find Havi at Valdisdall.
identity.description:
<As the raven stares into your eyes, a familiar voice fills your mind.>

Champion, I require your aid. It seems Helya has shown her hand.

Steel yourself then come to me.

identity.title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Favor
identity.objectives: Gain Odyn's favor within the Trial of Valor Raid.
identity.description:
The time to deal with that treacherous witch has come. I suspect you may be the one to deal the final blow, but I must be certain.

See me in the Halls of Valor and we will test the strength of your will.

Title.text: 海拉加尔登陆战：远石海滩

identity.title: Away From Prying Eyes
identity.objectives: Join the Council of Six in the Purple Parlor above the Violet Citadel.
identity.description: Wars are not won solely with armies charging bravely across the battlefield, $ct.$B$BSometimes, it is the actions of individuals that matter most, fighting battles few ever hear about. That is why - $B$B<Khadgar furrows his brow slightly.>$B$BWe should really discuss this somewhere a tad more private. Let's move up to the Purple Parlor, shall we?

Description.text: 光靠军队冲锋陷阵是赢不了战争的，$ct。$b$b有时候，由单人执行的、默默无闻的战斗才是最重要的。所以说——$b$b<卡德加微微皱了皱眉。>$b$b我们还是到更隐蔽的地方讨论这件事比较好。我们去上面的紫色天台吧，怎么样？
Description.english: Wars are not won solely with armies charging bravely across the battlefield, $ct.$B$BSometimes, it is the actions of individuals that matter most, fighting battles few ever hear about. That is why - $B$B<Khadgar furrows his brow slightly.>$B$BWe should really discuss this somewhere a tad more private. Let's move up to the Purple Parlor, shall we?

AreaDescription.text: 在紫色天台与六人议会会合。
AreaDescription.english: Join the Council of Six in the Purple Parlor.

identity.title: From Bones They Rise
identity.objectives: Revive $1oa Deceased Thorignir in Thorim's Peak.
identity.description: Alright, the job is to get the broodmother under our control. But hear me out. A few more drakes would be a boon, right?$b$bWhile we're here, why don't we use our awesome power over undeath to raise some of her brood as well? Although the peak has claimed their corpses for the ice, I'm sure the embrace of undeath will be much more welcoming. We must find their frozen corpses and breathe your will into them.

Objectives.text: 在托里姆峰复活$1oa只死去的托林尼尔幼龙。
Objectives.english: Revive $1oa Deceased Thorignir in Thorim's Peak.

identity.title: Trial by Demonfire
identity.objectives: Slay Rozzeleth in Meredil.
identity.description:
We are out of time. I have reports that a pitlord has come to Meredil. 

I have dispatched a strike force. We cannot let this demon flank our army here, nor can we let him find Shal'Aran. It is time to temper these recruits in a real battle.

Join our forces in Meredil, engage the demon, and help us ensure this new army of ours is not lost in its first conflict.

PortraitGiverText.text: 他想碾碎起义军。
PortraitGiverText.english: He seeks to crush the rebellion.

identity.title: Citizens' Army
identity.objectives: Defeat $1oa of Ravencrest's forces at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
identity.description: I can barely get these civilians to stand in a straight line.$b$bThey are untrained, undisciplined, and underarmed.$b$bStill, they need to be ready for the real battle.$b$BKhadgar suggested we try some field training at the ruins of Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah. The risen forces of Lord Ravencrest apparently remember how to fight.$b$bGo, hero, and I will send some trainees to support you.

Objectives.text: 在瓦尔莎拉的黑鸦堡垒击败$1oa个拉文凯斯的士兵。
Objectives.english: Defeat $1oa of Ravencrest's forces at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.

identity.title: We Need Weapons
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Weapon Caches at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
identity.description: So many of the rebels want to help in the coming battle. Our people have the will, they lack only the means.$b$bThey need weapons.$b$bFrom what Khadgar has told me, the fortress of Black Rook has plenty of munitions we could use.$b$bTravel to the fortress and place these beacons on some weapon caches there. Once placed, I can teleport them back.

Objectives.text: 在瓦尔莎拉的黑鸦堡垒找到$1oa个武器箱。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Weapon Caches at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.

identity.title: Learning From the Dead
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Books of Tactics from Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
identity.description: I heard you were traveling to Black Rook Hold.$b$bIt was once home to the legendary Lord Ravencrest, a brilliant tactician. His knowledge may be exactly what we need to give us an edge against the Duskwatch.$b$bWhile you are at the Rook, keep your eyes peeled for any books that might have survived the ages that outline the Ravencrest's strategems.

Objectives.text: 从瓦尔莎拉的黑鸦堡垒获得$1oa本战术论。
Objectives.english: Recover $1oa Books of Tactics from Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.

identity.title: Taking a Promenade
identity.objectives: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.
identity.description: These people are foreign to us, despite our common heritage. They have changed much in the years they have been cloistered away.$b$bWe need to learn more about them, what they are capable of. We dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and assess the defenses. The blood elves did the same, although I doubt their ability to be discreet.$b$bBoth are long past due for reporting back to us. Find them and make sure they are safe or at least did not die in vain.

AreaDescription.english: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.

identity.title: Nullified
identity.objectives: Obtain the Charged Arcshaper Staff and a Volatile Construct Core for Sendath.
identity.description: The magus in charge of the defenses here is powerful. Perhaps too strong, even for the both of us.$b$bFortunately, the sin'dorei know a thing or two about magic. The mage's barrier is strong, but we are clever.$b$bHe has somehow channeled enough energy into his staff to power another set of defense portals, but he has left it out of his sight. Bring me the staff and an energy source from one of those constructs. I should be able to create just the thing we need to take that shield out.

AreaDescription.text: 为塞达斯获取充能的塑魔法杖和不稳定的构造体核心。
AreaDescription.english: Obtain the Charged Arcshaper Staff and a Volatile Construct Core for Sendath.

identity.title: Shield, Meet Spell
identity.objectives: Use the Arcane Nullifier to defeat Arcshaper Thorendis.
identity.description: There you have it, one arcane nullifier! Using their weapon and magical signatures to cloak the spell, it should tear apart the shield as good as any spellbreaker would.$b$bGo teach that amateur spellslinger what it means to wage war against the sin'dorei!

AreaDescription.text: 使用魔力消除器击败塑魔者索伦迪斯。
AreaDescription.english: Use the Arcane Nullifier to defeat Arcshaper Thorendis.

identity.title: Crystal Clearing
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Portal Crystals.
identity.description: This portal is a problem. With it they can summon countless reserves.$b$bThe crystals nearby seem to be powering the gate. If we destroy those, we can set them back significantly.

Objectives.text: 破坏$1oa个传送水晶。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Portal Crystals.

identity.title: Powering Down the Portal
identity.objectives: Slay Overseer Ingra.
identity.description: Destroying the crystals will stop them temporarily, but it will be meaningless if we do not deal with the person controlling the portal itself.$b$bI heard their overseer, Ingra, shouting orders for more power so that she could bring the stronger Legion lieutenants through the gate. We must stop her to truly seal the portal for good.

identity.title: Break An Arm
identity.objectives: Defeat the Arm of the Magistrix.
identity.description: The insurgents you marshaled gave me some bad news, $n.$b$bThe arcanists loyal to Elisande have reactivated the Arm of the Magistrix. The most powerful construct ever attempted, it raged out of control and decimated an entire district before it was disabled. Truly they must be desperate to turn it against us.$b$bThe scouts have spotted it in the Crimson Thicket to the north. We cannot allow it to reach full power if we are to succeed.

AreaDescription.english: Defeat the Arm of the Magistrix.

identity.title: Not There, Not Then, Not Forever

Title.english: Not There, Not Then, Not Forever

identity.title: Trolling Them
identity.objectives: Remove insulting items from the elven war camps.
identity.description: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the Sin'dorei in combat unless I give the command.$b$bHowever, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.$b$bPlease, $p, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

Description.text: 我的部队纪律严明，没有我的命令，绝对不会与辛多雷开战。$b$b可是，我不得不羞愧地承认，两支军队都在搞恶作剧，互相骚扰，还把带有侮辱含义的物品丢到对方的营地。$b$b请你帮个忙，$p，我们需要找个双方军队都尊敬的人，把这些物品收起来，以免双方擦枪走火。
Description.english: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the Sin'dorei in combat unless I give the command.$b$bHowever, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.$b$bPlease, $p, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

identity.title: Trolling Them
identity.objectives: Remove insulting items from the elven war camps.
identity.description: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the kaldorei in combat unless I give the command.$b$bHowever, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.$b$bPlease, $p, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

Description.text: 我的部队纪律严明，没有我的命令，绝对不会与卡多雷开战。$b$b可是，我不得不羞愧地承认，两支军队都在搞恶作剧，互相骚扰，还把带有侮辱含义的物品丢到对方的营地。$b$b请你帮个忙，$p，我们需要找个双方军队都尊敬的人，把这些物品收起来，以免双方擦枪走火。
Description.english: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the kaldorei in combat unless I give the command.$b$bHowever, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.$b$bPlease, $p, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

identity.title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Judgment
identity.objectives: Defeat Helya within the Trial of Valor Raid.
identity.description: You've proven worthy to challenge Helya. Now with my blessing, the power to defeat her is yours.

identity.title: Mouths to Feed
identity.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois in Shal'Aran.
identity.description: We have rescued many refugees, as you can see. Unfortunately this has revealed a new problem.$b$bThe arcan'dor fruit is our salvation, but it does not bear enough fruit right now to cure everyone. We must rely on mana a little longer to tide the refugees over.$b$bValtrois thinks that she may have a solution. Please go speak with her and see what she plans to do.

AreaDescription.text: 在沙尔艾兰与奥术师瓦尔托伊谈一谈。
AreaDescription.english: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois in Shal'Aran.

identity.title: Oculeth Ex Machina
identity.objectives: Speak with Oculeth and teleport to Azsuna.
identity.description: I have a plan to feed Shal'Aran.$b$bNow that I am no longer starving for mana I have had time to study ley lines in new regions. I detected an eddy of mana in the ley lines of Azsuna. I have plenty of magic at my disposal, but we must visit the ley line in person in order to properly redirect the energy to Shal'Aran.$b$bOculeth has graciously offered to teleport us there, but I could use an assistant. Care to join me?

AreaDescription.text: 与欧库勒斯谈一谈，然后传送到阿苏纳。
AreaDescription.english: Speak with Oculeth and teleport to Azsuna.

identity.title: Unbeleyvable
identity.objectives: Assist Arcanist Valtrois with placing ley line taps.
identity.description: Back to the task at hand!$b$bTake these ley line taps. We can use the resonant energies to properly redirect the flow, but they must be placed in precise locations. I will show you where.$b$bYour friend has agreed to... "supervise" us. Let us hope she just stays out of the way while the professionals take care of this.

AreaDescription.text: 协助奥术师瓦尔托伊放置魔网共振器。
AreaDescription.english: Assist Arcanist Valtrois with placing ley line taps.

identity.title: The Art of Flow
identity.objectives: Protect Arcanist Valtrois while she completes the ritual.
identity.description: All done, $n! We have but one more step and Shal'Aran will have all the mana it needs.$b$bNow that I have better access to the ley line below I can break the pool so that it will flow through properly. Given the chaotic state of this ley line it will require all of my concentration to redirect the energy.$b$bI must warn you that we will attract attention while I am doing this. You will need to protect me while I complete the process.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready.

AreaDescription.text: 在奥术师瓦尔托伊进行仪式期间保护她。
AreaDescription.english: Protect Arcanist Valtrois while she completes the ritual.

identity.title: A Dance With Dragons
identity.objectives: Speak with Stellagosa to ride back to Shal'Aran.
identity.description: I must say I am impressed, $n.$b$bYou and your friend were able to fix a ley line, and you are not even dragons!$b$bYou both seem exhausted by this ordeal. Allow me to help you get back home.

AreaDescription.text: 与丝黛拉苟萨交谈并飞回沙尔艾兰。
AreaDescription.english: Speak with Stellagosa to ride back to Shal'Aran.

identity.title: Attack on the Roost
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Legion invaders.
identity.description: Skylord Shadegrove has been leading the defense of the shrine, but I think he's starting to lose hope. Clearly he needs some more firepower behind him!$b$bLet's take out these demons and fend off the attack. They'll never see it coming!

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个军团入侵者。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Legion invaders.

identity.title: Worth Its Weight in Steel
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Axe Blades from orcs and ogres around the Burning Steppes. Return them to Hoddruc in Chiselgrip when you've collected them all.
identity.description: Listen, ye seem like one who may be interested in getting a copy of those axe plans.$b$bCould probably make a pretty penny at the auction house on it. But I can't just hand 'em over to ya, $glad:lass;. Not fer free.$b$bThat axe blade ye brought me, I could use more of those. Good steel in those blades. Don't worry, $glad:lass;, I just need a few...$b$bWhat do ye say?

Objectives.text: 从燃烧平原上的兽人和食人魔身上收集$1oa把斧刃。集齐后返回凿握据点向胡德鲁克复命。
Objectives.english: Gather $1oa Axe Blades from orcs and ogres around the Burning Steppes. Return them to Hoddruc in Chiselgrip when you've collected them all.

identity.title: Something's Not Quite Right...
identity.objectives: Remove the disguise of 5 Nightborne Infiltrators.
identity.description: Something is troubling me, champion.$b$bBeyond these simple japes, the Kirin Tor has had to break up a few fights between the elves. I am worried something - or someone - might be influencing them.$b$bYour disguise was made by the nightborne, yes? It is not unreasonable to assume they can do something similar.$b$bFortunately, Thalyssra has told me much about how the illusion works, and I believe this crystal can remove their disguise.$b$bWhy don't you check the camps, just to be safe?

AreaDescription.text: 解除5名夜之子渗透者的伪装。
AreaDescription.english: Remove the disguise of 5 Nightborne Infiltrators.

identity.title: Deadmines: Sea'in Red
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Bloodied Defias Bandanas for Captain Bramblebeard.
identity.description: Arr, finally! I been stuck up here f'years with naught company but me own thoughts. Tis good to clap me eyes on another swashbuckling soul. Are ye up for a plot of revenge and skullduggery? These meddlin' Defias thugs murdered  me and me crew years ago before they took over this cave. I propose a series of counter-murders to bring about balance! Bring me proof ye've dealt with enough of the thieves to clog a bilge pump!

Objectives.text: 为棘须船长收集$1oa条染血的迪菲亚头巾。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Bloodied Defias Bandanas for Captain Bramblebeard.

identity.title: The Nighthold: Ettin Your Foot In The Door

Title.english: The Nighthold: Ettin Your Foot In The Door

PortraitGiverText.text: 海边最狂暴的龙虾人。
PortraitGiverText.english: The most audacious makrura by the sea.

identity.title: Raising Your Snowfeather
identity.objectives: Raise your Snowfeather Hatchling to level 25.
identity.description: <Your snowfeather hatchling looks at you timidly. It appears to be looking to you to help it survive and grow.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 啾！
PortraitGiverText.english: Erk!

identity.title: Raising Your Direbeak
identity.objectives: Raise your Direbeak Hatchling to level 25.
identity.description: <Your direbeak hatchling appears uncertain about what to do with itself. It appears to be looking to you to help it survive and grow.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 啾！啾！
PortraitGiverText.english: Erk! Erk!

identity.title: Raising Your Sharptalon
identity.objectives: Raise your Sharptalon Hatchling to level 25.
identity.description: <Your sharptalon hatchling continues to shiver as it settles in at your side. It looks up at you with wide, unblinking eyes. It appears to be looking to you to help it survive and grow.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 啾？
PortraitGiverText.english: Erk?

identity.title: Raising Your Bloodgazer
identity.objectives: Raise your Bloodgazer Hatchling to level 25.
identity.description: <Your bloodgazer hatchling looks at you curiously, cocking its head to the side and emitting a low whistle. It appears to be looking to you to help it survive and grow.>

PortraitGiverText.text: 咕噜！
PortraitGiverText.english: Baroo!

identity.title: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
identity.objectives: Kill creatures around Un'Goro Crater and retrieve $1oa Stolen Enchanted Thorium Bars, $2oa Mostly Powerful Mojos, $3oa Calcified Diemetradon Scales, and $4oa Bleached Stegodon Spikes. Bring them to Ko'Zan when you're done.
identity.description: I been at dis camp for some time now, an' I know for a fact dat dose materials can be found right here in Un'Goro.$b$bTime ta give da creatures here some payback. Take from dem just like dey took from me! At least, you could do dat for me, right bruddah?$b$bI'll just wait here for ya to return wit' all da stuff.

Objectives.text: 消灭安戈洛环形山的生物，获得$1oa个偷来的魔化瑟银锭，$2oa个半吊子的强力魔精，$3oa片钙化双帆龙鳞和$4oa个漂白的剑龙尖刺。集齐后交给考赞。
Objectives.english: Kill creatures around Un'Goro Crater and retrieve $1oa Stolen Enchanted Thorium Bars, $2oa Mostly Powerful Mojos, $3oa Calcified Diemetradon Scales, and $4oa Bleached Stegodon Spikes. Bring them to Ko'Zan when you're done.

identity.title: Noressa
identity.objectives: Rescue Noressa.
identity.description: She is still in there, $n. Noressa, my wife.$b$bShe is in the Promenade while we wait outside, preparing to strike. Who knows what has happened to her?$b$bPlease, friend, I fear the worst. Tell her there is hope outside.$b$bWe had a small house in the south of the Grand Promenade, by the water gardens. She will probably be there during this madness.

identity.title: Felborne No More
identity.objectives: Slay $2oa Felborne and their leader, Valthis Ama'ran, at the Felborne Outpost in Crimson Thicket.
identity.description: The Felborne have begun to expand their grasp beyond the city's reach. A camp to the east in the Crimson Thicket is of a particular interest to us. Their outpost leader, Valthis Ama'ran, serves Andaris directly.$B$BNow is the time to put our withered training and Oculeth's device to the test. We cannot allow them to advance any further, $n.$B$BHead for the camp and use the orb to sever the head of the beast. The time has come to begin our advance.

Objectives.text: 前往深红林地的邪脉岗哨，消灭$2oa个邪脉部队成员，以及他们的首领瓦提斯·阿玛兰。
Objectives.english: Slay $2oa Felborne and their leader, Valthis Ama'ran, at the Felborne Outpost in Crimson Thicket.

identity.title: Experimental Instability
identity.objectives: Gather the Telemancy Notes and $3oa Discarded Orbs from Oculeth's Test Chamber.
identity.description: In order to advance our studies I must ask you to recover a few particular items from my long-forgotten chambers.$B$BI assure you it is... mostly safe there, aside from a few unstable elements.$B$BMake your way to my workshop and locate the teleporter. I'll disable its cloaking device when you arrive.

Objectives.text: 前往欧库勒斯的测试间收集传送笔记和$3oa个废弃的宝珠。
Objectives.english: Gather the Telemancy Notes and $3oa Discarded Orbs from Oculeth's Test Chamber.

identity.title: Loot and Plunder!
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa Blacksail Booty.
identity.description: I'm bein' honest here matey, I've got me own motives fer bein' here. Last time there was a bit of a debacle. Some drinkin', some gamblin', and a bit too much rum if ye catch me meanin'. Some words were said, some fists were thrown and... honestly it was quite a haze. I'm not the most welcome pirate here after that.$b$bBut they took me stuff! These lyin', dirty ol'... ahem. Could ye just take this torch and... burn their belongin's? I'd be grateful.

Objectives.text: 烧毁$1oa份黑帆宝藏。
Objectives.english: Burn $1oa Blacksail Booty.

identity.title: A Glorious Reunion
identity.objectives: Speak to Aerylia, then report to Odyn.
identity.description: You have done well, Battlelord $n. Let us return to Skyhold. Odyn will want to hear of your success here.

identity.title: Runic Reading
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fel Blood from demons throughout the Broken Isles.
identity.description:
There is something curious about this scroll. It appears to be an empty page to the untrained eye, but I can see a shimmer of runes appear briefly when I hold it up to the light.

As with most demonic runes, I will need fel blood to undo the magic that's been used to conceal whatever message is within this scroll.

Objectives.text: 从破碎群岛的恶魔身上收集$1oa份魔血。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Fel Blood from demons throughout the Broken Isles.

identity.title: Oath Breaker
identity.objectives: Head to the Broken Shore and slay Oathbinder Zorak.
identity.description: Many years ago I made a pact with a man I thought not to be unlike myself. His promise of protection seemed too good to be true, but it was a deal I was desperate to make.$B$BIt wasn't until I had signed in blood that the dreadlord Zorak revealed himself.$B$BAs long as he lives, my ancestors will remain bound to the Burning Legion, allowing our enemies to amass an army of unwilling soldiers.$B$BHead to the Broken Shore and slay Oathbinder Zorak. His death will break the hold he has over my ancestors.

identity.title: Those Scrying Eyes
identity.objectives: Inspect $1oa Duskwatch Scrying Orbs in the Terrace of Enlightenment.
identity.description:
Until recently, Ly'leth was sending magical messages to us regularly from within the Nighthold. She took care to hide these messages - only the most vigilant scryers could have detected them.

They could not be within the palace... too much interference from the Nightwell...

Of course! The Terrace of Enlightenment! The Duskwatch must have set up a listening post there.

Check the scrying orbs for traces of Ly'leth's messages. We must learn what she was trying to tell us!

Objectives.text: 在启迪平台检查$1oa个暮色卫队占卜宝珠。
Objectives.english: Inspect $1oa Duskwatch Scrying Orbs in the Terrace of Enlightenment.

identity.title: On Daumyr's Wings
identity.objectives: Ride Daumyr to the Broken Shore.
identity.description: The time is nigh, $p. With these new dragons in our army, we are prepared for our assault on the Broken Shore. A large detachment of demons have appeared near one of our camps, and there are far too many of them for any of our allies to overcome.$b$bWho better to defeat these demons than those without fear of death? Those with quite the large secret weapon?$b$bTake Daumyr. We will meet you there.

Description.text: 时候就要到了，$p。我们的部队新增了这些龙之后，就做好了突袭破碎海滩的准备。有一支庞大的恶魔分遣队出现在了我们的一个营地附近。他们人多势众，已经令我们的盟友疲于应付了。$b$b我们这种不惧死亡，而且具有秘密武器的人正是对付这些恶魔的最佳人选，不是吗？$b$b乘上多米尔吧。我们到那儿见。
Description.english: The time is nigh, $p. With these new dragons in our army, we are prepared for our assault on the Broken Shore. A large detachment of demons have appeared near one of our camps, and there are far too many of them for any of our allies to overcome.$b$bWho better to defeat these demons than those without fear of death? Those with quite the large secret weapon?$b$bTake Daumyr. We will meet you there.

PortraitGiverText.text: 海边最肆意妄为的龙虾人。
PortraitGiverText.english: The most audacious makrura by the sea.

identity.title: Fighting on All Fronts
identity.objectives: Complete 5 missions from your Order Hall.
identity.description:
We are nearly ready to siege the gates. Your efforts here have been monumental, $n.

But let us not forget that you are also the $ct. Your forces rely on you to command them. No single person can stand against the Legion.

Continue your duty. Guide the $cs of Azeroth, and victory will be assured.

Description.text:
我们马上就能围攻大门了。你实在是劳苦功高，$n。

但别忘了，你还是$ct。你的军队需要你的指挥。没有人能独力对抗军团。

继续履行你的职责吧。领导艾泽拉斯的$c，胜利必将到来。
Description.english:
We are nearly ready to siege the gates. Your efforts here have been monumental, $n.

But let us not forget that you are also the $ct. Your forces rely on you to command them. No single person can stand against the Legion.

Continue your duty. Guide the $cs of Azeroth, and victory will be assured.

identity.title: Touch of a Titan
identity.objectives: Bring $1oa Essences of Aman'Thul to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
identity.description: Oh my! You've managed to acquire an item of legend to carry on your adventures. I've long theorized that such items draw their power directly from the titans, and this may prove to be a chance to test such speculation!$b$bIt is said that the Nightwell draws power from the Eye of Aman'Thul, and after centuries in close proximity I believe that titan's power now dwells within the inhabitants of the Nighthold. Bring me remnants of this energy, and I will empower your equipment.

Objectives.text: 将$1oa个阿曼苏尔的精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
Objectives.english: Bring $1oa Essences of Aman'Thul to Arcanomancer Vridiel.

identity.title: Touch of a Titan
identity.objectives: Bring $1oa Essences of Aman'Thul to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
identity.description: Harnessing the strength of the titans may be the only thing that lets us push back the Burning Legion. Bring me more of this power, and we will improve your odds of defeating Gul'dan.

Objectives.text: 将$1oa个阿曼苏尔的精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
Objectives.english: Bring $1oa Essences of Aman'Thul to Arcanomancer Vridiel.

identity.title: Treasure Master Iks'reeged
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Felwing Devourers.
identity.description: <TEMP> Board the ship then kill fel bats.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个邪翼吞噬者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa Felwing Devourers.

identity.title: Severing the Sveldrek
identity.objectives: Kill and raise $1oa Sveldrek vrykul.
identity.description: So here's the order of things, as far as I've been told. Mortal walks into Icecrown. Mortal is brutally defeated. Mortal gets raised as Scourge.$b$bThese fools can't expect to trounce in here, do whatever they want, and leave without any consequence. Time to make them truly as mindless as they act.

Objectives.text: 消灭并复活$1oa个斯维德克维库人。
Objectives.english: Kill and raise $1oa Sveldrek vrykul.

identity.title: The Nighthold: Lord of the Shadow Council
identity.objectives: Defeat Gul'dan in The Nighthold.
identity.description:
As we speak, Gul'dan is using the Nightwell's power to pull Sargeras into our world.

Gather your companions and fight your way to the top of The Nighthold.

I will prepare Light's Heart and join you when the time is right.

Together, we will put an end to Gul'dan once and for all.

identity.title: The God-Queen's Fury
identity.objectives: Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to Sigryn's location and defeat her.
identity.description:
$ct, the Kirin Tor have found a way to get you into the Halls of Valor to pursue the God-King's heir. Archmage Khadgar has asked me to stress upon you the importance of stopping Sigryn, as the prophecies hint that she may still be the key to uniting the Tideskorn against the Legion.

It will require an incredible amount of energy to teleport you directly to the Halls, so be sure that you are prepared. It may be some time before we can send you again.

Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

Description.text:
$ct，肯瑞托有办法把你传送到英灵殿，追上神王的后裔。大法师卡德加还要我对你再三强调，阻止希格林是非常重要的事，因为根据预言所示，她可能仍是联合蔑潮部族对抗军团的关键。

要把你直接传送进英灵殿的话，需要花费难以置信的巨大能量，所以去之前请确保你已经有了万全的准备。否则我们可能就要等上一段时间才能再次传送了。

你准备好了的话就告诉我。
Description.english:
$ct, the Kirin Tor have found a way to get you into the Halls of Valor to pursue the God-King's heir. Archmage Khadgar has asked me to stress upon you the importance of stopping Sigryn, as the prophecies hint that she may still be the key to uniting the Tideskorn against the Legion.

It will require an incredible amount of energy to teleport you directly to the Halls, so be sure that you are prepared. It may be some time before we can send you again.

Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

identity.title: The Befouled Barrows
identity.objectives: Close $1oa Legion Portals in the Stormrage Barrow Dens.
identity.description: You were taking too long, so I took the liberty to scout out the barrows in advance. The Legion has set up portals, pulling more and more demons through them by the second. We need to shut them down so we can save Goldrinn!$b$bI'm not sure my usual methods are going to do much to take them down, but I think you can do it! I think some nice vine-work is in order.

Objectives.text: 在怒风兽穴关闭$1oa个军团传送门。
Objectives.english: Close $1oa Legion Portals in the Stormrage Barrow Dens.

identity.title: A Bit of Espionage
identity.objectives: Speak to Aludane Whitecloud in Krasus' Landing for a flight to Broken Shore.
identity.description: With the gunpowder in tow, it's time to move on to our next plan. Meet us on the Broken Shore. $b$bYou can get a flight directly to our next location from Krasus' Landing. We will meet you there, $ct.

Description.text: 有了火药，我们也该进行下一步计划了。到破碎海滩来见我们吧。$b$b你可以从克拉苏斯平台直接飞到我们的下一个目标地点。我们到那儿见，$ct。
Description.english: With the gunpowder in tow, it's time to move on to our next plan. Meet us on the Broken Shore. $b$bYou can get a flight directly to our next location from Krasus' Landing. We will meet you there, $ct.

identity.title: Rise Up
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa demons, then reach the top of the ramp.
identity.description: Here we are, $ct. On this island is a cavern full of exceptionally powerful demons and their leaders. If our plan succeeds, these demons will be... "blown to smithereens", as Tethys so nicely put it.$b$bThere's no time to explain the plan in full right now, but Tess has agreed to walk you through it. First you must get up to the top of this ramp. Slaughter a few on your way.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa个恶魔，然后登上斜坡顶部。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa demons, then reach the top of the ramp.

Description.text: 我们到了，$ct。这座岛上有个洞窟，里面全是极其强大的恶魔和他们的首领。如果我们的计划成功，这些恶魔就会如特塞斯所说的那样，被“炸成碎片”。$b$b现在没时间详细解释整个计划了，但是苔丝答应与你同行。首先，你必须登上这面斜坡的顶部。别忘了顺路杀几个恶魔。

identity.title: Finders Keepers
identity.objectives: Sweep up $oa piles of Arcane Dust in the Hall of the Guardian.
identity.description: Would you look at this place? It's a mess! Everywhere you look there's just pile after pile of arcane dust!$B$B<Akazamzarak smiles broadly.>$B$BThese poor saps don't realize what that stuff's worth!$B$BI tell ya what, if you help me summon up some brooms to collect this powdered gold, I'll split the profits with you 80/20.

Objectives.text: 在守护者圣殿里打扫出$oa堆奥法之尘。
Objectives.english: Sweep up $oa piles of Arcane Dust in the Hall of the Guardian.

identity.title: This Time, Leave a Trail
identity.objectives: Rappel down into the cave, then follow Tess's instructions.
identity.description: Are you ready, $ct? I will walk you through every step of the plan. You'll be perfectly safe! First thing's first: You see that rappel point behind me? That's your way down into the cave. Good luck!

Description.text: 你准备好了吗，$ct？我会引导你一步步完成这个计划的。所以你绝对安全！首先，看到我身后的垂降点了吗？你得从那里进入洞穴。祝你好运！
Description.english: Are you ready, $ct? I will walk you through every step of the plan. You'll be perfectly safe! First thing's first: You see that rappel point behind me? That's your way down into the cave. Good luck!

identity.title: This Time, Leave a Trail
identity.objectives: Rappel down into the cave, then follow Lilian's instructions.
identity.description: Here goes nothing, $ct. If anybody can pull this off, you can! ...Probably. Just use the rappel point behind me to get into the cave.$b$bWhat? Don't make that face. I'll give you more instructions once you're in the cave.

Description.text: 不用紧张，$ct。如果真有人能完成这个任务，那一定是你！……大概吧。使用我身后的垂降点，进入洞窟吧。$b$b什么？别摆出那副表情。你进入洞窟后，我再给你进一步的指示。
Description.english: Here goes nothing, $ct. If anybody can pull this off, you can! ...Probably. Just use the rappel point behind me to get into the cave.$b$bWhat? Don't make that face. I'll give you more instructions once you're in the cave.

identity.title: A "Humble" Request
identity.objectives: Meet your visitor at Storm's Eye Overlook.
identity.description: $ct, we've received a... visitor. She orders entry, but the guards will not let her pass without approval.$b$bPlease head up to the overlook as soon as you are able.

Description.text: $ct，外面来了位……客人。她想进来，但在没有得到允许前，卫兵是不会让她通过的。$b$b请尽快到瞭望台去见见她吧。
Description.english: $ct, we've received a... visitor. She orders entry, but the guards will not let her pass without approval.$b$bPlease head up to the overlook as soon as you are able.

identity.title: The Crone's Wrath
identity.objectives: Defeat $1oa demons on Darkcloud Pinnacle.
identity.description: These demons come into my home, take my things, and capture my people? They will see my wrath. Destroy them, child. Surely you are capable of at least that.

Objectives.text: 在黑云峰击败$1oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Defeat $1oa demons on Darkcloud Pinnacle.

identity.title: Breaking Chains
identity.objectives: Free $1oa Captured Grimtotem from Prison Cages.
identity.description: The Legion shall not make fools of the Grimtotem. Free my people, and we will grace you with our aid in the coming battle.

Objectives.text: 从牢笼中释放$1oa个被俘的恐怖图腾成员。
Objectives.english: Free $1oa Captured Grimtotem from Prison Cages.

identity.title: Uniting the Isles
identity.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran
identity.description: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.

PortraitGiverText.text: 我们需要你的帮助！
PortraitGiverText.english: We need your help!

identity.title: Brothers and Sisters
identity.objectives: Heal $1oa Injured Shaman  in Garrison of the Fel.
identity.description: Your people were trying to stop the Legion before you arrived, but flesh is weak and they accumulated too many wounds. Without your aid, they will surely perish at the hands of the demons. Go, help them.

Objectives.text: 在邪能要塞治疗$1oa个受伤的萨满。
Objectives.english: Heal $1oa Injured Shaman  in Garrison of the Fel.

identity.title: Elemental Cores
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fire Power Cores, $2oa Water Power Cores, $3oa Earth Power Cores, and $4oa Air Power Cores.
identity.description: The eredar here are abusing the power of all of Azeroth's elements, forcing them to their command using their fel magics. They succeed to do this through curiosities the Legion has developed, cores of power that correspond to each element.$b$bDo not allow the Legion to continue abusing our world. Kill them and take the sources of their power.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个火焰能量核心，$2oa个流水能量核心，$3oa个土地能量核心和$4oa个大气能量核心。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Fire Power Cores, $2oa Water Power Cores, $3oa Earth Power Cores, and $4oa Air Power Cores.

identity.title: A Gift From the Six
identity.objectives: Raise your weapon and receive the Council of Six's gift in the Violet Citadel.
identity.description: $n, without you some of the Legion's strongest agents would still be roaming Azeroth, threatening to undermine all that we've accomplished in this war.$B$BSuch a deed merits more than mere recognition.$B$BIf you would accept it, we would like to formally reward your heroism in the face of such darkness with a portion of our power.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, $n.

identity.title: A Few Things First
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Leystone Ore and a Suramarian Sapphire.
identity.description: Lately I've been working with the ore of this land, leystone it's called. I've found its qualities to hold remarkable strength and durability. We'll need a lot of it for this.$b$bThere is felslate, but that's a probably too tainted for what you're looking to do with this barding.$b$bYou know, I also like to adorn my pieces with something sparkly, like a jewel. I've heard that the elves of Suramar have particularly beautiful ones. Perhaps you could acquire one for this project.

Objectives.text: 获取$1oa块魔石矿石和一颗苏拉玛蓝宝石。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Leystone Ore and a Suramarian Sapphire.

identity.title: Knowledge is Power
identity.objectives: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.

There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must hasten our efforts.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.

Shall we begin, $ct?

Description.text:
通过我们在破碎群岛的战役，你已经为你的古代神器注入了能量。但随着燃烧军团的入侵加剧，我们必须尽快解锁这把武器的潜力。

我们可以稍后再进行缓慢稳妥的研究。但现在，我们得加快进度了。

将我们的职业大厅资源投入对武器历史的研究，我们就能加快你的神器获得能量的速度了。

我们可以开始了吗，$ct？
Description.english:

identity.title: Knowledge is Power
identity.objectives: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
Boss, you've been working every angle on the Broken Isles, infusing that ancient artifact of yours with power. But those demons won't give up, and we really need to unlock more of your weapon's potential... and I mean pronto!

Slow, steady progress is one thing. But today, we need to get busy.

Here's the deal. You fork over our order's resources so I can study the weapon's history, and I'll get you a way to up the value of the power you apply to that artifact.

How does that sound, $ct?

Description.text:
头儿，你已经踏遍了破碎群岛的每个角落，为你的古代神器注入了许多能量。但那些恶魔是不会放弃的，我们急需解锁那把武器的更多潜力……马上就要！

缓慢稳妥的研究是一回事，但今天，我们得加快速度了。

我们这么办。你把职业大厅的资源交给我，我就能研究那把武器的历史，帮你找出增加神器能量的方法。

你觉得这买卖怎么样，$ct？

Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.

There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must hasten our efforts.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.

Shall we begin, $ct?

identity.objectives: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
In the course of trouncing foe after foe in the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But the Legion fights without honor, and to defeat them we must unlock even more of your weapon's potential.

Slow, steady progress will wait for another time. Today, we must hasten the path to victory.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we will rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.

Glory awaits us, $ct!

Description.text:
你在破碎群岛迎头痛击了一个又一个敌人，为你的古代神器注入了能量。但燃烧军团毫无荣誉可言，为了击败他们，我们必须尽快解锁你这把武器的潜力。

我们可以稍后再进行缓慢稳妥的研究。但现在，我们得加快向胜利迈进的步伐了。

将我们的职业大厅资源投入对武器历史的研究，我们就能加快你的神器获得能量的速度了。

荣耀在等着我们，$ct。
