identity.title: A Godly Invitation
identity.objectives: Speak with Odyn at your order hall in Skyhold.
identity.description: Battlelord $p, Odyn has requested an audience with you back in Skyhold.$b$bPlease meet with him at your earliest convenience.

Description.text: 战争领主$p，奥丁请你返回苍穹要塞觐见他。$b$b请在方便时尽快前往。
Description.english: Battlelord $p, Odyn has requested an audience with you back in Skyhold.$b$bPlease meet with him at your earliest convenience.

identity.title: Crystals Not Included
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Argunite Crystals.
identity.description: Turalyon is safe, and we can start to fight back.$b$bFirst things first, we must secure what supplies we can from the crash.$b$bEven though we are blessed by the Light, our ships still rely on crystal technology. From powering our defenses to arming our weapons, we will need to collect as much as we can to fight back against the enemy.$b$bVenture out into the crash and retrieve what crystals you can. While you are out there, keep an eye out for Y'mera. She was separated from us, and will need help.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个阿古尼特水晶。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Argunite Crystals.

identity.title: Begin Construction
identity.objectives: Use the Construction Table to donate Legionfall War Supplies to the construction of the Mage Tower, Nether Disruptor, or Command Center.
identity.description:
We've got the supplies. Now someone needs to decide what to do with 'em.

Hmm. Looks like it's your call, being the $ct and all!

Time to pick a building to focus on.

Description.text:
物资已经到手了。现在需要有人来决定该怎么使用它们。

嗯。看来得让你来拿主意，毕竟你是个$ct嘛！

是时候了，选择一个建筑作为努力的目标吧。
Description.english:
We've got the supplies. Now someone needs to decide what to do with 'em.

Hmm. Looks like it's your call, being the $ct and all!

Time to pick a building to focus on.

identity.title: Strike Them Down
identity.objectives: Slay 100 demons on the Broken Shore.
identity.description:
The Felstorm continues to rain demon scum upon these shores. Kil'jaeden believes his army infinite, his resources inexhaustible.

We will show him how wrong he is.

Cut a swath of retribution through their ranks, $ct. Strike down demon after demon, until your weapons are bathed in their blood. And when they cry out for mercy, send them screaming back into the Nether.

Description.text:
邪能风暴一直源源不断地将恶魔渣滓输送到海滩上。基尔加丹相信，他的大军无穷无尽，他的资源永不枯竭。

我们要让他看看，他错得有多么离谱。

冲进他们的阵地里去当中大杀四方吧，$ct。斩杀一只又一只的恶魔，让恶魔的鲜血浸透你的双手。让他们哭喊着求你饶命，让他们尖叫着滚回扭曲虚空。
Description.english:
The Felstorm continues to rain demon scum upon these shores. Kil'jaeden believes his army infinite, his resources inexhaustible.

We will show him how wrong he is.

Cut a swath of retribution through their ranks, $ct. Strike down demon after demon, until your weapons are bathed in their blood. And when they cry out for mercy, send them screaming back into the Nether.

identity.title: Defending Broken Isles
identity.objectives: Defeat a Legion Assault in the Broken Isles.
identity.description:
In our zeal to reclaim the Broken Shore from the Legion, we cannot allow the rest of this land to fall into the demons' foul grip.

Kil'jaeden has dispatched his forces across the Broken Isles, threatening the homelands of the allies you have made. You must answer their call in this hour of need.

Turn back these demon assaults with haste, $ct. The Armies of Legionfall will see that the Broken Shore remains secured.

Description.text:
虽然我们正在尽力从军团手中收复破碎海滩，但也不能让破碎群岛的其他地方落入军团的魔掌。

基尔加丹已经向破碎群岛各处派出了部队，威胁着你的新盟友的家园。在这个危急时刻，你必须回应他们的呼唤。

请迅速击退这些恶魔的突袭，$ct。抗魔联军会牢牢守住破碎海滩的。
Description.english:
In our zeal to reclaim the Broken Shore from the Legion, we cannot allow the rest of this land to fall into the demons' foul grip.

Kil'jaeden has dispatched his forces across the Broken Isles, threatening the homelands of the allies you have made. You must answer their call in this hour of need.

Turn back these demon assaults with haste, $ct. The Armies of Legionfall will see that the Broken Shore remains secured.

identity.title: Championing Our Cause
identity.objectives: Successfully complete a Legionfall mission at your Class Order Hall.
identity.description:
Important work has been done by your order, $ct. Your champions have succeeded time and again in undermining the Legion's invasion.

As we make preparations for our assault on the Tomb of Sargeras, we need to keep the demons off balance. By pressuring them at every turn, we will expose vulnerabilities that can be exploited to our advantage.

Send out your order's champions, $n. Their missions are vital to the success of our campaign... especially as our confrontation with Kil'jaeden draws closer.

Description.text:
你的组织作出了卓越贡献，$ct。你的勇士们也多次成功击退了军团的入侵。

在我们为突袭萨格拉斯之墓做准备期间，也不能让恶魔站稳脚跟。我们要在所有战场上打击他们的气焰，我们还要寻找他们的弱点并加以利用。

派出你们组织的勇士吧，$n。他们的任务对我们这场战役的成败至关重要……尤其是在我们即将直面基尔加丹的关键时刻。
Description.english:
Important work has been done by your order, $ct. Your champions have succeeded time and again in undermining the Legion's invasion.

As we make preparations for our assault on the Tomb of Sargeras, we need to keep the demons off balance. By pressuring them at every turn, we will expose vulnerabilities that can be exploited to our advantage.

Send out your order's champions, $n. Their missions are vital to the success of our campaign... especially as our confrontation with Kil'jaeden draws closer.

identity.title: Shard Times
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Nethershards on the Broken Shore.
identity.description: As you have surely noticed, a slain demon leaves behind Nethershards, solidified residual energy from the Twisting Nether. I require a significant quantity of them for an experiment I'm conducting... $1oa shards, to be precise.$b$bWhy are you looking at me like that? We've had this conversation before. I did the math.$b$bI need exactly $1oa shards. Fewer would be inadequate. More would be absurd.$b$bDon't question my methods. Go!

Objectives.text: 在破碎海滩收集$1oa块虚空碎片。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Nethershards on the Broken Shore.

Description.text: 你肯定注意到了，恶魔死后会留下一些虚空碎片，那是扭曲虚空的能量结晶。我正在进行的实验需要大量的这种碎片……确切来说，是$1oa块。$b$b你干嘛要用那种眼神看着我？我们早就讨论过了吧，我仔细算过的。$b$b我需要的，不多不少，就是$1oa块碎片。少了不够，多了不行。$b$b不要质疑我的算法。快去吧！
Description.english: As you have surely noticed, a slain demon leaves behind Nethershards, solidified residual energy from the Twisting Nether. I require a significant quantity of them for an experiment I'm conducting... $1oa shards, to be precise.$b$bWhy are you looking at me like that? We've had this conversation before. I did the math.$b$bI need exactly $1oa shards. Fewer would be inadequate. More would be absurd.$b$bDon't question my methods. Go!

identity.title: Darkbinder Dilemma
identity.objectives: Kill Darkbinder Elissath.
identity.description: Ah, Delas sent you. I see.$B$BIt's good she didn't come herself. It would break her heart to see what is happening to our family.$B$BA demon is defiling our dead in the ruins nearby. She's using her fel magic on our ancestors, turning them into mindless horrors that do the bidding of the Burning Legion.$B$BI can't deal with the harpies and this demon, but maybe you could help?$B$BGet rid of the darkbinder that torments our dead, and I will grant you access to whatever's left of the Moonfang family relics.

identity.title: Overwhelming Power
identity.objectives: Kill $4oa demons.
identity.description: We will find no sanctuary on this world. Even now the full might of the Burning Legion rises to defend Argus.$B$BThe siege camp below overflows with demon filth that stand between us and the weapon trained on the Vindicaar.$B$BThey must be dealt with before it can fully charge, or Argus will be our grave.

Objectives.text: 消灭$4oa个恶魔。
Objectives.english: Kill $4oa demons.

identity.title: Livin' on the Ledge
identity.objectives: Return to the Fel Hammer and speak with Matron Mother Malevolence.
identity.description: Slayer $p, Matron Mother Malevolence requests an audience with you back at the Fel Hammer. Please see her at your earliest convenience.

Description.text: 屠魔者$p，主母玛沃伦丝请你回邪能之槌号见她一面。请你方便时尽快去见她。
Description.english: Slayer $p, Matron Mother Malevolence requests an audience with you back at the Fel Hammer. Please see her at your earliest convenience.

identity.title: Lilies for Ryuli
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Moon Lilies for Waterspeaker Ryuli.
identity.description:
I have not seen Ban-Lu, but the waters will surely know where he is.

There is a flower that grows in the lakes of the mountain slopes near the Temple of the White Tiger, that only blooms in the presence of someone pure of heart.

Bring me six of these Moon Lilies and I shall use them to speak to the river.

Objectives.text: 为水语者云离收集$1oa朵月光百合。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Moon Lilies for Waterspeaker Ryuli.

identity.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Legend of the Deep

Title.text: 萨格拉斯之墓：深渊传说
Title.english: Tomb of Sargeras: Legend of the Deep

Title.text: 萨格拉斯之墓：压抑深渊

identity.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Life After Death

Title.text: 萨格拉斯之墓：死后的生命
Title.english: Tomb of Sargeras: Life After Death

identity.title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Dread Stalker

Title.text: 萨格拉斯之墓：恐怖追踪者
Title.english: Tomb of Sargeras: The Dread Stalker

Title.text: 萨格拉斯之墓：艾萨拉的影响

identity.title: To Track a Demon
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Impsorrow Missives from demons in Impsorrow Approach.
identity.description: I took the initiative to scout around before I grabbed that wyrmtongue. It seems like their forces are holed up in a camp in Impsorrow Approach. What I've struggled to figure out, however, is who their commander is and if he's nearby.$b$bIf he's leading from elsewhere, the troops need to have some commands on them. Let's go see if we can find any... on their dead bodies!

Objectives.text: 从鬼哭小径的恶魔身上收集$1oa个鬼哭公函。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Impsorrow Missives from demons in Impsorrow Approach.

identity.title: Nature's Touch
identity.objectives: Heal $1oa Injured Druids in Impsorrow Approach.
identity.description: Apparently we're not the only druids that have run into these demons. The Legion took a ton of captives and brought them back to their camp. Our brothers and sisters lay wounded and hurting...$b$bYou can heal! Let's go save them!

Objectives.text: 在鬼哭小径治疗$1oa个受伤的德鲁伊。
Objectives.english: Heal $1oa Injured Druids in Impsorrow Approach.

identity.title: Drapings of the Ancients
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Ancient Imbued Silkweave from humanoids in Broken Shore.
identity.description: $n, we are going to need a high quality cloth to work with. Thankfully, the weaving quality of nightborne craftspeople from long ago was very good. It is a lost art to some degree but I feel like you can take their masterworks and do even more with it. $b$bSome of the hostiles in these parts still wear Ancient Imbued Silkweave Armor. Start to unstitch the silkweave cloth from any of that armor that you find on Broken Shore.

Objectives.text: 从破碎海滩的人型生物身上获取$1oa块古代灌魔丝纹布。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Ancient Imbued Silkweave from humanoids in Broken Shore.

identity.title: The Legend of the Elderhide
identity.objectives: Capture Ancient Wisps in Val'sharah.
identity.description: Leatherworking is one of the oldest forms of craftsmanship in the world. Hides of animals were the first clothing. Legends tell of a particular form of leather curing that has been lost to us in modern times. $b$bCombining magic of the earth with some of the finest leathers ever found, this technique has been recreated by yours truly through careful analysis and my understanding of style. $b$bTo begin, you must capture some ancient wisps to channel the exact nature magic for the curing process.

identity.title: Leather of the Ancients
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa pieces of Ancient Dreadleather from humanoids in Broken Shore.
identity.description: $n, we are going to need high quality leather to work with. Ancient Dreadleather is the best hereabouts and local tanning techniques were exceptional in the past. To the untrained eye, it may look like normal dreadleather. That is where the wisp comes in. $b$bMany of your enemies across Broken Shore will have some amount of ancient dreadleather.  As you defeat them, you will start to recognize armor made from it and you can harvest the leather for our purposes.

Objectives.text: 从破碎海滩的人型生物身上获取$1oa张古代恐皮。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa pieces of Ancient Dreadleather from humanoids in Broken Shore.

identity.title: Mail of the Ancients
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Ancient Gravenscale from humanoids in Broken Shore.
identity.description: There is some wardenscale scattered here and there in the Broken Isles. Various enemies and local monsters seeking to ape the superior races like ourselves will have picked it up and worn it. $b$bThe kind we need is amongst the oldest ever made. It is ancient gravenscale. Keep all that you find and and bring it to me. We will harvest what useful bits we can from it.

Objectives.text: 从破碎海滩的人型生物身上获取$1oa片古代刻鳞。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Ancient Gravenscale from humanoids in Broken Shore.

identity.title: Armor of the Ancients
identity.objectives: Obtain $1oa Ancient Demonsteel from humanoids in Broken Shore.
identity.description: It is not just the hammers and my careful research that we need, $n. We also need a lot of the very highest quality of ancient metal to make the final hammer. $b$bEnemies across Broken Shore that are able to wear armor often collect bits of Ancient Demonsteel here and there. Collect enough of it in your battles for our purposes.

Objectives.text: 从破碎海滩的人型生物身上获取$1oa块古代邪钢。
Objectives.english: Obtain $1oa Ancient Demonsteel from humanoids in Broken Shore.

identity.title: Relieved of Their Valuables
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Hidden Wyrmtongue Caches on the Broken Shore.
identity.description:
Not all demons on this shore stomp around in the open. Some slink about in the shadows, finding more subtle ways to advance the Legion's cause.

I have been observing the behavior of smaller demons, these wyrmtongues. They seem to spend considerable time acquiring objects of power. We cannot allow them to use these items against us.

The wyrmtongues stash their goods in chests spread around the Broken Shore. I suggest you relieve them of their ill-gotten gain.

Objectives.text: 在破碎海滩找到$1oa个隐藏的虫语者箱子。
Objectives.english: Find $1oa Hidden Wyrmtongue Caches on the Broken Shore.

identity.title: The Bounties of Legionfall
identity.objectives: Speak with Captain Ruysantos on the Broken Shore for your reward.
identity.description:
$ct, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to secure additional resources from the battlefield.

The more you continue to dominate the battlefield the more resources our forces can spare.

Description.text:
$ct，多亏了你的努力，我们的军队从战场上成功获得了额外的资源。

只要你继续在战场上大杀四方，我们的军队就有更多的资源可以使用。
Description.english:
$ct, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to secure additional resources from the battlefield.

The more you continue to dominate the battlefield the more resources our forces can spare.

identity.title: Carried On the Wind
identity.objectives: Return to the Maelstrom and speak with Consular Celestos.
identity.description: Farseer $p, Consular Celestos has requested your presence back at the Maelstrom. Please see him at your earliest convenience.

Description.text: 先知$p，赛莱托斯大使请你返回大漩涡。请尽快与他会面。
Description.english: Farseer $p, Consular Celestos has requested your presence back at the Maelstrom. Please see him at your earliest convenience.

identity.title: Khazaduum, First of His Name
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Argunite Keystone from the Echo of Khazaduum.
identity.description: The Argunite Matrix that powered this part of Mac'Aree was shattered by a hulking beast. We had never seen another like him.$b$bHe was called Khazaduum and he was a most faithful servant of the Legion. He volunteered to undergo an experimental transformation to become the first of his kind. His arrival was the end of this battle.$b$bAs a prize he took the Argunite Keystone from the shattered matrix. Take it back and we can finally end this bloodshed.

PortraitGiverText.text: 卡扎杜姆第一个接受了可怕的改造，他获得了当时的艾瑞达无法想象的力量。
PortraitGiverText.english: Khazaduum was the first to undergo a horrific transformation, granting him strength unlike any known to the Eredar at the time.

identity.title: Prisoners No More
identity.objectives: Rescue $oa Darkfallen Slaves from the Annihilan Pits.
identity.description:
Hatuun's people have endured arduous times. Their numbers dwindle as those ripped from beyond the walls of their sanctuary become servants to the annihilan lords in the pits just beyond, sentenced to a life of labor, torture and ultimately, death.

Seek out these captives, release them from their bonds and show our allies we stand as one against the Burning Legion.

Objectives.text: 从安尼赫兰熔池中救出$oa名堕暗奴隶。
Objectives.english: Rescue $oa Darkfallen Slaves from the Annihilan Pits.

identity.title: A Strike at the Heart
identity.objectives: Slay Aggonar.
identity.description: These pits have long been a blight upon the lives of our new allies. The demons hunt them down and torture the poor souls for sport.$B$B<Turalyon shakes his head with disgust, fixing his gaze upon the beast before him.>$B$BIt is time to make them pay for their cruelty and restore hope to this Light-forsaken place.$b$bWe strike on your mark, $n.

identity.title: The Council's Call
identity.objectives: Seek out the Council of Six in the Violet Citadel.
identity.description:
I'm sorry that I haven't kept your apprised of the situation. We needed more actionable information before bringing the matter before you.

The Council of the Six has been investigating Legion threats outside of the Broken Shore. I believe this scroll to be the final piece of information we need.

Meet me in Dalaran at the Violet Citadel. We will need the other members of the Council.

AreaDescription.english: Seek out the Council of Six.

identity.title: Lost Souls
identity.objectives: Release $1oa Lost Souls.
identity.description:
Never in my life have I beheld such destruction... such misery. The very ground we walk on us paved with the bones of our allies.

Even now I can see the lost spirits of Alliance soldiers wandering the ruins.

I cannot leave this place without putting the souls of our brave soldiers to rest. We owe them... I owe them that much.

Objectives.text: 释放$1oa个迷失之魂。
Objectives.english: Release $1oa Lost Souls.

identity.title: Mark of the Sentinax
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Marks of the Sentinax.
identity.description:
The Sentinax rains down terror upon the Broken Shore, unleashing hordes of demons that menace our forces. The fiends seek to stop us from taking the Tomb.

They will fail.

Lure out the strongest among their vile ranks. Slay them and seize the marks they bear. Make the Legion fear our strength!

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa个森提纳克斯号印记。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Marks of the Sentinax.

identity.title: A Vessel Made Ready
identity.objectives: Defeat Nhal'athoth and collect his heart.
identity.description: After some consideration, I have decided to allow Alleria another opportunity to pursue her destiny.$b$bI suppose you want to know what that means, mortal.$b$b<Locus-Walker laughs.>$b$bMeet us deep in the Shadowguard camp ahead- my brethren are preparing a summons that will provide adequate energy for Windrunner to begin again.$b$bWitness what happens when you harness the Void's power.

PortraitGiverText.text: 纳拉索斯虽然只是个半神，但他的气息依然萦绕在玛凯雷的黑暗角落。
PortraitGiverText.english: Though only a demi-god, Nhal'athoth's presence haunts the dark corners of Mac'Aree.

identity.title: The Hand of Fate
identity.objectives: Meet your escort to the Exodar at Stormwind Harbor.
identity.description:
$p,

We have won many battles against the Burning Legion, but it is time to end this war once and for all. 

Final preparations have begun to depart for Argus.

Make haste to Stormwind Harbor. A ship awaits you there to grant you and your allies passage to Azuremyst.

Description.text:
"$p,

我们已经赢得许多对抗燃烧军团的战斗，但这一次我们要彻底终结这场战争。

最后的准备工作已经就绪，准备向阿古斯出发。

快点赶去暴风城港口。那里有艘船正在等着你，将会把你和你的盟友带往秘蓝岛。"
Description.english:
$p,

We have won many battles against the Burning Legion, but it is time to end this war once and for all. 

Final preparations have begun to depart for Argus.

Make haste to Stormwind Harbor. A ship awaits you there to grant you and your allies passage to Azuremyst.

identity.title: Fire At Will
identity.objectives: Enter a Lightforged Battery and slay $1oa Frenzied Plaguewings.
identity.description: Look out there, the wings of the bats fill the sky. We must offer what ranged support we can, but our hands are full here.$b$bIt looks like the Legion has not yet destroyed all of the artillery batteries. If you can get to one, you should be able to show those flying fiends the Light.

Objectives.text: 进入光铸炮台并杀死$1oa个疯狂的灾翼蝠。
Objectives.english: Enter a Lightforged Battery and slay $1oa Frenzied Plaguewings.

identity.title: The Best Prevention
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa attackers in the Shattered Fields.
identity.description: If you've brought the High Exarch back to us, you are a welcome ally indeed.$b$bMore is needed of you. You see our soldiers out there, fighting against all odds? Defend them. Slay the enemy.$b$bStrong words for a priest, perhaps, but every dead man'ari is one less blade at our throats.$b$bShow them that the Light protects its chosen even as it scorches the unfaithful.$b$bWhen you are finished, seek out Y'mera. She will have fewer troops, and more need of your abilities.

Objectives.text: 在破碎之野消灭$1oa个攻击者。
Objectives.english: Slay $1oa attackers in the Shattered Fields.

identity.title: Righteous Fury
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Legion Devastators.
identity.description: The devastators bombarding our forces prevent us from advancing any further. I can only protect us from their blasts for so long.$B$BChampion, you must pierce their lines and remove the barriers protecting the devastators.$B$BIf you can destroy the anchors that maintain the shields, I can cleanse them from afar.

Objectives.text: 摧毁$1oa个军团灭绝者。
Objectives.english: Destroy $1oa Legion Devastators.

identity.title: I Don't Need Them, But I'll Take Them
identity.objectives: Collect 10,000 Coins of Air for Griftah.
identity.description: If you wanna collect more, Griftah not gonna argue with dat. Dat bein' said, I don't need dem as much anymore, so I be givin' you less for dem.

AreaDescription.text: 为格里伏塔收集9999枚空气硬币。
AreaDescription.english: Collect 9999 Coins of Air for Griftah.

identity.title: Signs of Resistance
identity.objectives: Search for signs of resistance.
identity.description: Our forces sustained heavy losses defending the Vindicaar, $n. We require allies.$B$BThe Army of the Light was known to take in survivors of the Legion's crusade to bolster their ranks. We must do the same.$B$BI sense the presence of the Legion slaves you freed nearby. I suspect that they have carved out a resistance against their masters.$B$BI would appreciate your company, $p.

Description.text: 我们的部队在守卫维迪卡尔的时候承受了巨大的损失，$n。我们需要盟友的支援。$B$B圣光军团以吸收燃烧远征的幸存者，充实自己的力量而著称。我们也必须这么做。$B$B我感到附近有你释放的燃烧军团的奴隶。我猜他们已经开始对抗自己的主人。$B$B如果你能和我一起前去寻找就太好了，$p。
Description.english: Our forces sustained heavy losses defending the Vindicaar, $n. We require allies.$B$BThe Army of the Light was known to take in survivors of the Legion's crusade to bolster their ranks. We must do the same.$B$BI sense the presence of the Legion slaves you freed nearby. I suspect that they have carved out a resistance against their masters.$B$BI would appreciate your company, $p.

identity.title: The Defiler's Legacy
identity.objectives: Defeat Archimonde and retrieve the Sigil of Awakening.
identity.description: It seems you are not so easily deterred. Very well.$b$bYour deeds qualify you to seek the Sigil. To be clear, I am only permitting you to move on. This does not guarantee your success.$b$bThe greatest of your challenges lies before you.$b$bYou must go to the Praetorium and face Archimonde himself. Only by defeating the master of the Conservatory will you be worthy of the Sigil.$b$bFew have overcome this obstacle. I hope he does not make too much of a mess of you.

PortraitGiverText.text: 阿克蒙德并不知道自己会成为污染者，但他对力量的追求也不是从萨格拉斯出现时才开始的。
PortraitGiverText.english: Archimonde did not know he would become the Defiler, but his pursuit of power did not start when Sargeras arrived.

identity.title: Unsettled Power
identity.objectives: Bring $1oa Writhing Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
identity.description: The release of the energy previously trapped in the Nightwell has... complicated the influence of Aman'Thul scattered about the Broken Isles. Sadly, the results of my previous work have been invalidated, much like the contents of this vial.$b$bI must understand what has caused this change! Please, bring me more samples so that I may continue my work. It goes without saying that you will be the beneficiary of any breakthroughs I may find.

Objectives.text: 把$1oa个沸腾的精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
Objectives.english: Bring $1oa Writhing Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.

identity.title: Unsettled Power
identity.objectives: Bring $1oa Writhing Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
identity.description: It is deeply disconcerting that the power of Aman'thul grows increasingly unstable. We must pursue this matter further.$b$bIs this volatility the result of the Legion's corruption? No, that is too recent an influence. Something else must have...$b$b<Vridiel trails off absentmindedly, not looking directly at you.>

Objectives.text: 把$1oa个沸腾的精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
Objectives.english: Bring $1oa Writhing Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.

identity.title: The Hand of Fate
identity.objectives: Meet your escort to the Exodar at Bladefist Bay.
identity.description:
$p,

We have won many battles against the Burning Legion, but it is time to end this war once and for all. 

Final preparations have begun to depart for Argus.

Make haste to Bladefist Bay. A ship awaits you there to grant you and your allies passage to Azuremyst.

Description.text:
"$p,

我们已经赢得了许多对抗燃烧军团的战斗，但这一次我们要彻底终结这场战争。

最后的准备工作已经准备就绪，准备向阿古斯出发。

快点赶去刃拳海湾。那里有艘船正在等着你，将会把你和你的盟友带往秘蓝岛。"
Description.english:
$p,

We have won many battles against the Burning Legion, but it is time to end this war once and for all. 

Final preparations have begun to depart for Argus.

Make haste to Bladefist Bay. A ship awaits you there to grant you and your allies passage to Azuremyst.

identity.title: Across the Universe
identity.objectives: Defeat Talgath.
identity.description: Talgath. There was a time I called him an ally, a friend.$b$bI put my trust in him when it came time to leave Argus. I asked him to call out to the others who would join me.$b$bI gave him all that he needed to betray me and slaughter my followers.$b$bI do not know what brought this hatred to lurk in his heart, but his machinations repeatedly forced my people to flee world after world. He made it his mission to hunt us across the universe.$b$bThis must end, $n. Talgath must die.

PortraitGiverText.text: 作为基尔加丹手下的秘密狩猎大师，塔尔加斯一直在群星间追杀着德莱尼。
PortraitGiverText.english: Acting as Kil'jaeden's unseen, unspoken master of the hunt, Talgath pursued the draenei across the stars.

identity.title: An Argus Roper
identity.objectives: Return $1oa Wild Cragscalers to Lead Rider Jerek.
identity.description: My warriors stand no chance against even the smallest of the Legion's forces without our Cragscalers. If you can capture a few and bring them here, my warriors can better defend our people.

Objectives.text: 将$1oa头野生岩羊带给首席骑兵贾伊德。
Objectives.english: Return $1oa Wild Cragscalers to Lead Rider Jerek.

identity.title: Preventive Measures
identity.objectives: Use the Talisman of the Prophet to sanctify $1oa fallen Army of the Light warriors.
identity.description:
There is no end to the Legion's depravity. Every battle won, every world conquered, yields more souls to fuel their war machine.

They have not yet defiled all of the fallen warriors in the hold, but I fear it is only a matter of time. Please, take this talisman with you into the hold and use it to sanctify any corpses you encounter.

They deserve a better fate.

Objectives.text: 使用先知护符，净化$1oa名阵亡的圣光军团战士。
Objectives.english: Use the Talisman of the Prophet to sanctify $1oa fallen Army of the Light warriors.

identity.title: Chaos Theory
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Nath'raxxan Fleshcarvers, Nath'raxxan Doomshots, or Ravenous Soulhunters, and $2oa Nathrezim Banelord.
identity.description:
Despite their strength and their numbers, even the Burning Legion requires order to fight. Disrupt that order... and they fall like the rabble they are.

The plan is simple. Let chaos reign in their ranks, and the day will be ours.

Objectives.text: 消灭$1oa名纳斯拉克森裂肉者、纳斯拉克森末日射手或贪婪的猎魂犬，以及$2oa名纳斯雷兹姆怨毒领主。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Nath'raxxan Fleshcarvers, Nath'raxxan Doomshots, or Ravenous Soulhunters, and $2oa Nathrezim Banelord.

identity.title: Dark Machinations
identity.objectives: Dismantle $1oa Spires of Woe.
identity.description:
Eredar are adept at manipulating the fel that courses through this world. Those who do not shape it into living weapons build other armaments, like the Spires of Woe.

The spires will make it difficult for even a small force to penetrate the main stronghold. We must dismantle enough of them to clear the way before we advance upon it.

Objectives.text: 拆毁$1oa座哀伤尖塔。
Objectives.english: Dismantle $1oa Spires of Woe.

identity.title: Limited Supplies
identity.objectives: Go to the Petrified Forest and reclaim $1oa Used Vials.
identity.description: Hello, $n. It's good to see a fellow alchemist again.$b$bI've been supplying our camp with necessary potions to deal with the demons, but lately I've been running low on supplies. Normally when scouting parties go out, they return with empty vials, but as of late fewer have been returning.$b$bI try to recycle as much as I can, so you see, those vials are precious to me. If you'd be willing to go out and retrieve them, I could show you what I've been making to help combat the demons.

Objectives.text: 前往石化森林，回收$1oa个用过的瓶子。
Objectives.english: Go to the Petrified Forest and reclaim $1oa Used Vials.

identity.title: Tracking the Trackers
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Feflame Scavengers at the Annihilan Pits.
identity.description: $n, have I told you about my tracking potion? Our scouts use it to track demons, especially their "fiends".$b$bThose particular creatures tend to consume the astral glory in the area, making it difficult to replenish our stores of the herb.$b$bIf you could help thin their numbers out, it would greatly help us from having to search elsewhere for supplies. You can find many of them in the Annihilan Pits.$b$bI could also teach you the recipe for this potion for your effort.

Objectives.text: 消灭安尼赫兰熔池的$1oa头邪焰清道夫。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Feflame Scavengers at the Annihilan Pits.

identity.title: Ascending Alchemy
identity.objectives: Bring Funen $1oa Astral Glory, $2oa Primal Sargerite and an Infernal Alchemist Stone.
identity.description: I've seen other alchemists come through our camp carrying interesting looking trinkets. I believe they refer to them as... "alchemist stones"?$b$bI can sense the power they radiate, but they appear fel-tainted. The herb that grows on this planet is particularly good at cleansing corruption. I use it to purify the primal sargerite that's often found amongst the herbs.$b$bI'm certain that if we used a purified sargerite with one of those stones, we could elevate the power within it.

Objectives.text: 把$1oa株星辰之耀，$2oa个源生萨格里特以及一枚地狱火炼金石交给弗恩。
Objectives.english: Bring Funen $1oa Astral Glory, $2oa Primal Sargerite and an Infernal Alchemist Stone.

identity.title: Counterbalancing
identity.objectives: Gather Fiendish Leather and Lightweave Cloth and use Enstraa's Tanning Oil to create $1oa Purified Fiendish Leather.
identity.description: In the past, I was able to make glorious items from the beasts of this land. But then the Legion came and wiped out all those amazing beasts.$b$bNow I'm forced to use their polluted hides to craft armor for my allies. I have, however, found a way to remove their taint.$b$bThe cloth we use is made from special thread infused with Light energy. I devised an oil which when combined with the cloth purifies the leather and makes it usable.$b$bHere, take my oil and see for yourself.

Objectives.text: 收集恶魔皮革和光纹布，然后使用恩斯特拉的制革油制作$1oa块净化的恶魔皮革。
Objectives.english: Gather Fiendish Leather and Lightweave Cloth and use Enstraa's Tanning Oil to create $1oa Purified Fiendish Leather.

identity.title: Hindering the Legion War Machine
identity.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Gambit in the Wastes."
identity.description:
$ct, I could use your help. The Army of the Light is coordinating an attack against the Spirit Crucible, Terminus, and Shaper's Rise to cripple the Legion's ability to wage war outside of the Antoran Wastes. We do not have enough soldiers to defend our footholds and execute this operation.

Will you approach the $cs on our behalf? This gambit could succeed with them fighting by our side. We can paralyze the Legion war machine.

Description.text:
$ct，我需要你的帮助。圣光军团正在策划一场针对炼魂熔炉、终端船坞和塑造者高台的袭击，以削弱军团在安托兰废土以外发动战争的能力。但我们的士兵数量不足以在守卫据点的同时执行这项计划。

你是否可以代表我们去联系$cs？如果他们与我们并肩作战，这个计划就能够成功。我们也就能令燃烧军团的战争机器瘫痪。
Description.english:
$ct, I could use your help. The Army of the Light is coordinating an attack against the Spirit Crucible, Terminus, and Shaper's Rise to cripple the Legion's ability to wage war outside of the Antoran Wastes. We do not have enough soldiers to defend our footholds and execute this operation.

Will you approach the $cs on our behalf? This gambit could succeed with them fighting by our side. We can paralyze the Legion war machine.

identity.title: Strike Back
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Eredar ritualists and Lady Shahrazad in the Petrified Forest.
identity.description: As you may have seen, the ritualists in this forest kidnap our people and perform heinous rituals on them. The souls of our fallen now roam as twisted creatures. This sin cannot go unpunished. Kill as many ritualists as you are able, but be sure to strike at the dark demon that leads them.

Objectives.text: 在石化森林杀死$1oa名艾瑞达仪祭师和莎拉扎德夫人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Eredar ritualists and Lady Shahrazad in the Petrified Forest.

identity.title: Duskcloak Problem
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa panthara within the Petrified Forest.
identity.description:
Here in this forest, species of talbuk and panthara still roam. However, the balance has been disrupted and now the panthara risk hunting the talbuk to extinction. To ensure their survival, we must decrease the number of panthara.

Do not let their suffering linger. A swift death is the most merciful.

Objectives.text: 在石化森林里击杀$1oa头影豹。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa panthara within the Petrified Forest.

identity.title: A Stranger's Plea
identity.objectives: Heal $1oa Felbound Drudges.
identity.description:
My people... enslaved...

Beaten... within death's grasp...

<The cowled figure weakly raises his arm, handing you a small liquid skin.>

Help... us...

Objectives.text: 治疗$1oa名邪缚苦工。
Objectives.english: Heal $1oa Felbound Drudges.

identity.title: Strike Back
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Eredar ritualists and Lady Shahrazad in the Petrified Forest.
identity.description: The scroll details a dark spell which steals the souls from the neighboring Krokul to create a new demon, the Ur'zul. The scroll is signed by Lady Shahrazad.

Objectives.text: 在石化森林击杀$1oa名艾瑞达仪祭师和莎拉扎德夫人。
Objectives.english: Kill $1oa Eredar ritualists and Lady Shahrazad in the Petrified Forest.

identity.title: Further Supplying Krokuun
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Order Hall Resources.
identity.description:
This desolate place offers little for my people. Every hour is spent scraping together enough to survive. If I had more supplies, I could offer you another ridgestalker.

What say you, offworlder?

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa点职业大厅资源。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Order Hall Resources.

identity.title: Fuel of a Doomed World
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Pristine Argunite from Invasion Points, Rare encounters, or treasure chests on Argus.
identity.description: There is a rare and precious resource to be found in these wastes, $n.$b$bArgunite was once abundant on Argus. Its magical properties helped eredar civilization thrive. Far better for us to make use of its power than the Legion.$b$bSeek out all the pristine argunite you can, champion. Every bit you recover will aid our cause.

Objectives.text: 从阿古斯的侵入点、稀有怪物或宝藏处收集$1oa颗太古阿古尼特水晶。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Pristine Argunite from Invasion Points, Rare encounters, or treasure chests on Argus.

identity.title: Supplying Krokuun
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Order Hall Resources.
identity.description:
This desolate place offers little for my people. Every hour is spent scraping together enough to survive. If I had more supplies, I could offer you another ridgestalker.

What say you, offworlder?

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa点职业大厅资源。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Order Hall Resources.

identity.title: Seat of the Triumvirate: Dark Fissures

Title.english: Seat of the Triumvirate: Dark Fissures

identity.title: Supplies From the Argussian Reach
identity.objectives: Speak with Toraan the Revered on the Vindicaar.
identity.description:
$ct, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to locate resources and prevent them from falling into the Legion's hands.

With your continued assistance, we will be able to provide additional resources.

Description.text:
$ct，多亏了你的努力，我们的军队从战场上成功找到了这些资源，没让它们落入燃烧军团的手中。

只要你继续帮助我们，我们就可以提供额外的资源。
Description.english:
$ct, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to locate resources and prevent them from falling into the Legion's hands.

With your continued assistance, we will be able to provide additional resources.

identity.title: Essence of the Light Mother
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Vestiges of Light.
identity.description:
This is a crucial moment, $n. Our campaign must not lose momentum.

Though she has fallen, I still sense Xe'ra's presence all around us. The Light that shone within her heart can yet be a source of strength for our cause.

No doubt the loss of Xe'ra has deeply wounded Turalyon. I will do what I can to ease his troubled spirit while you gather the vestiges of the naaru that remain.

Objectives.text: 收集$1oa份圣光残迹。
Objectives.english: Collect $1oa Vestiges of Light.

identity.title: A Titanic Effort
identity.objectives: Bring $1oa Wakening Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
identity.description:
Illidan may have forced fate's hand, but bringing Argus so near to Azeroth has accelerated the reaction triggered by the Nightwell's collapse.

I believe the Legion's actions on Argus are further destabilizing the powers we've drawn upon unknowingly for many years.

It is clear that further studies are required.

Objectives.text: 将$1oa个觉醒精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
Objectives.english: Bring $1oa Wakening Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.

identity.title: A Titanic Effort
identity.objectives: Bring $1oa Wakening Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
identity.description:
The reaction's intensity is accelerating by the day. We may win the fight against the Legion only to lose something very dear to us.

Is this a portent of some greater upheaval to come? What fate awaits our world, $n?

I will seek answers at my forge, as I have done all my life. Your answers, I suspect, lie elsewhere.

Objectives.text: 将$1oa个觉醒精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
Objectives.english: Bring $1oa Wakening Essence to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
